texts.zh: 0A002 为配合空间、船用或移动式“核反应堆”使用而“专门设计”的发电或推进设备。（这些物项“受ITAR管辖”。见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分。）
texts.en: 0A002 Power generating or propulsion equipment “specially designed” for use with space, marine or mobile “nuclear reactors”. (These items are “subject to the ITAR.” See 22 CFR parts 120 through 130.)

texts.zh: 0A501 枪支（0A502霰弹枪、0A506半自动步枪、0A507半自动手枪和0A508半自动霰弹枪除外）及下列相关商品（ECCN 0A509针对ECCN 0A506、0A507或0A508列举或以其他方式描述的半自动枪支相关商品除外）（见受管制物项清单）。
texts.en: 0A501 Firearms (except 0A502 shotguns, 0A506 semi-automatic rifles, 0A507 semi-automatic pistols, and 0A508 semi-automatic shotguns) and related commodities (except semi-automatic related commodities enumerated or otherwise described in Eccn 0A509 for Eccns 0A506, 0A507, or 0A508) as follows (see List of Items controlled).

texts.zh: 除依据商业国家表确定许可要求外，向中华人民共和国出口和再出口ECCN 0A501.y.7枪支均须取得许可证。
texts.en: In addition to using the Commerce Country Chart to determine license requirements, a license is required for exports and reexports of ECCN 0A501.y.7 firearms to the People's Republic of China.

texts.en: $500 for 0A501.c, .d, .e, and .x if the ultimate destination is Canada.

texts.zh: 向国家组A:5或A:6列明的任何目的地发送ECCN 0A501.a、.b、.c、.d或.e物项，不得使用STA许可证例外（见EAR第740部分补充文件第1号）。向国家组A:6列明的任何目的地发送本条目任何物项，不得使用STA许可证例外（见EAR第740部分补充文件第1号）。
texts.en: License Exception STA may not be used for ECCN 0A501.a, .b, .c, .d, or .e, to any of the destinations listed in Country Group A:5 or A:6 (See supplement no.1 to part 740 of the EAR). License Exception STA may not be used for any item in this entry to any of the destinations listed in Country Group A:6 (See Supplement No.1 to part 740 of the EAR).

texts.zh: 受管制物项清单
texts.en: List of Items Controlled

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及某些相关零件、部件、配件和附属装置（包括容量超过50发的弹匣），见USML第I类。(2) 半自动步枪见ECCN 0A506。(3) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507。(4) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”见ECCN 0A502。(5) ECCN 0A506、0A507和0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(6) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见本条目.d、.x和.y。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and certain related parts, components, accessories, and attachments (including magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds). (2) See ECCN 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles. (3) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols. (4) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (5) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (6) See .d, .x, and .y of this entry for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用。
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的非自动且非半自动枪支。
texts.en: a. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic firearms equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.
Note 1 to paragraph 0A501.a:

texts.zh: ‘组合式手枪’受ECCN 0A501.a管制。‘组合式手枪’（亦称组合枪）至少具有一根膛线枪管和一根滑膛枪管（通常为霰弹枪式枪管）。
texts.en: 'Combination pistols' are controlled under ECCN 0A501.a. A 'combination pistol' (a.k.a., a combination gun) has at least one rifled barrel and at least one smoothbore barrel (generally a shotgun style barrel).
Note 2 to paragraph 0A501.a:

texts.zh: 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的半自动枪支受ECCN 0A506和0A507管制。
texts.en: Semi-automatic firearms equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less are controlled under ECCNs 0A506 and 0A507.

texts.zh: 0A501.a技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note to 0A501.a:

texts.zh: 0A501.a所述枪支包括膛室适配0.50 BMG枪弹的枪支。
texts.en: Firearms described in 0A501.a include those chambered for the .50 BMG cartridge.

texts.zh: b. 口径大于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）但小于或等于0.72英寸（18.0毫米）的非自动且非半自动步枪、卡宾枪、左轮手枪或手枪。
texts.en: b. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic rifles, carbines, revolvers or pistols with a caliber greater than .50 inches (12.7 mm) but less than or equal to .72 inches (18.0 mm).

texts.zh: c. 为本条目.a或.b款、ECCN 0A506或0A507或USML第I类管制商品“专门设计”的下列类型“零件”和“部件”（USML另有列举或规定，或受ECCN 0A509管制的除外）：枪管、弹巢、枪管延伸件、安装座（耳轴座）、枪机、枪机框、操作杆、导气活塞、扳机座、扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器，含有射击控制“零件”或“部件”（如扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器）的手枪握把，以及含有射击控制“零件”或“部件”的枪托。
texts.en: c. The following types of “parts” and “components” if “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507, or USML Category I (unless otherwise enumerated or elsewhere specified on the USML or controlled under ECCN 0A509): Barrels, cylinders, barrel extensions, mounting blocks (trunnions), bolts, bolt carriers, operating rods, gas pistons, trigger housings, triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors, pistol grips that contain fire control “parts” or “components” (e.g., triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors) and buttstocks that contain fire control “parts” or “components.”

texts.zh: 0A501.c技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note to 0A501.c:

texts.zh: 制造进度已达到加工出弹膛或膛线阶段的枪管毛坯，受0A501.c管制。
texts.en: Barrel blanks that have reached a stage in manufacturing in which they are either chambered or rifled are controlled by 0A501.c.

texts.zh: d. 为本条目.a或.b款或ECCN 0A506或0A507管制商品“专门设计”、容量为17至50发的可拆卸弹匣。
texts.en: d. Detachable magazines with a capacity of 17 to 50 rounds “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or controlled by ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507.

texts.zh: 0A501.d款注3
texts.en: Note 3 to paragraph 0A501.d

texts.zh: 容量为16发或以下的弹匣受0A501.x管制；容量超过50发的弹匣见USML第I类。仅容纳0A505.d管制空包弹的弹匣，视其容量受0A501.d或0A501.x管制。
texts.en: Magazines with a capacity of 16 rounds or less are controlled under 0A501.x; for magazines with a capacity greater than 50 rounds, see USML Category I. Magazines that hold only blank ammunition controlled under 0A505.d are controlled under 0A501.d or 0A501.x, depending on the magazine's capacity.

texts.zh: e. 为本条目.a或.b款管制商品“专门设计”的机匣（机框）及“完整闭锁机构”，包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
texts.en: e. Receivers (frames) and “complete breech mechanisms,” including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry.
Note 4 to 0A501.e:

texts.zh: 0A501.e所指机框（机匣），是指枪支上依法须标记序列号时具有或通常标有序列号的任何“零件”或“部件”。0A501.e款所指物项，与酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局作为枪支管理的“零件”或“部件”同义（见《美国法典》第18编第921(a)(3)条；《联邦法规》第27编第447、478和479部分）。
texts.en: Frames (receivers) under 0A501.e refers to any “part” or “component” of the firearm that has or is customarily marked with a serial number when required by law. This paragraph 0A501.e is synonymous with a “part” or “component” that is regulated by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (see 18 U.S.C. 921(a)(3); 27 CFR parts 447, 478, and 479,) as a firearm.
Note 5 to 0A501.e:

texts.zh: 为半自动枪支“专门设计”的机框（机匣）受ECCN 0A509.b或.c管制。
texts.en: Frames (receivers) “specially designed” for semi-automatic firearms are controlled under ECCN 0A509.b or .c.

texts.zh: f.至w. [保留]
texts.en: f. through w. [Reserved]

texts.zh: x. 为本条目.a至.c款、ECCN 0A506或0A507或USML项下分类商品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定、亦不受ECCN 0A509管制的“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: x. “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity classified under paragraphs .a through .c of this entry, a commodity classified under ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507, or the USML and not elsewhere specified on the USML or CCL or controlled under ECCN 0A509.

texts.zh: y. 为本ECCN、ECCN 0A506或0A507管制商品“专门设计”，或与USML第I类防务物品通用，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的下列特定“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
texts.en: y. Specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN, ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, or common to a defense article in USML Category I and not elsewhere specified in the USML or CCL as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor.

texts.zh: y.1. 不含任何射击控制“零件”或“部件”（如扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器）的枪托（包括可调式、折叠式、刀片式枪托和支撑托）、握把、护木或前托；
texts.en: y.1. Stocks (including adjustable, collapsible, blades and braces), grips, handguards, or forends, that do not contain any fire control “parts” or “components” (e.g., triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors);

texts.zh: y.2至y.5. [保留]
texts.en: y.2 through y.5. [Reserved]

texts.zh: y.6. 刺刀；以及
texts.en: y.6. Bayonets; and

texts.zh: y.7. 1890年至1898年制造的枪支及其仿制品。
texts.en: y.7. Firearms manufactured from 1890 to 1898 and reproductions thereof.

texts.zh: 0A501技术注1：
texts.en: Technical Note 1 to 0A501:

texts.zh: ECCN 0A501包括不“受ITAR管辖”的“零件”和“部件”，即使它们可通用于ECCN 0A501所述枪支及“受ITAR管辖”的枪支。
texts.en: ECCN 0A501 includes “parts” and “components” that are not “subject to the ITAR” even though they are common to firearms described in ECCN 0A501 and to those firearms “subject to the ITAR.”

texts.zh: 0A501技术注2：
texts.en: Technical Note 2 to 0A501:

texts.zh: 带有任何其他受管制“零件”或“部件”（如枪管（0A501.c）、扳机护圈（0A501.x）或枪托（0A501.y.1））的机匣，仍受0A501.e管制。
texts.en: A receiver with any other controlled “part” or “component” ( e.g., a barrel (0A501.c), or trigger guard (0A501.x), or stock (0A501.y.1)) is still controlled under 0A501.e.

texts.zh: 0A501技术注3：
texts.en: Technical Note 3 to 0A501:

texts.zh: 空包弹射击适配器归为EAR99。该适配器是半自动和自动枪支的附属装置，为安全和正常工作而与空包弹配合使用，用于警察、军队、体育射击人员的枪械训练，也用于电影行业。
texts.en: Blank firing adapters, which are attachments to semi-automatic and automatic firearms used in conjunction with blank cartridges for safety and functional reasons and used for firearm training purposes by police, military, sporting shooters, as well as in the movie industry, are designated as EAR99.
Note 6 to 0A501:

texts.zh: 古董枪支（即1890年以前制造的枪支）及其仿制品、前装枪和黑火药枪（基于1937年后设计的中心发火武器设计者除外）、BB枪、铅弹气步枪、彩弹枪及所有其他气步枪，均为EAR99商品。
texts.en: Antique firearms (i.e., those manufactured before 1890) and reproductions thereof, muzzle loading and black powder firearms except those designs based on centerfire weapons of a post 1937 design, BB guns, pellet rifles, paint ball, and all other air rifles are EAR99 commodities.
Note 7 to 0A501:

texts.zh: 1937年后制造、口径小于20毫米、用于狩猎或体育用途、非为军事用途“专门设计”、未在USML中描述且不作为霰弹枪受ECCN 0A502管制的前装枪和黑火药枪，属于EAR99商品。
texts.en: Muzzle loading and black powder firearms with a caliber less than 20 mm that were manufactured post 1937 that are used for hunting or sporting purposes that were not “specially designed” for military use and are not described on the USML nor controlled as shotguns under ECCN 0A502 are EAR99 commodities.
Note 8 to 0A501:

texts.zh: 受EAR管辖的瞄准镜座或附件导轨、机械瞄具、背带环和枪托底板或后坐垫，归为EAR99。已确定这些商品不再应按ECCN 0A501视为“专门设计”。
texts.en: Scope mounts or accessory rails, iron sights, sling swivels, and butt plates or recoil pads that are subject to the EAR are designated as EAR99. These commodities have been determined to no longer warrant being “specially designed” for purposes of ECCN 0A501.
Note 9 to 0A501:

texts.zh: 通常成套销售和出口的枪支“零件”或“部件”套件，包括更换或维修套件，按其中管制最严格的“零件”或“部件”分类。例如，含有0A501.y和.x“零件”的套件按0A501.x套件管制，因为.x“零件”是该套件中管制最严格的“零件”。以拆解套件形式提供的完整0A501枪支，按0A501.a、.b或.y.7项下枪支管制。
texts.en: A kit, including a replacement or repair kit, of firearms “parts” or “components” customarily sold and exported together takes on the classification of the most restrictive “part” or “component” that is included in the kit. For example, a kit containing 0A501.y and .x “parts,” is controlled as a 0A501.x kit because the .x “part” is the most restrictive “part” included in the kit. A complete 0A501 firearm disassembled in a kit form is controlled as a firearm under 0A501.a, .b, or .y.7.

texts.zh: 0A502 霰弹枪（0A508半自动霰弹枪除外）及下列相关商品（ECCN 0A509针对ECCN 0A508列举或以其他方式描述的半自动枪支相关商品除外）（见受管制物项清单）。
texts.en: 0A502 Shotguns (except 0A508 semi-automatic shotguns) and related commodities (except semi-automatic related commodities enumerated or otherwise described in ECCN 0A509 for ECCN 0A508) as follows (see List of Items controlled).

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML所述霰弹枪见USML第I类。(2) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508。(3) ECCN 0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(4) 为0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见0A501.d、.x和.y。(5) 非半自动枪支见ECCN 0A501，半自动步枪见0A506，半自动手枪见0A507。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for shotguns described therein. (2) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns. (3) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCN 0A508. (4) See 0A501.d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A508. (5) See ECCNs 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms, 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles, and 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols.

texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 非自动且非半自动的中心发火（非边缘发火）霰弹枪。
texts.en: a. Non-automatic and non-semi automatic centerfire (non-rimfire) shotguns.

texts.zh: b. 非自动且非半自动的边缘发火霰弹枪。
texts.en: b. Non-automatic and non-semi automatic rimfire shotguns.

texts.zh: c. 用于本条目.a或.b款、ECCN 0A508或USML第I类管制商品的完整扳机机构（USML另有列举或规定的除外）。
texts.en: c. Complete trigger mechanisms for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry, ECCN 0A508, or USML Category I (unless otherwise enumerated or elsewhere specified on the USML).

texts.zh: d. 用于本条目.a或.b款或ECCN 0A508管制商品的弹匣和弹匣延长管。
texts.en: d. Magazines and magazine extension tubes for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or controlled by ECCN 0A508.

texts.en: e. “Complete breech mechanisms” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry.
Note 1 to paragraph 0A502.e:

texts.zh: 为半自动霰弹枪“专门设计”的机框（机匣）受ECCN 0A509.d管制。
texts.en: Frames (receivers) “specially designed” for semi-automatic shotguns are controlled under ECCN 0A509.d.
Note 2 to 0A502:

texts.zh: ECCN 0A502不管制用于屠宰家畜或专用于治疗动物、使动物镇静的设备；也不管制专为发射信号、照明弹或鸣礼用途设计的武器。
texts.en: ECCN 0A502 does not control equipment used to slaughter domestic animals or used exclusively to treat or tranquilize animals; or arms designed solely for signal, flare, or saluting use.
Note 3 to 0A502:

texts.zh: 1898年或以前制造的霰弹枪视为古董霰弹枪，归为EAR99。
texts.en: Shotguns made in or before 1898 are considered antique shotguns and designated as EAR99.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 非自动且非半自动的霰弹手枪，或去掉肩托并加装手枪握把的霰弹枪，受ECCN 0A502管制。非自动且非半自动的独头弹枪同样受ECCN 0A502管制。
texts.en: Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic shot pistols or shotguns that have had the shoulder stock removed and a pistol grip attached are controlled by ECCN 0A502. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic slug guns are also controlled under ECCN 0A502.

texts.zh: 0A503 发射式武器；非致命或较低致命性手榴弹和弹丸，以及为这些弹丸“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”；施加电击的装置，例如电击枪、电击警棍、电击盾牌、电动赶牛棒、制动枪及其弹丸；但用于屠宰家畜或专用于治疗动物、使动物镇静的设备，以及专为发射信号、照明弹或鸣礼用途设计的武器除外；以及未在其他处规定的“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: 0A503 Discharge type arms; non-lethal or less-lethal grenades and projectiles, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” of those projectiles; and devices to administer electric shock, for example, stun guns, shock batons, shock shields, electric cattle prods, immobilization guns and projectiles; except equipment used to slaughter domestic animals or used exclusively to treat or tranquilize animals, and except arms designed solely for signal, flare, or saluting use; and “specially designed” “parts” and “components,” n.e.s.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 榴弹炮、火炮、大炮、迫击炮和无后坐力炮等现代重型武器的弹药，以及固有军事用途弹药（如预先装入弹链或弹带的弹药、无壳弹、曳光弹、带有贫铀弹丸或硬化弹尖/弹芯的弹药及带爆炸弹丸的弹药），见USML第III类。(2) 用于前装枪支的击发帽、铅丸和弹头属于EAR99物项。(3) 箭形、燃烧、曳光或爆炸性霰弹枪弹丸，见USML第III类。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category III for ammunition for modern heavy weapons such as howitzers, artillery, cannon, mortars and recoilless rifles as well as inherently military ammunition types such as ammunition preassembled into links or belts, caseless ammunition, tracer ammunition, ammunition with a depleted uranium projectile or a projectile with a hardened tip or core and ammunition with an explosive projectile. (2) Percussion caps, and lead balls and bullets, for use with muzzle-loading firearms are EAR99 items. (3) See USML Category III for shotgun projectiles that are flechettes, incendiary, tracer, or explosive.

texts.zh: 相关定义：‘标记弹’为非致命弹药，通常用于训练，其胶囊内装有不属于化学刺激剂的染料或涂料。
texts.en: Related Definitions: 'Marking rounds' are non-lethal, typically used for training purposes, and contain a dye or paint in a capsule that is not a chemical irritant.

texts.zh: a. 用于ECCN 0A501、0A506或0A507或USML第I类管制枪支，且未在本条目.b、.c或.d款列举或USML第III类描述的弹药。
texts.en: a. Ammunition for firearms controlled by ECCNs 0A501, 0A506, or 0A507 or USML Category I and not enumerated in paragraph .b, .c, or .d of this entry or described in USML Category III.

texts.zh: b. 鹿弹霰弹枪弹（4号、直径0.24英寸及以上，任何材料），以及仅装鹿弹或用于散布化学刺激剂的霰弹枪弹。
texts.en: b. Buckshot (No. 4 .24” diameter and larger, any material) shotgun shells and shotgun shells that contain only buckshot, or are for the dispersion of chemical irritants.

texts.zh: c. 不含鹿弹的霰弹枪弹（包括较低致命性弹药）；以及霰弹枪弹的“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: c. Shotgun shells (including less than lethal rounds) that do not contain buckshot; and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” of shotgun shells.

texts.zh: d. 用于ECCN 0A501、0A502、0A506、0A507或0A508管制枪支，且未在USML第III类描述的空包弹。
texts.en: d. Blank ammunition for firearms controlled by ECCNs 0A501, 0A502, 0A506, 0A507, or 0A508 and not described in USML Category III.

texts.en: Technical Note to 0A505.d:

texts.zh: 包括以涂料/染料为弹丸的‘标记弹’。
texts.en: Includes 'marking rounds' that have paint/dye as the projectile.

texts.zh: x. 为本ECCN管制商品或USML第III类防务物品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: x. “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN or a defense article in USML Category III and not elsewhere specified on the USML or the CCL.
Note 1 to 0A505.x:

texts.zh: 本条目对“零件”和“部件”的管制包括伯丹式和博克瑟式底火、金属弹壳以及标准金属弹丸，例如全金属被甲弹、铅芯弹、铜弹丸和易碎弹丸。
texts.en: The controls on “parts” and “components” in this entry include Berdan and boxer primers, metallic cartridge cases, and standard metallic projectiles such as full metal jacket, lead core, copper projectiles, and frangible projectiles.
Note 2 to 0A505:

texts.zh: 小于4号鹿弹的金属弹丸、未装填且未装底火的霰弹枪弹壳、霰弹枪弹托、无烟火药、‘假弹’和‘训练弹’（已连接成弹链或弹带者除外），如不含致命或非致命弹丸，归为EAR99。‘假弹’或‘训练弹’是完全惰性的弹药（即不含底火、发射药或爆炸装药），通常用于检查武器功能及人员训练。
texts.en: Metal shot smaller than No. 4 Buckshot, empty and unprimed shotgun shells, shotgun wads, smokeless gunpowder, 'dummy rounds' and 'drill rounds' (unless linked or belted), not incorporating a lethal or non-lethal projectile(s) are designated EAR99. A 'dummy round' or 'drill round' is a round that is completely inert, (i.e., contains no primer, propellant, or explosive charge). It is typically used to check weapon function and for crew training.
Note 3 to 0A505:

texts.zh: 含有两颗或以上、尺寸大于0.24英寸的球形弹丸/霰弹的霰弹枪弹，受0A505.b管制。
texts.en: Shotgun shells that contain two or more balls/shot larger than .24-inch are controlled under 0A505.b.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及容量超过50发的弹匣，见USML第I类。(2) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507，但使用例如AR式或AK式机匣（机框）构成的手枪除外，此类手枪受ECCN 0A506管制。(3) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(4) ECCN 0A506、0A507和0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(5) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见0A501.c、.d、.x和.y。(6) 受EAR管辖的非半自动枪支（0A502霰弹枪除外）及相关商品，见ECCN 0A501。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds. (2) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols, excluding pistols built with, e.g., AR- or AK-style receivers (frames), which are controlled under ECCN 0A506. (3) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (4) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (5) See 0A501.c, .d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (6) See ECCN 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms (except 0A502 shotguns) and related commodities that are subject to the EAR. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices.

texts.en: a. Semi-automatic centerfire (non-rimfire) rifles equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.

texts.zh: 0A509.b和.c所指机匣（机框），是指枪支上依法须标记序列号时具有或通常标有序列号的任何“零件”或“部件”。0A509.b和.c款所指物项，与酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局作为枪支管理的“零件”或“部件”同义（见《美国法典》第18编第921(a)(3)条；《联邦法规》第27编第447、478和479部分）。就0A509.c而言，机匣（机框）包括法律上作为枪支的底架“部件”（即在现代手枪中，底架本身即为标记序列号的枪支）。
texts.en: Receivers (frames) under 0A509.b and .c refers to any “part” or “component” of the firearm that has or is customarily marked with a serial number when required by law. Paragraph 0A509.b and .c are synonymous with a “part” or “component” that is regulated by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (see 18 U.S.C. 921(a)(3); 27 CFR parts 447, 478, and 479,) as a firearm. For 0A509.c, receivers (frames) includes chassis “components” that serve as the legal firearm ( i.e., with modern pistols, the chassis itself is the serialized firearm).

texts.en: 0A521 commodities are subject to RS1 controls with no license exception eligibility other than License Exception GOV for U.S. Government personnel and agencies under § 740.11(b)(2)(ii) of the EAR, or an item-specific license exception identified in Supplement No. 5 to part 774 particular to an item covered under ECCN 0A521. The list of commodities determined to be classified under ECCN 0A521 controls is published in Supplement No. 5 to part 774. The license requirements and licensing policy relating to ECCN 0A521 are set forth in § 742.6(a)(8) of the EAR.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”，且未在USML第VII类列举或以其他方式描述的地面车辆，无论有人驾驶还是无人驾驶。
texts.en: a. Ground vehicles, whether manned or unmanned, “specially designed” for a military use and not enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VII.

texts.zh: a款注1：
texts.en: Note 1 to paragraph a:

texts.zh: 就a款而言，“地面车辆”包括：(i) 1956年之前制造、1955年以后未改装，且不含可正常使用武器或经维修即可恢复使用武器的坦克和装甲车辆；(ii) 军用铁路列车，但已武装或为发射导弹“专门设计”者除外；(iii) 非装甲军用抢救车辆和其他支援车辆；(iv) 非装甲、无武装、带有0.50口径或以下枪支安装座或挂点的车辆；以及(v) 为配合USML第VII类或ECCN 0A606.a列举的其他地面车辆使用而“专门设计”，且未在USML第VII类单独列举或以其他方式描述的拖车。就本注而言，“改装”不包括加装法律要求的安全设施、外观变更（如改换涂漆或调整螺栓孔位置），或加装1956年以前已有的“零件”或“部件”。
texts.en: For purposes of paragraph a, “ground vehicles” include (i) tanks and armored vehicles manufactured prior to 1956 that have not been modified since 1955 and that do not contain a functional weapon or a weapon capable of becoming functional through repair; (ii) military railway trains except those that are armed or are “specially designed” to launch missiles; (iii) unarmored military recovery and other support vehicles; (iv) unarmored, unarmed vehicles with mounts or hard points for firearms of .50 caliber or less; and (v) trailers “specially designed” for use with other ground vehicles enumerated in USML Category VII or ECCN 0A606.a, and not separately enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VII. For purposes of this note, the term “modified” does not include incorporation of safety features required by law, cosmetic changes (e.g., different paint or repositioning of bolt holes) or addition of “parts” or “components” available prior to 1956.

texts.zh: a款注2：
texts.en: Note 2 to paragraph a:

texts.zh: 为确定.a款管制，地面车辆为军事用途“专门设计”，是指其结构、电气或机械特征涉及一个或多个为军事用途“专门设计”的“部件”。这些“部件”包括：
texts.en: A ground vehicle's being “specially designed” for military use for purposes of determining controls under paragraph .a. entails a structural, electrical or mechanical feature involving one or more “components” that are “specially designed” for military use. Such “components” include:

texts.zh: a. “专门设计”为防弹型的充气轮胎外胎；
texts.en: a. Pneumatic tire casings of a kind “specially designed” to be bullet-proof;

texts.zh: b. 对重要“零件”（如油箱或驾驶室）的装甲防护；
texts.en: b. Armored protection of vital “parts” (e.g., fuel tanks or vehicle cabs);

texts.zh: c. 武器专用加固结构或安装座；
texts.en: c. Special reinforcements or mountings for weapons;

texts.zh: d. 灯火管制照明装置。
texts.en: d. Black-out lighting.

texts.zh: b. 下列其他地面车辆、“零件”和“部件”：
texts.en: b. Other ground vehicles, “parts” and “components,” as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 由民用车辆衍生并具有以下所有特征的无武装车辆：
texts.en: b.1. Unarmed vehicles that are derived from civilian vehicles and that have all of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 使用或加装反应式或电磁装甲以外的材料或“部件”，以提供等于或优于III级（美国国家司法研究所标准0108.01，1985年9月）或“同等标准”的弹道防护；
texts.en: b.1.a. Manufactured or fitted with materials or “components” other than reactive or electromagnetic armor to provide ballistic protection equal to or better than level III (National Institute of Justice standard 0108.01, September 1985) or “equivalent standards”;

texts.zh: b.1.b. 配有同时驱动前后轮的传动系统，包括为承载而增设车轮的车辆，无论该附加车轮是否驱动；
texts.en: b.1.b. A transmission to provide drive to both front and rear wheels simultaneously, including those for vehicles having additional wheels for load bearing purposes whether driven or not;

texts.zh: b.1.c. 车辆额定总质量（GVWR）大于4,500千克；以及
texts.en: b.1.c. Gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) greater than 4,500 kg; and

texts.zh: b.1.d. 为越野使用而设计或改装。
texts.en: b.1.d. Designed or modified for off-road use.

texts.zh: b.2. 具有以下所有特征的“零件”和“部件”：
texts.en: b.2. “Parts” and “components” having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 为本条目.b.1款规定的车辆“专门设计”；以及
texts.en: b.2.a. “Specially designed” for vehicles specified in paragraph .b.1 of this entry; and

texts.zh: b.2.b. 提供等于或优于III级（美国国家司法研究所标准0108.01，1985年9月）或“同等标准”的弹道防护。

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML第XIII类管制的防务物品（如依据保密信息制成的材料）及其直接相关技术数据（包括软件），受ITAR管辖。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 自携式潜水和水下游泳装置及相关商品的管制，见ECCN 8A620.f。(4) 机器人、机器人控制器和机器人末端执行器的管制，见USML第VII类及ECCN 0A606和2B007。(5) 为军事用途而与USML或“600系列”ECCN管制设备配合使用所“专门设计”的“数据库”（即参数化技术数据库），受适用于相应物项的技术数据和技术管制。(6) 为军事用途“专门设计”的核发电设备或推进设备（包括“核反应堆”）及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”的管制，见USML第VI、XIII、XV和XX类。(7) 为军用“核反应堆”“专门设计”的模拟器，受USML第IX(b)类管制。(8) 为军事用途“专门设计”的“激光”防护设备（如眼睛和传感器防护），见USML第X、XI和XII类。(9) 为USML中的防务物品或“600系列”ECCN管制商品“专门设计”的“燃料电池”，按相应最终产品所属的“600系列”ECCN管制。(10) 为卫星或航天器“专门设计”的燃料电池管制，见USML第XV类。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Defense articles, such as materials made from classified information, that are controlled by USML Category XIII, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are subject to the ITAR. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) For controls on self-contained diving and underwater swimming apparatus and related commodities, see ECCN 8A620.f. (4) For controls on robots, robot controllers, and robot end-effectors, see USML Category VII and ECCNs 0A606 and 2B007. (5) “Libraries,” i.e., parametric technical databases, “specially designed” for military use with equipment controlled by the USML or a “600 series” ECCN are controlled by the technical data and technology controls pertaining to such items. (6) For controls on nuclear power generating equipment or propulsion equipment, including “nuclear reactors,” “specially designed” for military use, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor, see USML Categories VI, XIII, XV, and XX. (7) Simulators “specially designed” for military “nuclear reactors” are controlled by USML Category IX(b). (8) See USML Categories X, XI and XII for “laser” protection equipment (e.g., eye and sensor protection) “specially designed” for military use. (9) “Fuel cells” “specially designed” for a defense article on the USML or a commodity controlled by a “600 series” ECCN are controlled according to the corresponding “600 series” ECCN for such end items. (10) See USML Category XV for controls on fuel cells “specially designed” for satellite or spacecraft.

texts.en: y.3. ISO intermodal containers or demountable vehicle bodies (i.e., swap bodies), n.e.s., “specially designed” or 'modified' for shipping or packing defense articles or items controlled by a “600 series” ECCN.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就0A617.y.3而言，‘改装’是指任何结构、电气、机械或其他变化，使非军事物项具备相当于为军事用途“专门设计”物项的军事能力。
texts.en: For the purpose of 0A617.y.3, 'modified' means any structural, electrical, mechanical, or other change that provides a non-military item with military capabilities equivalent to an item which is “specially designed” for military use.

texts.zh: y.4. 为军事用途“专门设计”的野战发电机。
texts.en: y.4. Field generators “specially designed” for military use.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) “军事商品”如含有受《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR，《联邦法规》第22编第120—130部分）管辖的物项，即受国务院出口许可管辖。(2) 本款所述“军事商品”如列于《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）并位于美国境内，即受国务院出口许可管辖。(3) 无论在美国境内或境外，就受ITAR管辖防务物品的设计、开发、工程、制造、生产、组装、测试、修理、维护、改装、操作、非军事化、销毁、加工或使用向外国人提供协助（包括培训），或向外国人提供受《联邦法规》第22编§121.1管制的任何技术数据，均属国务院许可管辖。(4) 对受ITAR管辖“军事商品”开展的经纪活动（定义见《联邦法规》第22编第129部分），属国务院许可管辖。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) “Military commodities” are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State if they incorporate items that are subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130). (2) “Military commodities” described in this paragraph are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State if such commodities are described on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121) and are in the United States. (3) The furnishing of assistance (including training) to foreign persons, whether in the United States or abroad, in the design, development, engineering, manufacture, production, assembly, testing, repair, maintenance, modification, operation, demilitarization, destruction, processing, or use of defense articles that are subject to the ITAR; or the furnishing to foreign persons of any technical data controlled under 22 CFR 121.1 whether in the United States or abroad are under the licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State. (4) Brokering activities (as defined in 22 CFR 129) of “military commodities” that are subject to the ITAR are under the licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State.

texts.zh: 相关定义：“军事商品”是指《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）或《常规武器和两用物品及技术出口管制瓦森纳安排》公布的军品清单（即瓦森纳安排军品清单，WAML）所述物品、材料或物资，但不包括软件、技术、列于末三位数字为018的任何ECCN中的物项，或任何“600系列”物项。
texts.en: Related Definitions: “Military commodity” or “military commodities” means an article, material or supply that is described on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121) or on the Munitions List that is published by the Wassenaar Arrangement on Export Controls for Conventional Arms and Dual-Use Goods and Technologies (i.e., the Wassenaar Arrangement Munitions List (WAML)), but does not include software, technology, any item listed in any ECCN for which the last three numerals are 018, or any item in the “600 series.”

texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 在美国境外生产并位于美国境外、不受《国际武器贸易条例》（《联邦法规》第22编第120—130部分）管辖，且具有以下任一特征的“军事商品”：
texts.en: a. “Military commodities” produced and located outside the United States that are not subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (22 CFR parts 120-130) and having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产受管制内容，该内容分类于ECCN 6A002、6A003或6A993.a（最大帧频等于或小于9 Hz，因而符合6A003.b.4注3.a的标准）；
texts.en: a.1. Incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin controlled content classified under ECCNs 6A002, 6A003, or 6A993.a (having a maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz and thus meeting the criterion of Note 3.a to 6A003.b.4);

texts.zh: a.2. 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容（见EAR §734.4）；或
texts.en: a.2. Incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content (see § 734.4 of the EAR); or

texts.zh: a.3. 属于美国原产“600系列”技术或软件的直接产品（见EAR §734.9(d)）。
texts.en: a.3. Are direct products of U.S.-origin “600 series” technology or software (see § 734.9(d) of the EAR).

texts.zh: 0A977水炮系统例如包括装有遥控水炮的车辆或固定站，其设计通过装甲、防碎车窗、金属防护网、防撞杆或缺气保用轮胎等特征，保护操作人员免受外部骚乱伤害。为水炮“专门设计”的部件例如包括：甲板式水炮喷嘴、水泵、储水罐、经加固或屏蔽以防弹射物损伤的摄像机和灯具、用于这些物项的升降桅杆及遥控操作系统。
texts.en: 0A977 water cannon systems include, for example: vehicles or fixed stations equipped with remotely operated water cannon that are designed to protect the operator from an outside riot with features such as armor, shatter resistant windows, metal screens, bull-bars, or run-flat tires. Components “specially designed” for water cannons may include, for example: deck gun water nozzles, pumps, reservoirs, cameras, and lights that are hardened or shielded against projectiles, elevating masts for those items, and teleoperation systems for those items.

texts.zh: ‘支撑剂’是一种固体材料，通常为经处理的砂或人造陶瓷材料，设计用于在压裂处理期间或之后保持诱导产生的水力裂缝开启。其加入‘压裂液’中；压裂液的组成可随压裂类型变化，可以凝胶、泡沫或滑溜水为基础。
texts.en: A 'proppant' is a solid material, typically treated sand or man-made ceramic materials, designed to keep an induced hydraulic fracture open, during or following a fracturing treatment. It is added to a 'fracking fluid' which may vary in composition depending on the type of fracturing used, and can be gel, foam or slickwater-based.

texts.en: 0D521 Any software subject to the EAR that is not listed elsewhere in the CCL, but which is controlled for export because it provides at least a significant military or intelligence advantage to the United States or for foreign policy reasons.

texts.zh: 0D521软件受RS1管制，除EAR §740.11(b)(2)(ii)针对美国政府人员和机构的GOV许可证例外，或第774部分补充文件第5号针对ECCN 0D521所涵盖特定物项列明的物项专属许可证例外外，不具备其他许可证例外资格。确定归入ECCN 0D521管制的软件清单公布于第774部分补充文件第5号。ECCN 0D521相关许可要求和许可政策见EAR §742.6(a)(8)。
texts.en: 0D521 software is subject to RS1 controls with no license exception eligibility other than License Exception GOV for U.S. Government personnel and agencies under § 740.11(b)(2)(ii) of the EAR, or an item-specific license exception identified in Supplement No. 5 to part 774 particular to an item covered under ECCN 0D521. The list of software determined to be classified under ECCN 0D521 controls is published in Supplement No. 5 to part 774. The license requirements and licensing policy relating to ECCN 0D521 are set forth in § 742.6(a)(8) of the EAR.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术见ECCN 1E001（“开发”和“生产”）及1E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 1A202、1C010、1C210、9A010和9A110。(3) 为导弹应用“专门设计”的“复合材料”结构（包括“专门设计”的子系统、“零件”和“部件”），受ECCN 9A110管制。(4) 为分离铀同位素而“专门设计”或制备的“复合材料”结构或层压制品，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCNs 1A202, 1C010, 1C210, 9A010, and 9A110. (3) “Composite” structures “specially designed” for missile applications (including “specially designed” subsystems, “parts,” and “components”) are controlled by ECCN 9A110. (4) “Composite” structures or laminates “specially designed” or prepared for use in separating uranium isotopes are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

texts.en: a. Made from any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 有机“基体”及1C010.c或1C010.d规定的“纤维或丝状材料”；或
texts.en: a.1. An organic “matrix” and “fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.c or 1C010.d; or

texts.zh: a.2. 1C010.e规定的预浸料或预成型件；
texts.en: a.2. Prepregs or preforms specified by 1C010.e;

texts.zh: b. 由金属或碳“基体”及以下任一种材料制成：
texts.en: b. Made from a metal or carbon “matrix”, and any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 具有以下所有特征的碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: b.1. Carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” having all of the following:
b.1.a. A “specific modulus” exceeding 10.15 x 10^{6} m; and
b.1.b. A “specific tensile strength” exceeding 17.7 x 10^{4} m; or

texts.zh: b.2. 1C010.c管制的材料。
texts.en: b.2. Materials controlled by 1C010.c.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 1A002不管制由环氧树脂浸渍碳“纤维或丝状材料”制成、用于维修“民用航空器”结构或层压制品，并具有以下所有特征的“复合材料”结构或层压制品：
texts.en: 1A002 does not control “composite” structures or laminates made from epoxy resin impregnated carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials”, for the repair of “civil aircraft” structures or laminates, having all of the following:

texts.zh: a. 面积不超过1 m^{2}；
texts.en: a. An area not exceeding 1 m^{2};

texts.zh: b. 长度不超过2.5米；以及
texts.en: b. A length not exceeding 2.5 m; and

texts.zh: c. 宽度大于15毫米。
texts.en: c. A width exceeding 15 mm.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 1A002不管制为以下民用应用“专门设计”的半成品：
texts.en: 1A002 does not control semi-finished items, “specially designed” for civilian applications as follows:

texts.zh: a. 体育用品；
texts.en: a. Sporting goods;

texts.zh: b. 汽车工业；
texts.en: b. Automotive industry;

texts.zh: c. 机床工业；
texts.en: c. Machine tool industry;

texts.zh: d. 医疗应用。
texts.en: d. Medical applications.
Note 3:

texts.en: 1A002.b.1 does not apply to semi-finished items containing a maximum of two dimensions of interwoven filaments and “specially designed” for applications as follows:

texts.zh: a. 用于金属回火的金属热处理炉；
texts.en: a. Metal heat-treatment furnaces for tempering metals;

texts.zh: b. 硅单晶锭生产设备。
texts.en: b. Silicon boule production equipment.
Note 4:

texts.zh: 1A002不适用于为特定应用“专门设计”的成品。
texts.en: 1A002 does not apply to finished items “specially designed” for a specific application.
Note 5:

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 见ECCN 1A995、2B351和2B352。(2) 为使设备能够执行1A004.c项（核、生物和化学（NBC）探测系统）管制设备的功能而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”，见ECCN 1D003。(3) 为使设备能够执行1A004.c（核、生物和化学（NBC）探测系统）管制设备的功能而“专门设计”或改装的控制数据库（参数化技术数据库），见ECCN 1E002.g。(4) 专为军事应用设计、开发、改装、配置或适配的化学和生物防护及探测设备“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分，包括USML第XIV(f)类）；装有该类管制“零件”或“部件”的商业设备亦同。但用于国内应急准备的个人防护装置如集成USML第XIV(f)(4)类所列“部件”和“零件”，且这些“零件”或“部件”是装置不可分割的组成部分、不能从装置分离，并且若更换就会损害装置有效性，则该设备按ECCN 1A004受商务部出口许可管辖。(5) 本条目不管制装入本条目所列设备的放射性核素；此类材料受核管理委员会许可管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1A995, 2B351, and 2B352. (2) See ECCN 1D003 for “software” “specially designed” or modified to enable equipment to perform the functions of equipment controlled under section 1A004.c (Nuclear, biological, and chemical (NBC) detection systems). (3) See ECCN 1E002.g for control libraries (parametric technical databases) “specially designed” or modified to enable equipment to perform the functions of equipment controlled under 1A004.c (Nuclear, biological, and chemical (NBC) detection systems). (4) Chemical and biological protective and detection equipment specifically designed, developed, modified, configured, or adapted for military applications is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130, including USML Category XIV(f)), as is commercial equipment that incorporates “parts” or “components” controlled under that category except for domestic preparedness devices for individual protection that integrate “components” and “parts” identified in USML Category XIV(f)(4) when such “parts” or “components” are: Integral to the device; inseparable from the device; and incapable of replacement without compromising the effectiveness of the device, in which case the equipment is subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of Commerce under ECCN 1A004. (5) This entry does not control radionuclides incorporated in equipment listed in this entry—such materials are subject to the licensing jurisdiction of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (See 10 CFR part 110).

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) ‘生物战剂’是指经选择或改性（例如改变纯度、储存寿命、毒力、散布特性或抗紫外线辐射能力），以造成人或动物伤亡、降低设备性能或损害作物或环境的病原体或毒素。(2) ‘防暴剂’是指在预期防暴使用条件下，迅速使人产生感觉刺激或丧失行动能力的生理作用，且停止接触后该作用在短时间内消失的物质。（催泪剂属于‘防暴剂’的一部分。）
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) 'Biological agents' means: pathogens or toxins, selected or modified (such as altering purity, shelf life, virulence, dissemination characteristics, or resistance to UV radiation) to produce casualties in humans or animals, degrade equipment or damage crops or the environment. (2) 'Riot control agents' are substances which, under the expected conditions of use for riot control purposes, produce rapidly in humans sensory irritation or disabling physical effects which disappear within a short time following termination of exposure. (Tear gases are a subset of 'riot control agents.')

texts.en: a. Full face masks, filter canisters and decontamination equipment therefor, designed or modified for defense against any of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

texts.en: 1A004.a includes Powered Air Purifying Respirators (PAPR) that are designed or modified for defense against agents or materials, listed in 1A004.a.

texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就1A004.a而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 1A004.a:

texts.zh: 1. 全面罩也称防毒面具。
texts.en: 1. Full face masks are also known as gas masks.

texts.zh: 2. 滤毒罐包括滤毒盒。
texts.en: 2. Filter canisters include filter cartridges.

texts.zh: a.1. ‘生物战剂’；
texts.en: a.1. 'Biological agents';

texts.zh: a.2. ‘放射性材料’；
texts.en: a.2. 'Radioactive materials';

texts.zh: a.3. 化学战剂（CW）；或
texts.en: a.3. Chemical warfare (CW) agents; or

texts.zh: a.4. 下列‘防暴剂’：
texts.en: a.4. 'Riot control agents', as follows:

texts.zh: a.4.a. α-溴苯乙腈（溴苄基氰）（CA）（CAS 5798-79-8）；
texts.en: a.4.a. α-Bromobenzeneacetonitrile, (Bromobenzyl cyanide) (CA) (CAS 5798-79-8);

texts.zh: a.4.b. [(2-氯苯基)亚甲基]丙二腈（邻氯苯亚甲基丙二腈）（CS）（CAS 2698-41-1）；

texts.zh: a.4.c. 2-氯-1-苯基乙酮、苯甲酰甲基氯（ω-氯苯乙酮）（CN）（CAS 532-27-4）；

a.4.d. Dibenz-(b,f)-1,4-oxazephine, (CR) (CAS 257-07-8);

texts.zh: b. 为防御以下任一种战剂或材料而“专门设计”或改装的防护服、手套和鞋：
texts.en: b. Protective suits, gloves and shoes, “specially designed” or modified for defense against any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. ‘生物战剂’；
texts.en: b.1. 'Biological agents';

texts.zh: b.2. ‘放射性材料’；或
texts.en: b.2. 'Radioactive materials'; or

texts.zh: b.3. 化学战剂（CW）；
texts.en: b.3. Chemical warfare (CW) agents;

texts.zh: c. 为探测或识别以下任一种战剂或材料而“专门设计”或改装的探测系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: c. Detection systems, “specially designed” or modified for detection or identification of any of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

texts.zh: c.1. ‘生物战剂’；
texts.en: c.1. 'Biological agents';

texts.zh: c.2. ‘放射性材料’；或
texts.en: c.2. 'Radioactive materials'; or

texts.zh: c.3. 化学战剂（CW）；
texts.en: c.3. Chemical warfare (CW) agents;

texts.zh: d. 设计用于自动探测或识别“炸药”（列于第1类末尾附件）残留物，并采用‘痕量探测’技术（如表面声波、离子迁移谱、差分迁移谱、质谱）的电子设备。
texts.en: d. Electronic equipment designed for automatically detecting or identifying the presence of “explosives” (as listed in the annex at the end of Category 1) residues and utilizing 'trace detection' techniques (e.g., surface acoustic wave, ion mobility spectrometry, differential mobility spectrometry, mass spectrometry).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1A004.d而言，‘痕量探测’定义为能够探测浓度低于1 ppm的蒸气或质量低于1毫克的固体或液体。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1A004.d, 'trace detection' is defined as the capability to detect less than 1 ppm vapor, or 1 mg solid or liquid.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 1A004.d不适用于为实验室使用而“专门设计”的设备。
texts.en: 1A004.d does not apply to equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use.

texts.zh: 注2：1A004.d不适用于非接触式步行通过安检门。
texts.en: Note 2: 1A004.d does not apply to non-contact walk-through security portals.

texts.zh: 注：1A004不管制：
texts.en: Note: 1A004 does not control:

texts.zh: a. 个人辐射监测剂量计；
texts.en: a. Personal radiation monitoring dosimeters;

texts.zh: b. 设计或功能仅限于防护住宅安全或民用行业特有危险的职业健康或安全设备，包括：
texts.en: b. Occupational health or safety equipment limited by design or function to protect against hazards specific to residential safety or civil industries, including:

texts.zh: 1. 采矿；
texts.en: 1. Mining;

texts.zh: 2. 采石；
texts.en: 2. Quarrying;

texts.zh: 3. 农业；
texts.en: 3. Agriculture;

texts.zh: 4. 制药；
texts.en: 4. Pharmaceutical;

texts.zh: 5. 医疗；
texts.en: 5. Medical;

texts.zh: 6. 兽医；
texts.en: 6. Veterinary;

texts.zh: 7. 环境；
texts.en: 7. Environmental;

texts.zh: 8. 废物管理；
texts.en: 8. Waste management;

texts.zh: 9. 食品工业。
texts.en: 9. Food industry.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 1A004包括已被‘认定’、通过国家标准测试或以其他方式证明能够有效探测或防御‘放射性材料’、‘生物战剂’、化学战剂、‘模拟剂’或“防暴剂”的设备和“部件”，即使这些设备或“部件”用于采矿、采石、农业、制药、医疗、兽医、环境、废物管理或食品工业等民用行业。
texts.en: 1. 1A004 includes equipment, “components” that have been 'identified,' successfully tested to national standards or otherwise proven effective, for the detection of or defense against 'radioactive materials' 'biological agents,' chemical warfare agents, 'simulants' or “riot control agents,” even if such equipment or “components” are used in civil industries such as mining, quarrying, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, medical, veterinary, environmental, waste management, or the food industry.

texts.zh: 2. ‘模拟剂’：在训练、研究、测试或评估中替代有毒战剂（化学或生物）的物质或材料。
texts.en: 2. 'Simulant': A substance or material that is used in place of toxic agent (chemical or biological) in training, research, testing or evaluation.

texts.zh: 3. 就1A004而言，‘放射性材料’是指经选择或改性，以提高其造成人或动物伤亡、降低设备性能或损害作物或环境的效力的材料。
texts.en: 3. For the purposes of 1A004, 'radioactive materials' are those selected or modified to increase their effectiveness in producing casualties in humans or animals, degrading equipment or damaging crops or the environment.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 提供NIJ IV型或以上防护的防弹背心（防弹衣）“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1第X(a)类）。(2) 按军事标准或规格制造、提供等于或低于NIJ III级或“同等标准”防护的软质防弹衣和防护服，分类于ECCN 1A613.d.1。(3) 提供NIJ III级或“同等标准”弹道防护的硬质防弹板，分类于ECCN 1A613.d.2。(4) 警用头盔和盾牌分类于ECCN 0A979。(5) 为军事应用“专门设计”、未受USML或CCL其他处管制的其他个人防护“设备”，分类于ECCN 1A613.e。(6) 用于制造防弹衣的“纤维或丝状材料”，见ECCN 1C010。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Bulletproof and bullet resistant vests (body armor) providing NIJ Type IV protection or greater are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR 121.1 Category X(a)). (2) Soft body armor and protective garments manufactured to military standards or specifications that provide protection equal to or less than NIJ level III or “equivalent standards” are classified under ECCN 1A613.d.1. (3) Hard armor plates providing NIJ level III or “equivalent standard” ballistic protection are classified under ECCN 1A613.d.2. (4) Police helmets and shields are classified under ECCN 0A979. (5) Other personal protective “equipment” “specially designed” for military applications not controlled by the USML or elsewhere in the CCL is classified under ECCN 1A613.e. (6) For “fibrous or filamentary materials” used in the manufacture of body armor, see ECCN 1C010.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.en: a. Soft body armor not manufactured to military standards or specifications, or to their equivalents, and “specially designed” “components” therefor;

texts.zh: b. 提供低于NIJ III级（NIJ 0101.06，2008年7月）或“同等标准”弹道防护的硬质防弹板。
texts.en: b. Hard body armor plates that provide ballistic protection less than NIJ level III (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008) or “equivalent standards”.

texts.zh: ECCN 1A005各注：
texts.en: Notes to ECCN 1A005:

texts.zh: 1. 防弹衣随使用者携带、供其本人个人防护时，本条目不予管制。
texts.en: 1. This entry does not control body armor when accompanying its user for the user's own personal protection.

texts.zh: 2. 本条目不管制设计为仅对非军用爆炸装置的破片和爆炸冲击同时提供正面防护的防弹衣。
texts.en: 2. This entry does not control body armor designed to provide frontal protection only from both fragment and blast from non-military explosive devices.

texts.zh: 3. 本条目不适用于设计为仅防护刀、尖刺、针或钝器伤害的防护衣。
texts.en: 3. This entry does not apply to body armor designed to provide protection only from knife, spike, needle or blunt trauma.

texts.zh: 相关管制：为军事用途“专门设计”的猛炸药及相关设备“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。本条目不管制仅使用叠氮化铅等起爆药的雷管。另见ECCN 0A604、3A229和3A232。“开发”和“生产”技术管制见1E001，“使用”技术管制见1E201。
texts.en: Related Controls: High explosives and related equipment “specially designed” for military use are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). This entry does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. See also ECCNs 0A604, 3A229, and 3A232. See 1E001 for “development” and “production” technology controls, and 1E201 for “use” technology controls.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 设计用于驱动1A007.b规定爆炸雷管的雷管起爆装置；
texts.en: a. Explosive detonator firing sets designed to drive explosive detonators specified by 1A007.b;

texts.zh: b. 下列电驱动爆炸雷管：
texts.en: b. Electrically driven explosive detonators as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 爆炸桥（EB）；
texts.en: b.1. Exploding bridge (EB);

texts.zh: b.2. 爆炸桥丝（EBW）；
texts.en: b.2. Exploding bridge wire (EBW);

texts.zh: b.3. 冲击片式；
texts.en: b.3. Slapper;

texts.zh: b.4. 爆炸箔起爆器（EFI）。
texts.en: b.4. Exploding foil initiators (EFI).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. “起爆器”或“点火器”一词有时用于替代“雷管”。
texts.en: 1. The word initiator or igniter is sometimes used in place of the word detonator.

texts.zh: 2. 就1A007.b而言，所涉雷管均利用一个微小电导体（桥、桥丝或箔），当快速大电流电脉冲通过时，该导体爆炸性气化。在非冲击片型中，爆炸导体使与其接触的猛炸药材料（如PETN，季戊四醇四硝酸酯）发生化学爆轰。在冲击片雷管中，电导体的爆炸性气化驱动飞片或冲击片穿过间隙，冲击片撞击炸药从而引发化学爆轰。某些设计中的冲击片由磁力驱动。“爆炸箔雷管”一词可指EB型或冲击片型雷管。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 1A007.b, the detonators of concern all utilize a small electrical conductor (bridge, bridge wire, or foil) that explosively vaporizes when a fast, high-current electrical pulse is passed through it. In non slapper types, the exploding conductor starts a chemical detonation in a contacting high explosive material such as PETN (pentaerythritoltetranitrate). In slapper detonators, the explosive vaporization of the electrical conductor drives a flyer or slapper across a gap, and the impact of the slapper on an explosive starts a chemical detonation. The slapper in some designs is driven by magnetic force. The term exploding foil detonator may refer to either an EB or a slapper-type detonator.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 以下全部物项“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）：
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) All of the following are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130):

texts.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”的猛炸药及相关设备；
texts.en: a. High explosives and related equipment “specially designed” for military use;

texts.zh: b. 本条目中使用USML管制含能材料（见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1第V类）的爆炸装置或装药，如其专为军事应用设计、开发、配置、适配或改装；
texts.en: b. Explosive devices or charges in this entry that utilize USML controlled energetic materials (See 22 CFR 121.1 Category V), if they have been specifically designed, developed, configured, adapted, or modified for a military application;

texts.zh: c. 同时具有以下所有特征的聚能装药：形状均匀、夹角为90度或以下的锥形药型罩，含有超过2.0千克受管制材料，且直径大于4.5英寸；
texts.en: c. Shaped charges that have all of the following a uniform shaped conical liner with an included angle of 90 degrees or less, more than 2.0 kg of controlled materials, and a diameter exceeding 4.5 inches;

texts.zh: d. 每米含受管制材料超过0.1千克（每英尺470格令）的导爆索；
texts.en: d. Detonating cord containing greater than 0.1 kg per meter (470 grains per foot) of controlled materials;

texts.zh: e. 含有超过10千克受管制材料的切割器和切断工具；
texts.en: e. Cutters and severing tools containing greater than 10 kg of controlled materials;

texts.zh: f. 除切割器和切断工具外，本条目管制且可在不破坏装置或装药的情况下轻易提取其中USML管制材料的装置或装药；以及
texts.en: f. With the exception of cutters and severing tools, devices or charges controlled by this entry where the USML controlled materials can be easily extracted without destroying the device or charge; and

texts.zh: g. 本条目中的单独USML管制含能材料，即使与其他材料混合，在未装入本条目或1C992管制爆炸装置或装药时亦同。
texts.en: g. Individual USML controlled energetic materials in this entry, even when compounded with other materials, when not incorporated into explosive devices or charges controlled by this entry or 1C992.

texts.zh: (2) 其他受管制含能材料另见ECCN 1C011、1C018、1C111、1C239和1C608。ECCN 1A008管制商品的“开发”或“生产”“技术”，见ECCN 1E001；但“受ITAR管辖”的炸药或商品除外（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。
texts.en: (2) See also ECCNs 1C011, 1C018, 1C111, 1C239, and 1C608 for additional controlled energetic materials. See ECCN 1E001 for the “development” or “production” “technology” for the commodities controlled by ECCN 1A008, but not for explosives or commodities that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 具有以下所有特征的‘聚能装药’：
texts.en: a. 'Shaped charges' having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 净炸药量（NEQ）大于90克；以及
texts.en: a.1. Net Explosive Quantity (NEQ) greater than 90 g; and

texts.zh: a.2. 外壳直径等于或大于75毫米；
texts.en: a.2. Outer casing diameter equal to or greater than 75 mm;

texts.zh: b. 具有以下所有特征的线性聚能切割装药，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: b. Linear shaped cutting charges having all of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

texts.zh: b.1. 装药量大于40克/米；以及
texts.en: b.1. An explosive load greater than 40 g/m; and

texts.zh: b.2. 宽度为10毫米或以上；
texts.en: b.2. A width of 10 mm or more;

texts.zh: c. 炸药芯装药量大于64克/米的导爆索；
texts.en: c. Detonating cord with explosive core load greater than 64 g/m;

texts.zh: d. 1A008.b未规定、净炸药量大于3.5千克的切割器和切断工具。
texts.en: d. Cutters, not specified by 1A008.b, and severing tools, having a NEQ greater than 3.5 kg.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1A008.a而言，‘聚能装药’是通过成形使爆炸冲击效应集中的炸药装药。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1A008.a, 'shaped charges' are explosive charges shaped to focus the effects of the explosive blast.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1A008仅规定含“炸药”（见第1类末尾附件中的炸药清单）及其混合物的装药和装置。
texts.en: The only charges and devices specified in 1A008 are those containing “explosives” (see list of explosives in the Annex at the end of Category 1) and mixtures thereof.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目不管制加工为军火用途形态的贫铀。“受ITAR管辖”的贫铀见《联邦法规》第22编第121部分。(2) 非加工用于军火、非仅为利用其高密度而加工成商品（如飞机、船舶或其他配重）、且非本条目所列形态的贫铀，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖。（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分。）(3) 金属、合金、化合物或浓缩物形态的“天然铀”或“贫铀”或钍，以及含上述一种或多种物质的任何其他材料，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) This entry does not control depleted uranium in fabricated forms for use in munitions. See 22 CFR part 121 for depleted uranium “subject to the ITAR. (2) Depleted uranium that is not fabricated for use in munitions or fabricated into commodities solely to take advantage of its high density (e.g., aircraft, ship, or other counterweights) or in the forms listed in this entry are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. (See 10 CFR part 110.) (3) “Natural uranium” or “depleted uranium” or thorium in the form of metal, alloy, chemical compound or concentrate and any other material containing one or more of the foregoing are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) ECCN 1C991所列疫苗不受本ECCN管制。(2) 受ITAR管辖的疫苗，见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1（USML）第XIV(h)类。(3) ECCN 1A004、1A995或2B351所列防护和探测设备及相关物项不受本ECCN管制。(4) 受ITAR管辖的散布、探测和防护设备，见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1（USML）第XIV(f)类。(5) 位于美国境外并在美国境外生产、含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Vaccines identified in ECCN 1C991 are not controlled by this ECCN. (2) See 22 CFR 121.1 (USML), Category XIV(h), for vaccines that are subject to the ITAR. (3) Protection and detection equipment and related items identified in ECCN 1A004, 1A995, or 2B351 are not controlled by this ECCN. (4) See 22 CFR 121.1 (USML), Category XIV(f), for dissemination, detection and protection equipment that is subject to the ITAR. (5) See ECCN 0A919 for “military commodities” located and produced outside the United States that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content.

texts.en: k. Medical countermeasures that are “specially designed” for military use (including pre- and post-treatments, antidotes, and medical diagnostics) and “specially designed” to counter chemical agents controlled by the USML Category XIV(a).

texts.zh: 注：

texts.zh: 本条目管制“设备”的示例包括防护屏障型和非屏障型乳膏，以及已装药的自动注射器（例如一支注射器含2-PAM、另一支含阿托品的组合注射笔），条件是其为对抗此类战剂而“专门设计”。
texts.en: Examples of “equipment” controlled by this entry are barrier and non-barrier creams and filled autoinjectors (e.g., combopens where one injector contains 2-PAM and the other atropine) if “specially designed” to counter such agents.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) ITAR下USML第X或XIII类管制的防务物品（如依据保密信息制成的材料）及其直接相关技术数据（包括软件）“受ITAR管辖”。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 抗过载服（“G-suits”）及能在海拔高于55,000英尺处工作的压力服，见ECCN 9A610.g。(4) 1A613.c未规定的其他军用头盔“部件”或“配件”，见CCL中的相关ECCN或USML条目。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Defense articles, such as materials made from classified information, that are controlled by USML Category X or XIII of the ITAR, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are “subject to the ITAR.” (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) See ECCN 9A610.g for anti-gravity suits (“G-suits”) and pressure suits capable of operating at altitudes higher than 55,000 feet above sea level. (4) For other military helmet “components” or “accessories” not specified in 1A613.c, see the relevant ECCN in the CCL or USML Entry.

texts.zh: 相关定义：提及“NIJ型”防护，是指美国国家司法研究所NIJ标准0101.06《防弹衣的防弹性能》和NIJ标准0108.01《防弹防护材料》中的分类指南。
texts.en: Related Definitions: References to “NIJ Type” protection are to the National Institute of Justice Classification guide at NIJ Standard 0101.06, Ballistic Resistance of Body Armor, and NIJ Standard 0108.01, Ballistic Resistant Protective Materials.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”且不受USML管制的金属或非金属装甲板。
texts.en: a. Metallic or non-metallic armored plate “specially designed” for military use and not controlled by the USML.

texts.zh: a款注：
texts.en: Note to paragraph a:

texts.zh: 防弹衣插板的管制，见ECCN 1A613.d.2和USML第X(a)(1)类。
texts.en: For controls on body armor plates, see ECCN 1A613.d.2 and USML Category X(a)(1).

texts.zh: b. 为下列用途“专门设计”的掩蔽设施：
texts.en: b. Shelters “specially designed” to:

texts.zh: b.1. 为军事系统提供弹道防护；或
texts.en: b.1. Provide ballistic protection for military systems; or

texts.zh: b.2. 防护核、生物或化学污染。
texts.en: b.2. Protect against nuclear, biological, or chemical contamination.

texts.zh: c. 提供低于NIJ IV型或“同等标准”防护的军用头盔（1A613.y.1管制头盔除外）。
texts.en: c. Military helmets (other than helmets controlled under 1A613.y.1) providing less than NIJ Type IV or “equivalent standards” protection.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 警用头盔的管制，见ECCN 0A979。
texts.en: See ECCN 0A979 for controls on police helmets.

texts.zh: 注2：其他军用头盔的管制，见USML第X(a)(5)和(a)(6)类。
texts.en: Note 2: See USML Category X(a)(5) and (a)(6) for controls on other military helmets.

texts.zh: 注3：1A613.c不适用于满足以下所有条件的头盔：
texts.en: Note 3: 1A613.c does not apply to helmets that meet all the following:

texts.zh: a. 首次制造于1970年之前；以及

texts.zh: d. 下列防弹衣和防护服：
texts.en: d. Body armor and protective garments, as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 按军事标准、规格或其等效标准制造，并提供等于或低于NIJ III级（NIJ 0101.06，2008年7月）或“同等标准”弹道防护的软质防弹衣和防护服；或
texts.en: d.1. Soft body armor and protective garments manufactured to military standards or specifications, or to their equivalents, that provide ballistic protection equal to or less than NIJ level III (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008) or “equivalent standards”; or

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 就1A613.d.1而言，军事标准或规格至少包括破片防护规格。
texts.en: For 1A613.d.1, military standards or specifications include, at a minimum, specifications for fragmentation protection.

texts.zh: d.2. 提供等于NIJ III级（NIJ 0101.06，2008年7月）或“同等标准”弹道防护的硬质防弹板。
texts.en: d.2. Hard body armor plates that provide ballistic protection equal to NIJ level III (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008) or “equivalent standards”.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 非按军事标准或规格制造的软质防弹衣，以及提供低于NIJ III级或“同等标准”防护的硬质防弹板的管制，见ECCN 1A005。提供NIJ IV型或以上防护的防弹衣，见USML第X(a)(1)类。
texts.en: See ECCN 1A005 for controls on soft body armor not manufactured to military standards or specifications and hard body armor plates providing less than NIJ level III or “equivalent standards” protection. For body armor providing NIJ Type IV protection or greater, see USML Category X(a)(1).

texts.zh: e. 为USML或CCL管制潜艇的救援行动“专门设计”的常压潜水服。

texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为使用“纤维或丝状材料”制造“复合材料”结构或层压制品而“专门设计”的纤维缠绕机，其纤维定位、包绕和缠绕运动可在三个或以上‘主要伺服定位’轴上协调并编程；
texts.en: a. Filament winding machines, of which the motions for positioning, wrapping and winding fibers are coordinated and programmed in three or more 'primary servo positioning' axes, “specially designed” for the manufacture of “composite” structures or laminates, from “fibrous or filamentary materials”;

texts.zh: b. 为制造“复合材料”机体或导弹结构而“专门设计”的‘铺带机’，其定位和铺带运动可在五个或以上‘主要伺服定位’轴上协调并编程；
texts.en: b. 'Tape laying machines', of which the motions for positioning and laying tape are coordinated and programmed in five or more 'primary servo positioning' axes, “specially designed” for the manufacture of “composite” airframe or missile structures;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1B001.b而言，‘铺带机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度限于大于25.4毫米且小于或等于304.8毫米的‘丝束带’，并能在铺放过程中切断和重新开始单条‘丝束带’的铺放路径。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1B001.b, 'tape-laying machines' have the ability to lay one or more 'filament bands' limited to widths greater than 25.4 mm and less than or equal to 304.8 mm, and to cut and restart individual 'filament band' courses during the laying process.

texts.zh: c. 为编织、交织或编结“复合材料”结构用纤维而“专门设计”或改装的多向、多维编织机或交织机，包括适配器和改装套件；
texts.en: c. Multidirectional, multidimensional weaving machines or interlacing machines, including adapters and modification kits, “specially designed” or modified for weaving, interlacing or braiding fibers for “composite” structures;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1B001.c而言，交织技术包括针织。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1B001.c the technique of interlacing includes knitting.

texts.zh: d. 为生产增强纤维而“专门设计”或适配的下列设备：
texts.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” or adapted for the production of reinforcement fibers, as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 将聚合物纤维（如聚丙烯腈、人造丝、沥青或聚碳硅烷）转化为碳纤维或碳化硅纤维的设备，包括加热期间对纤维施加张力的专用设备；
texts.en: d.1. Equipment for converting polymeric fibers (such as polyacrylonitrile, rayon, pitch or polycarbosilane) into carbon fibers or silicon carbide fibers, including special equipment to strain the fiber during heating;

texts.zh: d.2. 在加热的丝状基材上通过化学气相沉积元素或化合物制造碳化硅纤维的设备；
texts.en: d.2. Equipment for the chemical vapor deposition of elements or compounds, on heated filamentary substrates, to manufacture silicon carbide fibers;

texts.zh: d.3. 耐火陶瓷（如氧化铝）湿法纺丝设备；
texts.en: d.3. Equipment for the wet-spinning of refractory ceramics (such as aluminum oxide);

texts.zh: d.4. 通过热处理将含铝前驱体纤维转化为氧化铝纤维的设备；
texts.en: d.4. Equipment for converting aluminum containing precursor fibers into alumina fibers by heat treatment;

texts.zh: e. 采用热熔法生产1C010.e管制预浸料的设备；
texts.en: e. Equipment for producing prepregs controlled by 1C010.e by the hot melt method;

texts.zh: f. 为“复合材料”“专门设计”的下列无损检测设备：
texts.en: f. Non-destructive inspection equipment “specially designed” for “composite” materials, as follows:

texts.zh: f.1. 用于三维缺陷检查的X射线断层成像系统；
texts.en: f.1. X-ray tomography systems for three dimensional defect inspection;

texts.zh: f.2. 数控超声检测机，其发射器或接收器的定位运动可在四个或以上轴上同时协调并编程，以沿被检“零件”或“部件”的三维轮廓运动；
texts.en: f.2. Numerically controlled ultrasonic testing machines of which the motions for positioning transmitters or receivers are simultaneously coordinated and programmed in four or more axes to follow the three dimensional contours of the “part” or “component” under inspection;

texts.en: g. Tow-placement machines, of which the motions for positioning and laying tows are coordinated and programmed in two or more 'primary servo positioning' axes, “specially designed” for the manufacture of “composite” airframe or missile structures.

texts.zh: 1B001.g技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note to 1B001.g:

texts.zh: 就1B001.g而言，‘铺丝机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度小于或等于25.4毫米的‘丝束带’，并能在铺放过程中切断和重新开始单条‘丝束带’的铺放路径。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1B001.g, 'tow-placement machines' have the ability to place one or more 'filament bands' having widths less than or equal to 25.4 mm, and to cut and restart individual 'filament band' courses during the placement process.

texts.zh: 1B001技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes for 1B001:

texts.zh: 1. 就1B001而言，‘主要伺服定位’轴在计算机“程序”指令下控制末端执行器（即头部）相对于工件的空间位置，使其处于正确姿态和方向，以实现所需工艺。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 1B001, 'primary servo positioning' axes control, under computer “program” direction, the position of the end effector (i.e., head) in space relative to the work piece at the correct orientation and direction to achieve the desired process.

texts.zh: 2. 就1B001而言，‘丝束带’是一条具有连续宽度、完全或部分浸渍树脂的带材、丝束或纤维。完全或部分浸渍树脂的‘丝束带’包括涂覆加热后具有黏性的干粉者。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 1B001, a 'filament band' is a single continuous width of fully or partially resin-impregnated tape, tow or fiber. Fully or partially resin-impregnated 'filament bands' include those coated with dry powder that tacks upon heating.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 设计用于由纤维或丝状材料制造复合材料结构或层压制品的纤维缠绕机或‘纤维/丝束铺放机’，其纤维定位、包绕和缠绕运动可在三个或以上轴上协调并编程；以及协调与编程控制器；
texts.en: Items: a. Filament winding machines or 'fiber/tow-placement machines,' of which the motions for positioning, wrapping and winding fibers can be coordinated and programmed in three or more axes, designed to fabricate composite structures or laminates from fibrous or filamentary materials, and coordinating and programming controls;

texts.zh: b. 设计用于制造复合材料机体和导弹结构的‘铺带机’，其定位和铺带运动可在两个或以上轴上协调并编程；
texts.en: b. 'Tape-laying machines' of which the motions for positioning and laying tape can be coordinated and programmed in two or more axes, designed for the manufacture of composite airframe and missile structures;

texts.zh: a款和b款技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

texts.zh: 就1B101.a和1B101.b而言，适用以下定义：
texts.en: For the purposes of 1B101.a. and 1B101.b., the following definitions apply:

texts.zh: 1. ‘纤维/丝束铺放机’和‘铺带机’执行类似工艺，利用计算机引导的头部将一条或数条‘丝束带’铺到模具上，以形成零件或结构。这些机器能在铺放过程中切断并重新开始单条‘丝束带’的铺放路径。
texts.en: 1. 'Fiber/tow-placement machines' and 'tape-laying machines' are machines that perform similar processes that use computer-guided heads to lay one or several 'filament bands' onto a mold to create a part or a structure. These machines have the ability to cut and restart individual 'filament band' courses during the laying process.

texts.zh: 2. ‘丝束带’是一条具有连续宽度、完全或部分浸渍树脂的带材、丝束或纤维。完全或部分浸渍树脂的‘丝束带’包括涂覆加热后具有黏性的干粉者。
texts.en: 2. A 'filament band' is a single continuous width of fully or partially resin-impregnated tape, tow, or fiber. Fully or partially resin-impregnated 'filament bands' include those coated with dry powder that tacks upon heating.

texts.zh: 3. ‘纤维/丝束铺放机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度小于或等于25.4毫米的‘丝束带’。这指机器能够铺放的材料最小宽度，不论机器最大能力为何。
texts.en: 3. 'Fiber/tow-placement machines' have the ability to place one or more 'filament bands' having widths less than or equal to 25.4 mm. This refers to the minimum width of material the machine can place, regardless of the upper capability of the machine.

texts.zh: 4. ‘铺带机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度小于或等于304.8毫米的‘丝束带’，但不能铺放宽度等于或小于25.4毫米的‘丝束带’。这指机器能够铺放的材料最小宽度，不论机器最大能力为何。
texts.en: 4. 'Tape-laying machines' have the ability to place one or more 'filament bands' having widths less than or equal to 304.8 mm, but cannot place 'filament bands' with a width equal to or less than 25.4 mm. This refers to the minimum width of material the machine can place, regardless of the upper capability of the machine.

texts.zh: c. 为“生产”“纤维或丝状材料”而设计或改装的下列设备：
texts.en: c. Equipment designed or modified for the “production” of “fibrous or filamentary materials” as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 转化聚合物纤维（如聚丙烯腈、人造丝或聚碳硅烷）的设备，包括加热期间对纤维施加张力的专门配置；
texts.en: c.1. Equipment for converting polymeric fibers (such as polyacrylonitrile, rayon or polycarbosilane) including special provision to strain the fiber during heating;

texts.zh: c.2. 在加热丝状基材上进行元素或化合物气相沉积的设备；以及
texts.en: c.2. Equipment for the vapor deposition of elements or compounds on heated filament substrates; and

texts.zh: c.3. 耐火陶瓷（如氧化铝）湿法纺丝设备；
texts.en: c.3. Equipment for the wet-spinning of refractory ceramics (such as aluminum oxide);

texts.zh: d. 为特殊纤维表面处理，或为生产9A110管制预浸料和预成型件而设计或改装的设备。
texts.en: d. Equipment designed or modified for special fiber surface treatment or for producing prepregs and preforms controlled by 9A110.

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) 就本ECCN而言，“细晶不锈钢”是指ASTM（或同等标准）晶粒度级别为5或以上的细晶奥氏体不锈钢。(2) 就本ECCN而言，“有效长度”是指填料塔内填料的有效高度，或板式塔内接触塔板的有效高度。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) The term “fine grain stainless steels,” for purposes of this ECCN, means fine grain austenitic stainless steels with an ASTM (or equivalent standard) grain size number of 5 or greater. (2) The term “effective length,” for purposes of this ECCN, means the active height of packing material in a packed-type column, or the active height of internal contactor plates in a plate-type column.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 设计内部工作温度为35 K（−238 °C）或以下；
texts.en: Items: a. Designed to operate with internal temperatures of 35 K (−238 °C) or less;

texts.zh: b. 设计内部工作压力为0.5至5 MPa（5至50个大气压）；
texts.en: b. Designed to operate at an internal pressure of 0.5 to 5 MPa (5 to 50 atmospheres);

texts.zh: c. 由低硫300系列“细晶不锈钢”或具有同等低温性能且与H_{2}相容的材料制成；以及
texts.en: c. Constructed of “fine-grain stainless steels” of the 300 series with low sulphur content or equivalent cryogenic and H_{2}-compatible materials; and

texts.zh: d. 内径为30厘米或以上，“有效长度”为4米或以上。
texts.en: d. With internal diameters of 30 cm or greater and “effective lengths” of 4 m or greater.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCN 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and ECCN 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items described in this entry. (2) Facilities and plants described in 1B233.a are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110). (3) Certain lithium isotope separation equipment and components for the plasma separation process (PSP) that are described in 1B233.b through .d are also directly applicable to uranium isotope separation and are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

texts.zh: 物项：a. 用于分离锂同位素的设施或工厂；
texts.en: Items: a. Facilities or plants for the separation of lithium isotopes;

texts.zh: b. 基于锂—汞齐工艺分离锂同位素的下列设备：
texts.en: b. Equipment for the separation of lithium isotopes based on the lithium-mercury amalgam process, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 为锂汞齐“专门设计”的填料式液—液交换塔；
texts.en: b.1. Packed liquid-liquid exchange columns “specially designed” for lithium amalgams;

texts.zh: b.2. 汞和/或锂汞齐泵；
texts.en: b.2. Mercury and/or lithium amalgam pumps;

texts.zh: b.3. 锂汞齐电解槽；
texts.en: b.3. Lithium amalgam electrolysis cells;

texts.zh: b.4. 氢氧化锂浓溶液蒸发器。
texts.en: b.4. Evaporators for concentrated lithium hydroxide solution.

texts.zh: c. 为锂同位素分离“专门设计”的离子交换系统，以及为其“专门设计”的组成零件；
texts.en: c. Ion exchange systems “specially designed” for lithium isotope separation, and “specially designed” component parts therefor;

texts.zh: d. 为锂同位素分离“专门设计”的化学交换系统（使用冠醚、穴醚或套索醚），以及为其“专门设计”的组成零件。
texts.en: d. Chemical exchange systems (employing crown ethers, cryptands, or lariat ethers) “specially designed” for lithium isotope separation, and “specially designed” component parts therefor.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Devices “specially designed” for the handling, control, activation, monitoring, detection, protection, discharge, or detonation of the articles enumerated in USML Category IV(a) and (b) are controlled by USML Category IV(c) of the ITAR (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) See USML Category V of the ITAR (22 CFR parts 120 through 130) for devices identified therein that are “specially designed” to fully contain explosives enumerated in USML Category V. (3) Also see ECCN 1B608 for “equipment” “specially designed” for the “development,” “production,” repair, overhaul, or refurbishing of items controlled by ECCN 1C608 or USML Category V and not elsewhere specified on the USML.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 用于吸收频率大于2 × 10^{8} Hz但小于3 × 10^{12} Hz的材料。
texts.en: a. Materials for absorbing frequencies exceeding 2 × 10^{8} Hz but less than 3 × 10^{12} Hz.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 1C001.a不管制：
texts.en: 1C001.a does not control:

texts.zh: a. 由天然或合成纤维构成、以非磁性填料实现吸收的毛发型吸收体；
texts.en: a. Hair type absorbers, constructed of natural or synthetic fibers, with non-magnetic loading to provide absorption;

texts.zh: b. 无磁损耗且入射表面为非平面形状的吸收体，包括金字塔形、圆锥形、楔形和褶皱表面；
texts.en: b. Absorbers having no magnetic loss and whose incident surface is non-planar in shape, including pyramids, cones, wedges and convoluted surfaces;

texts.zh: c. 具有以下所有特征的平面吸收体：
texts.en: c. Planar absorbers, having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 由以下任一种材料制成：
texts.en: 1. Made from any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 含碳填料的塑料泡沫材料（柔性或非柔性），或包括粘合剂在内的有机材料，在超过入射能量中心频率±15%的带宽内，其回波超过金属回波的5%，且不能耐受高于450 K（177 °C）的温度；或
texts.en: a. Plastic foam materials (flexible or non-flexible) with carbon-loading, or organic materials, including binders, providing more than 5% echo compared with metal over a bandwidth exceeding ±15% of the center frequency of the incident energy, and not capable of withstanding temperatures exceeding 450 K (177 °C); or

texts.zh: b. 陶瓷材料，在超过入射能量中心频率±15%的带宽内，其回波超过金属回波的20%，且不能耐受高于800 K（527 °C）的温度；
texts.en: b. Ceramic materials providing more than 20% echo compared with metal over a bandwidth exceeding ±15% of the center frequency of the incident energy, and not capable of withstanding temperatures exceeding 800 K (527 °C);

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1C001.a注1.c.1而言，吸收测试样品应为正方形，每边至少为中心频率波长的5倍，并置于辐射元件的远场。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1C001.a Note 1.c.1, absorption test samples should be a square at least 5 wavelengths of the center frequency on a side and positioned in the far field of the radiating element.
2. Tensile strength less than 7 × 10^{6} N/m^{2}; and
3. Compressive strength less than 14 × 10^{6} N/m^{2};

texts.zh: d. 由烧结铁氧体制成、具有以下所有特征的平面吸收体：
texts.en: d. Planar absorbers made of sintered ferrite, having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 比重大于4.4；以及
texts.en: 1. A specific gravity exceeding 4.4; and

texts.zh: 2. 最高工作温度为548 K（275 °C）或以下；
texts.en: 2. A maximum operating temperature of 548 K (275 °C) or less;

texts.zh: e. 无磁损耗，且由密度为0.15克/cm^{3}或以下的‘开孔泡沫’塑料材料制成的平面吸收体。
texts.en: e. Planar absorbers having no magnetic loss and fabricated from 'open-cell foams' plastic material with a density of 0.15 grams/cm^{3} or less.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:
