texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1C002不管制专为涂覆用途配制的金属合金、金属合金粉末和合金化材料。
texts.en: 1C002 does not control metal alloys, metal alloy powder and alloyed materials, specially formulated for coating purposes.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1C002而言，金属合金是指所述金属的重量百分比高于任何其他元素的合金。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1C002, metal alloys are those containing a higher percentage by weight of the stated metal than of any other element.

texts.zh: a. 下列铝化物：
texts.en: a. Aluminides, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 铝含量按重量计最低15%、最高38%，且含有至少一种其他合金元素的镍铝化物；
texts.en: a.1. Nickel aluminides containing a minimum of 15% by weight aluminum, a maximum of 38% by weight aluminum and at least one additional alloying element;

texts.zh: a.2. 铝含量按重量计为10%或以上，且含有至少一种其他合金元素的钛铝化物；
texts.en: a.2. Titanium aluminides containing 10% by weight or more aluminum and at least one additional alloying element;

texts.zh: b. 由1C002.c管制粉末或颗粒材料制成的下列金属合金：
texts.en: b. Metal alloys, as follows, made from the powder or particulate material controlled by 1C002.c:

texts.zh: b.1. 具有以下任一特征的镍合金：
texts.en: b.1. Nickel alloys having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 在923 K（650 °C）、676 MPa应力下，‘持久断裂寿命’为10,000小时或以上；或
texts.en: b.1.a. A 'stress-rupture life' of 10,000 hours or longer at 923 K (650 °C) at a stress of 676 MPa; or

texts.zh: b.1.b. 在823 K（550 °C）、最大应力1,095 MPa下，‘低周疲劳寿命’为10,000次循环或以上；
texts.en: b.1.b. A 'low cycle fatigue life' of 10,000 cycles or more at 823 K (550 °C) at a maximum stress of 1,095 MPa;

texts.zh: b.2. 具有以下任一特征的铌合金：
texts.en: b.2. Niobium alloys having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 在1,073 K（800 °C）、400 MPa应力下，‘持久断裂寿命’为10,000小时或以上；或
texts.en: b.2.a. A 'stress-rupture life' of 10,000 hours or longer at 1,073 K (800 °C) at a stress of 400 MPa; or

texts.zh: b.2.b. 在973 K（700 °C）、最大应力700 MPa下，‘低周疲劳寿命’为10,000次循环或以上；
texts.en: b.2.b. A 'low cycle fatigue life' of 10,000 cycles or more at 973 K (700 °C) at a maximum stress of 700 MPa;

texts.zh: b.3. 具有以下任一特征的钛合金：
texts.en: b.3. Titanium alloys having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.3.a. 在723 K（450 °C）、200 MPa应力下，‘持久断裂寿命’为10,000小时或以上；或
texts.en: b.3.a. A 'stress-rupture life' of 10,000 hours or longer at 723 K (450 °C) at a stress of 200 MPa; or

texts.zh: b.3.b. 在723 K（450 °C）、最大应力400 MPa下，‘低周疲劳寿命’为10,000次循环或以上；
texts.en: b.3.b. A 'low cycle fatigue life' of 10,000 cycles or more at 723 K (450 °C) at a maximum stress of 400 MPa;

texts.zh: b.4 具有以下任一特征的铝合金：
texts.en: b.4 Aluminum alloys having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.4.a. 在473 K（200 °C）下，抗拉强度为240 MPa或以上；或
texts.en: b.4.a. A tensile strength of 240 MPa or more at 473 K (200 °C); or

texts.zh: b.4.b. 在298 K（25 °C）下，抗拉强度为415 MPa或以上；
texts.en: b.4.b. A tensile strength of 415 MPa or more at 298 K (25 °C);

texts.zh: b.5. 具有以下所有特征的镁合金：
texts.en: b.5. Magnesium alloys having all the following:

texts.zh: b.5.a. 抗拉强度为345 MPa或以上；以及
texts.en: b.5.a. A tensile strength of 345 MPa or more; and

texts.zh: b.5.b. 依据ASTM G-31或国家等效标准测量，在3%氯化钠水溶液中的腐蚀速率小于1毫米/年；
texts.en: b.5.b. A corrosion rate of less than 1 mm/year in 3% sodium chloride aqueous solution measured in accordance with ASTM standard G-31 or national equivalents;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就1C002.b而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 1C002.b:

texts.zh: 1. ‘持久断裂寿命’应依据ASTM E-139或国家等效标准测量。
texts.en: 1. 'Stress-rupture life' should be measured in accordance with ASTM standard E-139 or national equivalents.

texts.zh: 2. ‘低周疲劳寿命’应依据ASTM E-606《恒定幅值低周疲劳试验推荐规程》或国家等效标准测量。试验应为轴向，平均应力比等于1，应力集中系数（K_{t}）等于1。平均应力比定义为最大应力减去最小应力后再除以最大应力。
texts.en: 2. 'Low cycle fatigue life' should be measured in accordance with ASTM Standard E-606 'Recommended Practice for Constant-Amplitude Low-Cycle Fatigue Testing' or national equivalents. Testing should be axial with an average stress ratio equal to 1 and a stress-concentration factor (K_{t}) equal to 1. The average stress ratio is defined as maximum stress minus minimum stress divided by maximum stress.

texts.zh: c. 具有以下所有特征的金属合金粉末或颗粒材料：
texts.en: c. Metal alloy powder or particulate material, having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 由以下任一种组成体系制成：
texts.en: c.1. Made from any of the following composition systems:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1C002.c.1而言，X表示一种或多种合金元素。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1C002.c.1, X equals one or more alloying elements.

texts.zh: c.1.a. 符合涡轮发动机“零件”或“部件”要求的镍合金（Ni-Al-X、Ni-X-Al），即每109个合金颗粒中，大于100 µm的非金属颗粒（制造过程中引入）少于3个；
texts.en: c.1.a. Nickel alloys (Ni-Al-X, Ni-X-Al) qualified for turbine engine “parts” or “components,” i.e., with less than 3 non-metallic particles (introduced during the manufacturing process) larger than 100 µm in 109 alloy particles;

texts.zh: c.1.b. 铌合金（Nb-Al-X或Nb-X-Al、Nb-Si-X或Nb-X-Si、Nb-Ti-X或Nb-X-Ti）；
texts.en: c.1.b. Niobium alloys (Nb-Al-X or Nb-X-Al, Nb-Si-X or Nb-X-Si, Nb-Ti-X or Nb-X-Ti);

texts.zh: c.1.c. 钛合金（Ti-Al-X或Ti-X-Al）；
texts.en: c.1.c. Titanium alloys (Ti-Al-X or Ti-X-Al);

texts.zh: c.1.d. 铝合金（Al-Mg-X或Al-X-Mg、Al-Zn-X或Al-X-Zn、Al-Fe-X或Al-X-Fe）；或
texts.en: c.1.d. Aluminum alloys (Al-Mg-X or Al-X-Mg, Al-Zn-X or Al-X-Zn, Al-Fe-X or Al-X-Fe); or

texts.zh: c.1.e. 镁合金（Mg-Al-X或Mg-X-Al）；
texts.en: c.1.e. Magnesium alloys (Mg-Al-X or Mg-X-Al);

texts.zh: c.2. 在受控环境中采用以下任一种工艺制成：
texts.en: c.2. Made in a controlled environment by any of the following processes:

texts.zh: c.2.a. ‘真空雾化’；
texts.en: c.2.a. 'Vacuum atomization';

texts.zh: c.2.b. ‘气体雾化’；
texts.en: c.2.b. 'Gas atomization';

texts.zh: c.2.c. ‘旋转雾化’；
texts.en: c.2.c. 'Rotary atomization';

texts.zh: c.2.d. ‘撞击淬冷’；
texts.en: c.2.d. 'Splat quenching';

texts.zh: c.2.e. ‘熔体旋淬’和‘粉碎’；
texts.en: c.2.e. 'Melt spinning' and 'comminution';

texts.zh: c.2.f. ‘熔体抽取’和‘粉碎’；
texts.en: c.2.f. 'Melt extraction' and 'comminution';

texts.zh: c.2.g. ‘机械合金化’；或
texts.en: c.2.g. 'Mechanical alloying'; or

texts.zh: c.2.h. ‘等离子体雾化’；以及
texts.en: c.2.h. 'Plasma atomization'; and

texts.zh: c.3. 能够形成1C002.a或1C002.b管制材料；
texts.en: c.3. Capable of forming materials controlled by 1C002.a or 1C002.b;

texts.zh: d. 具有以下所有特征的合金化材料：
texts.en: d. Alloyed materials, having all the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 由1C002.c.1规定的任一种组成体系制成；
texts.en: d.1. Made from any of the composition systems specified by 1C002.c.1;

texts.zh: d.2. 呈未粉碎的薄片、带材或细棒形态；以及
texts.en: d.2. In the form of uncomminuted flakes, ribbons or thin rods; and

texts.zh: d.3. 在受控环境中采用以下任一种工艺生产：
texts.en: d.3. Produced in a controlled environment by any of the following:

texts.zh: d.3.a. ‘撞击淬冷’；
texts.en: d.3.a. 'Splat quenching';

texts.zh: d.3.b. ‘熔体旋淬’；或
texts.en: d.3.b. 'Melt spinning'; or

texts.zh: d.3.c. ‘熔体抽取’。
texts.en: d.3.c. 'Melt extraction'.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就1C002而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 1C002:

texts.zh: 1. ‘真空雾化’是使熔融金属流暴露于真空，利用溶解气体迅速析出，将其分散为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
texts.en: 1. 'Vacuum atomization' is a process to reduce a molten stream of metal to droplets of a diameter of 500 µm or less by the rapid evolution of a dissolved gas upon exposure to a vacuum.

texts.zh: 2. ‘气体雾化’是利用高压气流，将熔融金属合金流分散为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
texts.en: 2. 'Gas atomization' is a process to reduce a molten stream of metal alloy to droplets of 500 µm diameter or less by a high pressure gas stream.

texts.zh: 3. ‘旋转雾化’是利用离心力，将熔融金属流或熔池分散为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
texts.en: 3. 'Rotary atomization' is a process to reduce a stream or pool of molten metal to droplets of a diameter of 500 µm or less by centrifugal force.

texts.zh: 4. ‘撞击淬冷’是使熔融金属流撞击冷却块而‘快速凝固’，形成片状产品的工艺。
texts.en: 4. 'Splat quenching' is a process to 'solidify rapidly' a molten metal stream impinging upon a chilled block, forming a flake-like product.

texts.zh: 5. ‘熔体旋淬’是使熔融金属流撞击旋转冷却块而‘快速凝固’，形成片状、带状或棒状产品的工艺。
texts.en: 5. 'Melt spinning' is a process to 'solidify rapidly' a molten metal stream impinging upon a rotating chilled block, forming a flake, ribbon or rod-like product.

texts.zh: 6. ‘粉碎’是通过破碎或研磨将材料变为颗粒的工艺。
texts.en: 6. 'Comminution' is a process to reduce a material to particles by crushing or grinding.

texts.zh: 7. ‘熔体抽取’是将旋转冷却块的一小段浸入熔融金属合金浴中，使其‘快速凝固’并抽取带状合金产品的工艺。
texts.en: 7. 'Melt extraction' is a process to 'solidify rapidly' and extract a ribbon-like alloy product by the insertion of a short segment of a rotating chilled block into a bath of a molten metal alloy.

texts.zh: 8. ‘机械合金化’是通过机械冲击使元素粉末和母合金粉末结合、断裂并再结合的合金化工艺。可通过加入适当粉末将非金属颗粒纳入合金。
texts.en: 8. 'Mechanical alloying' is an alloying process resulting from the bonding, fracturing and rebonding of elemental and master alloy powders by mechanical impact. Non-metallic particles may be incorporated in the alloy by addition of the appropriate powders.

texts.zh: 9. ‘等离子体雾化’是在惰性气体环境中使用等离子炬，将熔融金属流或固体金属转化为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
texts.en: 9. 'Plasma atomization' is a process to reduce a molten stream or solid metal to droplets of 500 µm diameter or less, using plasma torches in an inert gas environment.

texts.zh: 10. 就1C002技术注而言，‘快速凝固’是熔融材料以超过1,000 K/秒的冷却速率凝固的工艺。
texts.en: 10. For the purposes of 1C002 Technical Notes, 'solidify rapidly' is a process involving the solidification of molten material at cooling rates exceeding 1000 K/sec.

texts.zh: 1C008.a管制液态或固态“可熔融”形态的物质，包括树脂、粉末、颗粒、薄膜、片材、带材或条带。
texts.en: 1C008.a controls the substances in liquid or solid “fusible” form, including resin, powder, pellet, film, sheet, tape, or ribbon.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 薄膜、片材、带材或条带形态的非“可熔融”芳香族聚酰亚胺，见ECCN 1A003。
texts.en: For non-“fusible” aromatic polyimides in film, sheet, tape, or ribbon form, see ECCN 1A003.

texts.zh: b. [保留]
texts.en: b. [Reserved]

texts.zh: c. [保留]
texts.en: c. [Reserved]

texts.zh: d. 聚芳撑酮；
texts.en: d. Polyarylene ketones;

texts.zh: e. 芳撑基团为联苯撑、三联苯撑或其组合的聚芳撑硫醚；
texts.en: e. Polyarylene sulfides, where the arylene group is biphenylene, triphenylene or combinations thereof;

texts.zh: f. ‘玻璃化转变温度（Tg）’高于563 K（290 °C）的聚联苯醚砜。
texts.en: f. Polybiphenylenethersulphone having a 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' exceeding 563 K (290 °C).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就1C008.a.2热塑性材料、1C008.a.4材料和1C008.f材料而言，‘玻璃化转变温度（Tg）’按ISO 11357-2（1999）或国家等效标准所述方法确定。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 1C008.a.2 thermoplastic materials, 1C008.a.4 materials, and 1C008.f materials, the 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' is determined using the method described in ISO 11357-2 (1999) or national equivalents.

texts.zh: 2. 就1C008.a.2热固性材料和1C008.a.3材料而言，‘玻璃化转变温度（Tg）’按ASTM D 7028-07或国家等效标准所述三点弯曲法确定。测试应使用干燥试样，其固化度已达到ASTM E 2160-04或国家等效标准规定的至少90%，并采用能取得最高Tg的标准固化与后固化组合工艺完成固化。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 1C008.a.2 thermosetting materials and 1C008.a.3 materials, the 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' is determined using the 3-point bend method described in ASTM D 7028-07 or equivalent national standard. The test is to be performed using a dry test specimen which has attained a minimum of 90% degree of cure as specified by ASTM E 2160-04 or equivalent national standard, and was cured using the combination of standard- and post-cure processes that yield the highest Tg.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术，见ECCN 1E001（“开发”和“生产”）及1E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 1C210和1C990。(3) 依据注1或注2不受1C010.e管制的材料，另见9C110。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCNs 1C210 and 1C990. (3) See also 9C110 for material not controlled by 1C010.e, as defined by notes 1 or 2.

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) “比模量”：以帕斯卡（等同N/m2）表示的杨氏模量除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296+2) K（(23+2) °C）和相对湿度(50+5)%条件下测量。(2) “比抗拉强度”：以帕斯卡（等同N/m2）表示的极限抗拉强度除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296+2) K（(23+2) °C）和相对湿度(50+5)%条件下测量。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Specific modulus”: Young's modulus in pascals, equivalent to N/m2 divided by specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296+2) K ((23+2) °C) and a relative humidity of (50+5) %. (2) “Specific tensile strength”: ultimate tensile strength in pascals, equivalent to N/m2 divided by specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296+2) K ((23+2) °C) and a relative humidity of (50+5) %.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 计算1C010.a、1C010.b、1C010.c或1C010.e.1.b中“纤维或丝状材料”的“比抗拉强度”“比模量”或比重时，抗拉强度和模量应采用ISO 10618（2004）或国家等效标准所述方法A确定。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of calculating “specific tensile strength”, “specific modulus” or specific weight of “fibrous or filamentary materials” in 1C010.a, 1C010.b, 1C010.c, or 1C010.e.1.b the tensile strength and modulus should be determined by using Method A described in ISO 10618 (2004) or national equivalents.

texts.zh: 2. 评估1C010中非单向“纤维或丝状材料”（如织物、无规毡或编织物）的“比抗拉强度”“比模量”或比重时，应依据组成该材料的单向单丝（如单丝、纱线、无捻粗纱或丝束）在加工成非单向“纤维或丝状材料”之前的力学性能。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of assessing the “specific tensile strength”, “specific modulus” or specific weight of non-unidirectional “fibrous or filamentary materials” (e.g., fabrics, random mats or braids) in 1C010, this is to be based on the mechanical properties of the constituent unidirectional monofilaments (e.g., monofilaments, yarns, rovings or tows) prior to processing into the non-unidirectional “fibrous or filamentary materials”.

texts.zh: a. 具有以下所有特征的有机“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: a. Organic “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:
a.1. “Specific modulus” exceeding 12.7 × 10^{6} m; and
a.2. “Specific tensile strength” exceeding 23.5 × 10^{4} m;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1C010.a不管制聚乙烯。
texts.en: 1C010.a does not control polyethylene.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下所有特征的碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: b. Carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:
b.1. “Specific modulus” exceeding 14.65 × 10^{6} m; and
b.2. “Specific tensile strength” exceeding 26.82 × 10^{4} m;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1C010.b不管制：
texts.en: 1C010.b does not control:

texts.zh: a. 用于维修“民用航空器”结构或层压制品，且具有以下所有特征的“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: a. “Fibrous or filamentary materials”, for the repair of “civil aircraft” structures or laminates, having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 面积不超过1 m^{2}；
texts.en: 1. An area not exceeding 1 m^{2};

texts.zh: 2. 长度不超过2.5米；以及
texts.en: 2. A length not exceeding 2.5 m; and

texts.zh: 3. 宽度大于15毫米。
texts.en: 3. A width exceeding 15 mm.

texts.zh: b. 经机械切碎、研磨或切断，且长度为25.0毫米或以下的碳“纤维或丝状材料”。
texts.en: b. Mechanically chopped, milled or cut carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” 25.0 mm or less in length.

texts.zh: c. 具有以下所有特征的无机“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: c. Inorganic “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下任一特征：
texts.en: c.1. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 二氧化硅（SiO_{2}）重量含量为50%或以上，且“比模量”大于2.54 × 10^{6}米；或
texts.en: c.1.a. Composed of 50% or more by weight silicon dioxide (SiO_{2}) and having a “specific modulus” exceeding 2.54 × 10^{6} m; or

texts.zh: c.1.b. 不属于1C010.c.1.a规定范围，且“比模量”大于5.6 × 10^{6}米；以及
texts.en: c.1.b. Not specified in 1C010.c.1.a and having a “specific modulus” exceeding 5.6 × 10^{6} m; and

texts.zh: c.2. 在惰性环境中的熔点、软化点、分解点或升华点高于1,922 K（1,649 °C）；
texts.en: c.2. Melting, softening, decomposition or sublimation point exceeding 1,922 K (1,649 °C) in an inert environment;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1C010.c不管制：
texts.en: 1C010.c does not control:

texts.zh: a. 呈短切纤维或无规毡形态、不连续、多相、多晶的氧化铝纤维，其二氧化硅重量含量为3%或以上，且“比模量”小于10 × 10^{6}米；
texts.en: a. Discontinuous, multiphase, polycrystalline alumina fibers in chopped fiber or random mat form, containing 3% by weight or more silica, with a “specific modulus” of less than 10 × 10^{6} m;

texts.zh: b. 钼和钼合金纤维；
texts.en: b. Molybdenum and molybdenum alloy fibers;

texts.zh: c. 硼纤维；
texts.en: c. Boron fibers;

texts.zh: d. 在惰性环境中熔点、软化点、分解点或升华点低于2,043 K（1,770 °C）的不连续陶瓷纤维。
texts.en: d. Discontinuous ceramic fibers with a melting, softening, decomposition or sublimation point lower than 2,043 K (1,770 °C) in an inert environment.

texts.zh: d. 具有以下任一特征的“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: d. “Fibrous or filamentary materials”, having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 由以下任一种材料组成：
texts.en: d.1. Composed of any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1.a. 1C008.a管制的聚醚酰亚胺；或
texts.en: d.1.a. Polyetherimides controlled by 1C008.a; or

texts.zh: d.1.b. 1C008.b至1C008.f管制的材料；或
texts.en: d.1.b. Materials controlled by 1C008.b to 1C008.f; or

texts.zh: d.2. 由1C010.d.1.a或1C010.d.1.b管制材料组成，并与1C010.a、1C010.b或1C010.c管制的其他纤维‘混纤’；
texts.en: d.2. Composed of materials controlled by 1C010.d.1.a or 1C010.d.1.b and 'commingled' with other fibers controlled by 1C010.a, 1C010.b or 1C010.c;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就1C010.d.2而言，‘混纤’是将热塑性纤维与增强纤维逐丝混合，以形成完全呈纤维形态的纤维增强“基体”混合物。
texts.en: For the purposes of 1C010.d.2, 'commingled' is filament to filament blending of thermoplastic fibers and reinforcement fibers in order to produce a fiber reinforcement “matrix” mix in total fiber form.

texts.zh: e. 完全或部分浸渍树脂或沥青的“纤维或丝状材料”（预浸料）、金属或碳涂覆的“纤维或丝状材料”（预成型件），或‘碳纤维预成型件’，具有以下所有特征：
texts.en: e. Fully or partially resin impregnated or pitch impregnated “fibrous or filamentary materials” (prepregs), metal or carbon coated “fibrous or filamentary materials” (preforms) or 'carbon fiber preforms', having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 具有以下任一项：
texts.en: e.1. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.1.a. 1C010.c管制的无机“纤维或丝状材料”；或
texts.en: e.1.a. Inorganic “fibrous or filamentary materials” controlled by 1C010.c; or

texts.zh: e.1.b. 具有以下所有特征的有机或碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
texts.en: e.1.b. Organic or carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:
e.1.b.1. “Specific modulus” exceeding 10.15 × 10^{6} m; and
e.1.b.2 “Specific tensile strength” exceeding 17.7 × 10^{4}m; and

texts.zh: e.2. 具有以下任一项：
texts.en: e.2. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.2.a. 1C008或1C009.b管制的树脂或沥青；
texts.en: e.2.a. Resin or pitch, controlled by 1C008 or 1C009.b;

texts.zh: e.2.b. ‘动态力学分析玻璃化转变温度（DMA T_{g}）’等于或高于453 K（180 °C），并含有酚醛树脂；或
texts.en: e.2.b. 'Dynamic Mechanical Analysis glass transition temperature (DMA T_{g})' equal to or exceeding 453 K (180 °C) and having a phenolic resin; or

texts.zh: e.2.c. ‘动态力学分析玻璃化转变温度（DMA T_{g}）’等于或高于505 K（232 °C），并含有1C008或1C009.b未规定且不属于酚醛树脂的树脂或沥青；
texts.en: e.2.c. 'Dynamic Mechanical Analysis glass transition temperature (DMA T_{g})' equal to or exceeding 505 K (232 °C) and having a resin or pitch, not specified by 1C008 or 1C009.b, and not being a phenolic resin;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 未浸渍树脂或沥青的金属或碳涂覆“纤维或丝状材料”（预成型件）或‘碳纤维预成型件’，属于1C010.a、1C010.b或1C010.c中“纤维或丝状材料”的规定范围。
texts.en: Metal or carbon coated “fibrous or filamentary materials” (preforms) or 'carbon fiber preforms', not impregnated with resin or pitch, are specified by “fibrous or filamentary materials” in 1C010.a, 1C010.b or 1C010.c.

texts.zh: 注2：1C010.e不适用于：
texts.en: Note 2: 1C010.e does not apply to:

texts.zh: a. 用于维修“民用航空器”结构或层压制品、具有以下所有特征的环氧树脂“基体”浸渍碳“纤维或丝状材料”（预浸料）：
texts.en: a. Epoxy resin “matrix” impregnated carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” (prepregs) for the repair of “civil aircraft” structures or laminates, having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 面积不超过1 m^{2}
texts.en: 1. An area not exceeding 1 m^{2}

texts.zh: 2. 长度不超过2.5米；以及
texts.en: 2. A length not exceeding 2.5 m; and

texts.zh: 3. 宽度大于15毫米；
texts.en: 3. A width exceeding 15 mm;

texts.zh: b. 经机械切碎、研磨或切断、长度为25.0毫米或以下、完全或部分浸渍树脂或沥青的碳“纤维或丝状材料”，且所用树脂或沥青不属于1C008或1C009.b规定者。
texts.en: b. Fully or partially resin-impregnated or pitch-impregnated mechanically chopped, milled or cut carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” 25.0 mm or less in length when using a resin or pitch other than those specified by 1C008 or 1C009.b.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就1C010.e及注1而言，‘碳纤维预成型件’是涂覆或未涂覆纤维的有序排列，拟在引入“基体”形成“复合材料”之前构成零件的骨架。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 1C010.e and Note 1, 'carbon fiber preforms' are an ordered arrangement of uncoated or coated fibers intended to constitute a framework of a part before the “matrix” is introduced to form a “composite”.

texts.zh: 2. 就1C010.e.2而言，‘动态力学分析玻璃化转变温度（DMA Tg）’采用ASTM D 7028-07或国家等效标准所述方法，在干燥试样上确定。对于热固性材料，干燥试样的固化度须至少达到ASTM E 2160-04或国家等效标准定义的90%。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 1C010.e.2, 'Dynamic Mechanical Analysis glass transition temperature (DMA Tg)' is determined using the method described in ASTM D 7028 -07, or equivalent national standard, on a dry test specimen. In the case of thermoset materials, degree of cure of a dry test specimen shall be a minimum of 90% as defined by ASTM E 2160 04 or equivalent national standard.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 在15 °C测量体密度为1.72 g/cm^{3}或以上、粒径为100微米或以下，可用于火箭喷管和再入飞行器鼻尖的下列细晶石墨：
texts.en: Items: a. Fine grain graphites with a bulk density of 1.72 g/cm^{3} or greater, measured at 15 °C, and having a grain size of 100 micrometers or less, usable for rocket nozzles and reentry vehicle nose tips as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 直径为120毫米或以上、长度为50毫米或以上的圆柱体；
texts.en: a.1. Cylinders having a diameter of 120 mm or greater and a length of 50 mm or greater;

texts.zh: a.2. 内径为65毫米或以上、壁厚为25毫米或以上且长度为50毫米或以上的管材；
texts.en: a.2. Tubes having an inner diameter of 65 mm or greater and a wall thickness of 25 mm or greater and a length of 50 mm or greater;

texts.zh: a.3. 尺寸为120毫米 × 120毫米 × 50毫米或以上的块材。
texts.en: a.3. Blocks having a size of 120 mm × 120 mm × 50 mm or greater.

texts.zh: b. 可用于火箭喷管和再入飞行器鼻尖的热解石墨或纤维增强石墨；
texts.en: b. Pyrolytic or fibrous reinforced graphites, usable for rocket nozzles and reentry vehicle nose tips;

texts.zh: c. 用于可供“航程”等于或大于300千米的火箭、导弹和无人驾驶航空器使用的雷达罩的陶瓷复合材料（在100 MHz至100 GHz之间任一频率下介电常数小于6）；或
texts.en: c. Ceramic composite materials (dielectric constant is less than 6 at any frequency from 100 MHz to 100 GHz) for use in radomes useable in rockets, missiles, and unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km; or

texts.zh: d. 可用于“航程”等于或大于300千米的火箭、导弹和无人驾驶航空器的下列高温陶瓷材料：
texts.en: d. High-temperature ceramic materials, useable in rockets, missiles, and unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 可用于鼻尖、可整体机加工的碳化硅增强未烧结陶瓷。
texts.en: d.1. Bulk machinable silicon-carbide reinforced unfired ceramic, usable for nose tips.

texts.zh: d.2. 可用于鼻尖、再入飞行器及喷管瓣片的增强碳化硅陶瓷复合材料。
texts.en: d.2. Reinforced silicon-carbide ceramic composites usable for nose tips, re-entry vehicles, nozzle flaps.

texts.zh: d.3. 由熔点等于或高于3,000 °C的‘超高温陶瓷（UHTC）’基体组成、以纤维或丝增强、可整体机加工并可用于导弹部件（如鼻尖、再入飞行器、前缘、燃气舵、控制面或火箭发动机喉衬）的陶瓷复合材料。
texts.en: d.3. Bulk machinable ceramic composite materials consisting of an 'Ultra High Temperature Ceramic (UHTC)' matrix with a melting point equal to or greater than 3000 °C and reinforced with fibers or filaments, usable for missile components (such as nose tips, re-entry vehicles, leading edges, jet vanes, control surfaces, or rocket motor throat inserts).

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: ECCN 1C107.d.3不管制非复合形态的‘超高温陶瓷（UHTC）’材料。
texts.en: ECCN 1C107.d.3. does not control 'Ultra High Temperature Ceramic (UHTC)' materials in non-composite form.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: ‘超高温陶瓷（UHTC）’包括：二硼化钛（TiB_{2}）、二硼化锆（ZrB_{2}）、二硼化铌（NbB_{2}）、二硼化铪（HfB_{2}）、二硼化钽（TaB_{2}）、碳化钛（TiC）、碳化锆（ZrC）、碳化铌（NbC）、碳化铪（HfC）和碳化钽（TaC）。
texts.en: 'Ultra High Temperature Ceramics (UHTC)' includes: Titanium diboride (TiB_{2}), zirconium diboride (ZrB_{2}), niobium diboride (NbB_{2}), hafnium diboride (HfB_{2}), tantalum diboride (TaB_{2}), titanium carbide (TiC), zirconium carbide (ZrC), niobium carbide (NbC), hafnium carbide (HfC), tantalum carbide (TaC).

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category V(e)(7) for controls on HTPB (hydroxyl terminated polybutadiene) with a hydroxyl functionality equal to or greater than 2.2 and less than or equal to 2.4, a hydroxyl value of less than 0.77 meq/g, and a viscosity at 30 °C of less than 47 poise (CAS #69102-90-5). (2) See USML Category V for controls on ferrocene derivatives, including butacene. (3) See ECCN 1C608 for controls on oxidizers that are composed of fluorine and also other halogens, oxygen, or nitrogen, except for chlorine trifluoride, which is controlled under this ECCN 1C111.a.3.f. (4) See ECCN 1C011.b for controls on boron and boron alloys not controlled under this ECCN 1C111.a.2.b. (5) See USML Category V for controls on Inhibited Red Fuming Nitric Acid (IRFNA) (CAS 8007-58-7).

texts.zh: 相关定义：粒径是按重量或体积计算的平均颗粒直径。取样和确定粒径时必须采用最佳工业实践，不得通过添加较大或较小粒径材料改变平均直径而规避管制。
texts.en: Related Definitions: Particle size is the mean particle diameter on a weight or volume basis. Best industrial practices must be used in sampling, and in determining particle size, and the controls may not be undermined by the addition of larger or smaller sized material to shift the mean diameter.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 推进物质：
texts.en: a. Propulsive substances:

texts.zh: a.1. 粒径小于200 × 10^{−6}米（200 µm）、铝重量含量为97%或以上的球形或类球形铝粉（CAS 7429-90-5），且依据ISO 2591-1:1988或国家等效标准，总重量中至少10%由小于63 µm的颗粒组成。
texts.en: a.1. Spherical or spheroidal aluminum powder (C.A.S. 7429-90-5) in particle size of less than 200 × 10^{−6} m (200 µm) and an aluminum content of 97% by weight or more, if at least 10% of the total weight is made up of particles of less than 63 µm, according to ISO 2591-1:1988 or national equivalents.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 63 µm粒径（ISO R-565）对应250目（Tyler）或230目（ASTM E-11标准）。
texts.en: A particle size of 63 µm (ISO R-565) corresponds to 250 mesh (Tyler) or 230 mesh (ASTM standard E-11).

texts.zh: a.2. 下列金属粉末和合金，无论球形、雾化、类球形、片状或研磨形态，其中按颗粒体积或重量计，全部颗粒中至少90%由小于60 µ的颗粒组成（通过筛分、激光衍射或光学扫描等测量技术确定）：
texts.en: a.2. Metal powders and alloys where at least 90% of the total particles by particle volume or weight are made up of particles of less than 60 µ (determined by measurement techniques such as using a sieve, laser diffraction or optical scanning), whether spherical, atomized, spheroidal, flaked or ground, as follows:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 按重量计含有97%或以上的以下任一种物质：
texts.en: a.2.a. Consisting of 97% by weight or more of any of the following:
a.2.a.2. Beryllium (C.A.S. #7440-41-7); or

texts.zh: a.2.b. 硼重量含量为85%或以上的硼或硼合金。
texts.en: a.2.b. Boron or boron alloys with a boron content of 85% or more by weight.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 锆中天然存在的铪含量（通常为2%至7%）计入锆含量。
texts.en: The natural content of hafnium in the zirconium (typically 2% to 7%) is counted with the zirconium.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 在多峰颗粒分布（如不同粒径混合物）中，如一个或多个峰的颗粒受管制，则整个粉末混合物均受管制。
texts.en: In a multimodal particle distribution (e.g., mixtures of different grain sizes) in which one or more modes are controlled, the entire powder mixture is controlled.

texts.zh: a.3. 可用于液体推进剂火箭发动机的下列氧化剂物质：
texts.en: a.3. Oxidizer substances usable in liquid propellant rocket engines, as follows:
a.3.a. Dinitrogen trioxide (CAS 10544-73-7);

texts.zh: a.3.d. 混合氮氧化物（MON）；
texts.en: a.3.d. Mixed oxides of nitrogen (MON);

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 混合氮氧化物（MON）是一氧化氮（NO）在四氧化二氮/二氧化氮（N_{2}O_{4}/NO_{2}）中的溶液，可用于导弹系统。其具有一系列组成，可表示为MONi或MONij，其中i和j为表示混合物中一氧化氮百分比的整数（例如MON3含3%一氧化氮，MON25含25%一氧化氮；上限为MON40，即重量含量40%）。
texts.en: Mixed oxides of nitrogen (MON) are solutions of nitric oxide (NO) in dinitrogen tetroxide/nitrogen dioxide (N_{2}O_{4}/NO_{2}) that can be used in missile systems. There are a range of compositions that can be denoted as MONi or MONij, where i and j are integers representing the percentage of nitric oxide in the mixture (e.g., MON3 contains 3% nitric oxide, MON25 25% nitric oxide. An upper limit is MON40, 40% by weight).

texts.zh: b.1. 羧基封端聚丁二烯（包括端羧基聚丁二烯）（CTPB）；

texts.en: b.2. Hydroxy-terminated polybutadiene (including hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene) (HTPB) (CAS 69102-90-5), except for hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene as specified in USML Category V (see 22 CFR 121.1) (also see Related Controls Note #1 for this ECCN);

texts.zh: b.3. 聚丁二烯—丙烯酸共聚物（PBAA）；

texts.en: b.5. Polytetrahydrofuran polyethylene glycol (TPEG).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 聚四氢呋喃—聚乙二醇（TPEG）是聚1,4-丁二醇（CAS 110-63-4）与聚乙二醇（PEG）（CAS 25322-68-3）的嵌段共聚物。
texts.en: Polytetrahydrofuran polyethylene glycol (TPEG) is a block copolymer of poly 1,4-Butanediol (CAS 110-63-4) and polyethylene glycol (PEG) (CAS 25322-68-3).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 马氏体时效钢是通常具有以下特征的铁合金：
texts.en: Maraging steels are iron alloys that are generally:

texts.zh: a. 镍含量高、碳含量极低，使用置换元素或析出物使合金强化和时效硬化；以及
texts.en: a. Characterized by high nickel, very low carbon content and use substitutional elements or precipitates to produce strengthening and age-hardening of the alloy; and

texts.zh: b. 通过热处理循环促进马氏体转变过程（固溶退火阶段），随后进行时效硬化（沉淀硬化阶段）。
texts.en: b. Subjected to heat treatment cycles to facilitate the martensitic transformation process (solution annealed stage) and subsequently age hardened (precipitation hardened stage).

texts.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“纤维或丝状材料”仅限于连续“单丝”“纱线”“无捻粗纱”“丝束”或“带材”。本条目所用其他术语定义如下：
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, the term “fibrous or filamentary materials” is restricted to continuous “monofilaments”, “yarns”, “rovings”, “tows”, or “tapes”. Definitions for other terms used in this entry:

texts.zh: 丝或单丝是纤维的最小单位，通常直径为数微米。
texts.en: Filament or Monofilament is the smallest increment of fiber, usually several µm in diameter.

texts.zh: 股是大致平行排列的一束单丝（通常超过200根）。
texts.en: Strand is a bundle of filaments (typically over 200) arranged approximately parallel.

texts.zh: 无捻粗纱是一束大致平行排列的股（通常为12—120股）。
texts.en: Roving is a bundle (typically 12-120) of approximately parallel strands.

texts.zh: 纱线是一束加捻的股。
texts.en: Yarn is a bundle of twisted strands.

texts.zh: 丝束是一束通常大致平行的单丝。
texts.en: Tow is a bundle of filaments, usually approximately parallel.

texts.zh: 带材是由交织或单向的单丝、股、无捻粗纱、丝束或纱线等构成的材料，通常已预浸树脂。
texts.en: Tape is a material constructed of interlaced or unidirectional filaments, strands, rovings, tows, or yarns, etc., usually preimpregnated with resin.

texts.zh: 比模量是以N/m^{2}表示的杨氏模量除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296 ±2) K（(23 ±2) °C）和相对湿度50 ±5%条件下测量。
texts.en: Specific modulus is the Young's modulus in N/m^{2} divided by the specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296 ±2) K ((23 ±2) °C) and a relative humidity of 50 ±5 percent.

texts.zh: 比抗拉强度是以N/m^{2}表示的极限抗拉强度除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296 ±2) K（(23 ±2) °C）和相对湿度50 ±5%条件下测量。
texts.en: Specific tensile strength is the ultimate tensile strength in N/m^{2} divided by specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296 ±2) K ((23 ±2) °C) and a relative humidity of 50 ±5 percent.

texts.zh: 物项：a. “比模量”为12.7 × 10^{6}米或以上，或“比抗拉强度”为235 × 10^{3}米或以上的碳或芳纶“纤维或丝状材料”；但含有重量占比0.25%或以上的酯类纤维表面改性剂的芳纶“纤维或丝状材料”除外；
texts.en: Items: a. Carbon or aramid “fibrous or filamentary materials” having a “specific modulus” of 12.7 × 10^{6} m or greater or a “specific tensile strength” of 235 × 10^{3} m or greater except Aramid “fibrous or filamentary materials” having 0.25 percent or more by weight of an ester based fiber surface modifier;

texts.zh: b. “比模量”为3.18 × 10^{6}米或以上，且“比抗拉强度”为76.2 × 10^{3}米或以上的玻璃“纤维或丝状材料”；或
texts.en: b. Glass “fibrous or filamentary materials” having a “specific modulus” of 3.18 × 10^{6} m or greater and a “specific tensile strength” of 76.2 × 10^{3} m or greater; or

texts.zh: c. 由1C210.a或.b管制碳或玻璃“纤维或丝状材料”制成、经热固性树脂浸渍的连续“纱线”“无捻粗纱”“丝束”或宽度不大于15毫米的“带材”（预浸料）。
texts.en: c. Thermoset resin impregnated continuous “yarns”, “rovings”, “tows” or “tapes” with a width no greater than 15 mm (prepregs), made from carbon or glass “fibrous or filamentary materials” controlled by 1C210.a or .b.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 树脂构成复合材料的基体。
texts.en: The resin forms the matrix of the composite.

texts.zh: ECCN管制：本条目不管制下列物项：
texts.en: ECCN Controls: This entry does not control the following:

texts.zh: a. 丝状镍粉；
texts.en: a. Filamentary nickel powders;

texts.zh: b. 每片面积为1,000 cm^{2}或以下的单片多孔镍板。
texts.en: b. Single porous nickel sheets with an area of 1,000 cm^{2} per sheet or less.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 同时具有以下两项特征的镍粉：
texts.en: Items: a. Nickel powder having both of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 镍重量纯度为99.0%或以上；以及
texts.en: a.1. A nickel purity content of 99.0% or greater by weight; and

texts.zh: a.2. 依据美国材料与试验协会（ASTM）B330标准测量的平均粒径小于10微米；
texts.en: a.2. A mean particle size of less than 10 micrometers measured by American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) B330 standard;

texts.zh: b. 由1C240.a管制材料制成的多孔镍金属。
texts.en: b. Porous nickel metal produced from materials controlled by 1C240.a.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 1C240.b是指将1C240.a中的材料压实并烧结，形成整个结构内部细孔互相连通的多孔金属材料。
texts.en: 1C240.b refers to porous metal formed by compacting and sintering the materials in 1C240.a to form a metal material with fine pores interconnected throughout the structure.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见1C107。(2) 依据ASTM C-1233-98测量纯度水平为“硼当量”低于5 ppm，且拟用于核反应堆的石墨，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。(3) 氘原子与氢原子之比超过1:5,000，且拟用于核反应堆的氘及任何氘化合物（包括重水），受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 1C107. (2) Graphite having a purity level of less than 5 parts per million “boron equivalent” as measured according to ASTM standard C-1233-98 and intended for use in a nuclear reactor is subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110). (3) Deuterium and any deuterium compound, including heavy water, in which the ratio of deuterium atoms to hydrogen atoms exceeds 1:5000; and intended for use in a nuclear reactor is subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

texts.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，石墨纯度优于5 ppm硼当量，依据ASTM C1233-98确定。适用该标准时，元素碳的硼当量不计入硼当量计算，因为碳不被视为杂质。就本条目而言，‘氘’是指氘原子与氢原子之比超过1:5,000的氘及任何氘化合物，包括重水。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, graphite with a purity level better than 5 parts per million boron equivalent is determined according to ASTM standard C1233-98. In applying ASTM standard C1233-98, the boron equivalence of the element carbon is not included in the boron equivalence calculation, since carbon is not considered an impurity. For the purpose of this entry, 'Deuterium' means deuterium and any deuterium compound, including heavy water, in which the ratio of deuterium atoms to hydrogen atoms exceeds 1:5000.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 硼含量小于5 ppm、密度大于1.5克/立方厘米，且拟用于核反应堆以外用途的石墨；
texts.en: a. Graphite with a boron content of less than 5 parts per million and a density greater than 1.5 grams per cubic centimeter that is intended for use other than in a nuclear reactor;

texts.zh: b. 非用于核反应堆的‘氘’。
texts.en: b. 'Deuterium' not for use in a nuclear reactor.

texts.zh: CW适用于1C350.b和.c。商业国家表不用于确定因CW原因受管制物项的许可要求。向《禁止化学武器公约》（CWC）非缔约国（EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明的目的地）出口或再出口1C350.b所列附表2化学品和混合物，因CW原因须取得许可证。向CWC非缔约国出口1C350.c所列附表3化学品和混合物，因CW原因须取得许可证，除非出口商在出口前已取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明。将1C350.c所列附表3化学品和混合物从一个CWC非缔约国再出口至任何其他CWC非缔约国，因CW原因须取得许可证。（因CW原因受管制的有毒化学品及前体化学品的许可要求和政策，见EAR §742.18。向EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明国家出口附表3化学品适用的最终用途证明要求，见EAR §745.2。）
texts.en: CW applies to 1C350.b and .c. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CW reasons. A license is required, for CW reasons, to export or reexport Schedule 2 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C350.b to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR). A license is required, for CW reasons, to export Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C350.c to States not Party to the CWC, unless an End-Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country has been obtained by the exporter prior to export. A license is required, for CW reasons, to reexport Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C350.c from a State not Party to the CWC to any other State not Party to the CWC. (See § 742.18 of the EAR for license requirements and policies for toxic and precursor chemicals controlled for CW reasons. See § 745.2 of the EAR for End-Use Certificate requirements that apply to exports of Schedule 3 chemicals to countries not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR.)

texts.zh: AT适用于本条目全部物项。商业国家表不用于确定1C350中因AT原因受管制物项的许可要求。向EAR第740部分补充文件第1号国家组E:1中的国家出口或再出口1C350管制物项，因AT原因须取得许可证。（有关适用于伊朗、朝鲜和叙利亚的AT管制，见EAR第742部分；适用于这些国家的制裁，见EAR第746部分。）
texts.en: AT applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for AT reasons in 1C350. A license is required, for AT reasons, to export or reexport items controlled by 1C350 to a country in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR. (See part 742 of the EAR for additional information on the AT controls that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria. See part 746 of the EAR for additional information on sanctions that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria.)

texts.zh: 许可要求注
texts.en: License Requirement Notes

texts.zh: 1. 样品运输：在符合以下要求和限制的前提下，同一历年向同一收货人运输单一化学品样品的累计总量不超过一个55加仑容器或200千克时，无须许可证。依据本项排除接收样品的收货人不得转售、转移或再出口样品，但可将其用于与化学武器无关的任何其他合法目的。
texts.en: 1. SAMPLE SHIPMENTS: Subject to the following requirements and restrictions, a license is not required for sample shipments when the cumulative total of these shipments does not exceed a 55-gallon container or 200 kg of a single chemical to any one consignee during a calendar year. A consignee that receives a sample shipment under this exclusion may not resell, transfer, or reexport the sample shipment, but may use the sample shipment for any other legal purpose unrelated to chemical weapons.

texts.zh: a. 不符合资格的化学品
texts.en: a. Chemicals Not Eligible

texts.zh: A. [保留]
texts.en: A. [Reserved]

texts.zh: B. CWC附表2化学品（CWC非缔约国）。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明的目的地）运输1C350.b所列任何CWC附表2化学品或混合物的样品，均不得免证。
texts.en: B. CWC Schedule 2 chemicals (States not Party to the CWC). No CWC Schedule 2 chemical or mixture identified in 1C350.b is eligible for sample shipment to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR) without a license.

texts.zh: b. 不符合资格的国家：EAR第740部分补充文件第1号国家组E:1中的国家，不得无证接收本ECCN管制的任何化学品样品。
texts.en: b. Countries Not Eligible: Countries in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR are not eligible to receive sample shipments of any chemicals controlled by this ECCN without a license.

texts.zh: c. 因CW原因须取得最终用途证明的样品运输：向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补充文件第2号未列明的目的地）运输1C350.c所列任何CWC附表3化学品或混合物的样品，均不得免证，除非出口商在出口前取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明（最终用途证明要求见EAR §745.2）。
texts.en: c. Sample shipments that require an End-Use Certificate for CW reasons: No CWC Schedule 3 chemical or mixture identified in 1C350.c is eligible for sample shipment to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR) without a license, unless an End-Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country is obtained by the exporter prior to export (see § 745.2 of the EAR for End-Use Certificate requirements).

texts.zh: d. 因EAR其他规定须取得许可证的样品运输：本注1所述样品运输，仍可能因EAR其他规定须取得许可证。尤其参见EAR第744部分最终用途/最终用户限制，以及第746部分对禁运国家的限制。
texts.en: d. Sample shipments that require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR: Sample shipments, as described in this Note 1, may require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR. See, in particular, the end-use/end-user restrictions in part 744 of the EAR, and the restrictions that apply to embargoed countries in part 746 of the EAR.

texts.zh: e. 年度报告要求。出口商须就依据本注1进行的样品运输提交年度书面报告。报告须使用公司抬头信纸，第一页顶部标题为“Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors”（化学品前体样品运输报告），并列明上一历年全部样品运输的化学品名称、化学文摘社登记号（CAS号）、数量、最终收货人姓名或名称及地址，以及出口日期。报告须最迟于样品运输所在历年次年2月28日提交至：U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security, 14th Street and Pennsylvania Ave. NW, Room 2099B, Washington, DC 20230；收件事项：“Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors”。
texts.en: e. Annual report requirement. The exporter is required to submit an annual written report for shipments of samples made under this Note 1. The report must be on company letterhead stationery (titled “Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors” at the top of the first page) and identify the chemical(s), Chemical Abstract Service Registry (C.A.S.) number(s), quantity(ies), the ultimate consignee's name and address, and the date of export for all sample shipments that were made during the previous calendar year. The report must be submitted no later than February 28 of the year following the calendar year in which the sample shipments were made, to: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security, 14th Street and Pennsylvania Ave. NW, Room 2099B, Washington, DC 20230, Attn: “Report of Sample Shipments of Chemical Precursors.”

texts.zh: 2. 混合物：
texts.en: 2. MIXTURES:

texts.zh: a. 含有ECCN 1C350所列前体化学品、但浓度低于1C350.b至.d所示水平的混合物，受ECCN 1C395或1C995管制，并适用这些ECCN规定的许可要求。
texts.en: a. Mixtures that contain precursor chemicals identified in ECCN 1C350, in concentrations that are below the levels indicated in 1C350.b through .d, are controlled by ECCN 1C395 or 1C995 and are subject to the licensing requirements specified in those ECCNs.

texts.zh: b. 混合物中的受管制化学品如属于供个人使用、按零售方式包装的消费品正常成分，则本ECCN不要求许可证。此类消费品归为EAR99。但仍可能因EAR其他规定须取得许可证。
texts.en: b. A license is not required under this ECCN for a mixture, when the controlled chemical in the mixture is a normal ingredient in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use. Such consumer goods are designated EAR99. However, a license may be required for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR.

texts.zh: 混合物注：澳大利亚集团（AG）管制化学品浓度的计算：
texts.en: Note to Mixtures: Calculation of concentrations of AG-controlled chemicals:

texts.zh: a. 排除。不得仅为规避《出口管理条例》而向混合物（溶液）中添加任何化学品；
texts.en: a. Exclusion. No chemical may be added to the mixture (solution) for the sole purpose of circumventing the Export Administration Regulations;

texts.zh: b. 重量百分比计算。计算化学混合物中各成分的重量百分比时，应计入全部成分，包括作为溶剂的成分。
texts.en: b. Percent Weight Calculation. When calculating the percentage, by weight, of ingredients in a chemical mixture, include all ingredients of the mixture, including those that act as solvents.

texts.zh: 3. 化合物。使用本ECCN 1C350所列任何化学品形成的化合物，可以NLR（无须许可证）方式运输，无须取得最终用途证明；但该化合物本身也列于本条目，或因EAR其他规定须取得许可证的除外。
texts.en: 3. COMPOUNDS. Compounds created with any chemicals identified in this ECCN 1C350 may be shipped NLR (No License Required), without obtaining an End-Use Certificate, unless those compounds are also identified in this entry or require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR.

texts.zh: 4. 测试试剂盒：含有少量本ECCN 1C350所列化学品的某些医疗、分析、诊断和食品测试试剂盒，不在本ECCN范围内，而受ECCN 1C395或1C995管制。（注意：这些试剂盒的替换试剂，如含有一种或多种1C350所列前体化学品，且浓度达到或超过1C350所示混合物管制水平，则受本ECCN 1C350管制。）
texts.en: 4. TESTING KITS: Certain medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits containing small quantities of chemicals identified in this ECCN 1C350, are excluded from the scope of this ECCN and are controlled under ECCN 1C395 or 1C995. (Note that replacement reagents for such kits are controlled by this ECCN 1C350 if the reagents contain one or more of the precursor chemicals identified in 1C350 in concentrations equal to or greater than the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.)

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就本条目而言，“混合物”定义为由两种或多种在正常储存条件下不相互反应的成分组成的固体、液体或气体产品。
texts.en: 1. For purposes of this entry, a “mixture” is defined as a solid, liquid or gaseous product made up of two or more ingredients that do not react together under normal storage conditions.

texts.zh: 2. 对氟化氢的本项管制范围（见受管制物项清单1C350.d.14）包括其液相、气相、水溶液及水合物。
texts.en: 2. The scope of this control applicable to Hydrogen Fluoride (see 1C350.d.14 in the List of Items Controlled) includes its liquid, gaseous, and aqueous phases, and hydrates.

texts.zh: 3. ECCN 1C350前体化学品按名称、化学文摘社（CAS）号和CWC附表（如适用）列示。结构式相同的前体化学品（如水合物、同位素标记形态或所有可能的立体异构体），均受ECCN 1C350管制，不论名称或CAS号为何。列示CAS号是为了辅助识别特定前体化学品或混合物是否受ECCN 1C350管制，不受命名方式影响。但CAS号不能在所有情况下作为唯一标识，因为所列前体化学品的某些形态具有不同CAS号，含有ECCN 1C350所列前体化学品的混合物也可能具有不同CAS号。
texts.en: 3. Precursor chemicals in ECCN 1C350 are listed by name, Chemical Abstract Service (CAS) number and CWC Schedule (where applicable). Precursor chemicals of the same structural formula (e.g., hydrates, isotopically-labeled forms or all possible stereoisomers) are controlled by ECCN 1C350, regardless of name or CAS number. CAS numbers are shown to assist in identifying whether a particular precursor chemical or mixture is controlled under ECCN 1C350, irrespective of nomenclature. However, CAS numbers cannot be used as unique identifiers in all situations because some forms of the listed precursor chemical have different CAS numbers, and mixtures containing a precursor chemical listed in ECCN 1C350 may also have different CAS numbers.

texts.zh: 许可要求注
texts.en: License Requirement Notes

texts.zh: 1. 所有疫苗和‘免疫毒素’均排除在本条目范围之外。含有1C351.d管制生物毒素的某些医疗产品、诊断及食品测试试剂盒，也排除在本条目范围之外，但因CW原因受1C351.d.15或.d.16管制的毒素除外。排除在本条目范围之外的疫苗、‘免疫毒素’、某些医疗产品、诊断及食品测试试剂盒，受ECCN 1C991管制。
texts.en: 1. All vaccines and 'immunotoxins' are excluded from the scope of this entry. Certain medical products and diagnostic and food testing kits that contain biological toxins controlled under 1C351.d, with the exception of toxins controlled for CW reasons under 1C351.d.15 or .d.16, are excluded from the scope of this entry. Vaccines, 'immunotoxins', certain medical products, and diagnostic and food testing kits excluded from the scope of this entry are controlled under ECCN 1C991.

texts.zh: 2. 除1C351.c.12所述产ε毒素产气荚膜梭菌菌株外，其他产气荚膜梭菌菌株排除在本条目范围之外，因为它们可用作食品测试和质量控制的阳性对照培养物。
texts.en: 2. Clostridium perfringens strains, other than the epsilon toxin-producing strains of Clostridium perfringens described in 1C351.c.12, are excluded from the scope of this entry, since they may be used as positive control cultures for food testing and quality control.

texts.zh: 3. 除本ECCN 1C351其他处另有规定（如许可要求注1—3）外，本ECCN管制其受管制物项清单所列的所有生物剂和“毒素”，不论数量或减毒情况，包括美国农业部（USDA）动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）或美国卫生与公众服务部（HHS）疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）分别依据其《联邦法规》第9编第121部分和第42编第73部分规定，从特定生物剂或“毒素”清单中排除的少量或减毒菌株生物剂及“毒素”。
texts.en: 3. Unless specified elsewhere in this ECCN 1C351 (e.g., in License Requirement Notes 1-3), this ECCN controls all biological agents and “toxins,” regardless of quantity or attenuation, that are identified in the List of Items Controlled for this ECCN, including small quantities or attenuated strains of select biological agents or “toxins” that are excluded from the lists of select biological agents or “toxins” by the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), or the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), in accordance with their regulations in 9 CFR part 121 and 42 CFR part 73, respectively.

texts.zh: 4. 生物剂和病原体在以下形态下受本ECCN 1C351管制：病原体的分离活培养物，或从任何来源或材料中分离或提取的毒素制剂，包括故意接种或污染该生物剂的活体材料。病原体分离活培养物包括休眠形态或干燥制剂中的活培养物，不论其为天然、经增强还是经改造。
texts.en: 4. Biological agents and pathogens are controlled under this ECCN 1C351 when they are an isolated live culture of a pathogen agent, or a preparation of a toxin agent that has been isolated or extracted from any source or material, including living material that has been deliberately inoculated or contaminated with the agent. Isolated live cultures of a pathogen agent include live cultures in dormant form or in dried preparations, whether the agent is natural, enhanced or modified.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 1C351.d.15和.d.16中的某些蓖麻毒素和石房蛤毒素形态属于CWC附表1化学品（见EAR §742.18）。美国政府必须就所有附表1化学品出口向禁止化学武器组织（OPCW）作事先通知并提交年度报告。通知程序见EAR §745.1。“受ITAR管辖”的CWC附表1化学品见《联邦法规》第22编第121部分第XIV类。(2) 美国农业部动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）及美国卫生与公众服务部疾病控制与预防中心（CDC），对本ECCN管制某些物项在美国境内的持有、使用和转移实施管制（APHIS见《联邦法规》第7编§331.3(b)、第9编§121.3(b)和§121.4(b)；CDC见第42编§73.3(b)和§73.4(b)）。(3) “受ITAR管辖”的改造生物剂及生物来源物质见USML第XIV类（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Certain forms of ricin and saxitoxin in 1C351.d.15 and .d.16 are CWC Schedule 1 chemicals (see § 742.18 of the EAR). The U.S. Government must provide advance notification and annual reports to the OPCW of all exports of Schedule 1 chemicals. See § 745.1 of the EAR for notification procedures. See 22 CFR part 121, Category XIV for CWC Schedule 1 chemicals that are “subject to the ITAR.” (2) The Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), U.S. Department of Agriculture, and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, maintain controls on the possession, use, and transfer within the United States of certain items controlled by this ECCN (for APHIS, see 7 CFR 331.3(b), 9 CFR 121.3(b), and 9 CFR 121.4(b); for CDC, see 42 CFR 73.3(b) and 42 CFR 73.4(b)). (3) See USML Category XIV for modified biological agents and biologically derived substances that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，‘免疫毒素’是与毒素连接的单克隆抗体，目的在于破坏特定靶细胞，同时保持邻近细胞完好。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purposes of this entry, 'immunotoxins' are monoclonal antibodies linked to a toxin with the intention of destroying a specific target cell while leaving adjacent cells intact.

texts.en: a.4. Avian influenza (AI) viruses identified as having high pathogenicity (HP), as follows:

texts.zh: a.4.a. 在6周龄鸡中的静脉内致病指数（IVPI）大于1.2的禽流感病毒；或
texts.en: a.4.a. AI viruses that have an intravenous pathogenicity index (IVPI) in 6-week-old chickens greater than 1.2; or

texts.en: a.4.b. AI viruses that cause at least 75% mortality in 4- to 8-week-old chickens infected intravenously.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 对于不具有1C351.a.4（具体为1C351.a.4.a或.a.4.b）所述任一特征的H5或H7亚型禽流感（AI）病毒，应进行测序，以确定血凝素分子（HA0）裂解位点是否存在多个碱性氨基酸。如果其氨基酸序列基序与其他高致病性禽流感（HPAI）分离株中观察到的相似，则应将受试分离株视为HPAI，该病毒受1C351.a.4管制。
texts.en: Avian influenza (AI) viruses of the H5 or H7 subtype that do not have either of the characteristics described in 1C351.a.4 (specifically, 1C351.a.4.a or .a.4.b) should be sequenced to determine whether multiple basic amino acids are present at the cleavage site of the haemagglutinin molecule (HA0). If the amino acid motif is similar to that observed for other HPAI isolates, then the isolate being tested should be considered as HPAI and the virus is controlled under 1C351.a.4.

texts.en: 1. Vaccines that contain genetic elements or genetically modified organisms identified in this ECCN are controlled by ECCN 1C991.

texts.zh: 2. 除本ECCN 1C353其他位置另有规定（例如许可要求注释1）外，受管制物项清单列明的全部生物因子和毒素的遗传元件或遗传修饰生物体均受本条目管制，不论数量或减毒程度；这包括按照美国农业部动植物卫生检验局（APHIS）7 CFR第331部分和9 CFR第121部分以及美国卫生与公众服务部疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）42 CFR第73部分，由APHIS或CDC从特定病原体清单中排除的特定生物因子或毒素减毒株的遗传元件或遗传修饰生物体。

texts.zh: a.1. ECCN 1C351.a、1C351.b或1C354.c管制的任何病毒所特有的任何单个或多个基因、单个或多个翻译产物；
texts.en: a.1. Any gene, genes, translated product or translated products specific to any virus controlled by 1C351.a or .b or 1C354.c;

texts.zh: a.2. ECCN 1C351.c或1C354.a管制的任何细菌，或1C351.e或1C354.b管制的任何真菌所特有的任何单个或多个基因，且：
texts.en: a.2. Any gene or genes specific to any bacterium controlled by 1C351.c or 1C354.a, or any fungus controlled by 1C351.e or 1C354.b, and which;

texts.zh: a.2.a. 其本身或通过其转录或翻译产物对人类、动物或植物健康构成重大危害；或
texts.en: a.2.a. In itself or through its transcribed or translated products represents a significant hazard to human, animal or plant health; or

texts.zh: a.2.b. 能够赋予或增强致病性；或
texts.en: a.2.b. Could endow or enhance pathogenicity; or

texts.en: a.3. Any toxins, or their subunits, controlled by 1C351.d.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 遗传修饰生物体包括通过人为分子操作创建或改变核酸序列的生物体。
texts.en: 1. Genetically modified organisms include organisms in which the nucleic acid sequences have been created or altered by deliberate molecular manipulation.

texts.zh: 2. “遗传元件”包括但不限于染色体、基因组、质粒、转座子、载体，以及含有可回收核酸片段的灭活生物体，无论其经过或未经过遗传修饰，或全部或部分通过化学合成。就本ECCN 1C353而言，如果材料的灭活和制备旨在或已知可促进核酸的分离、纯化、扩增、检测或鉴定，则来自灭活生物体、病毒或样本的核酸视为“可回收”。
texts.en: 2. “Genetic elements” include, inter alia, chromosomes, genomes, plasmids, transposons, vectors, and inactivated organisms containing recoverable nucleic acid fragments, whether genetically modified or unmodified, or chemically synthesized in whole or in part. For the purposes of this ECCN 1C353, nucleic acids from an inactivated organism, virus, or sample are considered to be 'recoverable' if the inactivation and preparation of the material is intended or known to facilitate isolation, purification, amplification, detection, or identification of nucleic acids.

texts.zh: 3. 本ECCN不管制O26、O45、O103、O104、O111、O121、O145、O157血清群及其他产志贺毒素血清群的产志贺毒素大肠杆菌核酸序列，但编码志贺毒素或其亚单位的遗传元件除外。
texts.en: 3. This ECCN does not control nucleic acid sequences of shiga toxin producing Escherichia coli of serogroups O26, O45, O103, O104, O111, O121, O145, O157, and other shiga toxin producing serogroups, other than those genetic elements coding for shiga toxin, or for its subunits.

texts.zh: 4. “赋予或增强致病性”是指插入或整合一个或多个核酸序列可能使受体生物体获得或增强被用于故意导致疾病或死亡的能力。这可包括对以下方面的改变，但不限于：毒力、传播能力、稳定性、感染途径、宿主范围、繁殖能力、逃避或抑制宿主免疫的能力、对医疗应对措施的抵抗能力或可检测性。
texts.en: 4. 'Endow or enhance pathogenicity' is defined as when the insertion or integration of the nucleic acid sequence or sequences is/are likely to enable or increase a recipient organism's ability to be used to deliberately cause disease or death. This might include alterations to, inter alia: virulence, transmissibility, stability, route of infection, host range, reproducibility, ability to evade or suppress host immunity, resistance to medical countermeasures, or detectability.

texts.en: 1C355 Chemical Weapons Convention (CWC) Schedule 2 and 3 chemicals and families of chemicals not controlled by ECCN 1C350 or “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts) (see List of Items Controlled).

texts.zh: 许可要求
texts.en: License Requirements

texts.en: Reason for Control: CW, AT.

texts.zh: 管制
texts.en: Control(s)

texts.zh: CW适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定因CW原因受管制物项的许可要求。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补编2未列明的目的地）出口或再出口1C355.a列明的CWC附表2化学品及混合物需要许可证。向CWC非缔约国出口1C355.b列明的CWC附表3化学品及混合物需要许可证，除非出口商在出口前取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明。将1C355.b列明的CWC附表3化学品及混合物从一个CWC非缔约国再出口到任何其他CWC非缔约国需要许可证。（因CW原因受管制的有毒化学品及前体化学品的许可要求和政策，见EAR第742.18节。）
texts.en: CW applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CW reasons. A license is required to export or reexport CWC Schedule 2 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C355.a to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR). A license is required to export CWC Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C355.b to States not Party to the CWC, unless an End Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country is obtained by the exporter, prior to export. A license is required to reexport CWC Schedule 3 chemicals and mixtures identified in 1C355.b from a State not Party to the CWC to any other State not Party to the CWC. (See § 742.18 of the EAR for license requirements and policies for toxic and precursor chemicals controlled for CW reasons.)

texts.zh: AT适用于本条目全部物项。商业国家表不用于确定1C350中因AT原因受管制物项的许可要求。向EAR第740部分补充文件第1号国家组E:1中的国家出口或再出口1C350管制物项，因AT原因须取得许可证。（有关适用于伊朗、朝鲜和叙利亚的AT管制，见EAR第742部分；适用于这些国家的制裁，见EAR第746部分。）
texts.en: AT applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for AT reasons in 1C350. A license is required, for AT reasons, to export or reexport items controlled by 1C350 to a country in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR. (See part 742 of the EAR for additional information on the AT controls that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria. See part 746 of the EAR for additional information on sanctions that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria.)

texts.zh: 许可要求注：
texts.en: License Requirements Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 混合物：
texts.en: 1. MIXTURES:

texts.zh: a. 含有ECCN 1C355列明的有毒化学品及前体化学品、且浓度低于1C355.a和.b所示管制水平的混合物，受ECCN 1C995管制，并适用该ECCN规定的许可要求。
texts.en: a. Mixtures containing toxic and precursor chemicals identified in ECCN 1C355, in concentrations that are below the control levels indicated in 1C355.a and .b, are controlled by ECCN 1C995 and are subject to the license requirements specified in that ECCN.

texts.zh: b. 含有本条目列明化学品的混合物，如果该受管制化学品是包装供零售以供个人使用或包装供个人使用的消费品的正常成分，则不受ECCN 1C355管制。此类消费品归为EAR99。
texts.en: b. Mixtures containing chemicals identified in this entry are not controlled by ECCN 1C355 when the controlled chemical is a normal ingredient in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use or packaged for individual use. Such consumer goods are classified as EAR99.

texts.zh: 混合物注释：
texts.en: Note to mixtures:

texts.zh: 受CW管制化学品的浓度计算：
texts.en: Calculation of concentrations of CW-controlled chemicals:

texts.zh: a. 排除。不得仅为规避《出口管理条例》而向混合物（溶液）中添加任何化学品；
texts.en: a. Exclusion. No chemical may be added to the mixture (solution) for the sole purpose of circumventing the Export Administration Regulations;

texts.zh: b. 重量百分比计算。计算化学混合物中各成分的重量百分比时，应计入全部成分，包括作为溶剂的成分。
texts.en: b. Percent Weight Calculation. When calculating the percentage, by weight, of ingredients in a chemical mixture, include all ingredients of the mixture, including those that act as solvents.

texts.zh: 2. 化合物：使用本ECCN 1C355列明的任何化学品制成的化合物可以NLR（无需许可证）方式装运，无需取得最终用途证明，除非这些化合物也列于本条目，或由于EAR其他位置所述原因需要许可证。
texts.en: 2. COMPOUNDS: Compounds created with any chemicals identified in this ECCN 1C355 may be shipped NLR (No License Required), without obtaining an End-Use Certificate, unless those compounds are also identified in this entry or require a license for reasons set forth elsewhere in the EAR.

texts.zh: 就本条目而言，“混合物”定义为由两种或两种以上成分组成的固体、液体或气体产品，这些成分在正常储存条件下不相互反应。
texts.en: For purposes of this entry, a “mixture” is defined as a solid, liquid or gaseous product made up of two or more ingredients that do not react together under normal storage conditions.

texts.zh: 管制：CB适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定1C395中因CB原因受管制物项的许可要求。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补编2未列明的目的地）出口或再出口1C395.a管制的混合物以及1C395.b管制的检测试剂盒，因CB原因需要许可证。
texts.en: Control(s): CB applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CB reasons in 1C395. A license is required, for CB reasons, to export or reexport mixtures controlled by 1C395.a and test kits controlled by 1C395.b to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR).

texts.zh: CW适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定因CW原因受管制物项的许可要求。向CWC非缔约国（EAR第745部分补编2未列明的目的地）进行下列活动，因CW原因需要许可证：（1）出口和再出口1C395.a管制的混合物；（2）出口和再出口1C395.b管制、且含有ECCN 1C350管制的CWC附表2化学品的检测试剂盒；（3）出口1C395.b管制、且含有ECCN 1C350管制的CWC附表3化学品的检测试剂盒，但如果出口商在出口前取得进口国政府签发的最终用途证明，则出口含有CWC附表3化学品的检测试剂盒不因CW原因需要许可证；以及（4）从CWC非缔约国再出口1C395.b管制且含有CWC附表3化学品的检测试剂盒。（因CW原因受管制的有毒化学品及前体化学品的许可要求和政策，见EAR第742.18节。）
texts.en: CW applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for CW reasons. A license is required for CW reasons, as follows, to States not Party to the CWC (destinations not listed in Supplement No. 2 to part 745 of the EAR): (1) Exports and reexports of mixtures controlled by 1C395.a, (2) exports and reexports of test kits controlled by 1C395.b that contain CWC Schedule 2 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350, (3) exports of test kits controlled by 1C395.b that contain CWC Schedule 3 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350, except that a license is not required, for CW reasons, to export test kits containing CWC Schedule 3 chemicals if an End-Use Certificate issued by the government of the importing country is obtained by the exporter prior to export, and (4) reexports from States not Party to the CWC of test kits controlled by 1C395.b that contain CWC Schedule 3 chemicals. (See § 742.18 of the EAR for license requirements and policies for toxic and precursor chemicals controlled for CW reasons.)

texts.zh: AT适用于整个条目。商务国家表不用于确定1C395中因AT原因受管制物项的许可要求。向EAR第740部分补编1国家组E:1中的国家出口或再出口1C395管制的物项，因AT原因需要许可证。（适用于伊朗、朝鲜、苏丹和叙利亚的AT管制补充信息见EAR第742部分。适用于伊朗、朝鲜和叙利亚的制裁补充信息见EAR第746部分。）
texts.en: AT applies to entire entry. The Commerce Country Chart is not designed to determine licensing requirements for items controlled for AT reasons in 1C395. A license is required, for AT reasons, to export or reexport items controlled by 1C395 to a country in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR. (See part 742 of the EAR for additional information on the AT controls that apply to Iran, North Korea, Sudan, and Syria. See part 746 of the EAR for additional information on sanctions that apply to Iran, North Korea, and Syria.)

texts.en: Related Controls: 1. ECCN 1C350 controls mixtures containing 30 percent or higher concentrations, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b; ECCN 1C995 controls such mixtures containing concentrations of 10 percent or less. 2. ECCN 1C995 controls “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Definitions paragraph of this ECCN) that contain precursor chemicals listed in ECCN 1C350.d. ECCN 1C350 controls any such kits in which the amount of any single chemical listed in 1C350.b, .c, or .d exceeds 300 grams by weight.

texts.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”是具有规定组成、专门为医疗、分析、诊断或公共卫生目的开发、包装和销售的预包装材料。对于1C395.b所述医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒的替换试剂，如果其含有ECCN 1C350列明的至少一种前体化学品，且浓度等于或高于1C350.b或.c所示混合物管制水平，则受ECCN 1C350管制。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” are pre-packaged materials of defined composition that are specifically developed, packaged and marketed for medical, analytical, diagnostic, or public health purposes. Replacement reagents for medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits described in 1C395.b are controlled by ECCN 1C350 if the reagents contain at least one of the precursor chemicals identified in that ECCN in concentrations equal to or greater than the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.b. or .c.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 含有ECCN 1C350.b列明的任何单一CWC附表2化学品，且该化学品占混合物重量超过10%但低于30%的混合物（含有这些化学品的其他混合物的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段注释1）。
texts.en: Items: a. Mixtures containing more than 10 percent, but less than 30 percent, by weight of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b (For controls on other mixtures containing these chemicals, see Note 1 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.).

texts.zh: b. 含有ECCN 1C350.b或.c管制的CWC附表2或附表3化学品、且每种化学品含量不超过300克的“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”（定义见本ECCN相关定义）。（含有这些化学品及其他受管制化学品的其他此类检测试剂盒的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段注释2。）
texts.en: b. “Medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Definitions for this ECCN) that contain CWC Schedule 2 or 3 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350.b or .c in an amount not exceeding 300 grams per chemical. (For controls on other such test kits containing these and other controlled chemicals, see Note 2 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.)

texts.en: ECCN 1C607.a. does not control the following: formulations containing 1% or less of CN or CS; individually packaged tear gases or riot control agents for personal self-defense purposes that are controlled by ECCN 1A984; or active constituent chemicals, and combinations thereof, identified and packaged for food production or medical purposes.

texts.zh: b. 不受USML第XIV(g)类管制、为检测或识别USML第XIV(a)类所列化学战剂而“专门设计”或加工的“生物聚合物”，以及用于生产此类聚合物的特定细胞培养物。
texts.en: b. “Biopolymers,” not controlled by USML Category XIV(g) “specially designed” or processed for the detection or identification of chemical warfare agents specified by USML Category XIV(a), and the cultures of specific cells used to produce them.

texts.zh: c. 不受USML第XIV(g)类管制、为消除或降解USML第XIV(a)类管制的化学战剂而“专门设计”的下列“生物催化剂”及其生物系统：
texts.en: c. “Biocatalysts,” and biological systems therefor, not controlled by USML Category XIV(g) “specially designed” for the decontamination or degradation of chemical warfare agents controlled in USML Category XIV (a), as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 通过对生物系统进行实验室定向筛选或遗传操纵而获得、为消除或降解USML第XIV(a)类管制的化学战剂而“专门设计”的“生物催化剂”；
texts.en: c.1. “Biocatalysts” “specially designed” for the decontamination or degradation of chemical warfare agents controlled in USML Category XIV(a) resulting from directed laboratory selection or genetic manipulation of biological systems;

texts.zh: c.2. 含有专用于生产1C607.c.1所列“生物催化剂”的遗传信息的下列生物系统：
texts.en: c.2. Biological systems containing the genetic information specific to the production of “biocatalysts” specified by 1C607.c.1, as follows:

texts.zh: c.2.a. “表达载体”；
texts.en: c.2.a. “Expression vectors;”

texts.zh: c.2.b. 病毒；或
texts.en: c.2.b. Viruses; or

texts.zh: c.2.c. 细胞培养物。
texts.en: c.2.c. Cultures of cells.

texts.en: Note to 1C607.b and .c:

texts.zh: 此处的细胞培养物和生物系统具有专用性；这些子项不适用于农业、制药、医疗、兽医、环境保护、废物管理或食品工业等民用用途的细胞或生物系统。
texts.en: The cultures of cells and biological systems are exclusive and these sub-items do not apply to cells or biological systems for civil purposes, such as agricultural, pharmaceutical, medical, veterinary, environmental, waste management, or in the food industry.

texts.zh: d. 不受USML第XIV(f)类管制、为军事用途而“专门设计”，用于对受到USML第XIV(a)或(b)类所列物质污染的物体进行去污的化学混合物。
texts.en: d. Chemical mixtures not controlled by USML Category XIV(f) “specially designed” for military use for the decontamination of objects contaminated with materials specified by USML Category XIV(a) or (b).

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 含有USML第V(c)(6)、V(h)或V(i)子项所管制材料的装置或装药不受EAR管制；含有此类材料的装置由USML管制。(2) 本条目中的装置和装药，如含有USML第V类管制的材料（浆状物除外），且能够在不破坏装置或装药的情况下轻易提取这些材料，则由USML第III、IV或V类管制。(3) 另见ECCN 1A006、1A007、1A008、1C011、1C111、1C239和1C992列举的炸药及其他物项。(4) 外国制造的“军用商品”如含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受控成分，见ECCN 0A919。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) The EAR does not control devices or charges containing materials controlled by USML subparagraphs V(c)(6), V(h), or V(i). The USML controls devices containing such materials. (2) The USML in Categories III, IV, or V controls devices and charges in this entry if they contain materials controlled by Category V (other than slurries) and such materials can be easily extracted without destroying the device or charge. (3) See also explosives and other items enumerated in ECCNs 1A006, 1A007, 1A008, 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, and 1C992. (4) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content.

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) 就本条目而言，“受控材料”指ECCN 1C011、1C111、1C239、1C608或USML第V类列举的受控含能材料。(2) 就本条目而言，“推进剂”指通过化学反应以受控速率产生大量热气体、从而做机械功的物质或混合物。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) For purposes of this entry, the term 'controlled materials' means controlled energetic materials enumerated in ECCNs 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, 1C608, or USML Category V. (2) For the purposes of this entry, the term 'propellants' means substances or mixtures that react chemically to produce large volumes of hot gases at controlled rates to perform mechanical work.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 含有氮含量大于12.6%的硝化纤维素，且呈下列任一形态的“单基”“双基”和“三基”“推进剂”：
texts.en: Items: a. 'Single base', 'double base', and 'triple base' 'propellants' having nitrocellulose with nitrogen content greater than 12.6% in the form of either:

texts.zh: a.1. “片材”或“卷材”；或
texts.en: a.1. 'Sheetstock' or 'carpet rolls'; or

texts.zh: a.2. 直径大于0.10英寸的药粒。
texts.en: a.2. Grains with diameter greater than 0.10 inches.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 本条目不管制用于霰弹枪弹、小型武器枪弹或步枪弹的“推进剂”药粒。
texts.en: This entry does not control 'propellant' grains used in shotgun shells, small arms cartridges, or rifle cartridges.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. “片材”指制造成适于进一步加工的片状“推进剂”。
texts.en: 1. 'Sheetstock' is 'propellant' that has been manufactured in the form of a sheet suitable for further processing.

texts.zh: 2. “卷材”指先制成片状、通常切割成所需宽度，再像地毯一样卷起的“推进剂”。
texts.en: 2. A 'carpet roll' is 'propellant' that has been manufactured as a sheet, often cut to a desired width, and subsequently rolled up (like a carpet).

texts.zh: 3. “单基”指主要由硝化纤维素组成的“推进剂”。
texts.en: 3. 'Single base' is 'propellant' which consists mostly of nitrocellulose.

texts.zh: 4. “双基”“推进剂”主要由硝化纤维素和硝化甘油组成。
texts.en: 4. 'Double base' 'propellant' consist mostly of nitrocellulose and nitroglycerine.

texts.zh: 5. “三基”主要由硝化纤维素、硝化甘油和硝基胍组成。这类“推进剂”还含有树脂或稳定剂等其他材料，可包括碳、盐类、燃速调节剂、硝基二苯胺、蜡、聚乙二醇（PEG）和聚乙二醇己二酸酯（PGA）。
texts.en: 5. 'Triple base' consists mostly of nitrocellulose, nitroglycerine, and nitroguanidine. Such 'propellants' contain other materials, such as resins or stabilizers, that could include carbon, salts, burn rate modifiers, nitrodiphenylamine, wax, polyethylene glycol (PEG), polyglycol adipate (PGA).

texts.zh: b. 每米含有大于0.064 kg（每英尺300格令）但不超过0.1 kg（每英尺470格令）“受控材料”的导爆管。
texts.en: b. Shock tubes containing greater than 0.064 kg per meter (300 grains per foot), but not more than 0.1 kg per meter (470 grains per foot) of 'controlled materials.'

texts.zh: c. 含有大于0.70 kg但不超过1.0 kg“受控材料”的药筒动力装置。
texts.en: c. Cartridge power devices containing greater than 0.70 kg, but not more than 1.0 kg of 'controlled materials.'

texts.zh: d. 含有大于0.01 kg但不超过0.1 kg“受控材料”的雷管（电雷管或非电雷管）及为其“专门设计”的组件。
texts.en: d. Detonators (electric or nonelectric) and “specially designed” assemblies therefor containing greater than 0.01 kg, but not more than 0.1 kg of 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: e. 不受USML第III或IV类管制，且含有大于0.01 kg但不超过0.1 kg“受控材料”的点火器。
texts.en: e. Igniters not controlled by USML Categories III or IV that contain greater than 0.01 kg, but not more than 0.1 kg of 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: f. 含有大于0.015 kg但不超过0.1 kg“受控材料”的油井药筒。
texts.en: f. Oil well cartridges containing greater than 0.015 kg, but not more than 0.1 kg of 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: g. 含有大于1.0 kg但不超过5.0 kg“受控材料”的商用浇铸或压制传爆药柱。
texts.en: g. Commercial cast or pressed boosters containing greater than 1.0 kg, but not more than 5.0 kg of 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: h. 含有大于10 kg且按重量计不超过35%的USML“受控材料”的商用预制浆状和乳化混合物。
texts.en: h. Commercial prefabricated slurries and emulsions containing greater than 10 kg and less than or equal to thirty-five percent by weight of USML 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: i. [保留]
texts.en: i. [Reserved]

texts.zh: j. 为商业用途（例如剧院舞台、电影特效和烟花表演）而“专门设计”，且含有大于3.0 kg但不超过5.0 kg“受控材料”的“烟火”装置。
texts.en: j. “Pyrotechnic” devices “specially designed” for commercial purposes (e.g., theatrical stages, motion picture special effects, and fireworks displays), and containing greater than 3.0 kg, but not more than 5.0 kg of 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: k. 为商业应用而“专门设计”、不受上述1C608.c至.g管制，且含有大于1.0 kg但不超过5.0 kg“受控材料”的其他商用爆炸装置或装药。
texts.en: k. Other commercial explosive devices or charges “specially designed” for commercial applications, not controlled by 1C608.c through .g above, containing greater than 1.0 kg, but not more than 5.0 kg of 'controlled materials'.

texts.zh: l. 丙烯亚胺（2-甲基氮丙啶）（C.A.S. #75-55-8）。
texts.en: l. Propyleneimine (2 methylaziridine) (C.A.S. #75-55-8).

texts.zh: m. 由氟与下列任一种元素组成的化合物氧化剂或其“混合物”：其他卤素、氧或氮。
texts.en: m. Any oxidizer or 'mixture' thereof that is a compound composed of fluorine and any of the following: other halogens, oxygen, or nitrogen.
Note 1 to 1C608.m:

texts.zh: 气态三氟化氮（NF3）（CAS 7783-54-2）由ECCN 1C992管制，不由ECCN 1C608.m管制。
texts.en: Nitrogen trifluoride (NF3) (CAS 7783-54-2) in a gaseous state is controlled under ECCN 1C992 and not under ECCN 1C608.m.
Note 2 to 1C608.m:

texts.zh: 三氟化氯（ClF3）（CAS 7790-91-2）由ECCN 1C111.a.3.f管制，不由ECCN 1C608.m管制。
texts.en: Chlorine trifluoride (ClF3) (CAS 7790-91-2) is controlled under ECCN 1C111.a.3.f and not under ECCN 1C608.m.
Note 3 to 1C608.m:

texts.zh: 二氟化氧（OF2）由USML第V.d.10类（见22 CFR 121.1）管制，不由ECCN 1C608.m管制。
texts.en: Oxygen difluoride (OF2) is controlled under USML Category V.d.10 (see 22 CFR 121.1) and not under ECCN 1C608.m.

texts.zh: 1C608.l和m注释：
texts.en: Note to 1C608.l and m:

texts.zh: 如果ECCN 1C608.l或.m中的化学品被加入ECCN 1C608.c至.k或ECCN 1C992所述商用装药或装置中，该物项适用该商用装药或装置的分类。
texts.en: If a chemical in ECCN 1C608.l or .m is incorporated into a commercial charge or device described in ECCN 1C608.c through .k or in ECCN 1C992, the classification of the commercial charge or device applies to the item.

texts.zh: 1C608.m技术说明：
texts.en: Technical Note to 1C608.m:

texts.zh: “混合物”指由两种或两种以上物质组成，且至少一种物质列于1C011、1C111、1C239、1C608、USML第V类或USML其他部分的组合物。
texts.en: 'Mixture' refers to a composition of two or more substances with at least one substance being enumerated in 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, 1C608, USML Category V, or elsewhere on the USML.

texts.zh: n. 为军事用途而“专门设计”，且未在USML第V类或USML其他部分列举或另作描述的任何炸药、“推进剂”、氧化剂、“烟火剂”、燃料、黏结剂或添加剂。
texts.en: n. Any explosives, 'propellants', oxidizers, “pyrotechnics”, fuels, binders, or additives that are “specially designed” for military application and not enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category V or elsewhere on the USML.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 1C608.n不适用于以下“航空器”燃料：JP-4、JP-5和JP-8。
texts.en: 1C608.n does not apply to the following “aircraft” fuels: JP-4, JP-5, and JP-8.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 1C608.n注释1所列“航空器”燃料指成品，不包括其组成成分。
texts.en: “Aircraft” fuels specified by 1C608.n, Note 1 are finished products, not their constituents.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 含有以下蓖麻毒素或石房蛤毒素的医疗产品，由ECCN 1C351基于CW原因管制：
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Medical products containing ricin or saxitoxin, as follows, are controlled for CW reasons under ECCN 1C351:

texts.zh: (a) 蓖麻凝集素II（RCA_{II}），又称蓖麻毒素D或蓖麻凝集素III（RCL_{III}）；
texts.en: (a) Ricinus communis AgglutininII (RCA_{II}), also known as ricin D, or Ricinus Communis LectinIII (RCL_{III});

texts.zh: (b) 蓖麻凝集素IV（RCL_{IV}），又称蓖麻毒素E；或
texts.en: (b) Ricinus communis LectinIV (RCL_{IV}), also known as ricin E; or

texts.zh: (c) C.A.S. #35523-89-8所标识的石房蛤毒素。
texts.en: (c) Saxitoxin identified by C.A.S. #35523-89-8.

texts.zh: (2) 属于21 CFR 312.3所定义“研究性新药”（IND）的“医疗产品”，其出口须遵守美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的某些要求；这些要求独立于本ECCN或EAR其他部分规定的出口要求。FDA的这些要求载于21 CFR 312.110，除满足EAR规定的要求外，也必须满足这些要求。
texts.en: (2) The export of a “medical product” that is an “Investigational New Drug” (IND), as defined in 21 CFR 312.3, is subject to certain U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) requirements that are independent of the export requirements specified in this ECCN or elsewhere in the EAR. These FDA requirements are described in 21 CFR 312.110 and must be satisfied in addition to any requirements specified in the EAR.

texts.zh: (3) 关于新药和新原料药出口的FDA要求，另见21 CFR 314.410。
texts.en: (3) Also see 21 CFR 314.410 for FDA requirements concerning exports of new drugs and new drug substances.

texts.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“免疫毒素”指与毒素连接的单克隆抗体，旨在杀灭特定靶细胞，同时保持邻近细胞完整。就本条目而言，“医疗产品”是同时符合下列条件的产品：(1) 采用药物配方，设计用于试验以及对人或动物给药以治疗病症；(2) 已预先包装，供作为临床或医疗产品分销；以及(3) 已获美国食品药品监督管理局批准，作为临床或医疗产品销售，或作为“研究性新药”（IND）使用（见21 CFR第312部分）。就本条目而言，“诊断及食品检测试剂盒”指为诊断或公共卫生用途而专门开发、包装和销售的试剂盒。以其他任何形式提供（包括散装运输）或用于其他任何最终用途的生物毒素，均由ECCN 1C351管制。就本条目而言，“疫苗”定义为采用药物配方的药用或兽用产品，已获美国食品药品监督管理局或美国农业部批准作为医疗或兽用产品销售或用于临床试验，旨在刺激人或动物产生保护性免疫反应，以预防接种对象患病。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, 'immunotoxins' are monoclonal antibodies linked to a toxin with the intention of destroying a specific target cell while leaving adjacent cells intact. For the purpose of this entry, 'medical products' are: (1) Pharmaceutical formulations designed for testing and human (or veterinary) administration in the treatment of medical conditions; (2) prepackaged for distribution as clinical or medical products; and (3) approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration either to be marketed as clinical or medical products or for use as an “Investigational New Drug” (IND) (see 21 CFR part 312). For the purpose of this entry, 'diagnostic and food testing kits' are specifically developed, packaged and marketed for diagnostic or public health purposes. Biological toxins in any other configuration, including bulk shipments, or for any other end-uses are controlled by ECCN 1C351. For the purpose of this entry, 'vaccine' is defined as a medicinal (or veterinary) product in a pharmaceutical formulation, approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or the U.S. Department of Agriculture to be marketed as a medical (or veterinary) product or for use in clinical trials, that is intended to stimulate a protective immunological response in humans or animals in order to prevent disease in those to whom or to which it is administered.

texts.zh: c. 含有下列任一种成分的医疗产品：
texts.en: c. Medical products that contain any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. ECCN 1C351.d管制的毒素，但ECCN 1C351.d.3管制的肉毒神经毒素、ECCN 1C351.d.6管制的芋螺毒素，或ECCN 1C351.d.15或.d.16基于CW原因管制的物项除外；或
texts.en: c.1. Toxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d (except for botulinum neurotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.3, conotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.6, or items controlled for CW reasons under ECCN 1C351.d.15 or .d.16); or

texts.zh: c.2. ECCN 1C353.a.3管制的遗传修饰生物体或遗传元件，但含有或编码ECCN 1C351.d.3管制的肉毒神经毒素或ECCN 1C351.d.6管制的芋螺毒素者除外；
texts.en: c.2. Genetically modified organisms or genetic elements controlled by ECCN 1C353.a.3 (except for those that contain, or code for, botulinum neurotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.3 or conotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.6);

texts.zh: d. 不受1C991.c管制，且含有下列任一种成分的医疗产品：
texts.en: d. Medical products not controlled by 1C991.c that contain any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. ECCN 1C351.d.3管制的肉毒神经毒素；
texts.en: d.1. Botulinum neurotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.3;

texts.zh: d.2. ECCN 1C351.d.6管制的芋螺毒素；或
texts.en: d.2. Conotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.6; or

texts.zh: d.3. ECCN 1C353.a.3管制、含有或编码ECCN 1C351.d.3管制的肉毒神经毒素或ECCN 1C351.d.6管制的芋螺毒素的遗传修饰生物体或遗传元件；
texts.en: d.3. Genetically modified organisms or genetic elements controlled by ECCN 1C353.a.3 that contain, or code for, botulinum neurotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.3 or conotoxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d.6;

texts.zh: e. 含有ECCN 1C351.d管制毒素的诊断及食品检测试剂盒，但ECCN 1C351.d.15或.d.16基于CW原因管制的物项除外。
texts.en: e. Diagnostic and food testing kits containing toxins controlled by ECCN 1C351.d (except for items controlled for CW reasons under ECCN 1C351.d.15 or .d.16).
