texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Commercial charges and devices “subject to the EAR,” contain energetic materials described on the USML that exceed the quantities noted or that are not covered by this entry are controlled under ECCN 1C608. (2) Nitrogen trifluoride when not in a gaseous state is controlled under ECCN 1C608.

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) 本条目ECCN 1C992管制的物项为不受ECCN 1C608管制且不“受ITAR管辖”的材料。(2) 就本条目而言，“受控材料”指受控含能材料（见ECCN 1C011、1C111、1C239和1C608；另见22 CFR 121.1第V类）。(3) USML所述单种含能材料，即使与其他材料配制在一起，只要未被加入爆炸装置或装药，仍“受ITAR管辖”。(4) 含有超过35%的USML所述含能材料的商用预制浆状和乳化混合物“受ITAR管辖”。(5) 就本条目而言，确定商用爆炸装置和装药中受控材料总质量时，不计入其中铝粉、高氯酸钾及USML注释（见22 CFR 121.12）所列任何物质（例如苦味酸铵、黑火药等）的质量。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) Items controlled by this entry ECCN 1C992 are those materials not controlled by ECCN 1C608 and not “subject to the ITAR.” (2) For purposes of this entry, the term “controlled materials” means controlled energetic materials (see ECCNs 1C011, 1C111, 1C239, and 1C608; see also 22 CFR 121.1, Category V). (3) The individual energetic materials described on the USML, even when compounded with other materials, remain “subject to the ITAR” when not incorporated into explosive devices or charges. (4) Commercial prefabricated slurries and emulsions containing greater than 35% of energetic materials described on the USML are “subject to the ITAR.” (5) For purposes of this entry, the mass of aluminum powder, potassium perchlorate, and any of the substances listed in the note to the USML (see 22 CFR 121.12) (such as ammonium pictrate, black powder, etc.) contained in commercial explosive devices and in the charges are omitted when determining the total mass of controlled material.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为油井作业而“专门设计”、采用沿单一轴线起作用的单个装药、起爆后形成孔洞，且符合下列条件的聚能装药：
texts.en: a. Shaped charges “specially designed” for oil well operations, utilizing one charge functioning along a single axis, that upon detonation produce a hole, and

texts.zh: a.1. 含有任意配方的受控材料；
texts.en: a.1. Contain any formulation of controlled materials;

texts.zh: a.2. 仅具有形状均匀、顶角不超过90度的锥形药型罩；
texts.en: a.2. Have only a uniform shaped conical liner with an included angle of 90 degrees or less;

texts.zh: a.3. 含有大于0.010 kg但小于等于0.090 kg的受控材料；以及
texts.en: a.3. Contain more than 0.010 kg but less than or equal to 0.090 kg of controlled materials; and

texts.zh: a.4. 直径不超过4.5英寸；
texts.en: a.4. Have a diameter not exceeding 4.5 inches;

texts.zh: b. 为油井作业而“专门设计”，且含有小于等于0.010 kg受控材料的聚能装药；
texts.en: b. Shaped charges “specially designed” for oil well operations containing less than or equal to 0.010 kg of controlled materials;

texts.zh: c. 每米含有小于等于0.064 kg（每英尺300格令）受控材料的导爆索或导爆管；
texts.en: c. Detonation cord or shock tubes containing less than or equal to 0.064 kg per meter (300 grains per foot) of controlled materials;

texts.zh: d. 爆燃材料中含有小于等于0.70 kg受控材料的药筒动力装置；
texts.en: d. Cartridge power devices, that contain less than or equal to 0.70 kg of controlled materials in the deflagration material;

texts.zh: e. 含有小于等于0.01 kg受控材料的雷管（电雷管或非电雷管）及其组件；
texts.en: e. Detonators (electric or nonelectric) and assemblies thereof, that contain less than or equal to 0.01 kg of controlled materials;

texts.zh: f. 含有小于等于0.01 kg受控材料的点火器；
texts.en: f. Igniters, that contain less than or equal to 0.01 kg of controlled materials;

texts.zh: g. 含有小于等于0.015 kg受控含能材料的油井药筒；
texts.en: g. Oil well cartridges, that contain less than or equal to 0.015 kg of controlled energetic materials;

texts.zh: h. 含有小于等于1.0 kg受控材料的商用浇铸或压制传爆药柱；
texts.en: h. Commercial cast or pressed boosters containing less than or equal to 1.0 kg of controlled materials;

texts.zh: i. 含有小于等于10.0 kg且按重量计小于等于35%的USML所述材料的商用预制浆状和乳化混合物；
texts.en: i. Commercial prefabricated slurries and emulsions containing less than or equal to 10.0 kg and less than or equal to thirty-five percent by weight of materials described on the USML;

texts.zh: j. 含有小于等于3.5 kg受控材料的切割器和切断工具；
texts.en: j. Cutters and severing tools containing less than or equal to 3.5 kg of controlled materials;

texts.zh: k. 专为商业用途（例如剧院舞台、电影特效和烟花表演）设计，且含有小于等于3.0 kg受控材料的烟火装置；或
texts.en: k. Pyrotechnic devices when designed exclusively for commercial purposes (e.g., theatrical stages, motion picture special effects, and fireworks displays) and containing less than or equal to 3.0 kg of controlled materials; or

texts.zh: l. 不受1C992.a至.k管制，且含有小于等于1.0 kg受控材料的其他商用爆炸装置和装药。
texts.en: l. Other commercial explosive devices and charges not controlled by 1C992.a through .k containing less than or equal to 1.0 kg of controlled materials.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1C992.l包括汽车安全装置；灭火系统；铆钉枪药筒；用于农业、油气作业、体育用品、商业采矿或公共工程的爆炸装药；以及用于组装商用爆炸装置的延期管。
texts.en: 1C992.l includes automotive safety devices; extinguishing systems; cartridges for riveting guns; explosive charges for agricultural, oil and gas operations, sporting goods, commercial mining, or public works purposes; and delay tubes used in the assembly of commercial explosive devices.

texts.zh: m. 气态三氟化氮（NF_{3}）。
texts.en: m. Nitrogen trifluoride (NF_{3}) in a gaseous state.

texts.zh: 许可证要求注释：
texts.en: License Requirement Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 本ECCN不管制因不可避免的副产品或杂质而含有任何一种ECCN 1C350.b、.c或.d或ECCN 1C355管制的有毒化学品或前体化学品、且其含量低于0.5%的混合物。此类混合物归类为EAR99。
texts.en: 1. This ECCN does not control mixtures containing less than 0.5% of any single toxic or precursor chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.b, .c, or .d or ECCN 1C355 as unavoidable by-products or impurities. Such mixtures are classified as EAR99.

texts.zh: 2. 1C995.c不管制含有1C350.d列明的前体化学品、且浓度低于1C350.d规定的混合物浓度水平的混合物。此类混合物由1C995.a.2.b管制，但本ECCN许可证要求注释3所述的消费品除外。
texts.en: 2. 1C995.c does not control mixtures that contain precursor chemicals identified in 1C350.d in concentrations below the levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.d. 1C995.a.2.b controls such mixtures, unless they are consumer goods as described in License Requirements Note 3 of this ECCN.

texts.zh: 3. 当受控化学品为供个人使用、以零售形式包装的消费品中的正常成分时，本ECCN不管制此类混合物。此类消费品归类为EAR99。
texts.en: 3. This ECCN does not control mixtures when the controlled chemicals are normal ingredients in consumer goods packaged for retail sale for personal use. Such consumer goods are classified as EAR99.

texts.zh: 相关管制：1. ECCN 1C350管制含有任何一种ECCN 1C350.b列明的《化学武器公约》（CWC）附表2化学品、且其浓度大于等于30%的混合物。ECCN 1C395管制含有任何一种ECCN 1C350.b列明的CWC附表2化学品、且其浓度大于10%但小于30%的混合物。2. ECCN 1C350管制含有ECCN 1C350.c或.d列明的化学品、且浓度超过1C995.a.2规定水平的混合物。3. ECCN 1C355管制含有ECCN 1C355列明的化学品、且浓度超过1C995.b规定水平的混合物。4. ECCN 1C395管制含有1C350.b或.c列明的CWC附表2或附表3化学品的“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”（定义见本ECCN相关管制段落）。ECCN 1C350管制其中任何一种1C350.b、.c或.d列明的化学品重量超过300克的此类检测试剂盒。
texts.en: Related Controls: 1. ECCN 1C350 controls mixtures containing 30 percent or higher concentrations of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b. ECCN 1C395 controls mixtures containing concentrations of more than 10 percent, but less than 30 percent, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical identified in ECCN 1C350.b. 2. ECCN 1C350 controls mixtures containing chemicals identified in ECCN 1C350.c or .d that exceed the concentration levels indicated in 1C995.a.2. 3. ECCN 1C355 controls mixtures containing chemicals identified in ECCN 1C355 that exceed the concentration levels indicated in 1C995.b. 4. ECCN 1C395 controls “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN) that contain CWC Schedule 2 or 3 chemicals listed in 1C350.b or .c. ECCN 1C350 controls any such testing kits in which the amount of any single chemical listed in 1C350.b, .c., or .d exceeds 300 grams by weight.

texts.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”是指为医疗、分析、诊断或公共卫生目的专门开发、包装和销售，且组成确定的预包装材料。1C995.c所述医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒的替换试剂，如果含有ECCN 1C350列明的至少一种前体化学品，且浓度大于等于1C350.d规定的混合物管制水平，则由ECCN 1C350管制。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, “medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” are pre-packaged materials of defined composition that are specifically developed, packaged and marketed for medical, analytical, diagnostic, or public health purposes. Replacement reagents for medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits described in 1C995.c are controlled by ECCN 1C350 if the reagents contain at least one of the precursor chemicals identified in that ECCN in concentrations equal to or greater than the control levels for mixtures indicated in 1C350.d.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 含有以下浓度的ECCN 1C350管制前体化学品的混合物（关于含有这些化学品的其他混合物的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段落注释1和2）：
texts.en: Items: a. Mixtures containing the following concentrations of precursor chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350 (For controls on other mixtures containing these chemicals, see Notes 1 and 2 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.):

texts.zh: a.1. 含有任何一种ECCN 1C350.b管制的CWC附表2化学品、且其重量百分比小于等于10%的混合物；
texts.en: a.1. Mixtures containing 10 percent or less, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.b;

texts.zh: a.2. 含有以下化学品、且其重量百分比小于30%的混合物：
texts.en: a.2. Mixtures containing less than 30 percent, by weight, of:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 任何一种ECCN 1C350.c管制的CWC附表3化学品；或
texts.en: a.2.a. Any single CWC Schedule 3 chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.c; or

texts.zh: a.2.b. 任何一种ECCN 1C350.d管制的前体化学品。
texts.en: a.2.b. Any single precursor chemical controlled by ECCN 1C350.d.

texts.zh: b. 含有以下浓度的ECCN 1C355管制的有毒化学品或前体化学品的混合物（关于含有这些化学品的其他混合物的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段落注释3）：
texts.en: b. Mixtures containing the following concentrations of toxic or precursor chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C355 (For controls on other mixtures containing these chemicals, see Note 3 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.):

texts.zh: b.1. 含有以下浓度的ECCN 1C355.a管制的CWC附表2化学品的混合物：
texts.en: b.1. Mixtures containing the following concentrations of CWC Schedule 2 chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C355.a:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 含有任何一种ECCN 1C355.a.1管制的CWC附表2化学品、且其重量百分比小于等于1%的混合物（即含有全氟异丁烯（PFIB）的混合物）；或
texts.en: b.1.a. Mixtures containing 1 percent or less, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical controlled by ECCN 1C355.a.1 (i.e., mixtures containing PFIB); or

texts.zh: b.1.b. 含有任何一种1C355.a.2管制的CWC附表2化学品、且其重量百分比小于等于10%的混合物；
texts.en: b.1.b. Mixtures containing 10 percent or less, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 2 chemical controlled by 1C355.a.2;

texts.zh: b.2. 含有任何一种ECCN 1C355.b管制的CWC附表3化学品、且其重量百分比小于30%的混合物。
texts.en: b.2. Mixtures containing less than 30 percent, by weight, of any single CWC Schedule 3 chemical controlled by ECCN 1C355.b.

texts.zh: c. 含有ECCN 1C350.d管制的前体化学品、且每种化学品的含量不超过300克的“医疗、分析、诊断及食品检测试剂盒”（定义见本ECCN相关定义）。（关于含有这些及其他受控化学品的其他此类检测试剂盒的管制，见本ECCN相关管制段落注释4。）
texts.en: c. “Medical, analytical, diagnostic, and food testing kits” (as defined in the Related Definitions for this ECCN) that contain precursor chemicals controlled by ECCN 1C350.d in an amount not exceeding 300 grams per chemical. (For controls on other such test kits containing these and other controlled chemicals, see Note 4 in the Related Controls paragraph of this ECCN.)

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) “Software” directly related to articles enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category XIV is subject to the ITAR (see 22 CFR § 121.1, Category XIV(m)). “Software” controlled by USML Category XIV(m) includes “software” directly related to any equipment containing reagents, algorithms, coefficients, software, libraries, spectral databases, or alarm set point levels developed under U.S. Department of Defense contract or funding for the detection, identification, warning or monitoring of items controlled in paragraphs (a) or (b) of USML Category XIV, or for chemical or biological agents specified by U.S. Department of Defense funding or contract. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for “military commodities” located and produced outside the United States that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content.

texts.zh: 相关管制：（1）另见ECCN 1E101、1E201和1E202。（2）对于归类于ECCN 1B608或1C608、且在2014年7月1日之前紧接该日的时点归类于ECCN 1B018.a或1C018.b至.m的物项，其“技术”见ECCN 1E608（注意：ECCN 1E001管制ECCN 1C111.a.3.f所管制三氟化氯的“开发”和“生产”“技术”；三氟化氯的“使用”“技术”管制见ECCN 1E101）。（3）为使设备能够执行ECCN 1A004.c（核、生物和化学（NBC）探测系统）或ECCN 1A004.d（探测或识别爆炸物残留物的设备）管制设备功能而“专门设计”或改装的数据库（参数技术数据库），其管制见ECCN 1E002.g。（4）锂同位素分离的“技术”（见相关ECCN 1B233）以及ECCN 1C012所述物项的“技术”受能源部出口许可权限管辖（见10 CFR第810部分）。（5）ECCN 1A102所述物项的“技术”“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR第120至130部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls (1) Also see ECCNs 1E101, 1E201, and 1E202. (2) See ECCN 1E608 for “technology” for items classified under ECCN 1B608 or 1C608 that, immediately prior to July 1, 2014, were classified under ECCN 1B018.a or 1C018.b through .m (note that ECCN 1E001 controls “development” and “production” “technology” for chlorine trifluoride controlled by ECCN 1C111.a.3.f—see ECCN 1E101 for controls on “use” “technology” for chlorine trifluoride). (3) See ECCN 1E002.g for control libraries (parametric technical databases) “specially designed” or modified to enable equipment to perform the functions of equipment controlled under ECCN 1A004.c (Nuclear, biological and chemical (NBC) detection systems) or ECCN 1A004.d (Equipment for detecting or identifying explosives residues). texts.zh: c. 下列陶瓷粉末或非“复合”陶瓷材料的设计或“生产”“技术”：
texts.en: c. “Technology” for the design or “production” of the following ceramic powders or non-“composite” ceramic materials:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性的陶瓷粉末：
texts.en: c.1. Ceramic powders having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 具有下列任一组成：
texts.en: c.1.a. Any of the following compositions:

texts.zh: c.1.a.1. 锆的单一或复合氧化物，以及硅或铝的复合氧化物；
texts.en: c.1.a.1. Single or complex oxides of zirconium and complex oxides of silicon or aluminum;

texts.zh: c.1.a.2. 硼的单一氮化物（立方晶型）；
texts.en: c.1.a.2. Single nitrides of boron (cubic crystalline forms);

texts.zh: c.1.a.3. 硅或硼的单一或复合碳化物；或
texts.en: c.1.a.3. Single or complex carbides of silicon or boron; or

texts.zh: c.1.a.4. 硅的单一或复合氮化物；
texts.en: c.1.a.4. Single or complex nitrides of silicon;

texts.zh: c.1.b. 金属杂质总量（不包括有意添加物）符合下列任一条件：
texts.en: c.1.b. Any of the following total metallic impurities (excluding intentional additions):

texts.zh: c.1.b.1. 单一氧化物或碳化物的金属杂质总量低于1,000 ppm；或
texts.en: c.1.b.1. Less than 1,000 ppm for single oxides or carbides; or

texts.zh: c.1.b.2. 复合化合物或单一氮化物的金属杂质总量低于5,000 ppm；以及
texts.en: c.1.b.2. Less than 5,000 ppm for complex compounds or single nitrides; and

texts.zh: c.1.c. 属于下列任一种：
texts.en: c.1.c. Being any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.c.1. 平均粒径小于等于1 µm，且粒径大于5 µm的颗粒占比不超过10%的氧化锆（CAS 1314-23-4）；或
texts.en: c.1.c.1. Zirconia (CAS 1314-23-4) with an average particle size equal to or less than 1 µm and no more than 10% of the particles larger than 5 µm; or

texts.zh: c.1.c.2. 平均粒径小于等于5 µm，且粒径大于10 µm的颗粒占比不超过10%的其他陶瓷粉末；
texts.en: c.1.c.2. Other ceramic powders with an average particle size equal to or less than 5 µm and no more than 10% of the particles larger than 10 µm;

texts.zh: c.2. 由1E002.c.1所述材料组成的非“复合”陶瓷材料；
texts.en: c.2. Non-“composite” ceramic materials composed of the materials described in 1E002.c.1;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 1E002.c.2不管制磨料的“技术”。
texts.en: 1E002.c.2 does not control “technology” for abrasives.

texts.en: Related Controls: Technical data directly related to defense articles enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category XIV are subject to the ITAR (see 22 CFR § 121.1, Category XIV(m)). texts.zh: 2A001.a包括为其中所列物项“专门设计”的滚珠和滚子元件。
texts.en: 2A001.a includes ball bearing and roller elements “specially designed” for the items specified therein.

texts.zh: a. 制造商规定的所有公差均符合ISO 492第2或第4公差等级（或国家同等标准）或更优，且“套圈”和“滚动体”均由蒙乃尔合金或铍制成的球轴承和实心滚子轴承；

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2A001.a不管制圆锥滚子轴承。
texts.en: 2A001.a does not control tapered roller bearings.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就2A001.a而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 2A001.a:

texts.zh: 1. “套圈”——向心滚动轴承中具有一个或多个滚道的环形零件（ISO 5593:1997）。
texts.en: 1. 'Ring'—is an annular part of a radial rolling bearing incorporating one or more raceways (ISO 5593:1997).

texts.zh: 2. “滚动体”——在滚道之间滚动的球或滚子（ISO 5593:1997）。
texts.en: 2. 'Rolling element'—is a ball or roller which rolls between raceways (ISO 5593:1997).

texts.zh: c.1. 磁通密度为2.0 T或以上且屈服强度大于414 MPa的材料；
texts.en: c.1. Materials with flux densities of 2.0 T or greater and yield strengths greater than 414 MPa;

texts.zh: c.2. 用于执行器的全电磁三维同极偏置设计；或
texts.en: c.2. All-electromagnetic 3D homopolar bias designs for actuators; or

texts.zh: c.3. 高温（450 K（177 °C）及以上）位置传感器。
texts.en: c.3. High temperature (450 K (177 °C) and above) position sensors.

texts.en: c. Casks that are “specially designed” for transportation of high-level radioactive material and that weigh more than 1,000 kg.

texts.zh: d. 为核设施“专门设计”或制备的商品、“零件”、“部件”和“附件”（例如缓冲器、气锁、泵、反应堆燃料装卸设备、氢复合器和贯穿件密封等安全壳设备，以及包括超声或涡流检测设备在内的反应堆和燃料检查设备）。
texts.en: d. Commodities, “parts,” “components” and “accessories” “specially designed” or prepared for use with nuclear plants (e.g., snubbers, airlocks, pumps, reactor fuel charging and discharging equipment, containment equipment such as hydrogen recombiner and penetration seals, and reactor and fuel inspection equipment, including ultrasonic or eddy current test equipment).

texts.zh: e. 为探测或测量“特殊核材料”（定义见10 CFR Part 110）或为核反应堆“专门设计”的辐射探测器和监测器。
texts.en: e. Radiation detectors and monitors “specially designed” for detecting or measuring “special nuclear material” (as defined in 10 CFR part 110) or for nuclear reactors.

texts.zh: 相关定义：（1）就本条目而言，自动判定是指设备能够以设计或操作人员选择的灵敏度探测炸药或雷管，并在探测到达到或超过该灵敏度水平的炸药或雷管时自动报警。本条目不管制依赖操作人员解释指示结果的设备，例如对被扫描物项进行无机物/有机物颜色映射的设备。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) For the purpose of this entry, automated decision making is the ability of the equipment to detect explosives or detonators at the design or operator-selected level of sensitivity and provide an automated alarm when explosives or detonators at or above the sensitivity level are detected. This entry does not control equipment that depends on operator interpretation of indicators such as inorganic/organic color mapping of the items(s) being scanned.

texts.zh: （2）炸药和雷管包括1C018和1C992管制的商用装药和装置，以及ECCN 1C011、1C111、1C239和22 CFR 121.1第V类管制的含能材料。
texts.en: (2) Explosives and detonators include commercial charges and devices controlled by 1C018 and 1C992 and energetic materials controlled by ECCNs 1C011, 1C111, 1C239 and 22 CFR 121.1 Category V.

texts.en: Explosives or detonation detection equipment in 2A983 includes equipment for screening people, documents, baggage, other personal effects, cargo and/or mail.

Explosives detection equipment for automated decision making to detect and identify bulk explosives utilizing, but not limited to, x-ray (e.g., computed tomography, dual energy, or coherent scattering), nuclear (e.g., thermal neutron analysis, pulse fast neutron analysis, pulse fast neutron transmission spectroscopy, and gamma resonance absorption), or electromagnetic techniques (e.g., quadropole resonance and dielectrometry).

texts.en: c. Detonator detection equipment for automated decision making to detect and identify initiation devices (e.g. detonators, blasting caps) utilizing, but not limited to, x-ray (e.g. dual energy or computed tomography) or electromagnetic techniques.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.1 milliradian (a lower milliradian number means a more accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is “subject to the ITAR” under USML Category XII(c). (2) Concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is designated as EAR99. (3) See ECCNs 2D984 and 2E984 for related software and technology controls.

texts.zh: 相关管制：（1）本条目不管制制造商规定的公差符合ISO 3290第5级或更低等级的滚珠。（2）低噪声运转轴承“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR Parts 120至130）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) This entry does not control balls with tolerance specified by the manufacturer in accordance with ISO 3290 as grade 5 or worse. (2) Quiet running bearings are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 相关定义：（1）（a）DN为轴承内孔直径（mm）与轴承转速（rpm）的乘积。（b）工作温度包括燃气涡轮发动机运行后停机时达到的温度。（2）环形轴承工程师委员会（ABEC）；美国国家标准学会（ANSI）；滚动轴承制造商协会（AFBMA）。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) (a) DN is the product of the bearing bore diameter in mm and the bearing rotational velocity in rpm. (b) Operating temperatures include those temperatures obtained when a gas turbine engine has stopped after operation. (2) Annular Bearing Engineers Committee (ABEC); American National Standards Institute (ANSI); Anti-Friction Bearing Manufacturers Association (AFBMA)

texts.zh: 物项：a. 制造商规定的公差符合ABEC 7、ABEC 7P或ABEC 7T，或ISO标准第4级或更优等级（或同等标准），且具有以下任一特性的球轴承或实心球轴承。
texts.en: Items: a. Ball bearings or Solid ball bearings, having tolerances specified by the manufacturer in accordance with ABEC 7, ABEC 7P, or ABEC 7T or ISO Standard Class 4 or better (or equivalents) and having any of the following characteristics.

texts.zh: a.1. 通过使用特殊材料或特殊热处理，制造用于高于573 K（300 °C）的工作温度；或
texts.en: a.1. Manufactured for use at operating temperatures above 573 K (300 °C) either by using special materials or by special heat treatment; or

texts.zh: a.2. 具有润滑元件或“零件”或“部件”改动，按制造商规格，该改动是为使轴承能够以超过230万DN的速度运行而“专门设计”的。
texts.en: a.2. With lubricating elements or “part” or “component” modifications that, according to the manufacturer's specifications, are “specially designed” to enable the bearings to operate at speeds exceeding 2.3 million DN.

texts.zh: b. 制造商规定的公差符合ANSI/AFBMA 00级（英制）或A级（公制）或更优等级（或同等标准），且具有以下任一特性的实心圆锥滚子轴承。
texts.en: b. Solid tapered roller bearings, having tolerances specified by the manufacturer in accordance with ANSI/AFBMA Class 00 (inch) or Class A (metric) or better (or equivalents) and having either of the following characteristics.

texts.zh: b.1. 具有润滑元件或“零件”或“部件”改动，按制造商规格，该改动是为使轴承能够以超过230万DN的速度运行而“专门设计”的；或
texts.en: b.1. With lubricating elements or “part” or “component” modifications that, according to the manufacturer's specifications, are “specially designed” to enable the bearings to operate at speeds exceeding 2.3 million DN; or

texts.zh: b.2. 制造用于低于219 K（−54 °C）或高于423 K（150 °C）的工作温度。
texts.en: b.2. Manufactured for use at operating temperatures below 219 K (−54 °C) or above 423 K (150 °C).

texts.zh: c. 制造用于561 K（288 °C）或更高工作温度，且单位载荷能力超过1 MPa的气体润滑箔片轴承。
texts.en: c. Gas-lubricated foil bearing manufactured for use at operating temperatures of 561 K (288 °C) or higher and a unit load capacity exceeding 1 MPa.

texts.zh: d. 主动磁轴承系统。
texts.en: d. Active magnetic bearing systems.

texts.zh: e. 制造用于低于219 K（−54 °C）或高于423 K（150 °C）工作温度的织物衬里调心轴承或织物衬里轴颈滑动轴承。
texts.en: e. Fabric-lined self-aligning or fabric-lined journal sliding bearings manufactured for use at operating temperatures below 219 K (−54 °C) or above 423 K (150 °C).

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:
Note 1:

texts.zh: 2B001不管制仅用于制造齿轮的专用机床。此类机床见2B003。
texts.en: 2B001 does not control special purpose machine tools limited to the manufacture of gears. For such machines, see 2B003.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 2B001不管制仅用于制造以下任一物项的专用机床：
texts.en: 2B001 does not control special purpose machine tools limited to the manufacture of any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 曲轴或凸轮轴；
texts.en: a. Crank shafts or cam shafts;

texts.zh: b. 工具或刀具；
texts.en: b. Tools or cutters;

texts.zh: c. 挤出机螺杆；
texts.en: c. Extruder worms;

texts.zh: d. 雕刻或切面珠宝零件；或
texts.en: d. Engraved or faceted jewelry parts; or

texts.zh: e. 牙科修复体。
texts.en: e. Dental prostheses.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 具有车削、铣削或磨削三种能力中至少两种的机床（例如具备铣削能力的车床），必须针对2B001.a、.b或.c中每个适用条目进行评估。
texts.en: A machine tool having at least two of the three turning, milling or grinding capabilities (e.g., a turning machine with milling capability), must be evaluated against each applicable entry 2B001.a, .b or .c.
Note 4:

texts.zh: 除具有车削、铣削或磨削能力外，还具有增材制造能力的机床，必须针对2B001.a、.b或.c中每个适用条目进行评估。
texts.en: A machine tool having an additive manufacturing capability in addition to a turning, milling or grinding capability must be evaluated against each applicable entry 2B001.a, .b or .c.

texts.zh: a. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性的车削机床：
texts.en: a. Machine tools for turning having two or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm；或
texts.en: a.1. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length less than 1.0 m; or

texts.zh: a.2. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；
texts.en: a.2. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1.0 m;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 2B001.a不管制为生产隐形眼镜“专门设计”且具有以下全部特性的车床：
texts.en: 2B001.a does not control turning machines “specially designed” for producing contact lenses, having all of the following:

texts.zh: a. 机床控制器仅限于使用眼科“软件”输入零件编程数据；且
texts.en: a. Machine controller limited to using ophthalmic based “software” for part programming data input; and

texts.zh: b. 无真空夹持功能。
texts.en: b. No vacuum chucking.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 2B001.a不适用于仅限加工穿过式送料棒材的棒料机床（瑞士型车床），条件是最大棒材直径等于或小于42 mm，且不能安装卡盘。此类机床可具有对直径小于42 mm的零件进行钻削或铣削的能力。
texts.en: 2B001.a does not apply to bar machines (Swissturn), limited to machining only bar feed thru, if maximum bar diameter is equal to or less than 42 mm and there is no capability of mounting chucks. Machines may have drilling or milling capabilities for machining parts with diameters less than 42 mm.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下任一特性的铣削机床：
texts.en: b. Machine tools for milling having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 具有三个直线轴加一个旋转轴，可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: b.1. Three linear axes plus one rotary axis which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm；或
texts.en: b.1.a. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length less than 1.0 m; or

texts.zh: b.1.b. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；
texts.en: b.1.b. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1.0 m;

texts.zh: b.2. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: b.2. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm；
texts.en: b.2.a. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length less than 1.0 m;

texts.zh: b.2.b. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于1 m且小于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.4 µm；或
texts.en: b.2.b. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.4 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1 m and less than 4 m; or

texts.zh: b.2.c. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）6.0 µm；
texts.en: b.2.c. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 6.0 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 4 m;

texts.zh: b.3. 坐标镗床沿一根或多根直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；或
texts.en: b.3. A “unidirectional positioning repeatability” for jig boring machines, equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis; or

texts.zh: b.4. 具有以下全部特性的飞刀切削机床：
texts.en: b.4. Fly cutting machines having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.4.a. 主轴的径向“跳动”和轴向“窜动”小于（优于）0.0004 mm总指示读数（TIR）；且
texts.en: b.4.a. Spindle “run-out” and “camming” less (better) than 0.0004 mm TIR; and

texts.zh: b.4.b. 在300 mm行程内，滑座运动的角偏差（偏航、俯仰及滚转）小于（优于）2角秒（TIR）；
texts.en: b.4.b. Angular deviation of slide movement (yaw, pitch and roll) less (better) than 2 seconds of arc, TIR, over 300 mm of travel;

texts.zh: c. 具有以下任一特性的磨削机床：
texts.en: c. Machine tools for grinding having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: c.1. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 沿一根或多根直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；且
texts.en: c.1.a. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis; and

texts.zh: c.1.b. 具有三个或四个可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴；或
texts.en: c.1.b. Three or four axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”; or

texts.zh: c.2. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: c.2. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.2.a. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；
texts.en: c.2.a. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length less than 1m;

texts.zh: c.2.b. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于1 m且小于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.4 µm；或
texts.en: c.2.b. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.4 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1 m and less than 4 m; or

texts.zh: c.2.c. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）6.0 µm。
texts.en: c.2.c. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 6.0 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 4 m.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Notes:

texts.zh: 2B001.c不管制以下磨床：
texts.en: 2B001.c does not control grinding machines as follows:

texts.zh: a. 具有以下全部特性的外圆、内圆及内外圆磨床：
texts.en: a. Cylindrical external, internal, and external-internal grinding machines, having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 仅限于圆柱面磨削；且
texts.en: a.1. Limited to cylindrical grinding; and

texts.zh: a.2. 最大工件加工能力仅限于外径或长度150 mm。
texts.en: a.2. Limited to a maximum workpiece capacity of 150 mm outside diameter or length.

texts.zh: b. 专门设计为坐标磨床、不具有z轴或w轴，且“单向定位重复性”小于（优于）1.1 µm的机床。
texts.en: b. Machines designed specifically as jig grinders that do not have a z-axis or a w-axis, with a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” less (better) than 1.1 µm.

texts.zh: c. 平面磨床。
texts.en: c. Surface grinders.

texts.zh: d. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的旋转轴的非线切割型电火花加工机床（EDM）；
texts.en: d. Electrical discharge machines (EDM) of the non-wire type which have two or more rotary axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”;

texts.zh: e. 用于去除金属、陶瓷或“复合材料”且具有以下全部特性的机床：
texts.en: e. Machine tools for removing metals, ceramics or “composites”, having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 通过以下任一方式去除材料：
texts.en: e.1. Removing material by means of any of the following:

texts.zh: e.1.a. 水射流或其他液体射流，包括采用磨料添加剂的射流；
texts.en: e.1.a. Water or other liquid jets, including those employing abrasive additives;

texts.zh: e.1.b. 电子束；或
texts.en: e.1.b. Electron beam; or

texts.zh: e.1.c. “激光”束；且
texts.en: e.1.c. “Laser” beam; and

texts.zh: e.2. 至少具有两个同时满足以下全部条件的旋转轴：
texts.en: e.2. At least two rotary axes having all of the following:

texts.zh: 相关定义：就2B002而言，“MRF”是采用含磨料磁流体去除材料的工艺，其黏度由磁场控制。“ERF”是采用含磨料流体去除材料的工艺，其黏度由电场控制。“高能粒子束精加工”采用反应原子等离子体（RAP）或离子束选择性去除材料。“充气薄膜工具精加工”是采用受压薄膜发生变形并以小面积接触工件的工艺。“流体射流精加工”利用流体流束去除材料。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purposes of 2B002, ‘MRF’ is a material removal process using an abrasive magnetic fluid whose viscosity is controlled by a magnetic field. ‘ERF’ is a removal process using an abrasive fluid whose viscosity is controlled by an electric field. ‘Energetic particle beam finishing’ uses Reactive Atom Plasmas (RAP) or ion-beams to selectively remove material. ‘Inflatable membrane tool finishing’ is a process that uses a pressurized membrane that deforms to contact the workpiece over a small area.'Fluid jet finishing’ makes use of a fluid stream for material removal.

texts.en: a. Computer controlled or “numerically controlled” Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM), having a three dimensional length (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement (E_{0,MPE}) at any point within the operating range of the machine (i.e., within the length of axes) equal to or less (better) than (1.7 + L/1,000) µm (L is the measured length in mm) according to ISO 10360-2 (2009);

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就2B006.a而言，应将制造商规定的CMM最精确配置（例如以下因素的最佳组合：测头、测针长度、运动参数、环境）并启用“所有可用补偿”时的E_{0,MPE}，与1.7 + L/1,000 µm阈值进行比较。
texts.en: For the purposes of 2B006.a, E_{0,MPE} of the most accurate configuration of the CMM specified by the manufacturer (e.g.,best of the following: Probe, stylus length, motion parameters, environment) and with “all compensations available” shall be compared to the 1.7 + L/1,000 µm threshold.

texts.zh: b. 如下直线位移测量仪器或系统、直线位置反馈单元及“电子组件”：
texts.en: b. Linear displacement measuring instruments or systems, linear position feedback units, and “electronic assemblies”, as follows:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 含“激光”的干涉仪和光学编码器测量系统仅由2B006.b.3列明。
texts.en: Interferometer and optical-encoder measuring systems containing a “laser” are only specified by 2B006.b.3.

texts.zh: b.1. 在“测量范围”的0至0.2 mm范围内，“分辨率”等于或小于（优于）0.2 µm的“非接触式测量系统”；
texts.en: b.1. 'Non-contact type measuring systems' with a 'resolution' equal to or less (better) than 0.2 µm within 0 to 0.2 mm of the 'measuring range';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 2B006.b.1:

texts.zh: 1. “非接触式测量系统”设计用于在测头或被测物体运动时，沿单一矢量测量测头与被测物体之间的距离。
texts.en: 1. 'Non-contact type measuring systems' are designed to measure the distance between the probe and measured object along a single vector, where the probe or measured object is in motion.

texts.zh: 2. “测量范围”指最小与最大工作距离之差。
texts.en: 2. 'Measuring range' means the distance between the minimum and maximum working distance.

texts.zh: b.2. 为机床“专门设计”，且总“精度”小于（优于）（800 +（600 × L/1,000））nm的直线位置反馈单元（L为以mm计的有效长度）；
texts.en: b.2. Linear position feedback units “specially designed” for machine tools and having an overall “accuracy” less (better) than (800 + (600 × L/1,000)) nm (L equals effective length in mm);

texts.zh: b.3. 具有以下全部特性的测量系统：
texts.en: b.3. Measuring systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.3.a. 含有“激光”；
texts.en: b.3.a. Containing a “laser”;

texts.zh: b.3.b. 全量程“分辨率”为0.200 nm或以下（更优）；且
texts.en: b.3.b. A 'resolution' over their full scale of 0.200 nm or less (better); and

texts.zh: b.3.c. 在对空气折射率进行补偿，并在20±0.01 °C温度下测量30秒时，能够在测量范围内任一点达到等于或小于（优于）（1.6 + L/2,000）nm的“测量不确定度”（L为以mm计的测量长度）；
texts.en: b.3.c. Capable of achieving a “measurement uncertainty” equal to or less (better) than (1.6 + L/2,000) nm (L is the measured length in mm) at any point within a measuring range, when compensated for the refractive index of air and measured over a period of 30 seconds at a temperature of 20±0.01 °C;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就2B006.b而言，“分辨率”指测量装置的最小增量；对于数字仪器，指最低有效位。
texts.en: For the purposes of 2B006.b, 'resolution' is the least increment of a measuring device; on digital instruments, the least significant bit.

texts.zh: b.4. 为在2B006.b.3管制系统中提供反馈功能而“专门设计”的“电子组件”；
texts.en: b.4. “Electronic assemblies” “specially designed” to provide feedback capability in systems controlled by 2B006.b.3;

texts.zh: c. 为机床“专门设计”的旋转位置反馈单元或角位移测量仪器，其角位置“精度”等于或小于（优于）0.9角秒；
texts.en: c. Rotary position feedback units “specially designed” for machine tools or angular displacement measuring instruments, having an angular position “accuracy” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 second of arc;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2B006.c不管制采用准直光（例如“激光”）探测反射镜角位移的光学仪器，例如自准直仪。
texts.en: 2B006.c does not control optical instruments, such as autocollimators, using collimated light (e.g., “laser” light) to detect angular displacement of a mirror.

texts.zh: d. 通过测量光散射来测量表面粗糙度（包括表面缺陷），灵敏度为0.5 nm或以下（更优）的设备。
texts.en: d. Equipment for measuring surface roughness (including surface defects), by measuring optical scatter with a sensitivity of 0.5 nm or less (better).

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2B006包括2B001所列以外、可用作测量机且达到或超过所规定测量功能标准的机床。
texts.en: 2B006 includes machine tools, other than those specified by 2B001, that can be used as measuring machines, if they meet or exceed the criteria specified for the measuring machine function.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCN 2D101 for “software” for items controlled under this entry. (2) See ECCNs 2E001 (“development”), 2E002 (“production”), and 2E101 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (3) Also see ECCNs 9B106 and 9B990.

texts.zh: 相关定义：配备数字控制器的振动试验系统，是指其功能全部或部分由存储的数字编码电信号自动控制的系统。
texts.en: Related Definitions: Vibration test systems incorporating a digital controller are those systems, the functions of which are, partly or entirely, automatically controlled by stored and digitally coded electrical signals.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 采用反馈或闭环技术并配备数字控制器的振动试验系统，能够在20 Hz至2,000 Hz之间，使系统以等于或大于10 g rms的加速度振动，同时施加以“空台”测量等于或大于50 kN（11,250磅）的力；
texts.en: Items: a. Vibration test systems employing feedback or closed loop techniques and incorporating a digital controller, capable of vibrating a system at an acceleration equal to or greater than 10 g rms between 20 Hz to 2,000 Hz while imparting forces equal to or greater than 50 kN (11,250 lbs.), measured ‘bare table’;

texts.zh: b. 与“专门设计”的振动试验“软件”配合使用、“实时控制带宽”大于5 kHz，且设计用于2B116.a所述振动试验系统的数字控制器；
texts.en: b. Digital controllers, combined with “specially designed” vibration test “software”, with a ‘real-time control bandwidth’ greater than 5 kHz and designed for use with vibration test systems described in 2B116.a;

texts.zh: c. 无论是否配有相关放大器，以“空台”测量能够施加等于或大于50 kN（11,250磅）的力，且可用于2B116.a所述振动试验系统的振动推力装置（振动器单元）；
texts.en: c. Vibration thrusters (shaker units), with or without associated amplifiers, capable of imparting a force equal to or greater than 50 kN (11,250 lbs.), measured ‘bare table’, and usable in vibration test systems described in 2B116.a;

texts.zh: d. 设计用于将多个振动器单元组合成完整振动系统的试件支撑结构和电子单元，该系统以“空台”测量能够提供等于或大于50 kN的有效合力，且可用于2B116.a所述振动试验系统。
texts.en: d. Test piece support structures and electronic units designed to combine multiple shaker units into a complete shaker system capable of providing an effective combined force equal to or greater than 50 kN, measured ‘bare table’, and usable in vibration test systems described in 2B116.a.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: （1）“空台”指没有任何夹具或配件的平坦台面或表面。
texts.en: (1) ‘Bare table’ means a flat table, or surface, with no fixture or fitting.

texts.zh: （2）“实时控制带宽”定义为控制器能够执行采样、处理数据和传输控制信号完整循环的最大速率。
texts.en: (2) ‘Real-time control bandwidth’ is defined as the maximum rate at which a controller can execute complete cycles of sampling, processing data and transmitting control signals.

texts.zh: 2B117 不受2B004、2B005.a、2B104或2B105管制，为结构复合材料火箭喷管和再入飞行器鼻锥的致密化及热解而设计或改装的设备和过程控制装置。
texts.en: 2B117 Equipment and process controls, other than those controlled by 2B004, 2B005.a, 2B104 or 2B105, designed or modified for the densification and pyrolysis of structural composite rocket nozzles and reentry vehicle nose tips.

texts.zh: a. 具有以下全部特性的平衡机：
texts.en: a. Balancing machines having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 不能对质量大于3 kg的转子/组件进行平衡；
texts.en: a.1. Not capable of balancing rotors/assemblies having a mass greater than 3 kg;

texts.zh: a.2. 能在超过12,500 rpm的速度下对转子/组件进行平衡；
texts.en: a.2. Capable of balancing rotors/assemblies at speeds greater than 12,500 rpm;

texts.zh: a.3. 能在两个或以上平面上校正不平衡量；且
texts.en: a.3. Capable of correcting unbalance in two planes or more; and

texts.zh: a.4. 能平衡至每千克转子质量的剩余比不平衡量为0.2 g mm。
texts.en: a.4. Capable of balancing to a residual specific unbalance of 0.2 g mm per kg of rotor mass.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2B119.a不管制为牙科或其他医疗设备设计或改装的平衡机。
texts.en: 2B119.a. does not control balancing machines designed or modified for dental or other medical equipment.

texts.zh: b. 为2B119.a所列机床设计或改装的指示头。
texts.en: b. Indicator heads designed or modified for use with machines specified in 2B119.a.

texts.zh: 注：

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2B201不管制仅限制造以下任一零件的专用机床：
texts.en: 2B201 does not control special purpose machine tools limited to the manufacture of any of the following parts:

texts.zh: a. 齿轮；
texts.en: a. Gears;

texts.zh: b. 曲轴或凸轮轴；
texts.en: b. Crank shafts or cam shafts;

texts.zh: c. 工具或刀具；
texts.en: c. Tools or cutters;

texts.zh: d. 挤出机螺杆；
texts.en: d. Extruder worms;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 本条目所列定位精度值基于ISO 230/2（2006），等同于核供应国集团（NSG）所采用的基于ISO 230/2（1988）的数值。在2B201.a和.b.1中，由此产生的变化是从6 µm改为4.5 µm；在2B201.b注释的.b项中，从30 µm改为22.5 µm；在2B201.c中，从4 µm改为3 µm。
texts.en: The identified positioning accuracy values in this entry are based on ISO 230/2 (2006), which equates to the values based on ISO 230/2 (1988) that are used by the Nuclear Supplier's Group (NSG). In 2B201.a and .b.1, this results in a change from 6 µm to 4.5 µm. In paragraph .b of the Note to 2B201.b, the resulting change is from 30 µm to 22.5 µm, In 2B201.c, the resulting change is from 4 µm to 3 µm.

texts.zh: a. 能加工直径大于35 mm的工件，且根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用所有可用补偿时，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于（小于）4.5 µm的车削机床；
texts.en: a. Machine tools for turning, that have positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006) with all compensations available better (less) than 4.5 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for machines capable of machining diameters greater than 35 mm;
Note to 2B201.a:

texts.zh: 2B201.a不管制仅限加工穿过式送料棒材的棒料机床（瑞士型车床），条件是最大棒材直径等于或小于42 mm，且不能安装卡盘。此类机床可具有对直径小于42 mm的零件进行钻削和/或铣削的能力。
texts.en: 2B201.a does not control bar machines (Swissturn), limited to machining only bar feed thru, if maximum bar diameter is equal to or less than 42 mm and there is no capability of mounting chucks. Machines may have drilling and/or milling capabilities for machining parts with diameters less than 42 mm.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下任一特性的铣削机床：
texts.en: b. Machine tools for milling, having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用“所有可用补偿”时，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）等于或小于（优于）4.5 µm；
texts.en: b.1. Positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006) with “all compensations available” equal to or less (better) than 4.5 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning);

texts.zh: b.2. 具有两个或以上轮廓控制旋转轴；或
texts.en: b.2. Two or more contouring rotary axes; or

texts.zh: b.3. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴。
texts.en: b.3. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.”
Note to 2B201.b:

texts.zh: 2B201.b不管制具有以下特性的铣床：
texts.en: 2B201.b does not control milling machines having the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a. X轴行程大于2 m；且
texts.en: a. X-axis travel greater than 2 m; and

texts.zh: b. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），x轴的总定位精度大于（差于）22.5 µm。
texts.en: b. Overall positioning accuracy according to ISO 230/2 (2006) on the x-axis more (worse) than 22.5 µm.

texts.zh: c. 具有以下任一特性的磨削机床：
texts.en: c. Machine tools for grinding, having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: c.1. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用“所有可用补偿”时，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）等于或小于（优于）3 µm；
texts.en: c.1. Positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006) with “all compensations available” equal to or less (better) than 3 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning);

texts.zh: c.2. 具有两个或以上轮廓控制旋转轴；或
texts.en: c.2. Two or more contouring rotary axes; or

texts.zh: c.3. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴。
texts.en: c.3. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.”
Note to 2B201.c:

texts.zh: 2B201.c不管制以下磨床：
texts.en: 2B201.c does not control the following grinding machines:

texts.zh: a. 具有以下全部特性的外圆、内圆及内外圆磨床：
texts.en: a. Cylindrical external, internal, and external-internal grinding machines having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: 1. 最大工件加工能力仅限于外径或长度150 mm；且
texts.en: 1. Limited to a maximum workpiece capacity of 150 mm outside diameter or length; and

texts.zh: 2. 轴仅限于x、z和c。
texts.en: 2. Axes limited to x, z and c.

texts.zh: b. 不具有z轴或w轴，且总定位精度小于（优于）3微米的坐标磨床。定位精度按ISO 230/2（2006）确定。
texts.en: b. Jig grinders that do not have a z-axis or a w-axis with an overall positioning accuracy less (better) than 3 microns. Positioning accuracy is according to ISO 230/2 (2006).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 2B201.b.3和c.3包括基于并联直线运动学设计（例如六足平台）、具有5个或以上轴且所有轴均非旋转轴的机床。
texts.en: 2B201.b.3 and c.3 include machines based on a parallel linear kinematic design (e.g. hexapods) that have 5 or more axes none of which are rotary axes.

texts.zh: ECCN 2B206管制注释：
texts.en: Control Notes to ECCN 2B206:

texts.zh: （1）可用作测量机的机床，如达到或超过本条目针对测量机功能规定的管制参数，则由ECCN 2B206管制。（2）ECCN 2B206所述机器，如在其工作范围内任何位置超过规定的管制阈值，即由本条目管制。
texts.en: (1) Machine tools that can be used as measuring machines are controlled by ECCN 2B206 if they meet or exceed the control parameters specified in this entry for the measuring machine function. (2) The machines described in ECCN 2B206 are controlled by this entry if they exceed the specified control threshold anywhere in their operating range.

texts.zh: ECCN 2B206技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to ECCN 2B206:

texts.zh: 本条目中的所有测量值参数均表示正/负值，而非总范围。
texts.en: All parameters of measurement values in this entry represent plus/minus, i.e., not total band.

texts.zh: a. 具有以下任一特性的计算机控制或数控坐标测量机（CMM）：
texts.en: a. Computer controlled or numerically controlled coordinate measuring machines (CMM) with either of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 仅有两个轴，根据ISO 10360-2（2009），在机器工作范围内任一点（即轴长范围内），沿任一轴（一维）的长度测量最大允许误差（以E_{0x MPE}、E_{0y MPE}或E_{0z MPE}的任意组合表示）等于或小于（优于）（1.25 + L/1,000）µm（L为以mm计的测量长度）；或
texts.en: a.1. Having only two axes with a maximum permissible error of length measurement along any axis (one dimension), identified as any combination of E_{0x MPE}, E_{0y MPE} or E_{0z MPE}, equal to or less (better) than (1.25 + L/1,000) µm (where L is the measured length in mm) at any point within the operating range of the machine (i.e., within the length of the axis), according to ISO 10360-2 (2009); or

texts.zh: a.2. 具有三个或以上轴，根据ISO 10360-2（2009），在机器工作范围内任一点（即轴长范围内），三维（空间）长度测量最大允许误差（表示为E_{0},_{MPE}）等于或小于（优于）（1.7 + L/800）µm（L为以mm计的测量长度）。
texts.en: a.2. Having three or more axes with a three dimensional (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement, identified as E_{0},_{MPE}, equal to or less (better) than (1.7 + L/800) µm (where L is the measured length in mm) at any point within the operating range of the machine (i.e., within the length of the axis), according to ISO 10360-2 (2009).

texts.zh: 2B206.a.2技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B206.a.2:

texts.zh: 应将制造商依ISO 10360-2（2009）规定的CMM最精确配置（例如以下因素的最佳组合：测头、测针长度、运动参数、环境）并启用所有可用补偿时的E_{0},_{MPE}，与1.7 + L/800 µm阈值进行比较。
texts.en: The E_{0},_{MPE} of the most accurate configuration of the CMM specified according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) by the manufacturer (e.g., best of the following: Probe, stylus length, motion parameters, environment) and with all compensations available shall be compared to the 1.7 + L/800 µm threshold.

texts.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特性的半球壳直线-角度同步检验系统：
texts.en: b. Systems for simultaneous linear-angular inspection of hemishells, having both of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 沿任一直线轴的“测量不确定度”等于或小于（优于）每5 mm为3.5 µm；且
texts.en: b.1. “Measurement uncertainty” along any linear axis equal to or less (better) than 3.5 µm per 5 mm; and

texts.zh: b.2. “角位置偏差”等于或小于0.02°。
texts.en: b.2. “Angular position deviation” equal to or less than 0.02°.

texts.zh: c. 同时具有以下两项特性的直线位移测量系统：
texts.en: c. Linear displacement measuring systems having both of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: c.1. 含有“激光”；且
texts.en: c.1. Containing a “laser;” and

texts.zh: c.2. 能够在标准压力及标准温度上下±1 K的温度范围内，至少连续12小时同时保持以下两项性能：
texts.en: c.2. Capable of maintaining, for at least 12 hours over a temperature range of ± 1 K around a standard temperature and a standard pressure, both:

texts.zh: c.2.a. 全量程“分辨率”为0.1 µm或更优；且
texts.en: c.2.a. A “resolution” over their full scale of 0.1 µm or better; and

texts.zh: c.2.b. “测量不确定度”等于或优于（小于）（0.2 + L/2,000）µm（L为以毫米计的测量长度）。
texts.en: c.2.b. A “measurement uncertainty” equal to or better (less) than (0.2 + L/2,000) µm (L is the measured length in millimeters).

texts.zh: 2B206.c管制注释：
texts.en: Control Note to 2B206.c:

texts.zh: 2B206.c不管制不具有闭环或开环反馈、含“激光”以测量机床、尺寸检验机或类似设备滑座运动误差的测量干涉仪系统。
texts.en: 2B206.c does not control measuring interferometer systems, without closed or open loop feedback, containing a “laser” to measure slide movement errors of machine tools, dimensional inspection machines, or similar equipment.

texts.zh: 2B206.c技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B206.c:

texts.zh: 在2B206.c中，“直线位移”指测量探头与被测物体之间距离的变化。
texts.en: In 2B206.c, “linear displacement” means the change of distance between the measuring probe and the measured object.

texts.zh: d. 具有以下全部特性的线性可变差动变压器（LVDT）系统：
texts.en: d. Linear Variable Differential Transformer (LVDT) systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: d.1. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1.a. 对于全工作范围不超过±5 mm（包括±5 mm）的LVDT，从0至全工作范围测得的“线性度”等于或小于（优于）0.1%；或
texts.en: d.1.a. “Linearity” equal to or less (better) than 0.1% measured from 0 to the full operating range, for LVDTs with a full operating range up to and including ±5 mm; or

texts.zh: d.1.b. 对于“全工作范围”大于±5 mm的LVDT，从0至5 mm测得的“线性度”等于或小于（优于）0.1%；且
texts.en: d.1.b. “Linearity” equal to or less (better) than 0.1% measured from 0 to 5 mm for LVDTs with a 'full operating range' greater than ±5 mm; and

texts.zh: 物项：a. 设计用于平衡长度为600 mm或以上的挠性转子，且具有以下全部特性的离心平衡机：
texts.en: Items: a. Centrifugal balancing machines designed for balancing flexible rotors having a length of 600 mm or more and having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 回转直径或轴颈直径大于75 mm；
texts.en: a.1. Swing or journal diameter greater than 75 mm;

texts.zh: a.2. 质量能力为0.9至23 kg；且
texts.en: a.2. Mass capability of from 0.9 to 23 kg; and

texts.zh: a.3. 能在大于5,000 r.p.m.的转速下进行平衡；
texts.en: a.3. Capable of balancing speed of revolution greater than 5,000 r.p.m.;

texts.zh: b. 设计用于平衡空心圆柱形转子“零件”或“部件”，且具有以下全部特性的离心平衡机：
texts.en: b. Centrifugal balancing machines designed for balancing hollow cylindrical rotor “parts” or “components” and having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 轴颈直径大于75 mm；
texts.en: b.1. Journal diameter greater than 75 mm;

texts.zh: b.2. 质量能力为0.9至23 kg；
texts.en: b.2. Mass capability of from 0.9 to 23 kg;

texts.zh: b.3. 每个平面可达到的最小剩余比不平衡量等于或小于10 g-mm/kg；且
texts.en: b.3. A minimum achievable residual specific unbalance equal to or less than 10 g-mm/kg per plane; and

texts.zh: b.4. 为皮带驱动型。
texts.en: b.4. Belt drive type.

texts.zh: 相关定义：（1）就本条目而言，“压力传感器”指将压力测量值转换为信号的装置。（2）就本条目而言，“精度”包括环境温度下的非线性、迟滞和重复性。

texts.zh: 物项：a. 压力敏感元件由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（氧化铝陶瓷或蓝宝石）、镍、按重量计镍含量超过60%的镍合金或全氟烃聚合物制成或防护；
texts.en: Items: a. Pressure sensing elements made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloy, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloy with more than 60% nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers;

texts.zh: b. 如有对压力敏感元件密封至关重要且与工艺介质直接接触的密封件，该密封件由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（氧化铝陶瓷或蓝宝石）、镍、按重量计镍含量超过60%的镍合金或全氟烃聚合物制成或防护；且
texts.en: b. Seals, if any, essential for sealing the pressure sensing element, and in direct contact with the process medium, made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloy, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloy with more than 60% nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; and

texts.zh: c. 具有以下任一特征：
texts.en: c. Either of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: c.1. 全量程小于13 kPa，且“精度”优于全量程的±1%；或
texts.en: c.1. A full scale of less 13 kPa and an “accuracy” of better than ±1% of full scale; or

texts.zh: c.2. 全量程为13 kPa或以上，且在13 kPa下测量时“精度”优于±130 Pa。
texts.en: c.2. A full scale of 13 kPa or greater and an “accuracy” of better than ±130 Pa when measuring at 13 kPa.

texts.en: Items: a. Capable of an inlet volume flow rate of 50 m^{3}/h or greater;

texts.zh: b. 压比能够达到2:1或以上；且
texts.en: b. Capable of a pressure ratio of 2:1 or greater; and

texts.zh: c. 与工艺气体接触的所有表面均由以下任一材料制成：
texts.en: c. Having all surfaces that come in contact with the process gas made from any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 铝或铝合金；
texts.en: c.1. Aluminum or aluminum alloy;

texts.zh: c.2. 氧化铝；
texts.en: c.2. Aluminum oxide;

texts.zh: c.3. 不锈钢；
texts.en: c.3. Stainless steel;

texts.zh: c.4. 镍或镍合金；
texts.en: c.4. Nickel or nickel alloy;

texts.zh: c.5. 磷青铜；或
texts.en: c.5. Phosphor bronze; or

texts.zh: c.6. 含氟聚合物。
texts.en: c.6. Fluoropolymers.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 在涡旋式压缩机或真空泵中，月牙形气腔形成于一对或多对相互啮合的螺旋叶片（涡旋盘）之间，其中一个运动，另一个保持静止。动涡旋盘绕静涡旋盘公转而不自转。随着动涡旋盘绕静涡旋盘公转，气腔向机器出口移动，其体积逐渐减小（即被压缩）。
texts.en: 1. In a scroll compressor or vacuum pump, crescent-shaped pockets of gas are trapped between one or more pairs of intermeshed spiral vanes, or scrolls, one of which moves while the other remains stationary. The moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll; it does not rotate. As the moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll, the gas pockets diminish in size (i.e., they are compressed) as they move toward the outlet port of the machine.

texts.zh: 2. 在波纹管密封涡旋式压缩机或真空泵中，工艺气体通过金属波纹管与泵的润滑部件及外部大气完全隔离。波纹管一端连接动涡旋盘，另一端连接泵的固定壳体。
texts.en: 2. In a bellows-sealed scroll compressor or vacuum pump, the process gas is totally isolated from the lubricated parts of the pump and from the external atmosphere by a metal bellows. One end of the bellows is attached to the moving scroll and the other end is attached to the stationary housing of the pump.

texts.zh: 3. 含氟聚合物包括但不限于以下材料：
texts.en: 3. Fluoropolymers include, but are not limited to, the following materials:

texts.zh: a. 聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）；
texts.en: a. Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE);

texts.zh: b. 氟化乙烯丙烯共聚物（FEP）；
texts.en: b. Fluorinated Ethylene Propylene (FEP);

texts.zh: c. 全氟烷氧基聚合物（PFA）；
texts.en: c. Perfluoroalkoxy (PFA);

texts.zh: d. 聚三氟氯乙烯（PCTFE）；且
texts.en: d. Polychlorotrifluoroethylene (PCTFE); and

texts.zh: e. 偏氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚物。
texts.en: e. Vinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene copolymer.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 如下反应容器、反应器及其预制维修组件：
texts.en: Items: a. Reaction vessels, reactors and prefabricated repair assemblies therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 带或不带搅拌器、内部总（几何）容积大于0.1 m^{3}（100升）且小于20 m^{3}（20,000升）的反应容器或反应器，其与所加工或盛装化学品直接接触的所有表面均由以下任一材料制成：
texts.en: a.1. Reaction vessels or reactors, with or without agitators, with total internal (geometric) volume greater than 0.1 m^{3} (100 liters) and less than 20 m^{3} (20,000 liters), where all surfaces that come in direct contact with the chemical(s) being processed or contained are made from any of the following materials:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 按重量计镍含量超过25%且铬含量超过20%的合金；
texts.en: a.1.a Alloys with more than 25% nickel and 20% chromium by weight;

texts.zh: a.1.b. 镍或按重量计镍含量超过40%的合金；
texts.en: a.1.b. Nickel or alloys with more than 40% nickel by weight;

texts.zh: a.1.c. 含氟聚合物（按重量计氟含量超过35%的聚合物或弹性体材料）；
texts.en: a.1.c. Fluoropolymers (polymeric or elastomeric materials with more than 35% fluorine by weight);

texts.zh: a.1.d. 玻璃（包括玻璃化或搪瓷涂层或玻璃衬里）；
texts.en: a.1.d. Glass (including vitrified or enameled coating or glass lining);

texts.zh: a.1.e. 钽或钽合金；
texts.en: a.1.e. Tantalum or tantalum alloys;

texts.zh: a.1.f. 钛或钛合金；
texts.en: a.1.f. Titanium or titanium alloys;

texts.zh: a.1.g. 锆或锆合金；或
texts.en: a.1.g. Zirconium or zirconium alloys; or

texts.zh: a.1.h. 铌或铌合金；
texts.en: a.1.h. Niobium (columbium) or niobium alloys;

texts.zh: a.2. 满足以下条件的预制维修组件及为其专门设计的部件：
texts.en: a.2. Prefabricated repair assemblies, and their specially designed components, that:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 设计用于机械连接至2B350.a.1所述玻璃衬里反应容器或反应器；且
texts.en: a.2.a. Are designed for mechanical attachment to glass-lined reaction vessels or reactors described in 2B350.a.1; and

texts.zh: a.2.b. 具有由钽或钽合金制成、并与所加工化学品直接接触的金属表面。
texts.en: a.2.b. Have metallic surfaces that are made from tantalum or tantalum alloys and come in direct contact with the chemical(s) being processed.

texts.zh: b. 设计用于2B350.a.1所述反应容器或反应器的搅拌器，以及为此类搅拌器设计的叶轮、叶片或轴，其与所加工或盛装化学品直接接触的所有表面均由以下任一材料制成：

texts.zh: 2B350.i技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B350.i:

texts.zh: 2B350.i所指密封件与所加工化学品直接接触（或设计用于此种接触），并在旋转或往复式驱动轴穿过泵体的位置提供密封功能。
texts.en: The seals referred to in 2B350.i come into direct contact with the chemical(s) being processed (or are designed to do so), and provide a sealing function where a rotary or reciprocating drive shaft passes through a pump body.

texts.zh: j. 设计用于销毁化学战剂、1C350管制的化学武器前体或化学弹药的焚烧炉，具有“专门设计”的废物供给系统、特殊处理设施，且燃烧室平均温度大于1000 °C；其废物供给系统中与废物直接接触的所有表面均由以下任一材料制成或衬里：
texts.en: j. texts.zh: 技术注释1：
texts.en: Technical Note 1:

texts.zh: 碳-石墨是主要由石墨和无定形碳组成的材料，其中石墨占该组合物重量的8%或以上。
texts.en: Carbon-graphite is a composition consisting primarily of graphite and amorphous carbon, in which the graphite is 8 percent or more by weight of the composition.

texts.zh: 技术注释2：
texts.en: Technical Note 2:

texts.zh: 对于2B350所列物项，“合金”一词如未附具体元素浓度，是指所标明金属的重量百分比高于任何其他元素的合金。
texts.en: For the items listed in 2B350, the term 'alloy,' when not accompanied by a specific elemental concentration, is understood as identifying those alloys where the identified metal is present in a higher percentage by weight than any other element.

texts.zh: 技术注释3：
texts.en: Technical Note 3:

texts.zh: 用于垫片、填料、密封件、螺钉或垫圈的材料，或其他发挥密封功能的材料，不决定本ECCN物项的管制状态，但前提是这些部件设计为可互换。
texts.en: The materials used for gaskets, packing, seals, screws or washers, or other materials performing a sealing function, do not determine the control status of the items in this ECCN, provided that such components are designed to be interchangeable.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 所有“受ITAR管辖”的化学品见《美国军品清单》第V和第XIV类（见22 CFR Parts 120至130）。
texts.en: See Categories V and XIV of the United States Munitions List for all chemicals that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 相关管制：本ECCN管制的有毒气体监测器和监测系统及其专用检测“零件”和“部件”的“软件”见ECCN 2D351。另见ECCN 1A004：该条目管制为探测或识别化学战剂“专门设计”或改装、但并非为军事用途“专门设计”的化学检测系统及其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”；以及ECCN 1A995：该条目管制不受ECCN 1A004或本ECCN管制的某些检测设备、“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: Related Controls: See ECCN 2D351 for “software” for toxic gas monitors and monitoring systems, and their dedicated detecting “parts” and “components,” controlled by this ECCN. Also see ECCN 1A004, which controls chemical detection systems and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor that are “specially designed” or modified for detection or identification of chemical warfare agents, but not “specially designed” for military use, and ECCN 1A995, which controls certain detection equipment, “parts” and “components” not controlled by ECCN 1A004 or by this ECCN.

texts.zh: 相关定义：（1）就本条目而言，“专用”指完全专用于单一用途或装置。（2）就本条目而言，“连续运行”描述设备无需人工干预即可在线运行的能力。本条目旨在管制能够在化工厂等环境中采集和检测样品的有毒气体监测器和监测系统，而非实验室中用于分批操作的设备。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) For the purposes of this entry, the term “dedicated” means committed entirely to a single purpose or device. (2) For the purposes of this entry, the term “continuous operation” describes the capability of the equipment to operate on line without human intervention. The intent of this entry is to control toxic gas monitors and monitoring systems capable of collection and detection of samples in environments such as chemical plants, rather than those used for batch-mode operation in laboratories.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 设计用于连续运行，能够探测化学战剂或1C350管制的前体化学品，“最低检出限”为0.3 mg/m^{3}；或
texts.en: a. Designed for continuous operation and usable for the detection of chemical warfare agents or precursor chemicals controlled by 1C350 'minimum detection limit' of 0.3 mg/m^{3}; or

texts.zh: b. 设计用于检测胆碱酯酶抑制活性。
texts.en: b. Designed for the detection of cholinesterase-inhibiting activity.

texts.zh: 技术注释：
texts.en: Technical note:

texts.zh: 有毒气体监测器或监测系统的“最低检出限”，是指产生的信号大于该监测器或系统测量空白样品时信号标准偏差三倍所需的最低可检测分析物浓度。
texts.en: The 'minimum detection limit' of toxic gas monitors or monitoring systems is the lowest detectable concentration of the analyte required to produce a signal greater than three times the standard deviation of the toxic gas monitor's or monitoring system's signal when measuring a blank sample.

texts.zh: 对于具有死区或程序化零点抑制的有毒气体监测器或监测系统，“最低检出限”指产生读数所需的最低可检测浓度。
texts.en: In the case of toxic gas monitors or monitoring systems having a deadband or programmed zero suppression, the 'minimum detection limit' is the lowest detectable concentration required to produce a reading.

texts.zh: 相关管制：本条目未涵盖的防护设备见ECCN 1A004和1A995。另见ECCN 9A120：该条目管制某些设计或改装用于喷散气溶胶，且能够携带体积大于20升、呈颗粒或液体形式的有效载荷组成部分（此类飞行器燃料“零件”或“部件”除外）的“无人航空器”系统。
texts.en: Related Controls: See ECCNs 1A004 and 1A995 for protective equipment that is not covered by this entry. Also see ECCN 9A120 for controls on certain “UAV” systems designed or modified to dispense an aerosol and capable of carrying elements of a payload in the form of a particulate or liquid, other than fuel “parts” or “components” of such vehicles, of a volume greater than 20 liters.

texts.zh: 相关定义：（1）“轻于空气的飞行器”——依靠热空气或氦、氢等轻于空气的气体获得升力的气球和飞艇。（2）“UAVs”——无人航空器。（3）“VMD”——体积中位直径。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Lighter than air vehicles”—balloons and airships that rely on hot air or on lighter-than-air gases, such as helium or hydrogen, for their lift. (2) “UAVs”—Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. (3) “VMD”—Volume Median Diameter.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 如下密闭设施及相关设备：
texts.en: a. Containment facilities and related equipment, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. P3或P4密闭等级的完整密闭设施。
texts.en: a.1. Complete containment facilities at P3 or P4 containment level.

texts.zh: 2B352.a.1技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B352.a.1:

texts.zh: P3或P4（BL3、BL4、L3、L4）密闭等级按世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（第3版，日内瓦，2004年）规定。
texts.en: P3 or P4 (BL3, BL4, L3, L4) containment levels are as specified in the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004).

texts.zh: a.2. 设计用于固定安装在本ECCN a.1项所列密闭设施中的如下设备：
texts.en: a.2. Equipment designed for fixed installation in containment facilities specified in paragraph a.1 of this ECCN, as follows:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 双门贯通式去污高压灭菌器；
texts.en: a.2.a. Double-door pass-through decontamination autoclaves;

texts.zh: a.2.b. 呼吸供气防护服去污淋浴装置；
texts.en: a.2.b. Breathing air suit decontamination showers;

texts.zh: a.2.c. 机械密封或充气密封通行门。
texts.en: a.2.c. Mechanical-seal or inflatable-seal walkthrough doors.

texts.zh: b. 如下发酵罐及部件：
texts.en: b. Fermenters and components as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 能在不扩散气溶胶的情况下培养微生物，或培养活细胞以生产病毒或毒素，且内部总体积为20升或以上的发酵罐。
texts.en: b.1. Fermenters capable of cultivation of micro-organisms or of live cells for the production of viruses or toxins, without the propagation of aerosols, having a total internal volume of 20 liters or greater.

texts.zh: b.2. 为此类发酵罐设计的如下部件：
texts.en: b.2. Components designed for such fermenters, as follows:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 设计可进行原位灭菌或消毒的培养室；
texts.en: b.2.a. Cultivation chambers designed to be sterilized or disinfected in situ;

texts.zh: b.2.b. 培养室支撑装置；或
texts.en: b.2.b. Cultivation chamber holding devices; or

texts.zh: b.2.c. 能同时监测和控制两个或以上发酵系统参数（例如温度、pH、营养物、搅拌、溶解氧、气流、泡沫控制）的过程控制单元。
texts.en: b.2.c. Process control units capable of simultaneously monitoring and controlling two or more fermentation system parameters (e.g., temperature, pH, nutrients, agitation, dissolved oxygen, air flow, foam control).

texts.zh: 2B352.b技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Notes to 2B352.b:

texts.zh: 1. 发酵罐包括生物反应器（包括一次性生物反应器）、恒化器和连续流系统。
texts.en: 1. Fermenters include bioreactors (including single-use (disposable) bioreactors), chemostats and continuous-flow systems.

texts.zh: 2. 2B352.b.2.b管制的培养室支撑装置包括具有刚性壁的一次性培养室。
texts.en: 2. Cultivation chamber holding devices controlled by 2B352.b.2.b include single-use cultivation chambers with rigid walls.

texts.zh: c. 能在不扩散气溶胶的情况下连续分离、流量大于每小时100升的如下离心分离机：
texts.en: c. Centrifugal separators capable of continuous separation, without the propagation of aerosols, having a flow rate greater than 100 liters per hour, as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性的离心分离机：
texts.en: c.1. Centrifugal separators having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 蒸汽密闭区域内具有一个或多个密封接头；
texts.en: c.1.a. One or more sealing joints within the steam containment area;

texts.zh: c.1.b. 部件由抛光不锈钢或钛制成；且
texts.en: c.1.b. Components of polished stainless steel or titanium; and

texts.zh: c.1.c. 能在封闭状态下进行原位蒸汽灭菌。
texts.en: c.1.c. Capable of in-situ steam sterilization in a closed state.

texts.zh: c.2. 一次性离心分离机，其与所加工物质直接接触的所有部件均为用后弃置或单次使用。
texts.en: c.2. Single-use centrifugal separators, in which all components that come in direct contact with the substances being processed are disposable or single-use.

texts.zh: 2B352.c技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B352.c:

texts.zh: 离心分离机和一次性离心分离机包括卧式螺旋沉降离心机。
texts.en: Centrifugal separators and single-use centrifugal separators include decanters.

texts.zh: d. 如下交叉流（切向流）过滤设备及“附件”：
texts.en: d. Cross (tangential) flow filtration equipment and “accessories”, as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 能分离微生物、病毒、毒素或细胞培养物，且具有以下全部特性的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备：
texts.en: d.1. Cross (tangential) flow filtration equipment capable of separation of microorganisms, viruses, toxins or cell cultures having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: d.1.a. 总过滤面积等于或大于1平方米（1 m^{2}）；且
texts.en: d.1.a. A total filtration area equal to or greater than 1 square meter (1 m^{2}); and

texts.zh: d.1.b. 具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: d.1.b. Having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: d.1.b.1. 能进行原位灭菌或消毒；或
texts.en: d.1.b.1. Capable of being sterilized or disinfected in-situ; or

texts.zh: d.1.b.2. 使用用后弃置或单次使用的过滤“零件”或“部件”。
texts.en: d.1.b.2. Using disposable or single-use filtration “parts” or “components”.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 2B352.d.1不管制制造商标明的反渗透及血液透析设备。
texts.en: 2B352.d.1 does not control reverse osmosis and hemodialysis equipment, as specified by the manufacturer.

texts.zh: d.2. 每个“零件”或“部件”的过滤面积等于或大于0.2平方米（0.2 m^{2}），且设计用于2B352.d.1管制交叉流（切向流）过滤设备的交叉流（切向流）过滤“零件”或“部件”（例如模块、元件、膜包、滤芯、单元或板）。
texts.en: d.2. Cross (tangential) flow filtration “parts” or “components” (e.g., modules, elements, cassettes, cartridges, units or plates) with filtration area equal to or greater than 0.2 square meters (0.2 m^{2}) for each “part” or “component” and designed for use in cross (tangential) flow filtration equipment controlled by 2B352.d.1.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 在本ECCN中，“灭菌”指通过物理方式（例如蒸汽）或化学剂消除设备中的所有存活微生物。“消毒”指通过化学剂减少微生物数量（通常不包括细菌芽孢）的过程，不一定杀灭或去除所有生物体。
texts.en: In this ECCN, “sterilized” denotes the elimination of all viable microbes from the equipment through the use of either physical (e.g., steam) or chemical agents. “Disinfected” denotes a process to reduce the number of microorganisms, but not usually of bacterial spores, through the use of chemical agents, without necessarily killing or removing all organisms.

texts.zh: e. 可用蒸汽、气体或蒸气灭菌的冷冻干燥设备，其冷凝器容量为24小时内10 kg冰或以上（24小时内10升水或以上），且小于24小时内1000 kg冰（小于24小时内1,000升水）。
texts.en: e. Steam, gas or vapor sterilizable freeze-drying equipment with a condenser capacity of 10 kg of ice or greater in 24 hours (10 liters of water or greater in 24 hours) and less than 1000 kg of ice in 24 hours (less than 1,000 liters of water in 24 hours).

texts.zh: f. 能干燥毒素或病原微生物，且具有以下全部特性的喷雾干燥设备：
texts.en: f. Spray-drying equipment capable of drying toxins or pathogenic microorganisms having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: f.1. 水蒸发能力≥0.4 kg/h且≤400 kg/h；
texts.en: f.1. A water evaporation capacity of ≥0.4 kg/h and ≤400 kg/h;

texts.zh: f.2. 使用现有配件，或对喷雾干燥机作最低限度改装，配置能够产生所需粒径的雾化喷嘴，即可形成典型平均产品粒径≤10微米的颗粒；且
texts.en: f.2. The ability to generate a typical mean product particle size of ≤10 micrometers with existing fittings or by minimal modification of the spray-dryer with atomization nozzles enabling generation of the required particle size; and

texts.zh: f.3. 能进行原位灭菌或消毒。
texts.en: f.3. Capable of being sterilized or disinfected in situ.

texts.zh: g. 如下防护和密闭设备：
texts.en: g. Protective and containment equipment, as follows:

texts.zh: g.1. 依靠管路连接的外部气源、在正压下工作的全身或半身防护服或头罩。
texts.en: g.1. Protective full or half suits, or hoods dependent upon a tethered external air supply and operating under positive pressure.

texts.zh: 2B352.g.1技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B352.g.1:

texts.zh: 2B352.g.1不管制设计与自给式呼吸器配合穿戴的防护服。
texts.en: 2B352.g.1 does not control suits designed to be worn with self-contained breathing apparatus.

texts.zh: g.2. 正常运行时具有以下全部特性的生物密闭室、隔离器或生物安全柜：
texts.en: g.2. Biocontainment chambers, isolators, or biological safety cabinets having all of the following characteristics, for normal operation:

texts.zh: g.2.a. 工作空间完全封闭，操作人员通过实体屏障与工作区隔离；
texts.en: g.2.a. Fully enclosed workspace where the operator is separated from the work by a physical barrier;

texts.zh: g.2.b. 能在负压下运行；
texts.en: g.2.b. Able to operate at negative pressure;

texts.zh: g.2.c. 具有安全操纵工作空间内物项的装置；且
texts.en: g.2.c. Means to safely manipulate items in the workspace; and

texts.zh: g.2.d. 工作空间的送风和排风均经过高效空气颗粒（HEPA）过滤。
texts.en: g.2.d. Supply and exhaust air to and from the workspace is high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filtered.
Note 1 to 2B352.g.2:

texts.zh: 2B352.g.2管制世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（第3版，日内瓦，2004年）所规定，或依照国家标准、法规或指南建造的III级生物安全柜。
texts.en: 2B352.g.2 controls class III biosafety cabinets, as specified in the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004) or constructed in accordance with national standards, regulations or guidance.
Note 2 to 2B352.g.2:

texts.zh: 2B352.g.2管制具有2B352.g.2.a至g.2.d所述全部特性的任何隔离器，无论其预期用途或名称为何，但为隔离护理或运送感染患者“专门设计”的医疗隔离器除外。
texts.en: 2B352.g.2 controls any isolator having all of the characteristics described in 2B352.g.2.a through g.2.d, regardless of its intended use and its designation, except for medical isolators “specially designed” for barrier nursing or transportation of infected patients.

texts.zh: h. 设计用于以微生物、病毒或毒素进行气溶胶挑战试验的如下气溶胶吸入设备：
texts.en: h. Aerosol inhalation equipment designed for aerosol challenge testing with microorganisms, viruses or toxins, as follows:

texts.zh: h.1. 容量为1立方米或以上的全身暴露室；
texts.en: h.1. Whole-body exposure chambers having a capacity of 1 cubic meter or greater;

texts.zh: h.2. 采用定向气溶胶流、能够使12只或以上啮齿动物或两只或以上非啮齿动物暴露的仅鼻部暴露装置，以及设计与此类装置配合使用的封闭式动物固定管。
texts.en: h.2. Nose-only exposure apparatus utilizing directed aerosol flow and having a capacity for the exposure of 12 or more rodents, or two or more animals other than rodents, and closed animal restraint tubes designed for use with such apparatus.

texts.zh: i. 如下喷洒或雾化系统及其“零件”和“部件”：
texts.en: i. Spraying or fogging systems and “parts” and “components” therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: i.1. 为安装于航空器、“轻于空气的飞行器”或“无人航空器”上“专门设计”或改装的完整喷洒或雾化系统，能够以大于每分钟2升的流量，从液态悬浮液产生初始液滴“VMD”小于50微米的喷雾；
texts.en: i.1. Complete spraying or fogging systems, “specially designed” or modified for fitting to aircraft, “lighter than air vehicles,” or “UAVs,” capable of delivering, from a liquid suspension, an initial droplet “VMD” of less than 50 microns at a flow rate of greater than 2 liters per minute;

texts.zh: i.2. 为安装于航空器、“轻于空气的飞行器”或“无人航空器”上“专门设计”或改装的喷杆或气溶胶发生单元阵列，能够以大于每分钟2升的流量，从液态悬浮液产生初始液滴“VMD”小于50微米的喷雾；
texts.en: i.2. Spray booms or arrays of aerosol generating units, “specially designed” or modified for fitting to aircraft, “lighter than air vehicles,” or “UAVs,” capable of delivering, from a liquid suspension, an initial droplet “VMD” of less than 50 microns at a flow rate of greater than 2 liters per minute;

texts.zh: i.3. 为安装于本ECCN i.1及i.2项所列系统上“专门设计”的气溶胶发生单元。
texts.en: i.3. Aerosol generating units “specially designed” for fitting to the systems as specified in paragraphs i.1 and i.2 of this ECCN.

texts.zh: 2B352.i技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Notes to 2B352.i:

texts.zh: 1. 气溶胶发生单元是为安装于航空器上“专门设计”或改装的装置，包括喷嘴、旋转鼓式雾化器及类似装置。
texts.en: 1. Aerosol generating units are devices “specially designed” or modified for fitting to aircraft and include nozzles, rotary drum atomizers and similar devices.

texts.zh: 2. 本ECCN不管制2B352.i所列、经证明不能以感染性气溶胶形式散播生物战剂的喷洒或雾化系统、“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: 2. This ECCN does not control spraying or fogging systems, “parts” and “components,” as specified in 2B352.i, that are demonstrated not to be capable of delivering biological agents in the form of infectious aerosols.

texts.zh: 3. 为航空器或“无人航空器”“专门设计”的喷洒设备或喷嘴，其液滴粒径应使用以下任一方法测量（在国际公认标准获采用之前）：
texts.en: 3. Droplet size for spray equipment or nozzles “specially designed” for use on aircraft or “UAVs” should be measured using either of the following methods (pending the adoption of internationally accepted standards):

texts.zh: a. 多普勒激光法；
texts.en: a. Doppler laser method,

texts.zh: b. 前向激光衍射法。
texts.en: b. Forward laser diffraction method.

texts.zh: j. 同时符合以下两项条件的核酸组装仪和合成仪：
texts.en: j. Nucleic acid assemblers and synthesizers that are both:

texts.zh: j.1. 部分或全部自动化；且
texts.en: j.1 Partly or entirely automated; and

texts.zh: j.2. 设计能在单次运行中生成长度大于1.5千碱基、错误率小于5%的连续核酸。
texts.en: j.2. Designed to generate continuous nucleic acids greater than 1.5 kilobases in length with error rates less than 5% in a single run.

texts.zh: k. 同时符合以下两项条件的肽合成仪：
texts.en: k. Peptide synthesizers that are both:

texts.zh: k.1. 部分或全部自动化；且
texts.en: k.1 Partly or entirely automated; and

texts.zh: k.2. 能以1 mmol或更大的“系统合成规模”生成肽。
texts.en: k.2 Capable of generating peptides at a 'system synthesis scale' of 1 mmol or greater.

texts.zh: 2B352.k技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to 2B352.k:

texts.zh: “系统合成规模”指仪器使用最大兼容反应容器（L）所能生产的肽的最大量（mmol）。对于并行生产的多种肽，该规模按最大兼容反应容器（L）的总和确定。
texts.en: 'System synthesis scale' denotes the maximum amount of peptide (mmol) that can be produced by the instrument using the largest compatible reaction vessels (L). For multiple peptides produced in parallel, this is the sum of the largest compatible reaction vessels (L).

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 至少具有以下一种固结能量源：
texts.en: a. Having at least one of the following consolidation sources:
a.1. “Laser”;

texts.zh: a.2. 电子束；或
texts.en: a.2. Electron beam; or

texts.zh: a.3. 电弧；
texts.en: a.3. Electric arc;

texts.zh: b. 具有以下任一种受控工艺气氛：
texts.en: b. Having a controlled process atmosphere of any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 惰性气体；或
texts.en: b.1. Inert gas; or

texts.zh: b.2. 真空（等于或小于100 Pa）；
texts.en: b.2. Vacuum (equal to or less than 100 Pa);

texts.zh: c. 具有采用“同轴配置”或“旁轴配置”的以下任一“过程监测”设备：
texts.en: c. Having any of the following 'in-process monitoring' equipment in a 'co-axial configuration' or 'paraxial configuration':

texts.zh: c.1. 峰值响应波长大于380 nm且不超过14,000 nm的成像相机；
texts.en: c.1. Imaging camera with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 380 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm;

texts.zh: c.2. 设计用于测量大于1,273.15K（1,000 °C）温度的高温计；或
texts.en: c.2. Pyrometer designed to measure temperatures greater than 1,273.15K (1,000 °C); or

texts.zh: c.3. 峰值响应波长大于380 nm且不超过3,000 nm的辐射计或光谱仪；且
texts.en: c.3. Radiometer or spectrometer with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 380 nm but not exceeding 3,000 nm; and

texts.zh: d. 具有闭环控制系统，设计用于在成形周期中，根据2B910.c所列“过程监测”设备的反馈，修改固结能量源参数、成形路径或设备设置。
texts.en: d. A closed loop control system designed to modify the consolidation source parameters, build path, or equipment settings during the build cycle in response to feedback from 'in-process monitoring' equipment specified in 2B910.c.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就2B910而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 2B910:

texts.zh: 1. “过程监测”（亦称原位过程监测）指对增材制造过程进行观察和测量，包括熔池发出的电磁或热辐射。
texts.en: 1. 'In-process monitoring', also known as in-situ process monitoring, pertains to the observation and measurement of the additive manufacturing process including electromagnetic, or thermal, emissions from the melt pool.

texts.zh: 2. “同轴配置”（亦称轴上或共线配置）指一个或多个传感器安装在与“激光”固结能量源共用的光路上。
texts.en: 2. 'Co-axial configuration', also known as on-axis or inline configuration, pertains to one or more sensors that are mounted in an optical path shared by the “laser” consolidation source.

texts.zh: 3. “旁轴配置”指一个或多个传感器实体安装于或集成于“激光”、电子束或电弧固结能量源部件。
texts.en: 3. 'Paraxial configuration' pertains to one or more sensors that are physically mounted onto or integrated into the “laser”, electron beam, or electric arc consolidation source component.

texts.zh: 4. 对于“同轴配置”和“旁轴配置”，传感器的视场均固定于固结能量源的移动参照系，并在整个成形过程中沿与固结能量源相同的扫描轨迹移动。
texts.en: 4. For both 'co-axial configuration' and 'paraxial configuration', the field of view of the sensor(s) is fixed to the moving reference frame of the consolidation source and moves in the same scan trajectories of the consolidation source throughout the build process.

texts.zh: 2B991 其他未列明的机床数控单元及“数控”机床（见受控物项清单）。
texts.en: 2B991 Numerical control units for machine tools and “numerically controlled” machine tools, n.e.s. (see List of Items Controlled).
