texts.zh: 物项：a. 机床“数控”单元：
texts.en: Items: a. “Numerical control” units for machine tools:

texts.zh: a.1. 具有四个可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的插补轴；或
texts.en: a.1. Having four interpolating axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control;” or

texts.zh: a.2. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且最小可编程增量优于（小于）0.001 mm；
texts.en: a.2. Having two or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” and a minimum programmable increment better (less) than 0.001 mm;

texts.zh: a.3. 具有两个、三个或四个可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的插补轴，且能直接（在线）接收并处理计算机辅助设计（CAD）数据以在内部编制机床指令的机床“数控”单元；或
texts.en: a.3. “Numerical control” units for machine tools having two, three or four interpolating axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control,” and capable of receiving directly (on-line) and processing computer-aided-design (CAD) data for internal preparation of machine instructions; or

texts.zh: b. 为机床“专门设计”且具有以下任一特性的“运动控制板”：
texts.en: b. “Motion control boards” “specially designed” for machine tools and having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 可进行四个以上轴的插补；
texts.en: b.1. Interpolation in more than four axes;

texts.zh: b.2. 能通过以下任一方式对数据进行“实时处理”，在加工过程中修改刀具路径、进给速率和主轴数据：
texts.en: b.2. Capable of “real-time processing” of data to modify tool path, feed rate and spindle data, during the machining operation, by any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 通过测量循环及访问源数据，自动计算并修改用于两个或以上轴加工的零件程序数据；或
texts.en: b.2.a. Automatic calculation and modification of part program data for machining in two or more axes by means of measuring cycles and access to source data; or

texts.zh: b.2.b. “自适应控制”，测量一个以上物理变量，并通过计算模型（策略）处理，以更改一条或多条加工指令来优化过程。
texts.en: b.2.b. “Adaptive control” with more than one physical variable measured and processed by means of a computing model (strategy) to change one or more machining instructions to optimize the process.

texts.zh: b.3. 能接收和处理CAD数据以在内部编制机床指令；或
texts.en: b.3. Capable of receiving and processing CAD data for internal preparation of machine instructions; or

texts.zh: c. 按制造商技术规格，可配备电子装置以在两个或以上轴上同时进行“轮廓控制”，并同时具有以下两项特性的“数控”机床：
texts.en: c. “Numerically controlled” machine tools that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes and that have both of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行轮廓控制的轴；且
texts.en: c.1. Two or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for contouring control; and

texts.zh: c.2. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用所有可用补偿时，定位精度如下：
texts.en: c.2. Positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006), with all compensations available:

texts.zh: c.2.a. 对于磨床，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于15 µm；
texts.en: c.2.a. Better than 15 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for grinding machines;

texts.zh: c.2.b. 对于铣床，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于15 µm；或
texts.en: c.2.b. Better than 15 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for milling machines; or

texts.zh: c.2.c. 对于车床，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于15 µm；或
texts.en: c.2.c. Better than 15 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for turning machines; or

texts.zh: d. 用于去除或切削金属、陶瓷或复合材料，且按制造商技术规格可配备电子装置以在两个或以上轴上同时进行“轮廓控制”的如下机床：
texts.en: d. Machine tools, as follows, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics or composites, that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes:

texts.zh: d.1. 用于车削、磨削、铣削或其任何组合，具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性的机床：
texts.en: d.1. Machine tools for turning, grinding, milling or any combination thereof, having two or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” and having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: d.1.a. 具有一个或多个轮廓控制“倾斜主轴”；
texts.en: d.1.a. One or more contouring “tilting spindles;”

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2B991.d.1.a仅适用于磨削或铣削机床。
texts.en: 2B991.d.1.a. applies to machine tools for grinding or milling only.

texts.zh: d.1.b. 主轴旋转一周的轴向“窜动”（轴向位移）小于（优于）0.0006 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
texts.en: d.1.b. “Camming” (axial displacement) in one revolution of the spindle less (better) than 0.0006 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2B991.d.1.b仅适用于车削机床。
texts.en: 2B991.d.1.b. applies to machine tools for turning only.

texts.zh: d.1.c. 主轴旋转一周的径向“跳动”（旋转偏差）小于（优于）0.0006 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
texts.en: d.1.c. “Run out” (out-of-true running) in one revolution of the spindle less (better) than 0.0006 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

texts.zh: d.1.d. 在启用所有可用补偿时，任一旋转轴的“定位精度”小于（优于）0.001°；
texts.en: d.1.d. The “positioning accuracies”, with all compensations available, are less (better) than: 0.001° on any rotary axis;

texts.zh: d.2. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴的送丝式电火花加工机床（EDM）。
texts.en: d.2. Electrical discharge machines (EDM) of the wire feed type that have five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.”

texts.en: 2B992 Non-“numerically controlled” machine tools for generating optical quality surfaces, (see List of Items Controlled) and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 使用单点切削刀具，且具有以下全部特性的车床：
texts.en: Items: a. Turning machines using a single point cutting tool and having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 每300 mm行程的滑座定位精度小于（优于）0.0005 mm；
texts.en: a.1. Slide positioning accuracy less (better) than 0.0005 mm per 300 mm of travel;

texts.zh: a.2. 每300 mm行程的滑座双向定位重复性小于（优于）0.00025 mm；
texts.en: a.2. Bidirectional slide positioning repeatability less (better) than 0.00025 mm per 300 mm of travel;

texts.zh: a.3. 主轴径向“跳动”和轴向“窜动”小于（优于）0.0004 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
texts.en: a.3. Spindle “run out” and “camming” less (better) than 0.0004 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

texts.zh: a.4. 全行程内滑座运动的角偏差（偏航、俯仰和滚转）小于（优于）2角秒（TIR）；且
texts.en: a.4. Angular deviation of the slide movement (yaw, pitch and roll) less (better) than 2 seconds of arc, TIR, over full travel; and

texts.zh: a.5. 每300 mm行程的滑座垂直度误差小于（优于）0.001 mm；
texts.en: a.5. Slide perpendicularity less (better) than 0.001 mm per 300 mm of travel;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 某轴的滑座双向定位重复性（R），指使用ISO 230/2:1988第2.11部分规定的程序和条件，在沿该轴或绕该轴任何位置确定的定位重复性的最大值。
texts.en: The bidirectional slide positioning repeatability (R) of an axis is the maximum value of the repeatability of positioning at any position along or around the axis determined using the procedure and under the conditions specified in part 2.11 of ISO 230/2: 1988.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下全部特性的飞刀切削机床：
texts.en: b. Fly cutting machines having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 主轴径向“跳动”和轴向“窜动”小于（优于）0.0004 mm TIR；且
texts.en: b.1. Spindle “run out” and “camming” less (better) than 0.0004 mm TIR; and

texts.zh: b.2. 全行程内滑座运动的角偏差（偏航、俯仰及滚转）小于（优于）2角秒（TIR）。
texts.en: b.2. Angular deviation of slide movement (yaw, pitch and roll) less (better) than 2 seconds of arc, TIR, over full travel.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 至少由主轴和轴承构成的主轴组件，其主轴旋转一周的径向（“跳动”）或轴向（“窜动”）运动小于（优于）0.0006 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
texts.en: Items: a. Spindle assemblies, consisting of spindles and bearings as a minimal assembly, with radial (“run out”) or axial (“camming”) axis motion in one revolution of the spindle less (better) than 0.0006 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

texts.zh: b. 具有以下全部特性的单点金刚石切削刀片：
texts.en: b. Single point diamond cutting tool inserts, having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 切削刃在任何方向放大400倍观察时均无缺陷、无崩口；
texts.en: b.1. Flawless and chip-free cutting edge when magnified 400 times in any direction;

texts.zh: b.2. 切削半径为0.1至5 mm（包括端点）；且
texts.en: b.2. Cutting radius from 0.1 to 5 mm inclusive; and

texts.zh: b.3. 切削半径的不圆度小于（优于）0.002 mm TIR。
texts.en: b.3. Cutting radius out-of-roundness less (better) than 0.002 mm TIR.

texts.zh: c. “专门设计”、安装有“零件”或“部件”的印刷电路板，按制造商规格，能够将“数控”单元、机床或反馈装置升级至达到或超过ECCN 2B991、2B993、2B996、2B997或2B998所规定的水平。
texts.en: c. “Specially designed” printed circuit boards with mounted “parts” or “components” capable of upgrading, according to the manufacturer's specifications, “numerical control” units, machine tools or feed-back devices to or above the levels specified in ECCNs 2B991, 2B993, 2B996, 2B997, or 2B998.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) “Software” “required” for the “development,” “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.5 milliradian (a lower milliradian number means a more accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) “Software” “required” for the “development”, “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian spatial resolution (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is designated as EAR99. texts.zh: 物项：a. 提供“自适应控制”且同时具有以下两项特性的“软件”：
texts.en: Items: a. “Software” to provide “adaptive control” and having both of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 用于“柔性制造单元”（FMU），该单元至少由EAR Part 772中“柔性制造单元”定义b.1及b.2所述设备构成；且
texts.en: a.1. For “flexible manufacturing units” (FMUs) which consist at least of equipment described in b.1 and b.2 of the definition of “flexible manufacturing unit” contained in part 772 of the EAR; and

texts.zh: a.2. 能利用至少两种检测技术同时获取的信号，在“实时处理”中生成或修改程序或数据，例如：
texts.en: a.2. Capable of generating or modifying, in “real-time processing”, programs or data by using the signals obtained simultaneously by means of at least two detection techniques, such as:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 机器视觉（光学测距）；
texts.en: a.2.a. Machine vision (optical ranging);

texts.zh: a.2.b. 红外成像；
texts.en: a.2.b. Infrared imaging;

texts.zh: a.2.c. 声学成像（声学测距）；
texts.en: a.2.c. Acoustical imaging (acoustical ranging);

texts.zh: a.2.d. 触觉测量；
texts.en: a.2.d. Tactile measurement;

texts.zh: a.2.e. 惯性定位；
texts.en: a.2.e. Inertial positioning;

texts.zh: a.2.f. 力测量；且
texts.en: a.2.f. Force measurement; and

texts.zh: a.2.g. 扭矩测量。
texts.en: a.2.g. Torque measurement.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 2D992.a不管制仅利用预存零件程序和预存零件程序分配策略，对“柔性制造单元”内功能相同设备重新排程的“软件”。
texts.en: 2D992.a does not control “software” which only provides rescheduling of functionally identical equipment within “flexible manufacturing units” using pre-stored part programs and a pre-stored strategy for the distribution of the part programs.

texts.zh: b. 保留。
texts.en: b. Reserved.

b.2. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 燃气涡轮发动机及部件的金属加工制造工艺“技术”见9E003及USML第XIX类。
texts.en: For “technology” for metal-working manufacturing processes for gas turbine engines and components, see 9E003 and USML Category XIX.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就2E003.b.1.c而言，“直接作用液压压制”指使用充液柔性囊直接接触工件的变形工艺。
texts.en: For the purposes of 2E003.b.1.c, 'direct-acting hydraulic pressing' is a deformation process which uses a fluid-filled flexible bladder in direct contact with the workpiece.

texts.zh: c. 用于“开发”或“生产”制造机体结构所用液压拉伸成形机及其模具的“技术”；
texts.en: c. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of hydraulic stretch-forming machines and dies therefor, for the manufacture of airframe structures;

texts.zh: d. [保留]
texts.en: d. [Reserved]

texts.zh: e. 用于“开发”集成“软件”的“技术”，该软件将为车间作业提供先进决策支持的专家系统纳入“数控”单元；
texts.en: e. “Technology” for the “development” of integration “software” for incorporation of expert systems for advanced decision support of shop floor operations into “numerical control” units;

texts.zh: f. 采用下表第1列规定并在技术注释中定义的工艺，在非电子基材（下表第2列）上施加无机覆盖涂层或无机表面改性涂层（下表第3列）的“技术”。
texts.en: f. “Technology” for the application of inorganic overlay coatings or inorganic surface modification coatings (specified in column 3 of the following table) to non-electronic substrates (specified in column 2 of the following table), by processes specified in column 1 of the following table and defined in the Technical Note.

texts.zh: 沉积技术表注释 1. “涂覆工艺”包括涂层修复和翻新，以及初次涂覆。
texts.en: Notes to Table on Deposition Techniques 1. The term 'coating process' includes coating repair and refurbishing as well as original coating.

texts.zh: 2. “合金化铝化物涂层”包括在施加铝化物涂层之前或期间沉积一种或多种元素的单步骤或多步骤涂层，即使这些元素通过另一种涂覆工艺沉积。但不包括多次使用单步骤包埋渗工艺以获得合金化铝化物的情况。
texts.en: 2. The term 'alloyed aluminide coating' includes single or multiple-step coatings in which an element or elements are deposited prior to or during application of the aluminide coating, even if these elements are deposited by another coating process. It does not, however, include the multiple use of single-step pack cementation processes to achieve alloyed aluminides.

texts.zh: 3. “贵金属改性铝化物”涂层包括在施加铝化物涂层之前，通过其他涂覆工艺先沉积一种或多种贵金属的多步骤涂层。
texts.en: 3. The term 'noble metal modified aluminide' coating includes multiple-step coatings in which the noble metal or noble metals are laid down by some other coating process prior to application of the aluminide coating.

texts.zh: 4. “其混合物”包括通过表中一种或多种涂覆工艺获得的渗透材料、梯度组成、共沉积层及多层沉积层。
texts.en: 4. The term 'mixtures thereof' includes infiltrated material, graded compositions, co-deposits and multilayer deposits and are obtained by one or more of the coating processes specified in the Table.

texts.zh: 5. MCrAlX指一种涂层合金，其中M为钴、铁、镍或其组合；X为任意含量的铪、钇、硅、钽，或按重量计超过0.01%的其他有意添加元素，以不同比例和组合存在，但下列除外：
texts.en: 5. MCrAlX refers to a coating alloy where M equals cobalt, iron, nickel or combinations thereof and X equals hafnium, yttrium, silicon, tantalum in any amount or other intentional additions over 0.01% by weight in various proportions and combinations, except:

texts.zh: a. 按重量计铬含量低于22%、铝含量低于7%且钇含量低于2%的CoCrAlY涂层；
texts.en: a. CoCrAlY coatings which contain less than 22% by weight of chromium, less than 7% by weight of aluminum and less than 2% by weight of yttrium;

texts.zh: b. 按重量计铬含量为22至24%、铝含量为10至12%且钇含量为0.5至0.7%的CoCrAlY涂层；或
texts.en: b. CoCrAlY coatings which contain 22 to 24% by weight of chromium, 10 to 12% by weight of aluminum and 0.5 to 0.7% by weight of yttrium; or

texts.zh: c. 按重量计铬含量为21至23%、铝含量为10至12%且钇含量为0.9至1.1%的NiCrAlY涂层。
texts.en: c. NiCrAlY coatings which contain 21 to 23% by weight of chromium, 10 to 12% by weight of aluminum and 0.9 to 1.1% by weight of yttrium.

texts.zh: 6. “铝合金”指在293 K（20 °C）下测得极限抗拉强度为190 MPa或以上的合金。
texts.en: 6. The term 'aluminum alloys' refers to alloys having an ultimate tensile strength of 190 MPa or more measured at 293 K (20 °C).

texts.zh: 7. “耐蚀钢”指AISI（美国钢铁协会）300系列钢或符合等同国家标准的钢。
texts.en: 7. The term 'corrosion resistant steel' refers to AISI (American Iron and Steel Institute) 300 series or equivalent national standard steels.

texts.zh: 8. “难熔金属及合金”包括以下金属及其合金：铌、钼、钨和钽。
texts.en: 8. 'Refractory metals and alloys' include the following metals and their alloys: niobium (columbium), molybdenum, tungsten and tantalum.

texts.zh: 9. “传感器窗口材料”如下：氧化铝、硅、锗、硫化锌、硒化锌、砷化镓、金刚石、磷化镓、蓝宝石，以及以下金属卤化物：直径大于40 mm的氟化锆和氟化铪传感器窗口材料。
texts.en: 9. 'Sensor window materials', as follows: alumina, silicon, germanium, zinc sulfide, zinc selenide, gallium arsenide, diamond, gallium phosphide, sapphire and the following metal halides: sensor window materials of more than 40 mm diameter for zirconium fluoride and hafnium fluoride.

texts.zh: 10. 第2类不包括实心翼型件的单步骤包埋渗“技术”。
texts.en: 10. Category 2 does not include “technology” for single-step pack cementation of solid airfoils.

texts.zh: 11. “聚合物”如下：聚酰亚胺、聚酯、聚硫化物、聚碳酸酯和聚氨酯。
texts.en: 11. 'Polymers', as follows: Polyimide, polyester, polysulfide, polycarbonates and polyurethanes.

texts.zh: 12. “改性氧化锆”指为稳定某些晶相及相组成，向氧化锆中添加其他金属氧化物（例如氧化钙、氧化镁、氧化钇、氧化铪、稀土氧化物）。由通过混合或熔融方式以氧化钙或氧化镁改性的氧化锆制成的热障涂层不受管制。
texts.en: 12. 'Modified zirconia' refers to additions of other metal oxides, (e.g., calcia, magnesia, yttria, hafnia, rare earth oxides) to zirconia in order to stabilize certain crystallographic phases and phase compositions. Thermal barrier coatings made of zirconia, modified with calcia or magnesia by mixing or fusion, are not controlled.

texts.zh: 13. “钛合金”仅指在293 K（20 °C）下测得极限抗拉强度为900 MPa或以上的航空航天合金。
texts.en: 13. 'Titanium alloys' refers only to aerospace alloys having an ultimate tensile strength of 900 MPa or more measured at 293 K (20 °C).

texts.zh: 14. “低膨胀玻璃”指在293 K（20 °C）下测得热膨胀系数为1 × 10^{−7} K^{−1}或以下的玻璃。
texts.en: 14. 'Low-expansion glasses' refers to glasses which have a coefficient of thermal expansion of 1 × 10^{−7} K^{−1} or less measured at 293 K (20 °C).

texts.zh: 15. “介质层”是由多层绝缘材料构成的涂层，利用由不同折射率材料构成的设计的干涉特性，反射、透射或吸收不同波段。“介质层”指四层以上介质层或介质/金属“复合”层。
texts.en: 15. 'Dielectric layers' are coatings constructed of multi-layers of insulator materials in which the interference properties of a design composed of materials of various refractive indices are used to reflect, transmit or absorb various wavelength bands. Dielectric layers refers to more than four dielectric layers or dielectric/metal “composite” layers.

texts.zh: 16. “硬质碳化钨”不包括由碳化钨/（钴、镍）、碳化钛/（钴、镍）、碳化铬/镍铬及碳化铬/镍构成的切削和成形工具材料。
texts.en: 16. 'Cemented tungsten carbide' does not include cutting and forming tool materials consisting of tungsten carbide/(cobalt, nickel), titanium carbide/(cobalt, nickel), chromium carbide/nickel-chromium and chromium carbide/nickel.

texts.zh: 17. 在以下任一物项上沉积类金刚石碳的“技术”不受管制：磁盘驱动器及磁头、一次性用品制造设备、水龙头阀、扬声器声学振膜、汽车发动机零件、切削刀具、冲压模具、办公自动化设备、麦克风、医疗器械，或由铍含量低于5%的合金制成、用于塑料浇铸或模塑的模具。
texts.en: 17. “Technology” for depositing diamond-like carbon on any of the following is not controlled: magnetic disk drives and heads, equipment for the manufacture of disposables, valves for faucets, acoustic diaphragms for speakers, engine parts for automobiles, cutting tools, punching-pressing dies, office automation equipment, microphones, medical devices or molds, for casting or molding of plastics, manufactured from alloys containing less than 5% beryllium.

texts.zh: 18. “碳化硅”不包括切削和成形工具材料。
texts.en: 18. 'Silicon carbide' does not include cutting and forming tool materials.

texts.zh: 19. 本条目所称陶瓷基材，不包括黏土或水泥含量按重量计达到5%或以上的陶瓷材料，无论黏土和水泥单独存在还是组合存在。
texts.en: 19. Ceramic substrates, as used in this entry, does not include ceramic materials containing 5% by weight, or greater, clay or cement content, either as separate constituents or in combination.

texts.zh: 沉积技术表技术注释：
texts.en: Technical Note to Table on Deposition Techniques:

texts.zh: 表中第1列所列工艺定义如下：
texts.en: Processes specified in Column 1 of the Table are defined as follows:

texts.zh: a. 化学气相沉积（CVD）是一种覆盖涂层或表面改性涂层工艺，将金属、合金、“复合材料”、介质或陶瓷沉积于加热的基材上。气态反应物在基材附近分解或化合，使所需元素、合金或化合物材料沉积于基材。该分解或化学反应过程的能量可由基材热量、辉光放电等离子体或“激光”照射提供。
texts.en: a. Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) is an overlay coating or surface modification coating process wherein a metal, alloy, “composite”, dielectric or ceramic is deposited upon a heated substrate. Gaseous reactants are decomposed or combined in the vicinity of a substrate resulting in the deposition of the desired elemental, alloy or compound material on the substrate. Energy for this decomposition or chemical reaction process may be provided by the heat of the substrate, a glow discharge plasma, or “laser” irradiation.

texts.zh: 注1：CVD包括以下工艺：定向气流非包埋沉积、脉冲CVD、受控成核热分解（CNTD）、等离子体增强或等离子体辅助CVD。
texts.en: Note 1: CVD includes the following processes: Directed gas flow out-of-pack deposition, pulsating CVD, controlled nucleation thermal decomposition (CNTD), plasma enhanced or plasma assisted CVD processes.

texts.zh: 注2：包埋指基材浸埋于粉末混合物中。
texts.en: Note 2: Pack denotes a substrate immersed in a powder mixture.

texts.zh: 注3：非包埋工艺所用气态反应物采用与包埋渗工艺相同的基本反应及参数生成，区别在于待涂覆基材不与粉末混合物接触。
texts.en: Note 3: The gaseous reactants used in the out-of-pack process are produced using the same basic reactions and parameters as the pack cementation process, except that the substrate to be coated is not in contact with the powder mixture.

texts.zh: b. 热蒸发-物理气相沉积（TE-PVD）是在压力小于0.1 Pa的真空中进行的覆盖涂层工艺，利用热能源将涂层材料汽化。蒸发物随后在适当放置的基材上冷凝或沉积。在涂覆过程中向真空室加入气体以合成化合物涂层，是该工艺的常见改进。采用离子束、电子束或等离子体激活或辅助涂层沉积，也是该技术的常见改进。这些工艺可具有利用监测器在过程中测量涂层光学特性和厚度的功能。具体TE-PVD工艺如下：
texts.en: b. Thermal Evaporation-Physical Vapor Deposition (TE-PVD) is an overlay coating process conducted in a vacuum with a pressure less than 0.1 Pa wherein a source of thermal energy is used to vaporize the coating material. This process results in the condensation, or deposition, of the evaporated species onto appropriately positioned substrates. The addition of gases to the vacuum chamber during the coating process to synthesize compound coatings is an ordinary modification of the process. The use of ion or electron beams, or plasma, to activate or assist the coating's deposition is also a common modification in this technique. The use of monitors to provide in-process measurement of optical characteristics and thickness of coatings can be a feature of these processes. Specific TE-PVD processes are as follows:

texts.zh: 1. 电子束PVD利用电子束加热并蒸发形成涂层的材料；
texts.en: 1. Electron Beam PVD uses an electron beam to heat and evaporate the material which forms the coating;

texts.zh: 2. 离子辅助电阻加热PVD将电阻热源与入射离子束结合，产生受控、均匀的蒸发涂层物质通量；
texts.en: 2. Ion Assisted Resistive Heating PVD employs electrically resistive heating sources in combination with impinging ion beam(s) to produce a controlled and uniform flux of evaporated coating species;

texts.zh: 3. “激光”汽化利用脉冲或连续波“激光”束，使形成涂层的材料汽化；
texts.en: 3. “Laser” Vaporization uses either pulsed or continuous wave “laser” beams to vaporize the material which forms the coating;

texts.zh: 4. 阴极电弧沉积采用由涂层材料制成的消耗性阴极，通过接地触发器的瞬时接触，在其表面建立电弧放电。受控的电弧运动侵蚀阴极表面，产生高度电离的等离子体。阳极可以是通过绝缘体连接于阴极外围的锥体，也可以是腔体。非视线沉积采用基材偏压；
texts.en: 4. Cathodic Arc Deposition employs a consumable cathode of the material which forms the coating and has an arc discharge established on the surface by a momentary contact of a ground trigger. Controlled motion of arcing erodes the cathode surface creating a highly ionized plasma. The anode can be either a cone attached to the periphery of the cathode, through an insulator, or the chamber. Substrate biasing is used for non line-of-sight deposition;

texts.zh: 注：该定义不包括对未施加偏压基材进行的随机阴极电弧沉积。
texts.en: Note: This definition does not include random cathodic arc deposition with non-biased substrates.

texts.zh: 5. 离子镀是一般TE-PVD工艺的一种特殊改进，利用等离子体或离子源使待沉积物质电离，并对基材施加负偏压，以便从等离子体中引出该物质。引入反应性物质、在工艺腔内蒸发固体，以及使用监测器在过程中测量涂层光学特性和厚度，均为该工艺的常见改进。
texts.en: 5. Ion Plating is a special modification of a general TE-PVD process in which a plasma or an ion source is used to ionize the species to be deposited, and a negative bias is applied to the substrate in order to facilitate the extraction of the species from the plasma. The introduction of reactive species, evaporation of solids within the process chamber, and the use of monitors to provide in-process measurement of optical characteristics and thicknesses of coatings are ordinary modifications of the process.

texts.zh: c. 包埋渗是一种表面改性涂层或覆盖涂层工艺，将基材浸埋于由以下成分构成的粉末混合物（包埋料）中：
texts.en: c. Pack Cementation is a surface modification coating or overlay coating process wherein a substrate is immersed in a powder mixture (a pack), that consists of:

texts.zh: 1. 待沉积的金属粉末（通常为铝、铬、硅或其组合）；
texts.en: 1. The metallic powders that are to be deposited (usually aluminum, chromium, silicon or combinations thereof);

texts.zh: 2. 活化剂（通常为卤化物盐）；且
texts.en: 2. An activator (normally a halide salt); and

texts.zh: 3. 惰性粉末，最常用的是氧化铝。
texts.en: 3. An inert powder, most frequently alumina.

texts.zh: 注：基材与粉末混合物置于反应罐内，加热至1,030 K（757 °C）至1,375 K（1,102 °C）之间，并保持足够时间以沉积涂层。
texts.en: Note: The substrate and powder mixture is contained within a retort which is heated to between 1,030 K (757 °C) to 1,375 K (1,102 °C) for sufficient time to deposit the coating.

texts.zh: d. 等离子体喷涂是一种覆盖涂层工艺，产生并控制等离子体的喷枪接受粉末或丝状涂层材料，将其熔化并推向基材，在基材上形成整体结合的涂层。等离子体喷涂包括低压等离子体喷涂或高速等离子体喷涂。
texts.en: d. Plasma Spraying is an overlay coating process wherein a gun (spray torch) which produces and controls a plasma accepts powder or wire coating materials, melts them and propels them towards a substrate, whereon an integrally bonded coating is formed. Plasma spraying constitutes either low pressure plasma spraying or high velocity plasma spraying.

texts.zh: >注1：低压指低于环境大气压力。
texts.en: >Note 1: Low pressure means less than ambient atmospheric pressure.

texts.zh: 注2：高速指按293 K（20 °C）、0.1 MPa条件计算，喷嘴出口气体速度超过750 m/s。
texts.en: Note 2: High velocity refers to nozzle-exit gas velocity exceeding 750 m/s calculated at 293 K (20 °C) at 0.1 MPa.

texts.zh: e. 浆料沉积是一种表面改性涂层或覆盖涂层工艺，将含有机黏结剂的金属或陶瓷粉末悬浮于液体中，通过喷涂、浸涂或刷涂施加于基材，随后风干或烘干，并经热处理获得所需涂层。
texts.en: e. Slurry Deposition is a surface modification coating or overlay coating process wherein a metallic or ceramic powder with an organic binder is suspended in a liquid and is applied to a substrate by either spraying, dipping or painting, subsequent air or oven drying, and heat treatment to obtain the desired coating.

texts.zh: f. 溅射沉积是一种基于动量传递现象的覆盖涂层工艺，正离子经电场加速后射向靶材（涂层材料）表面。入射离子的动能足以使靶材表面原子逸出，并沉积于适当放置的基材上。
texts.en: f. Sputter Deposition is an overlay coating process based on a momentum transfer phenomenon, wherein positive ions are accelerated by an electric field towards the surface of a target (coating material). The kinetic energy of the impacting ions is sufficient to cause target surface atoms to be released and deposited on an appropriately positioned substrate.

texts.zh: 注1：本表仅涉及用于提高涂层附着力和沉积速率的三极、磁控或反应溅射沉积，以及用于使非金属涂层材料汽化的射频（RF）增强溅射沉积。
texts.en: Note 1: The Table refers only to triode, magnetron or reactive sputter deposition which is used to increase adhesion of the coating and rate of deposition and to radio frequency (RF) augmented sputter deposition used to permit vaporization of non-metallic coating materials.

texts.zh: 注2：可使用低能离子束（小于5 keV）激活沉积。
texts.en: Note 2: Low-energy ion beams (less than 5 keV) can be used to activate the deposition.

texts.zh: g. 离子注入是一种表面改性涂层工艺，将待合金化的元素电离，经电位梯度加速并注入基材表面区域。包括离子注入与电子束物理气相沉积或溅射沉积同步进行的工艺。
texts.en: g. Ion Implantation is a surface modification coating process in which the element to be alloyed is ionized, accelerated through a potential gradient and implanted into the surface region of the substrate. This includes processes in which ion implantation is performed simultaneously with electron beam physical vapor deposition or sputter deposition.

texts.zh: 相关管制：（1）为“开发”、“生产”或“使用”工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率小于0.5毫弧度（毫弧度数值越小，图像分辨率越精确）的隐蔽物体探测设备所“必需”的“技术”，或为“开发”此类工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率小于0.5毫弧度的隐蔽物体探测设备的“开发”、“生产”或“使用”所“必需”的“软件”而“必需”的“技术”，均“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR Parts 120至130）。（2）为“开发”、“生产”或“使用”工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率大于1毫弧度（毫弧度数值越大，图像分辨率越低）的隐蔽物体探测设备所“必需”的“技术”，或为“开发”此类工作频率范围为30 GHz至3000 GHz、在100米探测距离下空间分辨率大于1毫弧度（毫弧度数值越大，图像分辨率越低）的隐蔽物体探测设备的“开发”、“生产”或“使用”所“必需”的“软件”而“必需”的“技术”，均归为EAR99。（3）相关商品和软件管制见ECCN 2A984和2D984。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) “Technology” “required” for the “development,” “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.5 milliradian (a lower milliradian number means a more accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters or “required” for the “development” of “software” “required” for the “development,” “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution less than 0.5 milliradian at a standoff distance of 100 meters is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) “Technology” “required” for the “development”, “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian spatial resolution (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters or “required” for the “development” of “software” “required” for the “development”, “production” or “use” of concealed object detection equipment operating in the frequency range from 30 GHz to 3000 GHz and having a spatial resolution greater than 1 milliradian spatial resolution (a higher milliradian number means a less accurate image resolution) at a standoff distance of 100 meters is designated as EAR99. (3) See ECCNs 2A984 and 2D984 for related commodity and software controls.

texts.zh: 相关定义：“微电路”指多个无源或有源元件在连续结构表面或内部不可分割地关联，以执行电路功能的装置。就3A001.a.1中的集成电路而言，5 × 10^{3} Gy(Si) = 5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si)；5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/s = 5 × 10^{8} Rads (Si)/s。
texts.en: Related Definitions: 'Microcircuit' means a device in which a number of passive or active elements are considered as indivisibly associated on or within a continuous structure to perform the function of a circuit. For the purposes of integrated circuits in 3A001.a.1, 5 × 10^{3} Gy(Si) = 5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si); 5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/s = 5 × 10^{8} Rads (Si)/s.

texts.zh: a. 如下通用集成电路：
texts.en: a. General purpose integrated circuits, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 设计或额定为抗辐射型，能够承受以下任一条件的集成电路：
texts.en: a.1. Integrated circuits designed or rated as radiation hardened to withstand any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 总剂量5 × 10^{3} Gy（Si）或以上；
texts.en: a.1.a. A total dose of 5 × 10^{3} Gy (Si), or higher;

texts.zh: a.1.b. 剂量率扰乱阈值5 × 10^{6} Gy（Si）/s或以上；或
texts.en: a.1.b. A dose rate upset of 5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/s, or higher; or

texts.zh: a.1.c. 对硅材料，中子（1 MeV等效）注量（积分通量）为5 × 10^{13} n/cm^{2}或以上，或对其他材料的等效值；
texts.en: a.1.c. A fluence (integrated flux) of neutrons (1 MeV equivalent) of 5 × 10^{13} n/cm^{2} or higher on silicon, or its equivalent for other materials;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 3A001.a.1.c不适用于金属-绝缘体-半导体（MIS）。
texts.en: 3A001.a.1.c does not apply to Metal Insulator Semiconductors (MIS).

texts.zh: a.2. 具有以下任一特性的“微处理器微电路”、“微计算机微电路”、微控制器微电路、采用化合物半导体制造的存储集成电路、模数转换器、含模数转换器并存储或处理数字化数据的集成电路、数模转换器、设计用于“信号处理”的电光或“光集成电路”、现场可编程逻辑器件、功能未知或其将用于的设备管制状态未知的定制集成电路、快速傅里叶变换（FFT）处理器、静态随机存取存储器（SRAM）或“非易失性存储器”：

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3A001.a.2而言，“非易失性存储器”指断电后仍可在一段时间内保留数据的存储器。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.2, 'non-volatile memories' are memories with data retention over a period of time after a power shutdown.

texts.zh: a.2.a. 额定可在高于398 K（+125 °C）的环境温度下工作；
texts.en: a.2.a. Rated for operation at an ambient temperature above 398 K (+125 °C);

texts.en: a.2.b. Rated for operation at an ambient temperature below 218 K (−55 °C); or

texts.zh: a.2.c. 额定可在218 K（−55 °C）至398 K（+125 °C）的整个环境温度范围内工作；
texts.en: a.2.c. Rated for operation over the entire ambient temperature range from 218 K (−55 °C) to 398 K (+125 °C);

texts.en: 3A001.a.2 does not apply to integrated circuits designed for civil automobile or railway train applications.

texts.zh: a.3. 由化合物半导体制造，工作时钟频率超过40 MHz的“微处理器微电路”、“微计算机微电路”和微控制器微电路；
texts.en: a.3. “Microprocessor microcircuits”, “microcomputer microcircuits” and microcontroller microcircuits, manufactured from a compound semiconductor and operating at a clock frequency exceeding 40 MHz;

texts.en: 3A001.a.3 includes digital signal processors, digital array processors and digital coprocessors.
a.4. [Reserved]

texts.zh: a.5. 如下模数转换器（ADC）和数模转换器（DAC）集成电路：
texts.en: a.5. Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) and Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) integrated circuits, as follows:

texts.zh: a.5.a. 具有以下任一特性的ADC：
texts.en: a.5.a. ADCs having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.5.a.1. 分辨率为8 bit或以上但小于10 bit，“采样率”大于1.3吉样本/秒（GSPS）；
texts.en: a.5.a.1. A resolution of 8 bit or more, but less than 10 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.3 Giga Samples Per Second (GSPS);

texts.zh: a.5.a.2. 分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit，“采样率”大于600兆样本/秒（MSPS）；
texts.en: a.5.a.2. A resolution of 10 bit or more, but less than 12 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 600 Mega Samples Per Second (MSPS);

texts.zh: a.5.a.3. 分辨率为12 bit或以上但小于14 bit，“采样率”大于400 MSPS；
texts.en: a.5.a.3. A resolution of 12 bit or more, but less than 14 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 400 MSPS;

texts.zh: a.5.a.4. 分辨率为14 bit或以上但小于16 bit，“采样率”大于250 MSPS；或
texts.en: a.5.a.4. A resolution of 14 bit or more, but less than 16 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 250 MSPS; or

texts.zh: a.5.a.5. 分辨率为16 bit或以上，“采样率”大于65 MSPS；
texts.en: a.5.a.5. A resolution of 16 bit or more with a “sample rate” greater than 65 MSPS;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 含模数转换器且存储或处理数字化数据的集成电路见3A001.a.14。
texts.en: For integrated circuits that contain analog-to-digital converters and store or process the digitized data see 3A001.a.14.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就3A001.a.5.a而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.5.a:

texts.zh: 1. n bit分辨率对应2^{n}个量化等级。
texts.en: 1. A resolution of n bit corresponds to a quantization of 2^{n} levels.

texts.zh: 2. ADC的分辨率是表示被测模拟输入的数字输出位数。有效位数（ENOB）不用于确定ADC分辨率。
texts.en: 2. The resolution of the ADC is the number of bits of the digital output that represents the measured analog input. Effective Number of Bits (ENOB) is not used to determine the resolution of the ADC.

texts.zh: 3. 对于“多通道ADC”，“采样率”不累加，以任一单通道的最大速率为“采样率”。
texts.en: 3. For “multiple channel ADCs”, the “sample rate” is not aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum rate of any single channel.

texts.zh: 4. 对于“交织ADC”或规定具有交织工作模式的“多通道ADC”，各“采样率”累加，以所有交织通道合计的最大总速率为“采样率”。
texts.en: 4. For “interleaved ADCs” or for “multiple channel ADCs” that are specified to have an interleaved mode of operation, the “sample rates” are aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum combined total rate of all of the interleaved channels.

texts.zh: a.5.b. 具有以下任一特性的数模转换器（DAC）：
texts.en: a.5.b. Digital-to-Analog Converters (DAC) having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.5.b.1. 分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit，“调整后更新率”超过3,500 MSPS；或
texts.en: a.5.b.1. A resolution of 10-bit or more but less than 12-bit, with an 'adjusted update rate' of exceeding 3,500 MSPS; or

texts.zh: a.5.b.2. 分辨率为12 bit或以上，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: a.5.b.2. A resolution of 12-bit or more and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.5.b.2.a. “调整后更新率”超过1,250 MSPS但不超过3,500 MSPS，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: a.5.b.2.a. An 'adjusted update rate' exceeding 1,250 MSPS but not exceeding 3,500 MSPS, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.5.b.2.a.1. 从满量程阶跃达到满量程值的0.024%以内，建立时间小于9 ns；或
texts.en: a.5.b.2.a.1. A settling time less than 9 ns to arrive at or within 0.024% of full scale from a full scale step; or

texts.zh: a.5.b.2.a.2. 合成100 MHz满量程模拟信号，或低于100 MHz的规定最高频率满量程模拟信号时，“无杂散动态范围”（SFDR）大于68 dBc（载波）；或
texts.en: a.5.b.2.a.2. A 'Spurious Free Dynamic Range' (SFDR) greater than 68 dBc (carrier) when synthesizing a full scale analog signal of 100 MHz or the highest full scale analog signal frequency specified below 100 MHz; or

texts.zh: a.5.b.2.b. “调整后更新率”超过3,500 MSPS；
texts.en: a.5.b.2.b. An 'adjusted update rate' exceeding 3,500 MSPS;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就3A001.a.5.b而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.5.b:

texts.zh: 1. “无杂散动态范围”（SFDR）定义为DAC输入端载波频率（最大信号分量）的均方根值与输出端次大噪声或谐波失真分量均方根值之比。
texts.en: 1. 'Spurious Free Dynamic Range' (SFDR) is defined as the ratio of the RMS value of the carrier frequency (maximum signal component) at the input of the DAC to the RMS value of the next largest noise or harmonic distortion component at its output.

texts.zh: 2. SFDR直接根据规格表或SFDR随频率变化的特性曲线确定。
texts.en: 2. SFDR is determined directly from the specification table or from the characterization plots of SFDR versus frequency.

texts.zh: 3. 信号幅度大于−3 dBfs（满量程）时，定义为满量程信号。
texts.en: 3. A signal is defined to be full scale when its amplitude is greater than −3 dBfs (full scale).

texts.zh: 4. DAC的“调整后更新率”为：
texts.en: 4. 'Adjusted update rate' for DACs is:

texts.zh: a. 对于常规（非插值）DAC，“调整后更新率”是数字信号转换为模拟信号且DAC输出模拟值发生变化的速率。对于可旁路插值模式（插值因子为一）的DAC，应视为常规（非插值）DAC。
texts.en: a. For conventional (non-interpolating) DACs, the 'adjusted update rate' is the rate at which the digital signal is converted to an analog signal and the output analog values are changed by the DAC. For DACs where the interpolation mode may be bypassed (interpolation factor of one), the DAC should be considered as a conventional (non-interpolating) DAC.

texts.zh: b. 对于插值DAC（过采样DAC），“调整后更新率”定义为DAC更新率除以最小插值因子。对于插值DAC，“调整后更新率”可能采用不同名称，包括：
texts.en: b. For interpolating DACs (oversampling DACs), the 'adjusted update rate' is defined as the DAC update rate divided by the smallest interpolating factor. For interpolating DACs, the 'adjusted update rate' may be referred to by different terms including:

texts.zh: • 输入数据率
texts.en: • input data rate

texts.zh: • 输入字速率
texts.en: • input word rate

texts.zh: • 输入采样率
texts.en: • input sample rate

texts.zh: a.6. 设计用于“信号处理”且具有以下全部特性的电光及“光集成电路”：
texts.en: a.6. Electro-optical and “optical integrated circuits”, designed for “signal processing” and having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.6.a. 一个或多个内部“激光”二极管；
texts.en: a.6.a. One or more than one internal “laser” diode;

texts.zh: a.6.b. 一个或多个内部光探测元件；且
texts.en: a.6.b. One or more than one internal light detecting element; and

texts.zh: a.6.c. 光波导；
texts.en: a.6.c. Optical waveguides;

texts.zh: a.7. 具有以下任一特性的“现场可编程逻辑器件”：
texts.en: a.7. 'Field programmable logic devices' having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.7.a. 单端数字输入/输出端最大数量大于700；或
texts.en: a.7.a. A maximum number of single-ended digital input/outputs of greater than 700; or

texts.zh: a.7.b. “单向峰值串行收发器总数据率”为500 Gb/s或以上；
texts.en: a.7.b. An 'aggregate one-way peak serial transceiver data rate' of 500 Gb/s or greater;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:
3A001.a.7 includes:

texts.zh: —复杂可编程逻辑器件（CPLD）；
texts.en: —Complex Programmable Logic Devices (CPLDs);

texts.zh: —现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）；
texts.en: —Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs);

texts.zh: —现场可编程逻辑阵列（FPLA）；
texts.en: —Field Programmable Logic Arrays (FPLAs);

texts.zh: —现场可编程互连器件（FPIC）。
texts.en: —Field Programmable Interconnects (FPICs).

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 将现场可编程逻辑器件与模数转换器结合的集成电路见3A001.a.14。
texts.en: For integrated circuits having field programmable logic devices that are combined with an analog-to-digital converter, see 3A001.a.14.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A001.a.7:

texts.zh: 1. 3A001.a.7.a中的最大数字输入/输出端数量，也称最大用户输入/输出端数量或最大可用输入/输出端数量，无论集成电路已封装还是裸片。
texts.en: 1. Maximum number of digital input/outputs in 3A001.a.7.a is also referred to as maximum user input/outputs or maximum available input/outputs, whether the integrated circuit is packaged or bare die.

texts.zh: 2. “单向峰值串行收发器总数据率”为单向峰值串行收发器数据率与FPGA上收发器数量的乘积。
texts.en: 2. 'Aggregate one-way peak serial transceiver data rate' is the product of the peak serial one-way transceiver data rate times the number of transceivers on the FPGA.
a.8. [Reserved]
a.9. [Reserved]

texts.zh: a.10. 制造商不知道其功能，或不知道将使用该集成电路的设备管制状态，且具有以下任一特性的定制集成电路：
texts.en: a.10. Custom integrated circuits for which the function is unknown, or the control status of the equipment in which the integrated circuits will be used is unknown to the manufacturer, having any of the following:
a.10.a. More than 1,500 terminals;

texts.zh: a.10.b. 典型“基本门传播延迟时间”小于0.02 ns；或
texts.en: a.10.b. A typical “basic gate propagation delay time” of less than 0.02 ns; or

texts.zh: a.10.c. 工作频率超过3 GHz；
texts.en: a.10.c. An operating frequency exceeding 3 GHz;

texts.zh: a.11. 3A001.a.3至3A001.a.10及3A001.a.12所述以外，基于任何化合物半导体且具有以下任一特性的数字集成电路：
texts.en: a.11. Digital integrated circuits, other than those described in 3A001.a.3 to 3A001.a.10 and 3A001.a.12, based upon any compound semiconductor and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.11.a. 等效门数超过3,000（双输入门）；或
texts.en: a.11.a. An equivalent gate count of more than 3,000 (2 input gates); or

texts.zh: a.11.b. 翻转频率超过1.2 GHz；
texts.en: a.11.b. A toggle frequency exceeding 1.2 GHz;

texts.zh: a.12. 执行N点复数FFT的额定时间小于（N log_{2} N）/20,480 ms的快速傅里叶变换（FFT）处理器，其中N为点数；
texts.en: a.12. Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) processors having a rated execution time for an N-point complex FFT of less than (N log_{2} N)/20,480 ms, where N is the number of points;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3A001.a.12而言，N等于1,024点时，3A001.a.12公式给出的执行时间为500 µs。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.12, when N is equal to 1,024 points, the formula in 3A001.a.12 gives an execution time of 500 µs.

texts.zh: a.13. 具有以下任一特性的直接数字合成器（DDS）集成电路：
texts.en: a.13. Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS) integrated circuits having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.13.a. 数模转换器（DAC）时钟频率为3.5 GHz或以上，且DAC分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit；或
texts.en: a.13.a. A Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) clock frequency of 3.5 GHz or more and a DAC resolution of 10 bit or more, but less than 12 bit; or

texts.zh: a.13.b. DAC时钟频率为1.25 GHz或以上，且DAC分辨率为12 bit或以上；
texts.en: a.13.b. A DAC clock frequency of 1.25 GHz or more and a DAC resolution of 12 bit or more;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3A001.a.13而言，DAC时钟频率可标为主时钟频率或输入时钟频率。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.a.13, the DAC clock frequency may be specified as the master clock frequency or the input clock frequency.

texts.zh: a.14. 执行或可编程执行以下全部功能的集成电路：
texts.en: a.14. Integrated circuits that perform or are programmable to perform all of the following:

texts.zh: a.14.a. 满足以下任一条件的模数转换：
texts.en: a.14.a. Analog-to-digital conversions meeting any of the following:

texts.zh: a.14.a.1. 分辨率为8 bit或以上但小于10 bit，“采样率”大于1.3吉样本/秒（GSPS）；
texts.en: a.14.a.1. A resolution of 8 bit or more, but less than 10 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.3 Giga Samples Per Second (GSPS);

texts.zh: a.14.a.2. 分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit，“采样率”大于1.0 GSPS；
texts.en: a.14.a.2. A resolution of 10 bit or more, but less than 12 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.0 GSPS;

texts.zh: a.14.a.3. 分辨率为12 bit或以上但小于14 bit，“采样率”大于1.0 GSPS；
texts.en: a.14.a.3. A resolution of 12 bit or more, but less than 14 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.0 GSPS;

texts.zh: a.14.a.4. 分辨率为14 bit或以上但小于16 bit，“采样率”大于400兆样本/秒（MSPS）；或
texts.en: a.14.a.4. A resolution of 14 bit or more, but less than 16 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 400 Mega Samples Per Second (MSPS); or

texts.zh: a.14.a.5. 分辨率为16 bit或以上，“采样率”大于180 MSPS；且
texts.en: a.14.a.5. A resolution of 16 bit or more with a “sample rate” greater than 180 MSPS; and

texts.zh: a.14.b. 以下任一功能：
texts.en: a.14.b. Any of the following:

texts.zh: a.14.b.1. 存储数字化数据；或
texts.en: a.14.b.1. Storage of digitized data; or

texts.zh: a.14.b.2. 处理数字化数据；
texts.en: a.14.b.2. Processing of digitized data;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 1：模数转换器集成电路见3A001.a.5.a。
texts.en: 1: For analog-to-digital converter integrated circuits see 3A001.a.5.a.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 2：现场可编程逻辑器件见3A001.a.7。
texts.en: 2: For field programmable logic devices see 3A001.a.7.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A001.a.14:

texts.zh: 1. n bit分辨率对应2^{n}个量化等级。
texts.en: 1. A resolution of n bit corresponds to a quantization of 2^{n} levels.

texts.zh: 2. ADC的分辨率是其数字输出中表示被测模拟输入的位数。有效位数（ENOB）不用于确定ADC分辨率。
texts.en: 2. The resolution of the ADC is the number of bits of the digital output of the ADC that represents the measured analog input. Effective Number of Bits (ENOB) is not used to determine the resolution of the ADC.

texts.zh: 3. 对于具有非交织“多通道ADC”的集成电路，“采样率”不累加，以任一单通道的最大速率为“采样率”。
texts.en: 3. For integrated circuits with non- interleaving “multiple channel ADCs”, the “sample rate” is not aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum rate of any single channel.

texts.zh: 4. 对于具有“交织ADC”或规定具有交织工作模式的“多通道ADC”的集成电路，各“采样率”累加，以所有交织通道合计的最大总速率为“采样率”。
texts.en: 4. For integrated circuits with “interleaved ADCs” or with “multiple channel ADCs” that are specified to have an interleaved mode of operation, the “sample rates” are aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum combined total rate of all of the interleaved channels.

texts.zh: b. 如下微波或毫米波物项：
texts.en: b. Microwave or millimeter wave items, as follows:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3A001.b而言，峰值饱和输出功率参数在产品数据表中也可能称为输出功率、饱和输出功率、最大输出功率、峰值输出功率或峰值包络输出功率。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b, the parameter peak saturated power output may also be referred to on product data sheets as output power, saturated power output, maximum power output, peak power output, or peak envelope power output.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 3A001.b未列明的参量信号放大器或量子极限放大器（QLA）见ECCN 3A901.b。
texts.en: For parametric signal amplifiers or Quantum-limited amplifiers (QLAs) not specified by 3A001.b, see ECCN 3A901.b.

texts.zh: b.1. 如下“真空电子器件”和阴极：
texts.en: b.1. “Vacuum electronic devices” and cathodes, as follows:
Note 1:

texts.zh: 3A001.b.1不管制设计或额定在具有以下全部特性的任何频段工作的“真空电子器件”：
texts.en: 3A001.b.1 does not control “vacuum electronic devices” designed or rated for operation in any frequency band and having all of the following:

texts.zh: a. 不超过31.8 GHz；且
texts.en: a. Does not exceed 31.8 GHz; and

texts.zh: b. “由ITU分配”用于无线电通信业务，但不用于无线电测定。
texts.en: b. Is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 3A001.b.1不管制具有以下全部特性的非“空间合格”“真空电子器件”：
texts.en: 3A001.b.1 does not control non-“space-qualified” “vacuum electronic devices” having all the following:

texts.zh: a. 平均输出功率等于或小于50 W；且
texts.en: a. An average output power equal to or less than 50 W; and

texts.zh: b. 设计或额定在具有以下全部特性的任何频段工作：
texts.en: b. Designed or rated for operation in any frequency band and having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 超过31.8 GHz但不超过43.5 GHz；且
texts.en: 1. Exceeds 31.8 GHz but does not exceed 43.5 GHz; and

texts.zh: 2. “由ITU分配”用于无线电通信业务，但不用于无线电测定。
texts.en: 2. Is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.

texts.zh: b.1.a. 如下脉冲或连续波行波“真空电子器件”：
texts.en: b.1.a. Traveling-wave “vacuum electronic devices,” pulsed or continuous wave, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1.a.1. 工作频率超过31.8 GHz的器件；
texts.en: b.1.a.1. Devices operating at frequencies exceeding 31.8 GHz;

texts.zh: b.1.a.2. 阴极加热器从开启至达到额定射频功率的时间小于3秒的器件；
texts.en: b.1.a.2. Devices having a cathode heater with a turn on time to rated RF power of less than 3 seconds;

texts.zh: b.1.a.3. “相对带宽”大于7%或峰值功率超过2.5 kW的耦合腔器件或其衍生器件；
texts.en: b.1.a.3. Coupled cavity devices, or derivatives thereof, with a “fractional bandwidth” of more than 7% or a peak power exceeding 2.5 kW;

texts.zh: b.1.a.4. 基于螺旋线、折叠波导或蛇形波导电路，或其衍生电路，且具有以下任一特性的器件：
texts.en: b.1.a.4. Devices based on helix, folded waveguide, or serpentine waveguide circuits, or derivatives thereof, having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a.4.a. “瞬时带宽”大于一个倍频程，且平均功率（kW）与频率（GHz）的乘积大于0.5；
texts.en: b.1.a.4.a. An “instantaneous bandwidth” of more than one octave, and average power (expressed in kW) times frequency (expressed in GHz) of more than 0.5;

texts.zh: b.1.a.4.b. “瞬时带宽”为一个倍频程或以下，且平均功率（kW）与频率（GHz）的乘积大于1；
texts.en: b.1.a.4.b. An “instantaneous bandwidth” of one octave or less, and average power (expressed in kW) times frequency (expressed in GHz) of more than 1;

texts.zh: b.1.a.4.c. 具有“空间合格”资格；或
texts.en: b.1.a.4.c. Being “space-qualified”; or

texts.zh: b.1.a.4.d. 具有栅控电子枪；
texts.en: b.1.a.4.d. Having a gridded electron gun;

texts.zh: b.1.a.5. “相对带宽”大于或等于10%，且具有以下任一特性的器件：
texts.en: b.1.a.5. Devices with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than or equal to 10%, with any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a.5.a. 环形电子束；
texts.en: b.1.a.5.a. An annular electron beam;

texts.zh: b.1.a.5.b. 非轴对称电子束；或
texts.en: b.1.a.5.b. A non-axisymmetric electron beam; or

texts.zh: b.1.a.5.c. 多电子束；
texts.en: b.1.a.5.c. Multiple electron beams;

texts.zh: b.1.b. 增益大于17 dB的正交场放大器“真空电子器件”；
texts.en: b.1.b. Crossed-field amplifier “vacuum electronic devices” with a gain of more than 17 dB;

texts.zh: b.1.c. 为“真空电子器件”设计，在额定工作条件下发射电流密度超过5 A/cm^{2}，或脉冲（非连续）电流密度超过10 A/cm^{2}的热阴极；
texts.en: b.1.c. Thermionic cathodes, designed for “vacuum electronic devices,” producing an emission current density at rated operating conditions exceeding 5 A/cm^{2} or a pulsed (non-continuous) current density at rated operating conditions exceeding 10 A/cm^{2};

texts.zh: b.1.d. 能以“双模式”工作的“真空电子器件”。
texts.en: b.1.d. “Vacuum electronic devices” with the capability to operate in a 'dual mode.'

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3A001.b.1.d而言，“双模式”指利用栅极，可有意将“真空电子器件”的束流在连续波与脉冲工作模式之间切换，且产生的峰值脉冲输出功率大于连续波输出功率。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b.1.d, 'dual mode' means the “vacuum electronic device” beam current can be intentionally changed between continuous-wave and pulsed mode operation by use of a grid and produces a peak pulse output power greater than the continuous-wave output power.

texts.zh: b.2. 具有以下任一特性的“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器：
texts.en: b.2. “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers that any of the following:

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 集成有移相器的“MMIC”放大器见3A001.b.12。
texts.en: For “MMIC” amplifiers that have an integrated phase shifter see 3A001.b.12.

texts.zh: b.2.a. 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: b.2.a. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a.1. 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于75 W（48.75 dBm）；
texts.en: b.2.a.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 75 W (48.75 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

texts.zh: b.2.a.2. 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于55 W（47.4 dBm）；
texts.en: b.2.a.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 55 W (47.4 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

texts.zh: b.2.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于40 W（46 dBm）；或
texts.en: b.2.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 40 W (46 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

texts.zh: b.2.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 W（43 dBm）；
texts.en: b.2.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 W (43 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

texts.zh: b.2.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过16 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: b.2.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 16 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 W（40 dBm）；或
texts.en: b.2.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 10 W (40 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz; or

texts.zh: b.2.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于5 W（37 dBm）；
texts.en: b.2.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 5 W (37 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 16 GHz;

texts.zh: b.2.c. 额定在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于3 W（34.77 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
texts.en: b.2.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 3 W (34.77 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

texts.zh: b.2.d. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
texts.en: b.2.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

texts.zh: b.2.e. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于1 W（30 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
texts.en: b.2.e. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 1 W (30 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

texts.zh: b.2.f. 额定在大于43.5 GHz且不超过75 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于31.62 mW（15 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
texts.en: b.2.f. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 31.62 mW (15 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz up to and including 75 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

texts.zh: b.2.g. 额定在大于75 GHz且不超过90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 mW（10 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于5%；或
texts.en: b.2.g. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 10 mW (10 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 75 GHz up to and including 90 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 5%; or

texts.zh: b.2.h. 额定在大于90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
texts.en: b.2.h. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 90 GHz;
