texts.zh: o. 下列为300 mm晶圆而设计的退火设备：
texts.en: o. Annealing equipment designed for 300 mm wafers as follows:

texts.zh: o.1 在真空（小于等于0.01 Pa）环境中工作，并执行下列任一功能的退火设备：
texts.en: o.1 Annealing equipment, operating in a vacuum (equal to or less than 0.01 Pa) environment, performing any of the following:

texts.zh: o.1.a 铜（Cu）回流，以尽量减少或消除铜（Cu）金属互连中的空隙或接缝；或
texts.en: o.1.a Reflow of copper (Cu) to minimize or eliminate voids or seams in copper (Cu) metal interconnects; or

texts.zh: o.1.b 钴（Co）或钨（W）填充金属回流，以尽量减少或消除空隙或接缝；
texts.en: o.1.b Reflow of cobalt (Co) or tungsten (W) fill metal to minimize or eliminate voids or seams;

texts.zh: o.2. 为将半导体晶圆加热至高于1000 °C（1832 °F）的温度，且‘持续时间’小于2 ms而设计的设备。
texts.en: o.2. Equipment designed to heat a semiconductor wafer to a temperature greater than 1000 °C (1832 °F) for a 'duration' less than 2 ms.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3B993.o.2而言，‘持续时间’是指高于所述温度的时间。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3B993.o.2, 'duration' is the period above stated temperature.

texts.en: p. Removal and cleaning equipment as follows:

texts.zh: p.1. 为去除聚合物残留物和氧化铜（CuO）膜，并能够在真空（小于等于0.01 Pa）环境中沉积金属铜（Cu）而设计的设备。
texts.en: p.1. Equipment designed for removing polymeric residue and copper oxide (CuO) film and enabling deposition of copper (Cu) metal in a vacuum (equal to or less than 0.01 Pa) environment.
p.2. [Reserved]

texts.en: p.3. Equipment designed for dry surface oxide removal preclean or dry surface decontamination.

texts.zh: 这些管制不适用于沉积设备。
texts.en: These controls do not apply to deposition equipment.

texts.zh: q. 下列检验和计量设备：
texts.en: q. Inspection and metrology equipment as follows:

texts.zh: q.1. 为接纳直径大于等于300 mm的晶圆而设计或改装，且具有以下全部特性的图形化晶圆缺陷计量或图形化晶圆缺陷检验设备：
texts.en: q.1. Patterned wafer defect metrology or patterned wafer defect inspection equipment, designed or modified to accept wafers greater than or equal to 300 mm in diameter, and having all of the following:

texts.zh: q.1.a. 为检测尺寸小于等于21 nm的缺陷而设计或改装；以及
texts.en: q.1.a. Designed or modified to detect defects having a size equal to or less than 21 nm; and

texts.zh: q.1.b. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: q.1.b. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: q.1.b.1. 光学波长小于400 nm的光源；
texts.en: q.1.b.1. A light source with an optical wavelength less than 400 nm;

texts.zh: q.1.b.2. 分辨率小于（优于）或等于1.65 nm的电子束源；
texts.en: q.1.b.2. An electron-beam source with a resolution less (better) than or equal to 1.65 nm;

texts.zh: q.1.b.3. 冷场发射（CFE）电子束源；或
texts.en: q.1.b.3. A Cold Field Emission (CFE) electron-beam source; or

texts.zh: q.1.b.4. 两个或更多电子束源。
texts.en: q.1.b.4. Two or more electron-beam sources.

texts.zh: q.2. 下列计量设备：
texts.en: q.2. Metrology equipment as follows:

texts.zh: q.2.a. 为在光刻曝光前测量晶圆形状参数，并利用测量结果改善具有数值孔径大于1.3的浸没式透镜的深紫外（DUV）光刻系统或极紫外（EUV）光刻系统的套刻或聚焦而设计的独立设备；或
texts.en: q.2.a. Stand-alone equipment designed to measure wafer shape parameters prior to lithography exposure and utilize measurements to improve overlay or focus of a deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography system having an immersion lens having a numerical aperture more than 1.3 or an Extreme Ultraviolet lithography (EUV) system; or

texts.zh: q.2.b. 为在产品晶圆的光刻胶显影后或刻蚀后，使用基于图像的套刻或基于衍射的测量技术测量聚焦或套刻而设计，套刻测量精度小于（优于）或等于0.5 nm，且具有下列任一特性的计量设备：
texts.en: q.2.b. Metrology equipment designed to measure focus or overlay after resist development or after etch on product wafers using image-based overlay or diffraction-based measurements techniques, with an overlay measurement accuracy less (better) than or equal to 0.5 nm having any of the following:

texts.zh: q.2.b.1 为集成到‘涂胶显影轨道设备’而设计；或
texts.en: q.2.b.1 designed for integration to a 'track'; or

texts.zh: q.2.b.2 具有‘快速波长切换功能’；
texts.en: q.2.b.2 'fast wavelength switching functionality';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就3B993.q.2而言，‘涂胶显影轨道设备’是指为涂覆和显影专为光刻配制的光刻胶而设计的设备。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 3B993.q.2, a 'track' is equipment designed for coating and developing photoresist formulated for lithography.

texts.zh: 2. 就3B993.q.2而言，‘快速波长切换功能’定义为能够在小于25 ms的时间内改变测量波长并获取一次测量结果。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 3B993.q.2, 'fast wavelength switching functionality' is defined as having the ability the change the measurement wavelength and acquire a measurement in less than 25 ms.

texts.en: a. “Specially designed” for implementing 'Register Transfer Level' ('RTL') to 'Geometrical Database Standard II' ('GDSII') or equivalent standard; or

texts.zh: b. 为优化功耗或时序规则而“专门设计”。

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就3D006而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 3D006:

texts.zh: 1. “电子计算机辅助设计”（“ECAD”）是一类用于设计、分析、优化和验证集成电路或印制电路板性能的“软件”工具。
texts.en: 1. 'Electronic Computer-Aided Design' ('ECAD') is a category of “software” tools used for designing, analyzing, optimizing, and validating the performance of an integrated circuit or printed circuit board.

texts.zh: 2. “寄存器传输级”（“RTL”）是一种设计抽象方法，通过硬件寄存器之间数字信号的流动以及对这些信号执行的逻辑运算，对同步数字电路建模。
texts.en: 2. 'Register Transfer Level' ('RTL') is a design abstraction which models a synchronous digital circuit in terms of the flow of digital signals between hardware registers and the logical operations performed on those signals.

texts.zh: 3. “几何数据库标准II”（“GDSII”）是一种用于交换集成电路或集成电路版图数据的数据库文件格式。
texts.en: 3. 'Geometrical Database Standard II' ('GDSII') is a database file format for data exchange of integrated circuit or integrated circuit layout artwork.

texts.zh: a. 为“开发”或“生产”3B001.a.4、c、d、f.1、f.5、f.6、k至n、p.2、p.4、r或3B002.c所列商品而“专门设计”的“软件”。
texts.en: a. “Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production,” of commodities specified in 3B001.a.4, c, d, f.1, f.5, f.6, k to n, p.2, p.4, r, or 3B002.c.

texts.zh: b. 为将多个裸片集成到“多芯片”集成电路中而设计，且具有以下全部功能的“电子计算机辅助设计”（“ECAD”）“软件”：
texts.en: b. 'Electronic Computer-Aided Design' ('ECAD') “software” designed for the integration of multiple dies into a 'multi-chip' integrated circuit, and having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 布局规划；以及
texts.en: b.1. Floor planning; and

texts.zh: b.2. 裸片与封装的协同设计或协同仿真。
texts.en: b.2. Co-design or co-simulation of die and package.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3D992.b而言，“多芯片”包括多裸片和多芯粒。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3D992.b, 'multi-chip' includes multi-die and multi-chiplet.

texts.zh: c. 未由3D992.a列明、为在深紫外浸没式光刻设备中或与此类设备配合执行以下全部操作而设计或改装的“软件”：
texts.en: c. “Software” not specified by 3D992.a designed or modified to perform all of the following in or with deep-ultraviolet immersion photolithography equipment:

texts.zh: c.1. 减小3B001.f.1.b所列最小可分辨特征；以及
texts.en: c.1. Decrease the minimum resolvable feature specified by 3B001.f.1.b; and

texts.zh: c.2. 将深紫外浸没式光刻设备的最大“专用卡盘套刻精度”降低至小于或等于1.5 nm。
texts.en: c.2. Decrease the maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' of deep-ultraviolet immersion lithography equipment below or equal to 1.5 nm.

texts.en: 3D993 “Software” for the “development” or “production” of commodities specified in 3B993 and “software” as follows (see List of Items Controlled).

texts.en: a. “Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of commodities specified in 3B993.

texts.zh: b. 为运用多重图形化“开发”或“生产”集成电路而设计或改装的“电子计算机辅助设计”（“ECAD”）“软件”。
texts.en: b. 'Electronic Computer-Aided Design' ('ECAD') “software” designed or modified for the “development” or “production” of integrated circuits using multipatterning.

texts.zh: c. 为“开发”或“生产”DUV光刻掩模或光刻版上的图案而设计或改装的“计算光刻”“软件”。
texts.en: c. 'Computational lithography' “software” designed or modified for the “development” or “production” of patterns on DUV lithography masks or reticles.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3D993而言，“计算光刻”是指运用计算机建模，对一系列图案、工艺和系统条件下的光刻工艺成像性能进行预测、校正、优化和验证。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3D993, 'computational lithography' is the use of computer modelling to predict, correct, optimize and verify imaging performance of the lithography process over a range of patterns, processes, and system conditions.

texts.zh: d. 为使3B001.f.1或3B993.f.1所列设备每小时处理的晶圆数量（在任何时间间隔内取平均值）增加超过1%而设计或改装的“软件”。
texts.en: d. “Software” designed or modified to increase the number of wafers processed per hour, averaged over any time interval, by greater than 1%, of equipment specified in 3B001.f.1 or 3B993.f.1.

texts.zh: e. 未由3D993.a列明、为在深紫外浸没式光刻设备中或与此类设备配合执行以下全部操作而设计或改装的“软件”：
texts.en: e. “Software” not specified by 3D993.a designed or modified to perform all of the following in or with deep-ultraviolet immersion photolithography equipment:

texts.zh: e.1. 减小3B993.f.1.b.1所列最小可分辨特征；以及
texts.en: e.1. Decrease the minimum resolvable feature specified by 3B993.f.1.b.1; and

texts.zh: e.2. 将深紫外浸没式光刻设备的最大“专用卡盘套刻精度”降低至大于1.5 nm且小于或等于2.4 nm。
texts.en: e.2. Decrease the maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' of deep-ultraviolet immersion lithography equipment above 1.5 nm and below or equal to 2.4 nm.

texts.en: TSR: Yes, except N/A for MT, and “technology” for the “development” or “production” of: (a) vacuum electronic device amplifiers described in 3A001.b.8, having operating frequencies exceeding 19 GHz; (b) solar cells, coverglass-interconnect-cells or covered-interconnect-cells (CIC) “assemblies,” solar arrays and/or solar panels described in 3A001.e.4; (c) “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers in 3A001.b.2; (d) discrete microwave transistors in 3A001.b.3; and (e) commodities described in 3A090.

texts.en: STA: License Exception STA may not be used to ship or transmit “technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by ECCNs 3A002.g.1 or 3B001.a.2 to any of the destinations listed in Country Group A:6 (see supplement no.1 to part 740 of the EAR). License Exception STA may not be used to ship or transmit “technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of components specified by ECCN 3A001.b.2, b.3, commodities specified in 3A090, to any of the destinations listed in Country Group A:5 or A:6 (see supplement no. 1 to part 740 of the EAR).

texts.zh: a. 设计为可同时对“浮点”向量（由32位或更大位数构成的一维数值数组）执行两次以上计算的“向量处理器单元”；
texts.en: a. A 'vector processor unit' designed to perform more than two calculations on 'floating-point' vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 32-bit or larger numbers) simultaneously;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就3E002.a而言，“向量处理器单元”是具有内置指令、可同时对“浮点”向量（由32位或更大位数构成的一维数值数组）执行多次计算的处理器单元，具有至少一个向量算术逻辑单元以及每个包含至少32个元素的向量寄存器。
texts.en: For the purposes of 3E002.a, a 'vector processor unit' is a processor element with built-in instructions that perform multiple calculations on 'floating-point' vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 32-bit or larger numbers) simultaneously, having at least one vector arithmetic logic unit and vector registers of at least 32 elements each.

texts.zh: b. 设计为每个周期产生四个以上64位或更大位数的“浮点”运算结果；或
texts.en: b. Designed to perform more than four 64-bit or larger 'floating-point' operation results per cycle; or

texts.zh: c. 设计为每个周期产生八个以上16位“定点”乘加结果（例如，对先前已转换为数字形式的模拟信息进行数字处理，也称为数字“信号处理”）。
texts.en: c. Designed to perform more than eight 16-bit 'fixed-point' multiply-accumulate results per cycle (e.g., digital manipulation of analog information that has been previously converted into digital form, also known as digital “signal processing”).
Note 1:

texts.zh: 3E002不管制多媒体扩展的“技术”。
texts.en: 3E002 does not control “technology” for multimedia extensions.

texts.zh: 注2：3E002不管制同时具有以下全部特性的微处理器内核的“技术”：
texts.en: Note 2: 3E002 does not control “technology” for microprocessor cores, having all of the following:

texts.zh: a. 采用0.130 _{µ}m或以上的“技术”；以及
texts.en: a. Using “technology” at or above 0.130 _{µ}m; and

texts.zh: b. 采用金属层不超过五层的多层结构。
texts.en: b. Incorporating multi-layer structures with five or fewer metal layers.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 3E002包括“开发”或“生产”数字信号处理器和数字阵列处理器的“技术”。
texts.en: 3E002 includes “technology” for the “development” or “production” of digital signal processors and digital array processors.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就3E002.a和3E002.b而言，“浮点”的定义见IEEE-754。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 3E002.a and 3E002.b, 'floating-point' is defined by IEEE-754.

texts.zh: 2. 就3E002.c而言，“定点”指同时包含整数部分和小数部分的固定位宽实数，不包括纯整数格式。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 3E002.c, 'fixed-point' refers to a fixed-width real number with both an integer component and a fractional component, and which does not include integer-only formats.

texts.zh: 在满足下列条件时，4A003所述“数字计算机”及相关设备的管制状态由其他设备或系统的管制状态决定：
texts.en: The control status of the “digital computers” and related equipment described in 4A003 is determined by the control status of other equipment or systems provided:

texts.zh: a. “数字计算机”或相关设备为其他设备或系统运行所必不可少；
texts.en: a. The “digital computers” or related equipment are essential for the operation of the other equipment or systems;

texts.zh: b. “数字计算机”或相关设备不是其他设备或系统的“主要组成部分”；以及
texts.en: b. The “digital computers” or related equipment are not a “principal element” of the other equipment or systems; and

texts.zh: 特别提示1：
为其他设备“专门设计”、且功能限于该其他设备所需功能的“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备，即使超过“主要组成部分”标准，其管制状态仍由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
texts.en: The control status of “signal processing” or “image enhancement” equipment “specially designed” for other equipment with functions limited to those required for the other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment even if it exceeds the “principal element” criterion.

texts.zh: 特别提示2：
用于电信设备的“数字计算机”或相关设备的管制状态，见第5类第1部分（电信）。
texts.en: For the control status of “digital computers” or related equipment for telecommunications equipment, see Category 5, Part 1 (Telecommunications).

texts.zh: c. “数字计算机”及相关设备的“技术”由4E确定。
texts.en: c. The “technology” for the “digital computers” and related equipment is determined by 4E.

texts.zh: a. “脉动阵列计算机”；
texts.en: a. 'Systolic array computers';

texts.zh: b. “神经计算机”；
texts.en: b. 'Neural computers';

texts.zh: c. “光计算机”。
texts.en: c. 'Optical computers'.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就4A004.a而言，“脉动阵列计算机”是指用户可在逻辑门层面动态控制数据流动和修改的计算机。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 4A004.a, 'systolic array computers' are computers where the flow and modification of the data is dynamically controllable at the logic gate level by the user.

texts.zh: 2. 就4A004.b而言，“神经计算机”是为模仿神经元或神经元集合的行为而设计或改装的计算设备，即其特征在于具有根据先前数据调节多个计算部件之间互连权重和数量的硬件能力的计算设备。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 4A004.b, 'neural computers' are computational devices designed or modified to mimic the behavior of a neuron or a collection of neurons, i.e., computational devices which are distinguished by their hardware capability to modulate the weights and numbers of the interconnections of a multiplicity of computational components based on previous data.

texts.zh: 3. 就4A004.c而言，“光计算机”是为用光表示数据而设计或改装，且其计算逻辑元件基于直接耦合光学器件的计算机。
texts.en: 3. For the purposes of 4A004.c, 'optical computers' are computers designed or modified to use light to represent data and whose computational logic elements are based on directly coupled optical devices.

texts.zh: a. 下列量子计算机：
texts.en: a. Quantum computers, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 支持34个或以上但少于100个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于10^{−4}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.1. Quantum computers supporting 34 or more, but fewer than 100, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 10^{−4};

texts.zh: a.2. 支持100个或以上但少于200个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于10^{−3}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.2. Quantum computers supporting 100 or more, but fewer than 200, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 10^{−3};

texts.zh: a.3. 支持200个或以上但少于350个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于2 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.3. Quantum computers supporting 200 or more, but fewer than 350, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 2 × 10^{−3};

texts.zh: a.4. 支持350个或以上但少于500个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于3 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.4. Quantum computers supporting 350 or more, but fewer than 500, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 3 × 10^{−3};

texts.zh: a.5. 支持500个或以上但少于700个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于4 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.5. Quantum computers supporting 500 or more, but fewer than 700, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 4 × 10^{−3};

texts.zh: a.6. 支持700个或以上但少于1,100个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于5 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.6. Quantum computers supporting 700 or more, but fewer than 1,100, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 5 × 10^{−3};

texts.zh: a.7. 支持1,100个或以上但少于2,000个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于6 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.7. Quantum computers supporting 1,100 or more, but fewer than 2,000, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 6 × 10^{−3};

texts.zh: a.8. 支持2,000个或以上“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”的量子计算机；
texts.en: a.8. Quantum computers supporting 2,000 or more 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits';

texts.zh: b. 含有或支持“物理量子比特”阵列，且为4A906.a所列物项“专门设计”的量子比特器件和量子比特电路；
texts.en: b. Qubit devices and qubit circuits, containing or supporting arrays of 'physical qubits', and “specially designed” for items specified by 4A906.a;

texts.zh: c. 为4A906.a所列物项“专门设计”的量子控制部件和量子测量器件；
texts.en: c. Quantum control components and quantum measurement devices, “specially designed” for items specified by 4A906.a;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 4A906适用于电路模型（或基于量子门）和单向（或基于测量）的量子计算机。本条目不适用于绝热（或退火）量子计算机。
texts.en: 4A906 applies to circuit model (or gate-based) and one-way (or measurement-based) quantum computers. This entry does not apply to adiabatic (or annealing) quantum computers.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 4A906所列物项未必在物理上包含任何量子比特。例如，基于光子方案的量子计算机并不永久包含可识别为量子比特的实物。光子量子比特是在计算机运行时生成、随后被舍弃的。
texts.en: Items specified by 4A906 may not necessarily physically contain any qubits. For example, quantum computers based on photonic schemes do not permanently contain a physical item that can be identified as a qubit. Instead, the photonic qubits are generated while the computer is operating and then later discarded.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 4A906.b所列物项包括半导体、超导和光子量子比特芯片及芯片阵列；表面离子阱阵列；其他量子比特约束技术；以及这些物项之间的相干互连。
texts.en: Items specified by 4A906.b include semiconductor, superconducting, and photonic qubit chips and chip arrays; surface ion trap arrays; other qubit confinement technologies; and coherent interconnects between such items.
Note 4:

texts.zh: 4A906.c适用于为校准、初始化、操控或测量量子计算机内驻留量子比特而设计的物项。
texts.en: 4A906.c applies to items designed for calibrating, initializing, manipulating or measuring the resident qubits of a quantum computer.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就4A906而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 4A906:

texts.zh: 1. “物理量子比特”是通过未经纠错的操控和测量来表示量子逻辑基本单元的二能级量子系统。“物理量子比特”有别于逻辑量子比特，后者是由多个“物理量子比特”组成的经纠错量子比特。
texts.en: 1. A 'physical qubit' is a two-level quantum system used to represent the elementary unit of quantum logic by means of manipulations and measurements that are not error corrected. 'Physical qubits' are distinguished from logical qubits, in that logical qubits are error-corrected qubits comprised of many 'physical qubits'.

texts.zh: 2. “完全受控”是指可根据需要对“物理量子比特”进行校准、初始化、门操作和读出。
texts.en: 2. 'Fully controlled' means the 'physical qubit' can be calibrated, initialized, gated, and read out, as necessary.

texts.zh: 3. “相连”是指可在可用且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”中任意一对之间执行双量子比特门操作。这不一定意味着全连接。
texts.en: 3. 'Connected' means that two-qubit gate operations can be performed between any arbitrary pair of the available 'working' 'physical qubits'. This does not necessarily entail all-to-all connectivity.

texts.zh: 4. “正常工作”是指“物理量子比特”按照系统对量子比特操作保真度的规格要求执行通用量子计算任务。
texts.en: 4. 'Working' means that the 'physical qubit' performs universal quantum computational work according to the system specifications for qubit operational fidelity.

texts.zh: 5. 支持34个或以上“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，是指量子计算机能够约束、控制、测量和处理34个或以上“物理量子比特”中承载的量子信息。
texts.en: 5. Supporting 34 or more 'fully controlled', 'connected', 'working' 'physical qubits' refers to the capability of a quantum computer to confine, control, measure and process the quantum information embodied in 34 or more 'physical qubits'.

texts.zh: 6. “C-NOT误差”是最近邻两个“物理量子比特”的受控非（C-NOT）门的平均物理门误差。
texts.en: 6. 'C-NOT error' is the average physical gate error for the nearest-neighbor two-'physical qubit' Controlled-NOT (C-NOT) gates.

texts.zh: a. 额定可在高于343 K（70 °C）的环境温度下运行的电子计算机及相关设备，以及为其配套的“电子组件”和“专门设计”的“零件”及“部件”；
texts.en: a. Electronic computers and related equipment, and “electronic assemblies” and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor, rated for operation at an ambient temperature above 343 K (70 °C);

texts.zh: b. “调整峰值性能”（“APP”）大于或等于0.0128加权万亿次浮点运算/秒（WT）的“数字计算机”，包括“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备；
texts.en: b. “Digital computers”, including equipment of “signal processing” or image enhancement”, having an “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”) equal to or greater than 0.0128 Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT);

texts.zh: c. 为通过处理器聚合提升性能而“专门设计”或改装的下列“电子组件”：
texts.en: c. “Electronic assemblies” that are “specially designed” or modified to enhance performance by aggregation of processors, as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 设计为可按16个或以上处理器的配置进行聚合；
texts.en: c.1. Designed to be capable of aggregation in configurations of 16 or more processors;
c.2. [Reserved];
Note 1:

texts.zh: 4A994.c仅适用于以未集成的“电子组件”形式装运时，“APP”不超过4A994.b限值的“电子组件”和可编程互连装置。本款不适用于因其设计性质而固有限定为用作4A994.k管制相关设备的“电子组件”。
texts.en: 4A994.c applies only to “electronic assemblies” and programmable interconnections with a “APP” not exceeding the limits in 4A994.b, when shipped as unintegrated “electronic assemblies”. It does not apply to “electronic assemblies” inherently limited by nature of their design for use as related equipment controlled by 4A994.k.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 4A994.c不管制为最大配置不超过4A994.b限值的产品或产品系列“专门设计”的任何“电子组件”。
texts.en: 4A994.c does not control any “electronic assembly” “specially designed” for a product or family of products whose maximum configuration does not exceed the limits of 4A994.b.

texts.zh: d. ［保留］；
texts.en: d. [Reserved];

texts.zh: e. ［保留］；
texts.en: e. [Reserved];

texts.zh: f. “调整峰值性能”（“APP”）大于或等于0.0128加权万亿次浮点运算/秒（WT）的“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备；
texts.en: f. Equipment for “signal processing” or “image enhancement” having an “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”) equal to or greater than 0.0128 Weighted TeraFLOPS WT;

texts.zh: g. ［保留］；
texts.en: g. [Reserved];

texts.zh: h. ［保留］；
texts.en: h. [Reserved];

texts.zh: i. 含有超过5A991限值的“终端接口设备”的设备；
texts.en: i. Equipment containing “terminal interface equipment” exceeding the limits in 5A991;

texts.zh: j. 为提供“数字计算机”或相关设备的外部互连、允许数据速率超过80 Mbyte/s的通信而“专门设计”的设备。
texts.en: j. Equipment “specially designed” to provide external interconnection of “digital computers” or associated equipment that allows communications at data rates exceeding 80 Mbyte/s.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 4A994.j不管制内部互连设备（例如背板、总线）、无源互连设备、“网络接入控制器”或“通信通道控制器”。
texts.en: 4A994.j does not control internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes, buses) passive interconnection equipment, “network access controllers” or “communication channel controllers”.

texts.zh: k. “混合计算机”、其“电子组件”以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”，含有同时具有以下全部特性的模数转换器：
texts.en: k. “Hybrid computers” and “electronic assemblies” and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor containing analog-to-digital converters having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: k.1. 32个或以上通道；以及
texts.en: k.1. 32 channels or more; and

texts.zh: k.2. 分辨率为14位（另加符号位）或以上，转换速率为200,000次转换/秒或以上。
texts.en: k.2. A resolution of 14 bit (plus sign bit) or more with a conversion rate of 200,000 conversions/s or more.

texts.zh: l. 其他未列明的计算机、“电子组件”和“部件”，含有集成电路且其中任一集成电路达到或超过ECCN 3A991.p的限值。
texts.en: l. Computers, “electronic assemblies,” and “components,” n.e.s., containing integrated circuits, any of which meets or exceeds the limit of ECCN 3A991.p.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就4A994.l而言，计算机包括“数字计算机”、“混合计算机”和模拟计算机。
texts.en: For the purposes of 4A994.l, computers include “digital computers,” “hybrid computers,” and analog computers.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就4E091而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 4E091:

texts.zh: 1. “参数”指训练期间学习得到的任何数值（例如网络权重、偏置等）。人工智能模型的“参数”也称模型权重。
texts.en: 1. 'Parameters' refers to any value learned during training (e.g., network weights, biases, etc.). 'Parameters' for an artificial intelligence model are also known as model weights.

texts.zh: 2. “运算”指预训练及任何后续训练（例如对预训练模型进行微调）所使用的数学运算，但不包括输入训练数据的收集和整理。训练“运算”应计入执行预训练和后续训练过程所有步骤所需的运算，包括所有相关层的前向传播和反向传播、池化及卷积所需的运算，不考虑具体实现方式和硬件限制，并适用于所有相关运算。例如，考虑一个由单个全连接层构成、具有I个输入神经元和O个输出神经元、无偏置并采用反向传播训练的模型。该模型共有N = I * O个学习参数。每次前向传播需要N次乘加运算，或（假设采用浮点运算）2N FLOP。每次反向传播需要2N次乘加运算，或4N FLOP。因此，每个训练数据点总共需要6N FLOP。在大小为D的数据集上训练需要总计6ND FLOP。
texts.en: 2. 'Operations' refers to mathematical operations used for pre-training and any subsequent training, such as fine-tuning the pre-trained model, but does not include the collection and curation of the input training data. Training 'operations' should account for operations required to perform all steps in the pre-training and subsequent training process, including those for forward and backward propagation for all relevant layers, pooling, and convolutions, regardless of the implementation and hardware limitations, and applied to all relevant operations. For example, consider a model composed of a single densely connected layer with I input neurons, O output neurons, and no biases being trained with backpropagation. Such a model would have a total of N = I * O learned parameters. Each forward pass would require N multiply accumulate operations, or (assuming floating point arithmetic) 2N FLOP. Each backward pass would require 2N multiply accumulate operations, or 4N FLOP. Then, in total, each training data point would require 6N FLOP. Training on a data set of size D would require 6ND total FLOP.

texts.zh: 3. 如果超过百分之十的“运算”涉及使用尚未按第734.7(a)条定义“公开”、且由单一数据生成模型生成的数据进行训练，则应计入该数据生成模型生成数据所使用的“运算”；如果该数据生成模型的“参数”尚未“公开”，还应计入训练该数据生成模型所使用的训练“运算”。单一数据生成模型包括同一模型的变体，例如不同检查点或经微调的变体。如果使用多个“参数”尚未“公开”的模型生成的数据用于超过百分之十的训练“运算”，则仅计入其中使用训练“运算”最多的数据生成模型的训练“运算”。任何实际训练“运算”不得重复计数；因此，如果数据生成模型A用于训练数据生成模型B和C，而模型B和C用于训练模型D，则训练A的运算仅向模型D的运算次数中加入一次。
texts.en: 3. If more than ten percent of the 'operations' involve training on data that was not “published” as defined in § 734.7(a) and was generated by a single data-generation model, then 'operations' the data-generation model used to generate the data should be counted, and if the data-generation model's 'parameters' were not “published,” then the training 'operations' used to train the data-generating model should be counted as well. A single data-generation model includes variants of the same model, such as different checkpoints or fine-tuned variants. If multiple models with 'parameters' that were not “published” were used to generate data used for more than ten percent of the training 'operations,' then only the training 'operations' of the data-generation model using the most training 'operations' should be counted. No actual training 'operation' should be counted more than once, so if data-generation model A is used to train data-generation model B and data-generation model C, and models B and C are used to train model D, then the operations to train A are only added to the number of operations for model D once.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 根据EAR第734.7条，4E091不管制已按第734.7(a)条定义“公开”的任何人工智能模型的“参数”。4E091也不管制从参数已“公开”的模型衍生的任何人工智能模型的“参数”，但该模型的衍生过程使用的额外训练“运算”超过2.5 × 10^{25}次“运算”或超过注2定义的训练“运算”的25%（以较高者为准）的除外。
texts.en: 1. In accordance with § 734.7 of the EAR, 4E091 does not control the 'parameters' of any artificial intelligence model that have been “published” as defined in § 734.7(a). 4E091 also does not control the 'parameters' of any artificial intelligence model derived from a model whose parameters have been 'published,' except where the model has been derived using additional training 'operations' that constitute more than 2.5 × 10^{25} 'operations' or more than 25 percent of the training 'operations' defined in Note 2, whichever is higher.

texts.zh: 2. 4E091不管制下述任何人工智能模型的“参数”：其训练所使用的“运算”少于按最高效的已“公开”人工智能模型训练方法、训练一个根据广泛使用的基准综合评估能力等同于已按EAR第734.7(a)条定义“公开”的最先进人工智能模型所需的运算次数。为确保该排除规定的确定性，所需“运算”次数不应因算法改进而减少。
texts.en: 2. 4E091 does not control the 'parameters' of any artificial intelligence model trained utilizing fewer 'operations' than the number needed, based on the most efficient “published” methods to train artificial intelligence models, to train an artificial intelligence model as capable, according to an aggregate of widely used benchmarks, as the most advanced artificial intelligence model that has been “published” as defined in § 734.7(a) of the EAR. To provide certainty for this exclusion, the number of 'operations' needed should not decrease with algorithmic improvements.

texts.zh: 2.a. 出口商可通过以下任一方式确定AI模型是否属于该排除范围：
texts.en: 2.a. An exporter may determine whether an AI model falls within this exclusion by either:

texts.zh: 2.a.1. 依据BIS公布的指引，或美国AI安全研究所和能源部出具的技术意见（如已公布此类意见）自行分类；或
texts.en: 2.a.1. Self classifying by relying on guidance published by BIS or technical opinions issued by the U.S. AI Safety Institute and the Department of Energy, should such opinions have been published, or

texts.zh: 2.a.2. 按照EAR第748.1条和第748.3条的程序向BIS提出分类请求。
texts.en: 2.a.2. A classification request to BIS in accordance with the procedures in §§ 748.1 and 748.3 of the EAR.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 测向“设备”（包括ECCN 5A001.e中的设备类型）及任何其他“受ITAR管辖”的军用或情报电子“设备”的管制，见USML第XI类。(2) 5A001.f及.h定义且受ITAR管辖的电子攻击和干扰“设备”的管制，见USML第XI(a)(4)(iii)类。(3) 将抗辐射加固集成电路装入ECCN 5A991所列或指定为EAR99的电信设备，这一行为本身并不使该电信设备达到ECCN 5A001.a.2款的指标。(4) 另见ECCN 5A101、5A980和5A991。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category XI for controls on direction-finding “equipment” including types of “equipment” in ECCN 5A001.e and any other military or intelligence electronic “equipment” that is “subject to the ITAR.” (2) See USML Category XI(a)(4)(iii) for controls on electronic attack and jamming “equipment” defined in 5A001.f and .h that are subject to the ITAR. (3) The act of incorporating a radiation hardened integrated circuit into telecommunications equipment that is specified under ECCN 5A991 or designated as EAR99 does not, in and of itself, cause the telecommunications equipment to meet the specifications of ECCN paragraph 5A001.a.2. (4) See also ECCNs 5A101, 5A980, and 5A991.

texts.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的任何类型电信设备：
texts.en: a. Any type of telecommunications equipment having any of the following characteristics, functions or features:

texts.zh: a.1. 为承受核爆炸引起的瞬态电子效应或电磁脉冲效应而“专门设计”；
texts.en: a.1. “Specially designed” to withstand transitory electronic effects or electromagnetic pulse effects, both arising from a nuclear explosion;

texts.zh: a.2. 经专门加固以承受伽马、中子或离子辐射；
texts.en: a.2. Specially hardened to withstand gamma, neutron or ion radiation;

texts.zh: a.3. 为在低于218 K（−55 °C）温度下运行而“专门设计”；或
texts.en: a.3. “Specially designed” to operate below 218 K (−55 °C); or

texts.zh: a.4. 为在高于397 K（124 °C）温度下运行而“专门设计”；
texts.en: a.4. “Specially designed” to operate above 397 K (124 °C);

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A001.a.3和5A001.a.4仅适用于电子设备。
texts.en: 5A001.a.3 and 5A001.a.4 apply only to electronic equipment.

texts.zh: b. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的电信系统和设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”和“附件”：
texts.en: b. Telecommunication systems and equipment, and “specially designed” “components” and “accessories” therefor, having any of the following characteristics, functions or features:

texts.zh: b.1. 具有下列任一特性的水下无缆通信系统：
texts.en: b.1 Being underwater untethered communications systems having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 声载波频率处于20 kHz至60 kHz范围之外；
texts.en: b.1.a. An acoustic carrier frequency outside the range from 20 kHz to 60 kHz;

texts.zh: b.1.b. 使用低于30 kHz的电磁载波频率；或
texts.en: b.1.b. Using an electromagnetic carrier frequency below 30 kHz; or

texts.zh: b.1.c. 使用电子波束操纵技术；或
texts.en: b.1.c. Using electronic beam steering techniques; or

texts.zh: b.1.d. 在“局域网”中使用输出波长大于400 nm且小于700 nm的“激光器”或发光二极管（LED）；
texts.en: b.1.d. Using “lasers” or light-emitting diodes (LEDs), with an output wavelength greater than 400 nm and less than 700 nm, in a “local area network”;

texts.zh: b.2. 工作在1.5 MHz至87.5 MHz频段且同时具有以下全部特性的无线电设备：
texts.en: b.2. Being radio equipment operating in the 1.5 MHz to 87.5 MHz band and having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 自动预测和选择每通道的频率及“总数字传输速率”以优化传输；以及
texts.en: b.2.a.. Automatically predicting and selecting frequencies and “total digital transfer rates” per channel to optimize the transmission; and

texts.zh: b.2.b. 采用线性功率放大器配置，能够在一个倍频程或以上的“瞬时带宽”内，同时支持多个信号；在1.5 MHz或以上但低于30 MHz的频率范围内输出功率为1 kW或以上，或在30 MHz或以上但不超过87.5 MHz的频率范围内输出功率为250 W或以上；且输出谐波及失真含量优于−80 dB；
texts.en: b.2.b. Incorporating a linear power amplifier configuration having a capability to support multiple signals simultaneously at an output power of 1 kW or more in the frequency range of 1.5 MHz or more but less than 30 MHz, or 250 W or more in the frequency range of 30 MHz or more but not exceeding 87.5 MHz, over an “instantaneous bandwidth” of one octave or more and with an output harmonic and distortion content of better than −80 dB;

texts.zh: b.3. 采用“扩频”技术（包括“跳频”技术）、不受5A001.b.4管制且具有下列任一特性的无线电设备：
texts.en: b.3. Being radio equipment employing “spread spectrum” techniques, including “frequency hopping” techniques, not controlled in 5A001.b.4 and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.3.a. 用户可编程扩频码；或
texts.en: b.3.a. User programmable spreading codes; or

texts.zh: b.3.b. 总发射带宽为任一信息通道带宽的100倍或以上，且超过50 kHz；
texts.en: b.3.b. A total transmitted bandwidth which is 100 or more times the bandwidth of any one information channel and in excess of 50 kHz;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A001.b.3.b不管制为与下列任一系统或设备配合使用而“专门设计”的无线电设备：
texts.en: 5A001.b.3.b does not control radio equipment “specially designed” for use with any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 民用蜂窝无线电通信系统；或
texts.en: a. Civil cellular radio-communications systems; or

texts.zh: b. 商业民用电信的固定或移动卫星地面站。
texts.en: b. Fixed or mobile satellite Earth stations for commercial civil telecommunications.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A001.b.3不管制工作输出功率为1 W或以下的设备。
texts.en: 5A001.b.3 does not control equipment operating at an output power of 1 W or less.

texts.zh: b.4. 采用超宽带调制技术，具有用户可编程信道化码、扰码或网络识别码，且具有下列任一特性的无线电设备：
texts.en: b.4. Being radio equipment employing ultra-wideband modulation techniques, having user programmable channelizing codes, scrambling codes, or network identification codes and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.4.a. 带宽超过500 MHz；或
texts.en: b.4.a. A bandwidth exceeding 500 MHz; or

texts.zh: b.4.b. “相对带宽”为20%或以上；
texts.en: b.4.b. A “fractional bandwidth” of 20% or more;

texts.zh: b.5. 同时具有以下全部特性的数字控制无线电接收机：
texts.en: b.5. Being digitally controlled radio receivers having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.5.a. 超过1,000个通道；
texts.en: b.5.a. More than 1,000 channels;

texts.zh: b.5.b. “信道切换时间”小于1 ms；
texts.en: b.5.b. A 'channel switching time' of less than 1 ms;

texts.zh: b.5.c. 自动搜索或扫描部分电磁频谱；以及
texts.en: b.5.c. Automatic searching or scanning of a part of the electromagnetic spectrum; and

texts.zh: b.5.d. 识别接收信号或发射机类型；或
texts.en: b.5.d. Identification of the received signals or the type of transmitter; or

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A001.b.5不管制为与民用蜂窝无线电通信系统配合使用而“专门设计”的无线电设备。
texts.en: 5A001.b.5 does not control radio equipment “specially designed” for use with civil cellular radio-communications systems.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A001.b.5.b而言，“信道切换时间”是从一个接收频率切换到另一个接收频率，达到最终规定接收频率或其±0.05%以内所需的时间（即延迟）。规定频率范围小于中心频率±0.05%的物项，被定义为不具备信道频率切换能力。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A001.b.5.b, 'channel switching time' means the time (i.e., delay) to change from one receiving frequency to another, to arrive at or within ±0.05% of the final specified receiving frequency. Items having a specified frequency range of less than ±0.05% around their center frequency are defined to be incapable of channel frequency switching.

texts.zh: b.6. 采用数字“信号处理”功能，以低于700 bit/s的速率提供“语音编码”输出。
texts.en: b.6. Employing functions of digital “signal processing” to provide 'voice coding' output at rates of less than 700 bit/s.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 对于可变速率“语音编码”，5A001.b.6适用于连续语音的“语音编码”输出。
texts.en: 1. For variable rate 'voice coding', 5A001.b.6 applies to the 'voice coding' output of continuous speech.

texts.zh: 2. 就5A001.b.6而言，“语音编码”是对人类语音进行采样，然后考虑人类语音特定特征，将这些人类语音样本转换为数字信号的技术。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 5A001.b.6, 'voice coding' is defined as the technique to take samples of human voice and then convert these samples of human voice into a digital signal taking into account specific characteristics of human speech.

texts.zh: c. 长度超过500 m，且制造商规定能够承受2 × 10^{9} N/m^{2}或以上“验证试验”拉伸应力的光纤；
texts.en: c. Optical fibers of more than 500 m in length and specified by the manufacturer as being capable of withstanding a 'proof test' tensile stress of 2 × 10^{9} N/m^{2} or more;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 水下脐带缆见8A002.a.3。
texts.en: For underwater umbilical cables, see 8A002.a.3.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A001.c而言，“验证试验”是在线或离线生产筛选测试：光纤以2至5 m/s的运行速度通过直径约150 mm的绞盘时，对0.5至3 m长度的光纤动态施加规定拉伸应力。环境温度标称值为293 K（20 °C），相对湿度为40%。可采用等效国家标准实施验证试验。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A001.c, 'proof test' is the on-line or off-line production screen testing that dynamically applies a prescribed tensile stress over a 0.5 to 3 m length of fiber at a running rate of 2 to 5 m/s while passing between capstans approximately 150 mm in diameter. The ambient temperature is a nominal 293 K (20 °C) and relative humidity 40%. Equivalent national standards may be used for executing the proof test.

texts.zh: d. 下列“电子可操纵相控阵天线”：
texts.en: d. “Electronically steerable phased array antennae” as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 额定工作频率高于31.8 GHz但不超过57 GHz，且有效辐射功率（ERP）大于或等于+20 dBm（有效全向辐射功率〔EIRP〕为22.15 dBm）；
texts.en: d.1. Rated for operation above 31.8 GHz, but not exceeding 57 GHz, and having an Effective Radiated Power (ERP) equal to or greater than +20 dBm (22.15 dBm Effective Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP));

texts.zh: d.2. 额定工作频率高于57 GHz但不超过66 GHz，且ERP大于或等于+24 dBm（EIRP为26.15 dBm）；
texts.en: d.2. Rated for operation above 57 GHz, but not exceeding 66 GHz, and having an ERP equal to or greater than +24 dBm (26.15 dBm EIRP);

texts.zh: d.3. 额定工作频率高于66 GHz但不超过90 GHz，且ERP大于或等于+20 dBm（EIRP为22.15 dBm）；
texts.en: d.3. Rated for operation above 66 GHz, but not exceeding 90 GHz, and having an ERP equal to or greater than +20 dBm (22.15 dBm EIRP);

texts.zh: d.4. 额定工作频率高于90 GHz；
texts.en: d.4. Rated for operation above 90 GHz;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 5A001.d不管制用于仪表符合ICAO微波着陆系统（MLS）标准的着陆系统的“电子可操纵相控阵天线”。
texts.en: 5A001.d does not control 'electronically steerable phased array antennae' for landing systems with instruments meeting ICAO standards covering Microwave Landing Systems (MLS).
Note 2:

texts.zh: 5A001.d不适用于为下列任一用途而“专门设计”的天线：
texts.en: 5A001.d does not apply to antennae “specially designed” for any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 民用蜂窝或WLAN无线电通信系统；
texts.en: a. Civil cellular or WLAN radio-communications systems;

texts.zh: b. IEEE 802.15或无线HDMI；或
texts.en: b. IEEE 802.15 or wireless HDMI; or

texts.zh: c. 商业民用电信的固定或移动卫星地面站。
texts.en: c. Fixed or mobile satellite earth stations for commercial civil telecommunications.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A001.d而言，“电子可操纵相控阵天线”是通过相位耦合形成波束（即波束方向由辐射单元的复数激励系数控制），且可通过施加电信号在发射和接收时改变波束方位角或俯仰角或两者的天线。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A001.d, 'electronically steerable phased array antenna' is an antenna which forms a beam by means of phase coupling, (i.e., the beam direction is controlled by the complex excitation coefficients of the radiating elements) and the direction of that beam can be varied (both in transmission and reception) in azimuth or in elevation, or both, by application of an electrical signal.

texts.zh: e. 工作频率高于30 MHz且同时具有以下全部特性的无线电测向设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: e. Radio direction finding equipment operating at frequencies above 30 MHz and having all of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

texts.zh: e.1. “瞬时带宽”为10 MHz或以上；以及
texts.en: e.1. “Instantaneous bandwidth” of 10 MHz or more; and

texts.zh: e.2. 能够对信号持续时间小于1 ms的非合作无线电发射机确定方位线（LOB）；
texts.en: e.2. Capable of finding a Line Of Bearing (LOB) to non-cooperating radio transmitters with a signal duration of less than 1 ms;

texts.zh: f. 下列移动电信截获或干扰设备及其监测设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: f. Mobile telecommunications interception or jamming equipment, and monitoring equipment therefor, as follows, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

texts.zh: f.1. 为提取通过空中接口传输的语音或数据而设计的截获设备；
texts.en: f.1. Interception equipment designed for the extraction of voice or data, transmitted over the air interface;

texts.zh: f.2. 5A001.f.1未列明、为提取通过空中接口传输的客户端设备或用户标识符（例如IMSI、TIMSI或IMEI）、信令或其他元数据而设计的截获设备；
texts.en: f.2. Interception equipment not specified in 5A001.f.1, designed for the extraction of client device or subscriber identifiers (e.g., IMSI, TIMSI or IMEI), signaling, or other metadata transmitted over the air interface;

texts.zh: f.3. 为故意且有选择地干扰、拒止、抑制、降低或诱骗移动电信服务而“专门设计”或改装，并执行下列任一功能的干扰设备：
texts.en: f.3. Jamming equipment “specially designed” or modified to intentionally and selectively interfere with, deny, inhibit, degrade or seduce mobile telecommunication services and performing any of the following:

texts.zh: f.3.a. 模拟无线接入网络（RAN）设备的功能；
texts.en: f.3.a. Simulate the functions of Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment;

texts.zh: f.3.b. 检测并利用所采用移动电信协议（例如GSM）的特定特征；或
texts.en: f.3.b. Detect and exploit specific characteristics of the mobile telecommunications protocol employed (e.g., GSM); or

texts.zh: f.3.c. 利用所采用移动电信协议（例如GSM）的特定特征；
texts.en: f.3.c. Exploit specific characteristics of the mobile telecommunications protocol employed (e.g., GSM);

texts.zh: f.4. 为识别5A001.f.1、5A001.f.2或5A001.f.3所列物项运行而设计或改装的射频（RF）监测设备。
texts.en: f.4. Radio Frequency (RF) monitoring equipment designed or modified to identify the operation of items specified in 5A001.f.1, 5A001.f.2 or 5A001.f.3.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A001.f.1和5A001.f.2不适用于下列任一设备：
texts.en: 5A001.f.1 and 5A001.f.2 do not apply to any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 为截获模拟专用移动无线电（PMR）、IEEE 802.11 WLAN而“专门设计”的设备；
texts.en: a. Equipment “specially designed” for the interception of analog Private Mobile Radio (PMR), IEEE 802.11 WLAN;

texts.zh: b. 为移动电信网络运营商设计的设备；或
texts.en: b. Equipment designed for mobile telecommunications network operators; or

texts.zh: c. 为“开发”或“生产”移动电信设备或系统设计的设备。
texts.en: c. Equipment designed for the “development” or “production” of mobile telecommunications equipment or systems.

texts.zh: 特别提示1：
另见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第120至130部分）。5A001.f.1所列物项（包括此前由5A001.i列明的物项），另见5A980及《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
texts.en: See also the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130). For items specified by 5A001.f.1 (including as previously specified by 5A001.i), see also 5A980 and the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).

texts.zh: 特别提示2：
无线电接收机见5A001.b.5。
texts.en: For radio receivers see 5A001.b.5.

texts.zh: g. 为通过测量非雷达发射机产生的环境射频辐射反射来探测和跟踪移动目标而“专门设计”的无源相干定位（PCL）系统或设备。
texts.en: g. Passive Coherent Location (PCL) systems or equipment, “specially designed” for detecting and tracking moving objects by measuring reflections of ambient radio frequency emissions, supplied by non-radar transmitters.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A001.g而言，非雷达发射机可包括商业无线电、电视或蜂窝电信基站。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A001.g, non-radar transmitters may include commercial radio, television or cellular telecommunications base stations.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A001.g不管制：
texts.en: 5A001.g. does not control:

texts.zh: a. 射电天文设备；或
texts.en: a. Radio-astronomical equipment; or

texts.zh: b. 需要目标发出任何无线电信号的系统或设备。
texts.en: b. Systems or equipment, that require any radio transmission from the target.

texts.zh: h. 下列反简易爆炸装置（IED）设备及相关设备：
texts.en: h. Counter Improvised Explosive Device (IED) equipment and related equipment, as follows:

texts.zh: h.1. 未由5A001.f列明、为提前引爆或阻止引爆简易爆炸装置（IED）而设计或改装的射频（RF）发射设备；
texts.en: h.1. Radio Frequency (RF) transmitting equipment, not specified by 5A001.f, designed or modified for prematurely activating or preventing the initiation of Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs);

texts.zh: h.2. 采用相关技术，以实现在与同址5A001.h.1所列设备正在发射的相同频率信道上进行无线电通信的设备。
texts.en: h.2. Equipment using techniques designed to enable radio communications in the same frequency channels on which co-located equipment specified by 5A001.h.1 is transmitting.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 另见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第120至130部分）第XI类。
texts.en: See also Category XI of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130).

texts.zh: i. [保留]
texts.en: i. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 此前由5A001.i列明的物项，见5A001.f.1。
texts.en: See 5A001.f.1 for items previously specified by 5A001.i.

texts.zh: j. 同时具有以下全部特性的IP网络通信监视系统或设备，以及为其“专门设计”的部件：
texts.en: j. IP network communications surveillance systems or equipment, and “specially designed” components therefor, having all of the following:

texts.zh: j.1. 在运营商级IP网络（例如国家级IP骨干网）上执行以下全部操作：
texts.en: j.1. Performing all of the following on a carrier class IP network (e.g., national grade IP backbone):

texts.zh: j.1.a. 应用层分析（例如开放系统互连〔OSI〕模型〔ISO/IEC 7498-1〕的第7层）；
texts.en: j.1.a. Analysis at the application layer (e.g., Layer 7 of Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model (ISO/IEC 7498-1));

texts.zh: j.1.b. 提取选定元数据和应用内容（例如语音、视频、消息、附件）；以及
texts.en: j.1.b. Extraction of selected metadata and application content (e.g., voice, video, messages, attachments); and

texts.zh: j.1.c. 对提取数据建立索引；以及
texts.en: j.1.c. Indexing of extracted data; and

texts.zh: j.2. 为执行以下全部操作而“专门设计”：

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) “异步传输模式”（“ATM”）是将信息组织成信元的传输模式；其异步性体现在信元的重复出现取决于所需或瞬时比特率。(2) “一个话音信道的带宽”是指按CCITT建议G.151定义、设计为在一个3,100 Hz话音信道内工作的数据通信设备。(3) “通信通道控制器”是控制同步或异步数字信息流的物理接口，是可集成到计算机或电信设备中以提供通信接入的组件。(4) “数据报”是自包含的独立数据实体，携带足够的信息，使其可从源数据终端设备路由至目的数据终端设备，而不依赖此前该源、目的数据终端设备与传输网络之间的交互。(5) “快速选择”是适用于虚呼叫的一项功能，允许数据终端设备扩大在呼叫建立和拆除“分组”中传输数据的能力，超出虚呼叫的基本能力。(6) “网关”是由设备和“软件”的任意组合实现的一种功能，用于将一个系统中表示、处理或传送信息的约定，转换为另一系统中相应但不同的约定。(7) “综合业务数字网”（ISDN）是统一的端到端数字网络，其中源自所有通信类型（例如语音、文本、数据、静态及动态图像）的数据，从交换机中的一个端口（终端）经一条接入线与用户双向传输。(8) “分组”是作为一个整体交换的一组二进制数字，包括数据和呼叫控制信号。数据、呼叫控制信号以及可能的差错控制信息按规定格式排列。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Asynchronous transfer mode” (“ATM”) is a transfer mode in which the information is organized into cells; it is asynchronous in the sense that the recurrence of cells depends on the required or instantaneous bit rate. (2) “Bandwidth of one voice channel” is data communication equipment designed to operate in one voice channel of 3,100 Hz, as defined in CCITT Recommendation G.151. (3) “Communications channel controller” is the physical interface that controls the flow of synchronous or asynchronous digital information. It is an assembly that can be integrated into computer or telecommunications equipment to provide communications access. (4) “Datagram” is a self-contained, independent entity of data carrying sufficient information to be routed from the source to the destination data terminal equipment without reliance on earlier exchanges between this source and destination data terminal equipment and the transporting network. (5) “Fast select” is a facility applicable to virtual calls that allows data terminal equipment to expand the possibility to transmit data in call set-up and clearing “packets” beyond the basic capabilities of a virtual call. (6) “Gateway” is the function, realized by any combination of equipment and “software”, to carry out the conversion of conventions for representing, processing or communicating information used on one system into the corresponding, but different conventions used in another system. (7) “Integrated Services Digital Network” (ISDN) is a unified end-to-end digital network, in which data originating from all types of communication (e.g., voice, text, data, still and moving pictures) are transmitted from one port (terminal) in the exchange (switch) over one access line to and from the subscriber. (8) “Packet” is a group of binary digits including data and call control signals that is switched as a composite whole. The data, call control signals, and possible error control information are arranged in a specified format.

texts.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 频率不超过960 MHz；或
texts.en: a.1. Not exceeding 960 MHz; or

texts.zh: a.2. “总数字传输速率”不超过8.5 Mbit/s；以及
texts.en: a.2. With a “total digital transfer rate” not exceeding 8.5 Mbit/s; and

texts.zh: b. “频谱效率”不超过4 bit/s/Hz。
texts.en: b. Having a “spectral efficiency” not exceeding 4 bit/s/Hz.

texts.zh: c. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的“存储程序控制”交换设备及相关信令系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“部件”和“附件”：
texts.en: c. “Stored program controlled” switching equipment and related signaling systems, having any of the following characteristics, functions or features, and “specially designed” “parts,” “components” and “accessories” therefor:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 具有数字输入和数字输出、并提供交换功能的统计复用器，视为“存储程序控制”交换机。
texts.en: Statistical multiplexers with digital input and digital output which provide switching are treated as “stored program controlled” switches.

texts.zh: c.1. 为“分组模式操作”设计的“数据（报文）交换”设备或系统，以及其他未列明的相关“零件”、电子组件和“部件”。
texts.en: c.1. “Data (message) switching” equipment or systems designed for “packet-mode operation” and “parts,” electronic assemblies and “components” therefor, n.e.s.
c.2. [Reserved]

texts.zh: c.3. “数据报”分组的路由或交换；
texts.en: c.3. Routing or switching of “datagram” packets;
c.4. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A991.c.3中的限制不适用于仅限使用“网络接入控制器”的网络，也不适用于“网络接入控制器”本身。
texts.en: The restrictions in 5A991.c.3 do not apply to networks restricted to using only “network access controllers” or to “network access controllers” themselves.

texts.zh: c.5. 电路交换的多级优先和抢占；
texts.en: c.5. Multi-level priority and pre-emption for circuit switching;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A991.c.5不管制单级呼叫抢占。
texts.en: 5A991.c.5 does not control single-level call preemption.

texts.zh: c.6. 设计为可将蜂窝无线电呼叫自动切换至其他蜂窝交换机，或自动连接至由多个交换机共用的集中式用户数据库；
texts.en: c.6. Designed for automatic hand-off of cellular radio calls to other cellular switches or automatic connection to a centralized subscriber data base common to more than one switch;

texts.zh: c.7. 含有每端口“数字传输速率”超过8.5 Mbit/s的“存储程序控制”数字交叉连接设备。
texts.en: c.7. Containing “stored program controlled” digital cross connect equipment with “digital transfer rate” exceeding 8.5 Mbit/s per port.

texts.zh: c.8. 在非关联或准关联模式下运行的“公共信道信令”；
texts.en: c.8. “Common channel signaling” operating in either non-associated or quasi-associated mode of operation;

texts.zh: c.9. “动态自适应路由”；
texts.en: c.9. “Dynamic adaptive routing”;

texts.zh: c.10. 端口或线路超过下列任一指标的分组交换机、电路交换机和路由器：
texts.en: c.10. Being packet switches, circuit switches and routers with ports or lines exceeding any of the following:

texts.zh: c.10.a. “通信通道控制器”的每通道“数据信号速率”为64,000 bit/s；或
texts.en: c.10.a. A “data signaling rate” of 64,000 bit/s per channel for a “communications channel controller”; or

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A991.c.10.a不管制仅由各自不受5A991.b.1管制的通信通道组成的复用复合链路。
texts.en: 5A991.c.10.a does not control multiplex composite links composed only of communication channels not individually controlled by 5A991.b.1.

texts.zh: c.10.b. “网络接入控制器”及相关公共介质的“数字传输速率”为33 Mbit/s；
texts.en: c.10.b. A “digital transfer rate” of 33 Mbit/s for a “network access controller” and related common media;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A991.c.10不管制端口或线路不超过5A991.c.10限值的分组交换机或路由器。
texts.en: 5A991.c.10 does not control packet switches or routers with ports or lines not exceeding the limits in 5A991.c.10.
c.11. “Optical switching”;

texts.zh: c.12. 采用“异步传输模式”（“ATM”）技术。
texts.en: c.12. Employing “Asynchronous Transfer Mode” (“ATM”) techniques.

texts.zh: d. 长度超过50 m、为单模运行设计的光纤和光缆；
texts.en: d. Optical fibers and optical fiber cables of more than 50 m in length designed for single mode operation;

texts.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的集中式网络控制：
texts.en: e. Centralized network control having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: e.1. 从节点接收数据；以及
texts.en: e.1. Receives data from the nodes; and

texts.zh: e.2. 处理这些数据，以在无需操作员决策的情况下控制业务流量，从而执行“动态自适应路由”；
texts.en: e.2. Process these data in order to provide control of traffic not requiring operator decisions, and thereby performing “dynamic adaptive routing”;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 5A991.e不排除根据可预测的统计业务流量条件进行的流量控制。
texts.en: 5A991.e does not preclude control of traffic as a function of predictable statistical traffic conditions.

texts.zh: f. 工作频率高于10.5 GHz，含有有源单元和分布式“零件”或“部件”，且设计为可对波束成形和指向进行电子控制的相控阵天线，但仪表符合国际民用航空组织（ICAO）标准的着陆系统（微波着陆系统〔MLS〕）除外。
texts.en: f. Phased array antennas, operating above 10.5 GHz, containing active elements and distributed “parts” or “components,” and designed to permit electronic control of beam shaping and pointing, except for landing systems with instruments meeting International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards (microwave landing systems (MLS)).

texts.zh: g. 其他未列明的移动通信设备及其“零件”、电子组件和“部件”；或
texts.en: g. Mobile communications equipment, n.e.s., and “parts,” electronic assemblies and “components” therefor; or

texts.zh: h. 为在大于或等于19.7 GHz的频率下使用而设计的无线电中继通信设备，以及其他未列明的相关“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: h. Radio relay communications equipment designed for use at frequencies equal to or exceeding 19.7 GHz and “parts” and “components” therefor, n.e.s.

texts.zh: e. 5D001.a或5D001.c所列以外、为执法监控或分析而“专门设计”或改装，且提供以下全部功能的“软件”：
texts.en: e. “Software”, other than that specified by 5D001.a or 5D001.c, “specially designed” or modified for monitoring or analysis by law enforcement, providing all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 依据“硬选择标识符”，对通过“交付接口”从通信服务提供商获取的通信内容或元数据执行搜索；以及
texts.en: e.1. Execution of searches on the basis of “hard selectors” of either the content of communication or metadata acquired from a communications service provider using a 'handover interface'; and

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就5D001.e而言，“交付接口”是为经授权执法机关使用而设计的物理和逻辑接口，经此接口向通信服务提供商请求定向截获措施，并由通信服务提供商向请求机关交付截获结果。“交付接口”在接收和验证截获请求的系统或设备（例如中介设备）中实现，并仅向请求机关交付符合已验证请求的截获结果。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 5D001.e, a 'handover interface' is a physical and logical interface, designed for use by an authorised law enforcement authority, across which targeted interception measures are requested from a communications service provider and the results of interception are delivered from a communications service provider to the requesting authority. The 'handover interface' is implemented within systems or equipment (e.g., mediation devices) that receive and validate the interception request, and deliver to the requesting authority only the results of interception that fulfil the validated request.

texts.zh: 2. “交付接口”可由国际标准（包括但不限于ETSI TS 101 331、ETSI TS 101 671、3GPP TS 33.108）或等效国家标准规定。
texts.en: 2. 'Handover interfaces' may be specified by international standards (including but not limited to ETSI TS 101 331, ETSI TS 101 671, 3GPP TS 33.108) or national equivalents.

texts.zh: e.2. 根据对通信内容或元数据的搜索结果，或5D001.e.1所述搜索结果，绘制目标个人的关系网络或跟踪其移动。
texts.en: e.2. Mapping of the relational network or tracking the movement of targeted individuals based on the results of searches on content of communication or metadata or searches as described in 5D001.e.1.

texts.zh: 注：5D001.e不适用于为下列任一用途而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”：
texts.en: Note: 5D001.e does not apply to “software” “specially designed” or modified for any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 计费用途；
texts.en: a. Billing purposes;

texts.zh: b. 网络服务质量（QoS）；
texts.en: b. Network Quality of Service (QoS);

texts.zh: d. 中介设备；或
texts.en: d. Mediation devices; or

texts.zh: e. 移动支付或银行业务用途。
texts.en: e. Mobile payment or banking use.

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) “同步数字体系”（SDH）是一种数字体系，通过在不同类型介质上使用同步传输格式，提供管理、复用和接入各种形式数字业务的手段。该格式以CCITT建议G.703、G.707、G.708、G.709及其他尚待发布的建议所定义的同步传送模块（STM）为基础。“SDH”的第一级速率为155.52 Mbits/s。(2) “同步光网络”（SONET）是一种通过在光纤上使用同步传输格式，提供管理、复用和接入各种形式数字业务手段的网络。该格式为“SDH”的北美版本，也使用同步传送模块（STM）。但其采用同步传送信号（STS）作为基本传送模块，第一级速率为51.81 Mbits/s。SONET标准正在并入“SDH”标准。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Synchronous digital hierarchy” (SDH) is a digital hierarchy providing a means to manage, multiplex, and access various forms of digital traffic using a synchronous transmission format on different types of media. The format is based on the Synchronous Transport Module (STM) that is defined by CCITT Recommendation G.703, G.707, G.708, G.709 and others yet to be published. The first level rate of ‘SDH’ is 155.52 Mbits/s. (2) ‘Synchronous optical network’ (SONET) is a network providing a means to manage, multiplex and access various forms of digital traffic using a synchronous transmission format on fiber optics. The format is the North America version of ‘SDH’ and also uses the Synchronous Transport Module (STM). However, it uses the Synchronous Transport Signal (STS) as the basic transport module with a first level rate of 51.81 Mbits/s. The SONET standards are being integrated into those of ‘SDH’.

texts.en: List of Items Controlled

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) ECCN 5A002.a管制提供“信息安全”所需手段或功能的“部件”。所有此类“部件”均推定为“专门设计”，并受5A002.a管制。(2) 5A002.d或.e所述且“受ITAR管辖”的系统、设备和部件的管制，见USML第XI类（包括XI(b)）及第XIII(b)类（包括XIII(b)(2)）（见22 CFR第120至130部分）。(3) 含有或使用解密的“卫星导航系统”接收设备见7A005；相关解密“软件”和“技术”见7D005和7E001。(4) 应注意，物项可能受CCL其他条目管制；不受ECCN 5A002.a.4管制的物项示例如下：(a) 一辆汽车，其唯一采用“所述安全算法”的“数据保密密码功能”由车内安装、符合第5类第2部分注3条件的移动电话执行。在此情形下，安全电话通信支持汽车的一项非主要功能，但该移动电话（设备）作为独立物项，因《密码说明》（注3）将其排除而不受ECCN 5A002管制（见ECCN 5A992.c）。(b) 一辆嵌入符合第5类第2部分注3条件的网页浏览器的健身自行车，其唯一受管制密码功能由网页浏览器执行。在此情形下，安全网页浏览支持健身自行车的一项非主要功能，但网页浏览器（“软件”）作为独立物项，因《密码说明》（注3）将其排除而不受ECCN 5D002管制（见ECCN 5D992.c）。(5) 按EAR第740.17(b)条完成分类或自行分类后，符合资格要求的大众市场加密商品解除“EI”和“NS”管制。这些商品归为5A992.c。(6) 另见ECCN 3A090和4A090。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) ECCN 5A002.a controls “components” providing the means or functions necessary for “information security.” All such “components” are presumptively “specially designed” and controlled by 5A002.a. (2) See USML Categories XI (including XI(b)) and XIII(b) (including XIII(b)(2)) for controls on systems, equipment, and components described in 5A002.d or .e that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (3) For “satellite navigation system” receiving equipment containing or employing decryption see 7A005, and for related decryption “software” and “technology” see 7D005 and 7E001. (4) Noting that items may be controlled elsewhere on the CCL, examples of items not controlled by ECCN 5A002.a.4 include the following: (a) An automobile where the only 'cryptography for data confidentiality' having a 'described security algorithm' is performed by a Category 5—Part 2 Note 3 eligible mobile telephone that is built into the car. In this case, secure phone communications support a non-primary function of the automobile but the mobile telephone (equipment), as a standalone item, is not controlled by ECCN 5A002 because it is excluded by the Cryptography Note (Note 3) (See ECCN 5A992.c). (b) An exercise bike with an embedded Category 5—Part 2 Note 3 eligible web browser, where the only controlled cryptography is performed by the web browser. In this case, secure web browsing supports a non-primary function of the exercise bike but the web browser (“software”), as a standalone item, is not controlled by ECCN 5D002 because it is excluded by the Cryptography Note (Note 3) (See ECCN 5D992.c). (5) After classification or self-classification in accordance with § 740.17(b) of the EAR, mass market encryption commodities that meet eligibility requirements are released from “EI” and “NS” controls. These commodities are designated 5A992.c. (6) See also ECCNs 3A090 and 4A090.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 设计或改装为使用采用“所述安全算法”的“数据保密密码功能”，且该密码能力可用、已激活，或可通过安全“密码激活”以外的任何方式激活的下列物项：
texts.en: a. Designed or modified to use 'cryptography for data confidentiality' having a 'described security algorithm', where that cryptographic capability is usable, has been activated, or can be activated by any means other than secure “cryptographic activation”, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 以“信息安全”为主要功能的物项；
texts.en: a.1. Items having “information security” as a primary function;

texts.zh: a.2. 5A002.a.1款未列明的数字通信或联网系统、设备或部件；
texts.en: a.2. Digital communication or networking systems, equipment or components, not specified in paragraph 5A002.a.1;

texts.zh: a.3. 5A002.a.1或.a.2款未列明的计算机、以信息存储或处理为主要功能的其他物项及其部件；
texts.en: a.3. Computers, other items having information storage or processing as a primary function, and components therefor, not specified in paragraphs 5A002.a.1 or .a.2;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 操作系统另见5D002.a.1和.c.1。
texts.en: For operating systems see also 5D002.a.1 and .c.1.

texts.zh: a.4. 5A002.a.1至a.3款未列明，且其中采用“所述安全算法”的“数据保密密码功能”同时满足以下全部条件的物项：
texts.en: a.4. Items, not specified in paragraphs 5A002.a.1 to a.3, where the 'cryptography for data confidentiality' having a 'described security algorithm' meets all of the following:

texts.zh: a.4.a. 支持该物项的一项非主要功能；以及
texts.en: a.4.a. It supports a non-primary function of the item; and

texts.zh: a.4.b. 由所集成的设备或“软件”执行，且该设备或“软件”作为独立物项时将由ECCN 5A002、5A003、5A004、5B002或5D002列明。
texts.en: a.4.b. It is performed by incorporated equipment or “software” that would, as a standalone item, be specified by ECCNs 5A002, 5A003, 5A004, 5B002 or 5D002.

texts.zh: a.4款特别提示：
texts.en: N.B. to paragraph a.4:

texts.zh: 不受5A002.a.4管制物项的示例，见本ECCN 5A002“相关管制”第(4)段。
texts.en: See Related Control Paragraph (4) of this ECCN 5A002 for examples of items not controlled by 5A002.a.4.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就5A002.a而言，“数据保密密码功能”是指采用数字技术，且执行下列任一功能以外的任何密码功能的“密码技术”：
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 5A002.a, 'cryptography for data confidentiality' means “cryptography” that employs digital techniques and performs any cryptographic function other than any of the following:

texts.zh: 1.a. “身份鉴别”；
texts.en: 1.a. “Authentication;”

texts.zh: 1.b. 数字签名；
texts.en: 1.b. Digital signature;

texts.zh: 1.c. 数据完整性；
texts.en: 1.c. Data integrity;

texts.zh: 1.d. 不可否认性；
texts.en: 1.d. Non-repudiation;

texts.zh: 1.e. 数字版权管理，包括执行受复制保护的“软件”；
texts.en: 1.e. Digital rights management, including the execution of copy-protected “software;”

texts.zh: 1.f. 支持娱乐、大众商业广播或医疗记录管理的加密或解密；或
texts.en: 1.f. Encryption or decryption in support of entertainment, mass commercial broadcasts or medical records management; or

texts.zh: 1.g. 支持本技术说明第1段1.a至1.f款所述任一功能的密钥管理。
texts.en: 1.g. Key management in support of any function described in paragraphs 1.a to 1.f of this Technical Note paragraph 1.

texts.zh: 2. 就5A002.a而言，“所述安全算法”指下列任一算法：
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 5A002.a, 'described security algorithm' means any of the following:

texts.zh: 2.a. 密钥长度超过56位（不包括奇偶校验位）的“对称算法”；
texts.en: 2.a. A “symmetric algorithm” employing a key length in excess of 56 bits, not including parity bits;

texts.zh: 2.b. 算法安全性基于下列任一问题的“非对称算法”：
texts.en: 2.b. An “asymmetric algorithm” where the security of the algorithm is based on any of the following:

texts.zh: 2.b.1. 对超过512位的整数进行因数分解（例如RSA）；
texts.en: 2.b.1. Factorization of integers in excess of 512 bits (e.g., RSA);

texts.zh: 2.b.2. 在规模大于512位的有限域乘法群中计算离散对数（例如Z/pZ上的Diffie-Hellman）；或
texts.en: 2.b.2. Computation of discrete logarithms in a multiplicative group of a finite field of size greater than 512 bits (e.g., Diffie-Hellman over Z/pZ); or

texts.zh: 2.b.3. 在本技术说明2.b.2款所述以外的群中计算超过112位的离散对数（例如椭圆曲线上的Diffie-Hellman）；或
texts.en: 2.b.3. Discrete logarithms in a group other than mentioned in paragraph 2.b.2 of this Technical Note in excess of 112 bits (e.g., Diffie-Hellman over an elliptic curve); or

texts.zh: 2.c. 算法安全性基于下列任一问题的“非对称算法”：
texts.en: 2.c. An “asymmetric algorithm” where the security of the algorithm is based on any of the following:

texts.zh: 2.c.1. 与格有关的最短向量或最近向量问题（例如NewHope、Frodo、NTRUEncrypt、Kyber、Titanium）；
texts.en: 2.c.1. Shortest vector or closest vector problems associated with lattices (e.g., NewHope, Frodo, NTRUEncrypt, Kyber, Titanium);

texts.zh: 2.c.2. 寻找超奇异椭圆曲线之间的同源映射（例如超奇异同源密钥封装）；或
texts.en: 2.c.2. Finding isogenies between Supersingular elliptic curves (e.g., Supersingular Isogeny Key Encapsulation); or

texts.zh: 2.c.3. 随机码解码（例如McEliece、Niederreiter）。
texts.en: 2.c.3. Decoding random codes (e.g., McEliece, Niederreiter).

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 技术说明2.c所述算法也可称为后量子、量子安全或抗量子算法。
texts.en: An algorithm described by Technical Note 2.c. may be referred to as being post-quantum, quantum-safe or quantum-resistant.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 必须能够获取并应请求提供物项详细资料，以确定以下任一事项：
texts.en: Details of items must be accessible and provided upon request, in order to establish any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 该物项是否符合5A002.a.1至a.4的标准；或
texts.en: a. Whether the item meets the criteria of 5A002.a.1 to a.4; or

texts.zh: b. 5A002.a所列数据保密密码能力能否在未经“密码激活”的情况下使用。
texts.en: b. Whether the cryptographic capability for data confidentiality specified by 5A002.a is usable without “cryptographic activation.”
Note 2:

texts.zh: 5A002.a不管制下列任何物项，或为其专门设计的“信息安全”部件：
texts.en: 5A002.a does not control any of the following items, or specially designed “information security” components therefor:

texts.zh: a. 下列智能卡和智能卡“读写器”：
texts.en: a. Smart cards and smart card 'readers/writers' as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 满足下列任一条件的智能卡或可电子读取的个人证件（例如令牌币、电子护照）：
texts.en: a.1. A smart card or an electronically readable personal document (e.g., token coin, e-passport) that meets any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 密码能力同时满足以下全部条件：
texts.en: a.1.a. The cryptographic capability meets all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1. 仅限用于下列任一设备或系统：
texts.en: a.1.a.1. It is restricted for use in any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.a. 5A002.a.1至a.4未描述的设备或系统；
texts.en: a.1.a.1.a. Equipment or systems, not described by 5A002.a.1 to a.4;

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.b. 不使用采用“所述安全算法”的“数据保密密码功能”的设备或系统；或
texts.en: a.1.a.1.b. Equipment or systems, not using 'cryptography for data confidentiality' having a 'described security algorithm'; or

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.c. 本注b至f项排除于5A002.a之外的设备或系统；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.1.c. Equipment or systems, excluded from 5A002.a by entries b. to f. of this Note; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.2. 不能重新编程用于任何其他用途；或
texts.en: a.1.a.2. It cannot be reprogrammed for any other use; or

texts.zh: a.1.b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a.1.b. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.b.1. 专门设计且仅限于保护内部存储的“个人数据”；
texts.en: a.1.b.1. It is specially designed and limited to allow protection of 'personal data' stored within;

texts.zh: a.1.b.2. 已经或只能为公共或商业交易或个人身份识别进行个性化设置；以及
texts.en: a.1.b.2. Has been, or can only be, personalized for public or commercial transactions or individual identification; and

texts.zh: a.1.b.3. 用户无法访问其密码能力；
texts.en: a.1.b.3. Where the cryptographic capability is not user-accessible;

texts.zh: 注2的a.1.b.1款技术说明：
texts.en: Technical Note to paragraph a.1.b.1 of Note 2:

texts.zh: 就5A002.a注2的a.1.b.1款而言，“个人数据”包括与特定个人或实体有关的任何数据，例如储存的金额及“身份鉴别”所需的数据。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.-a.1.b.1, 'personal data' includes any data specific to a particular person or entity, such as the amount of money stored and data necessary for “authentication.”

texts.zh: a.2. 为本注a.1款所列物项专门设计或改装、且仅限于这些物项的“读写器”；
texts.en: a.2. 'Readers/writers' specially designed or modified, and limited, for items specified by paragraph a.1 of this Note;

texts.zh: 注2的a.2款技术说明：
texts.en: Technical Note to paragraph a.2 of Note 2:

texts.zh: 就5A002.a注2的a.2款而言，“读写器”包括通过网络与智能卡或可电子读取文件通信的设备。
texts.en: 'For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.a.2, 'readers/writers' include equipment that communicates with smart cards or electronically readable documents through a network.

texts.zh: b. 专门设计且仅限于银行业务或“货币交易”的密码设备；
texts.en: b. Cryptographic equipment specially designed and limited for banking use or 'money transactions';

texts.zh: 注2的b款技术说明：
texts.en: Technical Note to paragraph b. of Note 2:

texts.zh: 就5A002.a注2.b而言，5A002注2的b款中的“货币交易”包括费用收取和结算或信用功能。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.b, 'money transactions' in 5A002 Note 2 paragraph b. includes the collection and settlement of fares or credit functions.

texts.zh: c. 民用便携式或移动无线电话（例如用于商业民用蜂窝无线电通信系统），其不能直接向另一无线电话或设备（无线接入网络〔RAN〕设备除外）传输加密数据，也不能通过RAN设备（例如无线网络控制器〔RNC〕或基站控制器〔BSC〕）传送加密数据；
texts.en: c. Portable or mobile radiotelephones for civil use (e.g., for use with commercial civil cellular radio communication systems) that are not capable of transmitting encrypted data directly to another radiotelephone or equipment (other than Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment), nor of passing encrypted data through RAN equipment (e.g., Radio Network Controller (RNC) or Base Station Controller (BSC));

texts.zh: d. 不具备端到端加密能力，且按制造商规格，在不放大情况下无线运行的最大有效距离（即终端与家庭基站之间单次、无中继跳传）小于400米的无绳电话设备；
texts.en: d. Cordless telephone equipment not capable of end-to-end encryption where the maximum effective range of unboosted cordless operation (i.e., a single, unrelayed hop between terminal and home base station) is less than 400 meters according to the manufacturer's specifications;

texts.zh: e. 仅实施已公开或商用密码标准（反盗版功能可不公开），并符合《密码说明》（第5类第2部分注3）a.2至a.4款规定的民用便携式或移动无线电话及类似客户端无线设备；上述设备已针对特定民用行业应用定制，且增加的功能不影响原始未定制设备的密码功能；
texts.en: e. Portable or mobile radiotelephones and similar client wireless devices for civil use, that implement only published or commercial cryptographic standards (except for anti-piracy functions, which may be non-published) and also meet the provisions of paragraphs a.2 to a.4 of the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2), that have been customized for a specific civil industry application with features that do not affect the cryptographic functionality of these original non-customized devices;

texts.zh: f. “信息安全”功能仅限于实施已公开或商用密码标准的无线“个人区域网”功能的物项；
texts.en: f. Items, where the “information security” functionality is limited to wireless “personal area network ” functionality implementing only published or commercial cryptographic standards;

texts.zh: g. 为民用设计、同时符合《密码说明》（第5类第2部分注3）a.2至a.4款规定、射频输出功率限于0.1 W（20 dBm）或以下且支持不超过16个并发用户的移动电信无线接入网络（RAN）设备；
texts.en: g. Mobile telecommunications Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment designed for civil use, which also meet the provisions of paragraphs a.2 to a.4 of the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2), having an RF output power limited to 0.1W (20 dBm) or less, and supporting 16 or fewer concurrent users;

texts.zh: h. “信息安全”功能仅限于实施已公开或商用密码标准的“操作、管理或维护”（“OAM”）任务的路由器、交换机、网关或中继器；
texts.en: h. Routers, switches, gateways or relays, where the “information security” functionality is limited to the tasks of “Operations, Administration or Maintenance” (“OAM”) implementing only published or commercial cryptographic standards;

texts.zh: i. “信息安全”功能同时满足以下全部条件的通用计算设备或服务器：
texts.en: i. General purpose computing equipment or servers, where the “information security” functionality meets all of the following:

texts.zh: i.1. 仅使用已公开或商用密码标准；以及
texts.en: i.1. Uses only published or commercial cryptographic standards; and

texts.zh: i.2. 属于以下任一种情形：
texts.en: i.2. Is any of the following:

texts.zh: i.2.a. 为符合第5类第2部分注3规定的CPU的组成部分；
texts.en: i.2.a. Integral to a CPU that meets the provisions of Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2;

texts.zh: i.2.b. 为5D002未列明的操作系统的组成部分；或
texts.en: i.2.b. Integral to an operating system that is not specified by 5D002; or

texts.zh: i.2.c. 仅限于设备的“OAM”；或
texts.en: i.2.c. Limited to “OAM” of the equipment; or

texts.zh: j. 为“联网民用行业应用”专门设计，且同时满足以下全部条件的物项：
texts.en: j. Items specially designed for a 'connected civil industry application', meeting all of the following:

texts.zh: j.1. 属于下列任一种：
texts.en: j.1. Being any of the following:

texts.zh: j.1.a. 满足下列任一条件的具有联网能力的终端设备：
texts.en: j.1.a. A network-capable endpoint device meeting any of the following:

texts.zh: j.1.a.1. “信息安全”功能仅限于保护“非任意数据”或执行“操作、管理或维护”（“OAM”）任务；或
texts.en: j.1.a.1. The “information security” functionality is limited to securing 'non-arbitrary data' or the tasks of “Operations, Administration or Maintenance” (“OAM”); or

texts.zh: j.1.a.2. 该设备仅限于特定“联网民用行业应用”；或
texts.en: j.1.a.2. The device is limited to a specific 'connected civil industry application'; or

texts.zh: j.1.b. 同时满足以下全部条件的联网设备：
texts.en: j.1.b. Networking equipment meeting all of the following:

texts.zh: j.1.b.1. 为与上述j.1.a款所列设备通信而专门设计；以及
texts.en: j.1.b.1. Being specially designed to communicate with the devices specified by paragraph j.1.a. above; and

texts.zh: j.1.b.2. “信息安全”功能仅限于支持上述j.1.a款所列设备的“联网民用行业应用”，或执行该联网设备或本注j款所列其他物项的“OAM”任务；以及
texts.en: j.1.b.2. The “information security” functionality is limited to supporting the 'connected civil industry application' of devices specified by paragraph j.1.a. above, or the tasks of “OAM” of this networking equipment or of other items specified by paragraph j. of this Note; and

texts.zh: j.2. “信息安全”功能仅实施已公开或商用密码标准，且用户不能轻易改变密码功能。
texts.en: j.2. Where the “information security” functionality implements only published or commercial cryptographic standards, and the cryptographic functionality cannot easily be changed by the user.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就5A002.a注2.j而言，“联网民用行业应用”是指“信息安全”、数字通信、通用联网或计算以外的联网消费或民用行业应用。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.j, 'connected civil industry application' means a network-connected consumer or civil industry application other than “information security”, digital communication, general purpose networking or computing.

texts.zh: 2. 就5A002.a注2.j.1.a.1而言，“非任意数据”是与系统稳定性、性能或物理测量直接相关的传感器或计量数据（例如温度、压力、流量、质量、体积、电压、物理位置等），且设备用户不能改变此类数据。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 5A002.a Note 2.j.1.a.1, 'non-arbitrary data' means sensor or metering data directly related to the stability, performance or physical measurement of a system (e.g., temperature, pressure, flow rate, mass, volume, voltage, physical location, etc.), that cannot be changed by the user of the device.

texts.zh: b. 属于“密码激活令牌”；
texts.en: b. Being a 'cryptographic activation token';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A002.b而言，“密码激活令牌”是为下列任一用途设计或改装的物项：
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A002.b, a 'cryptographic activation token' is an item designed or modified for any of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 通过“密码激活”，将第5类第2部分未列明的物项转换为5A002.a或5D002.c.1所列、且未由《密码说明》（第5类第2部分注3）解除管制的物项；或
texts.en: 1. Converting, by means of “cryptographic activation”, an item not specified by Category 5—Part 2 into an item specified by 5A002.a or 5D002.c.1, and not released by the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5—Part 2); or

texts.zh: 2. 通过“密码激活”，使第5类第2部分已列明的物项启用5A002.a所列的额外功能；
texts.en: 2. Enabling by means of “cryptographic activation”, additional functionality specified by 5A002.a of an item already specified by Category 5—Part 2;

texts.zh: c. 为使用或执行“量子密码”而设计或改装；
texts.en: c. Designed or modified to use or perform “quantum cryptography”;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A002.c而言，“量子密码”也称量子密钥分发（QKD）。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A002.c,”quantum cryptography” is also known as Quantum Key Distribution (QKD).

texts.zh: d. 为使用密码技术，给采用超宽带调制技术且具有下列任一特性的系统生成信道化码、扰码或网络识别码而设计或改装：
texts.en: d. Designed or modified to use cryptographic techniques to generate channelizing codes, scrambling codes or network identification codes, for systems using ultra-wideband modulation techniques and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 带宽超过500 MHz；或
texts.en: d.1. A bandwidth exceeding 500 MHz; or

texts.zh: d.2. “相对带宽”为20%或以上；
texts.en: d.2. A “fractional bandwidth” of 20% or more;

texts.zh: e. 为使用密码技术，为5A002.d未列明的“扩频”系统生成扩频码（包括“跳频”系统的跳频码）而设计或改装。
texts.en: e. Designed or modified to use cryptographic techniques to generate the spreading code for “spread spectrum” systems, not specified by 5A002.d, including the hopping code for “frequency hopping” systems.

texts.en: f. through y. [Reserved]

texts.en: 5A004.a includes systems or equipment, designed or modified to perform 'cryptanalytic functions' by means of reverse engineering.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A004.a而言，“密码分析功能”是为破解密码机制，以获取保密变量或敏感数据（包括明文、密码或密码密钥）而设计的功能。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A004.a, 'cryptanalytic functions' are functions designed to defeat cryptographic mechanisms in order to derive confidential variables or sensitive data, including clear text, passwords or cryptographic keys.

texts.zh: b. ECCN 4A005或5A004.a未列明、为执行以下全部操作而设计的物项：
texts.en: b. Items, not specified by ECCNs 4A005 or 5A004.a, designed to perform all of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 从计算或通信设备“提取原始数据”；以及
texts.en: b.1. 'Extract raw data' from a computing or communications device; and

texts.zh: b.2. 绕过该设备的“身份鉴别”或授权控制，以执行5A004.b.1所述功能。
texts.en: b.2. Circumvent “authentication” or authorization controls of the device, in order to perform the function described in 5A004.b.1.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就5A004.b.1而言，从计算或通信设备“提取原始数据”是指从该设备的存储介质（例如RAM、闪存或硬盘）读取二进制数据，而不经该设备操作系统或文件系统解析。
texts.en: For the purposes of 5A004.b.1, 'extract raw data' from a computing or communications device means to retrieve binary data from a storage medium, e.g., RAM, flash or hard disk, of the device without interpretation by the device's operating system or filesystem.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 5A004.b不适用于为“开发”或“生产”计算或通信设备而专门设计的系统或设备。

texts.zh: 许可要求注：
texts.en: License Requirements Notes:

texts.zh: (1) 处理速度为5 GFLOPS或以上且算术逻辑单元访问宽度为32位或以上的微处理器（包括含有“信息安全”功能的微处理器），以及用于“生产”或“开发”此类微处理器的相关“软件”和“技术”的额外许可要求，见EAR第744.17条。
texts.en: (1) See § 744.17 of the EAR for additional license requirements for microprocessors having a processing speed of 5 GFLOPS or more and an arithmetic logic unit with an access width of 32 bit or more, including those incorporating “information security” functionality, and associated “software” and “technology” for the “production” or “development” of such microprocessors.

texts.zh: (2) 当某人实施或提供的技术协助纳入或以其他方式利用在美国获得或为美国原产的“技术”时，即发生该“技术”的释放。若提供此类技术协助的意图是帮助“开发”或“生产”将根据ECCN 5A002、5A004或5D002因“EI”理由受到管制的加密商品或软件，即使拟实施的基础加密算法属于公共领域或非美国原产，也可能需要EAR项下授权。
texts.en: (2) When a person performs or provides technical assistance that incorporates, or otherwise draws upon, “technology” that was either obtained in the United States or is of U.S.-origin, then a release of the “technology” takes place. Such technical assistance, when rendered with the intent to aid in the “development” or “production” of encryption commodities or software that would be controlled for “EI” reasons under ECCN 5A002, 5A004 or 5D002, may require authorization under the EAR even if the underlying encryption algorithm to be implemented is from the public domain or is not of U.S.-origin.
