texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 下列海洋声学系统、设备以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: a. Marine acoustic systems, equipment and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 下列主动式（发射或收发）系统、设备以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: a.1. Active (transmitting or transmitting-and-receiving) systems, equipment and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A001.a.1不管制下列设备：
texts.en: 6A001.a.1 does not control equipment as follows:

texts.zh: a. 在装置正下方垂直工作，不具有超过±20°的扫描功能，且仅限于测量水深、水下或埋藏物体距离或探鱼的测深仪；
texts.en: a. Depth sounders operating vertically below the apparatus, not including a scanning function exceeding ± 20°, and limited to measuring the depth of water, the distance of submerged or buried objects or fish finding;

texts.zh: b. 下列声信标：
texts.en: b. Acoustic beacons, as follows:

texts.zh: 1. 声学应急信标；
texts.en: 1. Acoustic emergency beacons;

texts.zh: 2. 为重新定位或返回某水下位置而“专门设计”的声脉冲发生器。
texts.en: 2. Pingers “specially designed” for relocating or returning to an underwater position.

texts.zh: a.1.a. 下列海底声学测绘设备：
texts.en: a.1.a. Acoustic seabed survey equipment as follows:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1. 为海底地形测绘设计，且同时具有以下全部特性的水面船舶测绘设备：
texts.en: a.1.a.1. Surface vessel survey equipment designed for sea bed topographic mapping and having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.a. 设计为在偏离垂直方向超过20°的角度进行测量；
texts.en: a.1.a.1.a. Designed to take measurements at an angle exceeding 20° from the vertical;

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.b. 设计为测量深度超过600 m的海底地形；
texts.en: a.1.a.1.b. Designed to measure seabed topography at seabed depths exceeding 600 m;

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.c. “测深分辨率”小于2；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.1.c.'Sounding resolution' less than 2; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.d. 通过补偿以下全部因素来“提高”深度“准确度”：
texts.en: a.1.a.1.d. 'Enhancement' of the depth “accuracy” through compensation for all the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.d.1. 声传感器运动；
texts.en: a.1.a.1.d.1. Motion of the acoustic sensor;

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.d.2. 从传感器至海底再返回的水中传播；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.1.d.2. In-water propagation from sensor to the seabed and back; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.1.d.3. 传感器处的声速；
texts.en: a.1.a.1.d.3. Sound speed at the sensor;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就6A001.a.1.a.1.c而言，“测深分辨率”为条带宽度（度）除以每条带最大测深点数。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.1.c, 'sounding resolution' is the swath width (degrees) divided by the maximum number of soundings per swath.

texts.zh: 2. 就6A001.a.1.a而言，“提高”包括通过外部手段进行补偿的能力。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a, 'enhancement' includes the ability to compensate by external means.

texts.zh: a.1.a.2. 为海底地形测绘设计，且具有下列任一特性的水下测绘设备：
texts.en: a.1.a.2. Underwater survey equipment designed for seabed topographic mapping and having any of the following:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.1.a.2而言，声传感器额定压力决定额定深度。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.2, the acoustic sensor pressure rating determines the depth rating.

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a.1.a.2.a. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.a.1. 为在超过300 m的深度运行而设计或改装；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.2.a.1. Designed or modified to operate at depths exceeding 300 m; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.a.2. “测深速率”大于3,800 m/s；或
texts.en: a.1.a.2.a.2. 'Sounding rate' greater than 3,800 m/s; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.1.a.2.a.2而言，“测深速率”为传感器可运行的最大速度（m/s）与假设100%覆盖时每条带最大测深点数的乘积。对于在两个方向产生测深结果的系统（3D声纳），应采用两个方向中较大的“测深速率”。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.2.a.2, 'sounding rate' is the product of the maximum speed (m/s) at which the sensor can operate and the maximum number of soundings per swath assuming 100% coverage. For systems that produce soundings in two directions (3D sonars), the maximum of the 'sounding rate' in either direction should be used.

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b. 6A001.a.1.a.2.a未列明、且同时具有以下全部特性的测绘设备：
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b. Survey equipment, not specified by 6A001.a.1.a.2.a, having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.1. 为在超过100 m的深度运行而设计或改装；
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.1. Designed or modified to operate at depths exceeding 100 m;

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.2. 设计为在偏离垂直方向超过20°的角度进行测量；
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.2. Designed to take measurements at an angle exceeding 20° from the vertical;

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.3. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.3.a. 工作频率低于350 kHz；或
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.3.a. Operating frequency below 350 kHz; or

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.3.b. 设计为测量距声传感器超过200 m范围的海底地形；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.3.b. Designed to measure seabed topography at a range exceeding 200 m from the acoustic sensor; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4. 通过补偿以下全部因素来“提高”深度“准确度”：
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.4. 'Enhancement' of the depth “accuracy” through compensation of all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4.a. 声传感器运动；
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.4.a. Motion of the acoustic sensor;

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4.b. 从传感器至海底再返回的水中传播；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.4.b. In-water propagation from sensor to the seabed and back; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.2.b.4.c. 传感器处的声速。
texts.en: a.1.a.2.b.4.c. Sound speed at the sensor.

texts.zh: a.1.a.3. 为海底成像设计且同时具有以下全部特性的侧扫声纳（SSS）或合成孔径声纳（SAS），以及为其“专门设计”的发射和接收声阵列：
texts.en: a.1.a.3. Side Scan Sonar (SSS) or Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS), designed for seabed imaging and having all of the following, and “specially designed” transmitting and receiving acoustic arrays therefor:

texts.zh: a.1.a.3.a. 为在超过500 m的深度运行而设计或改装；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.3.a. Designed or modified to operate at depths exceeding 500 m; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.3.b. 在可实现小于15 cm“沿航迹分辨率”的最大作用距离工作时，“面积覆盖速率”大于570 m^{2}/s；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.3.b. An 'area coverage rate' of greater than 570 m^{2}/s while operating at the maximum range that it can operate with an 'along track resolution' of less than 15 cm; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.3.c. “横航迹分辨率”小于15 cm；
texts.en: a.1.a.3.c. An 'across track resolution' of less than 15 cm;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.a.3:

texts.zh: 1. “面积覆盖速率”（m_{2}/s）为声纳作用距离（m）与传感器在该距离可运行的最大速度（m/s）乘积的两倍。
texts.en: 1. 'Area coverage rate' (m_{2}/s) is twice the product of the sonar range (m) and the maximum speed (m/s) at which the sensor can operate at that range.

texts.zh: 2. 仅就SSS而言，“沿航迹分辨率”（cm）为方位（水平）波束宽度（度）、声纳作用距离（m）与0.873的乘积。
texts.en: 2. 'Along track resolution' (cm), for SSS only, is the product of azimuth (horizontal) beamwidth (degrees) and sonar range (m) and 0.873.

texts.zh: 3. “横航迹分辨率”（cm）为75除以信号带宽（kHz）。
texts.en: 3. 'Across track resolution' (cm) is 75 divided by the signal bandwidth (kHz).

texts.zh: a.1.b. 为目标探测或定位设计，且具有下列任一特性的系统或发射和接收阵列：
texts.en: a.1.b Systems or transmitting and receiving arrays, designed for object detection or location, having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.b.1. 发射频率低于10 kHz；
texts.en: a.1.b.1. A transmitting frequency below 10 kHz;

texts.zh: a.1.b.2. 工作频率在10 kHz至24 kHz（含端点）频段内的设备，声压级超过224 dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa）；
texts.en: a.1.b.2. Sound pressure level exceeding 224dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band from 10 kHz to 24 kHz inclusive;

texts.zh: a.1.b.3. 工作频率在24 kHz与30 kHz之间频段内的设备，声压级超过235 dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa）；
texts.en: a.1.b.3. Sound pressure level exceeding 235 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band between 24 kHz and 30 kHz;

texts.zh: a.1.b.4. 在任一轴上形成小于1°的波束，且工作频率低于100 kHz；
texts.en: a.1.b.4. Forming beams of less than 1° on any axis and having an operating frequency of less than 100 kHz;

texts.zh: a.1.b.5. 设计为无模糊显示距离超过5,120 m；或
texts.en: a.1.b.5. Designed to operate with an unambiguous display range exceeding 5,120 m; or

texts.zh: a.1.b.6. 设计为在超过1,000 m深度正常运行时承受压力，且其换能器具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.1.b.6. Designed to withstand pressure during normal operation at depths exceeding 1,000 m and having transducers with any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.b.6.a. 压力动态补偿；或
texts.en: a.1.b.6.a. Dynamic compensation for pressure; or

texts.zh: a.1.b.6.b. 采用锆钛酸铅以外的材料作为换能元件；
texts.en: a.1.b.6.b. Incorporating other than lead zirconate titanate as the transduction element;

texts.zh: a.1.c. 采用压电、磁致伸缩、电致伸缩、电动或液压元件单独或按设计组合运行，且具有下列任一特性的声发射器（包括换能器）：
texts.en: a.1.c. Acoustic projectors, including transducers, incorporating piezoelectric, magnetostrictive, electrostrictive, electrodynamic or hydraulic elements operating individually or in a designed combination and having any of the following:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 为其他设备“专门设计”的声发射器（包括换能器）的管制状态，由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
texts.en: 1. The control status of acoustic projectors, including transducers, “specially designed” for other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment.

texts.zh: 2. 6A001.a.1.c不管制仅垂直定向发声的电子声源，或机械声源（例如气枪或蒸汽冲击枪），或化学声源（例如爆炸物）。
texts.en: 2. 6A001.a.1.c does not control electronic sources that direct the sound vertically only, or mechanical (e.g., air gun or vapor-shock gun) or chemical (e.g., explosive) sources.

texts.zh: 3. 6A001.a.1.c所列压电元件包括由固溶体生长的铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,}或PMN-PT）单晶，或由固溶体生长的铌铟酸铅/铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}或PIN-PMN-PT）单晶制成的元件。
texts.en: 3. Piezoelectric elements specified in 6A001.a.1.c include those made from lead-magnesium-niobate/lead-titanate (Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,} or PMN-PT) single crystals grown from solid solution or lead-indium-niobate/lead-magnesium niobate/lead-titanate (Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}, or PIN-PMN-PT) single crystals grown from solid solution.

texts.zh: a.1.c.1. 工作频率低于10 kHz，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.1.c.1. Operating at frequencies below 10 kHz and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.c.1.a. 非为以100%占空比连续运行而设计，且辐射的“自由场声源级（SLRMS）”超过(10log(f) + 169.77)dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa），其中f为10 kHz以下最大发射电压响应（TVR）对应的频率（Hz）；或
texts.en: a.1.c.1.a. Not designed for continuous operation at 100% duty cycle and having a radiated 'free-field Source Level (SLRMS)' exceeding (10log(f) + 169.77)dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) where f is the frequency in Hertz of maximum Transmitting Voltage Response (TVR) below 10 kHz; or

texts.zh: a.1.c.1.b. 为以100%占空比连续运行而设计，且在100%占空比下连续辐射的“自由场声源级（SLRMS）”超过(10log(f) + 159.77)dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa），其中f为10 kHz以下最大发射电压响应（TVR）对应的频率（Hz）；或
texts.en: a.1.c.1.b. Designed for continuous operation at 100% duty cycle and having a continuously radiated 'free-field Source Level (SLRMS)' at 100% duty cycle exceeding (10log(f) + 159.77)dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) where f is the frequency in Hertz of maximum Transmitting Voltage Response (TVR) below 10 kHz; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.1.c.1而言，“自由场声源级（SL_{RMS}）”沿最大响应轴并在声发射器远场定义。可根据发射电压响应用下式求得：SL_{RMS} = (TVR + 20log V_{RMS}) dB（参考值为1 m处1 µPa），其中SL_{RMS}为声源级，TVR为发射电压响应，V_{RMS}为发射器驱动电压。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.1.c.1, the 'free-field Source Level (SL_{RMS})' is defined along the maximum response axis and in the far field of the acoustic projector. It can be obtained from the Transmitting Voltage Response using the following equation: SL_{RMS} = (TVR + 20log V_{RMS}) dB (ref 1µPa at 1 m), where SL_{RMS} is the source level, TVR is the Transmitting Voltage Response and V_{RMS} is the Driving Voltage of the Projector.
a.1.c.2. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 特别提示
texts.en: N.B.

texts.zh: 此前由6A001.a.1.c.2列明的物项，见6A001.a.1.c.1。
texts.en: See 6A001.a.1.c.1 for items previously specified in 6A001.a.1.c.2.

texts.zh: a.1.c.3. 旁瓣抑制超过22 dB；
texts.en: a.1.c.3. Side-lobe suppression exceeding 22 dB;

texts.zh: a.1.d. 为确定水面船舶或水下航行器位置而设计，且同时具有以下全部特性的声学系统和设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: a.1.d. Acoustic systems and equipment, designed to determine the position of surface vessels or underwater vehicles and having all of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

texts.zh: a.1.d.1. 探测距离超过1,000 m；以及
texts.en: a.1.d.1. Detection range exceeding 1,000 m; and

texts.zh: a.1.d.2. 在1,000 m距离测量时，定位误差小于10 m rms（均方根）；
texts.en: a.1.d.2. Determined position error of less than 10 m rms (root mean square) when measured at a range of 1,000 m;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:
6A001.a.1.d includes:

texts.zh: a. 在两个或以上信标与水面船舶或水下航行器所携水听器单元之间采用相干“信号处理”的设备；
texts.en: a. Equipment using coherent “signal processing” between two or more beacons and the hydrophone unit carried by the surface vessel or underwater vehicle;

texts.zh: b. 能够自动校正声速传播误差以计算某一点位置的设备。
texts.en: b. Equipment capable of automatically correcting speed-of-sound propagation errors for calculation of a point.

texts.zh: a.1.e. 为探测、定位和自动分类游泳者或潜水员而“专门设计”或改装，且同时具有以下全部特性的主动式单体声纳，以及为其“专门设计”的发射和接收声阵列：
texts.en: a.1.e. Active individual sonars, “specially designed” or modified to detect, locate and automatically classify swimmers or divers, having all of the following, and “specially designed” transmitting and receiving acoustic arrays therefor:

texts.zh: a.1.e.1. 探测距离超过530 m；
texts.en: a.1.e.1. Detection range exceeding 530 m;

texts.zh: a.1.e.2. 在530 m距离测量时，定位误差小于15 m rms（均方根）；以及
texts.en: a.1.e.2. Determined position error of less than 15 m rms (root mean square) when measured at a range of 530 m; and

texts.zh: a.1.e.3. 发射脉冲信号带宽超过3 kHz；
texts.en: a.1.e.3. Transmitted pulse signal bandwidth exceeding 3 kHz;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 为军用“专门设计”或改装的潜水员探测系统，见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第121部分）中的《美国军品清单》。
texts.en: For diver detection systems “specially designed” or modified for military use, see the U.S. Munitions List in the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR part 121).

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.1.e而言，如针对不同环境规定了多个探测距离，则采用最大的探测距离。
texts.en: For 6A001.a.1.e, where multiple detection ranges are specified for various environments, the greatest detection range is used.

texts.zh: a.2. 下列被动式系统、设备以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: a.2. Passive systems, equipment and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A001.a.2也适用于接收设备及为其“专门设计”的部件，无论其在通常应用中是否与独立主动设备相关。
texts.en: 6A001.a.2 also applies to receiving equipment, whether or not related in normal application to separate active equipment, and “specially designed” components therefor.

texts.zh: a.2.a. 具有下列任一特性的水听器：
texts.en: a.2.a. Hydrophones having any of the following:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 为其他设备“专门设计”的水听器的管制状态，由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
texts.en: The control status of hydrophones “specially designed” for other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.2.a而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a:

texts.zh: 1. 水听器由一个或多个传感元件组成，产生一个声学输出通道。含有多个元件的水听器可称为水听器组。
texts.en: 1. Hydrophones consist of one or more sensing elements producing a single acoustic output channel. Those that contain multiple elements can be referred to as a hydrophone group.

texts.zh: 2. 为作为被动接收器运行而设计的水下声换能器属于水听器。
texts.en: 2. Underwater acoustic transducers designed to operate as passive receivers are hydrophones.

texts.zh: a.2.a.1. 采用连续柔性传感元件；
texts.en: a.2.a.1. Incorporating continuous flexible sensing elements;

texts.zh: a.2.a.2. 采用分立传感元件的柔性组件，元件直径或长度小于20 mm，且元件间距小于20 mm；
texts.en: a.2.a.2. Incorporating flexible assemblies of discrete sensing elements with either a diameter or length less than 20 mm and with a separation between elements of less than 20 mm;

texts.zh: a.2.a.3. 具有下列任一传感元件：
texts.en: a.2.a.3. Having any of the following sensing elements:
a.2.a.3.a. Optical fibers;

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.b. 聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）及其共聚物{P(VDF-TrFE)和P(VDF-TFE)}以外的“压电聚合物薄膜”；
texts.en: a.2.a.3.b. 'Piezoelectric polymer films' other than polyvinylidene-fluoride (PVDF) and its co-polymers {P(VDF-TrFE) and P(VDF-TFE)};

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.c. “柔性压电复合材料”；
texts.en: a.2.a.3.c. 'Flexible piezoelectric composites';

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.d. 从固溶体生长的铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（即Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,}或PMN-PT）压电单晶；或
texts.en: a.2.a.3.d. Lead-magnesium- niobate/lead-titanate (i.e., Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3,} or PMN-PT) piezoelectric single crystals grown from solid solution; or

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.e. 从固溶体生长的铌铟酸铅/铌镁酸铅/钛酸铅（即Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}或PIN-PMN-PT）压电单晶；
texts.en: a.2.a.3.e. Lead-indium-niobate/lead-magnesium niobate/lead-titanate (i.e., Pb(In_{1/2}Nb_{1/2})O_{3}-Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_{3}-PbTiO_{3}, or PIN-PMN-PT) piezoelectric single crystals grown from solid solution;

texts.zh: a.2.a.4. 在无加速度补偿时，任一深度的“水听器灵敏度”优于−180 dB；
texts.en: a.2.a.4. A 'hydrophone sensitivity' better than −180dB at any depth with no acceleration compensation;

texts.zh: a.2.a.5. 设计为在超过35 m深度运行，且具有加速度补偿；或
texts.en: a.2.a.5. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 35 m with acceleration compensation; or

texts.zh: a.2.a.6. 设计为在超过1,000 m深度运行，且在4 kHz以下“水听器灵敏度”优于−230 dB；
texts.en: a.2.a.6. Designed for operation at depths exceeding 1,000 m and having a 'hydrophone sensitivity' better than −230 dB below 4 kHz;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就6A001.a.2.a.3.b而言，“压电聚合物薄膜”传感元件由拉伸并固定在支撑框架或卷轴（芯轴）上的极化聚合物薄膜组成。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a.3.b, 'piezoelectric polymer film' sensing elements consist of polarized polymer film that is stretched over and attached to a supporting frame or spool (mandrel).

texts.zh: 2. 就6A001.a.2.a.3.c而言，“柔性压电复合材料”传感元件由压电陶瓷颗粒或纤维与电绝缘、声透明的橡胶、聚合物或环氧化合物结合而成，其中该化合物是传感元件的组成部分。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a.3.c, 'flexible piezoelectric composite' sensing elements consist of piezoelectric ceramic particles or fibers combined with an electrically insulating, acoustically transparent rubber, polymer or epoxy compound, where the compound is an integral part of the sensing elements.

texts.zh: 3. 就6A001.a.2.a而言，“水听器灵敏度”定义为：将不带前置放大器的水听器传感器置于均方根声压为1 µPa的平面波声场中，其均方根输出电压与1 V均方根参考值之比的以10为底对数的二十倍。例如，−160 dB（参考值1 V/µPa）的水听器在该声场中产生10^{−8} V输出电压，而灵敏度为−180 dB的水听器仅产生10^{−9} V输出。因此，−160 dB优于−180 dB。
texts.en: 3. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.a, 'hydrophone sensitivity' is defined as twenty times the logarithm to the base 10 of the ratio of rms output voltage to a 1 V rms reference, when the hydrophone sensor, without a pre-amplifier, is placed in a plane wave acoustic field with an rms pressure of 1 µPa. For example, a hydrophone of −160 dB (reference 1 V per µPa) would yield an output voltage of 10^{−8} V in such a field, while one of −180 dB sensitivity would yield only 10^{−9} V output. Thus, −160 dB is better than −180 dB.

texts.zh: a.2.b. 具有下列任一特性的拖曳声学水听器阵列：
texts.en: a.2.b. Towed acoustic hydrophone arrays having any of the following:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.2.b而言，水听器阵列由若干水听器组成，提供多个声学输出通道。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.b, hydrophones arrays consist of a number of hydrophones providing multiple acoustic output channels.

texts.zh: a.2.b.1. 水听器组间距小于12.5 m，或“能够改装”为水听器组间距小于12.5 m；
texts.en: a.2.b.1. Hydrophone group spacing of less than 12.5 m or 'able to be modified' to have hydrophone group spacing of less than 12.5 m;

texts.zh: a.2.b.2. 设计为或“能够改装”为在超过35 m深度运行；
texts.en: a.2.b.2. Designed or 'able to be modified' to operate at depths exceeding 35m;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A001.a.2.b.2而言，6A001.a.2.b中的“能够改装”是指预留可通过改变布线或互连来改变水听器组间距或工作深度限值的设计。此类预留设计包括：超过导线总数10%的备用导线、水听器组间距调整块，或可调节或控制一个以上水听器组的内部深度限制装置。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.b.2, 'able to be modified' in 6A001.a.2.b means having provisions to allow a change of the wiring or interconnections to alter hydrophone group spacing or operating depth limits. These provisions are: spare wiring exceeding 10% of the number of wires, hydrophone group spacing adjustment blocks or internal depth limiting devices that are adjustable or that control more than one hydrophone group.

texts.zh: a.2.b.3. 6A001.a.2.d管制的航向传感器；
texts.en: a.2.b.3. Heading sensors controlled by 6A001.a.2.d;

texts.zh: a.2.b.4. 纵向增强的阵列软管；
texts.en: a.2.b.4. Longitudinally reinforced array hoses;

texts.zh: a.2.b.5. 组装后的阵列直径小于40 mm；
texts.en: a.2.b.5. An assembled array of less than 40 mm in diameter;
a.2.b.6. [Reserved];

texts.zh: a.2.b.7. 具有6A001.a.2.a管制的水听器特性；或
texts.en: a.2.b.7. Hydrophone characteristics controlled by 6A001.a.2.a; or

texts.zh: a.2.b.8. 6A001.a.2.g所列基于加速度计的水声传感器；
texts.en: a.2.b.8. Accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors specified by 6A001.a.2.g;

texts.zh: a.2.c. 为拖曳声学水听器阵列“专门设计”、具有“用户可访问的可编程性”及时间域或频率域处理和相关功能的处理设备，包括采用快速傅里叶或其他变换或处理方法进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成；
texts.en: a.2.c. Processing equipment, “specially designed” for towed acoustic hydrophone arrays, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes;

texts.zh: a.2.d. 同时具有以下全部特性的航向传感器：
texts.en: a.2.d. Heading sensors having all of the following:
a.2.d.1. An “accuracy” of better than ± 0.5°; and

texts.zh: a.2.d.2. 设计为在超过35 m深度运行，或具有可调节或可拆卸的深度传感装置，以在超过35 m深度运行；
texts.en: a.2.d.2. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 35 m or having an adjustable or removable depth sensing device in order to operate at depths exceeding 35 m;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 惯性航向系统见7A003.c。
texts.en: For inertial heading systems, see 7A003.c.

texts.zh: a.2.e. 具有下列任一特性的海底或海湾电缆水听器阵列：
texts.en: a.2.e. Bottom or bay-cable hydrophone arrays having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.e.1. 采用6A001.a.2.a管制水听器；
texts.en: a.2.e.1. Incorporating hydrophones controlled by 6A001.a.2.a;

texts.zh: a.2.e.2. 采用同时具有以下全部特性的复用水听器组信号模块：
texts.en: a.2.e.2. Incorporating multiplexed hydrophone group signal modules having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.2.e.2.a. 设计为在超过35 m深度运行，或具有可调节或可拆卸的深度传感装置，以在超过35 m深度运行；以及
texts.en: a.2.e.2.a. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 35 m or having an adjustable or removal depth sensing device in order to operate at depths exceeding 35 m; and

texts.zh: a.2.e.2.b. 能够在运行中与拖曳声学水听器阵列模块互换；或
texts.en: a.2.e.2.b. Capable of being operationally interchanged with towed acoustic hydrophone array modules; or

texts.zh: a.2.e.3. 采用6A001.a.2.g所列基于加速度计的水声传感器；
texts.en: a.2.e.3. Incorporating accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors specified by 6A001.a.2.g;

texts.zh: a.2.f. 为海底或海湾电缆系统“专门设计”、具有“用户可访问的可编程性”及时间域或频率域处理和相关功能的处理设备，包括采用快速傅里叶或其他变换或处理方法进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成；
texts.en: a.2.f. Processing equipment, “specially designed” for bottom or bay cable systems, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes;

texts.zh: a.2.g. 同时具有以下全部特性的基于加速度计的水声传感器：
texts.en: a.2.g. Accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.g.1. 由沿三个不同轴排列的三个加速度计组成；
texts.en: a.2.g.1. Composed of three accelerometers arranged along three distinct axes;

texts.zh: a.2.g.2. 总体“加速度灵敏度”优于48 dB（参考值为每1g对应1,000 mV rms）；
texts.en: a.2.g.2. Having an overall 'acceleration sensitivity' better than 48 dB (reference 1,000 mV rms per 1g);

texts.zh: a.2.g.3. 设计为在大于35米的深度运行；以及
texts.en: a.2.g.3. Designed to operate at depths greater than 35 meters; and

texts.zh: a.2.g.4. 工作频率低于20 kHz；
texts.en: a.2.g.4. Operating frequency below 20 kHz;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A001.a.2.g不适用于质点速度传感器或地震检波器。
texts.en: 6A001.a.2.g does not apply to particle velocity sensors or geophones.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就6A001.a.2.g而言，基于加速度计的水声传感器也称矢量传感器。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.g, accelerometer-based hydro-acoustic sensors are also known as vector sensors.

texts.zh: 2. 就6A001.a.2.g.2而言，“加速度灵敏度”定义为：将不带前置放大器的水声传感器置于均方根加速度为1 g（即9.81 m/s^{2}）的平面波声场中，其均方根输出电压与1 V均方根参考值之比的以10为底对数的二十倍。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A001.a.2.g.2, 'acceleration sensitivity' is defined as twenty times the logarithm to the base 10 of the ratio of rms output voltage to a 1 V rms reference, when the hydro-acoustic sensor, without a preamplifier, is placed in a plane wave acoustic field with an rms acceleration of 1 g (i.e., 9.81 m/s^{2}).

texts.zh: b. 为测量设备载体相对于海底的水平速度而设计的下列相关测速和多普勒测速声纳计程仪设备：
texts.en: b. Correlation-velocity and Doppler-velocity sonar log equipment designed to measure the horizontal speed of the equipment carrier relative to the sea bed, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 具有下列任一特性的相关测速声纳计程仪设备：
texts.en: b.1. Correlation-velocity sonar log equipment having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 设计为在载体与海底间距离超过500 m时运行；或
texts.en: b.1.a. Designed to operate at distances between the carrier and the sea bed exceeding 500 m; or

texts.zh: b.1.b. 速度“准确度”优于速度的1%；
texts.en: b.1.b. Having speed “accuracy” better than 1% of speed;

texts.zh: b.2. 速度“准确度”优于速度的1%的多普勒测速声纳计程仪设备；
texts.en: b.2. Doppler-velocity sonar log equipment having speed “accuracy” better than 1% of speed;

texts.zh: 注1：6A001.b不适用于仅限下列任一用途的测深仪：
texts.en: Note 1: 6A001.b does not apply to depth sounders limited to any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 测量水深；
texts.en: a. Measuring the depth of water;

texts.zh: b. 测量水下或埋藏物体的距离；或
texts.en: b. Measuring the distance of submerged or buried objects; or

texts.zh: c. 探鱼。

(6) See USML Categories XII(e) and XV(e)(3) for read-out integrated circuits “subject to the ITAR.” (7) See 6B002 for masks and reticles, “specially designed” for optical sensors specified by 6A002.a.1.b or 6A002.a.1.d.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 下列光学探测器：
texts.en: a. Optical detectors as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 下列“航天级”固态探测器：
texts.en: a.1. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors as follows:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.a.1而言，固态探测器包括“焦平面阵列”。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.1, solid-state detectors include “focal plane arrays”.

texts.zh: a.1.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的“航天级”固态探测器：
texts.en: a.1.a. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于10 nm但不超过300 nm；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 10 nm but not exceeding 300 nm; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.2. 波长超过400 nm时，相对于峰值响应的响应低于0.1%；
texts.en: a.1.a.2. A response of less than 0.1% relative to the peak response at a wavelength exceeding 400 nm;

texts.zh: a.1.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的“航天级”固态探测器：
texts.en: a.1.b. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.b.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于900 nm但不超过1,200 nm；以及
texts.en: a.1.b.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 900 nm but not exceeding 1,200 nm; and

texts.zh: a.1.b.2. 响应“时间常数”为95 ns或以下；
texts.en: a.1.b.2. A response “time constant” of 95 ns or less;

texts.zh: a.1.c. 峰值响应波长范围大于1,200 nm但不超过30,000 nm的“航天级”固态探测器；
texts.en: a.1.c. “Space-qualified” solid-state detectors having a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,200 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

texts.zh: a.1.d. 每阵列超过2,048个元件，且峰值响应波长范围大于300 nm但不超过900 nm的“航天级”“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: a.1.d. “Space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having more than 2,048 elements per array and having a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 300 nm but not exceeding 900 nm;

texts.zh: a.2. 下列像增强管及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: a.2. Image intensifier tubes and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.a.2不管制真空空间中的电子感测器件仅限于下列任一种的非成像光电倍增管：
texts.en: 6A002.a.2 does not control non-imaging photomultiplier tubes having an electron sensing device in the vacuum space limited solely to any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 单个金属阳极；或
texts.en: a. A single metal anode; or

texts.zh: b. 中心间距大于500 µm的金属阳极。
texts.en: b. Metal anodes with a center to center spacing greater than 500 µm.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.a.2而言，“电荷倍增”是电子图像放大的一种形式，定义为通过碰撞电离增益过程产生电荷载流子。“电荷倍增”传感器可采用像增强管、固态探测器或“焦平面阵列”的形式。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.2, 'charge multiplication' is a form of electronic image amplification and is defined as the generation of charge carriers as a result of an impact ionization gain process. 'Charge multiplication' sensors may take the form of an image intensifier tube, solid state detector or “focal plane array”.

texts.zh: a.2.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的像增强管：
texts.en: a.2.a. Image intensifier tubes having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.a.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于400 nm但不超过1,050 nm；
texts.en: a.2.a.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm;

texts.zh: a.2.a.2. 采用下列任一种方式进行电子图像放大：
texts.en: a.2.a.2. Electron image amplification using any of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.a.2.a. 孔距（中心间距）为12 µm或以下的微通道板；或
texts.en: a.2.a.2.a. A microchannel plate with a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less; or

texts.zh: a.2.a.2.b. 未合并像素间距为500 µm或以下、为通过微通道板以外的方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装的电子感测器件；以及
texts.en: a.2.a.2.b. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' other than by a microchannel plate; and

texts.zh: a.2.a.3. 下列任一种光电阴极：
texts.en: a.2.a.3. Any of the following photocathodes:

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.a. 光照灵敏度超过350 µA/lm的多碱光电阴极（例如S-20和S-5）；
texts.en: a.2.a.3.a. Multialkali photocathodes (e.g., S-20 and S-5) having a luminous sensitivity exceeding 350 µA/lm;

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.b. GaAs或GaInAs光电阴极；或
texts.en: a.2.a.3.b. GaAs or GaInAs photocathodes; or

texts.zh: a.2.a.3.c. 最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W的其他“III-V族化合物”半导体光电阴极；
texts.en: a.2.a.3.c. Other “III-V compound” semiconductor photocathodes having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W;

texts.zh: a.2.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的像增强管：
texts.en: a.2.b. Image intensifier tubes having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.b.1. 峰值响应波长范围大于1,050 nm但不超过1,800 nm；
texts.en: a.2.b.1. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,050 nm but not exceeding 1,800 nm;

texts.zh: a.2.b.2. 采用下列任一种方式进行电子图像放大：
texts.en: a.2.b.2. Electron image amplification using any of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.b.2.a. 孔距（中心间距）为12 µm或以下的微通道板；或
texts.en: a.2.b.2.a. A microchannel plate with a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less; or

texts.zh: a.2.b.2.b. 未合并像素间距为500 µm或以下、为通过微通道板以外的方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装的电子感测器件；以及
texts.en: a.2.b.2.b. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' other than by a microchannel plate; and

texts.zh: a.2.b.3. 最大“辐射灵敏度”超过15 mA/W的“III/V族化合物”半导体（例如GaAs或GaInAs）光电阴极和转移电子光电阴极；
texts.en: a.2.b.3. “III/V compound” semiconductor (e.g., GaAs or GaInAs) photocathodes and transferred electron photocathodes, having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 15 mA/W;

texts.zh: a.2.c. 下列“专门设计”的“部件”：
texts.en: a.2.c. “Specially designed” “components” as follows:

texts.zh: a.2.c.1. 孔距（中心间距）为12 µm或以下的微通道板；
texts.en: a.2.c.1. Microchannel plates having a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less;

texts.zh: a.2.c.2. 未合并像素间距为500 µm或以下、为通过微通道板以外的方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装的电子感测器件；
texts.en: a.2.c.2. An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' other than by a microchannel plate;

texts.zh: a.2.c.3. “III-V族化合物”半导体（例如GaAs或GaInAs）光电阴极和转移电子光电阴极；
texts.en: a.2.c.3. “III-V compound” semiconductor (e.g., GaAs or GaInAs) photocathodes and transferred electron photocathodes;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.a.2.c.3不管制设计为实现下列任一最大“辐射灵敏度”的化合物半导体光电阴极：
texts.en: 6A002.a.2.c.3 does not control compound semiconductor photocathodes designed to achieve a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 在大于400 nm但不超过1,050 nm的波长范围内，峰值响应处为10 mA/W或以下；或
texts.en: a. 10 mA/W or less at the peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm; or

texts.zh: b. 在大于1,050 nm但不超过1,800 nm的波长范围内，峰值响应处为15 mA/W或以下。
texts.en: b. 15 mA/W or less at the peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,050 nm but not exceeding 1,800 nm.

texts.zh: a.3. 下列非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: a.3. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” as follows:

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: “微测辐射热计”非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”仅由6A002.a.3.f列明。
texts.en: 'Microbolometer' non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” are only specified by 6A002.a.3.f.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.a.3而言，线性或二维多元探测器阵列称为“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3, linear or two-dimensional multi-element detector arrays are referred to as “focal plane arrays”;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 6A002.a.3包括光电导阵列和光伏阵列。
texts.en: 6A002.a.3 includes photoconductive arrays and photovoltaic arrays.
Note 2:
6A002.a.3 does not control:

texts.zh: a. 使用硫化铅或硒化铅的多元（不超过16个元件）封装光电导单元；
texts.en: a. Multi-element (not to exceed 16 elements) encapsulated photoconductive cells using either lead sulphide or lead selenide;

texts.zh: b. 使用下列任一材料的热释电探测器：
texts.en: b. Pyroelectric detectors using any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 硫酸三甘氨酸及其变体；
texts.en: b.1. Triglycine sulphate and variants;

texts.zh: b.2. 钛酸铅镧锆及其变体；
texts.en: b.2. Lead-lanthanum-zirconium titanate and variants;

texts.zh: b.3. 钽酸锂；
texts.en: b.3. Lithium tantalate;

texts.zh: b.4. 聚偏氟乙烯及其变体；或
texts.en: b.4. Polyvinylidene fluoride and variants; or

texts.zh: b.5. 铌酸锶钡及其变体。
texts.en: b.5. Strontium barium niobate and variants.

texts.zh: c. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，并在设计上将超过760 nm波长的最大“辐射灵敏度”限制为10 mA/W或以下，且同时具有以下全部特性的“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: c. “Focal plane arrays” “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and limited by design to have a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of 10 mA/W or less for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm, having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 采用设计为不可移除或修改的响应限制机制；以及
texts.en: c.1. Incorporating a response limiting mechanism designed not to be removed or modified; and

texts.zh: c.2. 下列任一种情况：
texts.en: c.2. Any of the following:

texts.zh: c.2.a. 响应限制机制与探测器元件一体化或相结合；或
texts.en: c.2.a. The response limiting mechanism is integral to or combined with the detector element; or

texts.zh: c.2.b. “焦平面阵列”仅在响应限制机制就位时才能运行。
texts.en: c.2.b. The “focal plane array” is only operable with the response limiting mechanism in place.

texts.zh: d. 元件数少于5,130个的热电堆阵列；
texts.en: d. Thermopile arrays having less than 5,130 elements;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.a.3注2.c.2.a而言，与探测器元件一体化的响应限制机制被设计为一旦移除或修改，探测器即无法运行。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3 Note 2.c.2.a, a response limiting mechanism integral to the detector element is designed not to be removed or modified without rendering the detector inoperable.

texts.zh: a.3.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: a.3.a. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.a.1. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于900 nm但不超过1,050 nm；以及
texts.en: a.3.a.1. Individual elements with a peak response within the wavelength range exceeding 900 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm; and

texts.zh: a.3.a.2. 下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.3.a.2. Any of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.a.2.a. 响应“时间常数”小于0.5 ns；或
texts.en: a.3.a.2.a. A response “time constant” of less than 0.5 ns; or

texts.zh: a.3.a.2.b. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，且最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W；
texts.en: a.3.a.2.b. “Specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W;

texts.zh: a.3.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: a.3.b. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.b.1. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于1,050 nm但不超过1,200 nm；以及
texts.en: a.3.b.1. Individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,050 nm but not exceeding 1,200 nm; and

texts.zh: a.3.b.2. 下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.3.b.2. Any of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.b.2.a. 响应“时间常数”为95 ns或以下；或
texts.en: a.3.b.2.a. A response “time constant” of 95 ns or less; or

texts.zh: a.3.b.2.b. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，且最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W；
texts.en: a.3.b.2.b. “Specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W;

texts.zh: a.3.c. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于1,200 nm但不超过30,000 nm的非“航天级”非线性（二维）“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: a.3.c. Non-“space-qualified” non-linear (2-dimensional) “focal plane arrays” having individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,200 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 基于硅及其他材料的“微测辐射热计”非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”仅由6A002.a.3.f列明。
texts.en: Silicon and other material based 'microbolometer' non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” are only specified by 6A002.a.3.f.

texts.zh: a.3.d. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”线性（一维）“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: a.3.d. Non-“space-qualified” linear (1-dimensional) “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.d.1. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于1,200 nm但不超过3,000 nm；以及
texts.en: a.3.d.1. Individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 1,200 nm but not exceeding 3,000 nm; and

texts.zh: a.3.d.2. 下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.3.d.2. Any of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.d.2.a. 探测器元件的“扫描方向”尺寸与“横扫描方向”尺寸之比小于3.8；或
texts.en: a.3.d.2.a. A ratio of 'scan direction' dimension of the detector element to the 'cross-scan direction' dimension of the detector element of less than 3.8; or

texts.zh: a.3.d.2.b. 在探测器元件中进行信号处理；
texts.en: a.3.d.2.b. Signal processing in the detector elements;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.a.3.d不管制探测器元件材料仅限于锗的“焦平面阵列”（元件数不超过32个）。
texts.en: 6A002.a.3.d does not control “focal plane arrays” (not to exceed 32 elements) having detector elements limited solely to germanium material.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.a.3.d而言，“横扫描方向”定义为平行于探测器元件线性阵列的轴，“扫描方向”定义为垂直于探测器元件线性阵列的轴。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3.d, 'cross-scan direction' is defined as the axis parallel to the linear array of detector elements and the 'scan direction' is defined as the axis perpendicular to the linear array of detector elements.

texts.zh: a.3.e. 单个元件的峰值响应波长范围大于3,000 nm但不超过30,000 nm的非“航天级”线性（一维）“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: a.3.e. Non-“space-qualified” linear (1-dimensional) “focal plane arrays” having individual elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 3,000 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

texts.zh: a.3.f. 基于“微测辐射热计”材料的非“航天级”非线性（二维）红外“焦平面阵列”，其单个元件在大于或等于8,000 nm但不超过14,000 nm的波长范围具有未滤波响应；
texts.en: a.3.f. Non-“space-qualified” non-linear (2-dimensional) infrared “focal plane arrays” based on 'microbolometer' material having individual elements with an unfiltered response in the wavelength range equal to or exceeding 8,000 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.a.3.f而言，“微测辐射热计”定义为一种热成像探测器，利用吸收红外辐射引起的探测器温度变化产生任何可用信号。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.a.3.f, 'microbolometer' is defined as a thermal imaging detector that, as a result of a temperature change in the detector caused by the absorption of infrared radiation, is used to generate any usable signal.

texts.zh: a.3.g. 同时具有以下全部特性的非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: a.3.g. Non-“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays” having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.g.1. 单个探测器元件的峰值响应波长范围大于400 nm但不超过900 nm；
texts.en: a.3.g.1. Individual detector elements with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 900 nm;

texts.zh: a.3.g.2. 为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改装，且在超过760 nm波长时最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W；以及
texts.en: a.3.g.2. “Specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication' and having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm; and

texts.zh: a.3.g.3. 元件数大于32个；
texts.en: a.3.g.3. Greater than 32 elements;

texts.zh: b. 为遥感应用设计，且具有下列任一特性的“单光谱成像传感器”和“多光谱成像传感器”：
texts.en: b. “Monospectral imaging sensors” and “multispectral imaging sensors”, designed for remote sensing applications and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 瞬时视场（IFOV）小于200 µrad（微弧度）；或
texts.en: b.1. An Instantaneous-Field-Of-View (IFOV) of less than 200 µrad (microradians); or

texts.zh: b.2. 规定工作波长范围大于400 nm但不超过30,000 nm，且同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: b.2. Specified for operation in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 30,000 nm and having all the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 以数字格式提供输出成像数据；以及
texts.en: b.2.a. Providing output imaging data in digital format; and

texts.zh: b.2.b. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: b.2.b. Having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.2.b.1. “航天级”；或
texts.en: b.2.b.1. “Space-qualified”; or

texts.zh: b.2.b.2. 为机载运行设计，使用硅以外的探测器，且IFOV小于2.5 mrad（毫弧度）；
texts.en: b.2.b.2. Designed for airborne operation, using other than silicon detectors, and having an IFOV of less than 2.5 mrad (milliradians);

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.b.1不管制峰值响应波长范围大于300 nm但不超过900 nm，且仅采用下列任一非“航天级”探测器或非“航天级”“焦平面阵列”的“单光谱成像传感器”：
texts.en: 6A002.b.1 does not control “monospectral imaging sensors” with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 300 nm but not exceeding 900 nm and only incorporating any of the following non-“space-qualified” detectors or non -“space-qualified” “focal plane arrays”:

texts.zh: a. 非为实现“电荷倍增”而设计或改装的电荷耦合器件（CCD）；或
texts.en: a. Charge Coupled Devices (CCD) not designed or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication'; or

texts.zh: b. 非为实现“电荷倍增”而设计或改装的互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）器件。
texts.en: b. Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) devices not designed or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication'.

texts.zh: c. 采用下列任一物项的“直接观察”成像设备：
texts.en: c. 'Direct view' imaging equipment incorporating any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b所列特性的像增强管；
texts.en: c.1. Image intensifier tubes having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b;

texts.zh: c.2. 具有6A002.a.3所列特性的“焦平面阵列”；或
texts.en: c.2. “Focal plane arrays” having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.3; or

texts.zh: c.3. 6A002.a.1所列固态探测器；
texts.en: c.3. Solid state detectors specified by 6A002.a.1;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.c而言，“直接观察”是指直接向人类观察者呈现可见图像，无需将图像转换为电子信号供电视显示，且不能通过摄影、电子或任何其他方式记录或存储图像的成像设备。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.c,'direct view' refers to imaging equipment that presents a visual image to a human observer without converting the image into an electronic signal for television display, and that cannot record or store the image photographically, electronically or by any other means.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.c不管制采用GaAs或GaInAs以外光电阴极的下列设备：
texts.en: 6A002.c does not control equipment as follows, when incorporating other than GaAs or GaInAs photocathodes:

texts.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
texts.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

texts.zh: b. 医疗设备；
texts.en: b. Medical equipment;

texts.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
texts.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

texts.zh: d. 工业炉用火焰探测器；
texts.en: d. Flame detectors for industrial furnaces;

texts.zh: e. 为实验室使用而“专门设计”的设备。
texts.en: e. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use.

texts.zh: d. 下列光学传感器专用支持“部件”：
texts.en: d. Special support “components” for optical sensors, as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. “航天级”低温制冷机；
texts.en: d.1. “Space-qualified” cryocoolers;

texts.zh: d.2. 冷源温度低于218 K（−55 °C）的下列非“航天级”低温制冷机：
texts.en: d.2. Non-“space-qualified” cryocoolers having a cooling source temperature below 218 K (−55 °C), as follows:

texts.zh: d.2.a. 规定平均失效时间（MTTF）或平均故障间隔时间（MTBF）超过2,500小时的闭式循环型；
texts.en: d.2.a. Closed cycle type with a specified Mean-Time-To-Failure (MTTF) or Mean-Time-Between-Failures (MTBF), exceeding 2,500 hours;

texts.zh: d.2.b. 孔（外）径小于8 mm的焦耳—汤姆孙（JT）自调节微型制冷机；
texts.en: d.2.b. Joule-Thomson (JT) self-regulating minicoolers having bore (outside) diameters of less than 8 mm;

texts.zh: d.3. 在成分或结构上经特殊制造，或通过涂层改性，以对声、热、惯性、电磁或核辐射敏感的光学传感光纤。
texts.en: d.3. Optical sensing fibers specially fabricated either compositionally or structurally, or modified by coating, to be acoustically, thermally, inertially, electromagnetically or nuclear radiation sensitive.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.d.3不适用于为钻孔传感应用“专门设计”的封装光学传感光纤。
texts.en: 6A002.d.3 does not apply to encapsulated optical sensing fibers “specially designed” for bore hole sensing applications.

texts.zh: e. [保留]
texts.en: e. [Reserved]

texts.zh: f. 为6A002.a.3所列“焦平面阵列”“专门设计”的“读出集成电路”（“ROIC”）。
texts.en: f. 'Read-Out Integrated Circuits' ('ROIC') “specially designed” for “focal plane arrays” specified by 6A002.a.3.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A002.f不适用于为民用汽车应用“专门设计”的读出集成电路。
texts.en: 6A002.f does not apply to read-out integrated circuits “specially designed” for civil automotive applications.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A002.f而言，“读出集成电路”（“ROIC”）是设计为位于“焦平面阵列”（“FPA”）下方或与其键合、并用于读出（即提取和记录）探测器元件产生信号的集成电路。“ROIC”至少通过提取电荷并执行复用功能读取探测器元件的电荷，同时保留探测器元件的相对空间位置和方向信息，以在“ROIC”内部或外部进行处理。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A002.f, a 'Read-Out Integrated Circuit' ('ROIC') is an integrated circuit designed to underlie or be bonded to a “focal plane array” (“FPA”) and used to read-out (i.e., extract and register) signals produced by the detector elements. At a minimum the 'ROIC' reads the charge from the detector elements by extracting the charge and applying a multiplexing function in a manner that retains the relative spatial position and orientation information of the detector elements for processing inside or outside the 'ROIC'.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术，见ECCN 6E001（“开发”）、6E002（“生产”）及6E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 6A203。(3) 含有6A003所述照相机的外国制造军用商品，见ECCN 0A919。(4) 第744.9条对为某些军用最终用户使用或装入ECCN 0A919管制商品而出口、再出口或境内转移的6A003所述照相机规定了许可要求。(5) 受ITAR管辖的照相机，见USML第XII(c)和(e)类。(6) 另见ECCN 6A293。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 6E001 (“development”), 6E002 (“production”), and 6E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (2) Also see ECCN 6A203. (3) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign made military commodities that incorporate cameras described in 6A003. (4) Section 744.9 imposes a license requirement on cameras described in 6A003 if being exported, reexported, or transferred (in-country) for use by certain military end-users or for incorporation into a commodity controlled by ECCN 0A919. (5) See USML Category XII(c) and (e) for cameras subject to the ITAR. (6) Also see ECCN 6A293.

texts.en: b. Imaging cameras as follows:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A003.b不管制为电视广播“专门设计”的电视或视频摄像机。
texts.en: 6A003.b does not control television or video cameras “specially designed” for television broadcasting.

texts.zh: b.1. 采用固态传感器，峰值响应波长范围大于10 nm但不超过30,000 nm，且同时具有以下全部特性的视频摄像机：
texts.en: b.1. Video cameras incorporating solid state sensors, having a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 10 nm, but not exceeding 30,000 nm and having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: b.1.a. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a.1. 单色（黑白）摄像机的每个固态阵列超过4 x 10^{6}个“有效像素”；
texts.en: b.1.a.1. More than 4 x 10^{6} “active pixels” per solid state array for monochrome (black and white) cameras;

texts.zh: b.1.a.2. 采用三个固态阵列的彩色摄像机，每个固态阵列超过4 x 10^{6}个“有效像素”；或
texts.en: b.1.a.2. More than 4 x 10^{6} “active pixels” per solid state array for color cameras incorporating three solid state arrays; or

texts.zh: b.1.a.3. 采用一个固态阵列的固态阵列彩色摄像机，超过12 x 10^{6}个“有效像素”；以及
texts.en: b.1.a.3. More than 12 x 10^{6} “active pixels” for solid state array color cameras incorporating one solid state array; and

texts.zh: b.1.b. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: b.1.b. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.b.1. 6A004.a管制的光学反射镜；
texts.en: b.1.b.1. Optical mirrors controlled by 6A004.a.;

texts.zh: b.1.b.2. 6A004.d管制的光学控制设备；或
texts.en: b.1.b.2. Optical control equipment controlled by 6A004.d.; or

texts.zh: b.1.b.3. 能够标注内部生成的“摄像机跟踪数据”；
texts.en: b.1.b.3. The capability for annotating internally generated 'camera tracking data';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就6A003.b.1而言，应按用于捕获运动图像的最大“有效像素”数量评估数字视频摄像机。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A003.b.1, digital video cameras should be evaluated by the maximum number of “active pixels” used for capturing moving images.

texts.zh: 2. 就6A003.b.1.b.3而言，“摄像机跟踪数据”是确定摄像机视线相对于地球的方向所需的信息，包括：(1) 摄像机视线与地球磁场方向形成的水平角；以及(2) 摄像机视线与地球地平线之间的垂直角。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A003.b.1.b.3, 'camera tracking data' is the information necessary to define camera line of sight orientation with respect to the earth. This includes: (1) the horizontal angle the camera line of sight makes with respect to the earth's magnetic field direction and; (2) the vertical angle between the camera line of sight and the earth's horizon.

texts.zh: b.2. 同时具有以下全部特性的扫描照相机和扫描照相机系统：
texts.en: b.2. Scanning cameras and scanning camera systems, having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 峰值响应波长范围大于10 nm但不超过30,000 nm；
texts.en: b.2.a. A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 10 nm, but not exceeding 30,000 nm;

texts.zh: b.2.b. 每阵列超过8,192个元件的线性探测器阵列；以及
texts.en: b.2.b. Linear detector arrays with more than 8,192 elements per array; and

texts.zh: b.2.c. 在一个方向上进行机械扫描；
texts.en: b.2.c. Mechanical scanning in one direction;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A003.b.2不适用于为下列任一用途“专门设计”的扫描照相机和扫描照相机系统：
texts.en: 6A003.b.2 does not apply to scanning cameras and scanning camera systems, “specially designed” for any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 工业或民用复印机；
texts.en: a. Industrial or civilian photocopiers;

texts.zh: b. 为民用、固定式、近距离扫描应用（例如复制文件、艺术品或照片中的图像或印刷内容）“专门设计”的图像扫描仪；或
texts.en: b. Image scanners “specially designed” for civil, stationary, close proximity scanning applications (e.g., reproduction of images or print contained in documents, artwork, or photographs); or

texts.zh: c. 医疗设备。
texts.en: c. Medical equipment.

texts.zh: b.3. 采用具有6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b所列特性的像增强管的成像照相机；
texts.en: b.3. Imaging cameras incorporating image intensifier tubes having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b;

texts.zh: b.4. 采用“焦平面阵列”且具有下列任一特性的成像照相机：
texts.en: b.4. Imaging cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.4.a. 采用6A002.a.3.a至6A002.a.3.e管制的“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: b.4.a. Incorporating “focal plane arrays” controlled by 6A002.a.3.a to 6A002.a.3.e;

texts.zh: b.4.b. 采用6A002.a.3.f管制的“焦平面阵列”；或
texts.en: b.4.b. Incorporating “focal plane arrays” controlled by 6A002.a.3.f; or

texts.zh: b.4.c. 采用6A002.a.3.g管制的“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: b.4.c. Incorporating “focal plane arrays” controlled by 6A002.a.3.g;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 6A003.b.4所述成像照相机包括“焦平面阵列”与读出集成电路以外的足够“信号处理”电子器件的组合，使其供电后至少能够输出模拟或数字信号。
texts.en: Imaging cameras described in 6A003.b.4 include “focal plane arrays” combined with sufficient “signal processing” electronics, beyond the read out integrated circuit, to enable as a minimum the output of an analog or digital signal once power is supplied.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 6A003.b.4.a不管制采用12个或以下元件的线性“焦平面阵列”、元件内部不使用时间延迟积分，且为下列任一用途设计的成像照相机：
texts.en: 6A003.b.4.a does not control imaging cameras incorporating linear “focal plane arrays” with 12 elements or fewer, not employing time-delay-and-integration within the element and designed for any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
texts.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

texts.zh: b. 用于检查或监测建筑物、设备或工业过程热流的工业设备；
texts.en: b. Industrial equipment used for inspection or monitoring of heat flows in buildings, equipment, or industrial processes;

texts.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
texts.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

texts.zh: d. 为实验室使用“专门设计”的设备；或
texts.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use; or

texts.zh: e. 医疗设备。
texts.en: e. Medical equipment.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 6A003.b.4.b不管制具有下列任一特性的成像照相机：
texts.en: 6A003.b.4.b does not control imaging cameras having any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 最大帧率小于或等于9 Hz；
texts.en: a. A maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz;

texts.zh: b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: b. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 水平或垂直方向中较小的“瞬时视场（IFOV）”至少为2 mrad（毫弧度）；
texts.en: 1. Having a minimum horizontal or vertical 'Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)' of at least 2 mrad (milliradians);

texts.zh: 2. 采用设计为不可拆卸的定焦镜头；
texts.en: 2. Incorporating a fixed focal-length lens that is not designed to be removed;

texts.zh: 3. 不含“直接观察”显示器；以及
texts.en: 3. Not incorporating a 'direct view' display; and

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A003.b.4注3.b.3而言，“直接观察”是指在红外光谱范围工作，使用含有任何光安全机制的近眼微型显示器向人类观察者呈现可见图像的成像照相机。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A003.b.4 Note 3.b.3, 'direct view' refers to an imaging camera operating in the infrared spectrum that presents a visual image to a human observer using a near-to-eye micro display incorporating any light-security mechanism.

texts.zh: 4. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: 4. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 不具备获取所探测视场可视图像的功能；或
texts.en: a. No facility to obtain a viewable image of the detected field-of-view; or

texts.zh: b. 照相机仅为单一类型应用设计，且设计为用户不可修改；或
texts.en: b. The camera is designed for a single kind of application and designed not to be user modified; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A003.b.4注3.b.1而言，“瞬时视场（IFOV）”为“水平IFOV”和“垂直IFOV”中的较小值。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A003.b.4 Note 3.b.1, 'Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)' is the lesser figure of the 'Horizontal IFOV' or the 'Vertical IFOV'.

texts.zh: “水平IFOV” = 水平视场（FOV）/水平探测器元件数量
texts.en: 'Horizontal IFOV' = horizontal Field-of-View (FOV)/number of horizontal detector elements

texts.zh: “垂直IFOV” = 垂直视场（FOV）/垂直探测器元件数量。
texts.en: 'Vertical IFOV'= vertical Field-of-View (FOV)/number of vertical detector elements.

texts.zh: c. 照相机为安装于民用载客陆地车辆而“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: c. The camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle and having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 照相机在车辆内的位置和配置仅用于协助驾驶员安全驾驶车辆；
texts.en: 1. The placement and configuration of the camera within the vehicle are solely to assist the driver in the safe operation of the vehicle;

texts.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一载体或设施中时可运行：
texts.en: 2. Is operable only when installed in any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 其预定安装的民用载客陆地车辆，且车辆重量（总重）小于4,500 kg；或
texts.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle for which it was intended and the vehicle weighs less than 4,500 kg (gross vehicle weight); or

texts.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
texts.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

texts.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的车辆中移除时强制使其停止工作。
texts.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 必要时，应请求向工业与安全局提供物项详细资料，以核实是否符合本6A003.b.4.b注中的注3.b.4和注3.c所述条件。
texts.en: When necessary, details of the items will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 3.b.4 and Note 3.c in this Note to 6A003.b.4.b.
Note 4:

texts.zh: 6A003.b.4.c不适用于具有下列任一特性的“成像照相机”：
texts.en: 6A003.b.4.c does not apply to 'imaging cameras' having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 照相机为作为集成部件安装于室内、使用墙壁插座供电的系统或设备而“专门设计”，且设计上仅限于下列单一类型应用：
texts.en: 1. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation as an integrated component into indoor and wall-plug-operated systems or equipment, limited by design for a single kind of application, as follows:

texts.zh: a. 工业过程监测、质量控制或材料性能分析；
texts.en: a. Industrial process monitoring, quality control, or analysis of the properties of materials;

texts.zh: b. 为科学研究“专门设计”的实验室设备；
texts.en: b. Laboratory equipment “specially designed” for scientific research;

texts.zh: c. 医疗设备；
texts.en: c. Medical equipment;

texts.zh: d. 金融欺诈检测设备；以及
texts.en: d. Financial fraud detection equipment; and

texts.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一系统、设备或设施中时可运行：
texts.en: 2. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 其预定安装的系统或设备；或
texts.en: a. The system(s) or equipment for which it was intended; or

texts.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护设施；以及
texts.en: b. A “specially designed,” authorized maintenance facility; and

texts.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的系统或设备中移除时强制使其停止工作；
texts.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the system(s) or equipment for which it was intended;

texts.zh: b. 照相机为安装于民用载客陆地车辆或客货渡轮而“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: b. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle or passenger and vehicle ferries and having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 照相机在车辆或渡轮内的位置和配置仅用于协助驾驶员或操作员安全操作车辆或渡轮；
texts.en: 1. The placement and configuration of the camera within the vehicle or ferry are solely to assist the driver or operator in the safe operation of the vehicle or ferry;

texts.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一系统、设备或设施中时可运行：
texts.en: 2. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 其预定安装的民用载客陆地车辆，且车辆重量（总重）小于4,500 kg；
texts.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle for which it was intended and the vehicle weighs less than 4,500 kg (gross vehicle weight);

texts.zh: b. 其预定安装的客货渡轮，且总长（LOA）为65 m或以上；或
texts.en: b. The passenger and vehicle ferry for which it was intended and having a length overall (LOA) 65 m or greater; or

texts.zh: c. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
texts.en: c. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

texts.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的车辆中移除时强制使其停止工作；
texts.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended;

texts.zh: c. 设计上将超过760 nm波长的最大“辐射灵敏度”限制为10 mA/W或以下，且同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: c. Limited by design to have a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of 10 mA/W or less for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm, having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 采用设计为不可移除或修改的响应限制机制；以及
texts.en: 1. Incorporating a response limiting mechanism designed not to be removed or modified; and

texts.zh: 2. 含有主动机制，在响应限制机制被移除时强制使照相机停止工作；以及
texts.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when the response limiting mechanism is removed; and

texts.zh: 3. 并非为水下使用而“专门设计”或改装；或
texts.en: 3. Not “specially designed” or modified for underwater use; or

texts.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: d. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 不含“直接观察”或电子图像显示器；
texts.en: 1. Not incorporating a 'direct view' or electronic image display;

texts.zh: 2. 不具备输出所探测视场可视图像的功能；
texts.en: 2. Has no facility to output a viewable image of the detected field of view;

texts.zh: 3. “焦平面阵列”仅在安装于其预定照相机中时可运行；以及
texts.en: 3. The “focal plane array” is only operable when installed in the camera for which it was intended; and

texts.zh: 4. “焦平面阵列”含有主动机制，在从其预定照相机中移除时强制使其永久无法运行。
texts.en: 4. The “focal plane array” incorporates an active mechanism that forces it to be permanently inoperable when removed from the camera for which it was intended.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 必要时，应请求向工业与安全局提供物项详细资料，以核实是否符合上述注4所述条件。
texts.en: When necessary, details of the item will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 4 above.

texts.zh: b.5. 采用6A002.a.1所列固态探测器的成像照相机。
texts.en: b.5. Imaging cameras incorporating solid-state detectors specified by 6A002.a.1.

texts.en: List of Items Controlled

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 为光刻“设备”“专门设计”的光学反射镜或“非球面光学元件”，见ECCN 3B001。(2) “受ITAR管辖”的万向架，见USML第XII(e)类。(3) 另见6A994。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) For optical mirrors or 'aspheric optical elements' “specially designed” for lithography “equipment,” see ECCN 3B001. (2) See USML Category XII(e) for gimbals “subject to the ITAR.” (3) See also 6A994.

texts.zh: 相关定义：“非球面光学元件”是指光学系统中使用的任何元件，其一个或多个成像表面设计为偏离理想球面的形状。
texts.en: Related Definitions: An 'aspheric optical element' is any element used in an optical system whose imaging surface or surfaces are designed to depart from the shape of an ideal sphere.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 下列光学反射镜：
texts.en: a. Optical mirrors (reflectors) as follows:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A004.a而言，激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）按ISO 21254-1:2011测量。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A004.a, Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) is measured according to ISO 21254-1:2011.

texts.zh: a.1. 有效光学口径大于10 mm且具有下列任一特性的“可变形反射镜”，以及为其“专门设计”的部件：
texts.en: a.1. 'Deformable mirrors' having an active optical aperture greater than 10 mm and having any of the following, and “specially designed” components therefor:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a.1.a. Having all the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a.1. 机械谐振频率为750 Hz或以上；以及
texts.en: a.1.a.1. A mechanical resonant frequency of 750 Hz or more; and

texts.zh: a.1.a.2. 超过200个致动器；或
texts.en: a.1.a.2. More than 200 actuators; or

texts.zh: a.1.b. 激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）符合下列任一条件：
texts.en: a.1.b. A Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) being any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.b.1. 使用“连续波激光器”时大于1 kW/cm^{2}；或
texts.en: a.1.b.1. Greater than 1 kW/cm^{2} using a “CW laser”; or

texts.zh: a.1.b.2. 使用重复频率20 Hz的20 ns“激光”脉冲时大于2 J/cm^{2}；
texts.en: a.1.b.2. Greater than 2 J/cm^{2} using 20 ns “laser” pulses at 20 Hz repetition rate;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 6A004.a.1:

texts.zh: 1. “可变形反射镜”是具有下列任一特性的反射镜：
texts.en: 1. 'Deformable mirrors' are mirrors having any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 单一连续光学反射面，通过施加独立扭矩或力使其动态变形，以补偿入射至该镜面的光学波形畸变；或
texts.en: a. A single continuous optical reflecting surface which is dynamically deformed by the application of individual torques or forces to compensate for distortions in the optical waveform incident upon the mirror; or

texts.zh: b. 多个光学反射元件，可通过施加扭矩或力独立动态调整位置，以补偿入射至该镜面的光学波形畸变。
texts.en: b. Multiple optical reflecting elements that can be individually and dynamically repositioned by the application of torques or forces to compensate for distortions in the optical waveform incident upon the mirror.

texts.zh: 2. “可变形反射镜”也称自适应光学反射镜。
texts.en: 2. 'Deformable mirrors' are also known as adaptive optic mirrors.

texts.zh: a.2. 平均“等效密度”小于30 kg/m^{2}且总质量超过10 kg的轻量化整体反射镜；
texts.en: a.2. Lightweight monolithic mirrors having an average “equivalent density” of less than 30 kg/m^{2} and a total mass exceeding 10 kg;

texts.zh: a.3. 平均“等效密度”小于30 kg/m^{2}且总质量超过2 kg的轻量化“复合材料”或泡沫反射镜结构；
texts.en: a.3. Lightweight “composite” or foam mirror structures having an average “equivalent density” of less than 30 kg/m^{2} and a total mass exceeding 2 kg;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A004.a.2和6A004.a.3不适用于为地面定日镜装置引导太阳辐射而“专门设计”的反射镜。
texts.en: 6A004.a.2 and 6A004.a.3 do not apply to mirrors “specially designed” to direct solar radiation for terrestrial heliostat installations.

texts.zh: a.4. 为6A004.d.2.a所列光束操纵反射镜台“专门设计”，平面度为λ/10或更优（λ等于633 nm），且具有下列任一特性的反射镜：
texts.en: a.4. Mirrors “specially designed” for beam steering mirror stages specified in 6A004.d.2.a with a flatness of λ/10 or better (λ is equal to 633 nm) and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.4.a. 直径或长轴长度大于或等于100 mm；或
texts.en: a.4.a. Diameter or major axis length greater than or equal to 100 mm; or

texts.zh: a.4.b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a.4.b. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.4.b.1. 直径或长轴长度大于50 mm但小于100 mm；以及
texts.en: a.4.b.1. Diameter or major axis length greater than 50 mm but less than 100 mm; and

texts.zh: a.4.b.2. 激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）符合下列任一条件：
texts.en: a.4.b.2. A Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) being any of the following:

texts.zh: a.4.b.2.a. 使用“连续波激光器”时大于10 kW/cm2；或
texts.en: a.4.b.2.a. Greater than 10 kW/cm2 using a “CW laser”; or

texts.zh: a.4.b.2.b. 使用重复频率20 Hz的20 ns“激光”脉冲时大于20 J/cm2；
texts.en: a.4.b.2.b. Greater than 20 J/cm2 using 20 ns “laser” pulses at 20 Hz repetition rate;

texts.zh: 特别提示
texts.en: N.B.

texts.zh: 为光刻设备“专门设计”的光学反射镜，见3B001。
texts.en: For optical mirrors “specially designed” for lithography equipment, see 3B001.

texts.zh: b. 由硒化锌（ZnSe）或硫化锌（ZnS）制成，在大于3,000 nm但不超过25,000 nm的波长范围透射，且具有下列任一特性的光学“部件”：
texts.en: b. Optical “components” made from zinc selenide (ZnSe) or zinc sulfide (ZnS) with transmission in the wavelength range exceeding 3,000 nm but not exceeding 25,000 nm and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 体积超过100 cm^{3}；或
texts.en: b.1. Exceeding 100 cm^{3} in volume; or

texts.zh: b.2. 直径或长轴长度超过80 mm，且厚度（深度）超过20 mm；
texts.en: b.2. Exceeding 80 mm in diameter or length of major axis and 20 mm in thickness (depth);

texts.zh: c. 下列光学系统用“航天级”“部件”：
texts.en: c. “Space-qualified” “components” for optical systems, as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 经轻量化，与相同口径和厚度的实心坯料相比，“等效密度”低于20%的“部件”；
texts.en: c.1. “Components” lightweighted to less than 20% “equivalent density” compared with a solid blank of the same aperture and thickness;

texts.zh: c.2. 未加工衬底、具有表面涂层（单层或多层、金属或介质、导电、半导电或绝缘）或保护膜的加工后衬底；
texts.en: c.2. Raw substrates, processed substrates having surface coatings (single-layer or multi-layer, metallic or dielectric, conducting, semiconducting or insulating) or having protective films;

texts.zh: c.3. 设计为在太空组装成光学系统的反射镜分段或组件，该光学系统的集光口径等于或大于直径1 m的单一光学元件；
texts.en: c.3. Segments or assemblies of mirrors designed to be assembled in space into an optical system with a collecting aperture equivalent to or larger than a single optic 1 m in diameter;

texts.zh: c.4. 由“复合材料”制造、在任一坐标方向的线性热膨胀系数小于或等于5 × 10^{−6}/K的“部件”；
texts.en: c.4. “Components” manufactured from “composite” materials having a coefficient of linear thermal expansion, in any coordinate direction, equal to or less than 5 × 10^{−6}/K;

texts.zh: d. 下列光学控制设备：
texts.en: d. Optical control equipment as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 为保持6A004.c.1或6A004.c.3管制“航天级”“部件”的面形或方向而“专门设计”的设备；
texts.en: d.1. Equipment “specially designed” to maintain the surface figure or orientation of the “space-qualified” “components” controlled by 6A004.c.1 or 6A004.c.3;

texts.zh: d.2. 下列操纵、跟踪、稳定和谐振腔对准设备：
texts.en: d.2. Steering, tracking, stabilisation and resonator alignment equipment as follows:

texts.zh: d.2.a. 设计为承载直径或长轴长度大于50 mm的反射镜，且同时具有以下全部特性的光束操纵反射镜台，以及为其“专门设计”的电子控制设备：
texts.en: d.2.a. Beam steering mirror stages designed to carry mirrors having diameter or major axis length greater than 50 mm and having all of the following, and “specially designed” electronic control equipment therefor:

texts.zh: d.2.a.1. 最大角行程为±26 mrad或以上；
texts.en: d.2.a.1. A maximum angular travel of ±26 mrad or more;

texts.zh: d.2.a.2. 机械谐振频率为500 Hz或以上；以及
texts.en: d.2.a.2. A mechanical resonant frequency of 500 Hz or more; and

texts.zh: d.2.a.3. 角“准确度”为10 µrad（微弧度）或以下（更优）；
texts.en: d.2.a.3. An angular “accuracy” of 10 µrad (microradians) or less (better);

texts.zh: d.2.b. 带宽大于或等于100 Hz、且“准确度”为10 µrad或以下（更优）的谐振腔对准设备；
texts.en: d.2.b. Resonator alignment equipment having bandwidths equal to or more than 100 Hz and an “accuracy” of 10 µrad or less (better);

texts.zh: d.3. 同时具有以下全部特性的万向架：
texts.en: d.3. Gimbals having all of the following:

texts.zh: d.3.a. 最大回转角超过5°；
texts.en: d.3.a. A maximum slew exceeding 5°;

texts.zh: d.3.b. 带宽为100 Hz或以上；
texts.en: d.3.b. A bandwidth of 100 Hz or more;

texts.zh: d.3.c. 角指向误差为200 µrad（微弧度）或以下；以及
texts.en: d.3.c. Angular pointing errors of 200 µrad (microradians) or less; and

texts.zh: d.3.d. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.3.d. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.3.d.1. 直径或长轴长度超过0.15 m但不超过1 m，且角加速度能够超过2 rad（弧度）/s^{2}；或
texts.en: d.3.d.1. Exceeding 0.15 m but not exceeding 1 m in diameter or major axis length and capable of angular accelerations exceeding 2 rad (radians)/s^{2}; or

texts.zh: d.3.d.2. 直径或长轴长度超过1 m，且角加速度能够超过0.5 rad（弧度）/s^{2}；
texts.en: d.3.d.2. Exceeding 1 m in diameter or major axis length and capable of angular accelerations exceeding 0.5 rad (radians)/s^{2};
d.4. [Reserved]

texts.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的“非球面光学元件”：
texts.en: e. 'Aspheric optical elements' having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 光学口径的最大尺寸大于400 mm；
texts.en: e.1. Largest dimension of the optical-aperture greater than 400 mm;

texts.zh: e.2. 在采样长度大于或等于1 mm时，表面粗糙度小于1 nm（rms）；以及
texts.en: e.2. Surface roughness less than 1 nm (rms) for sampling lengths equal to or greater than 1 mm; and

texts.zh: e.3. 在25 °C时，线性热膨胀系数绝对值小于3 × 10^{−6}/K；
texts.en: e.3. Coefficient of linear thermal expansion's absolute magnitude less than 3 × 10^{−6}/K at 25 °C;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 1. 就6A004.e而言，“非球面光学元件”是指光学系统中使用的任何元件，其一个或多个成像表面设计为偏离理想球面的形状。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A004.e, an 'aspheric optical element' is any element used in an optical system whose imaging surface or surfaces are designed to depart from the shape of an ideal sphere.

texts.zh: 2. 就6A004.e.2而言，制造商无需测量表面粗糙度，除非设计或制造该光学元件的意图是达到或超过管制参数。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A004.e.2, manufacturers are not required to measure the surface roughness unless the optical element was designed or manufactured with the intent to meet, or exceed, the control parameter.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A004.e不管制具有下列任一特性的“非球面光学元件”：
texts.en: 6A004.e does not control 'aspheric optical elements' having any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 最大光学口径尺寸小于1 m，且焦距与口径之比大于或等于4.5:1；
texts.en: a. Largest optical-aperture dimension less than 1 m and focal length to aperture ratio equal to or greater than 4.5:1;

texts.zh: b. 最大光学口径尺寸大于或等于1 m，且焦距与口径之比大于或等于7:1；
texts.en: b. Largest optical-aperture dimension equal to or greater than 1 m and focal length to aperture ratio equal to or greater than 7:1;

texts.zh: c. 设计为菲涅耳、蝇眼、条纹、棱镜或衍射光学元件；
texts.en: c. Designed as Fresnel, flyeye, stripe, prism or diffractive optical elements;

texts.zh: d. 由25 °C时线性热膨胀系数大于2.5 × 10^{−6}/K的硼硅酸盐玻璃制造；或
texts.en: d. Fabricated from borosilicate glass having a coefficient of linear thermal expansion greater than 2.5 × 10^{−6}/K at 25 °C; or

texts.zh: e. 具有内表面反射能力的X射线光学元件（例如管式反射镜）。
texts.en: e. An x-ray optical element having inner mirror capabilities (e.g., tube-type mirrors).

texts.zh: f. 同时具有以下全部特性的动态波前测量设备：
texts.en: f. Dynamic wavefront measuring equipment having all of the following:

texts.zh: f.1. “帧率”大于或等于1 kHz；以及
texts.en: f.1. 'Frame rates' equal to or more than 1 kHz; and

texts.zh: f.2. 在设计波长下，波前准确度为λ/20或以下（更优）。
texts.en: f.2. A wavefront accuracy equal to or less (better) than λ/20 at the designed wavelength.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A004.f而言，“帧率”是“焦平面阵列”中全部“有效像素”进行积分，以记录波前传感器光学系统所投射图像的频率。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A004.f, 'frame rate' is a frequency at which all “active pixels” in the “focal plane array” are integrated for recording images projected by the wavefront sensor optics.

texts.en: 6A005 “Lasers”, “components” and optical equipment, as follows (see List of Items Controlled), excluding items that are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

texts.zh: GBS：适用于6A005.b.6.d.2（6A005.b.6.d.2.b除外）管制的掺钕（玻璃除外）“激光器”，其输出波长大于1,000 nm但不超过1,100 nm，平均或连续波输出功率不超过2 kW，且以脉冲激励、非“调Q”多横模，或连续激励多横模运行；6A005.c.1、c.2和c.3管制的染料及液体激光器，但“脉冲持续时间”小于100 ns时，平均输出功率超过1 W且重复频率超过1 kHz的脉冲单纵模振荡器除外；6A005.d.2管制且连续波最大额定单模或多模输出功率不超过10 kW的CO“激光器”；6A005.d.3管制的CO_{2}或CO/CO_{2}“激光器”，其输出波长在9,000至11,000 nm范围内，脉冲输出不超过每脉冲2 J，且最大额定平均单模或多模输出功率不超过5 kW；以及6A005.d.3管制、以连续波多横模运行且连续波输出功率不超过15 kW的CO_{2}“激光器”。
texts.en: GBS: Neodymium-doped (other than glass) “lasers” controlled by 6A005.b.6.d.2 (except 6A005.b.6.d.2.b) that have an output wavelength exceeding 1,000 nm, but not exceeding 1,100 nm, and an average or CW output power not exceeding 2 kW, and operate in a pulse-excited, non- “Q-switched” multiple-transverse mode, or in a continuously excited, multiple-transverse mode; Dye and Liquid Lasers controlled by 6A005.c.1, c.2 and c.3, except for a pulsed single longitudinal mode oscillator having an average output power exceeding 1 W and a repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz if the “pulse duration” is less than 100 ns; CO “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.2 having a CW maximum rated single or multimode output power not exceeding 10 kW; CO_{2} or CO/CO_{2} “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.3 having an output wavelength in the range from 9,000 to 11,000 nm and having a pulsed output not exceeding 2 J per pulse and a maximum rated average single or multimode output power not exceeding 5 kW; and CO_{2} “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.3 that operate in CW multiple-transverse mode, and having a CW output power not exceeding 15 kW.

texts.en: List of Items Controlled

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的“软件”见ECCN 6D001。(2) 本条目管制物项的技术见ECCN 6E001（“开发”）、6E002（“生产”）和6E201（“使用”）。(3) 另见ECCN 6A205和6A995。(4) 为光刻设备“专门设计”的准分子“激光器”，见ECCN 3B001。(5) 为用于同位素分离而“特别设计”或制备的“激光器”，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见10 CFR第110部分）。(6) 受ITAR管辖的激光系统或激光器，见USML第XII(b)和(e)类。(7) 受ITAR管辖的某些基于激光的定向能武器系统、设备和部件，见USML第XVIII类。
texts.en: Related Controls (1) See ECCN 6D001 for “software” for items controlled under this entry. (2) See ECCNs 6E001 (“development”), 6E002 (“production”), and 6E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (3) Also see ECCNs 6A205 and 6A995. (4) See ECCN 3B001 for excimer “lasers” “specially designed” for lithography equipment. (5) “Lasers” “especially designed” or prepared for use in isotope separation are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110). (6) See USML Category XII(b) and (e) for laser systems or lasers subject to the ITAR. (7) See USML Category XVIII for certain laser-based directed energy weapon systems, equipment, and components subject to the ITAR.

texts.zh: 相关定义：就6A005而言：(1) “电光效率”定义为“激光器”输出功率（或“平均输出功率”）与运行该“激光器”所需总电输入功率之比，包括电源/电力调节及温度调节/热交换器，见6A005.a.6.b.1和6A005.b.6；(2) “非重复脉冲”指产生单个输出脉冲，或脉冲间时间间隔超过一分钟的“激光器”，见6A005注2和6A005.d.6。
texts.en: Related Definitions: For the purposes of 6A005: (1) 'Wall-plug efficiency' is defined as the ratio of “laser” output power (or “average output power”) to total electrical input power required to operate the “laser”, including the power supply/conditioning and thermal conditioning/heat exchanger, see 6A005.a.6.b.1 and 6A005.b.6; (2) 'Non-repetitive pulsed' refers to “lasers” that produce either a single output pulse or that have a time interval between pulses exceeding one minute, see Note 2 of 6A005 and 6A005.d.6.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 脉冲“激光器”包括以连续波（CW）模式运行并叠加脉冲的激光器。
texts.en: 1. Pulsed “lasers” include those that run in a continuous wave (CW) mode with pulses superimposed.

texts.zh: 2. 准分子、半导体、化学、CO、CO^{2}以及“非重复脉冲”钕玻璃“激光器”仅由6A005.d列明。
texts.en: 2. Excimer, semiconductor, chemical, CO, CO^{2}, and 'non-repetitive pulsed' Nd:glass “lasers” are only specified by 6A005.d.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A005注2而言，“非重复脉冲”指产生单个输出脉冲，或脉冲间时间间隔超过一分钟的“激光器”。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A005 Note 2, 'non-repetitive pulsed' refers to “lasers” that produce either a single output pulse or that have a time interval between pulses exceeding one minute.

texts.zh: 3. 6A005包括光纤“激光器”。
texts.en: 3. 6A005 includes fiber “lasers”.

texts.zh: 4. 对于通过一台“激光器”泵浦另一台“激光器”以外的手段进行频率转换（即波长改变）的“激光器”，其管制状态通过同时对源“激光器”输出及频率转换后的光学输出应用管制参数来确定。
texts.en: 4. The control status of “lasers” incorporating frequency conversion (i.e., wavelength change) by means other than one “laser” pumping another “laser” is determined by applying the control parameters for both the output of the source “laser” and the frequency-converted optical output.

texts.zh: 5. 6A005不管制下列“激光器”：
texts.en: 5. 6A005 does not control “lasers” as follows:

texts.zh: a. 输出能量低于20 J的红宝石激光器；
texts.en: a. Ruby with output energy below 20 J;

texts.zh: b. 氮激光器；
texts.en: b. Nitrogen;

texts.zh: c. 氪激光器。
texts.en: c. Krypton.

texts.zh: 6. 就6A005.a和6A005.b而言，“单横模”指光束轮廓的M^{2}因子小于1.3的“激光器”，“多横模”指光束轮廓的M^{2}因子为1.3或以上的“激光器”。
texts.en: 6. For the purposes of 6A005.a and 6A005.b, 'single transverse mode' refers to “lasers” with a beam profile having an M^{2}-factor of less than 1.3, while 'multiple transverse mode' refers to “lasers” with a beam profile having an M^{2}-factor of 1.3 or higher

texts.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”连续波“（CW）激光器”：
texts.en: a. Non-“tunable” continuous wave “(CW) lasers” having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 输出波长小于150 nm且输出功率超过1 W；
texts.en: a.1. Output wavelength less than 150 nm and output power exceeding 1W;

texts.zh: a.2. 输出波长为150 nm或以上但不超过510 nm，且输出功率超过30 W；
texts.en: a.2. Output wavelength of 150 nm or more but not exceeding 510 nm and output power exceeding 30 W;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A005.a.2不管制输出功率小于或等于50 W的氩“激光器”。
texts.en: 6A005.a.2 does not control Argon “lasers” having an output power equal to or less than 50 W.

texts.zh: a.3. 输出波长大于510 nm但不超过540 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.3. Output wavelength exceeding 510 nm but not exceeding 540 nm and any of the following:

texts.en: a.3.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' output and output power exceeding 150 W;

texts.zh: a.5.a. “单横模”输出且输出功率超过50 W；或

texts.en: a.5.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' output and output power exceeding 80 W;

texts.en: a.6. Output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and any of the following;

texts.en: a.6.a.1. Output power exceeding 1,000 W; or

texts.zh: a.6.a.2. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a.6.a.2. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.6.a.2.a. 输出功率超过500 W；以及
texts.en: a.6.a.2.a. Output power exceeding 500 W; and

texts.zh: a.6.a.2.b. 频谱带宽小于40 GHz；或
texts.en: a.6.a.2.b. Spectral bandwidth less than 40 GHz; or

texts.zh: a.6.b. “多横模”输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.6.b. 'Multiple transverse mode' output and any of the following:

texts.zh: a.6.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且输出功率超过1,000 W；或
texts.en: a.6.b.1. 'Wall-plug efficiency' exceeding 18% and output power exceeding 1,000 W; or

texts.zh: a.6.b.2. 输出功率超过2 kW；
texts.en: a.6.b.2. Output power exceeding 2 kW;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 6A005.a.6.b不管制输出功率超过2 kW但不超过6 kW、且总质量大于1,200 kg的“多横模”工业“激光器”。就本注而言，总质量包括运行“激光器”所需的所有“部件”，例如“激光器”、电源和热交换器，但不包括用于光束调节或传输的外部光学器件。
texts.en: 6A005.a.6.b does not control 'multiple transverse mode', industrial “lasers” with output power exceeding 2 kW and not exceeding 6 kW with a total mass greater than 1,200 kg. For the purpose of this note, total mass includes all “components” required to operate the “laser,” e.g., “laser,” power supply, heat exchanger, but excludes external optics for beam conditioning or delivery.
Note 2:

texts.en: b.4.b. “Pulse duration” equal to or exceeding 1 ps and any of the following:

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A005.d.1.d而言，“功率密度”指“激光器”总输出功率除以“叠阵”的发射表面积。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.1.d, 'power density' means the total “laser” output power divided by the emitter surface area of the 'stacked array'.

texts.en: d.1.e.2. Integrated connections, common for both electronics and cooling;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 通过组合6A005.d.1.e所列半导体“激光器”“叠阵”而形成、且设计为进一步组合或改装的“叠阵”，由6A005.d.1.e列明。

Note 3:

texts.zh: 6A005.d.1.e不适用于由单个“巴条”构成、设计为制造成首尾相连堆叠线性阵列的模块化组件。
texts.en: 6A005.d.1.e does not apply to modular assemblies of single 'bars' designed to be fabricated into end to end stacked linear arrays.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就6A005.d.1.e而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.1.e:

texts.zh: 1. 半导体“激光器”通常称为“激光”二极管。
texts.en: 1. Semiconductor “lasers” are commonly called “laser” diodes.

texts.zh: 2. “巴条”（也称半导体“激光器”“巴条”、“激光”二极管“巴条”或二极管“巴条”）由多个半导体“激光器”组成一维阵列。
texts.en: 2. A 'bar' (also called a semiconductor “laser” 'bar', a “laser” diode 'bar' or diode 'bar') consists of multiple semiconductor “lasers” in a one-dimensional array.

texts.zh: 3. “叠阵”由多个“巴条”组成，形成半导体“激光器”的二维阵列。
texts.en: 3. A 'stacked array' consists of multiple 'bars' forming a two-dimensional array of semiconductor “lasers”.
