texts.zh: d.4.c. 输出波长大于190 nm但不超过360 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.4.c. Output wavelength exceeding 190 nm but not exceeding 360 nm and any of the following:

texts.zh: d.4.c.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过10 J；或
texts.en: d.4.c.1. Output energy exceeding 10 J per pulse; or

texts.zh: d.4.c.2. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；或
texts.en: d.4.c.2. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; or

texts.zh: d.4.d. 输出波长大于360 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.4.d. Output wavelength exceeding 360 nm and any of the following:

texts.zh: d.4.d.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过1.5 J；或
texts.en: d.4.d.1. Output energy exceeding 1.5 J per pulse; or

texts.zh: d.4.d.2. “平均输出功率”超过30 W；
texts.en: d.4.d.2. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 为光刻设备“专门设计”的准分子“激光器”，见3B001。
texts.en: For excimer “lasers” “specially designed” for lithography equipment, see 3B001.

texts.zh: d.5. 下列“化学激光器”：
texts.en: d.5. “Chemical lasers” as follows:

texts.zh: d.5.a. 氟化氢（HF）“激光器”；
texts.en: d.5.a. Hydrogen Fluoride (HF) “lasers';

texts.zh: d.5.b. 氟化氘（DF）“激光器”；
texts.en: d.5.b. Deuterium Fluoride (DF) “lasers”;

texts.zh: d.5.c. 下列“转移激光器”：
texts.en: d.5.c. 'Transfer lasers' as follows:
d.5.c.1. Oxygen Iodine (O_{2}-I) “lasers”;

texts.zh: d.5.c.2. 氟化氘—二氧化碳（DF-CO_{2}）“激光器”；
texts.en: d.5.c.2. Deuterium Fluoride-Carbon dioxide (DF-CO_{2}) “lasers”;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A005.d.5.c而言，“转移激光器”是指通过非激光跃迁原子或分子与激光跃迁原子或分子碰撞传递能量，激发激光工作物质的“激光器”。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.5.c, 'transfer lasers' are “lasers” in which the lasing species are excited through the transfer of energy by collision of a non-lasing atom or molecule with a lasing atom or molecule species.

texts.zh: d.6. 具有下列任一特性的“非重复脉冲”钕（Nd）玻璃“激光器”：
texts.en: d.6. 'Non-repetitive pulsed' Neodymium (Nd) glass “lasers” having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.6.a. “脉冲持续时间”不超过1 µs且每脉冲输出能量超过50 J；或
texts.en: d.6.a. A “pulse duration” not exceeding 1 µs and output energy exceeding 50 J per pulse; or

texts.zh: d.6.b. “脉冲持续时间”超过1 µs且每脉冲输出能量超过100 J；
texts.en: d.6.b. A “pulse duration” exceeding 1 µs and output energy exceeding 100 J per pulse;

texts.zh: e. 下列“部件”：
texts.en: e. “Components” as follows:

texts.zh: e.1. 采用“主动冷却”或热管冷却的反射镜；
texts.en: e.1. Mirrors cooled either by 'active cooling' or by heat pipe cooling;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A005.e.1而言，“主动冷却”是一种光学“部件”冷却技术，利用光学部件表层下方（标称距光学表面小于1 mm）流动的流体从光学器件移除热量。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A005.e.1, 'active cooling' is a cooling technique for optical “components” using flowing fluids within the subsurface (nominally less than 1 mm below the optical surface) of the optical component to remove heat from the optic.

texts.zh: e.2. 为与受管制“激光器”配合使用而“专门设计”的光学反射镜，或透射或部分透射光学或电光“部件”，但熔融拉锥光纤合束器和多层介质光栅（MLD）除外；
texts.en: e.2. Optical mirrors or transmissive or partially transmissive optical or electro-optical-”components,” other than fused tapered fiber combiners and Multi-Layer Dielectric gratings (MLDs), “specially designed” for use with controlled “lasers”;
Note to 6A005.e.2:

texts.zh: 光纤合束器和MLD由6A005.e.3列明。
texts.en: Fiber combiners and MLDs are specified by 6A005.e.3.

texts.zh: e.3. 下列光纤“激光器”“部件”：
texts.en: e.3. Fiber “laser” “components” as follows:

texts.zh: e.3.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的多模至多模熔融拉锥光纤合束器：
texts.en: e.3.a. Multimode to multimode fused tapered fiber combiners having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.3.a.1. 在额定总平均或连续波输出功率超过1,000 W时（不包括通过单模纤芯传输的输出功率，如有），维持优于（小于）或等于0.3 dB的插入损耗；以及
texts.en: e.3.a.1. An insertion loss better (less) than or equal to 0.3 dB maintained at a rated total average or CW output power (excluding output power transmitted through the single mode core if present) exceeding 1,000 W; and

texts.zh: e.3.a.2. 输入光纤数量大于或等于3；
texts.en: e.3.a.2. Number of input fibers equal to or greater than 3;

texts.zh: e.3.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的单模至多模熔融拉锥光纤合束器：
texts.en: e.3.b. Single mode to multimode fused tapered fiber combiners having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.3.b.1. 在额定总平均或连续波输出功率超过4,600 W时，维持优于（小于）0.5 dB的插入损耗；
texts.en: e.3.b.1. An insertion loss better (less) than 0.5 dB maintained at a rated total average or CW output power exceeding 4,600 W;

texts.zh: e.3.b.2. 输入光纤数量大于或等于3；以及
texts.en: e.3.b.2. Number of input fibers equal to or greater than 3; and

texts.zh: e.3.b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: e.3.b.3. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.3.b.3.a. 输入光纤数量小于或等于5时，在输出端测得的光束参数积（BPP）不超过1.5 mm mrad；或
texts.en: e.3.b.3.a. A Beam Parameter Product (BPP) measured at the output not exceeding 1.5 mm mrad for a number of input fibers less than or equal to 5; or

texts.zh: e.3.b.3.b. 输入光纤数量大于5时，在输出端测得的BPP不超过2.5 mm mrad；
texts.en: e.3.b.3.b. A BPP measured at the output not exceeding 2.5 mm mrad for a number of input fibers greater than 5;

texts.zh: e.3.c. 同时具有以下全部特性的MLD：
texts.en: e.3.c. MLDs having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.3.c.1. 设计为对5个或以上光纤“激光器”进行光谱合束或相干合束；以及
texts.en: e.3.c.1. Designed for spectral or coherent beam combination of 5 or more fiber “lasers;” and

texts.zh: e.3.c.2. 连续波“激光”诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）大于或等于10 kW/cm^{2}；
texts.en: e.3.c.2. CW “Laser” Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) greater than or equal to 10 kW/cm^{2};

texts.zh: f. 下列光学设备：
texts.en: f. Optical equipment as follows:

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 可用于“超高功率激光器”（“SHPL”）应用的共孔径光学元件，见《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
texts.en: For shared aperture optical elements, capable of operating in “Super-High Power Laser” (“SHPL”) applications, see the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).
f.1. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 此前由6A005.f.1列明的物项，见6A004.f。
texts.en: For items previously specified by 6A005.f.1, see 6A004.f.

texts.zh: f.2. 为动态测量“SHPL”系统光束角操纵误差而“专门设计”，且角“准确度”为10 µrad（微弧度）或以下（更优）的“激光”诊断设备；
texts.en: f.2. “Laser” diagnostic equipment “specially designed” for dynamic measurement of “SHPL” system angular beam steering errors and having an angular “accuracy” of 10 µrad (microradians) or less (better);

texts.zh: f.3. 为相控阵“SHPL”系统相干合束而“专门设计”，且具有下列任一特性的光学设备和“部件”：
texts.en: f.3. Optical equipment and “components”, “specially designed” for coherent beam combination in a phased-array “SHPL” system and having any of the following:

texts.zh: f.3.a. 对于大于1 µm的波长，“准确度”为0.1 µm或以下；或
texts.en: f.3.a. An “accuracy” of 0.1 µm or less, for wavelengths greater than 1 µm; or

texts.zh: f.3.b. 对于小于或等于1 µm的波长，在设计波长下“准确度”为λ/10或以下（更优）；
texts.en: f.3.b. An “accuracy” of λ/10 or less (better) at the designed wavelength, for wavelengths equal to or less than 1 µm;

texts.zh: f.4. 为与“SHPL”系统配合使用而“专门设计”的投射望远镜；
texts.en: f.4. Projection telescopes “specially designed” for use with “SHPL” systems;

texts.zh: g. 同时具有以下全部特性的“激光声探测设备”：
texts.en: g. 'Laser acoustic detection equipment' having all of the following:

texts.zh: g.1. 连续波“激光器”输出功率大于或等于20 mW；
texts.en: g.1. CW “laser” output power greater than or equal to 20 mW;

texts.zh: g.2. “激光器”频率稳定性等于或优于（小于）10 MHz；
texts.en: g.2. “Laser” frequency stability equal to or better (less) than 10 MHz;

texts.zh: g.3. “激光器”波长大于或等于1,000 nm但不超过2,000 nm；
texts.en: g.3. “Laser” wavelengths equal to or exceeding 1,000 nm but not exceeding 2,000 nm;

texts.zh: g.4. 光学系统分辨率优于（小于）1 nm；以及
texts.en: g.4. Optical system resolution better (less) than 1 nm; and

texts.zh: g.5. 光学信噪比大于或等于10^{3}。
texts.en: g.5. Optical Signal to Noise ratio equal to or exceeding 10^{3}.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A005.g而言，“激光声探测设备”有时称为“激光”麦克风或粒子流探测麦克风。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A005.g, 'laser acoustic detection equipment' is sometimes referred to as a “Laser” Microphone or Particle Flow Detection Microphone.

texts.zh: 相关管制：另见6A996。本条目不管制为渔业应用或医疗诊断用生物磁测量而“专门设计”的仪器。

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 下列“磁力计”和子系统：
texts.en: a. “Magnetometers” and subsystems, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 采用“超导”（SQUID）“技术”且具有下列任一特性的“磁力计”：
texts.en: a.1. “Magnetometers” using “superconductive” (SQUID) “technology” and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 为静止运行设计、不带为降低运动噪声而“专门设计”的子系统，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”等于或低于（优于）50 fT（rms）/√Hz的SQUID系统；或
texts.en: a.1.a. SQUID systems designed for stationary operation, without “specially designed” subsystems designed to reduce in-motion noise, and having a 'sensitivity' equal to or lower (better) than 50 fT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz; or

texts.zh: a.1.b. 在1 Hz频率下运动中磁力计“灵敏度”低于（优于）20 pT（rms）/√Hz，且为降低运动噪声而“专门设计”的SQUID系统；
texts.en: a.1.b. SQUID systems having an in-motion-magnetometer 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 20 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz and “specially designed” to reduce in-motion noise;

texts.zh: a.2. 采用光泵或核旋进（质子/Overhauser）“技术”，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”低于（优于）20 pT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”；
texts.en: a.2. “Magnetometers” using optically pumped or nuclear precession (proton/Overhauser) “technology” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 20 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz;

texts.zh: a.3. 采用磁通门“技术”，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”等于或低于（优于）10 pT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”；
texts.en: a.3. “Magnetometers” using fluxgate “technology” having a 'sensitivity' equal to or lower (better) than 10 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz;

texts.zh: a.4. “灵敏度”低于（优于）下列任一值的感应线圈“磁力计”：
texts.en: a.4. Induction coil “magnetometers” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than any of the following:

texts.zh: a.4.a. 频率小于1 Hz时为0.05 nT（rms）/√Hz；
texts.en: a.4.a. 0.05 nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies of less than 1 Hz;

texts.zh: a.4.b. 频率为1 Hz或以上但不超过10 Hz时为1 × 10^{−3} nT（rms）/√Hz；或
texts.en: a.4.b. 1 × 10^{−3} nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies of 1 Hz or more but not exceeding 10 Hz; or

texts.zh: a.4.c. 频率超过10 Hz时为1 × 10^{−4} nT（rms）/√Hz；
texts.en: a.4.c. 1 × 10^{−4} nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies exceeding 10 Hz;

texts.zh: a.5. “灵敏度”低于（优于）1 nT（rms）/√Hz的光纤“磁力计”；
texts.en: a.5. Fiber optic “magnetometers” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 1 nT (rms) per square root Hz;

texts.zh: b. 在1 Hz下测量时，“灵敏度”低于（优于）8纳伏/米/√Hz的水下电场传感器；
texts.en: b. Underwater electric field sensors having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 8 nanovolt per meter per square root Hz when measured at 1 Hz;

texts.zh: c. 下列“磁梯度计”：
texts.en: c. “Magnetic gradiometers” as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 采用多个6A006.a管制“磁力计”的“磁梯度计”；
texts.en: c.1. “Magnetic gradiometers” using multiple “magnetometers” controlled by 6A006.a;

texts.zh: c.2. 磁场梯度“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.3 nT/m（rms）/√Hz的光纤“本征磁梯度计”；
texts.en: c.2. Fiber optic “intrinsic magnetic gradiometers” having a magnetic gradient field 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 0.3 nT/m (rms) per square root Hz;

texts.zh: c.3. 采用光纤“技术”以外“技术”，且磁场梯度“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.015 nT/m（rms）/√Hz的“本征磁梯度计”；
texts.en: c.3. “Intrinsic magnetic gradiometers”, using “technology” other than fiber-optic “technology”, having a magnetic gradient field 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 0.015 nT/m (rms) per square root Hz;

texts.zh: d. 使性能达到或优于6A006.a、6A006.b和6A006.c管制参数的磁场和水下电场传感器“补偿系统”；以及
texts.en: d. “Compensation systems” for magnetic and underwater electric field sensors resulting in a performance equal to or better than the control parameters of 6A006.a, 6A006.b, and 6A006.c; and

texts.zh: e. 采用6A006.a所列磁场传感器或6A006.b所列水下电场传感器的水下电磁接收机。
texts.en: e. Underwater electromagnetic receivers incorporating magnetic field sensors specified by 6A006.a or underwater electric field sensors specified by 6A006.b.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A006而言，“灵敏度”（噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A006, 'sensitivity' (noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

texts.zh: b. 为移动平台设计且同时具有以下全部特性的重力仪：
texts.en: b. Gravity meters designed for mobile platforms and having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 静态“准确度”小于（优于）0.7 mGal；以及
texts.en: b.1. A static “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.7 mGal; and

texts.zh: b.2. 使用中（运行）“准确度”小于（优于）0.7 mGal，在任何随附校正补偿和运动影响组合下，“达到稳态记录的时间”小于2分钟；
texts.en: b.2. An in-service (operational) “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.7 mGal having a 'time-to-steady-state registration' of less than 2 minutes under any combination of attendant corrective compensations and motional influences;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A007.b.2而言，“达到稳态记录的时间”（也称重力仪响应时间）是减小平台引起的加速度（高频噪声）干扰效应所需的时间。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A007.b.2, 'time-to-steady-state registration' (also referred to as the gravimeter's response time) is the time over which the disturbing effects of platform induced accelerations (high frequency noise) are reduced.

texts.zh: c. 重力梯度仪。
texts.en: c. Gravity gradiometers.

ECCN 6A998 controls, inter alia, the Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) equipment excluded by the note to paragraph j of this ECCN (6A008). (2) See USML Category XII(b) for certain LIDAR, Laser Detection and Ranging (LADAR), or range-gated systems subject to the ITAR.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A008不管制：
texts.en: 6A008 does not control:

texts.zh: —二次监视雷达（SSR）；
texts.en: —Secondary surveillance radar (SSR);

texts.zh: —民用汽车雷达；
texts.en: —Civil Automotive Radar;

texts.zh: —用于空中交通管制（ATC）的显示器或监视器；
texts.en: —Displays or monitors used for air traffic control (ATC);

texts.zh: —气象（天气）雷达；
texts.en: —Meteorological (weather) radar;

texts.zh: —符合ICAO标准并采用电子可操纵线性（一维）阵列或机械定位无源天线的精密进近雷达（PAR）设备。
texts.en: —Precision Approach Radar (PAR) equipment conforming to ICAO standards and employing electronically steerable linear (1-dimensional) arrays or mechanically positioned passive antennas.

texts.zh: a. 工作频率为40 GHz至230 GHz，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a. Operating at frequencies from 40 GHz to 230 GHz and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 平均输出功率超过100 mW；或
texts.en: a.1. An average output power exceeding 100 mW; or

texts.zh: a.2. 距离定位“准确度”为1 m或以下（更优），方位定位“准确度”为0.2度或以下（更优）；
texts.en: a.2. Locating “accuracy” of 1 m or less (better) in range and 0.2 degree or less (better) in azimuth;

texts.zh: b. 可调谐带宽超过“中心工作频率”的±6.25%；
texts.en: b. A tunable bandwidth exceeding ±6.25% of the 'center operating frequency';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A008.b而言，“中心工作频率”等于最高与最低规定工作频率之和的一半。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A008.b, the 'center operating frequency' equals one half of the sum of the highest plus the lowest specified operating frequencies.

texts.zh: c. 能够同时在两个以上载波频率上工作；
texts.en: c. Capable of operating simultaneously on more than two carrier frequencies;

texts.zh: d. 能够以合成孔径（SAR）、逆合成孔径（ISAR）雷达模式或机载侧视（SLAR）雷达模式运行；
texts.en: d. Capable of operating in synthetic aperture (SAR), inverse synthetic aperture (ISAR) radar mode, or sidelooking airborne (SLAR) radar mode;

texts.zh: e. 采用电子扫描阵列天线；
texts.en: e. Incorporating electronically scanned array antennae;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A008.e而言，电子扫描阵列天线也称电子可操纵阵列天线。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A008.e, electronically scanned array antennae are also known as electronically steerable array antennae.

texts.zh: f. 能够对非合作目标进行测高；
texts.en: f. Capable of heightfinding non-cooperative targets;

texts.zh: g. 为机载（气球或机体安装）运行而“专门设计”，且具有用于探测移动目标的多普勒“信号处理”；
texts.en: g. “Specially designed” for airborne (balloon or airframe mounted) operation and having Doppler “signal processing” for the detection of moving targets;

texts.zh: h. 采用雷达信号处理且使用下列任一技术：
texts.en: h. Employing processing of radar signals and using any of the following:

texts.zh: h.1. “雷达扩频”技术；或
texts.en: h.1. “Radar spread spectrum” techniques; or

texts.zh: h.2. “雷达频率捷变”技术；
texts.en: h.2. “Radar frequency agility” techniques;

texts.zh: i. 可在地面运行，最大“仪器显示距离”超过185 km；
texts.en: i. Providing ground-based operation with a maximum 'instrumented range' exceeding 185 km;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A008.i不管制：
texts.en: 6A008.i does not control:

texts.zh: a. 渔场监视雷达；
texts.en: a. Fishing ground surveillance radar;

texts.zh: b. 为航路空中交通管制“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性的地面雷达设备：
texts.en: b. Ground radar equipment “specially designed” for en route air traffic control, and having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 最大“仪器显示距离”为500 km或以下；
texts.en: 1. A maximum 'instrumented range' of 500 km or less;

texts.zh: 2. 配置为雷达目标数据仅能从雷达站向一个或多个民用ATC中心单向传输；
texts.en: 2. Configured so that radar target data can be transmitted only one way from the radar site to one or more civil ATC centers;

texts.zh: 3. 不具备从航路ATC中心远程控制雷达扫描速率的功能；以及
texts.en: 3. Contains no provisions for remote control of the radar scan rate from the en route ATC center; and

texts.zh: 4. 永久安装；
texts.en: 4. Permanently installed;

texts.zh: c. 气象气球跟踪雷达。
texts.en: c. Weather balloon tracking radars.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A008.i而言，“仪器显示距离”是雷达规定的无模糊显示距离。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A008.i, 'instrumented range' is the specified unambiguous display range of a radar.

texts.zh: j. 属于“激光”雷达或光探测与测距（LIDAR）设备，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: j. Being “laser” radar or Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) equipment and having any of the following:

texts.zh: j.1. “航天级”；
texts.en: j.1. “Space-qualified”;

texts.zh: j.2. 采用相干外差或零差探测技术，且角分辨率小于（优于）20 µrad（微弧度）；或
texts.en: j.2. Employing coherent heterodyne or homodyne detection techniques and having an angular resolution of less (better) than 20 µrad (microradians); or

texts.zh: j.3. 设计为按国际海道测量组织（IHO）《海道测量标准》1a等标准（第5版，2008年2月）或更高标准执行机载近岸水深测量，并使用一个或多个波长大于400 nm但不超过600 nm的“激光器”；
texts.en: j.3. Designed for carrying out airborne bathymetric littoral surveys to International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) Order 1a Standard (5th Edition February 2008) for Hydrographic Surveys or better, and using one or more “lasers” with a wavelength exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 600 nm;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 为测绘“专门设计”的LIDAR设备仅由6A008.j.3列明。
texts.en: LIDAR equipment “specially designed” for surveying is only specified by 6A008.j.3.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 6A008.j不适用于为气象观测“专门设计”的LIDAR设备。
texts.en: 6A008.j does not apply to LIDAR equipment “specially designed” for meteorological observation.
Note 3:

texts.zh: IHO 1a等标准（第5版，2008年2月）中的参数概述如下：
texts.en: Parameters in the IHO Order 1a Standard 5th Edition February 2008 are summarized as follows:

texts.zh: 水平准确度（95%置信水平）= 5 m + 深度的5%。
texts.en: Horizontal Accuracy (95% Confidence Level)= 5 m + 5% of depth.

texts.zh: 归算水深的深度准确度（95%置信水平）= ±√(a^{2} + (b*d)^{2})，其中：
texts.en: Depth Accuracy for Reduced Depths (95% confidence level) = ±√(a^{2} + (b*d)^{2}) where:

texts.zh: a = 0.5 m = 恒定深度误差，即全部恒定深度误差之和
texts.en: a = 0.5 m = constant depth error, i.e., the sum of all constant depth errors

texts.zh: b = 0.013 = 随深度变化误差的系数
texts.en: b = 0.013 = factor of depth dependent error

texts.zh: b*d = 随深度变化的误差，即全部随深度变化误差之和
texts.en: b*d = depth dependent error, i.e., the sum of all depth dependent errors

texts.zh: d = 深度
texts.en: d = depth

texts.zh: 地物探测 = 深度不超过40 m时，大于2 m的立方体地物；深度超过40 m时，为深度的10%。
texts.en: Feature Detection = Cubic features > 2 m in depths up to 40 m; 10% of depth beyond 40 m.

texts.zh: k. 具有采用“脉冲压缩”的“信号处理”子系统，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: k. Having “signal processing” sub-systems using “pulse compression” and having any of the following:

texts.zh: k.1. “脉冲压缩”比超过150；或
texts.en: k.1. A “pulse compression” ratio exceeding 150; or

texts.zh: k.2. 压缩后脉冲宽度小于200 ns；或
texts.en: k.2. A compressed pulse width of less than 200 ns; or

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A008.k.2不适用于同时具有以下全部特性的二维“船用雷达”或“船舶交通服务”雷达：
texts.en: 6A008.k.2 does not apply to two dimensional 'marine radar' or 'vessel traffic service' radar, having all of the following:

texts.zh: a. “脉冲压缩”比不超过150；
texts.en: a. “Pulse compression” ratio not exceeding 150;

texts.zh: b. 压缩后脉冲宽度大于30 ns；
texts.en: b. Compressed pulse width of greater than 30 ns;

texts.zh: c. 单个旋转机械扫描天线；
texts.en: c. Single and rotating mechanically scanned antenna;

texts.zh: d. 峰值输出功率不超过250 W；以及
texts.en: d. Peak output power not exceeding 250 W; and

texts.zh: e. 不具备“跳频”能力。
texts.en: e. Not capable of “frequency hopping”.

texts.zh: l. 具有数据处理子系统，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: l. Having data processing sub-systems and having any of the following:

texts.zh: l.1. “自动目标跟踪”，在天线任一次旋转时提供超过下次天线波束通过时刻的预测目标位置；或
texts.en: l.1. 'Automatic target tracking' providing, at any antenna rotation, the predicted target position beyond the time of the next antenna beam passage; or

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A008.l.1不管制ATC系统中的冲突告警能力或“船用雷达”。
texts.en: 6A008.l.1 does not control conflict alert capability in ATC systems, or 'marine radar'.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A008.l.1而言，“自动目标跟踪”是一种实时自动确定目标最可能位置的外推值并将其作为输出提供的处理技术。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A008.l.1, 'automatic target tracking' is a processing technique that automatically determines and provides as output an extrapolated value of the most probable position of the target in real time.
l.2. [Reserved]
l.3. [Reserved]

texts.zh: l.4. 配置为在六秒内对两个或以上“地理分散”的雷达传感器的目标数据进行叠加和相关或融合，以使总体性能超过6A008.f或6A008.i所列任一单独传感器的性能。
texts.en: l.4. Configured to provide superposition and correlation, or fusion, of target data within six seconds from two or more 'geographically dispersed' radar sensors to improve the aggregate performance beyond that of any single sensor specified by 6A008.f, or 6A008.i.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A008.l.4而言，当每个传感器位置与任何其他位置在任一方向上的距离均超过1,500 m时，视为“地理分散”。移动传感器始终视为“地理分散”。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A008.l.4, sensors are considered 'geographically dispersed' when each location is distant from any other more than 1,500 m in any direction. Mobile sensors are always considered 'geographically dispersed'.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 另见《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
texts.en: See also the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A008.l不适用于为“船舶交通服务”设计的系统、设备和组件。
texts.en: 6A008.l does not apply to systems, equipment and assemblies designed for 'vessel traffic services'.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就6A008而言，“船用雷达”是为在海上、内陆水道或近岸环境安全航行而设计的雷达。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A008, 'marine radar' is a radar that is designed to navigate safely at sea, inland waterways or near-shore environments.

texts.zh: 2. 就6A008而言，“船舶交通服务”是一种类似于“航空器”空中交通管制的船舶交通监测和控制服务。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A008, 'vessel traffic service' is a vessel traffic monitoring and control service similar to air traffic control for “aircraft.”

texts.zh: 6A102 6A002管制以外、为抵御核效应（例如电磁脉冲〔EMP〕、X射线、冲击波与热复合效应）而“专门设计”或改装且可用于“导弹”，并经设计或额定可承受总辐照剂量达到或超过5 × 10^{5} rads（硅）的辐射水平的抗辐射加固探测器。
texts.en: 6A102 Radiation hardened detectors, other than those controlled by 6A002, “specially designed” or modified for protecting against nuclear effects (e.g., Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP), X-rays, combined blast and thermal effects) and usable for “missiles,” designed or rated to withstand radiation levels which meet or exceed a total irradiation dose of 5 × 10^{5} rads (silicon).

texts.zh: 相关定义：本条目中，探测器定义为自动识别并记录或登记刺激的机械、电气、光学或化学装置；刺激例如环境压力或温度变化、电或电磁信号，或放射性材料发出的辐射。
texts.en: Related Definitions: In this entry, a detector is defined as a mechanical, electrical, optical or chemical device that automatically identifies and records, or registers a stimulus such as an environmental change in pressure or temperature, an electrical or electromagnetic signal or radiation from a radioactive material.

texts.zh: 6A103 设计为承受大于100 cal/sq cm的复合热冲击并伴随大于50 kPa的峰值超压，可用于保护“导弹”免受核效应（例如电磁脉冲〔EMP〕、X射线、冲击波与热复合效应），且可用于“导弹”的雷达天线罩。（这些物项“受ITAR管辖”。见22 CFR第120至130部分。）

(These items are “subject to the ITAR.” See 22 CFR parts 120 through 130.)

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目不管制符合民用气象雷达国际标准的机载民用气象雷达，但其不得含有下列任一项：(a) 相控阵天线；(b) 频率捷变；(c) 扩频；或(d) 为跟踪运载工具而“专门设计”的信号处理。(2) 6A108.a中为“导弹”或《美国军品清单》物项“专门设计”或改装的物项“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR第120至130部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) This entry does not control airborne civil weather radar conforming to international standards for civil weather radars provided that they do not incorporate any of the following: (a) Phased array antennas; (b) Frequency agility; (c) Spread spectrum; or (d) Signal processing “specially designed” for the tracking of vehicles. (2) Items in 6A108.a that are “specially designed” or modified for “missiles” or for items on the U.S. Munitions List are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 相关定义：激光雷达系统是采用专门的发射、扫描、接收和信号处理技术，利用激光进行回波测距、测向，以及根据位置、径向速度和目标体反射特征识别目标的系统。
texts.en: Related Definitions: Laser radar systems are defined as those that embody specialized transmission, scanning, receiving and signal processing techniques for utilization of lasers for echo ranging, direction finding and discrimination of targets by location, radial speed and body reflection characteristics.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 为用于“导弹”而设计或改装的雷达和激光雷达系统；
texts.en: Items: a. Radar and laser radar systems designed or modified for use in “missiles”;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A108.a包括下列物项：
texts.en: 6A108.a includes the following:

texts.zh: a. 地形轮廓测绘设备；
texts.en: a. Terrain contour mapping equipment;

texts.zh: b. 成像传感器设备；
texts.en: b. Imaging sensor equipment;

texts.zh: c. 景象测绘和相关设备（数字和模拟）；
texts.en: c. Scene mapping and correlation (both digital and analog) equipment;

texts.zh: d. 多普勒导航雷达设备。
texts.en: d. Doppler navigation radar equipment.

texts.zh: b. 可用于能够达到大于或等于300 km“航程”的火箭、导弹或无人航空器的下列精密跟踪系统：
texts.en: b. Precision tracking systems, usable for rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 采用安装在火箭或无人航空器上的代码转换器，结合地面或机载基准或导航卫星系统，对飞行中的位置和速度提供实时测量的跟踪系统；
texts.en: b.1. Tracking systems which use a code translator installed on the rocket or unmanned aerial vehicle in conjunction with either surface or airborne references or navigation satellite systems to provide real-time measurements of in-flight position and velocity;

texts.zh: b.2. 同时具备以下全部能力的靶场测量雷达，包括相关光学/红外跟踪器：
texts.en: b.2. Range instrumentation radars including associated optical/infrared trackers with all of the following capabilities:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 角分辨率优于1.5毫弧度；
texts.en: b.2.a. Angular resolution better than 1.5 milliradians;

texts.zh: b.2.b. 作用距离为30 km或以上，且距离分辨率优于10 m rms；
texts.en: b.2.b. Range of 30 km or greater with a range resolution better than 10 m rms;

texts.zh: b.2.c. 速度分辨率优于3 m/s。
texts.en: b.2.c. Velocity resolution better than 3 m/s.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 下列条纹照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
texts.en: a. Streak cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 记录速度大于0.5 mm/µs的条纹照相机；
texts.en: a.1. Streak cameras with writing speeds greater than 0.5 mm/µs;

texts.zh: a.2. 时间分辨率可达50 ns或以下的电子条纹照相机；
texts.en: a.2. Electronic streak cameras capable of 50 ns or less time resolution;

texts.zh: a.3. 用于6A203.a.2所述照相机的条纹管；
texts.en: a.3. Streak tubes for cameras described in 6A203.a.2;

texts.zh: a.4. 为与模块化结构条纹照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.a.1或.a.2所述性能特性的插件；
texts.en: a.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with streak cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.a.1 or .a.2;

texts.zh: a.5. 为6A203.a.1所述照相机“专门设计”的同步电子单元，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的转子组件。
texts.en: a.5. Synchronizing electronics units, and rotor assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors and bearings, that are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.a.1.

texts.zh: b. 下列分幅照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
texts.en: b. Framing cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 记录速率大于每秒225,000帧的分幅照相机；
texts.en: b.1. Framing cameras with recording rates greater than 225,000 frames per second;

texts.zh: b.2. 每帧曝光时间可达50 ns或以下的分幅照相机；
texts.en: b.2. Framing cameras capable of 50 ns or less frame exposure time;

texts.zh: b.3. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下，且为6A203.b.1或.b.2所述照相机“专门设计”的分幅管和固态成像器件；
texts.en: b.3. Framing tubes, and solid-state imaging devices, that have a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less and are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2;

texts.zh: b.4. 为与模块化结构分幅照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.b.1或.b.2所述性能特性的插件；
texts.en: b.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with framing cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2;

texts.zh: b.5. 为6A203.b.1或.b.2所述照相机“专门设计”的同步电子单元，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的转子组件。
texts.en: b.5. Synchronizing electronic units, and rotor assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors and bearings, that are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2.

texts.zh: c. 下列固态或电子管照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
texts.en: c. Solid-state or electron tube cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下的固态照相机或电子管照相机；
texts.en: c.1. Solid-state cameras, or electron tube cameras, with a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less;

texts.zh: c.2. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下，且为6A203.c.1所述照相机“专门设计”的固态成像器件和像增强管；
texts.en: c.2. Solid-state imaging devices, and image intensifiers tubes, that have a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less and are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.c.1;

texts.zh: c.3. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下的电光快门器件（克尔或普克尔盒）；
texts.en: c.3. Electro-optical shuttering devices (Kerr or Pockels cells) with a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less;

texts.zh: c.4. 为与模块化结构照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.c.1所述性能特性的插件。
texts.en: c.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.c.1.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 高速单帧照相机可单独使用，以生成动态事件的一幅图像；也可将多台此类照相机组合为顺序触发系统，以生成某一事件的多幅图像。
texts.en: High speed single frame cameras can be used alone to produce a single image of a dynamic event, or several such cameras can be combined in a sequentially-triggered system to produce multiple images of an event.

texts.zh: d. 为抗辐射加固而“专门设计”或额定，可承受大于5 × 10^{4} Gy（硅）的总辐射剂量且运行性能不降低的抗辐射加固电视摄像机或其镜头。
texts.en: d. Radiation-hardened TV cameras, or lenses therefor, “specially designed” or rated as radiation hardened to withstand a total radiation dose greater than 5 × 10^{4} Gy (silicon) without operational degradation.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: Gy（硅）指未屏蔽硅样品受到电离辐射时，每千克吸收的能量（焦耳）。
texts.en: The term Gy (silicon) refers to the energy in Joules per kilogram absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample when exposed to ionizing radiation.

texts.en: a.2. An average output power equal to or greater than 30 W;

texts.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特性的氩离子“激光器”：
texts.en: b. Argon ion “lasers” having both of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.1. 工作波长在400 nm与515 nm之间；以及
texts.en: b.1. Operating at wavelengths between 400 nm and 515 nm; and

texts.zh: b.2. 平均输出功率大于40 W；
texts.en: b.2. An average output power greater than 40 W;

texts.zh: c. 输出波长在1000 nm与1100 nm之间，且具有下列任一特性的掺钕（玻璃除外）激光器：
texts.en: c. Neodymium-doped (other than glass) lasers with an output wavelength between 1000 nm and 1100 nm having either of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 脉冲激励且调Q，脉冲持续时间大于或等于1 ns，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: c.1. Pulse-excited and Q-switched with a pulse duration equal to or greater than 1 ns, and having either of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 单横模输出且平均输出功率大于40 W；或
texts.en: c.1.a. A single-transverse mode output with an average output power greater than 40 W; or

texts.zh: c.1.b. 多横模输出且平均输出功率大于50 W；或
texts.en: c.1.b. A multiple-transverse mode output with an average output power greater than 50 W; or

texts.zh: c.2. 采用倍频使输出波长在500 nm与550 nm之间，且平均输出功率大于40 W。
texts.en: c.2. Incorporating frequency doubling to give an output wavelength between 500 nm and 550 nm with an average output power of greater than 40 W.

texts.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性的可调谐脉冲单模染料激光振荡器：
texts.en: d. Tunable pulsed single-mode dye laser oscillators having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: d.1. 工作波长在300 nm与800 nm之间；
texts.en: d.1. Operating at wavelengths between 300 nm and 800 nm;

texts.zh: d.2. 平均输出大于1 W；
texts.en: d.2. An average output greater than 1 W;

texts.zh: d.3. 重复频率大于1 kHz；以及
texts.en: d.3. A repetition rate greater than 1 kHz; and

texts.zh: d.4. 脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
texts.en: d.4. Pulse width less than 100 ns;

texts.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的可调谐脉冲染料激光放大器和振荡器：
texts.en: e. Tunable pulsed dye laser amplifiers and oscillators having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: e.1. 工作波长在300 nm与800 nm之间；
texts.en: e.1. Operating at wavelengths between 300 nm and 800 nm;

texts.zh: e.4. 脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
texts.en: e.4. Pulse width less than 100 ns;

texts.zh: 6A205.e不管制单模振荡器。
texts.en: 6A205.e does not control single mode oscillators.

texts.zh: f. 同时具有以下全部特性的紫翠玉激光器：
texts.en: f. Alexandrite lasers having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: f.1. 工作波长在720 nm与800 nm之间；
texts.en: f.1. Operating at wavelengths between 720 nm and 800 nm;

texts.zh: f.2. 带宽为0.005 nm或以下；
texts.en: f.2. A bandwidth of 0.005 nm or less;

texts.zh: f.3. 重复频率大于125 Hz；以及
texts.en: f.3. A repetition rate greater than 125 Hz; and

texts.zh: f.4. 平均输出功率大于30 W；
texts.en: f.4. An average output power greater than 30 W;

texts.zh: g. 同时具有以下全部特性的脉冲二氧化碳“激光器”：
texts.en: g. Pulsed carbon dioxide “lasers” having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: g.1. 工作波长在9,000 nm与11,000 nm之间；
texts.en: g.1. Operating at wavelengths between 9,000 nm and 11,000 nm;

texts.zh: g.2. 重复频率大于250 Hz；
texts.en: g.2. A repetition rate greater than 250 Hz;

texts.zh: g.3. 平均输出功率大于500 W；以及
texts.en: g.3. An average output power greater than 500 W; and

texts.zh: g.4. 脉冲宽度小于200 ns；
texts.en: g.4. Pulse width of less than 200 ns;

texts.zh: 6A205.g不管制用于切割和焊接等应用的较高功率（通常为1 kW至5 kW）工业CO_{2}激光器，因为此类激光器为连续波，或为脉冲宽度大于200 ns的脉冲激光器。
texts.en: 6A205.g does not control the higher power (typically 1 kW to 5 kW) industrial CO_{2} lasers used in applications such as cutting and welding, as these latter lasers are either continuous wave or are pulsed with a pulse width greater than 200 ns.

texts.zh: a.1. 用于大于250 nm的波长，由多层光学涂层组成，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: a.1. For wavelengths longer than 250 nm, comprised of multi-layer optical coatings and having either of the following:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 半强度全宽（FWHI）带宽小于或等于1 nm，且峰值透射率为90%或以上；或
texts.en: a.1.a. Bandwidths equal to or less than 1 nm Full Width Half Intensity (FWHI) and peak transmission of 90% or more; or

texts.zh: a.1.b. FWHI带宽小于或等于0.1 nm，且峰值透射率为50%或以上；
texts.en: a.1.b. Bandwidths equal to or less than 0.1 nm FWHI and peak transmission of 50% or more;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A994不管制具有固定空气隙的光学滤光片或Lyot型滤光片。
texts.en: 6A994 does not control optical filters with fixed air gaps or Lyot-type filters.

texts.zh: a.2. 用于大于250 nm的波长，且同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: a.2. For wavelengths longer than 250 nm, and having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 可在500 nm或以上的光谱范围内调谐；
texts.en: a.2.a. Tunable over a spectral range of 500 nm or more;

texts.zh: a.2.b. 瞬时光学通带为1.25 nm或以下；
texts.en: a.2.b. Instantaneous optical bandpass of 1.25 nm or less;

texts.zh: a.2.c. 在可调谐光谱范围内，波长可在0.1 ms内重新设定，准确度为1 nm或更优；以及
texts.en: a.2.c. Wavelength resettable within 0.1 ms to an accuracy of 1 nm or better within the tunable spectral range; and

texts.zh: a.2.d. 单一峰值透射率为91%或以上；
texts.en: a.2.d. A single peak transmission of 91% or more;

texts.zh: a.3. 视场为30°或更宽、且响应时间小于或等于1 ns的光学不透明度开关（滤光片）；
texts.en: a.3. Optical opacity switches (filters) with a field of view of 30° or wider and a response time equal to or less than 1 ns;

texts.en: Items: a. Carbon dioxide (CO_{2}) “lasers” having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 连续波输出功率超过10 kW；
texts.en: a.1. A CW output power exceeding 10 kW;

texts.zh: a.2. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”超过10微秒；以及
texts.en: a.2. A pulsed output with a “pulse duration” exceeding 10 microseconds; and

texts.zh: a.2.a. 平均输出功率超过10 kW；或
texts.en: a.2.a. An average output power exceeding 10 kW; or

texts.zh: a.2.b. 脉冲“峰值功率”超过100 kW；或
texts.en: a.2.b. A pulsed “peak power” exceeding 100 kW; or

texts.zh: a.3. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”小于或等于10微秒；以及
texts.en: a.3. A pulsed output with a “pulse duration” equal to or less than 10 microseconds; and

texts.zh: a.3.a. 每脉冲能量超过5 J且“峰值功率”超过2.5 kW；或
texts.en: a.3.a. A pulse energy exceeding 5 J per pulse and “peak power” exceeding 2.5 kW; or

texts.zh: a.3.b. 平均输出功率超过2.5 kW；
texts.en: a.3.b. An average output power exceeding 2.5 kW;

texts.zh: b. 下列半导体激光器：
texts.en: b. Semiconductor lasers, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 具有下列特性的单个单横模半导体“激光器”：
texts.en: b.1. Individual, single-transverse mode semiconductor “lasers” having:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 平均输出功率超过100 mW；或
texts.en: b.1.a. An average output power exceeding 100 mW; or

texts.zh: b.1.b. 波长超过1,050 nm；
texts.en: b.1.b. A wavelength exceeding 1,050 nm;

texts.zh: b.2. 波长超过1,050 nm的单个多横模半导体“激光器”，或单个半导体“激光器”组成的阵列；
texts.en: b.2. Individual, multiple-transverse mode semiconductor “lasers”, or arrays of individual semiconductor “lasers”, having a wavelength exceeding 1,050 nm;

texts.zh: c. 每脉冲输出能量超过20 J的红宝石“激光器”；
texts.en: c. Ruby “lasers” having an output energy exceeding 20 J per pulse;

texts.zh: d. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”“脉冲激光器”：
texts.en: d. Non-“tunable” “pulsed lasers” having an output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. “脉冲持续时间”大于或等于1 ns但不超过1 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.1. A “pulse duration” equal to or exceeding 1 ns but not exceeding 1 µs, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1.a. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.1.a. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1.a.1. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
texts.en: d.1.a.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1kHz; or

texts.zh: d.1.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过20 W；或
texts.en: d.1.a.2. An “average output power” exceeding 20 W; or

texts.zh: d.1.b. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.1.b. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
texts.en: d.1.b.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W;

texts.zh: d.1.b.2. “峰值功率”超过200 MW；或
texts.en: d.1.b.2. A “peak power” exceeding 200 MW; or

texts.zh: d.1.b.3. “平均输出功率”超过50 W；或
texts.en: d.1.b.3. An “average output power” exceeding 50 W; or

texts.zh: d.2. “脉冲持续时间”超过1 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.2. A “pulse duration” exceeding 1 µs and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.2.a. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.2.a. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.2.a.1. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
texts.en: d.2.a.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1 kHz; or

texts.zh: d.2.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过20 W；或
texts.en: d.2.a.2. An “average output power” exceeding 20 W; or

texts.zh: d.2.b. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d.2.b. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.2.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；或
texts.en: d.2.b.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W; or

texts.zh: d.2.b.2. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；
texts.en: d.2.b.2. An “average output power” exceeding 500 W;

texts.zh: e. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”连续波“（CW）激光器”：
texts.en: e. Non-“tunable” continuous wave “(CW) lasers”, having an output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: e.1. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.1.a. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
texts.en: e.1.a. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1 kHz; or

texts.zh: e.1.b. “平均输出功率”超过50 W；或
texts.en: e.1.b. An “average output power” exceeding 50 W; or

texts.zh: e.2. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: e.2. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.2.a. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；或
texts.en: e.2.a. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W; or

texts.zh: e.2.b. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；
texts.en: e.2.b. An “average output power” exceeding 500 W;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 6A995.e.2.b不管制输出功率小于或等于2 kW且总质量大于1,200 kg的多横模工业“激光器”。就本注而言，总质量包括运行“激光器”所需的所有“部件”，例如“激光器”、电源和热交换器，但不包括用于光束调节和/或传输的外部光学器件。
texts.en: 6A995.e.2.b does not control multiple transverse mode, industrial “lasers” with output power less than or equal to 2kW with a total mass greater than 1,200kg. For the purpose of this note, total mass includes all “components” required to operate the “laser,” e.g., “laser,” power supply, heat exchanger, but excludes external optics for beam conditioning and/or delivery.

texts.zh: f. 波长大于1,400 nm但不超过1555 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”“激光器”：
texts.en: f. Non-“tunable” “lasers”, having a wavelength exceeding 1,400 nm, but not exceeding 1555 nm and having any of the following:

texts.zh: f.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过100 mJ且脉冲“峰值功率”超过1 W；或
texts.en: f.1. An output energy exceeding 100 mJ per pulse and a pulsed “peak power” exceeding 1 W; or

texts.zh: f.2. 平均或连续波输出功率超过1 W。
texts.en: f.2. An average or CW output power exceeding 1 W.

texts.zh: g. 自由电子“激光器”。
texts.en: g. Free electron “lasers”.

texts.zh: a. 其他未列明、“灵敏度”低于（优于）1.0 nT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”。
texts.en: a. “Magnetometers”, n.e.s., having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 1.0 nT (rms) per square root Hz.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6A996而言，“灵敏度”（噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6A996, 'sensitivity' (noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

texts.zh: b. “超导”电磁传感器、由“超导”材料制造且同时具有以下全部特性的“部件”：
texts.en: b. “Superconductive” electromagnetic sensors, “components” manufactured from “superconductive” materials and having all the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 设计为在低于其至少一种“超导”组成材料的“临界温度”下运行（包括约瑟夫森效应器件或“超导”量子干涉器件〔SQUIDS〕）；
texts.en: b.1. Designed for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of their “superconductive” constituents (including Josephson effect devices or “superconductive” quantum interference devices (SQUIDS));

texts.zh: b.2. 设计为感测1 KHz或以下频率的电磁场变化；以及
texts.en: b.2. Designed for sensing electromagnetic field variations at frequencies of 1 KHz or less; and

texts.zh: b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: b.3. Having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: b.3.a. 采用最小特征尺寸小于2 µm的薄膜SQUIDS，并具有相关输入和输出耦合电路；
texts.en: b.3.a. Incorporating thin-film SQUIDS with a minimum feature size of less than 2 µm and with associated input and output coupling circuits;

texts.zh: b.3.b. 设计为在磁场变化率超过每秒1 × 10^{6}个磁通量子时运行；
texts.en: b.3.b. Designed to operate with a magnetic field slew rate exceeding 1 × 10^{6} magnetic flux quanta per second;

texts.zh: b.3.c. 设计为在地球环境磁场中无需磁屏蔽即可工作；或
texts.en: b.3.c. Designed to function without magnetic shielding in the earth's ambient magnetic field; or

texts.zh: b.3.d. 温度系数小于0.1磁通量子/K。
texts.en: b.3.d. Having a temperature coefficient less (smaller) than 0.1 magnetic flux quantum/K.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 采用化学气相沉积工艺生产，且具有下列任一特性的硒化锌（ZnSe）和硫化锌（ZnS）“衬底坯料”：
texts.en: Items: a. Zinc selenide (ZnSe) and zinc sulfide (ZnS) “substrate blanks”, produced by the chemical vapor deposition process and having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 体积大于100 cm^{3}；或
texts.en: a.1. A volume greater than 100 cm^{3}; or

texts.zh: a.2. 直径大于80 mm，且厚度为20 mm或以上；
texts.en: a.2. A diameter greater than 80 mm and a thickness of 20 mm or more;

texts.zh: b. 下列电光材料和非线性材料：
texts.en: b. Electro-optic materials and non-linear materials, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 砷酸钛氧钾（KTA）（CAS 59400-80-5）；
texts.en: b.1. Potassium titanyl arsenate (KTA) (CAS 59400-80-5);

texts.zh: b.2. 硒镓银（AgGaSe_{2}，也称AGSE）（CAS 12002-67-4）；
texts.en: b.2. Silver gallium selenide (AgGaSe_{2}, also known as AGSE) (CAS 12002-67-4);

texts.zh: b.3. 硒砷铊（Tl_{3}AsSe_{3}，也称TAS）（CAS 16142-89-5）；
texts.en: b.3. Thallium arsenic selenide (Tl_{3}AsSe_{3}, also known as TAS) (CAS 16142-89-5);

texts.zh: b.4. 磷锗锌（ZnGeP_{2}，也称ZGP、二磷化锌锗〔zinc germanium biphosphide或zinc germanium diphosphide〕）；或
texts.en: b.4. Zinc germanium phosphide (ZnGeP_{2}, also known as ZGP, zinc germanium biphosphide or zinc germanium diphosphide); or
b.5. Gallium selenide (GaSe) (CAS 12024-11-2);

texts.zh: c. 6C004.b所列以外、具有下列任一特性的非线性光学材料：
texts.en: c. Non-linear optical materials, other than those specified by 6C004.b, having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: c.1. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 动态（也称非稳态）三阶非线性极化率（χ^{(3)}，chi 3）为10^{−6} m^{2}/V^{2}或以上；以及
texts.en: c.1.a. Dynamic (also known as nonstationary) third order nonlinear susceptibility (χ^{(3)}, chi 3) of 10^{−6} m^{2}/V^{2} or more; and

texts.zh: c.1.b. 响应时间小于1 ms；或
texts.en: c.1.b. Response time of less than 1 ms; or

texts.zh: c.2. 二阶非线性极化率（χ^{(2)}，chi 2）为3.3 × 10^{−11} m/V或以上；
texts.en: c.2. Second order nonlinear susceptibility (χ^{(2)}, chi 2) of 3.3 × 10^{−11} m/V or more;

texts.zh: d. 直径或长轴长度超过300 mm的碳化硅或铍—铍（Be/Be）沉积材料“衬底坯料”；
texts.en: d. “Substrate blanks” of silicon carbide or beryllium beryllium (Be/Be) deposited materials, exceeding 300 mm in diameter or major axis length;

texts.zh: e. 玻璃，包括熔融石英、磷酸盐玻璃、氟磷酸盐玻璃、氟化锆（ZrF_{4}）（CAS 7783-64-4）和氟化铪（HfF_{4}）（CAS 13709-52-9），且同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: e. Glass, including fused silica, phosphate glass, fluorophosphate glass, zirconium fluoride (ZrF_{4}) (CAS 7783-64-4) and hafnium fluoride (HfF_{4}) (CAS 13709-52-9) and having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 氢氧根离子（OH-）浓度低于5 ppm；
texts.en: e.1. A hydroxyl ion (OH-) concentration of less than 5 ppm;

texts.zh: e.2. 综合金属纯度水平低于1 ppm；以及
texts.en: e.2. Integrated metallic purity levels of less than 1 ppm; and

texts.zh: e.3. 高均匀性（折射率变化）小于5 × 10^{−6}；
texts.en: e.3. High homogeneity (index of refraction variance) less than 5 × 10^{−6};

texts.zh: f. 在大于200 nm但不超过14,000 nm的波长范围内，吸收系数小于10^{−5} cm^{−1}的合成金刚石材料。
texts.en: f. Synthetically produced diamond material with an absorption of less than 10^{−5} cm^{−1} for wavelengths exceeding 200 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm.

texts.zh: 声学
texts.en: Acoustics

texts.zh: a. 下列“软件”：
texts.en: a. “Software” as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 为采用拖曳水听器阵列进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的声波束形成而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: a.1. “Software” “specially designed” for acoustic beam forming for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using towed hydrophone arrays;

texts.zh: a.2. 用于采用拖曳水听器阵列进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
texts.en: a.2. “Source code” for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using towed hydrophone arrays;

texts.zh: a.3. 为采用海底或海湾电缆系统进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的声波束形成而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: a.3. “Software” “specially designed” for acoustic beam forming for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using bottom or bay cable systems;

texts.zh: a.4. 用于采用海底或海湾电缆系统进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
texts.en: a.4. “Source code” for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using bottom or bay cable systems;

texts.zh: a.5. 为以下全部用途而“专门设计”的“软件”或“源代码”：
texts.en: a.5. “Software” or “source code”, “specially designed” for all of the following:

texts.zh: a.5.a. 对6A001.a.1.e管制声纳系统的声学数据进行“实时处理”；以及
texts.en: a.5.a. “Real-time processing” of acoustic data from sonar systems controlled by 6A001.a.1.e; and

texts.zh: a.5.b. 自动探测、分类并确定潜水员或游泳者的位置；
texts.en: a.5.b. Automatically detecting, classifying and determining the location of divers or swimmers;

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 为军用而“专门设计”或改装的潜水员探测“软件”或“源代码”，见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第121部分）中的《美国军品清单》。
texts.en: For diver detection “software” or “source code”, “specially designed” or modified for military use, see the U.S. Munitions List of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR part 121).

texts.zh: b. 光学传感器。无。
texts.en: b. Optical sensors. None.

texts.zh: 照相机
texts.en: Cameras

texts.zh: c. 为采用6A002.a.3.f所列“焦平面阵列”的照相机设计或改装，且为移除帧率限制、使照相机超过6A003.b.4注3.a所列帧率而设计或改装的“软件”；
texts.en: c. “Software” designed or modified for cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by 6A002.a.3.f and designed or modified to remove a frame rate restriction and allow the camera to exceed the frame rate specified in 6A003.b.4 Note 3.a;

texts.zh: 光学
texts.en: Optics

texts.zh: d. 为保持分段反射镜系统的对准和相位关系而“专门设计”的“软件”，该系统由直径或长轴长度大于或等于1 m的反射镜分段组成；
texts.en: d. “Software” “specially designed” to maintain the alignment and phasing of segmented mirror systems consisting of mirror segments having a diameter or major axis length equal to or larger than 1 m;

texts.zh: e. 激光器。无。
texts.en: e. Lasers. None.

texts.zh: 磁场和电场传感器
texts.en: Magnetic and Electric Field Sensors

texts.zh: f. 下列“软件”：
texts.en: f. “Software” as follows:

texts.zh: f.1. 为设计在移动平台上运行的磁传感器的磁场和电场“补偿系统”而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: f.1. “Software” “specially designed” for magnetic and electric field “compensation systems” for magnetic sensors designed to operate on mobile platforms;

texts.zh: f.2. 为移动平台上的磁场和电场异常探测而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: f.2. “Software” “specially designed” for magnetic and electric field anomaly detection on mobile platforms;

texts.zh: f.3. 为使用6A006.e所列水下电磁接收机对电磁数据进行“实时处理”而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: f.3. “Software” “specially designed” for “real-time processing” of electromagnetic data using underwater electromagnetic receivers specified by 6A006.e;

texts.zh: f.4. 用于使用6A006.e所列水下电磁接收机对电磁数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
texts.en: f.4. “Source code” for “real-time processing” of electromagnetic data using underwater electromagnetic receivers specified by 6A006.e;

texts.zh: 重力仪
texts.en: Gravimeters

texts.zh: g. 为校正重力仪或重力梯度仪的运动影响而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: g. “Software” “specially designed” to correct motional influences of gravity meters or gravity gradiometers;

texts.zh: 雷达
texts.en: Radar

texts.zh: h. 下列“软件”：
texts.en: h. “Software” as follows:

texts.zh: h.1. 设计为运行在空中交通管制中心的通用计算机上，且能够接收四部以上一次雷达的雷达目标数据的空中交通管制（ATC）“软件”；
texts.en: h.1. Air Traffic Control (ATC) “software” designed to be hosted on general purpose computers located at Air Traffic Control centers and capable of accepting radar target data from more than four primary radars;

texts.zh: h.2. 用于设计或“生产”同时具有以下全部特性的雷达天线罩的“软件”：
texts.en: h.2. “Software” for the design or “production” of radomes having all of the following:

texts.zh: h.2.a. 为保护6A008.e所列“电子扫描阵列天线”而“专门设计”；以及
texts.en: h.2.a. “Specially designed” to protect the “electronically scanned array antennae” specified by 6A008.e; and

texts.zh: h.2.b. 使天线方向图的“平均旁瓣电平”低于主波束峰值电平超过40 dB。
texts.en: h.2.b. Resulting in an antenna pattern having an 'average side lobe level' more than 40 dB below the peak of the main beam level.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6D003.h.2.b而言，“平均旁瓣电平”在整个阵列范围测量，但不包括主波束及主波束两侧前两个旁瓣的角度范围。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6D003.h.2.b 'average side lobe level' is measured over the entire array excluding the angular extent of the main beam and the first two side lobes on either side of the main beam.

texts.zh: d. 下列“技术”：
texts.en: d. “Technology” as follows:

texts.zh: d.1. 对光学表面进行涂覆和处理，使直径或长轴长度为500 mm或以上、总损耗（吸收和散射）小于5 × 10^{−3}的光学涂层达到99.5%或更优“光学厚度”均匀性所“必需”的“技术”；
texts.en: d.1. “Technology” “required” for the coating and treatment of optical surfaces to achieve an 'optical thickness' uniformity of 99.5% or better for optical coatings 500 mm or more in diameter or major axis length and with a total loss (absorption and scatter) of less than 5 × 10^{−3};

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 另见2E003.f。
texts.en: See also 2E003.f.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6E003.d.1而言，“光学厚度”是涂层折射率与物理厚度的数学乘积。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6E003.d.1, 'optical thickness' is the mathematical product of the index of refraction and the physical thickness of the coating.

texts.zh: d.2. 采用单点金刚石车削技术制造光学器件，在超过0.5 m^{2}的非平面表面上实现优于10 nm rms表面加工“准确度”的“技术”；
texts.en: d.2. “Technology” for the fabrication of optics using single point diamond turning techniques to produce surface finish “accuracies” of better than 10 nm rms on non-planar surfaces exceeding 0.5 m^{2};

texts.en: Items: a. Optical fabrication technologies for serially producing optical “parts” and “components” at a rate exceeding 10 m^{2} of surface area per year on any single spindle and having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 面积超过1 m^{2}；以及
texts.en: a.1. Area exceeding 1 m^{2}; and

texts.zh: a.2. 在设计波长下面形超过λ/10（rms）；
texts.en: a.2. Surface figure exceeding λ/10 (rms) at the designed wavelength;

texts.zh: b. 带宽小于或等于10 nm、视场（FOV）超过40°且分辨率超过每毫弧度0.75线对的光学滤光片的“技术”；
texts.en: b. “Technology” for optical filters with a bandwidth equal to or less than 10 nm, a field of view (FOV) exceeding 40° and a resolution exceeding 0.75 line pairs per milliradian;

texts.zh: c. 用于“开发”或“生产”6A993管制照相机的“技术”；
texts.en: c. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of cameras controlled by 6A993;

texts.zh: d. “开发”或“生产”具有下列任一特性的非三轴磁通门“磁力计”或非三轴磁通门“磁力计”系统所“必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: d. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of non-triaxial fluxgate “magnetometers” or non-triaxial fluxgate “magnetometer” systems, having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 在小于1 Hz的频率下，“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.05 nT（rms）/√Hz；或
texts.en: d.1. ‘Sensitivity’ lower (better) than 0.05 nT (rms) per square root Hz at frequencies of less than 1 Hz; or

texts.zh: d.2. 在1 Hz或以上的频率下，“灵敏度”低于（优于）1 × 10^{−3} nT（rms）/√Hz。
texts.en: d.2. ‘Sensitivity’ lower (better) than 1 × 10^{−3} nT (rms) per square root Hz at frequencies of 1 Hz or more.

texts.zh: e. “开发”或“生产”同时具有以下全部特性的红外上转换器件所“必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: e. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of infrared up-conversion devices having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 在大于700 nm但不超过1500 nm的波长范围具有响应；以及
texts.en: e.1. A response in the wavelength range exceeding 700 nm but not exceeding 1500 nm; and

texts.zh: e.2. 由红外光电探测器、发光二极管（OLED）和纳米晶体组合，将红外光转换为可见光。
texts.en: e.2. A combination of an infrared photodetector, light emitting diode (OLED), and nanocrystal to convert infrared light into visible light.

texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就6E993而言，“灵敏度”（或噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
texts.en: For the purposes of 6E993, ‘sensitivity’ (or noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

texts.zh: 7A003不适用于已由一个或多个《瓦森纳安排》参与国民航主管机关认证用于“民用航空器”的“惯性测量设备或系统”，见EAR第743部分附件1。
texts.en: 7A003 does not apply to 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' which are certified for use on “civil aircraft” by civil aviation authorities of one or more Wassenaar Arrangement Participating States, see Supplement No. 1 to part 743 of the EAR.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就7A003而言，“惯性测量设备或系统”采用加速度计或陀螺仪测量速度和方向变化，以在对准后无需外部基准即可确定或保持航向或位置。“惯性测量设备或系统”包括：
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 7A003, 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' incorporate accelerometers or gyroscopes to measure changes in velocity and orientation in order to determine or maintain heading or position without requiring an external reference once aligned. 'Inertial measurement equipment or systems' include:

texts.zh: 姿态航向参考系统（AHRS）；
texts.en: Attitude and Heading Reference Systems (AHRSs);

texts.zh: 陀螺罗经；
texts.en: Gyrocompasses;

texts.zh: 惯性测量单元（IMU）；
texts.en: Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs);

texts.zh: 惯性导航系统（INS）；
texts.en: Inertial Navigation Systems (INSs);

texts.zh: 惯性参考系统（IRS）；
texts.en: Inertial Reference Systems (IRSs);

texts.zh: 惯性参考单元（IRU）。
texts.en: Inertial Reference Units (IRUs).

texts.zh: 2. 就7A003而言，“位置辅助基准”独立提供位置，包括：
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 7A003, 'positional aiding references' independently provide position, and include:

texts.zh: a. “卫星导航系统”；
texts.en: a. “Satellite navigation system”;

texts.zh: b. “基于数据库的参考导航”（“DBRN”）。
texts.en: b.”Data-Based Referenced Navigation” (“DBRN”).

texts.zh: a. 为“航空器”、陆地车辆或船舶设计，不使用“位置辅助基准”即可提供位置，且在正常对准后具有下列任一“准确度”：
texts.en: a. Designed for “aircraft”, land vehicles or vessels, providing position without the use of 'positional aiding references', and having any of the following “accuracies” subsequent to normal alignment:

texts.zh: a.1. “圆概率误差”（“CEP”）速率为每小时0.8海里（nm/hr）或以下（更优）；
texts.en: a.1. 0.8 nautical miles per hour (nm/hr) “Circular Error Probable” (“CEP”) rate or less (better);

texts.zh: a.2. “CEP”为行进距离的0.5%或以下（更优）；或
texts.en: a.2. 0.5% distanced travelled “CEP” or less (better); or

texts.zh: a.3. 24小时内总漂移“CEP”为1海里或以下（更优）；
texts.en: a.3. Total drift of 1 nautical mile “CEP” or less (better) in a 24 hr period;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7A003.a.1、7A003.a.2和7A003.a.3而言，这些性能参数通常分别适用于为“航空器”、车辆及船舶设计的“惯性测量设备或系统”。这些参数来自采用专用的非“位置辅助基准”（例如高度计、里程计、速度计程仪）。因此，规定的性能值不能在这些参数之间直接换算。为多种平台设计的设备，须按照每个适用条目7A003.a.1、7A003.a.2或7A003.a.3进行评估。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7A003.a.1, 7A003.a.2 and 7A003.a.3, the performance parameters typically apply to 'inertia measurement equipment or systems' designed for “aircraft”, vehicles and vessels, respectively. These parameters result from the utilization of specialized non-'positional aiding references' (e.g., altimeter, odometer, velocity log). As a consequence, the specified performance values cannot be readily converted between these parameters. Equipment designed for multiple platforms are evaluated against each applicable entry 7A003.a.1, 7A003.a.2, or 7A003.a.3.

texts.zh: b. 为“航空器”、陆地车辆或船舶设计，内置“位置辅助基准”，且在全部“位置辅助基准”丢失后长达4分钟期间提供位置，“准确度”小于（优于）10米“CEP”；
texts.en: b. Designed for “aircraft”, land vehicles or vessels, with an embedded 'positional aiding reference' and providing position after loss of all 'positional aiding references' for a period of up to 4 minutes, having an “accuracy” of less (better) than 10 meters “CEP”;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7A003.b而言，本条目指为提升性能，将“惯性测量设备或系统”与其他独立“位置辅助基准”内置于单一单元（即嵌入式）的系统。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7A003.b, this entry refers to systems in which 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' and other independent 'positional aiding references' are built into a single unit (i.e., embedded) in order to achieve improved performance.

texts.zh: c. 为“航空器”、陆地车辆或船舶设计，提供航向或真北确定，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: c. Designed for “aircraft”, land vehicles or vessels, providing heading or True North determination and having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 最大工作角速率小于500 deg/s，且在不使用“位置辅助基准”时航向“准确度”小于或等于（优于）0.07 deg sec (Lat)（相当于纬度45度时6角分rms）；或
texts.en: c.1. A maximum operating angular rate less (lower) than 500 deg/s and a heading “accuracy” without the use of 'positional aiding references' equal to or less (better) than 0.07 deg sec (Lat) (equivalent to 6 arc minutes rms at 45 degrees latitude); or

texts.zh: c.2. 最大工作角速率大于或等于500 deg/s，且在不使用“位置辅助基准”时航向“准确度”小于或等于（优于）0.2 deg sec (Lat)（相当于纬度45度时17角分rms）；
texts.en: c.2. A maximum operating angular rate equal to or greater (higher) than 500 deg/s and a heading “accuracy” without the use of 'positional aiding references' equal to or less (better) than 0.2 deg sec (Lat) (equivalent to 17 arc minutes rms at 45 degrees latitude);

texts.zh: d. 提供一个以上维度的加速度测量或角速率测量，且具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: d. Providing acceleration measurements or angular rate measurements, in more than one dimension, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 不使用任何辅助基准时，任一轴上具有7A001或7A002所列性能；或
texts.en: d.1. Performance specified by 7A001 or 7A002 along any axis, without the use of any aiding references; or

texts.zh: d.2. 属于“航天级”，且提供的角速率测量在任一轴上的“角随机游走”小于或等于（优于）0.1度/√小时。
texts.en: d.2. Being “space-qualified” and providing angular rate measurements having an “angle random walk” along any axis of less (better) than or equal to 0.1 degree per square root hour.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7A003.d.2不适用于所含陀螺仪仅为“旋转质量陀螺仪”的“惯性测量设备或系统”。
texts.en: 7A003.d.2 does not apply to 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' that contain “spinning mass gyros” as the only type of gyro.

Commercially available “satellite navigation system” receivers do not typically employ decryption or adaptive antennae and are classified as 7A994. (2) See USML Category XII(d) for “satellite navigation system” receiving equipment subject to the ITAR and USML Category XI(c)(10) for antennae that are subject to the ITAR. (3) Items that otherwise would be covered by ECCN 7A005.a are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.en: b. Employing 'adaptive antenna systems'.

texts.zh: 7A005.b不适用于仅使用下述“组件”的“卫星导航系统”接收设备：该组件用于对多个全向天线的信号进行滤波、切换或合并，且不采用自适应天线技术。
texts.en: 7A005.b does not apply to “satellite navigation system” receiving equipment that only uses “components” designed to filter, switch, or combine signals from multiple omni-directional antennas that do not implement adaptive antenna techniques.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category XII(e) for gyros or angular rate sensors subject to the ITAR. (2) See also ECCNs 7A002, 7A611, and 7A994.

texts.zh: 相关定义：(1) 漂移率定义为输出偏离期望输出的时间变化率，包含随机分量和系统分量，以相对于惯性空间单位时间的等效角位移表示。(2) 稳定性定义为在稳定温度条件下测得的某一参数相对于其校准值变化的标准差（1个西格玛），可表示为时间的函数。
texts.en: Related Definitions: (1) Drift rate is defined as the time rate of output deviation from the desired output. It consists of random and systematic components and is expressed as an equivalent angular displacement per unit time with respect to inertial space. (2) Stability is defined as standard deviation (1 sigma) of the variation of a particular parameter from its calibrated value measured under stable temperature conditions. This can be expressed as a function of time.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 可用于“射程/航程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器，且在1 g环境下额定“漂移率”的‘稳定性’小于每小时0.5度（1个西格玛或均方根）的所有类型陀螺仪。
texts.en: Items: a. All types of gyros, usable in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, with a rated “drift rate” ‘stability’ of less than 0.5 degrees (1 sigma or rms) per hour in a 1 g environment.

texts.zh: b. 设计用于惯性导航系统或各类制导系统，并规定可在大于100 g的加速度水平下工作的任何类型陀螺仪。
texts.en: b. Gyros of any type, designed for use in inertial navigation systems or in guidance systems of all types, specified to function at acceleration levels greater than 100 g.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 本条中，‘稳定性’定义为衡量特定机构或性能系数在持续处于固定工作条件时保持不变的能力。（此定义不涉及动态稳定性或伺服稳定性。）（IEEE STD 528-2001第2.247款）。
texts.en: In this entry, the term ‘stability’ is defined as a measure of the ability of a specific mechanism or performance coefficient to remain invariant when continuously exposed to a fixed operating condition. (This definition does not refer to dynamic or servo stability.) (IEEE STD 528-2001 paragraph 2.247).

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 见ECCN 7A003和7A994。(2) 为军用而特别设计、改装或配置的惯性导航系统、惯性设备以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规汇编》第22编第120至130部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCN 7A003 and 7A994. (2) Inertial navigation systems and inertial equipment, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor specifically designed, modified or configured for military use are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 相关定义：7A103.a所述‘惯性测量设备或系统’采用加速度计或陀螺仪测量速度及方向变化，以便在完成对准后无需外部参考即可确定或保持航向或位置。
texts.en: Related Definitions: 'Inertial measurement equipment or systems' specified in 7A103.a. incorporate accelerometers or gyros to measure changes in velocity and orientation in order to determine or maintain heading or position without requiring an external reference once aligned.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 使用7A001、7A002、7A101或7A102所管制加速度计或陀螺仪的‘惯性测量设备或系统’，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”；
texts.en: Items: a. 'Inertial measurement equipment or systems' using accelerometers or gyros controlled by 7A001, 7A002, 7A101 or 7A102, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor;
Note 1:

texts.zh: 7A103.a不管制包含为井下作业“专门设计”并开发为随钻测量（MWD）传感器的加速度计的设备。
texts.en: 7A103.a does not control equipment containing accelerometers “specially designed” and developed as MWD (Measurement While Drilling) sensors for use in down-hole well services operations.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 7A103.a不管制使用7A001或7A002所管制且仅因NS理由受控的加速度计或陀螺仪的惯性设备或其他设备。
texts.en: 7A103.a does not control inertial or other equipment using accelerometers or gyros controlled by 7A001 or 7A002 that are only NS controlled.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 7A103.a包括姿态航向参考系统（AHRS）、陀螺罗盘、惯性测量单元（IMU）、惯性导航系统（INS）、惯性参考系统（IRS）和惯性参考单元（IRU）。
texts.en: 7A103.a. includes Attitude and Heading Reference Systems (AHRSs), gyrocompasses, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), Inertial Navigations Systems (INSs), Inertial Reference Systems (IRSs), and Inertial Reference Units (IRUs).

texts.zh: b. 设计或改装用于“射程/航程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器，包含陀螺稳定器或自动驾驶仪的综合飞行仪表系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”。
texts.en: b. Integrated flight instrument systems, which include gyrostabilizers or automatic pilots, designed or modified for use in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor.

texts.zh: c. 设计或改装用于“射程/航程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器，并能够提供圆概率误差（CEP）为200m或更小的导航精度的综合导航系统。
texts.en: c. Integrated Navigation Systems, designed or modified for use in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km and capable of providing a navigational accuracy of 200m Circular Error Probable (CEP) or less.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: ‘综合导航系统’通常包括以下“零件”和“组件”：
texts.en: An ‘ integrated navigation system’ typically incorporates the following “parts” and “components”:

texts.zh: 1. 惯性测量装置（例如姿态航向参考系统、惯性参考单元或惯性导航系统）；
texts.en: 1. An inertial measurement device (e.g., an attitude and heading reference system, inertial reference unit, or inertial navigation system);

texts.zh: 2. 在整个飞行期间定期或连续更新位置和/或速度的一个或多个外部传感器（例如卫星导航接收机、雷达高度表和/或多普勒雷达）；且
texts.en: 2. One or more external sensors used to update the position and/or velocity, either periodically or continuously throughout the flight (e.g., satellite navigation receiver, radar altimeter, and/or Doppler radar); and

texts.zh: 3. 集成硬件和软件。
texts.en: 3. Integration hardware and software.

texts.en: 7A104 Gyro-astro compasses and other devices, other than those controlled by 7A004, which derive position or orientation by means of automatically tracking celestial bodies or satellites and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 7A005, 7A611 and 7A994. (2) See USML Category XII(d) for GNSS receiving equipment subject to the ITAR and USML Category XI(c)(10) for antennae that are subject to the ITAR. (3) Items that otherwise would be covered by ECCN 7A105.b.2 are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (4) See USML Category XII(d) for GPS receiving equipment in 7A105.a, b.1 and b.3 that are subject to the ITAR.

texts.zh: 相关定义：‘导航卫星系统’包括全球导航卫星系统（GNSS，例如GPS、GLONASS、Galileo或北斗）和区域导航卫星系统（RNSS，例如NavIC、QZSS）。
texts.en: Related Definitions: 'Navigation satellite systems' include Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS; e.g. GPS, GLONASS, Galileo or BeiDou) and Regional Navigation Satellite Systems (RNSS; e.g. NavIC, QZSS).

texts.zh: 物项：a. 设计或改装用于“导弹”；或
texts.en: Items: a. Designed or modified for use in “missiles”; or

texts.zh: b. 设计或改装用于机载应用，且具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: b. Designed or modified for airborne applications and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 能够在速度超过600 m/s时提供导航信息；
texts.en: b.1. Capable of providing navigation information at speeds in excess of 600 m/s;

texts.zh: b.2. 采用为军事或政府服务设计或改装的解密功能，以获取‘导航卫星系统’的安全信号/数据；或
texts.en: b.2. Employing decryption, designed or modified for military or governmental services, to gain access to a 'navigation satellite system' secure signal/data; or

texts.zh: b.3. “专门设计”采用抗干扰功能（例如零陷控制天线或电子可转向天线），以便在主动或被动对抗环境中工作。
texts.en: b.3. Being “specially designed” to employ anti-jam features (e.g., null steering antenna or electronically steerable antenna) to function in an environment of active or passive countermeasures.

texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7A105.b.2和7A105.b.3不管制为商业、民用或生命安全（例如数据完整性、飞行安全）‘导航卫星系统’服务而设计的设备。
texts.en: 7A105.b.2 and 7A105.b.3 do not control equipment designed for commercial, civil or Safety of Life (e.g., data integrity, flight safety) 'navigation satellite system' services.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见7B101、7B102和7B994。(2) 本条不管制用于‘I级维修’或‘II级维修’的测试、校准或对准设备。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 7B101, 7B102 and 7B994. (2) This entry does not control test, calibration or alignment equipment for 'Maintenance level I' or 'Maintenance Level II'.

texts.zh: 相关定义：就7B001而言：(1) ‘I级维修’：通过控制显示单元（CDU）的指示或相应子系统的状态信息，在“航空器”上发现惯性导航单元故障。按照制造商手册，可将故障原因定位至发生故障的航线可更换单元（LRU）。操作人员随后拆下该LRU并以备件替换。(2) ‘II级维修’：将故障LRU送至维修车间（制造商的车间或负责II级维修的运营方车间）。维修车间通过各种适当方法测试故障LRU，确认并定位造成故障的车间可更换组件（SRA）模块。拆下该SRA并以可用备件替换，随后将故障SRA（也可能是完整LRU）送至制造商。‘II级维修’不包括受控加速度计或陀螺传感器的拆解或修理。
texts.en: Related Definition: For the purposes of 7B001: (1) 'Maintenance Level I': The failure of an inertial navigation unit is detected on the “aircraft” by indications from the Control and Display Unit (CDU) or by the status message from the corresponding sub-system. By following the manufacturer's manual, the cause of the failure may be localized at the level of the malfunctioning Line Replaceable Unit (LRU). The operator then removes the LRU and replaces it with a spare. (2) 'Maintenance Level II': The defective LRU is sent to the maintenance workshop (the manufacturer's or that of the operator responsible for level II maintenance). At the maintenance workshop, the malfunctioning LRU is tested by various appropriate means to verify and localize the defective Shop Replaceable Assembly (SRA) module responsible for the failure. This SRA is removed and replaced by an operative spare. The defective SRA (or possibly the complete LRU) is then shipped to the manufacturer. 'Maintenance Level II' does not include the disassembly or repair of controlled accelerometers or gyro sensors.

texts.zh: 相关定义：‘基于数据库的参考导航’（‘DBRN’）系统，是整合使用各种来源的预先测量地理测绘数据，以在动态条件下提供准确导航信息的系统。数据源包括水深图、星图、重力图、磁场图或3-D数字地形图。
texts.en: Related Definitions: 'Data-Based Referenced Navigation' ('DBRN') systems are systems which use various sources of previously measured geo-mapping data integrated to provide accurate navigation information under dynamic conditions. Data sources include bathymetric maps, stellar maps, gravity maps, magnetic maps or 3-D digital terrain maps.

texts.en: b. “Source code” for hybrid integrated systems which improves the operational performance or reduces the navigational error of systems to the level controlled by 7A003 or 7A008 by continuously combining heading data with any of the following:
