texts.en: List of Items Controlled

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见7E001、7E002、7E101和7E994。(2) 除7E001、7E002和7E101中包括MT管制的相关管制外，还见7E104中的MT管制，其适用于为实现等于或大于300 km“射程/航程”的火箭或导弹而设计或改装的、将飞行控制、制导和推进数据集成到飞行管理系统中以优化火箭系统弹道的设计“技术”；还见9E101，其适用于为实现等于或大于300 km“射程/航程”的无人驾驶航空器而设计或改装的、将飞行器机身、推进系统和升力控制面集成起来以优化无人驾驶航空器整个飞行范围内气动性能的设计“技术”。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 7E001, 7E002, 7E101, and 7E994. (2) In addition to the Related Controls in 7E001, 7E002, and 7E101 that include MT controls, also see the MT controls in 7E104 for design “technology” for the integration of the flight control, guidance, and propulsion data into a flight management system, designed or modified for rockets or missiles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, for optimization of rocket system trajectory; and also see 9E101 for design “technology” for integration of air vehicle fuselage, propulsion system and lifting control surfaces, designed or modified for unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, to optimize aerodynamic performance throughout the flight regime of an unmanned aerial vehicle.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用。
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 用于“开发”或“生产”以下任一项的“技术”：
texts.en: a. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:
a.1. [Reserved]

texts.zh: a.2. 仅以表面静压数据为基础的大气数据系统，即无需传统大气数据探头的系统；
texts.en: a.2. Air data systems based on surface static data only, i.e., which dispense with conventional air data probes;

texts.zh: a.3. “航空器”用三维显示器；
texts.en: a.3. Three dimensional displays for “aircraft”;
a.4. [Reserved]

texts.zh: a.5. 为‘主飞行控制’“专门设计”的电动作动器（即机电式、电静液式和一体化作动器组件）；
texts.en: a.5. Electric actuators (i.e., electromechanical, electrohydrostatic and integrated actuator package) “specially designed” for 'primary flight control';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7E004.a.5而言，‘主飞行控制’是使用力/力矩发生装置（即气动控制面或推进推力矢量装置）对“航空器”进行的稳定性或机动控制。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7E004.a.5, 'primary flight control' is “aircraft” stability or maneuvering control using force/moment generators, i.e., aerodynamic control surfaces or propulsive thrust vectoring.

texts.zh: a.6. 为实现“主动飞行控制系统”而“专门设计”的‘飞行控制光学传感器阵列’；或
texts.en: a.6. 'Flight control optical sensor array' “specially designed” for implementing “active flight control systems”; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7E004.a.6而言，‘飞行控制光学传感器阵列’是使用“激光”束、提供实时飞行控制数据供机载处理的分布式光学传感器网络。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7E004.a.6, a 'flight control optical sensor array' is a network of distributed optical sensors, using “laser” beams, to provide real-time flight control data for on-board processing.

texts.zh: a.7. 设计用于水下导航、使用声呐或重力数据库、定位“精度”等于或小于（优于）0.4海里的“DBRN”系统；
texts.en: a.7. “DBRN” systems designed to navigate underwater, using sonar or gravity databases, that provide a positioning “accuracy” equal to or less (better) than 0.4 nautical miles;

texts.zh: b. 用于“主动飞行控制系统”（包括“电传飞控系统”或“光传飞控系统”）的以下“开发”“技术”：
texts.en: b. “Development” “technology”, as follows, for “active flight control systems” (including “fly-by-wire systems” or “fly-by-light systems”):

texts.zh: b.1. “光传飞控系统”式“主动飞行控制系统”“所需”的、用于感知“航空器”或飞行控制组件状态、传输飞行控制数据或指令作动器运动的光子“技术”；
texts.en: b.1. Photonic-based “technology” for sensing “aircraft” or flight control component state, transferring flight control data, or commanding actuator movement, “required” for “fly-by-light systems” “active flight control systems”;
b.2. [Reserved]

texts.zh: b.3. 分析组件传感器信息，以预测并提前减轻“主动飞行控制系统”内组件即将发生的性能退化和故障的实时算法；
texts.en: b.3. Real-time algorithms to analyze component sensor information to predict and preemptively mitigate impending degradation and failures of components within an “active flight control system”;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7E004.b.3不包括用于离线维护的算法。
texts.en: 7E004.b.3 does not include algorithms for purpose of off-line maintenance.

texts.zh: b.4. 识别组件故障并重构力和力矩控制，以减轻“主动飞行控制系统”性能退化和故障的实时算法；
texts.en: b.4. Real-time algorithms to identify component failures and reconfigure force and moment controls to mitigate “active flight control system” degradations and failures;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7E004.b.4不包括通过比较冗余数据源来消除故障影响的算法，也不包括针对预期故障预先离线规划的响应。
texts.en: 7E004.b.4 does not include algorithms for the elimination of fault effects through comparison of redundant data sources, or off-line pre-planned responses to anticipated failures.

texts.zh: b.5. 将数字飞行控制、导航和推进控制数据集成到数字飞行管理系统中，以实现“全飞行控制”；
texts.en: b.5. Integration of digital flight control, navigation and propulsion control data, into a digital flight management system for “total control of flight”;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7E004.b.5不适用于：
texts.en: 7E004.b.5 does not apply to:

texts.zh: 1. 将数字飞行控制、导航和推进控制数据集成到数字飞行管理系统中，以实现‘飞行航迹优化’的“技术”；
texts.en: 1. “Technology” for integration of digital flight control, navigation and propulsion control data, into a digital flight management system for 'flight path optimization';

texts.zh: 2. 仅为VOR、DME、ILS或MLS导航或进近而集成的“航空器”飞行仪表系统的“技术”。
texts.en: 2. “Technology” for “aircraft” flight instrument systems integrated solely for VOR, DME, ILS or MLS navigation or approaches.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: ‘飞行航迹优化’是一种以最大化任务性能或效能为基础、使相对于期望四维（空间和时间）轨迹的偏差最小化的程序。
texts.en: 'Flight path optimization' is a procedure that minimizes deviations from a four-dimensional (space and time) desired trajectory based on maximizing performance or effectiveness for mission tasks.
b.6. [Reserved]

texts.zh: b.7. 为推导具有以下全部特性的“电传飞控系统”的功能要求而“所需”的“技术”：
texts.en: b.7. “Technology” “required” for deriving the functional requirements for “fly-by-wire systems” having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.7.a. 要求闭环速率为40 Hz或以上的‘内环’机体稳定性控制；以及
texts.en: b.7.a. 'Inner-loop' airframe stability controls requiring loop closure rates of 40 Hz or greater; and

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7E004.b.7.a而言，‘内环’是指“主动飞行控制系统”中使机体稳定性控制自动化的功能。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7E004.b.7.a, 'inner-loop' refers to functions of “active flight control systems” that automate airframe stability controls.

texts.zh: b.7.b. 具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: b.7.b. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.7.b.1. 对在设计飞行包线内任一点测得的气动不稳定机体进行纠正；该机体若未在0.5秒内得到纠正，将失去可恢复的控制；
texts.en: b.7.b.1. Corrects an aerodynamically unstable airframe, measured at any point in the design flight envelope, that would lose recoverable control if not corrected within 0.5 seconds;

texts.zh: b.7.b.2. 在补偿‘航空器状态异常变化’的同时，耦合两个或多个轴的控制；
texts.en: b.7.b.2. Couples controls in two or more axes while compensating for 'abnormal changes in aircraft state';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7E004.b.7.b.2而言，‘航空器状态异常变化’包括飞行中结构损坏、发动机推力丧失、控制面失效，或导致失稳的货物载荷移位。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7E004.b.7.b.2, 'abnormal changes in aircraft state' include in-flight structural damage, loss of engine thrust, disabled control surface, or destabilizing shifts in cargo load.

texts.zh: b.7.b.3. 执行7E004.b.5规定的功能；或
texts.en: b.7.b.3. Performs the functions specified in 7E004.b.5; or

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7E004.b.7.b.3不适用于自动驾驶仪。
texts.en: 7E004.b.7.b.3 does not apply to autopilots.

texts.zh: b.7.b.4. 使“航空器”能够在起飞或着陆以外的阶段，在攻角大于18度、侧滑角大于15度、俯仰或偏航角速度大于15度/秒，或滚转角速度大于90度/秒的条件下保持稳定受控飞行；
texts.en: b.7.b.4. Enables ”aircraft” to have stable controlled flight, other than during take-off or landing, at greater than 18 degrees angle of attack, 15 degrees side slip, 15 degrees/second pitch or yaw rate, or 90 degrees/second roll rate;

texts.zh: b.8. 为推导“电传飞控系统”的功能要求以实现以下全部目标而“所需”的“技术”：
texts.en: b.8. “Technology” “required” for deriving the functional requirements of “fly-by-wire systems” to achieve all of the following:

texts.zh: b.8.a. “电传飞控系统”内任意两个单独故障相继发生时，“航空器”不会失控；以及
texts.en: b.8.a. No loss of control of the ”aircraft” in the event of a consecutive sequence of any two individual faults within the “fly-by-wire system”; and

texts.zh: b.8.b. “航空器”失控的概率小于（优于）每飞行小时1 × 10^{−9}次故障；
texts.en: b.8.b. Probability of loss of control of the ”aircraft” being less (better) than 1 × 10^{−9} failures per flight hour;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 7E004.b不适用于与不提供特定飞行控制系统功能的通用计算机要素和实用程序（例如输入信号采集、输出信号传输、计算机“程序”和数据加载、内置测试、任务调度机制）有关的“技术”。
texts.en: 7E004.b does not apply to “technology” associated with common computer elements and utilities (e.g., input signal acquisition, output signal transmission, computer “program” and data loading, built-in test, task scheduling mechanisms) not providing a specific flight control system function.

texts.zh: c. 用于“开发”以下直升机系统的“技术”：
texts.en: c. “Technology” for the “development” of helicopter systems, as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 将以下至少两项功能组合到一个控制元件中的多轴电传或光传控制器：
texts.en: c.1. Multi-axis fly-by-wire or fly-by-light controllers, which combine the functions of at least two of the following into one controlling element:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 总距控制；
texts.en: c.1.a. Collective controls;

texts.zh: c.1.b. 周期变距控制；
texts.en: c.1.b. Cyclic controls;

texts.zh: c.1.c. 偏航控制；
texts.en: c.1.c. Yaw controls;

texts.zh: c.2. “环量控制反扭矩系统或环量控制方向控制系统”；
texts.en: c.2. “Circulation-controlled anti-torque or circulation-controlled direction control systems”;

texts.zh: c.3. 装有‘可变几何翼型’、用于采用单独桨叶控制的系统的旋翼桨叶。
texts.en: c.3. Rotor blades incorporating 'variable geometry airfoils', for use in systems using individual blade control.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就7E004.c.3而言，‘可变几何翼型’使用后缘襟翼或调整片，或前缘缝翼或枢转式下垂前缘，其位置可在飞行中控制。
texts.en: For the purposes of 7E004.c.3, 'variable geometry airfoils' use trailing edge flaps or tabs, or leading edge slats or pivoted nose droop, the position of which can be controlled in flight.

7E101 “Technology,” according to the General Technology Note for the “use” of equipment controlled by 7A001 to 7A006, 7A101 to 7A107, 7A115 to 7A117, 7B001, 7B002, 7B003, 7B101, 7B102, 7B103, or 7D101 to 7D103 for MT reasons.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 设计工作深度超过1,000 m的有人有缆潜水器；
texts.en: a. Manned, tethered submersible vehicles designed to operate at depths exceeding 1,000 m;

texts.zh: b. 具有以下任一特性的有人无缆潜水器：
texts.en: b. Manned, untethered submersible vehicles having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 设计为可‘自主运行’，且起重能力同时满足以下全部条件：
texts.en: b.1. Designed to 'operate autonomously' and having a lifting capacity of all the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 达到其在空气中重量的10%或以上；以及
texts.en: b.1.a. 10% or more of their weight in air; and

texts.zh: b.1.b. 15 kN或以上；
texts.en: b.1.b. 15 kN or more;

texts.zh: b.2. 设计工作深度超过1,000 m；或
texts.en: b.2. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 1,000 m; or

texts.zh: b.3. 具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: b.3. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.3.a. 设计为可连续‘自主运行’10小时或以上；以及
texts.en: b.3.a. Designed to continuously 'operate autonomously' for 10 hours or more; and

texts.zh: b.3.b. ‘航程’为25海里或以上；
texts.en: b.3.b. 'Range' of 25 nautical miles or more;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就8A001.b而言，‘自主运行’是指完全潜入水下、不使用通气管、所有系统均工作，并以仅使用深度舵即可安全动态控制深度的最低速度巡航，无需水面、海底或岸上的支援船舶或支援基地，且配有供水下或水面使用的推进系统。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 8A001.b, 'operate autonomously' means fully submerged, without snorkel, all systems working and cruising at minimum speed at which the submersible can safely control its depth dynamically by using its depth planes only, with no need for a support vessel or support base on the surface, sea-bed or shore, and containing a propulsion system for submerged or surface use.

texts.zh: 2. 就8A001.b而言，‘航程’是指潜水器能够‘自主运行’的最大距离的一半。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 8A001.b, 'range' means half the maximum distance a submersible vehicle can 'operate autonomously'.

texts.zh: c. 以下无人潜水器：
texts.en: c. Unmanned submersible vehicles as follows:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下任一特性的无人潜水器：
texts.en: c.1. Unmanned submersible vehicles having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 设计为无需实时人工协助即可相对于任何地理参照确定航向；
texts.en: c.1.a. Designed for deciding a course relative to any geographical reference without real-time human assistance;

texts.zh: c.1.b. 声学数据或指令链路；或
texts.en: c.1.b. Acoustic data or command link; or

texts.zh: c.1.c. 距离超过1,000 m的无线光学数据或指令链路；
texts.en: c.1.c. Wireless optical data or command link exceeding 1,000 m;

texts.zh: c.2. 未在8A001.c.1中列明且具有以下全部特性的无人潜水器：
texts.en: c.2. Unmanned, submersible vehicles, not specified in 8A001.c.1, having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.2.a. 设计为通过系缆运行；
texts.en: c.2.a. Designed to operate with a tether;

texts.zh: c.2.b. 设计工作深度超过1,000 m；以及
texts.en: c.2.b. Designed to operate at depths exceeding 1,000 m; and

texts.zh: c.2.c. 具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: c.2.c. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.2.c.1. 设计为使用8A002.a.2所述推进电动机或推进器进行自航机动；或
texts.en: c.2.c.1. Designed for self-propelled maneuver using propulsion motors or thrusters specified by 8A002.a.2; or

texts.zh: c.2.c.2. 光纤数据链路；
texts.en: c.2.c.2. Fiber optic data link;

texts.zh: d. [保留]
texts.en: d. [Reserved]

texts.zh: e. 用于从超过250 m的深度打捞物体、起重能力超过5 MN且具有以下任一特性的海洋打捞系统：
texts.en: e. Ocean salvage systems with a lifting capacity exceeding 5 MN for salvaging objects from depths exceeding 250 m and having any of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. 能够将位置保持在导航系统提供的给定点20 m以内的动力定位系统；或
texts.en: e.1. Dynamic positioning systems capable of position keeping within 20 m of a given point provided by the navigation system; or

texts.zh: e.2. 用于超过1,000 m的深度、定位“精度”在预定点10 m以内的海底导航系统和导航综合系统。
texts.en: e.2. Seafloor navigation and navigation integration systems, for depths exceeding 1,000 m and with positioning “accuracies” to within 10 m of a predetermined point.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见8A992；水下通信系统见第5类第I部分——电信。(2) 未由8A002管制或根据8A002.q注释解除管制的自给式水下呼吸器，另见8A992。(3) 为水下使用“专门设计”或改装、包含6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b所述像增强管的电子成像系统，见6A003.b.3。(4) 为水下使用“专门设计”或改装、包含6A002.a.3.g所述“焦平面阵列”的电子成像系统，见6A003.b.4.c。(5) 对于为军事最终用户使用或装入ECCN 0A919所管制物项而出口、再出口或转移（境内）的8A002.d所述商品，第744.9节规定了许可证要求。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 8A992 and for underwater communications systems, see Category 5, Part I—Telecommunications. (2) See also 8A992 for self-contained underwater breathing apparatus that is not controlled by 8A002 or released for control by the 8A002.q Note. (3) For electronic imaging systems “specially designed” or modified for underwater use incorporating image intensifier tubes specified by 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b, see 6A003.b.3. (4) For electronic imaging systems “specially designed” or modified for underwater use incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by 6A002.a.3.g, see 6A003.b.4.c. (5) Section 744.9 imposes a license requirement on commodities described in 8A002.d if being exported, reexported, or transferred (in-country) for use by a military end-user or for incorporation into an item controlled by ECCN 0A919.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为潜水器“专门设计”或改装、且设计工作深度超过1,000 m的以下系统、设备、“零件”和“组件”：
texts.en: a. Systems, equipment, “parts” and “components,” “specially designed” or modified for submersible vehicles and designed to operate at depths exceeding 1,000 m, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 舱室最大内径超过1.5 m的耐压壳体或耐压艇体；
texts.en: a.1. Pressure housings or pressure hulls with a maximum inside chamber diameter exceeding 1.5 m;

texts.zh: a.2. 直流推进电动机或推进器；
texts.en: a.2. Direct current propulsion motors or thrusters;

texts.zh: a.3. 使用光纤且具有合成材料承力构件的脐带缆及其连接器；
texts.en: a.3. Umbilical cables, and connectors therefor, using optical fiber and having synthetic strength members;

texts.zh: a.4. 由ECCN 8C001所述材料制造的“零件”和“组件”；
texts.en: a.4. “Parts” and “components” manufactured from material specified by ECCN 8C001;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就8A002.a.4而言，不得通过出口已完成中间制造阶段但尚未形成最终组件形态的8C001所管制‘复合泡沫材料’来规避本条。
texts.en: For the purposes of 8A002.a.4, this entry should not be defeated by the export of 'syntactic foam' controlled by 8C001 when an intermediate stage of manufacture has been performed and it is not yet in its final component form.

texts.zh: b. 为自动控制8A001所管制潜水器的运动而“专门设计”或改装、使用导航数据、具有闭环伺服控制且具有以下任一特性的系统：
texts.en: b. Systems “specially designed” or modified for the automated control of the motion of submersible vehicles controlled by 8A001, using navigation data, having closed loop servo-controls and having any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 使潜水器能够移动到水体中预定点10 m以内；
texts.en: b.1. Enabling a vehicle to move within 10 m of a predetermined point in the water column;

texts.zh: b.2. 将潜水器的位置保持在水体中预定点10 m以内；或
texts.en: b.2. Maintaining the position of the vehicle within 10 m of a predetermined point in the water column; or

texts.zh: b.3. 在沿海床上或海床下的电缆航行时，将潜水器的位置保持在10 m以内；
texts.en: b.3. Maintaining the position of the vehicle within 10 m while following a cable on or under the seabed;

texts.zh: c. 光纤耐压壳体贯穿件；
texts.en: c. Fiber optic pressure hull penetrators;

texts.zh: d. 具有以下全部特性的水下视觉系统：
texts.en: d. Underwater vision systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: d.1. 为通过水下航行器进行遥控操作而“专门设计”或改装；以及
texts.en: d.1. “Specially designed” or modified for remote operation with an underwater vehicle; and

texts.zh: d.2. 采用以下任一技术以尽量减小后向散射的影响：
texts.en: d.2. Employing any of the following techniques to minimize the effects of back scatter:

texts.zh: d.2.a. 距离选通照明器；或
texts.en: d.2.a. Range-gated illuminators; or

texts.zh: d.2.b. 距离选通“激光”系统；
texts.en: d.2.b. Range-gated “laser” systems;

texts.zh: e. [保留]
texts.en: e. [Reserved]

texts.zh: f. [保留]
texts.en: f. [Reserved]

texts.zh: g. 为水下使用“专门设计”或改装的以下照明系统：
texts.en: g. Light systems “specially designed” or modified for underwater use, as follows:

texts.zh: g.1. 每次闪光的光输出能量超过300 J且闪光频率超过每秒5次的频闪照明系统；
texts.en: g.1. Stroboscopic light systems capable of a light output energy of more than 300 J per flash and a flash rate of more than 5 flashes per second;

texts.zh: g.2. 为在1,000 m以下使用而“专门设计”的氩弧照明系统；
texts.en: g.2. Argon arc light systems “specially designed” for use below 1,000 m;

texts.zh: h. 为水下使用“专门设计”、通过专用计算机控制且具有以下任一特性的“机器人”：
texts.en: h. “Robots” “specially designed” for underwater use, controlled by using a dedicated computer and having any of the following:

texts.zh: h.1. 使用传感器信息控制“机器人”的系统，该传感器测量施加于外部物体的力或扭矩、至外部物体的距离，或“机器人”与外部物体之间的触觉；或
texts.en: h.1. Systems that control the “robot” using information from sensors which measure force or torque applied to an external object, distance to an external object, or tactile sense between the “robot” and an external object; or

texts.zh: h.2. 能够施加250 N或以上的力或250 Nm或以上的扭矩，并在其结构构件中使用钛基合金或“复合”“纤维或纤丝材料”；
texts.en: h.2. The ability to exert a force of 250 N or more or a torque of 250 Nm or more and using titanium based alloys or “composite” “fibrous or filamentary materials” in their structural members;

texts.zh: i. 为与潜水器配套使用而“专门设计”或改装、且具有以下任一特性的遥控关节式机械手：
texts.en: i. Remotely controlled articulated manipulators “specially designed” or modified for use with submersible vehicles and having any of the following:

texts.zh: i.1. 使用测量以下任一项的传感器所提供的信息控制机械手的系统：
texts.en: i.1. Systems which control the manipulator using information from sensors which measure any of the following:

texts.zh: i.1.a. 施加于外部物体的扭矩或力；或
texts.en: i.1.a. Torque or force applied to an external object; or

texts.zh: i.1.b. 机械手与外部物体之间的触觉；或
texts.en: i.1.b. Tactile sense between the manipulator and an external object; or

texts.zh: i.2. 通过比例主从技术控制，且具有5个或以上‘运动自由度’；
texts.en: i.2. Controlled by proportional master-slave techniques and having 5 degrees of 'freedom of movement' or more;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就8A002.i.2而言，在确定‘运动自由度’数量时，只计入使用位置反馈进行按比例关联的运动控制的功能。
texts.en: For the purposes of 8A002.i.2, only functions having proportionally related motion control using positional feedback are counted when determining the number of degrees of 'freedom of movement'.

texts.zh: j. 为水下使用“专门设计”的以下不依赖空气动力系统：
texts.en: j. Air independent power systems “specially designed” for underwater use, as follows:

texts.zh: j.1. 具有以下任一特性的布雷顿循环或朗肯循环发动机不依赖空气动力系统：
texts.en: j.1. Brayton or Rankine cycle engine air independent power systems having any of the following:

texts.zh: j.1.a. 为从再循环发动机排气中去除二氧化碳、一氧化碳和颗粒物而“专门设计”的化学洗涤器或吸收器系统；
texts.en: j.1.a. Chemical scrubber or absorber systems, “specially designed” to remove carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and particulates from recirculated engine exhaust;

texts.zh: j.1.b. 为使用单原子气体而“专门设计”的系统；
texts.en: j.1.b. Systems “specially designed” to use a monoatomic gas;

texts.zh: j.1.c. 为降低10 kHz以下频率的水下噪声而“专门设计”的装置或外壳，或专用减振安装装置；或
texts.en: j.1.c. Devices or enclosures, “specially designed” for underwater noise reduction in frequencies below 10 kHz, or special mounting devices for shock mitigation; or

texts.zh: j.1.d. 具有以下全部特性的系统：
texts.en: j.1.d. Systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: j.1.d.1. 为对反应产物加压或进行燃料重整而“专门设计”；
texts.en: j.1.d.1. “Specially designed” to pressurize the products of reaction or for fuel reformation;

texts.zh: j.1.d.2. 为储存反应产物而“专门设计”；以及
texts.en: j.1.d.2. “Specially designed” to store the products of the reaction; and

texts.zh: j.1.d.3. 为在100 kPa或以上的背压下排出反应产物而“专门设计”；
texts.en: j.1.d.3. “Specially designed” to discharge the products of the reaction against a pressure of 100 kPa or more;

texts.zh: j.2. 具有以下全部特性的柴油循环发动机不依赖空气系统：
texts.en: j.2. Diesel cycle engine air independent systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: j.2.a. 为从再循环发动机排气中去除二氧化碳、一氧化碳和颗粒物而“专门设计”的化学洗涤器或吸收器系统；
texts.en: j.2.a. Chemical scrubber or absorber systems, “specially designed” to remove carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and particulates from recirculated engine exhaust;

texts.zh: j.2.b. 为使用单原子气体而“专门设计”的系统；
texts.en: j.2.b. Systems “specially designed” to use a monoatomic gas;

texts.zh: j.2.c. 为降低10 kHz以下频率的水下噪声而“专门设计”的装置或外壳，或专用减振安装装置；以及
texts.en: j.2.c. Devices or enclosures, “specially designed” for underwater noise reduction in frequencies below 10 kHz, or special mounting devices for shock mitigation; and

texts.zh: j.2.d. 不连续排出燃烧产物的“专门设计”的排气系统；
texts.en: j.2.d. “Specially designed” exhaust systems that do not exhaust continuously the products of combustion;

texts.zh: j.3. 输出功率超过2 kW且具有以下任一特性的“燃料电池”不依赖空气动力系统：
texts.en: j.3. “Fuel cell” air independent power systems with an output exceeding 2 kW and having any of the following:

texts.zh: j.3.a. 为降低10 kHz以下频率的水下噪声而“专门设计”的装置或外壳，或专用减振安装装置；或
texts.en: j.3.a. Devices or enclosures, “specially designed” for underwater noise reduction in frequencies below 10 kHz, or special mounting devices for shock mitigation; or

texts.zh: j.3.b. 具有以下全部特性的系统：
texts.en: j.3.b. Systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: j.3.b.1. 为对反应产物加压或进行燃料重整而“专门设计”；
texts.en: j.3.b.1. “Specially designed” to pressurize the products of reaction or for fuel reformation;

texts.zh: j.3.b.2. 为储存反应产物而“专门设计”；以及
texts.en: j.3.b.2. “Specially designed” to store the products of the reaction; and

texts.zh: j.3.b.3. 为在100 kPa或以上的背压下排出反应产物而“专门设计”；
texts.en: j.3.b.3. “Specially designed” to discharge the products of the reaction against a pressure of 100 kPa or more;

texts.zh: j.4. 具有以下全部特性的斯特林循环发动机不依赖空气动力系统：
texts.en: j.4. Stirling cycle engine air independent power systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: j.4.a. 为降低10 kHz以下频率的水下噪声而“专门设计”的装置或外壳，或专用减振安装装置；以及
texts.en: j.4.a. Devices or enclosures, “specially designed” for underwater noise reduction in frequencies below 10 kHz, or special mounting devices for shock mitigation; and

texts.zh: j.4.b. 在100 kPa或以上背压下排出燃烧产物的“专门设计”的排气系统；
texts.en: j.4.b. “Specially designed” exhaust systems which discharge the products of combustion against a pressure of 100 kPa or more;

texts.zh: o. 以下螺旋桨、动力传动系统、发电系统和降噪系统：
texts.en: o. Propellers, power transmission systems, power generation systems and noise reduction systems, as follows:
o.1. [Reserved]

texts.zh: o.2. 设计用于船舶的以下水用螺旋桨、发电系统或传动系统：
texts.en: o.2. Water-screw propeller, power generation systems or transmission systems, designed for use on vessels, as follows:

texts.zh: o.2.a. 额定功率超过30 MW的可调螺距螺旋桨和桨毂总成；
texts.en: o.2.a. Controllable-pitch propellers and hub assemblies, rated at more than 30 MW;

texts.zh: o.2.b. 输出功率超过2.5 MW的内部液冷式电推进电动机；
texts.en: o.2.b. Internally liquid-cooled electric propulsion motors with a power output exceeding 2.5 MW;

texts.zh: o.2.c. 输出功率超过0.1 MW的“超导”推进电动机；
texts.en: o.2.c. “Superconductive” propulsion motors with a power output exceeding 0.1 MW;

texts.zh: o.2.d. 包含“复合”材料“零件”或“组件”且能够传输超过2 MW功率的动力传动轴系统；
texts.en: o.2.d. Power transmission shaft systems incorporating “composite” material “parts” or “components” and capable of transmitting more than 2 MW;

texts.zh: o.2.e. 额定功率超过2.5 MW的通气式或底部通气式螺旋桨系统；
texts.en: o.2.e. Ventilated or base-ventilated propeller systems, rated at more than 2.5 MW;

texts.zh: o.3. 设计用于排水量1,000吨或以上船舶的以下降噪系统：
texts.en: o.3. Noise reduction systems designed for use on vessels of 1,000 tonnes displacement or more, as follows:

texts.zh: o.3.a. 降低500 Hz以下频率水下噪声的系统，由用于柴油发动机、柴油发电机组、燃气轮机、燃气轮机发电机组、推进电动机或推进减速齿轮声学隔离的复合隔声支座构成；该支座为隔声或隔振而“专门设计”，且中间质量块的质量超过所安装设备质量的30%；
texts.en: o.3.a. Systems that attenuate underwater noise at frequencies below 500 Hz and consist of compound acoustic mounts for the acoustic isolation of diesel engines, diesel generator sets, gas turbines, gas turbine generator sets, propulsion motors or propulsion reduction gears, “specially designed” for sound or vibration isolation and having an intermediate mass exceeding 30% of the equipment to be mounted;

texts.zh: o.3.b. 为动力传动系统“专门设计”的‘主动降噪或消噪系统’或磁轴承；
texts.en: o.3.b. 'Active noise reduction or cancellation systems' or magnetic bearings, “specially designed” for power transmission systems;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就8A002.o.3.b而言，‘主动降噪或消噪系统’包含电子控制系统，能够通过直接向噪声源或振动源发出反噪声或反振动信号，主动降低设备振动。
texts.en: For the purposes of 8A002.o.3.b, 'active noise reduction or cancellation systems' incorporate electronic control systems capable of actively reducing equipment vibration by the generation of anti-noise or anti-vibration signals directly to the source.

texts.zh: o.4. 为潜水器“专门设计”、输出功率超过0.1 MW的永磁电推进电动机。
texts.en: o.4. Permanent magnet electric propulsion motors “specially designed” for submersible vehicles, having a power output exceeding 0.1 MW.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 8A002.o.4.包括轮缘驱动推进系统。
texts.en: 8A002.o.4. includes rim-driven propulsion systems.

texts.zh: p. 具有以下全部特性的泵喷推进系统：
texts.en: p. Pumpjet propulsion systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: p.1. 输出功率超过2.5 MW；以及
texts.en: p.1. Power output exceeding 2.5 MW; and

texts.zh: p.2. 使用扩张喷嘴和流动调节叶片技术，以提高推进效率或降低推进产生的水下辐射噪声；
texts.en: p.2. Using divergent nozzle and flow conditioning vane techniques to improve propulsive efficiency or reduce propulsion-generated underwater-radiated noise;

texts.zh: q. 以下水下游泳和潜水设备；
texts.en: q. Underwater swimming and diving equipment as follows;

texts.zh: q.1. 闭路循环呼吸器；
texts.en: q.1. Closed circuit rebreathers;

texts.zh: q.2. 半闭路循环呼吸器；
texts.en: q.2. Semi-closed circuit rebreathers;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 8A002.q不管制由使用者随身携带、供个人使用的单人循环呼吸器。
texts.en: 8A002.q does not control individual rebreathers for personal use when accompanying their users.

texts.zh: 特别提示
texts.en: N.B.

texts.zh: 为军事用途“专门设计”的设备和装置，见ECCN 8A620.f。
texts.en: For equipment and devices “specially designed” for military use see ECCN 8A620.f.

texts.zh: r. 为干扰潜水员“专门设计”或改装、且在200 Hz及以下频率的声压级等于或超过190 dB（基准为1 m处1 µPa）的潜水员驱离声学系统。
texts.en: r. Diver deterrent acoustic systems “specially designed” or modified to disrupt divers and having a sound pressure level equal to or exceeding 190 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) at frequencies of 200 Hz and below.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 8A002.r不适用于基于水下爆炸装置、气枪或可燃源的潜水员驱离系统。
texts.en: 8A002.r does not apply to diver deterrent systems based on under-water-explosive devices, air guns or combustible sources.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 8A002.r包括使用火花间隙声源（亦称等离子体声源）的潜水员驱离声学系统。
texts.en: 8A002.r includes diver deterrent acoustic systems that use spark gap sources, also known as plasma sound sources.

texts.zh: 8A018 《瓦森纳安排军品清单》上的物项。
texts.en: 8A018 Items on the Wassenaar Arrangement Munitions List.

texts.zh: 目前本ECCN中无任何物项。在2014年1月6日之前的紧接时期归类于ECCN 8A018.b.3的发动机、推进系统及为其“专门设计”的“组件”，见ECCN 8A609。在2014年1月6日之前的紧接时期分别归类于ECCN 8A018.a、.b.1或.b.4的闭路和半闭路循环（再呼吸）装置、潜水船舶用发动机和推进系统（为潜艇“专门设计”、功率为1,500 hp及以上且转速为700 rpm及以上的柴油发动机）、防潜网和防鱼雷网及为其“专门设计”的“组件”，见ECCN 8A620。非军用潜水器、海洋学设备及相关设备的管制，见ECCN 8A001、8A002和8A992。在2014年1月6日之前的紧接时期归类于ECCN 8A018.b.2、为潜艇“专门设计”的电动机，见USML第XX类（《联邦法规汇编》第22编第121部分）。
texts.en: No items currently are in this ECCN. See ECCN 8A609 for engines and propulsion systems and “specially designed” “components” therefor that, immediately prior to January 6, 2014, were classified under ECCN 8A018.b.3. See ECCN 8A620 for closed and semi-closed circuit (rebreathing) apparatus, engines and propulsion systems for submersible vessels (diesel engines of 1,500 hp and over with rotary speed of 700 rpm or over “specially designed” for submarines), submarine and torpedo nets, and “specially designed” “components” therefor that, immediately prior to January 6, 2014, were classified under ECCN 8A018.a, .b.1, or .b.4, respectively. See ECCNs 8A001, 8A002 and 8A992 for controls on non-military submersible vehicles, oceanographic and associated equipment. See USML Category XX (22 CFR part 121) for electric motors “specially designed” for submarines that, immediately prior to January 6, 2014, were classified under ECCN 8A018.b.2.

texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Surface vessels of war and special naval equipment, and technical data (including software), and services directly related thereto, described in 22 CFR part 121, Category VI, Surface Vessels of War and Special Naval Equipment, are subject to the jurisdiction of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.- origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) For controls on diesel engines and electric motors that are “subject to the EAR” for surface vessels of war “subject to the EAR” or “subject to the ITAR,” see ECCN 8A992.g. For diesel engines and electric motors for surface vessels of war “subject to the ITAR,” see 22 CFR part 121, Category VI(c) for parts, components, accessories, and attachments, “specially designed” for developmental vessels funded by the Department of Defense via contract or other funding authorization. (4) For controls on military gas turbine engines and related items for vessels of war, see ECCN 9A619. (4) For controls on military gas turbine engines and related items for vessels of war, see ECCN 9A619.

texts.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”、且未在USML中列明或以其他方式描述的水面战舰。
texts.en: a. Surface vessels of war “specially designed” for a military use and not enumerated or otherwise described in the USML.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 8A609.a包括：(i) 航行补给舰；(ii) 水面舰艇和潜艇供应及修理舰，但为海军核动力装置提供支持而“专门设计”的舰船除外；(iii) 不可潜航的潜艇救援船；(iv) 其他辅助舰船（例如AGDS、AGF、AGM、AGOR、AGOS、AH、AP、ARL、AVB、AVM和AVT）；(v) 两栖作战艇，但武装艇除外；以及(vi) 无装甲且无武装、具有供.50口径或以下枪械安装的支架或挂点的沿海艇、巡逻艇、锚地艇、海岸警卫队艇及其他巡逻艇。
texts.en: 8A609.a includes: (i) Underway replenishment ships; (ii) surface vessel and submarine tender and repair ships, except vessels that are “specially designed” to support naval nuclear propulsion plants; (iii) non-submersible submarine rescue ships; (iv) other auxiliaries (e.g., AGDS, AGF, AGM, AGOR, AGOS, AH, AP, ARL, AVB, AVM, and AVT); (v) amphibious warfare craft, except those that are armed; and (vi) unarmored and unarmed coastal, patrol, roadstead, and Coast Guard and other patrol craft with mounts or hard points for firearms of .50 caliber or less.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 就.a款而言，水面战舰包括为军事用途“专门设计”、但未在ITAR第121.15节(a)款中列明的船舶，包括1950年以前制造且自1949年以来未作改装的任何非军事化船舶，无论其来源或名称如何。就本注释而言，“改装”一词不包括加入法律要求的安全功能、外观变化（例如不同涂装），或增添1950年以前已可获得的“零件”或“组件”。
texts.en: For purposes of paragraph .a, surface vessels of war includes vessels “specially designed” for military use that are not identified in paragraph (a) of ITAR § 121.15, including any demilitarized vessels, regardless of origin or designation, manufactured prior to 1950 and that have not been modified since 1949. For purposes of this note, the term modified does not include incorporation of safety features required by law, cosmetic changes (e.g., different paint), or the addition of “parts” or “components” available prior to 1950.

texts.zh: b. 输出功率为50 hp或以上且具有以下任一特性的无磁柴油发动机：
texts.en: b. Non-magnetic diesel engines with a power output of 50 hp or more and either of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 无磁材料含量超过总重量的25%；或
texts.en: b.1. Non-magnetic content exceeding 25% of total weight; or

texts.zh: b.2. 具有曲轴箱、缸体、缸盖、活塞、盖板、端板、阀面、垫片以及燃料、润滑和其他供给管路以外的无磁零件。
texts.en: b.2. Non-magnetic parts other than crankcase, block, head, pistons, covers, end plates, valve facings, gaskets, and fuel, lubrication and other supply lines.

texts.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity enumerated or otherwise described in ECCN 8A609 (except for 8A609.y) or a defense article enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VI and not specified elsewhere on the USML, in 8A609.y or 3A611.y.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 锻件、铸件及其他未完成产品（例如挤压件和机加工坯体），如已达到可根据其机械性能、材料成分、几何形状或功能明确识别为ECCN 8A609.x所管制商品的制造阶段，则由ECCN 8A609.x管制。
texts.en: Forgings, castings, and other unfinished products, such as extrusions and machined bodies, that have reached a stage in manufacturing where they are clearly identifiable by mechanical properties, material composition, geometry, or function as commodities controlled by ECCN 8A609.x are controlled by ECCN 8A609.x.
Note 2:

texts.zh: USML第VI(f)子类所述的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”受该款管制。ECCN 8A609.y所述的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”受该款管制。
texts.en: “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” specified in USML subcategory VI(f) are subject to the controls of that paragraph. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” specified in ECCN 8A609.y are subject to the controls of that paragraph.

texts.zh: y. 为本ECCN所管制的商品或USML第VI类中的国防物品“专门设计”、且未在USML其他条目列明的以下特定“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”：
texts.en: y. Specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN or for a defense article in USML Category VI and not elsewhere specified in the USML, as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor:

texts.zh: y.1. 公共广播（PA）系统；
texts.en: y.1. Public address (PA) systems;

texts.zh: y.2. 气动、液压、润滑油和燃料系统用过滤器和过滤器总成、软管、管路、管件、联接器和支架；
texts.en: y.2. Filters and filter assemblies, hoses, lines, fittings, couplings, and brackets for pneumatic, hydraulic, oil and fuel systems;

texts.zh: y.3. 船用厨房；
texts.en: y.3. Galleys;

texts.zh: y.4. 盥洗室；
texts.en: y.4. Lavatories;

texts.zh: y.5. 磁罗经、磁方位探测器；
texts.en: y.5. Magnetic compass, magnetic azimuth detector;

texts.zh: y.6. 医疗设施；
texts.en: y.6. Medical facilities;

texts.zh: y.7. 饮用水箱、过滤器、阀门、软管、管路、管件、联接器和支架；
texts.en: y.7. Potable water tanks, filters, valves, hoses, lines, fittings, couplings, and brackets;

texts.zh: y.8. 面板旋钮、指示器、开关、按钮和刻度盘，无论是否为配合夜视成像系统使用而加装滤光装置；
texts.en: y.8. Panel knobs, indicators, switches, buttons, and dials whether unfiltered or filtered for use with night vision imaging systems;

texts.zh: y.9. 应急照明；
texts.en: y.9. Emergency lighting;

texts.zh: y.10. 仪表和指示器；
texts.en: y.10. Gauges and indicators;

texts.zh: y.11. 音频选择面板。
texts.en: y.11. Audio selector panels.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 《联邦法规汇编》第22编第121部分第XX类“潜水船舶、海洋学及相关设备”所述的潜水船舶、海洋学及相关设备，以及与其直接相关的技术数据（包括软件）和服务，受《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）管辖。为USML第XX类中的国防物品“专门设计”的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”，由USML第XX(c)子类管制。(2) 包含超过最低比例的美国原产“600系列”受控内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 非军用潜水器、海洋学及相关设备的管制，见ECCN 8A001、8A002和8A992。(4) 输出功率为50 hp或以上并具有以下任一特性的无磁柴油发动机的管制，见ECCN 8A609：(i) 无磁材料含量超过总重量的25%；或(ii) 具有曲轴箱、缸体、缸盖、活塞、盖板、端板、阀面、垫片以及燃料、润滑和其他供给管路以外的无磁零件。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Submersible vessels, oceanographic and associated equipment, and technical data (including software), and services directly related thereto, described in 22 CFR part 121, Category XX, Submersible Vessels, Oceanographic and Associated Equipment, are subject to the jurisdiction of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for defense articles in USML Category XX are controlled under USML sub-category XX(c). (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) For controls on nonmilitary submersible vehicles, oceanographic and associated equipment, see ECCNs 8A001, 8A002, and 8A992. (4) See ECCN 8A609 for controls on nonmagnetic diesel engines with a power output of 50 hp or more and either: (i) Nonmagnetic content exceeding 25% of total weight; or (ii) non-magnetic parts other than crankcase, block, head, pistons, covers, end plates, valve facings, gaskets, and fuel, lubrication and other supply lines.

texts.zh: d. 为潜艇“专门设计”、功率为1,500 hp及以上且转速为700 rpm及以上的柴油发动机。
texts.en: d. Diesel engines of 1,500 hp and over with rotary speed of 700 rpm or over “specially designed” for submarines.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 以下水下视觉系统：
texts.en: a. Underwater vision systems, as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 在空气中测量的极限分辨率超过500线，且为通过潜水器进行遥控操作而“专门设计”或改装的电视系统（包括摄像机、照明、监视和信号传输设备）；或
texts.en: a.1. Television systems (comprising camera, lights, monitoring and signal transmission equipment) having a limiting resolution when measured in air of more than 500 lines and “specially designed” or modified for remote operation with a submersible vehicle; or

texts.zh: a.2. 在空气中测量的极限分辨率超过700线的水下电视摄像机；
texts.en: a.2. Underwater television cameras having a limiting resolution when measured in air of more than 700 lines;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 电视的极限分辨率是水平分辨率的一种量度，通常采用IEEE标准208/1960或任何等效标准，以测试图上每幅图像高度能够分辨的最大线数表示。
texts.en: Limiting resolution in television is a measure of horizontal resolution usually expressed in terms of the maximum number of lines per picture height discriminated on a test chart, using IEEE Standard 208/1960 or any equivalent standard.

texts.zh: b. 为水下使用“专门设计”或改装、胶片规格为35 mm或以上，且具有为水下使用“专门设计”的自动对焦或遥控对焦功能的静态照相机；
texts.en: b. Photographic still cameras “specially designed” or modified for underwater use, having a film format of 35 mm or larger, and having autofocusing or remote focusing “specially designed” for underwater use;

texts.zh: c. 为水下使用“专门设计”或改装、每次闪光的光输出能量超过300 J的频闪照明系统；
texts.en: c. Stroboscopic light systems, “specially designed” or modified for underwater use, capable of a light output energy of more than 300 J per flash;

texts.zh: d. 未另列明的其他水下照相设备；
texts.en: d. Other underwater camera equipment, n.e.s.;

texts.zh: e. 未另列明的其他潜水系统；
texts.en: e. Other submersible systems, n.e.s.;

texts.zh: f. 未另列明的船舶，包括充气艇，以及未另列明、为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”；
texts.en: f. Vessels, n.e.s., including inflatable boats, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor, n.e.s.;

texts.zh: g. 未另列明的船用发动机（舷内和舷外）及潜艇发动机；以及未另列明、为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”；
texts.en: g. Marine engines (both inboard and outboard) and submarine engines, n.e.s.; and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor, n.e.s.;

texts.zh: h. 未另列明的其他自给式水下呼吸器（水肺装备）及相关设备；
texts.en: h. Other self-contained underwater breathing apparatus (scuba gear) and related equipment, n.e.s.;

texts.zh: i. 救生衣、充气筒、罗盘、湿式潜水服、面罩、脚蹼、配重腰带和潜水电脑；
texts.en: i. Life jackets, inflation cartridges, compasses, wetsuits, masks, fins, weight belts, and dive computers;

texts.zh: j. 水下照明和推进设备；
texts.en: j. Underwater lights and propulsion equipment;

texts.zh: k. 为气瓶充气“专门设计”的空气压缩机和过滤系统。
texts.en: k. Air compressors and filtration systems “specially designed” for filling air cylinders.

texts.zh: l. 设计为具有以下任一特性的船用锅炉：
texts.en: l. Marine boilers designed to have any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: l.1. （最大额定工况下）每立方英尺炉膛容积每小时的放热率等于或超过190,000 BTU；或
texts.en: l.1. Heat release rate (at maximum rating) equal to or in excess of 190,000 BTU per hour per cubic foot of furnace volume; or

texts.zh: l.2. （最大额定工况下）以磅/小时计的蒸汽产量与以磅计的锅炉干重之比等于或超过0.83。
texts.en: l.2. Ratio of steam generated in pounds per hour (at maximum rating) to the dry weight of the boiler in pounds equal to or in excess of 0.83.

texts.zh: m. 8A992.l所述船用锅炉的主要“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”。
texts.en: m. Major “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” for marine boilers described in 8A992.l.

texts.zh: 8B001 设计为在超过0 Hz但不超过500 Hz的频率范围内背景噪声小于100 dB（基准为1 µPa、1 Hz），并设计用于测量推进系统模型周围水流所产生声场的水洞。
texts.en: 8B001 Water Tunnels Designed to Have a Background Noise of Less Than 100 dB (Reference 1 µPa, 1 Hz) Within the Frequency Range Exceeding 0 Hz But Not Exceeding to 500 Hz and Designed for Measuring Acoustic Fields Generated by a Hydro-Flow Around Propulsion System Models.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 用于“开发”、“生产”、维修、大修或翻新（重新机加工）为降低水下噪声而“专门设计”的螺旋桨的“技术”；
texts.en: a. “Technology” for the “development”, “production”, repair, overhaul or refurbishing (re-machining) of propellers “specially designed” for underwater noise reduction;

texts.zh: b. 用于大修或翻新8A001、8A002.b、8A002.j、8A002.o或8A002.p所管制设备的“技术”。
texts.en: b. “Technology” for the overhaul or refurbishing of equipment controlled by 8A001, 8A002.b, 8A002.j, 8A002.o or 8A002.p.

texts.zh: c. 根据《通用技术说明》，用于“开发”或“生产”以下任一项的“技术”：
texts.en: c. “Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性的表面效应航行器（全围裙式）：
texts.en: c.1. Surface-effect vehicles (fully skirted variety) having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 在有效波高为1.25 m或以上时，满载最大设计航速超过30节；
texts.en: c.1.a. Maximum design speed, fully loaded, exceeding 30 knots in a significant wave height of 1.25 m or more;

texts.zh: c.1.b. 气垫压力超过3,830 Pa；以及
texts.en: c.1.b. Cushion pressure exceeding 3,830 Pa; and

texts.zh: c.1.c. 空载排水量与满载排水量之比小于0.70；
texts.en: c.1.c. Light-ship-to-full-load displacement ratio of less than 0.70;

texts.zh: c.2. 在有效波高为3.25 m或以上时，满载最大设计航速超过40节的表面效应航行器（刚性侧壁式）；
texts.en: c.2. Surface-effect vehicles (rigid sidewalls) with a maximum design speed, fully loaded, exceeding 40 knots in a significant wave height of 3.25 m or more;

texts.zh: c.3. 配有自动控制水翼系统的主动系统，且在有效波高为3.25 m或以上时，满载最大设计航速为40节或以上的水翼船；或
texts.en: c.3. Hydrofoil vessels with active systems for automatically controlling foil systems, with a maximum design speed, fully loaded, of 40 knots or more in a significant wave height of 3.25 m or more; or

texts.zh: c.4. 具有以下任一特性的‘小水线面船舶’：
texts.en: c.4. 'Small waterplane area vessels' having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.4.a. 满载排水量超过500吨，且在有效波高为3.25 m或以上时，满载最大设计航速超过35节；或
texts.en: c.4.a. Full load displacement exceeding 500 tonnes with a maximum design speed, fully loaded, exceeding 35 knots in a significant wave height of 3.25 m or more; or

texts.zh: c.4.b. 满载排水量超过1,500吨，且在有效波高为4 m或以上时，满载最大设计航速超过25节。
texts.en: c.4.b. Full load displacement exceeding 1,500 tonnes with a maximum design speed, fully loaded, exceeding 25 knots in a significant wave height of 4 m or more.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就8E002.c.4而言，‘小水线面船舶’按以下公式定义：工作设计吃水下的水线面面积小于2x（工作设计吃水下的排水体积）^{2/3}。
texts.en: For the purposes of 8E002.c.4, a 'small waterplane area vessel' is defined by the following formula: waterplane area at an operational design draft less than 2x (displaced volume at the operational design draft)^{2/3}.

texts.en: 9A001 does not control aero gas turbine engines which meet all of the following:

texts.zh: a. 已获第743部分补充文件第1号所列国家的民用航空主管机关认证；以及
texts.en: a. Certified by the civil aviation authority in a country listed in Supplement No. 1 to Part 743; and

texts.en: b. Intended to power non-military manned “aircraft” for which any of the following has been issued by a Wassenaar Arrangement Participating State listed in Supplement No. 1 to Part 743 for the “aircraft” with this specific engine type:

texts.zh: b.1. 民用型号合格证；或
texts.en: b.1. A civil type certificate; or

texts.en: b.2. An equivalent document recognized by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO).

texts.en: 9A001 does not apply to aero gas turbine engines designed for Auxiliary Power Units (APUs) approved by the civil aviation authority in a Wassenaar Arrangement Participating State (see Supplement No. 1 to part 743 of the EAR).

texts.en: Items: a. Maximum continuous power when operating in “steady state mode” at standard reference conditions specified by ISO 3977-2:1997 (or national equivalent) of 24,245 kW or more; and

texts.zh: b. 使用液体燃料时，在最大持续功率的35%工况下，‘修正比油耗’不超过0.219 kg/kWh。
texts.en: b. 'Corrected specific fuel consumption' not exceeding 0.219 kg/kWh at 35% of the maximum continuous power when using liquid fuel.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: ‘船用燃气轮机发动机’一词包括为船舶发电或推进用途而改装的工业型或航空派生型燃气轮机发动机。
texts.en: The term 'marine gas turbine engines' includes those industrial, or aero-derivative, gas turbine engines adapted for a ship's electric power generation or propulsion.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9A002而言，‘修正比油耗’是将发动机比油耗修正至采用净比能量（即净热值）为42 MJ/kg的船用馏分液体燃料时的值（ISO 3977-2:1997）。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9A002, 'corrected specific fuel consumption' is the specific fuel consumption of the engine corrected to a marine distillate liquid fuel having a net specific energy (i.e., net heating value) of 42 MJ/kg (ISO 3977-2:1997).

texts.zh: 许可证要求注释：ECCN 9A004.a至.f适用于某些航天运载器、航天器、航天器平台、航天器有效载荷、星载系统或设备及地面设备。将这些物项列于ECCN 9A004.a至.f，是为了使9A004与《瓦森纳安排两用物项清单》保持一致，尽管这些物项的管制规定载于ECCN 9A515，并指引出口商、再出口商和转移方就9A004.a查阅USML第IV类。9A004.a见UMSL第IV类。9A004.b至.f以及.h见ECCN 9A515。.g、.h、.r以及.u至.y见本ECCN 9A004。
texts.en: License Requirement Note: ECCN 9A004.a through .f apply to certain space launch vehicles, spacecraft, spacecraft buses, spacecraft payloads, on-board systems or equipment, and terrestrial equipment. They are described in ECCN 9A004.a through .f in order to harmonize 9A004 with the Wassenaar Arrangement Dual-Use List, even though the controls for these items are found under ECCN 9A515 and direct exporters, reexporters, and transferors to see USML Category IV for 9A004.a. See UMSL Category IV for 9A004.a. See ECCN 9A515 for 9A004.b through .f, and .h. See this ECCN 9A004 for .g, .h, .r, and .u through .y.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 航天运载器。
texts.en: a. Space launch vehicles.

texts.zh: b. “航天器”。
texts.en: b. “Spacecraft.”

texts.zh: c. “航天器平台”。
texts.en: c. “Spacecraft buses.”

d. “Spacecraft payloads” incorporating items specified by 3A001.b.1.a.4 or z (if also described in 3A001.b.1.a.4), 3A002.g, 5A001.a.1, .b.3, 5A002.c, z.3 or z.8, .e, z.5, 6A002.a.1, a.2, .b, .d, 6A003.b, 6A004.c, .e, 6A008.d, .e, .k, .l or 9A010.c.

texts.zh: e. 为“航天器”“专门设计”且具有以下任一功能的星载系统或设备：
texts.en: e. On-board systems or equipment, “specially designed” for “spacecraft” and having any of the following functions:

texts.zh: e.1. ‘指令和遥测数据处理’；
texts.en: e.1. 'Command and telemetry data handling;'
Note 1 to 9A004.e.1:

texts.zh: 就9A004.e.1而言，‘指令和遥测数据处理’包括总线数据管理、存储和处理。
texts.en: For the purpose of 9A004.e.1, 'command and telemetry data handling' includes bus data management, storage, and processing.

texts.zh: e.2. ‘有效载荷数据处理’；或
texts.en: e.2. 'Payload data handling;' or
Note 2 to 9A004.e.2:

texts.zh: 就9A004.e.2而言，‘有效载荷数据处理’包括有效载荷数据管理、存储和处理。
texts.en: For the purpose of 9A004.e.2, 'payload data handling' includes payload data management, storage, and processing.

texts.zh: e.3. ‘姿态和轨道控制’；
texts.en: e.3. 'Attitude and orbit control;'
Note 3 to 9A004.e.3:

texts.zh: 就9A004.e.3而言，‘姿态和轨道控制’包括用于确定和控制“航天器”位置及朝向的传感和作动。
texts.en: For the purpose of 9A004.e.3, 'attitude and orbit control' includes sensing and actuation to determine and control the position and orientation of a “spacecraft.”

texts.zh: f. 为“航天器”专门设计的以下地面设备：
texts.en: f. Terrestrial equipment specially designed for “spacecraft,” as follows:

texts.zh: f.1. 为以下任一数据处理功能“专门设计”的遥测和遥控设备：
texts.en: f.1. Telemetry and telecommand equipment “specially designed” for any of the following data processing functions:

texts.zh: f.1.a. 进行帧同步和纠错的遥测数据处理，以监测“航天器平台”的运行状态（亦称健康和安全状态）；或
texts.en: f.1.a. Telemetry data processing of frame synchronization and error corrections, for monitoring of operational status (also known as health and safe status) of the “spacecraft bus;” or

texts.zh: f.1.b. 对发送至“航天器”以控制“航天器平台”的指令数据进行格式化的指令数据处理；
texts.en: f.1.b. Command data processing for formatting command data being sent to the “spacecraft” to control the “spacecraft bus;”

texts.zh: f.2. 为‘验证操作程序’而“专门设计”的“航天器”模拟器。
texts.en: f.2. Simulators “specially designed” for 'verification of operational procedures' of “spacecraft”.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9A004.f.2而言，‘验证操作程序’是指以下任一项：
texts.en: For the purposes of 9A004.f.2, 'verification of operational procedures' is any of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 指令序列确认；
texts.en: 1. Command sequence confirmation;

texts.zh: 2. 操作培训；
texts.en: 2. Operational training;

texts.zh: 3. 操作演练；或
texts.en: 3. Operational rehearsals; or

texts.zh: 4. 操作分析。
texts.en: 4. Operational analysis.

texts.zh: g. 为作为航天运载器或“亚轨道飞行器”的空中发射平台而“专门设计”或改装的“航空器”。
texts.en: g. “Aircraft” “specially designed” or modified to be air-launch platforms for space launch vehicles or “sub-orbital craft.”

texts.zh: h. “亚轨道飞行器”。
texts.en: h. “Sub-orbital craft.”

texts.zh: i.至q. [保留]
texts.en: i. through q. [Reserved]

texts.zh: r. 国际空间站（ISS）以外的太空居住舱。
texts.en: r. In-space habitats, other than the International Space Station (ISS).
Note 4 to 9A004.r:

texts.zh: 太空居住舱被视为空间站的商业等同物，因为它供人员进行实验或太空旅游活动使用。
texts.en: In-space habitats are considered the commercial equivalent of a space station because it is used for persons conducting experiments or space tourism activities.

texts.zh: s. 为9A004.r中的太空居住舱“专门设计”，且不属于以下任何一项的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”：
texts.en: s. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for in-space habitats in 9A004.r and that are NOT:

texts.zh: s.1. USML所述；
texts.en: s.1. Described on the USML;

texts.zh: s.2. ECCN 7A004或7A104所述；
texts.en: s.2. Described in ECCN 7A004 or 7A104;

texts.zh: s.3. 将“适用于空间”列为管制标准的ECCN所述（参见9A515.x.4）；或
texts.en: s.3. Described in an ECCN containing “space-qualified” as a control criterion (refer to 9A515.x.4); or
s.4 Described in 9A001, 9A002, 9A003, 9A515, or 9A991.

texts.zh: t. [保留]
texts.en: t. [Reserved]

texts.zh: u. 在美国国家航空航天局（NASA）监督下运行的詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）。
texts.en: u. The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) being operated under the supervision of the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).

texts.zh: v. 为詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜“专门设计”，且不属于以下任何一项的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”：
texts.en: v. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for the James Webb Space Telescope and that are NOT:

texts.zh: v.1. USML所述；
texts.en: v.1. Described on the USML;

texts.zh: v.2. 微电子电路；
texts.en: v.2. Microelectronic circuits;

texts.zh: v.3. ECCN 7A004或7A104所述；或
texts.en: v.3. Described in ECCN 7A004 or 7A104; or

texts.zh: v.4. 将“适用于空间”列为管制标准的ECCN所述（参见9A515.x.4）。
texts.en: v.4. Described in an ECCN containing “space-qualified” as a control criterion (refer to 9A515.x.4).

texts.zh: w. 在美国国家航空航天局监督下运行的国际空间站。
texts.en: w. The International Space Station being operated under the supervision of the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

texts.zh: x. 为国际空间站“专门设计”的“零件”、“组件”、“附件”和“附属装置”。
texts.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for the International Space Station.

texts.zh: y. 原本属于ECCN 9A004.s或.x范围、但在依据第748.3(e)节经跨部门审核通过的商品分类（CCATS）中被确定应由9A004.y管制的物项。
texts.en: y. Items that would otherwise be within the scope of ECCN 9A004.s or .x but that have been identified in an interagency-cleared commodity classification (CCATS) pursuant to § 748.3(e) as warranting control in 9A004.y.

texts.zh: y.1. 未在9A515.e中列明的分立电子组件；
texts.en: y.1. Discrete electronic components not specified in 9A515.e;

texts.zh: y.2. 航天器应用用热敏电阻；
texts.en: y.2. Thermistors for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.3. 射频微波带通陶瓷滤波器（例如介质谐振器带通滤波器）；
texts.en: y.3. RF microwave bandpass ceramic filters (e.g., Dielectric Resonator Bandpass Filters);

texts.zh: y.4. 航天器应用用霍尔效应传感器；
texts.en: y.4. Hall effect sensors for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.5. 航天器应用用超小型（SMA和SMP）插头和连接器、TNC插头，以及带SMA插头和连接器的电缆和连接器总成；
texts.en: y.5. Subminiature (SMA and SMP) plugs and connectors, TNC plugs and cable and connector assemblies with SMA plugs and connectors for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.6. 航天器应用用飞行电缆总成；
texts.en: y.6. Flight cable assemblies for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.7. 公共广播（PA）系统；
texts.en: y.7. Public address (PA) systems;

texts.zh: y.8. 音频选择面板；
texts.en: y.8. Audio selector panels;

texts.zh: y.9. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的盥洗室和人体排泄物管理系统；
texts.en: y.9. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant lavatories and body waste management systems;

texts.zh: y.10. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的个人卫生设施和系统；
texts.en: y.10. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant hygiene facilities and systems;

texts.zh: 在地球以外任何天体上运行的物项，为CCL分类之目的，按其在地球上运行处理。
texts.en: An item operating on any celestial body other than Earth is treated as if it is on Earth for classification purposes on the CCL.

texts.en: a. “Parts”, “components” and structures, each exceeding 10 kg and “specially designed” for launch vehicles manufactured using any of the following:

texts.zh: a.1. 由1C010.e所述“纤维或纤丝材料”和1C008或1C009.b所述树脂组成的“复合”材料；
texts.en: a.1. “Composite” materials consisting of “fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.e and resins specified by 1C008 or 1C009.b;

texts.zh: a.2. 采用以下任一材料增强的金属“基体”“复合材料”：
texts.en: a.2. Metal “matrix” “composites” reinforced by any of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 1C007所述材料；
texts.en: a.2.a. Materials specified by 1C007;

texts.zh: a.2.b. 1C010所述“纤维或纤丝材料”；或
texts.en: a.2.b. “Fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010; or

texts.zh: a.2.c. 1C002.a所述铝化物；或

texts.zh: b.1. 1C010.e所述“纤维或纤丝材料”和1C008或1C009.b所述树脂；
texts.en: b.1. “Fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.e and resins specified by 1C008 or 1C009.b;

texts.zh: b.2. 采用以下任一材料增强的金属“基体”“复合材料”：
texts.en: b.2. Metal “Matrix “composites” reinforced by any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 1C007所述材料；
texts.en: b.2.a. Materials specified by 1C007;

texts.zh: b.2.c. 1C002.a所述铝化物；或

texts.zh: b.3. 1C007所述陶瓷“基体”“复合”材料；

texts.zh: c. 为主动控制“航天器”结构的动态响应或变形而专门设计的结构组件和隔离系统；
texts.en: c. Structural components and isolation systems, specially designed to control actively the dynamic response or distortion of “spacecraft” structures;

texts.zh: d. 推重比等于或大于1 kN/kg、且‘响应时间’小于30 ms的脉冲式液体火箭发动机。
texts.en: d. Pulsed liquid rocket engines with thrust-to-weight ratios equal to or more than 1 kN/kg and a 'response time' of less than 30 ms.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9A010.d而言，‘响应时间’是指从启动至达到总额定推力90%所需的时间。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9A010.d, 'response time' means the time required to achieve 90% of total rated thrust from start-up.

texts.zh: 9A011 冲压发动机、超燃冲压发动机或‘组合循环发动机’，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”。（这些物项“受ITAR管辖”。见《联邦法规汇编》第22编第120至130部分。）

texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9A011而言，‘组合循环发动机’将以下两种或以上类型的发动机组合在一起：
texts.en: For the purposes of 9A011, 'combined cycle engines' combine two or more of the following types of engines:

texts.zh: —燃气轮机发动机（涡轮喷气、涡轮螺旋桨和涡轮风扇）；

texts.en: —Rocket motor or engine (liquid/gel/solid-propellant and hybrid).

texts.en: a.2. A maximum 'endurance' of 3 hours or greater;

texts.en: a.3. “UAVs” or unmanned “airships” incorporating items specified in ECCN 6A003.b.3, 6A003.b.4.b, or 6A008.d to .h;

texts.zh: a.4. 装有ECCN 6A005所述物项的“UAV”或无人“飞艇”；或
texts.en: a.4. “UAVs” or unmanned “airships” incorporating items specified in ECCN 6A005; or

texts.zh: a.5. 装有使用ECCN 7A001、7A002、7A003或7A005所述加速度计或陀螺仪的“惯性测量设备或系统”的“UAV”或无人“飞艇”。
texts.en: a.5. “UAVs” or unmanned “airships” incorporating “inertial measurement equipment or systems” using accelerometers or gyros specified in ECCNs 7A001, 7A002, 7A003, or 7A005.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就9A012.a而言，‘操作员’是指启动或指挥“UAV”或无人“飞艇”飞行的人员。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 9A012.a, 'operator' is a person who initiates or commands the “UAV” or unmanned “airship” flight.

texts.zh: 2. 就9A012.a而言，‘续航时间’应按海平面、无风、国际标准大气（ISA）条件（ISO 2533:1975）计算。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 9A012.a, 'endurance' is to be calculated for ISA conditions (ISO 2533:1975) at sea level in zero wind.

texts.zh: 3. 就9A012.a而言，‘自然视力’是指未借助辅助设备的人类视力，可佩戴或不佩戴矫正镜片。
texts.en: 3. For the purposes of 9A012.a, 'natural vision' means unaided human sight, with or without corrective lenses.

texts.zh: b. 以下相关设备和“组件”：
texts.en: b. Related equipment and “components”, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1 [保留]
texts.en: b.1 [Reserved]
b.2. [Reserved]

texts.zh: b.3. 为将有人“航空器”或有人“飞艇”改装为9A012.a所管制“UAV”或无人“飞艇”而“专门设计”的设备或“组件”；
texts.en: b.3. Equipment or “components” “specially designed” to convert a manned “aircraft” or a manned “airship” to a “UAV” or unmanned “airship”, controlled by 9A012.a;

texts.zh: b.4. 为在15,240米（50,000英尺）以上高度推进“UAV”或无人“飞艇”而“专门设计”或改装的吸气式往复式或旋转式内燃发动机。
texts.en: b.4. Air breathing reciprocating or rotary internal combustion type engines, “specially designed” or modified to propel “UAVs” or unmanned “airships”, at altitudes above 15,240 meters (50,000 feet).

texts.zh: 9A018 《瓦森纳安排军品清单》上的设备。
texts.en: 9A018 Equipment on the Wassenaar Arrangement Munitions List.

texts.zh: (a) 在2013年10月15日之前的紧接时期归类于9A018.a.1、.a.3、.c、.d、.e或.f的航空器、加油设备、地面设备、降落伞、安全带和仪表飞行训练器，以及上述物项的“零件”、“附件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 9A610。
texts.en: (a) See ECCN 9A610 for the aircraft, refuelers, ground equipment, parachutes, harnesses, and instrument flight trainers, as well as “parts”, “accessories,” and “attachments” for the forgoing that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under 9A018.a.1, .a.3, .c, .d, .e, or .f.

texts.zh: (b) 在2013年10月15日之前的紧接时期归类于ECCN 9A018.a.2或.a.3的军用教练机涡轮螺旋桨发动机及其“零件”和“组件”，见ECCN 9A619。
texts.en: (b) See ECCN 9A619 for military trainer aircraft turbo prop engines and “parts” and “components” therefor that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under ECCN 9A018.a.2 or .a.3.

texts.zh: (c) 在2014年1月6日以前归类于ECCN 9A018.b的某些装甲地面运输车辆，见ECCN 0A606.b。
texts.en: (c) See ECCN 0A606.b for certain armored ground transport vehicles that prior to January 6, 2014 were classified under ECCN 9A018.b.

texts.zh: 相关管制：9A101.b仅管制非军用无人驾驶航空器[UAV]或遥控飞行器[RPV]用发动机，不管制为“导弹”使用而设计或改装的其他发动机，后者“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规汇编》第22编第120至130部分）。
texts.en: Related Controls: 9A101.b controls only engines for non-military unmanned aerial vehicles [UAVs] or remotely piloted vehicles [RPVs], and does not control other engines designed or modified for use in “missiles”, which are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 具有以下全部特性的发动机：
texts.en: a. Engines having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. ‘最大推力值’大于400 N（未安装状态下达到），但最大推力值大于8,890 N（未安装状态下达到）且经民用认证的发动机除外；
texts.en: a.1. 'Maximum thrust value' greater than 400 N (achieved un-installed) excluding civil certified engines with a maximum thrust value greater than 8,890 N (achieved un-installed);

texts.zh: a.2. 比油耗为0.15 kg N^{−1} h^{−1}或以下；
texts.en: a.2. Specific fuel consumption of 0.15 kg N^{−1} h^{−1} or less;

texts.zh: a.3. ‘干重’小于750 kg；以及
texts.en: a.3. 'Dry weight' less than 750 kg; and

texts.zh: a.4. ‘第一级转子直径’小于1 m；或
texts.en: a.4. 'First-stage rotor diameter' less than 1 m; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 9A101.a.1中的‘最大推力值’是指制造商证实的、该型号发动机在未安装状态、海平面静止条件并采用ICAO标准大气时的最大推力。民用型号认证推力值应等于或小于制造商证实的该型号发动机最大推力。
texts.en: 1. 'Maximum thrust value' in 9A101.a.1 is the manufacturer's demonstrated maximum thrust for the engine type un-installed at sea level static conditions using the ICAO standard atmosphere. The civil type certified thrust value will be equal to or less than the manufacturer's demonstrated maximum thrust for the engine type.

texts.zh: 2. 比油耗在该型号发动机处于未安装状态、海平面静止条件并采用ICAO标准大气时的最大持续推力下确定。
texts.en: 2. Specific fuel consumption is determined at maximum continuous thrust for engine type un-installed at sea level static conditions using the ICAO standard atmosphere.

texts.zh: 3. ‘干重’是指发动机不含流体（燃料、液压液、润滑油等）时的重量，且不包括发动机短舱（壳体）。
texts.en: 3. 'Dry weight' is the weight of the engine without fluids (fuel, hydraulic fluid, oil, etc.) and does not include the nacelle (housing).

texts.zh: 4. ‘第一级转子直径’是指在叶尖前缘处测得的发动机第一个旋转级的直径，无论该级是风扇还是压气机。
texts.en: 4. 'First-stage rotor diameter' is the diameter of the first rotating stage of the engine, whether a fan or compressor, measured at the leading edge of the blade tips.

texts.zh: b. 为射程/航程等于或大于300 km的“导弹”或UAV使用而设计或改装的发动机，不论其推力、比油耗、‘干重’或‘第一级转子直径’如何。
texts.en: b. Engines designed or modified for use in “missiles” or UAVs with a range equal to or greater than 300 km, regardless of thrust, specific fuel consumption, 'dry weight' or 'first-stage rotor diameter'.

texts.zh: 9A102 为9A012中因MT理由受控物项“专门设计”、最大功率大于10 kW（在未安装状态、海平面静止条件并采用ICAO标准大气时达到）的‘涡轮螺旋桨发动机系统’，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”，但经民用认证的发动机除外。
texts.en: 9A102 'Turboprop engine systems' “specially designed” for items controlled in 9A012 for MT reasons, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor, having a maximum power greater than 10 kW (achieved uninstalled at sea level static conditions using the ICAO standard atmosphere), excluding civil certified engines.

texts.en: Items: a. Ablative liners for thrust or combustion chambers;

texts.zh: b. 火箭喷管；
texts.en: b. Rocket nozzles;

texts.zh: c. 推力矢量控制子系统；
texts.en: c. Thrust vector control sub-systems;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 9A106.c所管制的推力矢量控制实现方法示例包括：
texts.en: Examples of methods of achieving thrust vector control controlled by 9A106.c includes:

texts.zh: 1. 柔性喷管；
texts.en: 1. Flexible nozzle;

texts.zh: 2. 流体或二次气体喷射；
texts.en: 2. Fluid or secondary gas injection;

texts.zh: 3. 可动发动机或喷管；
texts.en: 3. Movable engine or nozzle;

texts.zh: 4. 排气流偏转（燃气舵或探针）；或
texts.en: 4. Deflection of exhaust gas steam (jet vanes or probes); or

texts.zh: 5. 推力调节片。
texts.en: 5. Thrust tabs.

texts.zh: d. 设计或改装为可在20 Hz至2000 Hz之间、振动大于10 g rms的环境中运行的液体、浆状和凝胶推进剂（包括氧化剂）控制系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”。
texts.en: d. Liquid, slurry and gel propellant (including oxidizers) control systems, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor, designed or modified to operate in vibration environments greater than 10 g rms between 20 Hz and 2000 Hz.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9A106.d所管制的伺服阀、泵和燃气轮机仅限于以下各项：
texts.en: The only servo valves, pumps and gas turbines controlled by 9A106.d, are the following:

texts.zh: a. 设计为在绝对压力等于或大于7 MPa时流量等于或大于每分钟24升，且作动器响应时间小于100 ms的伺服阀；
texts.en: a. Servo valves designed for flow rates equal to or greater than 24 liters per minute, at an absolute pressure equal to or greater than 7 MPa, that have an actuator response time of less than 100 ms;

texts.zh: b. 在最大运行模式下轴转速等于或大于8,000 rpm，或排出压力等于或大于7 Mpa的液体推进剂用泵；或
texts.en: b. Pumps, for liquid propellants, with shaft speeds equal to or greater than 8,000 rpm at the maximum operating mode or with discharge pressures equal to or greater than 7 Mpa; or

texts.zh: c. 在最大运行模式下轴转速等于或大于8,000 rpm的液体推进剂涡轮泵用燃气轮机。
texts.en: c. Gas turbines, for liquid propellant turbopumps, with shaft speeds equal to or greater than 8,000 rpm at the maximum operating mode.

texts.zh: e. 为“导弹”使用而设计或改装，且设计或改装为可在20Hz至2 kHz整个范围内振动大于10g rms的环境中运行的飞行控制伺服阀。
texts.en: e. Flight control servo valves designed or modified for use in “missiles” and designed or modified to operate in a vibration environment greater than 10g rms over the entire range between 20Hz and 2 kHz.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下任一特性：

texts.zh: b.1. 集成容量大于20升的气溶胶布撒系统/机构；或
texts.en: b.1. Incorporating an aerosol dispensing system/mechanism with a capacity greater than 20 liters; or

texts.zh: b.2. 经设计或改进，可集成容量大于20升的气溶胶布撒系统/机构。
texts.en: b.2. Designed or modified to incorporate an aerosol dispensing system/mechanism with a capacity of greater than 20 liters.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9A120不管制为娱乐或竞赛用途“专门设计”的模型飞机。
texts.en: 9A120 does not control model aircraft, “specially designed” for recreational or competition purposes.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 气溶胶由燃料成分、副产物或添加剂以外的颗粒物或液体构成，作为拟散布于大气中的“载荷”的一部分。气溶胶示例包括用于作物喷洒的农药及用于人工增雨的干燥化学品。
texts.en: 1. An aerosol consists of particulate or liquids other than fuel components, by—products or additives, as part of the “payload” to be dispersed in the atmosphere. Examples of aerosols include pesticides for crop dusting and dry chemicals for cloud seeding.

texts.zh: 2. 气溶胶布撒系统/机构包括储存气溶胶并将其散布至大气所必需的上述所有装置（机械、电气、液压等），也包括将气溶胶注入燃烧排气蒸气及螺旋桨滑流的可能方式。
texts.en: 2. An aerosol dispensing system/mechanism contains all above devices (mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, etc.), which are necessary for storage and dispersion of an aerosol into the atmosphere. This includes the possibility of aerosol injection into the combustion exhaust vapor and into the propeller slip stream.

See § 742.6(a)(9), which specifies that such commodities are subject to a worldwide license requirement, except to Australia, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

texts.zh: (2) ECCN 9A004.a至.f适用于某些航天运载火箭、航天器、航天器平台、航天器载荷、星载系统或设备及地面设备。尽管这些物项的管制规定载于ECCN 9A515，仍将其列入ECCN 9A004.a至.f，以使9A004与《瓦森纳安排》两用物项清单协调一致，并指引出口商、再出口商和转移方就9A004.a查阅USML第IV类。9A004.a见UMSL第IV类［原文如此，疑为USML］。9A004.b至.f及.h见ECCN 9A515。.g、.h、.r、.s及.u至.y见本ECCN 9A004。
texts.en: (2) ECCN 9A004.a through .f apply to certain space launch vehicles, spacecraft, spacecraft buses, spacecraft payloads, on-board systems or equipment, and terrestrial equipment. They are listed in ECCN 9A004.a through .f in order to harmonize 9A004 with the Wassenaar Arrangement Dual-Use List, even though the controls for these items are found under ECCN 9A515 and to direct exporters, reexporters, and transferors to see USML Category IV for 9A004.a. See UMSL Category IV for 9A004.a. See ECCN 9A515 for 9A004.b through .f, and .h. See this ECCN 9A004 for .g, .h, .r, .s, and .u through .y.
