(2) License Exception STA may not be used if the “spacecraft” controlled in ECCN 9A515.a.1, a.2, a.3, or a.4 contains a separable or removable propulsion system described in USML Category IV(d)(2) or USML Category XV(e)(12) and designated MT. (3) Paragraph (c)(2) of License Exception STA (§ 740.20(c)(2) of the EAR) may not be used for any item in 9A515.

texts.zh: 受管制物项清单
texts.en: List of Items Controlled

texts.zh: 相关管制：USML所述航天器、运载火箭及相关物品，与其直接相关的技术数据（包括“软件”），以及与将任何卫星或航天器集成至运载火箭直接相关的所有服务（包括培训），包括规划和现场支持，或为ECCN 9A515.a物项的发射失败分析或调查提供的任何协助（包括培训），均“受ITAR管辖”。下文列举且由§772.1定义的其他所有“航天器”均受本ECCN管制。特定“航天级”物项另见ECCN 3A001、3A002、3A991、3A992、6A002、6A004、6A008和6A998；星跟踪器见7A004和7A104；国际空间站（ISS）、詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”见9A004。某些“单片微波集成电路”（MMIC）放大器的管制见USML第XI(c)类。用于高空航空器的压力服见ECCN 9A610.g。
texts.en: Related Controls: Spacecraft, launch vehicles and related articles that are described on the USML, and technical data (including “software”) directly related thereto, and all services (including training) directly related to the integration of any satellite or spacecraft to a launch vehicle, including both planning and onsite support, or furnishing any assistance (including training) in the launch failure analysis or investigation for items in ECCN 9A515.a, are “subject to the ITAR.” All other “spacecraft,” as enumerated below and defined in § 772.1, are subject to the controls of this ECCN. See also ECCNs 3A001, 3A002, 3A991, 3A992, 6A002, 6A004, 6A008, and 6A998 for specific “space-qualified” items, 7A004 and 7A104 for star trackers, and 9A004 for the International Space Station (ISS), the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor. See USML Category XI(c) for controls on certain “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers. See ECCN 9A610.g for pressure suits used for high altitude aircraft.

texts.zh: 相关定义：“微电路”是指多个无源或有源元件在连续结构的表面或内部不可分割地结合在一起，以执行电路功能的器件。
texts.en: Related Definitions: 'Microcircuit' means a device in which a number of passive or active elements are considered as indivisibly associated on or within a continuous structure to perform the function of a circuit.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: ECCN 9A515所述“航天器”和其他物项，即使在出口、再出口或境内转移时，内部集成并包含“受ITAR管辖”的国防物品作为该物项不可分割的组成部分，仍受EAR管辖。在其他所有情况下，此类国防物品受ITAR管辖。例如，9A515.a“航天器”即使在出口、再出口或境内转移时，内部集成了USML第XV(e)(17)类所述“搭载载荷”，仍“受EAR管辖”。在其他所有情况下，执行USML第XV(a)类所述功能的“搭载载荷”始终属于USML物项。无论航天器依据何种CCL授权出口，将受ITAR管辖的国防物品从航天器上移除均构成ITAR项下的再转移，需要ITAR授权。此外，转移有关集成于航天器内、受ITAR管辖的国防物品的技术数据，也需要ITAR授权。
texts.en: “Spacecraft” and other items described in ECCN 9A515 remain subject to the EAR even if exported, reexported, or transferred (in-country) with defense articles “subject to the ITAR” integrated into and included therein as integral parts of the item. In all other cases, such defense articles are subject to the ITAR. For example, a 9A515.a “spacecraft” remains “subject to the EAR” even when it is exported, reexported, or transferred (in-country) with a “hosted payload” described in USML Category XV(e)(17) incorporated therein. In all other cases, a “hosted payload” performing a function described in USML Category XV(a) always remains a USML item. The removal of the defense article subject to the ITAR from the spacecraft is a retransfer under the ITAR and would require an ITAR authorization, regardless of the CCL authorization the spacecraft is exported under. Additionally, transfer of technical data regarding the defense article subject to the ITAR integrated into the spacecraft would require an ITAR authorization.

texts.zh: a. 未由USML第XV类描述，亦未由ECCN 9A004.r、.u或.w描述的“航天器”（包括卫星）、航天飞行器及“亚轨道飞行器”，无论其是否被指定用于开发、实验、研究或科学目的，且具有以下特性：
texts.en: a. “Spacecraft,” including satellites, and space vehicles and “sub-orbital craft,” whether designated developmental, experimental, research or scientific, not described in USML Category XV or described in ECCN 9A004.r, .u, or .w, that:

texts.zh: a.1. 具有光电遥感能力，净孔径大于0.35米但小于或等于0.50米；
texts.en: a.1. Have electro-optical remote sensing capabilities and having a clear aperture greater than 0.35 meters, but less than or equal to 0.50 meters;

texts.zh: a.2. 具有超出近红外（NIR）范围的遥感能力，即短波红外（SWIR）、中波红外（MWIR）或长波红外（LWIR）；
texts.en: a.2. Have remote sensing capabilities beyond NIR (i.e., SWIR, MWIR, or LWIR);

texts.zh: a.3. 具有雷达遥感能力，例如有源电子扫描阵列（AESA）、合成孔径雷达（SAR）或逆合成孔径雷达（ISAR），中心频率等于或大于1.0 GHz但小于10.0 GHz，且带宽等于或大于100 MHz但小于300 MHz；
texts.en: a.3. Have radar remote sensing capabilities (e.g., AESA, SAR, or ISAR) having a center frequency equal to or greater than 1.0 GHz, but less than 10.0 GHz and having a bandwidth equal to or greater than 100 MHz, but less than 300 MHz;

texts.zh: a.4. 为另一“航天器”提供天基物流、组装或在轨服务；或
texts.en: a.4. Provide space-based logistics, assembly, or servicing of another “spacecraft”; or

texts.zh: a.5. 未由ECCN 9A515.a.1、.a.2、.a.3或.a.4描述。
texts.en: a.5. Are not described in ECCN 9A515.a.1, .a.2, .a.3 or .a.4.
Note 1 to 9A515:

texts.zh: ECCN 9A515.a包括未在ECCN 9A004或USML第XV(a)类指明的商业通信卫星、遥感卫星、“亚轨道飞行器”以及行星和行星际探测器。
texts.en: ECCN 9A515.a includes commercial communications satellites, remote sensing satellites, “sub-orbital craft,” and planetary and interplanetary probes, not identified in ECCN 9A004 or USML Category XV(a).

texts.zh: b. 以下遥测、跟踪和控制设备：
texts.en: b. Equipment for telemetry, tracking, and control, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 为对9A004.u或9A515.a款所管制“航天器”进行遥测、跟踪和控制而“专门设计”的地面控制系统和训练模拟器；
texts.en: b.1. Ground control systems and training simulators “specially designed” for telemetry, tracking, and control of the “spacecraft” controlled in paragraphs 9A004.u or 9A515.a;

texts.zh: b.2. 以下为“航天器”“专门设计”的地面设备：
texts.en: b.2. Terrestrial equipment “specially designed” for “spacecraft,” as follows:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 为以下任一数据处理功能“专门设计”的遥测和遥控设备：
texts.en: b.2.a. Telemetry and telecommand equipment “specially designed” for any of the following data processing functions:

texts.zh: b.2.a.1. 对遥测数据进行帧同步和纠错处理，以监测“航天器平台”的运行状态，也称健康与安全状态；或
texts.en: b.2.a.1. Telemetry data processing of frame synchronization and error corrections, for monitoring of operational status (also known as health and safe status) of the “spacecraft bus;” or

texts.zh: b.2.a.2. 对指令数据进行格式化处理，以发送至“航天器”并控制“航天器平台”；
texts.en: b.2.a.2. Command data processing for formatting command data being sent to the “spacecraft” to control the “spacecraft bus;”

texts.zh: b.2.b. ［保留］
texts.en: b.2.b. [Reserved]

texts.zh: b.3. 为“验证航天器操作程序”而“专门设计”的模拟器。
texts.en: b.3. Simulators “specially designed” for 'verification of operational procedures' of “spacecraft.”

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9A515.b.3而言，“验证操作程序”是指以下任一事项：
texts.en: For the purposes of 9A515.b.3, 'verification of operational procedures' is any of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 指令序列确认；
texts.en: 1. Command sequence confirmation;

texts.zh: 2. 操作培训；
texts.en: 2. Operational training;

texts.zh: 3. 操作演练；或
texts.en: 3. Operational rehearsals; or

texts.zh: 4. 操作分析。
texts.en: 4. Operational analysis.

texts.zh: c. [保留]
texts.en: c. [Reserved]

texts.zh: d. 经额定、认证或以其他方式规定或描述为达到或超过下列所有特性，且为国防物品、“600系列”物项或ECCN 9A004.v或9A515所管制物项“专门设计”的微电子电路（例如集成电路、微电路或MOSFET）及分立电子部件：
texts.en: d. Microelectronic circuits (e.g., integrated circuits, microcircuits, or MOSFETs) and discrete electronic components rated, certified, or otherwise specified or described as meeting or exceeding all the following characteristics and that are “specially designed” for defense articles, “600 series” items, or items controlled by ECCNs 9A004.v or 9A515:
d.1. A total dose of 5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si) (5 × 10^{3} Gy (Si));

texts.zh: d.2. 剂量率翻转阈值5 × 10^{8} Rads (Si)/sec（5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/sec）；
texts.en: d.2. A dose rate upset threshold of 5 × 10^{8} Rads (Si)/sec (5 × 10^{6} Gy (Si)/sec);
d.3. A neutron dose of 1 × 10^{14} n/cm^{2} (1 MeV equivalent);

texts.zh: d.4. 在CRÈME-MC地球同步轨道、太阳活动极小期重离子通量环境下，未经校正的单粒子翻转敏感度为1 × 10^{−}^{10} errors/bit/day或更低；并且
texts.en: d.4. An uncorrected single event upset sensitivity of 1 × 10^{−}^{10} errors/bit/day or less, for the CRÈME-MC geosynchronous orbit, Solar Minimum Environment for heavy ion flux; and

texts.zh: d.5. 对于能量大于50 MeV、注量为1 × 10^{7} protons/cm^{2}的质子，未经校正的单粒子翻转敏感度为1 × 10^{−}^{10} errors/part或更低。
texts.en: d.5. An uncorrected single event upset sensitivity of 1 × 10^{−}^{10} errors/part or less for a fluence of 1 × 10^{7} protons/cm^{2} for proton energy greater than 50 MeV.

texts.zh: e. 经额定、认证或以其他方式规定或描述为达到或超过e.1或e.2款任一款所列特性，并且为USML第XV类所述国防物品或ECCN 9A004.u或9A515所管制物项“专门设计”的微电子电路（例如集成电路、微电路或MOSFET）及分立电子部件：
texts.en: e. Microelectronic circuits (e.g., integrated circuits, microcircuits, or MOSFETs) and discrete electronic components that are rated, certified, or otherwise specified or described as meeting or exceeding the characteristics in either paragraph e.1 or e.2, AND “specially designed” for defense articles described in USML Category XV or items controlled by ECCNs 9A004.u or 9A515:

texts.zh: e.1. 总剂量≥1 × 10^{5} Rads (Si)（1 × 10^{3} Gy(Si)）且<5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si)（5 × 10^{3} Gy(Si)）；并且对线性能量转移（LET）≥80 MeV-cm^{2}/mg具有单粒子效应（SEE）免疫性，即不发生单粒子锁定（SEL）、单粒子烧毁（SEB）或单粒子栅极击穿（SEGR）；或
texts.en: e.1. A total dose ≥1 × 10^{5} Rads (Si) (1 × 10^{3} Gy(Si)) and <5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si) (5 × 10^{3} Gy(Si)); and a single event effect (SEE) (i.e., single event latchup (SEL), single event burnout (SEB), or single event gate rupture (SEGR)) immunity to a linear energy transfer (LET) ≥80 MeV-cm^{2}/mg; or
e.2. A total dose ≥5 × 10^{5} Rads (Si) (5 × 10^{3} Gy (Si)) and not described in 9A515.d.

texts.zh: 9A515.d和.e说明2：
texts.en: Note 2 to 9A515.d and .e:

texts.zh: 军用电子产品见USML第XI类。为600系列物项编程的可编程逻辑器件（PLD）和专用集成电路（ASIC）见3A611.f。
texts.en: See USML Category XI for military electronics. See 3A611.f for PLDs and ASICs programmed for 600 series items.

texts.zh: 9A515.d和.e说明3：
texts.en: Note 3 to 9A515.d and .e:

texts.zh: 对于“受EAR管辖”、但不由9A515.d或.e管制的抗辐射加固微电子电路的管制，见3A001.a和.z。
texts.en: See 3A001.a and .z for controls on radiation-hardened microelectronic circuits “subject to the EAR” that are not controlled by 9A515.d or .e.

texts.zh: f. 能在海拔大于或等于55,000英尺高度运行的压力服，即航天服。
texts.en: f. Pressure suits (i.e., space suits) capable of operating at altitudes greater than or equal to 55,000 feet above sea level.

texts.zh: g. 以下为ECCN 9A515.a.1至.a.4所述“航天器”“专门设计”的遥感部件：
texts.en: g. Remote sensing components “specially designed” for “spacecraft” described in ECCNs 9A515.a.1 through .a.4 as follows:

texts.zh: g.1. 航天级光学件，即具有主动特性（例如自适应、可变形）的透镜、反射镜或薄膜，其最大横向净孔径尺寸等于或小于0.35米；或最大净孔径尺寸大于0.35米但小于或等于0.50米；
texts.en: g.1. Space-qualified optics (i.e., lens, mirror, membrane having active properties (e.g., adaptive, deformable)) with the largest lateral clear aperture dimension equal to or less than 0.35 meters; or with the largest clear aperture dimension greater than 0.35 meters but less than or equal to 0.50 meters;

texts.zh: g.2. 为ECCN 9A515.a.1、a.2、a.3或a.4“航天器”“专门设计”的光学基台组件；或
texts.en: g.2. Optical bench assemblies “specially designed” for ECCN 9A515.a.1, a.2, a.3, or a.4 “spacecraft;” or

texts.zh: g.3. 执行ECCN 9A515.a.1、a.2、a.3或a.4“航天器”功能的主载荷、次载荷或搭载载荷。
texts.en: g.3. Primary, secondary, or hosted payloads that perform a function of ECCN 9A515.a.1, a.2, a.3, or a.4 “spacecraft.”

texts.zh: h. 使用双组元或单组元推进剂，提供等于或小于150 lbf（即667.23 N）真空推力的航天器推力器。
texts.en: h. Spacecraft thrusters using bi-propellants or mono-propellants that provide thrust equal to or less than 150 lbf (i.e., 667.23 N) vacuum thrust.

texts.zh: i.至w.［保留］
texts.en: i. through w. [RESERVED]

texts.zh: w. 原本属于ECCN 9A515.x范围，但经跨部门认定应在9A515.w中管制的以下“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”：
texts.en: w. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that would otherwise be within the scope of ECCN 9A515.x but that have been identified by the interagency as warranting control in 9A515.w, as follows:
w.1. [Reserved]

texts.zh: x. 为USML第XV类所述国防物品或9A515所管制物项“专门设计”，且不属于以下情形的“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”：
texts.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for defense articles described in USML Category XV or items controlled by 9A515, and that are NOT:

texts.zh: x.1. 已在USML或ECCN 9A515或9A004其他部分描述；
texts.en: x.1. Described on the USML or elsewhere within ECCNs 9A515 or 9A004;

texts.zh: x.2. 微电子电路和分立电子部件；
texts.en: x.2. Microelectronic circuits and discrete electronic components;

texts.zh: x.3. 已由ECCN 7A004或7A104描述；
texts.en: x.3. Described in ECCNs 7A004 or 7A104;

x.4. Described in an ECCN containing “space-qualified” as a control criterion (i.e., 3A001.b.1, .e.4 or .z, 3A002.g.1, 3A991.o, 3A992.b.3, 6A002.a.1, .b.2, .d.1, 6A004.c and .d, 6A008.j.1, 6A998.b, or 7A003.d.2);

texts.zh: x.5. 微波固态放大器和微波组件，其管制见ECCN 3A001.b.4和.z；
texts.en: x.5. Microwave solid state amplifiers and microwave assemblies (refer to ECCN 3A001.b.4 and .z for controls on these items);

texts.zh: x.6. 行波管放大器，其管制见ECCN 3A001.b.8和.z；或
texts.en: x.6. Travelling wave tube amplifiers (refer to ECCN 3A001.b.8 and .z for controls on these items); or

texts.zh: x.7. 已在ECCN 9A515.y另行列明。
texts.en: x.7. Elsewhere specified in ECCN 9A515.y.
Note 4 to 9A515.x:

texts.zh: 在USML第XV(e)类或其他部分描述的“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”，受ITAR管辖。
texts.en: “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” described on the USML, either in Category XV(e) or elsewhere, are subject to the ITAR.

texts.zh: 9A515.b和.x说明5：
texts.en: Note 5 to 9A515.b and .x:

texts.zh: 本说明澄清基带单元（BBU）的管制范围。就9A515.b和.x而言，BBU是指解析传输信号原始频率范围的设备。此类设备在不执行遥测、跟踪和控制功能时，不受9A515.b或.x管制。
texts.en: This note clarifies the scope of controls over baseband units (BBU). For purposes of 9A515.b and .x, a BBU means a device that interprets the original frequency range of a transmission signal. These devices are not controlled under 9A515.b or .x when they do not perform telemetry, track, and control.

texts.zh: y. 原本属于ECCN 9A515.x范围，但根据§748.3(e)在经跨部门核准的商品归类（CCATS）中认定应在9A515.y管制的物项。
texts.en: y. Items that would otherwise be within the scope of ECCN 9A515.x but that have been identified in an interagency-cleared commodity classification (CCATS) pursuant to § 748.3(e) as warranting control in 9A515.y.

texts.zh: y.1. 未在9A515.e中列明的分立电子组件；
texts.en: y.1. Discrete electronic components not specified in 9A515.e;

texts.zh: y.2. 航天器应用用热敏电阻；
texts.en: y.2. Thermistors for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.3. 射频微波带通陶瓷滤波器（例如介质谐振器带通滤波器）；
texts.en: y.3. RF microwave bandpass ceramic filters (e.g., Dielectric Resonator Bandpass Filters);

texts.zh: y.4. 航天器应用用霍尔效应传感器；
texts.en: y.4. Hall effect sensors for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.5. 航天器应用用超小型（SMA和SMP）插头和连接器、TNC插头，以及带SMA插头和连接器的电缆和连接器总成；
texts.en: y.5. Subminiature (SMA and SMP) plugs and connectors, TNC plugs and cable and connector assemblies with SMA plugs and connectors for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.6. 航天器应用用飞行电缆总成；
texts.en: y.6. Flight cable assemblies for spacecraft applications;

texts.zh: y.7. 公共广播（PA）系统；
texts.en: y.7. Public address (PA) systems;

texts.zh: y.8. 音频选择面板；
texts.en: y.8. Audio selector panels;

texts.zh: y.9. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的盥洗室和人体排泄物管理系统；
texts.en: y.9. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant lavatories and body waste management systems;

texts.zh: y.10. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的个人卫生设施和系统；
texts.en: y.10. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant hygiene facilities and systems;

texts.zh: y.11. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的人员休息设备或睡眠舱；
texts.en: y.11. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant crew rest equipment or sleeping quarters;

texts.zh: y.12. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的厨房、食品制备或供餐系统；
texts.en: y.12. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant galleys or food preparation or serving systems;

texts.zh: y.13. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的娱乐系统；
texts.en: y.13. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant entertainment systems;

texts.zh: y.14. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的锻炼系统；
texts.en: y.14. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant exercise systems;

texts.zh: y.15. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的洗衣系统；
texts.en: y.15. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant laundry systems;

texts.zh: y.16. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者安全系统，但不包括发射中止系统/发射逃逸系统、弹射座椅、航天服、飞行服、头盔及其“零件”和“部件”；
texts.en: y.16. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant safety systems, not including launch abort systems/launch escape systems, ejector seats, spacesuits, flight suits, helmets, or “parts” and “components” therefor;

texts.zh: y.17. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的储物单元、设施或系统（用于与人员安全、福祉和健康有关的物项）；
texts.en: y.17. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant storage units, facilities, or systems (for items related to human safety, welfare, and health);

texts.zh: y.18. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的医疗设施或与健康相关的系统，用于监测、评价、评估或提供治疗；
texts.en: y.18. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant medical facilities or health-related systems for monitoring, evaluating, or assessing, or for providing treatments;

texts.zh: y.19. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的信息系统（例如个人笔记本电脑和电话）；
texts.en: y.19. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant information systems (e.g., personal laptops and phones);

texts.zh: y.20. 铭牌、识别牌和识别系统；
texts.en: y.20. Name plates, identification plates, and identification systems;

texts.zh: y.21. 内部、外部和应急照明系统；
texts.en: y.21. Internal, external, and emergency lighting systems;

texts.zh: y.22. 除湿和CO_{2}去除系统；
texts.en: y.22. Humidity and CO_{2} removal systems;

texts.zh: y.23. 饮用水储存系统；
texts.en: y.23. Potable water storage systems;

texts.zh: y.24. 水再生系统；
texts.en: y.24. Water regeneration systems;

texts.zh: y.25. 空气过滤器、过滤网络或空气质量系统；
texts.en: y.25. Air filters, filter networks, or air quality systems;

texts.zh: y.26. 人员居住用空间加热器、温度传感器或恒温器；
texts.en: y.26. Space heaters, temperature sensors, or thermostats for human habitation;

texts.zh: y.27. 人员居住用环境控制系统；
texts.en: y.27. Environmental control systems for human habitation;

texts.zh: y.28. 航天器环境控制系统（例如空调、空气分配、空气过滤和消毒、CO_{2}去除、舱压控制、除湿器、灭火系统、氮氧补充系统、加热器系统、恒温器）；
texts.en: y.28. Spacecraft environmental control systems (e.g., air conditioner, air distribution, air filtration and sanitation, CO_{2} removal, cabin pressure control, dehumidifier, fire suppression system, nitrogen oxygen recharge system, heater systems, thermostats);

texts.zh: y.29. 植物生长系统；
texts.en: y.29. Plant growth systems;

texts.zh: y.30. 灭火器；
texts.en: y.30. Fire extinguishers;

texts.zh: y.31. 火焰、烟雾或CO_{2}探测器；
texts.en: y.31. Flame, smoke, or CO_{2} detectors;

texts.zh: y.32. 灭火系统；
texts.en: y.32. Fire suppression systems;

texts.zh: y.33. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者座椅及其“零件”和“部件”，弹射座椅除外；
texts.en: y.33. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant seats, other than ejection seats, and “parts” and “components;”

texts.zh: y.34. 航天飞行机组人员、乘客或参与者的弹射座椅上安装的救生辅助装置；
texts.en: y.34. Spaceflight crew, passenger, or participant ejection seat mounted survival aids;

texts.zh: y.35. 航天飞行机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的救生筏；
texts.en: y.35. Spaceflight crew, passenger, or participant life rafts;

texts.zh: y.36. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的定位信标；
texts.en: y.36. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant locator beacons;

texts.zh: y.37. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的镜子；
texts.en: y.37. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant mirrors;

texts.zh: y.38. 航天器机组人员、乘客或参与者使用的舷窗；
texts.en: y.38. Spacecraft crew, passenger, or participant windows;

texts.zh: y.39. 航天器定位信标；
texts.en: y.39. Spacecraft locator beacons;

texts.zh: y.40. 无人航天器上的观察窗；
texts.en: y.40. Viewing windows on non-crewed spacecraft;

texts.zh: y.41. 温度传感器和压力传感器；
texts.en: y.41. Temperature sensors and pressure transducers;

texts.zh: y.42. 热控泵、蓄能器、流体过滤器及过滤器组件、控制阀、热交换器和散热器；
texts.en: y.42. Thermal control pumps, accumulators, fluid filters and filter assemblies, control valves, heat exchangers, and radiators;

texts.zh: y.43. 液压、气动、滑油、燃油、气体、推进剂、流体及热控流体的储罐、过滤器、过滤器组件、管材、管路、软管、止回阀和快速断开接头，以及相关管件、联轴器、夹具、支架、适配器、阀门、垫片、调整垫片和O形圈；
texts.en: y.43. Hydraulic, pneumatic, oil, fuel, gas, propellant, fluid, and thermal control fluid reservoirs, filters, filter assemblies, tubing, lines, hoses, check valves, and quick disconnects, and associated fittings, couplings, clamps, brackets, adapters, valves, gaskets, shims, and o-rings;

texts.zh: y.44. 仪表和指示器；
texts.en: y.44. Gauges and indicators;

texts.zh: y.45. 带滤波或不带滤波的面板旋钮、指示器、信号指示面板、开关、按钮和刻度盘；
texts.en: y.45. Filtered and unfiltered panel knobs, indicators, annunciator panels, switches, buttons and dials;

texts.zh: y.46. 航天器轮胎和制动系统，不包括烧结混合材料或碳/碳材料；
texts.en: y.46. Spacecraft tires and brake systems (does not include sintered mix or carbon/carbon materials);

texts.zh: y.47. 轴承，例如球轴承、滚子轴承和车轮轴承；
texts.en: y.47. Bearings (e.g., Ball, roller, wheel);

texts.zh: STA：(1) 9A610.a中的任何物项，即军用航空器“最终物项”，不得使用许可证例外STA的(c)(1)款（EAR §740.20(c)(1)），但BIS依据§740.20(g)（9x515及“600系列”物项的许可证例外STA资格申请）认定其符合该例外条件的除外。(2) 对9A610.a中因导弹技术（MT）原因管制、能够将至少500 kg载荷投送至至少300 km航程的商品，不得使用许可证例外STA运往A:5或A:6国家组所列任何目的地，见EAR第740部分补充文件1。(3) 9A610中的任何物项均不得使用许可证例外STA的(c)(2)款（EAR §740.20(c)(2)）。
texts.en: STA: (1) Paragraph (c)(1) of License Exception STA (§ 740.20(c)(1) of the EAR) may not be used for any item in 9A610.a (i.e., “end item” military aircraft), unless determined by BIS to be eligible for License Exception STA in accordance with § 740.20(g) (License Exception STA eligibility requests for 9x515 and “600 series” items). (2) License Exception STA may not be used to ship commodities in 9A610.a that are controlled for missile technology (MT) reasons that have a payload capability of at least 500 kg to a range of at least 300 km to any of the destinations listed in Country Groups A:5 or A:6 (See supplement no.1 to part 740 of the EAR). (3) Paragraph (c)(2) of License Exception STA (§ 740.20(c)(2) of the EAR) may not be used for any item in 9A610.

texts.zh: a. 为军用目的“专门设计”、但未在USML第VIII(a)款列举的“军用航空器”。
texts.en: a. 'Military Aircraft' “specially designed” for a military use that are not enumerated in USML paragraph VIII(a).
Note 1:

texts.zh: 就.a款而言，“军用航空器”是指LM-100J航空器，以及为军用目的“专门设计”、但未在USML第VIII(a)款列举的任何航空器。该术语包括教练机、运输机、通用固定翼飞机、军用直升机、观察机、军用非膨胀式气球及其他轻于空气的航空器、无武装军用航空器、“无人驾驶航空器”（UAV）及遥控飞行器（RPV），不论其来源或名称。为加入飞行安全特性或美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）或国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）要求的其他改装，例如应答机和飞行数据记录器，而进行改装的航空器，就本.a款而言视为“未经改装”。
texts.en: For purposes of paragraph .a the term 'military aircraft' means the LM-100J aircraft and any aircraft “specially designed” for a military use that are not enumerated in USML paragraph VIII(a). The term includes: Trainer aircraft; cargo aircraft; utility fixed wing aircraft; military helicopters; observation aircraft; military non-expansive balloons and other lighter-than-air aircraft; unarmed military aircraft,” unmanned aerial vehicles” (“UAVs”), and remotely piloted vehicles (RPVs), regardless of origin or designation. Aircraft with modifications made to incorporate safety of flight features or other FAA or NTSB modifications such as transponders and air data recorders are “unmodified” for the purposes of this paragraph .a.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 9A610.a不管制符合以下条件的“军用航空器”或“轻于空气的飞行器”：
texts.en: 9A610.a does not control 'military aircraft' or “lighter-than-air vehicles” that:

texts.zh: a. 首次制造时间早于1946年；
texts.en: a. Were first manufactured before 1946;

texts.zh: b. 未集成美国军品清单列举或以其他方式描述的国防物品，但为符合A:1国家组所列国家民航主管机关的安全或适航标准所必需的物项除外；并且
texts.en: b. Do not incorporate defense articles enumerated or otherwise described on the U.S. Munitions List, unless the items are required to meet safety or airworthiness standards of civil aviation authorities of a country listed in Country Group A:1; and

texts.zh: c. 未集成美国军品清单列举或以其他方式描述的武器，但该武器已无法使用且无法恢复使用的除外。
texts.en: c. Do not incorporate weapons enumerated or otherwise described on the U.S. Munitions List, unless inoperable and incapable of being returned to operation.

texts.zh: b. 2013年之前制造的L-100航空器。
texts.en: b. L-100 aircraft manufactured prior to 2013.

texts.zh: e. 用于USML第VIII(a)类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器的移动式航空器拦阻和接合跑道系统。
texts.en: e. Mobile aircraft arresting and engagement runway systems for aircraft controlled by either USML Category VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a.

texts.zh: f. 为USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器“专门设计”的压力加油设备及便于在狭小区域作业的设备。
texts.en: f. Pressure refueling equipment and equipment that facilitates operations in confined areas, “specially designed” for aircraft controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a.

texts.zh: g. 用于USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器的机组人员生命保障设备、安全设备及其他应急逃生装置。
texts.en: g. Aircrew life support equipment, aircrew safety equipment and other devices for emergency escape from aircraft controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a.

texts.zh: h. 为与USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器配套使用而“专门设计”的降落伞、滑翔伞、完整伞衣、背带、平台和电子释放机构，以及为军用高空跳伞人员“专门设计”的“设备”，例如服装、专用头盔、呼吸系统和导航设备。
texts.en: h. Parachutes, paragliders, complete parachute canopies, harnesses, platforms, electronic release mechanisms, “specially designed” for use with aircraft controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, and “equipment” “specially designed” for military high altitude parachutists, such as suits, special helmets, breathing systems, and navigation equipment.

texts.zh: i. 为伞降载荷设计的受控开伞设备或自动驾驶系统。
texts.en: i. Controlled opening equipment or automatic piloting systems, designed for parachuted loads.

texts.zh: j. 为军用“专门设计”的地效飞行器（GEMS），包括地表效应飞行器和气垫运载工具。
texts.en: j. Ground effect machines (GEMS), including surface effect machines and air cushion vehicles, “specially designed” for use by a military.

texts.zh: k.至s.［保留］
texts.en: k. through s. [Reserved]

texts.zh: t. 为USML第VIII(a)类所管制、航程等于或大于300 km的无人驾驶航空器“专门设计”的复合结构、层压材料及其制成品。
texts.en: t. Composite structures, laminates, and manufactures thereof “specially designed” for unmanned aerial vehicles controlled under USML Category VIII(a) with a range equal to or greater than 300 km.

texts.zh: .t款说明：
texts.en: Note to paragraph .t:

texts.zh: 为USML第VIII(a)类所管制、最大航程小于300 km的无人驾驶航空器“专门设计”的复合结构、层压材料及其制成品，受本条目.x款管制。
texts.en: Composite structures, laminates, and manufactures thereof “specially designed” for unmanned aerial vehicles controlled under USML Category VIII(a) with a maximum range less than 300 km are controlled in paragraph .x of this entry.

texts.zh: u. 为USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、航程等于或大于300 km的“无人机”的搬运、控制、启动和非舰载发射而“专门设计”的装置和设备。
texts.en: u. Apparatus and devices “specially designed” for the handling, control, activation and non-ship-based launching of “UAVs” controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, and capable of a range equal to or greater than 300 km.

texts.zh: .u款说明：
texts.en: Note to paragraph .u:

texts.zh: 为USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、最大航程小于300 km的“无人机”的搬运、控制、启动和非舰载发射而“专门设计”的装置和设备，受本条目.x款管制。
texts.en: Apparatus and devices “specially designed” for the handling, control, activation and non-ship-based launching of “UAVs” controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a with a maximum range less than 300 km are controlled in paragraph .x of this entry.

texts.zh: v. 为用于USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、能够将至少500千克载荷投送至至少300 km航程的“无人机”而设计或改进的雷达高度计。
texts.en: v. Radar altimeters designed or modified for use in “UAVs” controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a., and capable of delivering at least 500 kilograms payload to a range of at least 300 km.

texts.zh: .v款说明：
texts.en: Note to paragraph .v:

texts.zh: 为用于USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、不能将至少500千克载荷投送至至少300 km航程的“无人机”而设计或改进的雷达高度计，受本条目.x款管制。
texts.en: Radar altimeters designed or modified for use in “UAVs” controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a. that are not capable of delivering at least 500 kilograms payload to a range of at least 300 km are controlled in paragraph .x of this entry.

texts.zh: w.1. 为USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、能够将至少500千克载荷投送至至少300 km航程的“无人机”而设计或改进的气动、液压、机械、光电或机电飞行控制系统（包括电传和光传操纵系统）及姿态控制设备。
texts.en: w.1. Pneumatic hydraulic, mechanical, electro-optical, or electromechanical flight control systems (including fly-by-wire and fly-by-light systems) and attitude control equipment designed or modified for “UAVs” controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a., and capable of delivering at least 500 kilograms payload to a range of at least 300 km.

texts.zh: .w.1款说明：
texts.en: Note to paragraph .w.1:

texts.zh: 为USML第VIII(a)款或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、不能将至少500千克载荷投送至至少300 km航程的“无人机”而设计或改进的气动、液压、机械、光电或机电飞行控制系统（包括电传和光传操纵系统）及姿态控制设备，受本条目.x款管制。
texts.en: Pneumatic, hydraulic, mechanical, electro-optical, or electromechanical flight control systems (including fly-by-wire and fly-by-light systems) and attitude control equipment designed or modified for “UAVs” controlled by either USML paragraph VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a., not capable of delivering at least 500 kilograms payload to a range of at least 300 km are controlled in paragraph .x of this entry.

texts.zh: w.2. 为9A610.w.1中的系统设计或改进，且设计或改进为可在20Hz至2 kHz整个频率范围内、振动大于10g均方根值的环境中工作的飞行控制伺服阀。
texts.en: w.2. Flight control servo valves designed or modified for the systems in 9A610.w.1. and designed or modified to operate in a vibration environment greater than 10g rms over the entire range between 20Hz and 2 kHz.

texts.zh: .w款说明：
texts.en: Note to paragraph .w:

texts.zh: 9A610.w.1和9A610.w.2款包括为使有人航空器能够作为无人驾驶航空器运行而设计或改进的系统、设备和阀门。
texts.en: Paragraphs 9A610.w.1. and 9A610.w.2. include the systems, equipment and valves designed or modified to enable operation of manned aircraft as unmanned aerial vehicles.

texts.zh: x. 为ECCN 9A610（9A610.y除外）列举或以其他方式描述的商品，或USML第VIII类列举或以其他方式描述的国防物品“专门设计”，且未在USML或9A610.y、9A619.y或3A611.y其他部分列明的“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”。

texts.en: y. texts.en: y.1. Aircraft tires;

texts.en: y.2. Analog gauges and indicators;

texts.zh: y.3. 音频选择面板；
texts.en: y.3. Audio selector panels;

texts.en: y.4. Check valves for hydraulic and pneumatic systems;

texts.en: y.5. Crew rest equipment;

texts.en: y.10. Fluid hoses, straight and unbent lines (for a commodity subject to control in this entry or defense article in USML Category VIII), and fittings, couplings, clamps (for a commodity subject to control in this entry or defense article in USML Category VIII) and brackets therefor;

texts.en: y.23. Filtered and unfiltered panel knobs, indicators, switches, buttons, and dials;

texts.en: y.29. 'Military Aircraft' that were first manufactured from 1946 to 1955 that do not incorporate defense articles enumerated or otherwise described on the U.S. Munitions List, unless the items are required to meet safety or airworthiness standards of a Wassenaar Arrangement Participating State; and do not incorporate weapons enumerated or otherwise described on the U.S. Munitions List, unless inoperable and incapable of being returned to operation;

texts.en: y.30. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments,” other than electronic items or navigation equipment, for use in or with a commodity controlled by ECCN 9A610.h;

texts.zh: y.32. 流体歧管；以及

texts.en: y.33. Brackets, carrying cases, controllers, cables and adapters, chargers, docks, mounts, propellers, propeller systems, and propeller blades for “UAVs” and RPVs described in 9A610.a.

texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML第XIX类列举或以其他方式描述的军用燃气涡轮发动机及相关物品，以及与其直接相关的技术数据（包括软件），受《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）管辖。(2) 型号为501-D22的燃气涡轮发动机受ECCN 9A991.d管制，不论拟安装于何种航空器。(3) 对含有超过最低比例限度的美国原产“600系列”受控内容的外国制造“军用商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(4) USML第XIX(f)类所列“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”，受该款管制。(5) ECCN 9A619.y所列“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”，受该款管制。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Military gas turbine engines and related articles that are enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category XIX, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are subject to the jurisdiction of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). (2) Gas turbine engines designated 501-D22 are controlled in ECCN 9A991.d regardless of the aircraft type into which they will be installed. (3) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content. (4) “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” specified in USML Category XIX(f) are subject to the controls of that paragraph. (5) “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” specified in ECCN 9A619.y are subject to the controls of that paragraph.

texts.zh: 相关定义：本条目.y款中的“流体”包括液体和气体。
texts.en: Related Definitions: In paragraph .y of this entry, the term 'fluid' includes liquids and gases.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为军用目的“专门设计”、但不受USML第XIX(a)、(b)、(c)或(d)类管制的“军用燃气涡轮发动机”。
texts.en: a. “Military Gas Turbine Engines” “specially designed” for a military use that are not controlled in USML Category XIX(a), (b), (c), or (d).

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 就ECCN 9A619.a而言，“军用燃气涡轮发动机”是指为USML第VI、VII或VIII类，或CCL中ECCN 0A606、8A609或9A610所列“最终物项”“专门设计”的燃气涡轮发动机。
texts.en: For purposes of ECCN 9A619.a, the term “military gas turbine engines” means gas turbine engines “specially designed” for “end items” enumerated in USML Categories VI, VII or VIII or on the CCL under ECCNs 0A606, 8A609 or 9A610.

texts.zh: b. 为本ECCN 9A619所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的数字发动机控制装置，例如全权限数字发动机控制系统（FADEC）和数字电子发动机控制系统（DEEC）。
texts.en: b. Digital engine controls (e.g., Full Authority Digital Engine Controls (FADEC) and Digital Electronic Engine Controls (DEEC)) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in this ECCN 9A619.

texts.zh: c. 为9A619.a所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的热端部件，即燃烧室和火焰筒；高压涡轮叶片、导向叶片、盘及相关冷却结构；冷却式低压涡轮叶片、导向叶片、盘及相关冷却结构；冷却式加力燃烧室；以及冷却式喷嘴；
texts.en: c. If “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in 9A619.a, hot section components (i.e., combustion chambers and liners; high pressure turbine blades, vanes, disks and related cooled structure; cooled low pressure turbine blades, vanes, disks and related cooled structure; cooled augmenters; and cooled nozzles);

texts.zh: d. 为9A619.a所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的非冷却涡轮叶片、导向叶片、盘和叶尖护环；
texts.en: d. If “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in 9A619.a, uncooled turbine blades, vanes, disks, and tip shrouds;

texts.zh: e. 为9A619.a所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的燃烧室罩壳、扩压器、头部和壳体；
texts.en: e. If “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in 9A619.a, combustor cowls, diffusers, domes, and shells;

texts.zh: f. 为本ECCN 9A619所管制燃气涡轮发动机及部件“专门设计”的发动机监测系统，即执行预测、诊断和健康监测的系统。
texts.en: f. Engine monitoring systems (i.e., those that conduct prognostics, diagnostics, and monitor health) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines and components controlled in this ECCN 9A619.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 为安装于军用陆地、海上、空中或航天运载工具“专门设计”，能够在运动中工作，并能够产生或维持低于103 K（−170 °C）温度的设备。
texts.en: Items: a. Equipment “specially designed” to be installed in a vehicle for military ground, marine, airborne, or space applications, and capable of operating while in motion and of producing or maintaining temperatures below 103 K (−170 °C).

texts.zh: 9A620.a说明：
texts.en: Note to 9A620.a:

texts.zh: ECCN 9A620.a包括集成或使用由非金属或不导电材料（例如塑料或环氧树脂浸渍材料）制成的“附件”或“部件”的移动系统。
texts.en: ECCN 9A620.a includes mobile systems incorporating or employing “accessories” or “components” manufactured from non-metallic or non-electrical conductive materials such as plastics or epoxy-impregnated materials.

texts.zh: b. 为安装于军用陆地、海上、空中或航天运载工具“专门设计”，且能够在运动中工作的“超导”电气设备，即旋转机械和变压器。
texts.en: b. “Superconductive” electrical equipment (rotating machinery and transformers) “specially designed” to be installed in a vehicle for military ground, marine, airborne, or space applications, and capable of operating while in motion.

texts.zh: 9A620.b说明：
texts.en: Note to 9A620.b:

texts.zh: ECCN 9A620.b不管制直流混合式单极发电机：其单极常导金属电枢在超导绕组产生的磁场内旋转，且该绕组是发电机内唯一的超导部件。
texts.en: ECCN 9A620.b. does not control direct-current hybrid homopolar generators that have single-pole normal metal armatures which rotate in a magnetic field produced by superconducting windings, provided those windings are the only superconducting components in the generator.

texts.zh: 物项：a. 以下非军事化军用航空器，即未经专门装备或改装用于军事行动的航空器：
texts.en: Items: a. Military aircraft, demilitarized (not specifically equipped or modified for military operation), as follows:

texts.zh: a.1. 采用“C”型号代号，编号为C-45至C-118（含）、C-121至C-125（含）及C-131，且仅使用往复式发动机的运输机。
texts.en: a.1 Cargo aircraft bearing “C” designations and numbered C-45 through C-118 inclusive, C-121 through C-125 inclusive, and C-131, using reciprocating engines only.

texts.zh: a.2. 采用“T”型号代号，使用往复式发动机或功率低于600轴马力（s.h.p.）的涡轮螺旋桨发动机的教练机。
texts.en: a.2 Trainer aircraft bearing “T” designations and using reciprocating engines or turboprop engines with less than 600 horsepower (s.h.p.).

texts.zh: a.3. 采用“U”型号代号且仅使用往复式发动机的通用飞机。
texts.en: a.3 Utility aircraft bearing “U” designations and using reciprocating engines only.

texts.zh: a.4. 所有采用“L”型号代号的联络机。
texts.en: a.4 All liaison aircraft bearing an “L” designation.

texts.zh: a.5. 所有采用“O”型号代号且使用往复式发动机的观察机。
texts.en: a.5 All observation aircraft bearing “O” designations and using reciprocating engines.

texts.zh: b. 其他未列明的航空器；
texts.en: b. Aircraft n.e.s.;

texts.zh: c. 航空燃气涡轮发动机，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”。
texts.en: c. Aero gas turbine engines, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9A991.c不管制拟用于民用“航空器”、且已在真正的民用“航空器”中使用超过八年的航空燃气涡轮发动机。若已在真正的民用“航空器”中使用超过八年，此类发动机受9A991.d管制。
texts.en: 9A991.c does not control aero gas turbine engines that are destined for use in civil “aircraft” and that have been in use in bona fide civil “aircraft” for more than eight years. If they have been in use in bona fide civil “aircraft” for more than eight years, such engines are controlled under 9A991.d.

texts.en: a. Wind tunnels designed for speeds of Mach 1.2 or more;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9B005.a不管制为教育用途“专门设计”、且“试验段尺寸”（横向测量）小于250 mm的风洞。
texts.en: 9B005.a does not control wind tunnels “specially designed” for educational purposes and having a 'test section size' (measured laterally) of less than 250 mm.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9B005.a说明而言，“试验段尺寸”是指最大试验段位置处圆形截面的直径、正方形截面的边长或矩形截面的最长边。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9B005.a Note, 'test section size' means the diameter of the circle, or the side of the square, or the longest side of the rectangle, at the largest test section location.

texts.zh: b. 用于模拟速度超过5马赫流动环境的装置，包括热射风洞、等离子弧风洞、激波管、激波风洞、气体风洞和轻气炮；或
texts.en: b. Devices for simulating flow-environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, including hot-shot tunnels, plasma arc tunnels, shock tubes, shock tunnels, gas tunnels and light gas guns; or

texts.zh: c. 能模拟雷诺数超过25 × 10^{6}流动的风洞或装置，二维试验段除外。
texts.en: c. Wind tunnels or devices, other than two-dimensional sections, capable of simulating Reynolds number flows exceeding 25 × 10^{6}.

texts.zh: 9B006 能在试验舱温度超过1,273 K（1,000 °C）时，以4 kW或更高额定输出产生160 Db或更高声压级（以20 uPa为基准）的声振试验设备，以及为其“专门设计”的石英加热器。
texts.en: 9B006 Acoustic vibration test equipment capable of producing sound pressure levels of 160 Db or more (referenced to 20 uPa) with a rated output of 4 kW or more at a test cell temperature exceeding 1,273 K (1,000 °C), and “specially designed” quartz heaters therefor.

texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9B105不管制速度为3马赫或更低，且“试验横截面尺寸”等于或小于250 mm的风洞。
texts.en: 9B105 does not control wind tunnels for speeds of Mach 3 or less with the dimension of the ‘test cross section size’ equal to or less than 250 mm.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. “气动试验设施”包括用于研究物体周围气流的风洞和激波风洞。
texts.en: 1. ‘Aerodynamic test facilities’ includes wind tunnels and shock tunnels for the study of airflow over objects.

texts.zh: 2. “试验横截面尺寸”是指最大“试验横截面”位置处圆形截面的直径、正方形截面的边长、矩形截面的最长边或椭圆形截面的长轴。“试验横截面”是垂直于流动方向的截面。
texts.en: 2. ‘Test cross section size’ means the diameter of the circle, or the side of the square, or the longest side of the rectangle, or the major axis of the ellipse at the largest ‘test cross section’ location. ‘Test cross section’ is the section perpendicular to the flow direction.

texts.en: 9B106 Environmental chambers usable for rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km and their subsystems, as follows (see List of Items Controlled).

texts.zh: 物项：a. 具有以下所有特性的环境试验舱：
texts.en: Items: a. Environmental chambers having all of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a.1. 能够模拟以下任一飞行条件：
texts.en: a.1. Capable of simulating any of the following flight conditions:

texts.zh: a.1.a. 等于或大于15,000 m的高度；或
texts.en: a.1.a. Altitude equal to or greater than 15,000 m; or

texts.zh: a.1.b. 从低于−50 °C至高于125 °C的温度范围；并且
texts.en: a.1.b. Temperature range from below −50 °C to above 125 °C; and

texts.zh: a.2. 集成，或经设计或改进可集成振动台或其他振动试验设备，在20 Hz至2 kHz之间产生按“空台”测得等于或大于10 g均方根值的振动环境，同时施加等于或大于5 kN的力；
texts.en: a.2. Incorporating, or designed or modified to incorporate, a shaker unit or other vibration test equipment to produce vibration environments equal to or greater than 10 g rms, measured 'bare table,' between 20 Hz and 2 kHz while imparting forces equal to or greater than 5 kN;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 9B106.a.2描述能够产生单一波形（例如正弦波）振动环境的系统，以及能够产生宽带随机振动（即功率谱）的系统。
texts.en: 1. Item 9B106.a.2 describes systems that are capable of generating a vibration environment with a single wave (e.g., a sine wave) and systems capable of generating a broad band random vibration (i.e., power spectrum).

texts.zh: 2. “空台”是指没有夹具或配件的平坦台面或表面。
texts.en: 2. The term ‘bare table’ means a flat table, or surface, with no fixture or fittings.

texts.zh: 3. 在9B106.a.2中，“设计或改进”是指环境试验舱提供适当接口，例如密封装置，以集成本项规定的振动台或其他振动试验设备。
texts.en: 3. In Item 9B106.a.2, designed or modified means the environmental chamber provides appropriate interfaces (e.g., sealing devices) to incorporate a shaker unit or other vibration test equipment as specified in this Item.

texts.zh: b. 能够模拟以下所有飞行条件的环境试验舱：
texts.en: b. Environmental chambers capable of simulating all of the following flight conditions:

texts.zh: b.1. 总声压级为140 dB或更高（以2 × 10^{−5} N/m^{2}为基准），或总额定声功率输出为4kW或更高的声学环境；并且
texts.en: b.1. Acoustic environments at an overall sound pressure level of 140 dB or greater (referenced to 2 × 10^{−5} N/m^{2}) or with a total rated acoustic power output of 4kW or greater; and

texts.zh: b.2. 以下任一条件：
texts.en: b.2. Any of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 等于或大于15,000 m的高度；或
texts.en: b.2.a. Altitude equal to or greater than 15,000 m; or

texts.zh: b.2.b. 至少覆盖−50 °C至+125 °C的温度范围。
texts.en: b.2.b. Temperature range of at least −50 °C to + 125 °C.

texts.en: 9B115 “Specially designed” production “equipment” for systems, sub-systems and “components” controlled by ECCN 9A101 or by USML Category IV(d)(2), (d)(3), (d)(4), or (h)(17).

texts.en: Items: a. Materials not controlled by paragraph .b of this entry and not elsewhere specified in the CCL or on the USML, and “specially designed” for commodities enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category XIX or ECCN 9A619 (except 9A619.y).

texts.zh: b. 以下为用于某些燃气涡轮发动机而“专门设计”的材料：
texts.en: b. Materials “specially designed” for use in certain gas turbine engines, as follows:

texts.zh: b.1. 为USML第XIX类(f)(1)—(f)(4)款列举或描述、用于(f)(1)款所列发动机的国防物品的热障或环境障涂层“专门设计”的粉末；
texts.en: b.1. Powders “specially designed” for thermal or environmental barrier coating of defense articles enumerated or described in USML Category XIX paragraphs (f)(1)-(f)(4) for engines listed in (f)(1);

texts.zh: b.2. 用于定向凝固或单晶铸造，并为USML第XIX类(f)(1)—(f)(4)款列举或描述、用于(f)(1)款所列发动机的国防物品“专门设计”的高温合金，即镍基、钴基或铁基合金；或
texts.en: b.2. Superalloys (i.e., nickel, cobalt or iron based), used in directionally solidified or single crystal casting, “specially designed” for defense articles enumerated or described in USML Category XIX paragraphs (f)(1)-(f)(4) for engines listed in paragraph (f)(1); or

texts.zh: b.3. 为USML第XIX类(f)(1)—(f)(4)款列举或描述、用于(f)(1)款所列发动机的国防物品“专门设计”的酰亚胺基、金属基或陶瓷基复合材料，即增强纤维与基体的组合。
texts.en: b.3. Imide matrix, metal matrix, or ceramic matrix composite material (i.e., reinforcing fiber combined with a matrix) “specially designed” for defense articles enumerated or described in USML Category XIX paragraphs (f)(1)-(f)(4) for engines listed in paragraph (f)(1).
Note 1:

texts.zh: CCL其他部分所列材料，例如CCL第1类某个ECCN中的材料，按照适用ECCN的管制规定管制。
texts.en: Materials enumerated elsewhere in the CCL, such as in a CCL Category 1 ECCN, are controlled pursuant to the controls of the applicable ECCN.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 本条目.a款所述、同时为USML第XIX类所列发动机和ECCN 9A619所列发动机“专门设计”的材料，受本ECCN 9C619管制。
texts.en: Materials described in paragraph .a of this entry that are “specially designed” for both an engine enumerated in USML Category XIX and an engine enumerated in ECCN 9A619 are subject to the controls of this ECCN 9C619.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 本条目所述材料，如正在或曾经用于已投入生产（即非开发阶段）、且未在USML或ECCN 9A619列举或以其他方式描述的燃气涡轮发动机，则不受本条目管制。
texts.en: Materials described in this entry that are or have been used in gas turbine engines in production (i.e., not in development) that are not enumerated or otherwise described on the USML or ECCN 9A619 are not controlled by this entry.

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 经风洞或飞行试验数据验证、用于发动机详细流动建模的2D或3D黏性流“软件”；
texts.en: a. 2D or 3D viscous “software”, validated with wind tunnel or flight test data required for detailed engine flow modelling;

texts.zh: b. 具有以下所有特性、用于测试航空燃气涡轮发动机、组件、“零件”或“部件”的“软件”：
texts.en: b. “Software” for testing aero gas turbine engines, assemblies, “parts” or “components”, having all of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 为测试以下任一物项而“专门设计”：
texts.en: b.1. “Specially designed” for testing any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1.a. 包含9E003.a、9E003.h或9E003.i所列“技术”的航空燃气涡轮发动机、组件或部件；或
texts.en: b.1.a. Aero gas turbine engines, assemblies or components, incorporating “technology” specified by 9E003.a, 9E003.h or 9E003.i; or

texts.zh: b.1.b. 为包含9E003.a或9E003.h所列“技术”的航空燃气涡轮发动机专门设计、提供旁通或核心气流的多级压气机；并且
texts.en: b.1.b. Multi-stage compressors providing either bypass or core flow, specially designed for aero gas turbine engines incorporating “technology” specified by 9E003.a or 9E003.h; and

texts.zh: b.2. 为以下所有用途而“专门设计”：
texts.en: b.2. “Specially designed” for all of the following:

texts.zh: b.2.a. 实时采集和处理数据；并且
texts.en: b.2.a. Acquisition and processing of data, in real time; and

texts.zh: b.2.b. 在试验进行期间，对试验件或试验条件（例如温度、压力、流量）进行反馈控制；
texts.en: b.2.b. Feedback control of the test article or test conditions (e.g., temperature, pressure, flow rate) while the test is in progress;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9D004.b不涵盖用于试验设施运行或操作人员安全（例如超速停机、火灾探测和灭火）的软件，也不涵盖仅用于确定物项是否已正确装配或修理的生产、修理或维护验收试验软件。
texts.en: 9D004.b does not specify software for operation of the test facility or operator safety e.g., overspeed shutdown, fire detection and suppression), or production, repair or maintenance acceptance-testing limited to determining if the item has been properly assembled or repaired.

texts.zh: c. 为控制9B001.a或9B001.c所列设备中的定向凝固或单晶材料生长而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: c. “Software” “specially designed” to control directional solidification or single crystal material growth in equipment specified by 9B001.a or 9B001.c;

texts.zh: d. [保留]
texts.en: d. [Reserved]

texts.zh: e. 为操作9A012所列物项而“专门设计”或修改的“软件”；
texts.en: e. “Software” “specially designed” or modified for the operation of items specified by 9A012;

texts.zh: f. 为设计航空燃气涡轮发动机叶片、导向叶片和“叶尖围带”的内部冷却通道而“专门设计”的“软件”；
texts.en: f. “Software” “specially designed” to design the internal cooling passages of aero gas turbine engine blades, vanes and “tip shrouds”;

texts.zh: g. 具有以下全部特性的“软件”：
texts.en: g. “Software” having all of the following:

texts.zh: g.1. 为预测航空燃气涡轮发动机中的气动热力、气动机械和燃烧条件而“专门设计”；以及
texts.en: g.1. “Specially designed” to predict aero thermal, aeromechanical and combustion conditions in aero gas turbine engines; and

texts.zh: g.2. 对气动热力、气动机械和燃烧条件作出的理论建模预测，已通过实际涡轮发动机（试验型或生产型）的性能数据验证。
texts.en: g.2. Theoretical modeling predictions of the aero thermal, aeromechanical and combustion conditions, which have been validated with actual turbine engine (experimental or production) performance data.

texts.zh: 9D005 为操作9A004.e或9A004.f所列物项而专门设计或修改的“软件”。（此类“软件”受ECCN 9D515管制。）
texts.en: 9D005 “Software” Specially Designed or Modified for the Operation of Items Specified by 9A004.e or 9A004.f. (This “Software” Is Controlled by ECCN 9D515.)

texts.zh: 9D018 用于“使用”9A018所管制设备的“软件”。
texts.en: 9D018 “Software” for the “use” of equipment controlled by 9A018.

texts.zh: (a) 对于与航空器、加油设备、地面设备、降落伞、背带、仪表飞行训练器以及上述物项的“零件”、“附件”和“附属装置”有关的“软件”，如相关物项在2013年10月15日之前紧接的时期归类于9A018.a.1、.a.3、.c、.d、.e或.f，参见ECCN 9D610。
texts.en: (a) See ECCN 9D610 for “software” related to aircraft, refuelers, ground equipment, parachutes, harnesses, instrument flight trainers and “parts”, “accessories,” and “attachments” for the forgoing that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under 9A018.a.1, .a.3, .c, .d, .e, or .f.

texts.zh: (b) 对于与军用教练机涡轮螺旋桨发动机及其“零件”和“部件”有关的“软件”，如相关物项在2013年10月15日之前紧接的时期归类于ECCN 9A018.a.2或.a.3，参见ECCN 9D619。
texts.en: (b) See ECCN 9D619 for “software” related to military trainer aircraft turbo prop engines and “parts” and “components” therefor that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under ECCN 9A018.a.2 or .a.3.

texts.zh: (c) 与某些装甲地面运输车辆有关的软件，如相关车辆在2014年1月6日之前归类于ECCN 9A018.b，则属于EAR99（参见0D606）。
texts.en: (c) Software related to certain armored ground transport vehicles that prior to January 6, 2014 were classified under ECCN 9A018.b is EAR99 (See 0D606).

texts.zh: 9D101 为“使用”9B104、9B105、9B106、9B116或9B117所管制商品而“专门设计”或修改的“软件”。
texts.en: 9D101 “Software” “specially designed” or modified for the “use” of commodities controlled by 9B104, 9B105, 9B106, 9B116, or 9B117.

texts.zh: 对于经过改装、作为9A012所列且因MT原因受管制的无人驾驶航空器运行的有人驾驶航空器，9D104包括以下“软件”：
texts.en: For a manned aircraft converted to operate as an unmanned aerial vehicle specified in 9A012 and controlled for MT reasons, 9D104 includes “software”, as follows:

texts.zh: a. 为将改装设备与航空器系统功能集成而“专门设计”或修改的“软件”；
texts.en: a. “Software” “specially designed” or modified to integrate the conversion equipment with the aircraft system functions;

texts.zh: b. 为将航空器作为无人驾驶航空器运行而“专门设计”或修改的“软件”。
texts.en: b. “Software” “specially designed” or modified to operate the aircraft as an unmanned aerial vehicle.

texts.zh: 9D105 协调1个以上子系统功能，并为在“射程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器中“使用”而“专门设计”或修改的“软件”。（这些物项“受ITAR管辖”。参见22 CFR第120至130部分。）
texts.en: 9D105 “Software” that coordinates the function of more than one subsystem, “specially designed” or modified for “use” in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km. (These items are “subject to the ITAR.” See 22 CFR parts 120 through 130.)

texts.zh: a. 为“开发”、“生产”、运行、安装、维护、修理、大修或翻新ECCN 9A515（9A515.d、.e或.x除外）或9B515所管制商品而“专门设计”的“软件”（本条目.b、.d或.e段所管制的“软件”除外）。
texts.en: a. “Software” (other than “software” controlled in paragraphs .b, .d, or .e of this entry) “specially designed” for the “development,” “production,” operation, installation, maintenance, repair, overhaul, or refurbishing of commodities controlled by ECCN 9A515 (except 9A515.d, .e, or .x) or 9B515.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下特征的“源代码”：
texts.en: b. “Source code” that:

texts.zh: b.1. 包含为ECCN 9A515所管制物项“专门设计”的算法或控制原理（例如用于时钟管理）、精密轨道确定方法（例如用于星历或伪距分析）或信号构造方法（例如伪随机噪声（PRN）反欺骗）；
texts.en: b.1. Contains the algorithms or control principles (e.g., for clock management), precise orbit determination (e.g., for ephemeris or pseudo range analysis), signal construct (e.g., pseudo-random noise (PRN) anti-spoofing) “specially designed” for items controlled by ECCN 9A515;

texts.zh: b.2. 为集成、运行或控制ECCN 9A515所管制物项而“专门设计”；
texts.en: b.2. Is “specially designed” for the integration, operation, or control of items controlled by ECCN 9A515;

texts.zh: b.3. 包含为ECCN 9A515所管制物项的系统、子系统、部件、零件或附件的校准、操纵或控制而“专门设计”的算法或模块；
texts.en: b.3. Contains algorithms or modules “specially designed” for system, subsystem, component, part, or accessory calibration, manipulation, or control of items controlled by ECCN 9A515;

texts.zh: b.4. 为ECCN 9A515所管制物项的数据汇集、外推或处理而“专门设计”；
texts.en: b.4. Is “specially designed” for data assemblage, extrapolation, or manipulation of items controlled by ECCN 9A515;

texts.zh: b.5. 包含为ECCN 9A515所管制物项的姿态、位置或飞行控制而“专门设计”的算法或控制律；或
texts.en: b.5. Contains the algorithms or control laws “specially designed” for attitude, position, or flight control of items controlled in ECCN 9A515; or

texts.zh: b.6. 为ECCN 9A515所管制物项的内置测试和诊断而“专门设计”。
texts.en: b.6. Is “specially designed “for built-in test and diagnostics for items controlled by ECCN 9A515.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. 为“开发”、“生产”、运行或维护ECCN 9A610、ECCN 9B610或ECCN 9C610所管制商品而“专门设计”的“软件”（本条目.b或.y段所管制的软件除外）。
texts.en: a. “Software” (other than software controlled in paragraphs .b or .y of this entry) “specially designed” for the “development,” “production,” operation, or maintenance of commodities controlled by ECCN 9A610, ECCN 9B610, or ECCN 9C610.

texts.zh: b. 为“开发”或“生产”以下任何物项而“专门设计”的“软件”：
texts.en: b. “Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 静止结构构件；
texts.en: b.1. Static structural members;

texts.zh: b.2. 外蒙皮、可拆卸整流罩、不可拆卸整流罩、雷达罩、检修门和面板以及可在飞行中打开的门；
texts.en: b.2. Exterior skins, removable fairings, non-removable fairings, radomes, access doors and panels, and in-flight opening doors;

texts.zh: b.3. 操纵面、前缘、后缘和前缘襟翼密封件；
texts.en: b.3. Control surfaces, leading edges, trailing edges, and leading edge flap seals;

texts.zh: b.4. 为USML第VIII类所管制战斗机、攻击机或轰炸机“专门设计”的前缘襟翼作动系统商品（即动力驱动单元、旋转齿轮作动器、扭矩管、不对称制动器、位置传感器和角齿轮箱）；
texts.en: b.4. Leading edge flap actuation system commodities (i.e., power drive units, rotary geared actuators, torque tubes, asymmetry brakes, position sensors, and angle gearboxes) “specially designed” for fighter, attack, or bomber aircraft controlled in USML Category VIII;

texts.zh: b.5. 发动机进气口和管道；
texts.en: b.5. Engine inlets and ducting;

texts.zh: b.6. 为将实际使用情况与分析或设计载荷谱相关联并计算疲劳寿命量而“专门设计”、且为USML第VIII(a)子类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器“专门设计”的疲劳寿命监测系统，但军用商业衍生型航空器除外；
texts.en: b.6. Fatigue life monitoring systems “specially designed” to relate actual usage to the analytical or design spectrum and to compute amount of fatigue life “specially designed” for aircraft controlled by either USML subcategory VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, except for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft;

texts.zh: b.7. 为用于USML第VIII(a)子类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、重量超过21,000磅的航空器而“专门设计”的起落架及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”，但军用商业衍生型航空器除外；
texts.en: b.7. Landing gear, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor, “specially designed” for use in aircraft weighing more than 21,000 pounds controlled by either USML subcategory VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, except for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft;

texts.zh: b.8. 保形油箱及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”；
texts.en: b.8. Conformal fuel tanks and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor;

texts.zh: b.9. 为符合MIL-STD-461要求的航空器提供电磁干扰（EMI）防护（即传导发射、辐射发射、传导敏感度和辐射敏感度防护）而“专门设计”的电气“设备”、“零件”和“部件”；
texts.en: b.9. Electrical “equipment,” “parts,” and “components” “specially designed” for electro-magnetic interference (EMI)—i.e., conducted emissions, radiated emissions, conducted susceptibility and radiated susceptibility—protection of aircraft that conform to the requirements of MIL-STD-461;

texts.zh: b.10. HOTAS（双手不离油门和驾驶杆）操纵装置、HOCAS（双手不离总距杆和驾驶杆）操纵装置、主动操纵输入系统（即主动侧杆控制组件、主动油门操纵台组件和操纵输入控制单元的组合）、用于数字飞行控制系统的方向舵脚蹬组件，以及为其“专门设计”的零件和部件；
texts.en: b.10. HOTAS (Hand-on Throttle and Stick) controls, HOCAS (Hands on Collective and Stick), Active Inceptor Systems (i.e., a combination of Active Side Stick Control Assembly, Active Throttle Quadrant Assembly, and Inceptor Control Unit), rudder pedal assemblies for digital flight control systems, and parts and components “specially designed” therefor;

texts.zh: b.11. 综合载具健康管理系统（IVHMS）、基于状态的维护（CBM）系统和飞行数据监测（FDM）系统；
texts.en: b.11. Integrated Vehicle Health Management Systems (IVHMS), Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) Systems, and Flight Data Monitoring (FDM) systems;

texts.zh: a. 为“开发”、“生产”、运行或维护ECCN 9A619（9A619.y除外）、ECCN 9B619（9B619.y除外）或ECCN 9C619所管制商品而“专门设计”的“软件”（本条目.b段所管制的软件除外）。
texts.en: a. “Software” (other than software controlled in paragraph .b of this entry) “specially designed” for the “development,” “production,” operation, or maintenance of commodities controlled by ECCN 9A619 (except 9A619.y), ECCN 9B619 (except 9B619.y), or ECCN 9C619.

texts.zh: b. 为“开发”或“生产”以下任何物项而“专门设计”的“软件”：
texts.en: b. “Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 前框架、涡轮中间框架和排气框架；
texts.en: b.1. Front, turbine center, and exhaust frames;

texts.zh: b.2. 以下低压压气机（即风扇）“部件”和“零件”：整流锥、机匣、叶片、导向叶片、转子组件、围带、整体叶盘、轴和盘；
texts.en: b.2. Low pressure compressor (i.e., fan) “components” and “parts” as follows: nose cones, casings, blades, vanes, spools, shrouds, blisks, shafts and disks;

texts.zh: b.3. 以下高压压气机“部件”和“零件”：机匣、叶片、导向叶片、转子组件、围带、整体叶盘、轴、盘和叶轮；
texts.en: b.3. High pressure compressor “components” and “parts” as follows: casings, blades, vanes, spools, shrouds, blisks, shafts, disks, and impellers;

texts.zh: b.4. 以下燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：机匣、燃油喷嘴、旋流器、旋流杯、消旋器、阀式喷射器、点火器、扩压器、衬套、燃烧腔、罩、头部和壳体；
texts.en: b.4. Combustor “components” and “parts” as follows: casings, fuel nozzles, swirlers, swirler cups, deswirlers, valve injectors, igniters, diffusers, liners, chambers, cowlings, domes and shells;

texts.zh: b.5. 以下高压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：机匣、轴、盘、叶片、导向叶片、喷嘴和叶尖围带；
texts.en: b.5. High pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: casings, shafts, disks, blades, vanes, nozzles, and tip shrouds;

texts.zh: b.6. 以下低压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：机匣、轴、盘、叶片、导向叶片、喷嘴和叶尖围带；
texts.en: b.6. Low pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: casings, shafts, disks, blades, vanes, nozzles, and tip shrouds;

texts.zh: b.7. 以下加力燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：机匣、火焰稳定器、喷油杆、引燃器、加力燃油控制装置、调节片（外部、收敛和扩张调节片）、导向环和同步环，以及火焰探测器和传感器；
texts.en: b.7. Augmentor “components” and “parts” as follows: casings, flame holders, spray bars, pilot burners, augmentor fuel controls, flaps (external, convergent, and divergent), guide and syncronization rings, and flame detectors and sensors;

texts.zh: b.8. 以下机械“部件”和“零件”：燃油计量单元和燃油泵计量单元、阀（燃油节流阀、主计量阀、滑油流量管理阀）、热交换器（空气/空气、燃油/空气、燃油/滑油）、碎屑监测装置（进口和排气）、密封件（碳、迷宫、刷式、平衡活塞和刀刃密封件）、永磁交流发电机和发电机、涡流传感器；
texts.en: b.8. Mechanical “components” and “parts” as follows: fuel metering units and fuel pump metering units, valves (fuel throttle, main metering, oil flow management), heat exchangers (air/air, fuel/air, fuel/oil), debris monitoring (inlet and exhaust), seals (carbon, labyrinth, brush, balance piston, and knife-edge), permanent magnetic alternator and generator, eddy current sensors;

texts.zh: b.9. 扭矩计组件（即壳体、轴、基准轴和套筒）；
texts.en: b.9. Torquemeter assembly (i.e., housing, shaft, reference shaft, and sleeve);

texts.zh: b.10. 为本ECCN所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的数字发动机控制系统（例如全权限数字发动机控制（FADEC）和数字电子发动机控制（DEEC））；或
texts.en: b.10. Digital engine control systems (e.g., Full Authority Digital Engine Controls (FADEC) and Digital Electronic Engine Controls (DEEC)) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in this ECCN; or

texts.zh: b.11. 为本ECCN所管制燃气涡轮发动机和部件“专门设计”的发动机监测系统（即预测、诊断和健康监测系统）。
texts.en: b.11. Engine monitoring systems (i.e., prognostics, diagnostics, and health) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines and components controlled in this ECCN.
