texts.zh: 相关管制：(1) 专门为军用用途或目的设计、修改或配备，或主要使用美国国防部资金开发的热端“技术”“受ITAR管辖”（参见22 CFR第120至130部分）。(2) 实际应用于商用“航空器”发动机项目时，“技术”受EAR管辖。出口商可通过以下方式确定其商业应用：就具体出口向商务部申请出口许可证时，提交证明其应用于商业项目的文件，逐案进行认定；或者，在用于广泛类别的“航空器”、发动机、“零件”或“部件”时，向国务院申请商品管辖权裁定。
texts.en: Related Controls: (1) Hot section “technology” specifically designed, modified, or equipped for military uses or purposes, or developed principally with U.S. Department of Defense funding, is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) “Technology” is subject to the EAR when actually applied to a commercial “aircraft” engine program. Exporters may seek to establish commercial application either on a case-by-case basis through submission of documentation demonstrating application to a commercial program in requesting an export license from the Department of Commerce in respect to a specific export, or in the case of use for broad categories of “aircraft,” engines, “parts” or “components,” a commodity jurisdiction determination from the Department of State.

texts.zh: 相关定义：不适用
texts.en: Related Definitions: N/A

texts.zh: 物项：
texts.en: Items:

texts.zh: a. “开发”或“生产”以下任何燃气涡轮发动机“零件”、“部件”或系统“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: a. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following gas turbine engine “parts,” “components” or systems:

texts.zh: a.1. 由定向凝固（DS）或单晶（SC）合金制成的燃气涡轮叶片、导向叶片或“叶尖围带”，根据平均性能值，其（在001米勒指数方向上）在1,273 K（1,000 °C）和200 MPa应力下的持久断裂寿命超过400小时；
texts.en: a.1. Gas turbine blades, vanes or “tip shrouds”, made from Directionally Solidified (DS) or Single Crystal (SC) alloys and having (in the 001 Miller Index Direction) a stress-rupture life exceeding 400 hours at 1,273 K (1,000 °C) at a stress of 200 MPa, based on the average property values;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.a.1而言，持久断裂寿命试验通常在试样上进行。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.1, stress-rupture life testing is typically conducted on a test specimen.

texts.zh: a.2. 具有以下任何特性的燃烧室：
texts.en: a.2. Combustors having any of the following:

texts.zh: a.2.a. 设计为在“燃烧室出口温度”超过1,883 K（1,610 °C）时运行的“热解耦衬套”；
texts.en: a.2.a. 'Thermally decoupled liners' designed to operate at 'combustor exit temperature' exceeding 1,883 K (1,610 °C);

texts.zh: a.2.b. 非金属衬套；
texts.en: a.2.b. Non-metallic liners;

texts.zh: a.2.c. 非金属壳体；或
texts.en: a.2.c. Non-metallic shells; or

texts.zh: a.2.d. 设计为在“燃烧室出口温度”超过1,883 K（1,610 °C）时运行，且其孔满足9E003.c所列参数的衬套；
texts.en: a.2.d. Liners designed to operate at 'combustor exit temperature' exceeding 1,883 K (1,610 °C) and having holes that meet the parameters specified by 9E003.c;

texts.zh: a.2.e. 采用“增压燃烧”；
texts.en: a.2.e. Utilizing 'pressure gain combustion';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.a.2.e而言，在“增压燃烧”中，当发动机以“稳态模式”运行时，主要由于燃烧过程，燃烧室出口的总体平均滞止压力大于燃烧室进口的总体平均滞止压力。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.2.e, in 'pressure gain combustion' the bulk average stagnation pressure at the combustor outlet is greater than the bulk average stagnation pressure at the combustor inlet due primarily to the combustion process, when the engine is running in a “steady state mode” of operation.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9E003.a.2中孔“所必需”的“技术”仅限于推导孔的几何形状和位置。
texts.en: The “required” “technology” for holes in 9E003.a.2 is limited to the derivation of the geometry and location of the holes.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就9E003.a.2.a而言，“热解耦衬套”是至少具有设计用于承受机械载荷的支承结构，以及设计用于保护支承结构免受燃烧热影响的迎火结构的衬套。迎火结构和支承结构相对于彼此具有独立的热位移（热载荷引起的机械位移），即两者热解耦。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 9E003.a.2.a, 'thermally decoupled liners' are liners that feature at least a support structure designed to carry mechanical loads and a combustion facing structure designed to protect the support structure from the heat of combustion. The combustion facing structure and support structure have independent thermal displacement (mechanical displacement due to thermal load) with respect to one another, i.e., they are thermally decoupled.

texts.zh: 2. 就9E003.a.2.d而言，“燃烧室出口温度”是当发动机在经认证的最大连续工作温度下以“稳态模式”运行时，燃烧室出口平面与涡轮进口导向叶片前缘之间的总体平均燃气通道总温（滞止温度）（即在SAE ARP 755A定义的发动机T40站位测量）。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 9E003.a.2.d, 'combustor exit temperature' is the bulk average gas path total (stagnation) temperature between the combustor exit plane and the leading edge of the turbine inlet guide vane (i.e., measured at engine station T40 as defined in SAE ARP 755A) when the engine is running in a “steady state mode” of operation at the certificated maximum continuous operating temperature.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 关于制造冷却孔“所必需”的“技术”，参见9E003.c。
texts.en: See 9E003.c for “technology” “required” for manufacturing cooling holes.

texts.zh: a.3. 属于以下任何一种的“零件”或“部件”：
texts.en: a.3. “Parts” or “components,” that are any of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.a. 由设计为在588 K（315 °C）以上运行的有机“复合”材料制造；
texts.en: a.3.a. Manufactured from organic “composite” materials designed to operate above 588 K (315 °C);

texts.zh: a.3.b. 由以下任何材料制造：
texts.en: a.3.b. Manufactured from any of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.b.1. 由以下任何材料增强的金属“基体”“复合材料”：
texts.en: a.3.b.1. Metal “matrix” “composites” reinforced by any of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.b.1.a. 1C007所管制材料；
texts.en: a.3.b.1.a. Materials controlled by 1C007;

texts.zh: a.3.b.1.b. 1C010所列“纤维或丝状材料”；或
texts.en: a.3.b.1.b. “Fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010; or

texts.zh: a.3.b.1.c. 1C002.a所列铝化物；或
texts.en: a.3.b.1.c. Aluminides specified by 1C002.a; or

texts.zh: a.3.b.2. 1C007所列陶瓷“基体”“复合材料”；或
texts.en: a.3.b.2. Ceramic “matrix” “composites” specified by 1C007; or

texts.zh: a.3.c. 满足以下全部条件的定子、导向叶片、叶片、叶尖密封件（围带）、旋转整体叶环、旋转整体叶盘或“分流管道”：
texts.en: a.3.c. Stators, vanes, blades, tip seals (shrouds), rotating blings, rotating blisks or 'splitter ducts', that are all of the following:

texts.zh: a.3.c.1. 不属于9E003.a.3.a所列物项；
texts.en: a.3.c.1. Not specified in 9E003.a.3.a;

texts.zh: a.3.c.2. 为压气机或风扇设计；以及
texts.en: a.3.c.2. Designed for compressors or fans; and

texts.zh: a.3.c.3. 由1C010.e所管制材料与1C008所管制树脂制造；
texts.en: a.3.c.3. Manufactured from material controlled by 1C010.e with resins controlled by 1C008;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.a.3.c而言，“分流管道”对发动机旁路部分与核心部分之间的空气质量流进行初始分离。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.3.c, a 'splitter duct' performs the initial separation of the air-mass flow between the bypass and core sections of the engine.

texts.zh: a.4. 设计为在1,373 K（1,100 °C）或更高“燃气通道温度”下运行的非冷却涡轮叶片、导向叶片或“叶尖围带”；
texts.en: a.4. Uncooled turbine blades, vanes or “tip shrouds” designed to operate at a 'gas path temperature' of 1,373 K (1,100 °C) or more;

texts.zh: a.5. 9E003.a.1所述物项以外、设计为在1,693 K（1,420 °C）或更高“燃气通道温度”下运行的冷却涡轮叶片、导向叶片或“叶尖围带”；
texts.en: a.5. Cooled turbine blades, vanes or “tip shrouds”, other than those described in 9E003.a.1, designed to operate at a 'gas path temperature' of 1,693 K (1,420 °C) or more;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.a.5而言，“燃气通道温度”是当发动机在经认证或规定的最大连续工作温度下以“稳态模式”运行时，涡轮部件前缘平面处的总体平均燃气通道总温（滞止温度）。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.5, 'gas path temperature' is the bulk average gas path total (stagnation) temperature at the leading-edge plane of the turbine component when the engine is running in a “steady state mode” of operation at the certificated or specified maximum continuous operating temperature.

texts.zh: a.6. 采用固态连接的叶身与盘的叶片组合体；
texts.en: a.6. Airfoil-to-disk blade combinations using solid state joining;
a.7. [Reserved]

texts.zh: a.8. 使用1C002.b所管制粉末冶金材料的“损伤容限”燃气涡轮发动机转子“零件”或“部件”；或
texts.en: a.8. 'Damage tolerant' gas turbine engine rotor “parts” or “components” using powder metallurgy materials controlled by 1C002.b; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.a.8而言，“损伤容限”“零件”和“部件”是使用用于预测和限制裂纹扩展的方法和验证手段设计的零件和部件。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.8, 'damage tolerant' “parts” and “components” are designed using methodology and substantiation to predict and limit crack growth.
a.9. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 关于“FADEC系统”，参见9E003.h。
texts.en: For “FADEC systems”, see 9E003.h.
a.10. [Reserved]

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 关于可调流道几何形状，参见9E003.i。
texts.en: For adjustable flow path geometry, see 9E003.i.

texts.zh: a.11. 具有以下全部特性的“风扇叶片”：
texts.en: a.11. 'Fan blades' having all of the following:

texts.zh: a.11.a. 总体积的20%或以上由仅含真空或气体的1个或多个封闭空腔构成；以及
texts.en: a.11.a. 20% or more of the total volume being one or more closed cavities containing vacuum or gas only; and

texts.zh: a.11.b. 1个或多个封闭空腔的体积为5 cm^{3}或以上；
texts.en: a.11.b. One or more closed cavities having a volume of 5 cm^{3} or larger;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.a.11而言，“风扇叶片”是燃气涡轮发动机中为压气机和旁路同时提供气流的1级或多级旋转级的翼型部分。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.11, a 'fan blade' is the aerofoil portion of the rotating stage or stages, which provide both compressor and bypass flow in a gas turbine engine.

texts.zh: b. “开发”或“生产”以下任何物项“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: b. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 装备非侵入式传感器，且能够将传感器数据传输至数据采集系统的风洞航空模型；或
texts.en: b.1. Wind tunnel aero-models equipped with non-intrusive sensors capable of transmitting data from the sensors to the data acquisition system; or

texts.zh: b.2. 能够在超过0.55马赫的飞行速度下吸收超过2,000 kW功率的“复合材料”螺旋桨叶片或桨扇；
texts.en: b.2. “Composite” propeller blades or prop-fans, capable of absorbing more than 2,000 kW at flight speeds exceeding Mach 0.55;

texts.zh: c. 在采用9E003.a.1、9E003.a.2或9E003.a.5所列任何“技术”的燃气涡轮发动机“零件”或“部件”上制造冷却孔“所必需”的“技术”，且冷却孔具有以下任何特征：
texts.en: c. “Technology” “required” for manufacturing cooling holes in gas turbine engine “parts” or “components” incorporating any of the “technologies” specified by 9E003.a.1, 9E003.a.2, or 9E003.a.5, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: c.1. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.1.a. 最小“横截面积”小于0.45 mm^{2}；
texts.en: c.1.a. Minimum 'cross-sectional area' less than 0.45 mm^{2};

texts.zh: c.1.b. “孔形比”大于4.52；以及
texts.en: c.1.b. 'Hole shape ratio' greater than 4.52; and

texts.zh: c.1.c. “入射角”等于或小于25°；或
texts.en: c.1.c. 'Incidence angle' equal to or less than 25°; or

texts.zh: c.2. 具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: c.2. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: c.2.a. 最小“横截面积”小于0.12 mm^{2}；
texts.en: c.2.a. Minimum 'cross-sectional area' less than 0.12 mm^{2};

texts.zh: c.2.b. “孔形比”大于5.65；以及
texts.en: c.2.b. 'Hole shape ratio' greater than 5.65; and

texts.zh: c.2.c. “入射角”大于25°；
texts.en: c.2.c. 'Incidence angle' more than 25°;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9E003.c不适用于制造等半径圆柱形直通孔的“技术”，该孔的进口和出口均位于部件外表面。
texts.en: 9E003.c does not apply to “technology” for manufacturing constant radius cylindrical holes that are straight through and enter and exit on the external surfaces of the component.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 1. 就9E003.c而言，“横截面积”是垂直于孔轴线的平面内孔的面积。
texts.en: 1. For the purposes of 9E003.c, the 'cross-sectional area' is the area of the hole in the plane perpendicular to the hole axis.

texts.zh: 2. 就9E003.c而言，“孔形比”是孔轴线的标称长度除以其最小“横截面积”的平方根。
texts.en: 2. For the purposes of 9E003.c, 'hole shape ratio' is the nominal length of the axis of the hole divided by the square root of its minimum 'cross-sectional area'.

texts.zh: 3. 就9E003.c而言，“入射角”是在孔轴线进入翼型表面处，翼型表面切平面与孔轴线之间测得的锐角。
texts.en: 3. For the purposes of 9E003.c, 'incidence angle' is the acute angle measured between the plane tangential to the airfoil surface and the hole axis at the point where the hole axis enters the airfoil surface.

texts.zh: 4. 就9E003.c而言，孔的制造方法包括“激光”束加工、水射流加工、电化学加工（ECM）或电火花加工（EDM）。
texts.en: 4. For the purposes of 9E003.c, methods for manufacturing holes include “laser” beam machining, water jet machining, Electro-Chemical Machining (ECM) or Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM).

texts.zh: d. “开发”或“生产”直升机动力传输系统，或倾转旋翼或倾转机翼“航空器”动力传输系统“所必需”的“技术”；
texts.en: d. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of helicopter power transfer systems or tilt rotor or tilt wing “aircraft” power transfer systems;

texts.zh: e. 用于“开发”或“生产”具有以下全部特性的往复式柴油发动机地面车辆推进系统的“技术”：
texts.en: e. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of reciprocating diesel engine ground vehicle propulsion systems having all of the following:

texts.zh: e.1. “包络体积”为1.2 m^{3}或以下；
texts.en: e.1. 'Box volume' of 1.2 m^{3} or less;

texts.zh: e.2. 根据80/1269/EEC、ISO 2534或等效国家标准，总输出功率超过750 kW；以及
texts.en: e.2. An overall power output of more than 750 kW based on 80/1269/EEC, ISO 2534 or national equivalents; and

texts.zh: e.3. 按“包络体积”计算的功率密度超过700 kW/m^{3}；
texts.en: e.3. Power density of more than 700 kW/m^{3} of 'box volume';

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.e.1.而言，“包络体积”是按以下方式测量的3个相互垂直尺寸的乘积：
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.e.1., 'box volume' is the product of three perpendicular dimensions measured in the following way:

texts.zh: 长度：曲轴从前法兰到飞轮端面的长度；
texts.en: Length: The length of the crankshaft from front flange to flywheel face;

texts.zh: 宽度：以下任一尺寸中的最大值：
texts.en: Width: The widest of any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 从气门室盖到气门室盖的外部尺寸；
texts.en: a. The outside dimension from valve cover to valve cover;

texts.zh: b. 气缸盖外缘尺寸；或
texts.en: b. The dimensions of the outside edges of the cylinder heads; or

texts.zh: c. 飞轮壳直径；
texts.en: c. The diameter of the flywheel housing;

texts.zh: 高度：以下任一尺寸中的最大值：
texts.en: Height: The largest of any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 曲轴中心线至气门室盖（或气缸盖）顶面的尺寸，加上2倍行程；或
texts.en: a. The dimension of the crankshaft center-line to the top plane of the valve cover (or cylinder head) plus twice the stroke; or

texts.zh: b. 飞轮壳直径。
texts.en: b. The diameter of the flywheel housing.

texts.zh: f. “生产”以下为高功率柴油发动机“专门设计”的“零件”或“部件”“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: f. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of “specially designed” “parts” or “components” for high output diesel engines, as follows:

texts.zh: f.1. “生产”具有以下全部采用1C007所管制陶瓷材料的“零件”和“部件”的发动机系统“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: f.1. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of engine systems having all of the following “parts” and “components” employing ceramics materials controlled by 1C007:

texts.zh: f.1.a 气缸套；
texts.en: f.1.a Cylinder liners;

texts.zh: f.1.b. 活塞；
texts.en: f.1.b. Pistons;

texts.zh: f.1.c. 气缸盖；以及
texts.en: f.1.c. Cylinder heads; and

texts.zh: f.1.d. 1种或多种其他“零件”或“部件”（包括排气口、涡轮增压器、气门导管、气门组件或隔热喷油器）；
texts.en: f.1.d. One or more other “part” or “component” (including exhaust ports, turbochargers, valve guides, valve assemblies or insulated fuel injectors);

texts.zh: f.2. “生产”具有单级压气机且满足以下全部条件的涡轮增压系统“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: f.2. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of turbocharger systems with single-stage compressors and having all of the following:

texts.zh: f.2.a. 工作压比为4:1或以上；
texts.en: f.2.a. Operating at pressure ratios of 4:1 or higher;

texts.zh: f.2.b. 质量流量范围为每分钟30至130 kg；以及
texts.en: f.2.b. Mass flow in the range from 30 to 130 kg per minute; and

texts.zh: f.2.c. 在压气机或涡轮部分内具有可变流通面积能力；
texts.en: f.2.c. Variable flow area capability within the compressor or turbine sections;

texts.zh: f.3. “生产”具有“专门设计”的多燃料（例如柴油或喷气燃料）适用能力，覆盖从柴油（在310.8 K（37.8 °C）时为2.5 cSt）至汽油（在310.8 K（37.8 °C）时为0.5 cSt）的黏度范围，且具有以下全部特性的燃油喷射系统“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: f.3. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of fuel injection systems with a “specially designed” multifuel (e.g., diesel or jet fuel) capability covering a viscosity range from diesel fuel (2.5 cSt at 310.8 K (37.8 °C)) down to gasoline fuel (0.5 cSt at 310.8 K (37.8 °C)) and having all of the following:

texts.zh: f.3.a. 每缸每次喷射量超过230 mm^{3}；以及
texts.en: f.3.a. Injection amount in excess of 230 mm^{3} per injection per cylinder; and

texts.zh: f.3.b. 具有“专门设计”的电子控制功能，能够根据燃料特性自动切换调速器特性，并通过使用适当的传感器提供相同的扭矩特性；
texts.en: f.3.b. Electronic control features “specially designed” for switching governor characteristics automatically depending on fuel property to provide the same torque characteristics by using the appropriate sensors;

texts.zh: g. “开发”或“生产”采用固体、气相或液膜（或其组合）气缸壁润滑，并允许在超过723 K（450 °C）的温度下运行的“高功率柴油发动机”“所必需”的“技术”，该温度在活塞顶环行程上限处的气缸壁上测量；
texts.en: g. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of 'high output diesel engines' for solid, gas phase or liquid film (or combinations thereof) cylinder wall lubrication and permitting operation to temperatures exceeding 723 K (450 °C), measured on the cylinder wall at the top limit of travel of the top ring of the piston;

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就9E003.g而言，“高功率柴油发动机”是指在2,300 r.p.m.转速下规定的制动平均有效压力为1.8 MPa或以上的柴油发动机，且其额定转速为2,300 r.p.m.或以上。
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.g, 'high output diesel engines' are diesel engines with a specified brake mean effective pressure of 1.8 MPa or more at a speed of 2,300 r.p.m., provided the rated speed is 2,300 r.p.m. or more.

texts.zh: h. 以下燃气涡轮发动机“FADEC系统”的“技术”：
texts.en: h. “Technology” for gas turbine engine “FADEC systems” as follows:

texts.zh: h.1. 用于推导“FADEC系统”调节发动机推力或轴功率所需“零件”或“部件”的功能要求（例如反馈传感器的时间常数和精度、燃油阀转换速率）的“开发”“技术”；
texts.en: h.1. “Development” “technology” for deriving the functional requirements for the “parts” or “components” necessary for the “FADEC system” to regulate engine thrust or shaft power (e.g., feedback sensor time constants and accuracies, fuel valve slew rate);

texts.zh: h.2. 用于“FADEC系统”特有且用于调节发动机推力或轴功率的控制与诊断“零件”或“部件”的“开发”或“生产”“技术”；
texts.en: h.2. “Development” or “production” “technology” for control and diagnostic “parts” or “components” unique to the “FADEC system” and used to regulate engine thrust or shaft power;

texts.zh: h.3. 用于“FADEC系统”特有且用于调节发动机推力或轴功率的控制律算法（包括“源代码”）的“开发”“技术”；
texts.en: h.3. “Development” “technology” for the control law algorithms, including “source code”, unique to the “FADEC system” and used to regulate engine thrust or shaft power;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9E003.h不适用于与发动机和“航空器”集成有关、且1个或多个瓦森纳安排参与国（参见EAR第743部分补编第1号）的民航主管机关要求公开以供航空公司普遍使用的技术（例如安装手册、操作说明、持续适航说明），也不适用于接口功能（例如输入/输出处理、机体推力或轴功率需求）有关的技术。
texts.en: 9E003.h does not apply to technology related to engine-“aircraft” integration required by civil aviation authorities of one or more Wassenaar Arrangement Participating States (See Supplement No. 1 to part 743 of the EAR) to be published for general airline use (e.g., installation manuals, operating instructions, instructions for continued airworthiness) or interface functions (e.g., input/output processing, airframe thrust or shaft power demand).

texts.zh: i. 以下为燃气发生器涡轮、风扇或动力涡轮或推进喷嘴设计、用于保持发动机稳定性的可调流道系统“技术”：
texts.en: i. “Technology” for adjustable flow path systems designed to maintain engine stability for gas generator turbines, fan or power turbines, or propelling nozzles, as follows:

texts.zh: i.1. 用于推导保持发动机稳定性的“零件”或“部件”功能要求的“开发”“技术”；
texts.en: i.1. “Development” “technology” for deriving the functional requirements for the “parts” or “components” that maintain engine stability;

texts.zh: i.2. 用于可调流道系统特有且保持发动机稳定性的“零件”或“部件”的“开发”或“生产”“技术”；
texts.en: i.2. “Development” or “production” “technology” for “parts” or “components” unique to the adjustable flow path system and that maintain engine stability;

texts.zh: i.3. 用于可调流道系统特有且保持发动机稳定性的控制律算法（包括“源代码”）的“开发”“技术”；
texts.en: i.3. “Development” “technology” for the control law algorithms, including “source code”, unique to the adjustable flow path system and that maintain engine stability;

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 9E003.i不适用于以下任何物项的“技术”：
texts.en: 9E003.i does not apply to “technology” for any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 进口导向叶片；
texts.en: a. Inlet guide vanes;

texts.zh: b. 可变桨距风扇或桨扇；
texts.en: b. Variable pitch fans or prop-fans;

texts.zh: c. 可变压气机导向叶片；
texts.en: c. Variable compressor vanes;

texts.zh: d. 压气机放气阀；或
texts.en: d. Compressor bleed valves; or

texts.zh: e. 用于反推力的可调流道几何形状。
texts.en: e. Adjustable flow path geometry for reverse thrust.

texts.zh: j. “开发”为燃气涡轮发动机驱动的固定翼“航空器”设计的机翼折叠系统“所必需”的“技术”。
texts.en: j. “Technology” “required” for the “development” of wing-folding systems designed for fixed-wing “aircraft” powered by gas turbine engines.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 关于“开发”为USML第VIII(a)类所列固定翼“航空器”设计的机翼折叠系统“所必需”的“技术”，参见USML第VIII(i)类。
texts.en: For “technology” “required” for the “development” of wing-folding systems designed for fixed-wing “aircraft” specified in USML Category VIII (a), see USML Category VIII (i).

texts.zh: k. 9E003.a、9E003.h或9E003.i未列明的、为使“航空器”能够以1马赫或更高速度巡航超过30分钟而为航空燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的以下任何部件或系统的“开发”“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: k. “Technology”, not specified in 9E003.a, 9E003.h, or 9E003.i, “required” for the “development” of any of the following components or systems, “specially designed” for aero gas turbine engines to enable “aircraft” to cruise at Mach 1 or greater for more than 30 minutes:

texts.zh: k.1. 推进进气系统；
texts.en: k.1. Propulsion inlet systems;

texts.zh: k.2. 推进排气系统；
texts.en: k.2. Propulsion exhaust systems;

texts.zh: k.3. “加力系统”；
texts.en: k.3. 'Reheat systems';

texts.zh: k.4. 用于调节润滑或冷却“发动机转子支承”所用流体的“主动热管理系统”；
texts.en: k.4. 'Active thermal management systems' to condition fluids used to lubricate or cool 'engine rotor supports';

texts.zh: k.5. 无油“发动机转子支承”；或
texts.en: k.5. Oil-free 'engine rotor supports'; or

texts.zh: k.6. 从“压缩系统”核心燃气通道气流中移除热量的系统。
texts.en: k.6. Systems to remove heat from 'compression system' core gas path flow.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: 就9E003.k而言：
texts.en: For the purposes of 9E003.k:

texts.zh: 1. 推进进气系统包括核心气流预冷器。
texts.en: 1. Propulsion inlet systems include core flow pre-coolers.

texts.zh: 2. “加力系统”通过在最后一级涡轮机械下游的排气和/或旁路气流中燃烧燃料来提供额外推力。“加力系统”也称为加力燃烧室。
texts.en: 2. 'Reheat systems' provide additional thrust by combusting fuel in exhaust and/or bypass flow downstream of the last turbomachinery stage. 'Reheat systems' are also referred to as afterburners.

texts.zh: 3. “主动热管理系统”采用被动式油—空气冷却或油—燃料冷却以外的方法，例如蒸气循环系统。
texts.en: 3. 'Active thermal management systems' employ methods other than passive oil-to-air cooling or oil-to-fuel cooling, such as vapor cycle systems.

texts.zh: 4. “压缩系统”是发动机进气面与燃烧室之间，通过机械功提高气流通道压力的任何一级或多级组合。
texts.en: 4. 'Compression system' is any stage or combination of stages between the engine inlet face and the combustor that increases gas path pressure through mechanical work.

texts.zh: 5. “发动机转子支承”是支承发动机主轴的轴承，该主轴驱动压缩系统或涡轮转子。
texts.en: 5. An 'engine rotor support' is the bearing supporting the main engine shaft that drives the compression system or turbine rotors.

texts.zh: 注意1
texts.en: N.B. 1

texts.zh: 发动机控制技术见9E003.h。
texts.en: See 9E003.h, for engine control technology.

texts.zh: 注意2
texts.en: N.B. 2

texts.zh: 可调流道系统技术见9E003.i。
texts.en: See 9E003.i, for adjustable flow path systems technology.

texts.zh: l. 未由9E003.a.1至a.8、a.10及.h另行管制，用于美国军品清单所管制军用发动机的民用衍生型热端“零件”或“部件”的“开发”“生产”或大修的“技术”。
texts.en: l. “Technology” not otherwise controlled in 9E003.a.1 through a.8, a.10, and .h and used in the “development”, “production”, or overhaul of hot section “parts” or “components” of civil derivatives of military engines controlled on the U.S. Munitions List.

texts.zh: 9E018 用于9A018所管制设备的“开发”“生产”或“使用”的“技术”。
texts.en: 9E018 “Technology” for the “development,” “production,” or “use” of equipment controlled by 9A018.

texts.zh: (a) 对于在2013年10月15日之前紧接该日的时点归入9A018.a.1、.a.3、.c、.d、.e或.f的航空器、加油设备、地面设备、降落伞、背带、仪表飞行训练器，以及上述物项的“零件”“附件”和“附属装置”的相关“技术”，见ECCN 9E610。
texts.en: (a) See ECCN 9E610 for “technology” related to aircraft, refuelers, ground equipment, parachutes, harnesses, instrument flight trainers and “parts”, “accessories” and “attachments” for the forgoing that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under 9A018.a.1, .a.3, .c, .d, .e, or .f.

texts.zh: (b) 对于在2013年10月15日之前紧接该日的时点归入ECCN 9A018.a.2或.a.3的军用教练机涡轮螺旋桨发动机及其“零件”和“部件”的相关“技术”，见ECCN 9E619。
texts.en: (b) See ECCN 9E619 for “technology” related to military trainer aircraft turbo prop engines and “parts” and “components” therefor that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under ECCN 9A018.a.2 or .a.3.

texts.zh: (c) 在2014年1月6日之前归入ECCN 9A018.b的某些装甲陆地运输车辆的相关技术属于EAR99（见0E606）。
texts.en: (c) Technology related to certain armored ground transport vehicles that prior to January 6, 2014 were classified under ECCN 9A018.b is EAR99 (See 0E606).

texts.zh: 9E101 根据通用技术说明，用于ECCN 9A012（仅适用于9A012中因MT原因管制物项的“生产”“技术”）、9A101（9A101.b中“受ITAR管辖”的物项除外，见22 CFR第121部分）、9A106.d或.e、9A110（适用于为9A012所管制非军用无人驾驶航空器“专门设计”的物项）、9C110、9D101或9D104所管制商品或“软件”的“开发”或“生产”的“技术”。
texts.en: 9E101 “Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of commodities or “software” controlled by ECCN 9A012 (applies only to “production” “technology” for MT-controlled items in 9A012), 9A101 (except for items in 9A101.b that are “subject to the ITAR,” see 22 CFR part 121), 9A106.d or .e, 9A110 (for items that are “specially designed” for non-military unmanned aerial vehicles controlled by 9A012), 9C110, 9D101, or 9D104.

Note 2:

texts.zh: 与航天飞行（例如亚轨道、轨道、月球、行星际或其他超出地球轨道的飞行）乘客或参与者体验直接相关或为其所必需的活动及技术/技术数据，无论该体验用于太空旅游、科学或商业研究、商业制造/生产活动、教育、媒体或商业运输，均不受ITAR或EAR管辖。此类活动及技术/技术数据包括与以下事项直接相关或为其所必需的活动及技术/技术数据：
texts.en: Activities and technology/technical data directly related to or required for the spaceflight (e.g., sub-orbital, orbital, lunar, interplanetary, or otherwise beyond Earth orbit) passenger or participant experience, regardless of whether the passenger or participant experience is for space tourism, scientific or commercial research, commercial manufacturing/production activities, educational, media, or commercial transportation purposes, are not subject to the ITAR or the EAR. Such activities and technology/technical data include those directly related to or required for:

texts.zh: (i) 接近、进入和离开“航天器”，包括操作“航天器”的所有舱门、舱口和气闸；
texts.en: (i) “Spacecraft” access, ingress, and egress, including the operation of all “spacecraft” doors, hatches, and airlocks;

texts.zh: (ii) 生理训练（例如载人离心机训练或抛物线飞行、压力服或航天服的训练/操作）；
texts.en: (ii) Physiological training (e.g., human-rated centrifuge training or parabolic flights, pressure suit or spacesuit training/operation);

texts.zh: (iii) 对航天飞行乘客或参与者进行医学评价或评估；
texts.en: (iii) Medical evaluation or assessment of the spaceflight passenger or participant;

texts.zh: (iv) 对乘客或参与者进行健康和安全相关硬件或应急程序的培训，以及由其操作该硬件或执行应急程序；硬件包括座椅、环境控制与生命保障系统、卫生设施、食物制备设备、健身设备、灭火设备、通信设备、安全相关服装或头部防护用品；
texts.en: (iv) Training for and operation by the passenger or participant of health and safety related hardware (e.g., seating, environmental control and life support, hygiene facilities, food preparation, exercise equipment, fire suppression, communications equipment, safety-related clothing or headgear) or emergency procedures;

texts.zh: (v) 观看航天器或地面模型的内部和外部；
texts.en: (v) Viewing of the interior and exterior of the spacecraft or terrestrial mock-ups;

texts.zh: (vi) 观察“航天器”的运行（例如飞行前检查、着陆和飞行中状态）；
texts.en: (vi) Observing “spacecraft” operations (e.g., pre-flight checks, landing, in-flight status);

texts.zh: (vii) 在“航天器”或地面模型内，接受连接或操作乘客或参与者设备的培训，而该设备用于操作“航天器”以外的目的；或
texts.en: (vii) Training in “spacecraft” or terrestrial mock-ups for connecting to or operating passenger or participant equipment used for purposes other than operating the “spacecraft”; or

texts.zh: (viii) 穿上、穿戴或使用乘客或参与者的飞行服、压力服或航天服及个人装备。
texts.en: (viii) Donning, wearing or utilizing the passenger's or participant's flight suit, pressure suit or spacesuit, and personal equipment.

texts.zh: a. ECCN 9A610、9B610、9C610或9D610所管制商品或软件的“开发”“生产”、操作、安装、维护、修理、大修或翻新“所必需”的“技术”（本条目.b或.y款所管制技术除外）。
texts.en: a. “Technology” (other than technology controlled by paragraphs .b or .y of this entry) “required” for the “development,” “production,” operation, installation, maintenance, repair, overhaul, or refurbishing of commodities or software controlled by ECCN 9A610, 9B610, 9C610, or 9D610.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 本条目b.1至b.15款所述物项的“生产”“所必需”的“按图制造技术”，归入9E610.a。
texts.en: “Build-to-print technology” “required” for the “production” of items described in paragraphs b.1 through b.15 of this entry is classified under 9E610.a.

texts.zh: b. 以下任何物项的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的“技术”（“按图制造技术”除外）：
texts.en: b. “Technology” (other than “build-to-print technology”) “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 静止结构构件；
texts.en: b.1. Static structural members;

texts.zh: b.2. 外蒙皮、可拆卸整流罩、不可拆卸整流罩、雷达罩、检修门和面板以及可在飞行中打开的门；
texts.en: b.2. Exterior skins, removable fairings, non-removable fairings, radomes, access doors and panels, and in-flight opening doors;

texts.zh: b.3. 操纵面、前缘、后缘和前缘襟翼密封件；
texts.en: b.3. Control surfaces, leading edges, trailing edges, and leading edge flap seals;

texts.zh: b.4. 为USML第VIII类所管制战斗机、攻击机或轰炸机“专门设计”的前缘襟翼作动系统商品（即动力驱动单元、旋转齿轮作动器、扭矩管、不对称制动器、位置传感器和角齿轮箱）；
texts.en: b.4. Leading edge flap actuation system commodities (i.e., power drive units, rotary geared actuators, torque tubes, asymmetry brakes, position sensors, and angle gearboxes) “specially designed” for fighter, attack, or bomber aircraft controlled in USML Category VIII;

texts.zh: b.5. 发动机进气口和管道；
texts.en: b.5. Engine inlets and ducting;

texts.zh: b.6. 为将实际使用情况与分析或设计载荷谱相关联并计算疲劳寿命量而“专门设计”、且为USML第VIII(a)子类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器“专门设计”的疲劳寿命监测系统，但军用商业衍生型航空器除外；
texts.en: b.6. Fatigue life monitoring systems “specially designed” to relate actual usage to the analytical or design spectrum and to compute amount of fatigue life “specially designed” for aircraft controlled by either USML subcategory VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, except for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft;

texts.zh: b.7. 为用于USML第VIII(a)子类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、重量超过21,000磅的航空器而“专门设计”的起落架及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”，但军用商业衍生型航空器除外；
texts.en: b.7. Landing gear, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor, “specially designed” for use in aircraft weighing more than 21,000 pounds controlled by either USML subcategory VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, except for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft;

texts.zh: b.8. 保形油箱及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”；
texts.en: b.8. Conformal fuel tanks and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor;

texts.zh: b.9. 为符合MIL-STD-461要求的航空器提供电磁干扰（EMI）防护（即传导发射、辐射发射、传导敏感度和辐射敏感度防护）而“专门设计”的电气“设备”、“零件”和“部件”；
texts.en: b.9. Electrical “equipment,” “parts,” and “components” “specially designed” for electro-magnetic interference (EMI)—i.e., conducted emissions, radiated emissions, conducted susceptibility and radiated susceptibility—protection of aircraft that conform to the requirements of MIL-STD-461;

texts.zh: b.10. HOTAS（双手不离油门和驾驶杆）操纵装置、HOCAS（双手不离总距杆和驾驶杆）操纵装置、主动操纵输入系统（即主动侧杆控制组件、主动油门操纵台组件和操纵输入控制单元的组合）、用于数字飞行控制系统的方向舵脚蹬组件，以及为其“专门设计”的零件和部件；
texts.en: b.10. HOTAS (Hand-on Throttle and Stick) controls, HOCAS (Hands on Collective and Stick), Active Inceptor Systems (i.e., a combination of Active Side Stick Control Assembly, Active Throttle Quadrant Assembly, and Inceptor Control Unit), rudder pedal assemblies for digital flight control systems, and parts and components “specially designed” therefor;

texts.zh: b.11. 综合载具健康管理系统（IVHMS）、基于状态的维护（CBM）系统和飞行数据监测（FDM）系统；
texts.en: b.11. Integrated Vehicle Health Management Systems (IVHMS), Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) Systems, and Flight Data Monitoring (FDM) systems;

texts.zh: b.12. 为航空器系统预测与健康管理而“专门设计”的设备；
texts.en: b.12. Equipment “specially designed” for system prognostic and health management of aircraft;

texts.zh: b.13. 主动振动控制系统；
texts.en: b.13. Active Vibration Control Systems;

texts.zh: b.14. 为通过.50口径或更大口径枪击试验（MIL-DTL-5578、MIL-DTL-27422）而“专门设计”的自封闭燃油囊；或
texts.en: b.14. Self-sealing fuel bladders “specially designed” to pass a .50 caliber or larger gunfire test (MIL-DTL-5578, MIL-DTL-27422); or

texts.zh: b.15. 9A610.x所管制、且为USML第VIII(h)(7)类所管制损伤或故障自适应飞行控制系统“专门设计”的“零件”或“部件”的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的技术。
texts.en: b.15. Technology “required” for the “development” or “production” of “parts” or “components” controlled in 9A610.x and “specially designed” for damage or failure-adaptive flight control systems controlled in Category VIII(h)(7) of the USML.

texts.zh: c. 至x. ［保留］

texts.en: y. Specific “technology” “required” for the “production,” “development,” operation, installation, maintenance, repair, overhaul, or refurbishing of commodities or software enumerated in ECCN 9A610.y or 9D610.y.

texts.zh: a. ECCN 9A619（9A619.y除外）、ECCN 9B619（9B619.y除外）、ECCN 9C619或ECCN 9D619（9D619.y除外）所管制物项的“开发”“生产”、操作、安装、维护、修理、大修或翻新“所必需”的“技术”（本条目.b和.c款所管制“技术”除外）。
texts.en: a. “Technology” (other than “technology” controlled by paragraphs .b and .c of this entry) “required” for the “development,” “production,” operation, installation, maintenance, repair, overhaul, or refurbishment of items controlled by ECCN 9A619 (except 9A619.y), ECCN 9B619 (except 9B619.y), ECCN 9C619, or ECCN 9D619 (except 9D619.y).

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 本条目b.1至b.10款所述物项的“生产”“所必需”的“按图制造技术”，归入9E619.a。
texts.en: “Build-to-print technology” “required” for the “production” of items described in paragraphs b.1 through b.10 of this entry is classified under 9E619.a.

texts.zh: b. 以下任何物项的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的“技术”（“按图制造技术”除外）：
texts.en: b. “Technology” (other than “build-to-print technology”) “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: b.1. 前框架、涡轮中间框架和排气框架；
texts.en: b.1. Front, turbine center, and exhaust frames;

texts.zh: b.2. 以下低压压气机（即风扇）“部件”和“零件”：整流锥和机匣；
texts.en: b.2. Low pressure compressor (i.e., fan) “components” and “parts” as follows: Nose cones and casings;

texts.zh: b.3. 以下高压压气机“部件”和“零件”：机匣；
texts.en: b.3. High pressure compressor “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings;

texts.zh: b.4. 以下燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：机匣、燃油喷嘴、旋流器、旋流杯、消旋器、阀式喷射器和点火器；
texts.en: b.4. Combustor “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings, fuel nozzles, swirlers, swirler cups, deswirlers, valve injectors, and igniters;

texts.zh: b.5. 以下高压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：机匣
texts.en: b.5. High pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings

texts.zh: b.6. 以下低压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：机匣；
texts.en: b.6. Low pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings;

texts.zh: b.7. 以下加力燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：机匣、火焰稳定器、喷油杆、引燃燃烧器、加力燃油控制装置、调节片（外部、收敛和扩张调节片）、导向环和同步环，以及火焰探测器和传感器；
texts.en: b.7. Augmentor “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings, flame holders, spray bars, pilot burners, augmentor fuel controls, flaps (external, convergent, and divergent), guide and syncronization rings, and flame detectors and sensors;

texts.zh: b.8. 以下机械“部件”和“零件”：燃油计量装置和燃油泵计量装置、阀门（燃油节流阀、主计量阀、滑油流量管理阀）、热交换器（空气/空气、燃油/空气、燃油/滑油）、碎屑监测装置（进气和排气）、密封件（碳密封、迷宫密封、刷式密封、平衡活塞密封和“刀刃式”密封）、永磁交流发电机和发电机、涡流传感器；
texts.en: b.8. Mechanical “components” and “parts” as follows: Fuel metering units and fuel pump metering units, valves (fuel throttle, main metering, oil flow management), heat exchangers (air/air, fuel/air, fuel/oil), debris monitoring (inlet and exhaust), seals (carbon, labyrinth, brush, balance piston, and “knife-edge”), permanent magnetic alternator and generator, eddy current sensors;

texts.zh: b.9. 扭矩计组件（即壳体、轴、基准轴和套筒）；或
texts.en: b.9. Torquemeter assembly (i.e., housing, shaft, reference shaft, and sleeve); or

texts.zh: b.10. ECCN 9C619.b所管制的材料。
texts.en: b.10. Materials controlled by ECCN 9C619.b.

texts.zh: c. 以下任何物项的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的“技术”：
texts.en: c. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

texts.zh: c.1. 以下低压压气机（即风扇）“部件”和“零件”：叶片、导向叶片、转子、护环、整体叶盘、轴和盘；
texts.en: c.1. Low pressure compressor (i.e., fan) “components” and “parts” as follows: blades, vanes, spools, shrouds, blisks, shafts and disks;

texts.zh: c.2. 以下高压压气机“部件”和“零件”：叶片、导向叶片、转子、护环、整体叶盘、轴、盘和叶轮；
texts.en: c.2. High pressure compressor “components” and “parts” as follows: blades, vanes, spools, shrouds, blisks, shafts, disks, and impellers;

texts.zh: c.3. 以下燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：扩压器、火焰筒、燃烧腔、罩壳、头部和壳体；
texts.en: c.3. Combustor “components” and “parts” as follows: diffusers, liners, chambers, cowlings, domes and shells;

texts.zh: c.4. 以下高压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：轴和盘、叶片、导向叶片、喷嘴及叶尖护环；
texts.en: c.4. High pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: shafts and disks, blades, vanes, nozzles, tip shrouds;

texts.zh: c.5. 以下低压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：轴和盘、叶片、导向叶片、喷嘴及叶尖护环；
texts.en: c.5. Low pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: shafts and disks, blades, vanes, nozzles, tip shrouds;

texts.zh: c.6. 为本ECCN所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的数字发动机控制系统，例如全权限数字发动机控制系统（FADEC）和数字电子发动机控制系统（DEEC）；或
texts.en: c.6. Digital engine control systems (e.g., Full Authority Digital Engine Controls (FADEC) and Digital Electronic Engine Controls (DEEC)) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in this ECCN; or

texts.zh: c.7. 为本ECCN所管制燃气涡轮发动机及部件“专门设计”的发动机监测系统，即预测、诊断和健康监测系统。
texts.en: c.7. Engine monitoring systems (i.e., prognostics, diagnostics, and health) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines and components controlled in this ECCN.

texts.zh: 第774部分——商业管制清单
texts.en: PART 774—THE COMMERCE CONTROL LIST

texts.zh: 授权依据：
texts.en: Authority:

texts.zh: 《美国法典》第50编第4801—4852条；第50编第4601条及以下条款；第50编第1701条及以下条款；第10编第8720条；第10编第8730(e)条；第22编第287c条、第22编第3201条及以下条款；第22编第6004条；第42编第2139a条；第15编第1824条；第50编第4305条；第22编第7201条及以下条款；第22编第7210条；第13026号行政命令，《联邦公报》第61卷第58767页，《联邦法规》第3编，1996年汇编，第228页。
来源：
texts.en: Source:

texts.zh: 《联邦公报》第61卷第12937页，1996年3月25日，另有注明的除外。
texts.en: 61 FR 12937, Mar. 25, 1996, unless otherwise noted.
§ 774.1 Introduction.

texts.zh: (a) 管制清单的范围。本部分提及EAR，均指《联邦法规》第15编第VII章C分章。工业与安全局（BIS）管理商业管制清单（CCL），其中包括受BIS权限管辖的“物项”，即“商品”“软件”和“技术”。CCL不包括由美国政府其他部门或机构专属实施出口管制的物项；但其他机构对相关物项实施管制时，CCL条目可载有对这些管制的交叉引用。此外，“受EAR管辖”但未列于CCL的物项，以“EAR99”标识。“受EAR管辖”的物项见EAR §734.2(a)。EAR第738部分说明CCL的编排方式及其与国家表的关系。
texts.en: (a) Scope of the control list. In this part, references to the EAR are references to 15 CFR chapter VII, subchapter C. The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) maintains the Commerce Control List (CCL) that includes “items”—i.e., “commodities,” “software,” and “technology”—subject to the authority of BIS. The CCL does not include items exclusively controlled for export by another department or agency of the U.S. Government, though in instances where other agencies administer controls over related items, entries in the CCL may contain a reference to such controls. In addition, those items “subject to the EAR” but not identified on the CCL are identified by the designator “EAR99.” See § 734.2(a) of the EAR for items that are “subject to the EAR.” EAR Part 738 contains an explanation of the organization of the CCL and its relationship to the Country Chart.

texts.zh: (b) 对受其他机构专属管辖物项的ECCN交叉引用。
texts.en: (b) ECCN cross-references for items subject to exclusive jurisdiction of another agency.

texts.zh: (1) 2013年10月15日之前，CCL包含某些ECCN，其列入目的仅为交叉引用受核管理委员会所实施出口管制法规管辖的物项。
texts.en: (1) Prior to October 15, 2013, the CCL contained certain ECCNs that were only included as cross references to items subject to the export control regulations administered by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

(2) ECCNs formerly listed on the CCL that, as of October 15, 2013 were subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission at 10 CFR part 110 are: 0A001, 0B001, 0B002, 0B003, 0B004, 0B005, 0B006, 0C001, 0C002, 0C004, 0C005, 0C006, 0C201 and 1C012.

texts.zh: (3) 以下多边出口管制机制引用另作历史参考：0C201——INFCIRC 254第1部分，5.3.1(b)。
texts.en: (3) The following multilateral export control regime reference is provided, as an additional point of historical reference: 0C201—INFCIRC 254 Part 1, 5.3.1(b).

texts.zh: (b)款注：
texts.en: Note to paragraph (b):

texts.zh: ECCN 0D001和0E001“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。这些ECCN作为ITAR的交叉引用保留在CCL中；但自2014年6月5日起，原先在这两个ECCN“许可要求”部分“管制”段落中，对ECCN 0D001所列核管理委员会出口许可权限（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）及对0E001所列能源部权限（见第10编第810部分）的交叉引用已予删除，改为在这两个ECCN新增的标题注中列出较一般性的管辖权交叉引用。
texts.en: ECCNs 0D001 and 0E001 are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). These ECCNs are retained on the CCL as cross references to the ITAR, although the former cross references to export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110) for ECCN 0D001, and to the Department of Energy (see 10 CFR part 810) for 0E001 were removed from the Control(s) paragraph in the License Requirements section of these two ECCNs and added as a more general jurisdictional cross reference in a heading note added to these two ECCNs as of June 5, 2014.

texts.zh: (c) 在何处查阅CCL？CCL载于本部分补充文件第1号；本部分补充文件第2号载有与CCL条目有关的技术总注和软件总注。
texts.en: (c) Where to find the CCL? The CCL is contained in supplement no. 1 to this part, and supplement no. 2 to this part contains the General Technology and Software Notes relevant to entries contained in the CCL.

texts.zh: (d) CCL引号的使用惯例。CCL使用双引号，旨在提醒读者：有关术语已在第772部分（术语定义）中定义；或者，就ECCN而言，定义载于ECCN“许可要求”部分的“相关定义”段落，有时也载于特定ECCN的注和技术注中，且该定义仅适用于相应ECCN。从这一意义上说，单引号和双引号均有提示作用；但良好的合规做法是熟悉第772部分的定义术语，在审查CCL管制参数中未加引号的术语时，也应注意该术语可能已在第772部分定义。另一项有益的合规做法是查阅“相关定义”段落、注和技术注，以确定有关术语是否针对某一特定ECCN设有定义。
texts.en: (d) Conventions related to the use of quotation marks on the CCL. The use of double quotation marks on the CCL is intended to be an aid to alert you to terms used on the CCL that are defined in part 772 (Definitions of Terms), or for purposes of ECCNs, where a definition is provided in the “related definitions” paragraph in the License Requirements section of ECCNs or sometimes in Notes and Technical Notes for particular ECCNs and that definition is specific to that particular ECCN. In this sense the quotes are helpful both in the use of single and double quotes, but a good compliance practice is to familiarize yourself with the defined terms in part 772, and when reviewing a control parameter on the CCL that uses a term that is not in quotes to be aware it may be defined in part 772. It is also a useful compliance practice to review the “Related Definitions” paragraph and Notes and Technical Notes to determine if the term is defined for purposes of a particular ECCN.

texts.zh: (1) 双引号的使用。CCL中的术语加双引号，表示第772部分对其设有定义。但未加双引号并不表示该术语未在第772部分定义。由于CCL使用大量第772部分定义的术语，BIS的惯例是对某些关键术语使用双引号，并在为保持与基于多边出口管制机制的条目一致所必需时使用双引号；许多此类条目源于管制清单，尤其是同样采用双引号惯例的瓦森纳安排。但是，鉴于CCL所用定义术语数量较多，为避免特定ECCN中过多词语加引号而妨碍阅读，BIS对某些术语（如物项和商品）不加双引号。该惯例也适用于第772部分“术语定义”中的双引号使用。
texts.en: (1) Use of double quotes. If a term on the CCL uses double quotes it means there is a defined term in part 772. However, the absence of double quotes does not mean that a term used on the CCL is not defined in part 772. Because the CCL includes many terms that are defined in part 772, BIS's practice is to use double quotes for certain key terms and to use double quotes when needed for consistency with multilateral export control regime based entries, such as many derived from control lists, in particular for the Wassenaar Arrangement that also uses the double quotes convention. However, because of the large number of defined terms used on the CCL and a desire to avoid hindering readability by placing quotes around too many words used in particular ECCNs, BIS's practice is to not add double quotes around certain terms, such as items and commodities. This convention also applies to the use of double quotes within the Definition of Terms section under part 772.

texts.zh: (2) 单引号的使用。CCL也对单引号的使用作出约定。CCL中的单引号表示该术语是在某一特定ECCN语境中定义的术语。该惯例也适用于第772部分“术语定义”中的单引号使用。
texts.en: (2) Use of single quotes. The CCL also includes a convention regarding the use of single quotes. Single quotes on the CCL identify a term as a defined term in the context of a particular ECCN. This convention also applies to the use of single quotes within the Definition of Terms section under part 772.

texts.zh: (e) 以化学文摘社（CAS）登记号标识的化学品。在某些情况下，化学品以名称和CAS号列示。本清单适用于结构式相同的化学品（包括水合物），不论其名称或CAS号为何。列示CAS号是为了辅助识别特定化学品或混合物，不受命名方式影响。CAS号不能用作唯一标识，因为所列化学品的某些形态具有不同CAS号，含有所列化学品的混合物也可能具有不同CAS号。
texts.en: (e) Chemicals identified by Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) number. In some instances chemicals are listed by name and CAS number. The list applies to chemicals of the same structural formula (including hydrates) regardless of name or CAS number. CAS numbers are shown to assist in identifying a particular chemical or mixture, irrespective of nomenclature. CAS numbers cannot be used as unique identifiers because some forms of the listed chemical have different CAS numbers, and mixtures containing a listed chemical may also have different CAS numbers.
§ 774.2 [Reserved]

texts.zh: 金属和合金：除另有相反规定外，1C001至1C011中的“金属”和“合金”包括下列原始形态和半加工形态：
texts.en: Metals and alloys: Unless provision to the contrary is made, the words “metals” and “alloys” in 1C001 to 1C011 cover crude and semi-fabricated forms, as follows:

texts.zh: 原始形态：阳极、球、条（包括带缺口条和线坯条）、坯料、块、初轧坯、压块、饼、阴极、晶体、立方块、小方块、晶粒、颗粒、锭、块团、丸粒、生铁块、粉末、圆片、丸、板坯、坯块、海绵体、棒；
texts.en: Crude forms: Anodes, balls, bars (including notched bars and wire bars), billets, blocks, blooms, brickets, cakes, cathodes, crystals, cubes, dice, grains, granules, ingots, lumps, pellets, pigs, powder, rondelles, shot, slabs, slugs, sponge, sticks;

texts.zh: 半加工形态（无论是否涂覆、镀覆、钻孔或冲孔）：
texts.en: Semi-fabricated forms (whether or not coated, plated, drilled or punched):

texts.zh: a. 通过轧制、拉拔、挤压、锻造、冲击挤压、压制、造粒、雾化和研磨加工的锻压或加工材料，即：角材、槽材、圆片、圆盘、粉尘、薄片、箔和金属叶、锻件、厚板、粉末、压制件和冲压件、带材、环、杆（包括裸焊条、盘条和轧制线材）、截面型材、异型材、薄板、条带、管材（包括圆形管坯、方形管坯和空心坯）、拉拔或挤出线材；
texts.en: a. Wrought or worked materials fabricated by rolling, drawing, extruding, forging, impact extruding, pressing, graining, atomizing, and grinding, i.e.: angles, channels, circles, discs, dust, flakes, foils and leaf, forging, plate, powder, pressings and stampings, ribbons, rings, rods (including bare welding rods, wire rods, and rolled wire), sections, shapes, sheets, strip, pipe and tubes (including tube rounds, squares, and hollows), drawn or extruded wire;

texts.zh: b. 在砂型、压铸模、金属模、石膏模或其他模具中铸造的材料，包括高压铸件、烧结形态和粉末冶金制成的形态。

Technical Notes for 2B001 to 2B009, 2B201, and 2B991 to 2B999:

texts.zh: 1. 次级平行轮廓控制轴（例如卧式镗床的w轴，或中心线与主旋转轴平行的次级旋转轴）不计入轮廓控制轴总数。旋转轴不必能够旋转超过360°。旋转轴可由直线装置（例如丝杠或齿轮齿条）驱动。
texts.en: 1. Secondary parallel contouring axes, (e.g., the w-axis on horizontal boring mills or a secondary rotary axis the center line of which is parallel to the primary rotary axis) are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. Rotary axes need not rotate over 360°. A rotary axis can be driven by a linear device (e.g., a screw or a rack-and-pinion).

texts.zh: 2. 可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴数，是指加工工件时，工件与刀具之间沿其或绕其进行同步且相互关联运动的轴数。不包括机床内部发生其他相对运动所沿或所绕的任何附加轴，例如：
texts.en: 2. The number of axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” is the number of axes along or around which, during processing of the workpiece, simultaneous and interrelated motions are performed between the workpiece and a tool. This does not include any additional axes along or around which other relative motions within the machine are performed, such as:

texts.zh: 2.a. 磨床中的砂轮修整系统；
texts.en: 2.a. Wheel-dressing systems in grinding machines;

texts.zh: 2.b. 设计用于安装不同工件的平行旋转轴；
texts.en: 2.b. Parallel rotary axes designed for mounting of separate workpieces;

texts.zh: 2.c. 设计用于通过卡盘从不同端夹持同一工件并操纵该工件的共线旋转轴。
texts.en: 2.c. Co-linear rotary axes designed for manipulating the same workpiece by holding it in a chuck from different ends.

texts.zh: 3. 轴的命名应符合国际标准ISO 841:2001《工业自动化系统与集成——机床数控——坐标系和运动命名》。
texts.en: 3. Axis nomenclature shall be in accordance with International Standard ISO 841:2001, Industrial automation systems and integration—Numerical control of machines—Coordinate system and motion nomenclature.

texts.zh: 4. “倾斜主轴”计为一个旋转轴。
texts.en: 4. A “tilting spindle” is counted as a rotary axis.

texts.zh: 5. 对每个具体机床型号，可使用“声明的‘单向定位重复性’”替代逐台机床测试，其确定方式如下：
texts.en: 5. 'Stated “unidirectional positioning repeatability” ' may be used for each specific machine model as an alternative to individual machine tests, and is determined as follows:

texts.zh: 5.a. 从待评估型号中选择五台机床；
texts.en: 5.a. Select five machines of a model to be evaluated;

texts.zh: 5.b. 根据ISO 230-2:2014测量直线轴重复性（R↑、R↓），并评估这五台机床中每台每根轴的“单向定位重复性”；
texts.en: 5.b. Measure the linear axis repeatability (R↑,R↓) according to ISO 230-2:2014 and evaluate “unidirectional positioning repeatability” for each axis of each of the five machines;

texts.zh: 5.c. 计算五台机床对应各轴的“单向定位重复性”数值的算术平均值。这些“单向定位重复性”（UPR）算术平均值即成为该型号每根轴的声明值……）（UPR_{X}、UPR_{y}、……）；
texts.en: 5.c. Determine the arithmetic mean value of the ”unidirectional positioning repeatability”-values for each axis of all five machines together. These arithmetic mean values “unidirectional positioning repeatability” (UPR) become the stated value of each axis for the model...) (UPR_{X}, UPR_{y}, . . .);

texts.zh: 5.d. 由于第2类清单逐一涉及各直线轴，因此有多少根直线轴，就有多少个“声明的‘单向定位重复性’”值；
texts.en: 5.d. Since the Category 2 list refers to each linear axis there will be as many 'stated “unidirectional positioning repeatability” ' values as there are linear axes;

texts.zh: 5.e. 如果不受2B001.a至2B001.c管制的机床型号中任一轴的“声明的‘单向定位重复性’”等于或小于各机床型号规定的“单向定位重复性”加0.7 µm，则应要求制造商每十八个月重新确认一次精度水平。
texts.en: 5.e. If any axis of a machine model not controlled by 2B001.a. to 2B001.c. has a 'stated “unidirectional positioning repeatability” ' equal to or less than the specified “unidirectional positioning repeatability” of each machine tool model plus 0.7 µm, the builder should be required to reaffirm the accuracy level once every eighteen months.

texts.zh: 6. 就2B而言，不应考虑国际标准ISO 230-2:2014所定义的机床“单向定位重复性”的测量不确定度。
texts.en: 6. For the purpose of 2B, measurement uncertainty for the “unidirectional positioning repeatability” of machine tools, as defined in the International Standard ISO 230-2:2014, shall not be considered.

texts.zh: 7. 就2B而言，轴的测量应按ISO 230-2:2014第5.3.2节的试验程序进行。长度超过2米的轴应按2 m分段测试。长度超过4 m的轴需要多次测试（例如超过4 m至8 m的轴测试两次，超过8 m至12 m的轴测试三次），每次覆盖2 m区段，并沿轴长等间距分布。测试区段沿整个轴长均匀布置，剩余长度平均分配于测试区段的前端、区段之间和末端。应报告所有测试区段中最小的“单向定位重复性”值。
texts.en: 7. For the purpose of 2B, the measurement of axes shall be made according to test procedures in 5.3.2. of ISO 230-2:2014. Tests for axes longer than 2 meters shall be made over 2 m segments. Axes longer than 4 m require multiple tests (e.g., two tests for axes longer than 4 m and up to 8 m, three tests for axes longer than 8 m and up to 12 m), each over 2 m segments and distributed in equal intervals over the axis length. Test segments are equally spaced along the full axis length, with any excess length equally divided at the beginning, in between, and at the end of the test segments. The smallest “unidirectional positioning repeatability”-value of all test segments is to be reported.

texts.zh: “调整峰值性能”（“APP”）技术说明
texts.en: Technical Note on “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”)

texts.zh: “APP”是“数字计算机”执行64位或更大位数的浮点加法和乘法的调整后峰值速率。
texts.en: “APP” is an adjusted peak rate at which “digital computers” perform 64-bit or larger floating point additions and multiplications.

texts.zh: 本技术说明使用的缩写
texts.en: Abbreviations used in this Technical Note

texts.zh: n “数字计算机”中的处理器数量
texts.en: n number of processors in the “digital computer”

texts.zh: I 处理器编号（i . . . . n）
texts.en: I processor number (i . . . . n)

texts.zh: t_{i} 处理器周期时间（t_{i} = 1/F_{i}）
texts.en: t_{i} processor cycle time (t_{i} = 1/F_{i})

texts.zh: F_{i} 处理器频率
texts.en: F_{i} processor frequency

texts.zh: R_{i} 峰值浮点计算速率
texts.en: R_{i} peak floating point calculating rate

texts.zh: W_{i} 架构调整系数
texts.en: W_{i} architecture adjustment factor

texts.zh: “APP”以加权万亿次浮点运算/秒（WT）表示，单位为每秒10^{12}次经调整的浮点运算。
texts.en: “APP” is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10^{12} adjusted floating point operations per second.

texts.zh: “APP”计算方法概要
texts.en: Outline of “APP” calculation method

texts.zh: 1. 对每个处理器i，确定“数字计算机”中该处理器每周期执行的64位或更大位数浮点运算峰值次数FPO_{i}。
texts.en: 1. For each processor i, determine the peak number of 64-bit or larger floating-point operations, FPO_{i}, performed per cycle for each processor in the “digital computer”.

texts.zh: 注
texts.en: Note

texts.zh: 确定FPO时，仅计入64位或更大位数的浮点加法或乘法。所有浮点运算均须以每处理器周期的运算次数表示；需要多个周期的运算，可用每周期产生的结果分数表示。对于无法对64位或更大位数浮点操作数进行计算的处理器，有效计算速率R为零。
texts.en: In determining FPO, include only 64-bit or larger floating point additions or multiplications. All floating point operations must be expressed in operations per processor cycle; operations requiring multiple cycles may be expressed in fractional results per cycle. For processors not capable of performing calculations on floating-point operands of 64-bits or more the effective calculating rate R is zero.

texts.zh: 2. 计算每个处理器的浮点速率R
texts.en: 2. Calculate the floating point rate R for each processor

texts.zh: R_{i} = FPO_{i}/t_{i}。
texts.en: R_{i} = FPO_{i}/t_{i}.

texts.zh: 3. 按下式计算“APP”
texts.en: 3. Calculate “APP” as

texts.zh: 4. 对于“向量处理器”，W_{i} = 0.9。对于非“向量处理器”，W_{i} = 0.3。
texts.en: 4. For 'vector processors', W_{i} = 0.9. For non-'vector processors', W_{i} = 0.3.
Note 1:

texts.zh: 对于一个周期内执行复合运算（例如一次加法和一次乘法）的处理器，每次运算均应计入。
texts.en: For processors that perform compound operations in a cycle, such as an addition and multiplication, each operation is counted.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 对于流水线处理器，有效计算速率R取流水线填满后的流水线速率与非流水线速率两者中的较快者。
texts.en: For a pipelined processor the effective calculating rate R is the faster of the pipelined rate, once the pipeline is full, or the non-pipelined rate.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 在求取组合的“APP”前，应按理论上可能达到的最大值计算每个参与处理器的计算速率R。当计算机制造商在该计算机的手册或宣传册中声称可并发、并行或同时操作或执行时，视为存在同时运算。
texts.en: The calculating rate R of each contributing processor is to be calculated at its maximum value theoretically possible before the “APP” of the combination is derived. Simultaneous operations are assumed to exist when the computer manufacturer claims concurrent, parallel, or simultaneous operation or execution in a manual or brochure for the computer.
Note 4:

texts.zh: 计算“APP”时，不应计入仅限于输入/输出和外设功能（例如磁盘驱动器、通信和视频显示）的处理器。
texts.en: Do not include processors that are limited to input/output and peripheral functions (e.g., disk drive, communication and video display) when calculating “APP”.
Note 5:

texts.zh: 对于通过“局域网”、广域网、I/O共享连接/设备、I/O控制器及任何由“软件”实现的通信互连而连接或互连的处理器组合，不计算“APP”值。
texts.en: “APP” values are not to be calculated for processor combinations(inter)connected by “Local Area Networks”, Wide Area Networks, I/O shared connections/devices, I/O controllers and any communication interconnection implemented by “software”.
Note 6:

texts.zh: 对于包含为通过聚合提升性能而“专门设计”、同时运行且共享存储器的处理器的处理器组合，必须计算“APP”值。
texts.en: “APP” values must be calculated for processor combinations containing processors “specially designed” to enhance performance by aggregation, operating simultaneously and sharing memory.

texts.zh: 技术说明
texts.en: Technical Notes

texts.zh: 1. 聚合所有同时运行且位于同一裸片上的处理器和加速器。
texts.en: 1. Aggregate all processors and accelerators operating simultaneously and located on the same die.

texts.zh: 2. 如果任一处理器均可通过以硬件传送缓存行或存储字、无需任何软件机制参与而访问系统中的任一存储位置，则该处理器组合属于共享存储器；这种能力可通过4A003.c、z.1或z.3所列“电子组件”实现。
texts.en: 2. Processor combinations share memory when any processor is capable of accessing any memory location in the system through the hardware transmission of cache lines or memory words, without the involvement of any software mechanism, which may be achieved using “electronic assemblies” specified in 4A003.c, z.1, or z.3.
Note 7:

texts.zh: “向量处理器”是指具有内置指令，可同时对浮点向量（由64位或更大位数构成的一维数值数组）执行多次计算，且具有至少2个向量功能单元和至少8个每个含至少64个元素的向量寄存器的处理器。
texts.en: A 'vector processor' is defined as a processor with built-in instructions that perform multiple calculations on floating-point vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 64-bit or larger numbers) simultaneously, having at least 2 vector functional units and at least 8 vector registers of at least 64 elements each.

texts.en: Cryptography Note: ECCNs 5A002, 5D002.a.1, .b, .c.1, z.1, z.5, and z.6, do not control items as follows:

texts.zh: a. 同时满足以下全部条件的物项：
texts.en: a. Items meeting all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 在零售点通过下列任一方式，不受限制地从库存现货销售，向公众普遍提供：
texts.en: 1. Generally available to the public by being sold, without restriction, from stock at retail selling points by means of any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 柜台交易；
texts.en: a. Over-the-counter transactions;

texts.zh: b. 邮购交易；
texts.en: b. Mail order transactions;

texts.zh: c. 电子交易；或
texts.en: c. Electronic transactions; or

texts.en: d. Telephone call transactions;

texts.zh: 2. 用户不能轻易改变其密码功能；
texts.en: 2. The cryptographic functionality cannot be easily changed by the user;

texts.zh: 3. 设计为可由用户自行安装，无需供应商提供进一步实质性支持；以及
texts.en: 3. Designed for installation by the user without further substantial support by the supplier; and

texts.zh: 4. 必要时，可获取物项的详细资料，并应请求向出口商所在国的适当主管机关提供，以核实是否符合本注a.1至a.3款所述条件；
texts.en: 4. When necessary, details of the items are accessible and will be provided, upon request, to the appropriate authority in the exporter's country in order to ascertain compliance with conditions described in paragraphs a.1 through a.3 of this Note;

texts.zh: b. 为本注a款所述现有物项设计的这些现有物项的硬件部件或“可执行软件”，且同时满足以下全部条件：
texts.en: b. Hardware components or 'executable software', of existing items described in paragraph a. of this Note, that have been designed for these existing items, and meeting all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. “信息安全”不是该部件或“可执行软件”的主要功能或主要功能集合；
texts.en: 1. “Information security” is not the primary function or set of functions of the component or 'executable software';

texts.zh: 2. 该部件或“可执行软件”不改变现有物项的任何密码功能，也不向现有物项增添新的密码功能；
texts.en: 2. The component or 'executable software' does not change any cryptographic functionality of the existing items, or add new cryptographic functionality to the existing items;

texts.zh: 3. 该部件或“可执行软件”的功能集合固定，不按客户规格设计或修改；以及
texts.en: 3. The feature set of the component or 'executable software' is fixed and is not designed or modified to customer specification; and

texts.zh: 4. 出口商所在国的适当主管机关认为必要时，可获取该部件或“可执行软件”及相关最终产品的详细资料，并应请求向该主管机关提供，以核实是否符合上述条件。
texts.en: 4. When necessary, as determined by the appropriate authority in the exporter's country, details of the component or 'executable software', and details of relevant end-items are accessible and will be provided to the authority upon request, in order to ascertain compliance with conditions described above.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 就《密码说明》而言，“可执行软件”是指来自已依据《密码说明》排除于5A002之外的现有硬件部件的、可执行形式的“软件”。
texts.en: For the purpose of the Cryptography Note, 'executable software' means “software” in executable form, from an existing hardware component excluded from 5A002, by the Cryptography Note.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: “可执行软件”不包括在最终产品上运行的“软件”的完整二进制映像。
texts.en: 'Executable software' does not include complete binary images of the “software” running on an end-item.

texts.zh: 《密码说明》的注：
texts.en: Note to the Cryptography Note:

texts.zh: 1. 要满足注3的a款，必须同时符合以下全部条件：
texts.en: 1. To meet paragraph a. of Note 3, all of the following must apply:

texts.zh: a. 该物项可能引起广泛个人和企业的兴趣；以及
texts.en: a. The item is of potential interest to a wide range of individuals and businesses; and

texts.zh: b. 购买前即可获得物项价格和主要功能信息，无需向卖方或供应商咨询。简单询价不视为咨询。
texts.en: b. The price and information about the main functionality of the item are available before purchase without the need to consult the vendor or supplier. A simple price inquiry is not considered to be a consultation.

texts.zh: 2. 在判断是否符合注3的a款时，BIS可考虑数量、价格、所需技术技能、现有销售渠道、典型客户、典型用途或供应商的任何排他性做法等相关因素。
texts.en: 2. In determining eligibility of paragraph a. of Note 3, BIS may take into account relevant factors such as quantity, price, required technical skill, existing sales channels, typical customers, typical use or any exclusionary practices of the supplier.

texts.zh: 注3（密码说明）的特别提示：
texts.en: N.B. to Note 3 (Cryptography Note):

texts.zh: 对于符合《密码说明》的某些大众市场加密商品和软件，如其对称算法密钥长度大于64位（或对于未实施任何对称算法的商品和软件，5A002.a技术说明2.b所述非对称算法的密钥长度大于768位、椭圆曲线算法的密钥长度大于128位，或采用5A002.a技术说明2.c所述任何非对称算法），必须按照EAR第740.17(b)条要求向BIS提交分类请求或自行分类报告，方可解除ECCN 5A002或5D002的“EI”和“NS”管制。对于根据EAR第740.17(b)和(e)(3)条无需提交自行分类报告的大众市场商品和软件，也解除“EI”和“NS”管制，并转由ECCN 5A992或5D992管制。
texts.en: You must submit a classification request or self-classification report to BIS for certain mass market encryption commodities and software eligible for the Cryptography Note employing a key length greater than 64 bits for the symmetric algorithm (or, for commodities and software not implementing any symmetric algorithms, employing a key length greater than 768 bits for asymmetric algorithms described by Technical note 2.b to 5A002.a or greater than 128 bits for elliptic curve algorithms, or any asymmetric algorithm described by Technical Note 2.c to 5A002.a) in accordance with the requirements of § 740.17(b) of the EAR in order to be released from the “EI” and “NS” controls of ECCN 5A002 or 5D002. For mass market commodities and software that do not require a self-classification report pursuant to § 740.17(b) and (e)(3) of the EAR, such items are also released from “EI” and “NS” controls and controlled under ECCN 5A992 or 5D992.

Note 2:

texts.zh: USML第XV(f)类以及ECCN 9E001、9E002和9E515不管制向卫星或“航天器”发送或从其接收的真实或模拟数据，条件是该数据仅限于有关“航天器”、“航天器”有效载荷或其相关子系统或部件的健康状况、运行状态、测量或功能信息，或其传感器原始输出。就第9类产品组E而言，此类信息不属于EAR“技术”定义所涵盖的信息范围。此类信息通常称为“状态监测数据”，其示例包括：(i) 与温度、压力、功率、电流、电压和电池电量有关的系统、硬件、部件配置和运行状态信息；(ii) “航天器”或有效载荷的朝向或位置信息，例如状态矢量或星历信息；(iii) 有效载荷的原始任务或科学输出，例如图像、光谱、粒子测量或场测量；(iv) 指令响应；(v) 精确计时信息；以及(vi) 链路预算数据。处理此类遥测数据（即将原始数据转换为工程单位或可读成果）或对其加密的行为，本身不会使遥测数据受ITAR管辖，也不会使其因9A515而受ECCN 9E515管制，或因9A004而受ECCN 9E001或9E002管制。与USML第XV类或ECCN 9A515所管制物项直接相关的所有涉密技术数据，以及使用这些涉密技术数据的防务服务，仍受ITAR管辖。本说明不影响USML XV(f)、ECCN 9D515或ECCN 9E515对用于控制9A515相关“航天器”、有效载荷或相关子系统的软件源代码或指令的管制。本说明也不影响ECCN 9D001、9D002、9E001或9E002对用于控制9A004相关“航天器”、有效载荷或相关子系统的软件源代码或指令的管制。
texts.en: USML Category XV(f) and ECCNs 9E001, 9E002 and 9E515 do not control the data transmitted to or from a satellite or “spacecraft,” whether real or simulated, when limited to information about the health, operational status, or measurements or function of, or raw sensor output from, the “spacecraft,” “spacecraft” payload(s), or its associated subsystems or components. Such information is not within the scope of information captured within the definition of “technology” in the EAR for purposes of Category 9 Product Group E. Examples of such information, which are commonly referred to as “housekeeping data,” include (i) system, hardware, component configuration, and operation status information pertaining to temperatures, pressures, power, currents, voltages, and battery charges; (ii) “spacecraft” or payload orientation or position information, such as state vector or ephemeris information; (iii) payload raw mission or science output, such as images, spectra, particle measurements, or field measurements; (iv) command responses; (v) accurate timing information; and (vi) link budget data. The act of processing such telemetry data—i.e., converting raw data into engineering units or readable products—or encrypting it does not, in and of itself, cause the telemetry data to become subject to the ITAR or to ECCN 9E515 for purposes of 9A515, or to ECCNs 9E001 or 9E002 for purposes of 9A004. All classified technical data directly related to items controlled in USML Category XV or ECCNs 9A515, and defense services using the classified technical data remains subject to the ITAR. This note does not affect controls in USML XV(f), ECCN 9D515, or ECCN 9E515 on software source code or commands that control a “spacecraft,” payload, or associated subsystems for purposes of 9A515. This note also does not affect controls in ECCNs 9D001, 9D002, 9E001, or 9E002 on software source code or commands that control a “spacecraft,” payload, or associated subsystems for purposes of 9A004.

texts.zh: 第774部分补充文件2——通用技术和软件说明
texts.en: Supplement No. 2 to Part 774—General Technology and Software Notes

texts.zh: 1. 通用技术说明。商业管制清单物项的“开发”“生产”或“使用”“所必需”的“技术”的出口，按照各类别的规定实施管制。
texts.en: 1. General Technology Note. The export of “technology” that is “required” for the “development”, “production”, or “use” of items on the Commerce Control List is controlled according to the provisions in each Category.

texts.zh: 受控产品的“开发”“生产”或“使用”“所必需”的“技术”，即使适用于管制程度较低的产品，仍受管制。
texts.en: “Technology” “required” for the “development”, “production”, or “use” of a controlled product remains controlled even when applicable to a product controlled at a lower level.

texts.zh: 对于符合许可证例外条件或已凭许可证出口的产品，其安装、操作、维护（检查）或修理所需最低限度的“技术”，可适用许可证例外TSU。
texts.en: License Exception TSU is available for “technology” that is the minimum necessary for the installation, operation, maintenance (checking), or repair of those products that are eligible for License Exceptions or that are exported under a license.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: 这不允许依据许可证例外释放1E002.e、1E002.f、8E002.a或8E002.b所管制的修理“技术”。
texts.en: This does not allow release under a License Exception of the repair “technology” controlled by 1E002.e, 1E002.f, 8E002.a, or 8E002.b.

texts.zh: 注意：
texts.en: N.B.:

texts.zh: “最低限度”不包括“开发”或“生产”技术，仅允许在确保产品安全、高效使用“所必需”的范围内提供“使用”技术。各ECCN可对“最低限度”信息的出口进一步限制。
texts.en: The “minimum necessary” excludes “development” or “production” technology and permits “use” technology only to the extent “required” to ensure safe and efficient use of the product. Individual ECCNs may further restrict export of “minimum necessary” information.

texts.zh: 2. 通用软件说明。对于释放符合以下任一情形的“软件”，许可证例外TSU（大众市场软件）（见EAR §740.13）适用于所有目的地，但EAR第740部分补充文件1中E:1国家组的国家除外：
texts.en: 2. General Software Note. License Exception TSU (mass market software) (see § 740.13 of the EAR) is available to all destinations, except countries in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR, for release of “software” which is any of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 通过以下方式向公众普遍提供：
texts.en: 1. Generally available to the public by being:

texts.zh: a. 在零售销售点不受限制地从库存中销售，销售方式包括：
texts.en: a. Sold from stock at retail selling points, without restriction, by means of:

texts.zh: 1. 柜台交易；
texts.en: 1. Over the counter transactions;

texts.zh: 2. 邮购交易；
texts.en: 2. Mail order transactions;

texts.zh: 3. 电子交易；或
texts.en: 3. Electronic transactions; or

texts.zh: 4. 电话交易；并且
texts.en: 4. Telephone call transactions; and

texts.zh: b. 设计为可由用户自行安装，无需供应商进一步提供实质性支持。
texts.en: b. Designed for installation by the user without further substantial support by the supplier.

texts.zh: 2.［保留］“公开可获得的技术和软件”见§734.3(b)(3)。
texts.en: 2. [Reserved] See § 734.3(b)(3) for “publicly available technology and software.”

texts.zh: 3. 对已获准出口物项进行安装、操作、维护（检查）或修理所需最低限度的“目标代码”。
texts.en: 3. The minimum necessary “object code” for the installation, operation, maintenance (checking) or repair of those items whose export has been authorized.

texts.zh: 3. 通用“信息安全”说明。“信息安全”物项或功能，即使属于其他物项的部件、“软件”或功能，也应依据第5类第2部分的规定审查。
texts.en: 3. General “Information Security” Note. “Information security” items or functions should be considered against the provisions in Category 5-Part 2, even if they are components, “software” or functions of other items.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 最低限度的“目标代码”不得增强或提高物项性能，或提供新的特性或功能。
texts.en: Minimum necessary “object code” does not enhance or improve the performance of an item or provide new features or functionality.

texts.zh: 注：
texts.en: Note:

texts.zh: 通用软件说明不适用于第5类第2部分“信息安全”所管制的“软件”。对于第5类第2部分所管制的“软件”，见第774部分补充文件1、第5类第2部分说明3——密码说明。
texts.en: The General Software Note does not apply to “software” controlled by Category 5, part 2 “Information Security”). For “software” controlled by Category 5, part 2, see Supplement No. 1 to part 774, Category 5, part 2, Note 3—Cryptography Note.

texts.zh: 第774部分补充文件3——解释声明
texts.en: Supplement No. 3 to Part 774—Statements of Understanding

texts.zh: (a) 解释声明——医疗设备。为医疗最终用途“专门设计”的商品，若其“集成”的商业管制清单（EAR第774部分补充文件1）商品或软件不具有核不扩散（NP）、导弹技术（MT）或化学及生物武器（CB）管制原因，则归为EAR99，即未在商业管制清单其他条目列明。
texts.en: (a) Statement of Understanding—medical equipment. Commodities that are ““specially designed” for medical end-use” that “incorporate” commodities or software on the Commerce Control List (Supplement No. 1 to part 774 of the EAR) that do not have a reason for control of Nuclear Nonproliferation (NP), Missile Technology (MT), or Chemical & Biological Weapons (CB) are designated by the number EAR99 (i.e., are not elsewhere specified on the Commerce Control List).

texts.zh: (a)款说明：
texts.en: Notes to paragraph (a):

texts.zh: (1) “为医疗最终用途专门设计”是指为医疗治疗或医疗实践设计，不包括医学研究。
texts.en: (1) “Specially designed for medical end-use” means designed for medical treatment or the practice of medicine (does not include medical research).

texts.zh: (2) 商品或软件同时符合以下条件时，视为“集成”：对医疗设备的运行必不可少；通常随医疗设备一并销售；并且随医疗设备一并出口或再出口。
texts.en: (2) Commodities or software are considered “incorporated” if the commodity or software is: Essential to the functioning of the medical equipment; customarily included in the sale of the medical equipment; and exported or reexported with the medical equipment.

texts.zh: (3) 除依据EAR §734.3(b)(3)公开提供的软件外，“为医疗最终用途专门设计”的商品和软件仍受EAR管辖。
texts.en: (3) Except for such software that is made publicly available consistent with § 734.3(b)(3) of the EAR, commodities and software “specially designed for medical end-use” remain subject to the EAR.

texts.zh: (4) 对集成商业管制清单中受EAR管辖物项的其他类型设备，另见§770.2(b)解释2。
texts.en: (4) See also § 770.2(b) interpretation 2, for other types of equipment that incorporate items on the Commerce Control List that are subject to the EAR.

texts.zh: (5) 对与医疗设备配套使用的计算机，另见ECCN 4A003说明2关于“主要要素”的规则。
texts.en: (5) For computers used with medical equipment, see also ECCN 4A003 note 2 regarding the “principal element” rule.

texts.zh: (6) 对为医疗最终用途“专门设计”、且集成受EAR管辖的加密或其他“信息安全”物项的商品和软件，另见本部分补充文件2第3节（通用“信息安全”说明，GISN）。
texts.en: (6) For commodities and software “specially designed” for medical end-use that incorporate an encryption or other “information security” item subject to the EAR, see also section 3 (General “Information Security” Note (GISN)) to Supplement No. 2 to this part.

texts.zh: (b) 解释声明——源代码。就因国家安全原因管制的物项而言，“源代码”物项由“软件”管制或由“软件”和“技术”管制共同涵盖，但明确解除管制的“源代码”物项除外。
texts.en: (b) Statement of Understanding—Source Code. For the purpose of national security controlled items, “source code” items are controlled either by “software” or by “software” and “technology” controls, except when such “source code” items are explicitly decontrolled.

texts.zh: (c) 第5类第2部分说明4解释声明。原由5A002说明(b)、(c)和(h)描述的所有物项，现均由第5类第2部分说明4描述。2010年6月25日之前的5A002说明(h)规定，下列物项不受5A002管制：
texts.en: (c) Category 5—Part 2—Note 4 Statement of Understanding. All items previously described by Notes (b), (c) and (h) to 5A002 are now described by Note 4 to Category 5—Part 2. Note (h) to 5A002 prior to June 25, 2010 stated that the following was not controlled by 5A002:

texts.zh: 为维修满足密码说明（第5类第2部分说明3）全部规定的便携式或移动式无线电话及类似客户端无线设备而“专门设计”的设备，且该维修设备满足以下全部条件：
texts.en: Equipment “specially designed” for the servicing of portable or mobile radiotelephones and similar client wireless devices that meet all the provisions of the Cryptography Note (Note 3 in Category 5, Part 2), where the servicing equipment meets all of the following:

texts.zh: (1) 设备用户不能轻易改变维修设备的密码功能；
texts.en: (1) The cryptographic functionality of the servicing equipment cannot easily be changed by the user of the equipment;

texts.zh: (2) 维修设备设计为可在无需供应商进一步提供实质性支持的情况下安装；并且
texts.en: (2) The servicing equipment is designed for installation without further substantial support by the supplier; and

texts.zh: (3) 维修设备不能改变被维修设备的密码功能。
texts.en: (3) The servicing equipment cannot change the cryptographic functionality of the device being serviced.

texts.zh: (d) 解释声明——旧货。商业管制清单中的规格同等适用于新货和旧货。对于旧货，工业与安全局可进行评估，以判断其是否能够达到相关规格。
texts.en: (d) Statement of Understanding—Used Goods. The specifications in the Commerce Control List apply equally to new or used goods. In the case of used goods, an evaluation by the Bureau of Industry and Security may be carried out in order to assess whether the goods are capable of meeting the relevant specifications.

texts.zh: 第774部分补充文件4——商业管制清单审查顺序
texts.en: Supplement No. 4 to Part 774—Commerce Control List Order of Review

texts.zh: (a) 如EAR §734.3所述，EAR仅适用于“受EAR管辖”的物项，例如不属于其他机构专属管辖的物项。因此，某物项如由《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR，22 CFR第120—130部分）的美国军品清单（USML，22 CFR第121部分）描述，包括由其中的兜底条款描述，该物项即为受ITAR管辖的“国防物品”，无需再审查CCL是否描述该物项。见22 CFR §120.6：“国防物品是指ITAR §121.1指定的任何物项或技术数据。§120.3所述政策适用于新增物项的指定。”若USML未描述某物项，且该物项在其他方面“受EAR管辖”，则应依次完成下列各步骤，确定CCL在哪一条目涵盖该物项；如CCL未涵盖，则将其归为EAR99。
texts.en: (a) As described in EAR § 734.3, the EAR govern only items “subject to the EAR,” e.g., items not subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of another agency. Thus, for example, if an item is described in the U.S. Munitions List (USML) (22 CFR Part 121) of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120-130), including one of its catch-all paragraphs, then the item is a “defense article” subject to the ITAR and there is no need to review the CCL with respect to whether it describes the item. See 22 CFR § 120.6 (“Defense article means any item or technical data designated in § 121.1 of the ITAR. The policy described in § 120.3 is applicable to designations of additional items”). If an item is not described on the USML and is otherwise “subject to the EAR,” then work through each of the following steps to determine where the item is covered by the CCL or, if it is not covered by the CCL, and is therefore designated as EAR99.

texts.zh: (1) 第1步。将“受EAR管辖”的物项与CCL进行归类比对时，首先审查该物项的一般特征。这通常可帮助确定CCL中适当的类别（0至9）。
texts.en: (1) Step 1. To classify an item “subject to the EAR” against the CCL, review the general characteristics of the item. This will usually guide you to the appropriate category (0 through 9) on the CCL.

texts.zh: (2) 第2步。确定可能适用的CCL类别后，确定该类别或这些类别中的哪个产品组适用于该物项，即A、B、C、D或E。
texts.en: (2) Step 2. Once the potentially applicable CCL categories are identified, determine which product group within the CCL category or categories—i.e., A, B, C, D, or E—is applicable to the item.

texts.zh: (3) 第3步。“600系列”描述曾受ITAR管辖的军用物项。9x515 ECCN描述曾依据USML第XV类受ITAR管辖的“航天器”、相关物项及某些抗辐射加固微电子电路。如同ITAR实质上优先于EAR，9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN所描述的物项也优先于CCL中的其他ECCN。因此，对“受EAR管辖”物项进行归类分析的下一步，是确定该物项是否由9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN中非“兜底”款描述；兜底款例如“.x”款，其管制为该ECCN或对应USML款中的物项“专门设计”、但未具体列明的“零件”和“部件”。若是，即使其他ECCN也描述该物项，该物项仍归入该9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN款。
texts.en: (3) Step 3. The “600 series” describes military items that were once subject to the ITAR. The 9x515 ECCNs describe “spacecraft,” related items, and some radiation-hardened microelectronic circuits that were once subject to the ITAR under USML Category XV. Just as the ITAR effectively trumps the EAR, items described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN trump other ECCNs on the CCL. Thus, the next step in conducting a classification analysis of an item “subject to the EAR” is to determine whether it is described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN paragraph other than a “catch-all” paragraph such as a “.x” paragraph that controls unspecified “parts” and “components” “specially designed” for items in that ECCN or the corresponding USML paragraph. If so, the item is classified under that 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN paragraph even if it would also be described in another ECCN.

texts.zh: (4) 第4步。若物项未由9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN描述，则判断其是否归入9x515 ECCN或“600系列”的兜底款，即管制为该ECCN或对应USML款中的物项“专门设计”、但未具体列明的“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”的条款。此类物项通常列于ECCN 9A515或某个“600系列”ECCN的“.x”款。
texts.en: (4) Step 4. If the item is not described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN, then determine whether the item is classified under a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” catch-all paragraph, i.e., one that controls non-specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for items in that ECCN or the corresponding USML paragraph. Such items are generally in the “.x” paragraph of ECCN 9A515 or a “600 series” ECCN.

texts.zh: (i) 第4.a步。判断该物项是否符合EAR §772.1“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)款中的任一标准；这些款项通常非正式称为“纳入”款。若均不适用，该物项即不属于以“专门设计”为管制参数的ECCN款的范围，跳至第5步。
texts.en: (i) Step 4.a. Determine whether the item would meet the criteria of either paragraphs (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition in § 772.1 of the EAR. (These are informally known as the “catch” paragraphs.) If not applicable, then the item is not within the scope of the ECCN paragraph that contains a “specially designed” control parameter. Skip to Step 5.

texts.zh: (ii) 第4.b步。若物项符合“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)款中的任一标准，则判断该定义(b)款的任何规定是否适用；这些规定通常非正式称为“排除”规定。若适用，该物项即不属于以“专门设计”为管制参数的ECCN款的范围。
texts.en: (ii) Step 4.b. If the item meets the criteria of either paragraph (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition, then determine whether any of the provisions of paragraph (b) of the “specially designed” definition would apply. (These are informally known as the “release” provisions.) If so, then the item is not within the scope of the ECCN paragraph that contains a “specially designed” control parameter.

texts.zh: (a)(4)款说明：
texts.en: Note to paragraph (a)(4):

texts.zh: 第4.a步和第4.b步中对“管制”一词的强调具有特定含义。某些ECCN将“专门设计”用作解除管制的参数。若某物项因属于“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)项的范围而不归入某个特定ECCN，则无需分析该定义(b)款的任何要素是否适用于该物项。只有在使用“专门设计”一词的ECCN“管制”款中，“专门设计”定义(a)款适用于该物项时，才需审查该定义(b)款的“排除”规定。
texts.en: The emphasis on the word “control” in Steps 4.a and 4.b is deliberate. Some ECCNs use “specially designed” as a de-control parameter. If an item would not be classified under a particular ECCN because it falls within the scope of either subparagraph (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition, then there is no need to analyze whether any element of paragraph (b) of the definition would apply to the item. One needs only review the “release” provisions in paragraph (b) of the “specially designed” definition if paragraph (a) of the “specially designed” definition applies to the item in a “control” paragraph of an ECCN that uses the term “specially designed.”

texts.zh: (5) 第5步。若某物项未归入“600系列”或9x515 ECCN，则从产品组开头开始逐一分析各ECCN，判断该产品组中是否有其他ECCN描述该物项。若某ECCN使用“专门设计”一词，分别参见上文(a)(4)(i)及(a)(4)(ii)款中的第4.a步和第4.b步。若这些ECCN之一描述该物项，则归入该ECCN。
texts.en: (5) Step 5. If an item is not classified by a “600 series” or in a 9x515 ECCN, then starting from the beginning of the product group analyze each ECCN to determine whether any other ECCN in that product group describes the item. If any ECCN uses the term “specially designed,” see Steps 4.a and 4.b above in paragraphs (a)(4)(i) and (a)(4)(ii) respectively. If the item is described in one of these ECCNs, then the item is classified under that ECCN.

texts.zh: (6) 第6步。若CCL任何类别的任何ECCN均未描述该物项，则归为EAR99。若EAR99物项拟供给被禁止或受限制的最终用户、最终用途或目的地，仍可能需要许可证。CCL以外的许可要求，见§732.3“十项一般禁止的相关步骤”第(g)至(n)款，或EAR第736部分的一般禁止四至十。
texts.en: (6) Step 6. If the item is not described under any ECCN of any category of the CCL, then the item is designated as EAR99. EAR99 items may require a license if destined for a prohibited or restricted end user, end use or destination. See paragraphs (g) through (n) of § 732.3 “Steps Regarding the Ten General Prohibitions,” or General Prohibitions Four through Ten of part 736 of the EAR for license requirements other than those imposed by the CCL.

texts.zh: (b)［保留］
texts.en: (b) [Reserved]
