texts.zh: 补充文件6说明：
texts.en: Note to Supplement No. 6:

texts.zh: 本清单物项虽以ECCN而非《瓦森纳安排》编号标识，其物项描述仍直接取自《瓦森纳安排》的敏感清单。若下列ECCN附有文字说明，则敏感清单仅涵盖该ECCN项下的一部分物项，或采用不同参数。
texts.en: While the items on this list are identified by ECCN rather than by Wassenaar Arrangement numbering, the item descriptions are drawn directly from the Wassenaar Arrangement's Sensitive List. If text accompanies an ECCN below, then the Sensitive List is limited to a subset of items classified under the specific ECCN or has differing parameters.
(1) Category 1

texts.zh: (i) 1A002.a.1——由有机“基体”及1C010.c或1C010.d所列“纤维或纤丝材料”制成的“复合”结构或层压材料。
texts.en: (i) 1A002.a.1—“Composite” structures or laminates made from an organic “matrix” and “fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.c or 1C010.d.

texts.zh: (iv) 1C010.c和.d。
texts.en: (iv) 1C010.c and .d.

texts.zh: (vi) 1D002——用于“开发”1A002.a.1、1C001、1C007.c、1C010.c、1C010.d或1C012项下所管制有机“基体”、金属“基体”或碳“基体”层压材料或复合材料的“软件”。
texts.en: (vi) 1D002—“Software” for the “development” of organic “matrix”, metal “matrix”, or carbon “matrix” laminates or composites controlled under 1A002.a.1, 1C001, 1C007.c, 1C010.c, 1C010.d, or 1C012.

texts.zh: (vii) 1E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”或“生产”1A002、1C001、1C007.c、1C010.c、1C010.d或1C012项下所管制设备和材料的“技术”。
texts.en: (vii) 1E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment and materials controlled under 1A002, 1C001, 1C007.c, 1C010.c, 1C010.d, or 1C012.

texts.zh: (viii) 1E002.e和.f。
texts.en: (viii) 1E002.e and .f.
(2) Category 2

texts.zh: (i) 2D001——为“开发”或“生产”以下设备而“专门设计”的“软件”，但2D002所管制的软件除外：
texts.en: (i) 2D001—“Software”, other than that controlled by 2D002, “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment as follows:

texts.zh: (A) 2B001.a、2B001.b.1或2B001.b.2所列，且沿一个或多个直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm的设备；
texts.en: (A) Specified by 2B001.a, 2B001.b.1, or 2B001.b.2, and having a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis;
(B) Specified by 2B001.b.3, 2B001.d, 2B001.f or 2B003.

texts.zh: (ii) 2E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”以下设备或“软件”的“技术”：
texts.en: (ii) 2E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” of equipment or “software”, as follows:

texts.zh: (A) 2B001.a、2B001.b.1或2B001.b.2所列，且沿一个或多个直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm的设备；
texts.en: (A) Equipment specified by 2B001.a, 2B001.b.1 or 2B001.b.2, and having a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis;
(B) Equipment specified by 2B001.b.3, 2B001.d, 2B001.f or 2B003.

texts.zh: (C) 本补充文件2D001所列“软件”；
texts.en: (C) “Software” specified by 2D001 of this Supplement;

texts.zh: (iii) 2E002——根据通用技术说明，用于“生产”以下设备的“技术”：
texts.en: (iii) 2E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment as follows:

texts.zh: (A) 2B001.a、2B001.b.1或2B001.b.2所列，且沿一个或多个直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm的设备；
texts.en: (A) Specified by 2B001.a, 2B001.b.1, or 2B001.b.2, and having a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis;
(B) Specified by 2B001.b.3, 2B001.d, 2B001.f or 2B003.
(3) Category 3

texts.zh: (i) 3A001.b.2（包括3A001.b.2所述、由3A001.z管制的物项）——符合以下任一情形的“单片微波集成电路”（MMIC）放大器：
texts.en: (i) 3A001.b.2 (including those described under 3A001.b.2 that are controlled by 3A001.z)—“Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers that are any of the following:

texts.zh: (A) 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，并具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: (A) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: (A.1.) 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于300 W（54.8 dBm）；
texts.en: (A.1.) A peak saturated power output greater than 300 W (54.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

texts.zh: (A.2.) 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于300 W（54.8 dBm）；
texts.en: (A.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 300 W (54.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

texts.zh: (A.3.) 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于300 W（54.8 dBm）；或
texts.en: (A.3.) A peak saturated power output greater than 300 W (54.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

texts.zh: (A.4.) 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于120 W（50.8 dBm）；
texts.en: (A.4.) A peak saturated power output greater than 120 W (50.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

texts.zh: (B) 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过12 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，并具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: (B) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 12 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

texts.zh: (B.1) 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于25 W（44 dBm）；或
texts.en: (B.1) A peak saturated power output greater than 25 W (44 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz; or

texts.zh: (B.2.) 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于25 W（44 dBm）。
texts.en: (B.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 25 W (44 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz.

texts.zh: (ii) 3A001.b.3（包括3A001.b.3所述、由3A001.z管制的物项）——符合以下任一情形的分立微波晶体管：
texts.en: (ii) 3A001.b.3 (including those described under 3A001.b.3 that are controlled by 3A001.z)—Discrete microwave transistors that are any of the following:

texts.zh: (A) 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，并具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: (A) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz and having any of the following:

texts.zh: (A.1.) 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于600 W（57.8 dBm）；
texts.en: (A.1.) A peak saturated power output greater than 600 W (57.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

texts.zh: (A.2.) 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于600 W（57.8 dBm）；
texts.en: (A.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 600 W (57.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

texts.zh: (A.3.) 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于600 W（57.8 dBm）；或
texts.en: (A.3.) A peak saturated power output greater than 600 W (57.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

texts.zh: (A.4.) 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于130 W（51.2 dBm）；
texts.en: (A.4.) A peak saturated power output greater than 130 W (51.2 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

texts.zh: (B) 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过12 GHz，并具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: (B) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 12 GHz and having any of the following:

texts.zh: (B.1.) 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于130 W（51.2 dBm）；
texts.en: (B.1.) A peak saturated power output greater than 130 W (51.2 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz;

texts.zh: (B.2.) 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于60 W（47.8 dBm）。
texts.en: (B.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 60 W (47.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz.

texts.zh: (iv) 3D001——为“开发”或“生产”3A001.b.2、3A001.b.3及3A002.g.1项下所管制设备，以及3A001.b.2或3A001.b.3所述、由3A001.z管制的设备而“专门设计”的“软件”。
texts.en: (iv) 3D001—“Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment controlled under 3A001.b.2, 3A001.b.3, equipment described under 3A001.b.2 or 3A001.b.3 that are controlled under 3A001.z, and 3A002.g.1.

texts.zh: (v) 3E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”或“生产”3A001.b.2、3A001.b.3及3A002.g.1项下所管制设备，以及3A001.b.2或3A001.b.3所述、由3A001.z管制的设备的“技术”。
texts.en: (v) 3E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment controlled under 3A001.b.2, 3A001.b.3, equipment described under 3A001.b.2 or 3A001.b.3 that are controlled under 3A001.z, and 3A002.g.1.
(4) Category 4

texts.zh: (ii)［保留］
texts.en: (ii) [Reserved]

texts.zh: (5) 第5类第1部分
texts.en: (5) Category 5—Part 1

texts.zh: (ii) 5B001.a——为“开发”或“生产”5A001.b.3、b.5或.h项下所管制设备、功能或特性而“专门设计”的设备，以及为该设备“专门设计”的部件或“附件”。
texts.en: (ii) 5B001.a—Equipment and “specially designed” components or “accessories” therefor, “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment, functions or features controlled under 5A001.b.3, b.5, or .h.

texts.zh: (iii) 5D001.a——为“开发”或“生产”5A001.b.3、b.5或.h项下所管制设备、功能或特性而“专门设计”的“软件”。
texts.en: (iii) 5D001.a—“Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment, functions or features controlled under 5A001.b.3, b.5, or .h.

texts.zh: (iv)［保留］
texts.en: (iv) [Reserved]

texts.zh: (v) 5E001.a——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”或“生产”5A001.b.3、b.5或.h项下所管制设备、功能或特性，或本补充文件对5D001.a的描述所涉及“软件”的“技术”。
texts.en: (v) 5E001.a—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment, functions or features controlled under 5A001.b.3, b.5, or .h or “software” described in this Supplement's description of 5D001.a.
(6) Category 6

texts.zh: (i) 6A001.a.1.b——为物体探测或定位而设计，并具有以下任一特性的系统或发射和接收阵列：
texts.en: (i) 6A001.a.1.b—Systems or transmitting and receiving arrays, designed for object detection or location, having any of the following:

texts.zh: (A) 发射频率低于5 kHz；或者，对于工作频率处于5 kHz至10 kHz频段（含两端）的设备，声压级超过224 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准）；
texts.en: (A) A transmitting frequency below 5 kHz or a sound pressure level exceeding 224 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band from 5 kHz to 10 kHz inclusive;

texts.zh: (B) 对于工作频率处于10 kHz至24 kHz频段（含两端）的设备，声压级超过224 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准）；
texts.en: (B) Sound pressure level exceeding 224 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band from 10 kHz to 24 kHz inclusive;

texts.zh: (C) 对于工作频率处于24 kHz与30 kHz之间频段的设备，声压级超过235 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准）；
texts.en: (C) Sound pressure level exceeding 235 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band between 24 kHz and 30 kHz;

texts.zh: (D) 可在任一轴上形成小于1°的波束，且工作频率低于100 kHz；
texts.en: (D) Forming beams of less than 1° on any axis and having an operating frequency of less than 100 kHz;

texts.zh: (E) 设计为具有超过5,120 m的无模糊显示距离；或
texts.en: (E) Designed to operate with an unambiguous display range exceeding 5,120 m; or

texts.zh: (F) 设计为可承受在超过1,000 m深度正常运行时的压力，且其换能器具有以下任一特性：
texts.en: (F) Designed to withstand pressure during normal operation at depths exceeding 1,000 m and having transducers with any of the following:

texts.zh: (1) 压力动态补偿；或
texts.en: (1) Dynamic compensation for pressure; or

texts.zh: (2) 使用锆钛酸铅以外的材料作为换能元件；
texts.en: (2) Incorporating other than lead zirconate titanate as the transduction element;

texts.zh: (v) 6A001.a.2.c——为与拖曳式声学水听器阵列实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
texts.en: (v) 6A001.a.2.c—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with towed acoustic hydrophone arrays, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

texts.zh: (viii) 6A001.a.2.f——为与海底或海湾电缆系统实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
texts.en: (viii) 6A001.a.2.f—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with bottom or bay cable systems, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

texts.zh: (xi) 6A002.a.2.a——具有以下所有特性的图像增强管：
texts.en: (xi) 6A002.a.2.a—Image intensifier tubes having all of the following:

texts.zh: (A) 峰值响应波长大于400 nm但不超过1,050 nm；
texts.en: (A) A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm;

texts.zh: (B) 采用以下任一方式实现电子图像放大：
texts.en: (B) Electron image amplification using any of the following:

texts.zh: (1) 用于电子图像放大的微通道板，孔间距（中心距）为12 µm或更小；或
texts.en: (1) A microchannel plate for electron image amplification with a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less; or

texts.zh: (2) 为通过微通道板以外方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改进的电子探测器件，其未经像素合并的像素间距为500 µm或更小；并且
texts.en: (2) An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve ‘ charge multiplication’ other than by a microchannel plate; and

texts.zh: (C) 采用以下任一光电阴极：
texts.en: (C) Any of the following photocathodes:

texts.zh: (1) 光照灵敏度超过700 µA/lm的多碱光电阴极，例如S-20和S-25；
texts.en: (1) Multialkali photocathodes (e.g., S-20 and S-25) having a luminous sensitivity exceeding 700 µA/lm;

texts.zh: (2) GaAs或GaInAs光电阴极；或
texts.en: (2) GaAs or GaInAs photocathodes; or

texts.zh: (3) 最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W的其他“III-V族化合物”半导体光电阴极。
texts.en: (3) Other “III-V compound” semiconductor photocathodes having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W.

texts.zh: (xiii) 6A002.a.3——受以下附加说明约束：
texts.en: (xiii) 6A002.a.3—Subject to the following additional notes:
Note 1:

texts.zh: 在本补充文件中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to the following “focal plane arrays” in this Supplement:

texts.zh: a. 元件数量少于10,000的硅化铂（PtSi）“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: a. Platinum Silicide (PtSi) “focal plane arrays” having less than 10,000 elements;

texts.zh: b. 硅化铱（IrSi）“焦平面阵列”。
texts.en: b. Iridium Silicide (IrSi) “focal plane arrays”.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 在本补充文件中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to the following “focal plane arrays” in this Supplement:

texts.zh: a. 元件数量少于256的锑化铟（InSb）或硒化铅（PbSe）“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: a. Indium Antimonide (InSb) or Lead Selenide (PbSe) “focal plane arrays” having less than 256 elements;

texts.zh: b. 砷化铟（InAs）“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: b. Indium Arsenide (InAs) “focal plane arrays”;

texts.zh: c. 硫化铅（PbS）“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: c. Lead Sulphide (PbS) “focal plane arrays”;

texts.zh: d. 砷化铟镓（InGaAs）“焦平面阵列”。
texts.en: d. Indium Gallium Arsenide (InGaAs) “focal plane arrays”.
Note 3:

texts.zh: 在本补充文件中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下碲镉汞（HgCdTe）“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to Mercury Cadmium Telluride (HgCdTe) “focal plane arrays” as follows in this Supplement:

texts.zh: a. 具有以下任一特性的“扫描阵列”：
texts.en: a. 'Scanning Arrays' having any of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 元件数量为30或更少；或
texts.en: 1. 30 elements or less; or

texts.zh: 2. 在元件内部采用时间延迟积分，且元件数量为2或更少；
texts.en: 2. Incorporating time delay-and-integration within the element and having 2 elements or less;

texts.zh: b. 元件数量少于256的“凝视阵列”。
texts.en: b. 'Staring Arrays' having less than 256 elements.

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Notes:

texts.zh: a. “扫描阵列”定义为设计用于扫描光学系统的“焦平面阵列”；该系统依次对场景成像，从而生成图像；
texts.en: a. 'Scanning Arrays' are defined as “focal plane arrays” designed for use with a scanning optical system that images a scene in a sequential manner to produce an image;

texts.zh: b. “凝视阵列”定义为设计用于对场景成像的非扫描光学系统的“焦平面阵列”。
texts.en: b. 'Staring Arrays' are defined as “focal plane arrays” designed for use with a nonscanning optical system that images a scene.
Note 6:

texts.zh: 在本清单中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to the following “focal plane arrays” in this List:

texts.zh: a. 元件数量少于256的砷化镓（GaAs）或砷化镓铝（GaAlAs）量子阱“焦平面阵列”；
texts.en: a. Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) or Gallium Aluminum Arsenide (GaAlAs) quantum well “focal plane arrays” having less than 256 elements;

texts.zh: b. 元件数量少于8,000的微测辐射热计“焦平面阵列”。
texts.en: b. Microbolometer “focal plane arrays” having less than 8,000 elements.
Note 7:

texts.zh: 6A002.a.3.g不适用于以下为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改进的“焦平面阵列”：
texts.en: 6A002.a.3.g does not apply to “focal plane arrays”, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication', as follows:

texts.zh: a. 元件数量为4,096或更少的线性（1维）阵列。
texts.en: a. Linear (1-dimensional) arrays having 4,096 elements or less.

texts.zh: b. 具有以下所有特性的非线性（2维）阵列：

texts.en: (C) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.g.

texts.zh: 6A003.b.4所述“成像相机”包括“焦平面阵列”与读出集成电路之外的足够“信号处理”电子电路的组合，使其在通电后至少能够输出模拟或数字信号。
texts.en: ‘ Imaging cameras’ described in 6A003.b.4 include “focal plane arrays” combined with sufficient “signal processing” electronics, beyond the read out integrated circuit, to enable as a minimum the output of an analog or digital signal once power is supplied.
Note 2:

texts.zh: 6A003.b.4.a不管制集成元件数量为12（十二）或更少的线性“焦平面阵列”、未在元件内部采用时间延迟积分，且为以下任一用途设计的成像相机：
texts.en: 6A003.b.4.a does not control imaging cameras incorporating linear “focal plane arrays” with twelve 12 elements or fewer, not employing time-delay-and-integration within the element, and designed for any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
texts.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

texts.zh: b. 用于检查或监测建筑物、设备或工业过程内热流的工业设备；
texts.en: b. Industrial equipment used for inspection or monitoring of heat flows in buildings, equipment or industrial processes;

texts.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
texts.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

texts.zh: d. 为实验室使用“专门设计”的设备；或
texts.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use; or

texts.zh: e. 医疗设备。
texts.en: e. Medical equipment.

texts.en: 6A003.b.4.b does not control imaging cameras having any of the following characteristics:

texts.zh: a. 最大帧率小于或等于9 Hz；
texts.en: a. A maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz;

texts.zh: b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
texts.en: b. Having all of the following:

texts.zh: 1. 最小水平或垂直“瞬时视场”（IFOV）至少为10 mrad/pixel（毫弧度/像素）；
texts.en: 1. Having a minimum horizontal or vertical ‘ Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)’ of at least 10 mrad/pixel (milliradians/pixel);

texts.zh: 2. 采用设计为不可拆卸的定焦镜头；
texts.en: 2. Incorporating a fixed focal-length lens that is not designed to be removed;

texts.zh: 3. 不集成“直视”显示器；并且
texts.en: 3. Not incorporating a ‘ direct view’ display; and

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: “直视”是指在红外波段工作，通过集成任何防漏光机制的近眼微型显示器向观察者呈现可视图像的成像相机。
texts.en: ‘ Direct view’ refers to an imaging camera operating in the infrared spectrum that presents a visual image to a human observer using a near-to-eye micro display incorporating any light-security mechanism.

texts.zh: 4. 具有下列任一特性：
texts.en: 4. Having any of the following:

texts.zh: a. 不具备获取所探测视场可视图像的功能；或
texts.en: a. No facility to obtain a viewable image of the detected field-of-view; or

texts.zh: b. 照相机仅为单一类型应用设计，且设计为用户不可修改；或
texts.en: b. The camera is designed for a single kind of application and designed not to be user modified; or

texts.zh: 技术注：
texts.en: Technical Note:

texts.zh: 说明3.b所述“瞬时视场”（IFOV）为“水平FOV”与“垂直FOV”中的较小值。
texts.en: ‘ Instantaneous Field of View (IFOV)’ specified in Note 3.b is the lesser figure of the ‘ Horizontal FOV’ or the ‘ Vertical FOV’.

texts.zh: “水平IFOV”＝水平视场（FOV）/水平方向探测元件数量
texts.en: ‘ Horizontal IFOV’ = horizontal Field of View (FOV)/number of horizontal detector elements

texts.zh: “垂直IFOV”＝垂直视场（FOV）/垂直方向探测元件数量。
texts.en: ‘ Vertical IFOV’= vertical Field of View (FOV)/number of vertical detector elements.

texts.en: 4. The “focal plane array” incorporates an active mechanism that forces it to be permanently inoperable when removed from the camera for which it was intended.

texts.zh: 补充文件7说明：
texts.en: Note to Supplement No. 7:

texts.zh: 本清单物项虽以ECCN而非《瓦森纳安排》编号标识，其物项描述仍直接取自《瓦森纳安排》的高度敏感清单；高度敏感清单是《瓦森纳安排》敏感清单的子集。若下列ECCN附有文字说明，则高度敏感清单仅涵盖该ECCN项下的一部分物项，或采用不同参数。
texts.en: While the items on this list are identified by ECCN rather than by Wassenaar Arrangement numbering, the item descriptions are drawn directly from the Wassenaar Arrangement's Very Sensitive List, which is a subset of the Wassenaar Arrangement's Sensitive List. If text accompanies an ECCN below, then the Very Sensitive List is limited to a subset of items classified under the specific ECCN or has differing parameters.

texts.en: (iii) 5D001.a—“Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment, functions or features specified by 5A001.b.5 or 5A001.h.

texts.zh: (iv) 5E001.a——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”或“生产”5A001.b.5、5A001.h或5D001.a所列设备、功能、特性或“软件”的“技术”。
texts.en: (iv) 5E001.a—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment, functions, features or “software” specified by 5A001.b.5, 5A001.h, or 5D001.a.
(3) Category 6

texts.zh: (i) 6A001.a.1.b.1——为物体探测或定位而设计，声压级超过210 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准），且工作频率位于30 Hz至2 kHz频段的系统或发射和接收阵列。
texts.en: (i) 6A001.a.1.b.1—Systems or transmitting and receiving arrays, designed for object detection or location, having a sound pressure level exceeding 210 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) and an operating frequency in the band from 30 Hz to 2 kHz.

texts.zh: (iv) 6A001.a.2.c——为与拖曳式声学水听器阵列实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
texts.en: (iv) 6A001.a.2.c—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with towed acoustic hydrophone arrays, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

texts.zh: (vi) 6A001.a.2.f——为与海底或海湾电缆系统实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
texts.en: (vi) 6A001.a.2.f—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with bottom or bay cable systems, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

texts.zh: (viii) 6B008。
texts.en: (viii) 6B008.

texts.zh: (ix) 6D001——为“开发”或“生产”6B008所列设备而“专门设计”的“软件”。
texts.en: (ix) 6D001—“Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by 6B008.

texts.zh: (xi) 6E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”本补充文件所述6A、6B或6D条款所列设备或“软件”的“技术”。
texts.en: (xi) 6E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” of equipment or “software” specified by the 6A, 6B, or 6D provisions described in this Supplement.

texts.zh: (xii) 6E002——根据通用技术说明，用于“生产”本补充文件所述6A或6B条款所列设备的“技术”。
texts.en: (xii) 6E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment specified by the 6A or 6B provisions described in this Supplement.
(4) Category 7
(5) Category 8

texts.zh: (iv) 8D001——为“开发”或“生产”8A001.b、8A001.c.1或8A002.o.3.b所列设备而专门设计的“软件”。
texts.en: (iv) 8D001—“Software” specially designed for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by 8A001.b, 8A001.c.1, or 8A002.o.3.b.

texts.zh: (v) 8E001——根据《通用技术说明》，用于8A001.b、8A001.c.1或8A002.o.3.b所列设备的“开发”或“生产”的“技术”。
texts.en: (v) 8E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by 8A001.b, 8A001.c.1, or 8A002.o.3.b.
(6) Category 9

texts.zh: (ii) 9D001——为“开发”9A011、9E003.a.1或9E003.a.3.a所列设备或“技术”而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”。
texts.en: (ii) 9D001—“Software” “specially designed” or modified for the “development” of equipment or “technology” specified by 9A011, 9E003.a.1, or 9E003.a.3.a.

texts.zh: (iii) 9D002——为“生产”9A011所列设备而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”。
texts.en: (iii) 9D002—“Software” “specially designed” or modified for the “production” of equipment specified by 9A011.

texts.zh: (iv) 9E001——根据《通用技术说明》，用于“开发”9A011或本附件对9D001或9D002的描述所列设备或“软件”的“技术”。
texts.en: (iv) 9E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology note for the “development” of equipment or “software” specified by 9A011 or this Supplement's description of 9D001 or 9D002.

texts.zh: (v) 9E002——根据《通用技术说明》，用于“生产”9A011所列设备的“技术”。
texts.en: (v) 9E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment specified by 9A011.

texts.zh: 中国模块与美国模块各自独立；中文/英文仅切换同一模块的阅读语言。同一个产品可能需要分别完成两套审查。
texts.en: The China and U.S. modules are separate legal systems. Chinese/English changes the reading language within a module. A product may require separate reviews under both systems.

texts.zh: 准备商品名称、型号、主要材料/成分、性能参数、软件/技术内容、交易方向、目的地及最终用户/用途。有编码先查编码；无编码先查功能或材料。
texts.en: Prepare the item name, model, materials/composition, performance specifications, software/technology content, transaction direction, destination, and end user/use. Search a known code first; otherwise start with function or material.

texts.zh: 使用表头筛选箭头，按类别、物项类型、编码、名称、关键词筛选。Ctrl+F可改为搜索整个工作簿。命中只是候选结果；翻译名称和关键词不替代正式条文。
texts.en: Use column filters for category, item group, code, name, and keywords. Ctrl+F can search the entire workbook. A match is only a candidate; translated names and keywords do not replace the governing text.

texts.zh: 打开条文/子项，连同上级条件、技术注释、定义、排除项及交叉引用一起读。核对“全部/任一”“且/或”、>与≥、单位、纯度及测试条件。
texts.en: Open the provision/subitem and read its parent conditions, technical notes, definitions, exclusions, and cross-references. Check all/any, and/or, > versus ≥, units, purity, and test conditions.

texts.zh: 记录候选代码、命中子项、技术证据、未确认参数、目的地和用户/用途；完成各模块的交易审查后才能形成许可结论。找不到时扩大关键词并复核附件外规则。
texts.en: Record the candidate code, relevant subparagraph, technical evidence, unknown specifications, destination, and end user/use. Complete the module-specific transaction review before reaching a licensing conclusion. If no match appears, broaden the search and check rules outside the attachments.

texts.zh: 先按Part 734判断物项/活动是否受EAR管辖，不能只看发货国或品牌国籍。美国境外物项可能涉及美国原产内容最低比例规则或外国直接产品规则，须按具体条件判断。
texts.en: Determine whether the item/activity is subject to the EAR under Part 734. Shipment origin or brand nationality alone is insufficient. Items outside the United States may fall under de minimis or foreign-direct product rules, subject to their specific conditions.

texts.zh: 依附件4审查顺序、附件2通则、Part 772定义和具体条目确定ECCN及子项。只有受EAR管辖但不列入CCL的物项才使用EAR99；EAR99不是免证结论。
texts.en: Use Supplement 4’s order of review, Supplement 2’s notes, Part 772 definitions, and the specific entry to determine the ECCN and subparagraph. EAR99 applies to items subject to the EAR but not listed on the CCL; it is not a no-license conclusion.

texts.zh: 读取适用于该子项的License Requirements，按所列Country Chart列号核对Part 738附件1；同时遵守条目中不依赖国家表的特别要求，并查Part 742。
texts.en: Read the License Requirements applicable to the subparagraph and check the specified Country Chart columns in Supplement 1 to Part 738. Also apply entry-specific requirements that operate outside the chart and consult Part 742.

texts.zh: 查Part 744最终用户/用途限制及相关名单、Part 746禁运和专项管制，并结合Part 736一般禁止规定。Country Chart未标X、EAR99或民用用途均不能自动跳过这一步。
texts.en: Check Part 744 end-user/end-use restrictions and relevant lists, Part 746 embargoes and special controls, and Part 736 general prohibitions. No Country Chart X, an EAR99 designation, or a civilian use does not eliminate this step.

texts.zh: 有许可要求时，再核对Part 740具体许可证例外全文、§740.2限制、目的地/用户条件及通知、报告、记录义务。满足全部适用条件才可使用；否则评估申请许可及审批政策。禁止交易须另行处理。
texts.en: Where a license is required, check the full exception in Part 740, §740.2 restrictions, destination/user conditions, and notification, reporting, and recordkeeping duties. Use an exception only if all applicable conditions are met; otherwise assess licensing and review policy. Address prohibited transactions separately.

texts.zh: 中国中文和美国英文保留来源文本；跨语言译文为辅助阅读译文。最终分类应回到对应法域正式文本，重点复核译文中的逻辑连接词、否定词、专门定义及参数。
texts.en: The Chinese source text for China and the English source text for the U.S. are retained. Cross-language translations are reading aids. Final classification should return to the governing jurisdiction’s text, especially logical operators, negatives, defined terms, and specifications.

texts.zh: HTML包含15 CFR §§774.1、774.2以及Part 774附件1—7：CCL、通用技术/软件注释、理解声明、审查顺序、0Y521临时列管表、敏感清单和特别敏感清单。
texts.en: The HTML contains 15 CFR §§774.1 and 774.2 and Supplements 1–7 to Part 774: the CCL, General Technology/Software Notes, Statements of Understanding, Order of Review, 0Y521 entries, the Sensitive List, and the Very Sensitive List.

texts.zh: Part 734管辖规则、Part 738国家表、Part 740许可证例外全文/国家组别、Part 744名单及最终用途、Part 746禁运、Part 772定义等未在附件中完整提供。工作簿提供入口和解释，不声称已收录全部这些规则。
texts.en: The attachment does not provide the full Part 734 jurisdiction rules, Part 738 Country Chart, Part 740 exceptions/country groups, Part 744 lists/end-use controls, Part 746 embargoes, or Part 772 definitions. The workbook provides guidance and links, not complete coverage of those rules.

texts.zh: HTML元数据路径使用/on/2026-10-15；这只是展示版本日期。不能据此声称所有条款均于该日生效，或工作簿覆盖截至2026-10-19的全部现行管制。应按交易日期核查修订、过渡和实施安排。
texts.en: The HTML metadata uses /on/2026-10-15, identifying the displayed version. It does not establish a common effective date for all provisions or complete coverage of controls in force on October 19, 2026. Check amendments, transition rules, and implementation arrangements for the transaction date.

texts.zh: 附件1开头链接至2026年7月23日的91 FR 46261。附件未提供该公告全文；不能仅凭该链接判断修订是否已编入或何时适用。本轮网络工具未能打开该公告正文。
texts.en: Supplement 1 links to 91 FR 46261, dated July 23, 2026. The attachment omits the notice’s full text; the link alone does not establish incorporation or applicability. The notice text could not be retrieved through the web tool during this review.

texts.zh: HTML编辑注明示：88 FR 71936（2023年10月18日）修订9A005，但由于缺失文字未能编入。涉及9A005须回查该公告和后续更正；不得把当前展示文本标成无保留的完整现行规则。
texts.en: An HTML editorial note states that the 9A005 amendment at 88 FR 71936 (October 18, 2023) could not be incorporated because text was missing. Review that notice and subsequent corrections for 9A005; do not represent the displayed entry as unqualifiedly complete current law.

texts.zh: 中美有相似类别、技术术语甚至同形代码，但规则来源、范围、阈值、例外和交易限制可能不同。相同代码只可作为跨模块查找线索，不能自动映射为同一管制结论。
texts.en: Similar categories, technical terms, and even identical-looking codes may have different legal bases, scope, thresholds, exclusions, and transaction restrictions. A matching code is only a cross-module research lead, not an equivalent classification.

texts.zh: 不一定。先确认EAR适用，再根据具体子项、管制原因、目的地、最终用户/用途及专项规则判断。
texts.en: No. First confirm EAR jurisdiction, then assess the specific subparagraph, control reasons, destination, end user/use, and special rules.

texts.zh: 不等于。EAR99表示受EAR管辖但未列入CCL；最终用户/用途或目的地限制仍可触发许可。
texts.en: No. EAR99 means subject to the EAR but not listed on the CCL. End-user/end-use or destination restrictions may still require a license.

texts.zh: 不能。需核对Part 734，包括美国原产内容最低比例规则和外国直接产品规则的具体适用条件。
texts.en: No. Review Part 734, including the specific conditions of the de minimis and foreign-direct product rules.

texts.zh: 不能。本CCL按物项功能、性能和其他条件分类；HS/HTS/Schedule B属于不同用途的海关编码体系。
texts.en: No. The CCL classifies items using functions, performance, and other criteria. HS/HTS/Schedule B are customs systems serving different purposes.

texts.zh: 不能仅据此判断。还须看条目的特别许可要求、Part 744、Part 746、一般禁止规定及其他适用制度。
texts.en: Not on that basis alone. Check entry-specific requirements, Parts 744 and 746, the General Prohibitions, and other applicable regimes.

texts.zh: 不可以。它只是条目层面的资格提示；仍须满足Part 740相应例外的全部条件、§740.2限制及交易涉及的其他要求。
texts.en: No. It is an entry-level eligibility indication. All conditions of the relevant Part 740 exception, §740.2 restrictions, and other transaction requirements must be met.

texts.zh: 不宜这样概括。它通常针对该栏列示的具体例外；CCL栏不是所有可能例外的穷尽清单。应查Part 740和其他限制。
texts.en: Do not generalize. It generally addresses the particular exception shown. The CCL section is not an exhaustive list of all possible exceptions; consult Part 740 and other restrictions.

texts.zh: 不自动。除了条目金额限制，还须核对LVS全文的交易、数量/累计、目的地等条件及§740.2；不得只按单张发票金额判断。
texts.en: No. Besides the entry’s value limit, check the full LVS transaction, quantity/aggregate, destination, and other conditions and §740.2. An individual invoice amount is not sufficient.

texts.zh: 不能。该栏可能指向其他ECCN、ITAR或其他机构权限，影响分类范围和主管制度。
texts.en: No. It may refer to other ECCNs, the ITAR, or another agency’s jurisdiction, affecting classification and the governing regime.

texts.zh: 不是。应按Part 772的专门定义和适用条目审查，包括定义中的纳入与排除条件；不能只看营销描述。
texts.en: No. Apply the Part 772 definition and the relevant entry, including the definition’s inclusion and release provisions. Marketing descriptions alone are insufficient.

texts.zh: 通常不够。标题可能要求查看List of Items Controlled；还需技术注释、相关定义、相关管制和上级条件。
texts.en: Usually not. A heading may direct you to the List of Items Controlled. Read technical notes, related definitions/controls, and parent conditions as well.

texts.zh: 不表示。它是保留位置或已撤销条目的编排标识；还需检查现行其他条目及主管机构。
texts.en: No. It is an editorial placeholder or former entry. Review other applicable entries and agency jurisdiction.

texts.zh: 不一定。§774.1及部分条目保留对其他机构管辖事项的指引；应记录交叉引用状态，沿指引核查。
texts.en: Not necessarily. Section 774.1 and some entries retain references to items under other agencies’ jurisdiction. Record that status and follow the reference.

texts.zh: 不是。Part 774附件6、7列示特定既有条目或子项；它们不取代附件1的技术范围，可能影响相关许可证例外等规则。
texts.en: No. Supplements 6 and 7 identify existing entries or subparagraphs. They do not replace Supplement 1’s technical scope and may affect rules such as license-exception eligibility.

texts.zh: 0Y521是系列简称；按物项类型使用0A521、0B521、0C521、0D521或0E521，并核对附件5具体物项及其日期条件。
texts.en: 0Y521 is a series shorthand. Use 0A521, 0B521, 0C521, 0D521, or 0E521 according to item type and check Supplement 5’s item-specific dates and conditions.

texts.zh: 去Part 738附件1，而不是Part 774。新增HTML未包含该国家表全文；本表只提供规则入口，不能离线自动给出国家许可结论。
texts.en: Use Supplement 1 to Part 738, not Part 774. The added HTML omits the chart’s full text; the workbook provides a link, not an automatic offline destination-licensing determination.

texts.zh: 不能这样判断。Part 734涵盖特定技术/源代码的释放、传输及视同出口/再出口；按具体事实和定义核查。
texts.en: No. Part 734 addresses certain releases and transmissions of technology/source code and deemed exports/reexports. Assess the specific facts and definitions.

texts.zh: 不能。按实际功能、技术门槛、类别5第2部分注释、相关软件/技术条目和适用定义核对；适用大众市场等规则时仍须满足全部条件。
texts.en: No. Review actual functions, thresholds, Category 5 Part 2 notes, related software/technology entries, and definitions. Mass-market and similar provisions require all applicable conditions to be met.

texts.zh: 不是。它来自HTML版本路径；条款可能有各自生效、合规或过渡安排，且附件存在修订链接与9A005编辑缺口。
texts.en: No. It comes from the HTML’s version path. Provisions may have distinct effective, compliance, or transition dates, and the attachment includes an amendment link and a 9A005 editorial gap.

texts.zh: 不能。新增附件是Part 774，不含完整Part 744或其他机构制裁名单。应按交易日期另查名单、主体身份及适用限制。
texts.en: No. The added attachment is Part 774 and does not contain the full Part 744 or other agencies’ sanctions lists. Separately screen parties, identities, and applicable restrictions as of the transaction date.

texts.zh: 不能。分别核对两国条文和交易规则。例如同形代码不保证阈值、排除条款、管制原因或目的地要求相同。
texts.en: No. Review each jurisdiction’s text and transaction rules separately. Identical-looking codes do not ensure matching thresholds, exclusions, control reasons, or destination requirements.

texts.zh: 回到对应法域来源文本及适用法规，标记翻译疑点；不能用另一个法域的近似条文纠正或替代。
texts.en: Return to the relevant jurisdiction’s source text and applicable law, and flag the translation issue. Do not substitute a similar provision from the other jurisdiction.

texts.zh: CCL条目标识；须进一步确定子项和适用条件。
texts.en: The identifier of a CCL entry; determine the applicable subparagraph and conditions as well.

texts.zh: 受EAR管辖但未在CCL列明物项的指定标识；不是许可证例外。
texts.en: A designation for items subject to the EAR but not listed on the CCL; not a license exception.

texts.zh: 交易经审查无须BIS许可时的许可状态；与物项分类EAR99不是同一概念。
texts.en: A licensing status for a transaction determined not to require a BIS license; distinct from the EAR99 item designation.

texts.zh: EAR规定的附条件授权；适用资格及义务应查完整条款。
texts.en: A conditional authorization under the EAR; read the full provision for eligibility and obligations.

texts.zh: Part 738附件1，按目的地和管制原因列示相关许可触发；并非全部许可要求。
texts.en: Supplement 1 to Part 738; identifies certain destination/reason-based license triggers, not every licensing requirement.

texts.zh: Part 740附件1的国家分组；不同于Part 738国家表。
texts.en: Country groupings in Supplement 1 to Part 740; different from the Part 738 Country Chart.

texts.zh: ECCN的许可分析字段，如NS、AT、NP；须看其适用子项和特别要求。
texts.en: An ECCN licensing field, such as NS, AT, or NP; check the relevant subparagraphs and special requirements.

texts.zh: 指向其他ECCN或机构管辖规则；不只是备注。
texts.en: References to other ECCNs or agency jurisdiction; substantive guidance, not merely background.

texts.zh: 具体ECCN特有的定义或参数；还须查Part 772及适用通则。
texts.en: Definitions or parameters specific to an ECCN; also consult Part 772 and applicable general notes.

texts.zh: 说明EAR的管辖范围；本身不等于需要许可证。
texts.en: Describes EAR jurisdiction; does not itself mean a license is required.

texts.zh: 特定外国制造物项内美国原产受控内容的管辖规则；不能只用一个通用百分比。
texts.en: Jurisdiction rules for controlled U.S.-origin content in certain foreign-made items; no single percentage applies universally.

texts.zh: 特定外国生产物项基于指定技术/软件、生产设备等联系及其他条件而受EAR管辖的规则。
texts.en: Rules bringing certain foreign-produced items within EAR jurisdiction based on specified technology/software, production connections, and other conditions.

texts.zh: 用于通关商品归类的编号；国家延伸位数可能不同；不等于出口管制代码。
texts.en: A code used for customs classification, with country-specific extensions; not an export control code.

texts.zh: 化学物质检索线索；不能替代对浓度、混合物、形态及用途等条件的核对。
texts.en: A chemical identity search aid; it does not replace checks of concentration, mixtures, form, use, and other criteria.

texts.zh: 用于理解范围、参数或测试方式；须连同主条文阅读。
texts.en: Notes explaining scope, parameters, or test methods; read with the operative provision.

texts.zh: 0A617的UN表格引用§764.1(b)。原文照录；该引用需与适用的联合国管制条款核对。
texts.en: The UN row for 0A617 cites §764.1(b). This source citation is preserved and should be checked against the applicable UN-control provision.

texts.zh: 0E606的STA段落写“any technology in 0D606”。中英文均保留0D606，未擅自改为0E606。
texts.en: The STA paragraph of 0E606 says “any technology in 0D606.” Both languages retain 0D606 without silently changing it to 0E606.

texts.zh: 1A004的CB表格句子止于“that also have the technical characteristic”，未列出该特征。表内保留这一缺口，不能据此补造条件。
texts.en: The CB row for 1A004 ends with “that also have the technical characteristic” without specifying that characteristic. The omission is retained; no missing criterion is invented.

texts.zh: 1C002.c.1.a的HTML文字为“109 alloy particles”，该处没有上标标签。中英文保留109并标注核查，不擅自认定为10^9。
texts.en: The HTML for 1C002.c.1.a says “109 alloy particles,” without superscript markup at that position. Both languages preserve 109 and flag it for review, rather than assuming 10^9.

texts.zh: 2A984的Related Controls使用100m处小于0.1mrad；2D984、2E984的Related Controls使用小于0.5mrad。各条按其原文保留，不统一阈值。
texts.en: Related Controls in 2A984 use less than 0.1 mrad at 100 m, while 2D984 and 2E984 use less than 0.5 mrad. Each entry retains its own source threshold.

texts.zh: 1C003.b.1原文写作“5 × 104^{−4}”。保留该上标结构，不自行改写数值。
texts.en: 1C003.b.1 prints “5 × 104^{−4}.” The superscript structure is preserved without a numerical correction.

texts.zh: 1C010定义中的温湿度使用“+”；中英文均保留，不自动替换为±。
texts.en: The temperature/humidity notation in the 1C010 definition uses “+.” Both languages retain it rather than replacing it with ±.

texts.zh: 1C111.a.2原文尺寸单位写作“60µ”，缺少通常接续的m。按原文保留并提示回查。
texts.en: The source for 1C111.a.2 prints “60µ,” without a following m. The notation is retained and flagged for source review.

texts.zh: 3A069的GBS栏引用3A999中的RS管制；保留该原文引用，未改为3A069。
texts.en: The GBS provision in 3A069 cites RS control in 3A999. The source citation is retained without changing it to 3A069.

texts.zh: 1C350关于氟化氢的注释引用1C350.d.14，而同一文件中氟化氢列于d.15。译文保留原引用。
texts.en: The hydrogen fluoride note in 1C350 cites 1C350.d.14, while the chemical is listed at d.15 in the same source. The translation retains the source citation.

texts.zh: 1C355标题引用“22 CFR parts”但缺少部分编号；未补写。
texts.en: The heading of 1C355 says “22 CFR parts” without part numbers. No missing number is supplied.

texts.zh: 3A090注1(d)在推定受控的条件中仍使用“below 30/35/40 billion”；与前文解除推定条件的方向存在疑点。中英文保留原阈值方向；不补造2028年条件。
texts.en: Note 1(d) to 3A090 uses “below 30/35/40 billion” in the presumption provision, creating a directional concern relative to preceding provisions. Both languages retain the source direction; no 2028 criterion is invented.

texts.zh: 9A119标题同时使用“greater than 300 km or greater”；按原文保留，不擅自改为“大于等于300km”。
texts.en: The 9A119 heading says “greater than 300 km or greater.” The source wording is retained without changing it to equal to or greater than 300 km.

texts.zh: 9A515相关管制段含“UMSL”字样；保留并注明疑似USML拼写问题。
texts.en: Related Controls for 9A515 contain “UMSL.” The spelling is retained and identified as a possible USML typo.

texts.zh: 9D003相关管制段含“22 CRR”字样；保留并注明疑似22 CFR拼写问题。
texts.en: Related Controls for 9D003 contain “22 CRR.” The spelling is retained and identified as a possible 22 CFR typo.
